title: Service Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Anton Paar develops, produces and distributes highly accurate laboratory instruments and process measuring systems, and provides custom-tailored automation and robotic solutions. It is the world leader in the measurement of density, concentration and CO2 and in the field of rheometry.
  
  
At Anton Paar India, we are responsible for the distribution process, including sales, service, customer and application support, and logistics.
  
  
You may visit our website for more information at http://www.anton-paar.com/
  
  
Also, you may like to have a glimpse about the culture at Anton Paar India at https://www.anton-paar.com/in-en/jobs/corporations/working-at-anton-paar-india-pvt-ltd/
  
  
**Job Description**
This role is responsible for the installation and maintenance of the instruments, preventive maintenance as well as other after-sales technical support solutions to the customers. They are responsible for establishing and maintaining proper business relationships with customers in order to address their inquiries, concerns and requests from time to time.
  
  
Perform installation, calibration, maintenance and repair of the instruments and parts via visits, telephone and/or email.
  
  

* Ensuring high level of customer satisfaction for all instruments in the assigned product lines, designated territory and customer accounts.
* Serving as the primary customer contact for technical and service issues for the product lines, designated territory and customer accounts.
* Identifying, managing and coordinating with various departments in the company to resolve customer concerns proactively.
* Ensuring that the maximum number of instruments from the assigned product lines and territory are covered under Annual Maintenance Contract.
* Taking responsibility and following-up for collection of service receivables.
* Quoting, negotiating and closing service contracts and repair charges with customers.
* Ensuring full compliance to CRM and AP Service processes, workflows and guidelines.
* Ensuring monitoring and managing of CRM saved searches to ensure proper check and control on various tasks.
* Strict adherence to all systems at AP
* Gaining and regularly updating a comprehensive technical knowledge of the assigned products.

Identifying and transferring leads and sales opportunities to members of the sales team.
  
  

* Communicating new service opportunities, special developments, information, or feedback gathered through field activity to appropriate colleagues.
* Ensuring timely and effective communication with customers and colleagues.
* Assist Sales Team in conducting demonstrations, when required.

**Qualifications**
Master’s/ Bachelor’s degree
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Must have - interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently and responsibly
* High commitment to customer satisfaction
* Willingness for extensive travel as per the work requirement throughout India

*We do not accept applications via personnel service providers or recruitment agencies and ask all interested parties to submit their documents directly via our career site.
  
  
Applications via personnel service providers will not be processed. As a matter of principle, we also do not hire temporary workers, but build on long-term, direct employment relationships.*

title: Specialist - SAP FI/CO
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Specialist - SAP FI/CO
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req28006**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Specialist in this position will be responsible for the support, end to end implementation and optimization of SAP FICO And SAP FICO configuration, continuous improvements and standardization of SAP FICO with the objective to increase business process efficiencies and to meet internal and external business reporting requirements and provide consulting expertise to business stakeholders in at least two SAP FI sub-modules and one CO module
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* You must have deep hands-on configuration experience in at least two SAP FI sub-modules and one CO sub-module. Good conceptual understanding of additional SAP FICO sub-modules.
* Along with hands-on configuration experience of the SAP FICO integration with at least one Procurement, Supply, Sales or HR module
* And solid consulting experience in two SAP FI sub-modules and one CO sub-module
* You must be a team player, strong intercultural communication and cooperation skills, very good command of English & German (optional) both written and spoken
* Possess in-depth knowledge of S/4 and SAP FICO standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming
* And knowledge of incident, change and release management processes and tools
* You will be required to imply waterfall and agile project management methodologies
* Must have strong analytical and conceptual thinking

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* You must have 3+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large-scale systems in the SAP FICO domain, at a minimum experience in one end-to-end large-scale S/4Hana migration project or one S/4Hana implementation project.
* You also must have experience in working with onshore as well as offshore teams
* Bachelor's degree in business informatics, Business Administration, or equivalent qualification
* And Global Certification(s) in Central Finance, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde Plc. is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2024 sales of $33 billion and 65,000 employees spread across multiple countries. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Head - Strategic Account Management & Growth( IT Services)
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Global Account Executive will be the senior strategic leader and single point of accountability for Company's relationship with the Client Group. The role will own the overall account strategy, P&L, executive relationships, profitable growth, customer success and delivery governance across the Client portfolio.

Lead Company's engagement across Client's diverse businesses,. The leader will mobilize Company's consulting, technology, engineering, cloud, digital, cybersecurity, data, AI and operations capabilities to position Company as a strategic transformation partner to the Group.

Strategic account: Client is one of Company's priority growth accounts in the India market, with significant untapped potential across the Group's businesses.

* P&L and Commercial Accountability
* Portfolio and Opportunity Leadership

Account revenue, order bookings, ACV/TCV, profitability and margin performance

Growth of the Client portfolio and Company's wallet share

Large-deal wins and multi-business transformation opportunities

Customer satisfaction, retention and executive relationship strength

Delivery performance, risk mitigation and escalation management

Account-team effectiveness, leadership development and succession readiness

GUJARAT SWITCHGEARS PVT LTD is an electrical manufacturing company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. description:
**Company Description**

The Technical Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for overseeing technical operations, laboratory activities, and service delivery. description:
**Head-Operations & Maintenance (District Cooling System**
)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad

**Function:**
Operations & Maintenance

**Business:**
District Cooling System (DCS)

**About the Role**

Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) is seeking a seasoned professional to lead Operations & Maintenance (O&M) for its growing District Cooling System (DCS) business.

This leadership role will be responsible for driving operational excellence, asset reliability, customer service, safety, and business performance across district cooling assets. The incumbent will lead operations strategy, maintenance planning, utility management, operational readiness of new projects, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient service delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Leadership:**

* Lead end-to-end Operations & Maintenance activities across District Cooling assets.
* Ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of cooling plants, chilled water networks, utility infrastructure, and associated systems.
* Drive operational excellence, plant performance, asset utilization, and service delivery.

**Asset Reliability & Maintenance:**

* Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance programs.
* Establish maintenance strategies to maximize equipment availability and lifecycle performance.
* Lead reliability improvement initiatives, root cause analysis, and operational optimization programs.
* Oversee maintenance planning, shutdown management, and critical spare management.

**Customer Service & Stakeholder Management:**

* Drive customer service excellence and ensure adherence to service level commitments.
* Build strong relationships with customers, off-takers, utility partners, OEMs, contractors, and service providers.
* Lead customer satisfaction and complaint resolution initiatives.

**Project Handover & Operational Readiness:**

* Support projects during design review, testing & commissioning, handover, and asset stabilization phases.

title: Project Lead
description:
**Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QAQC) Manager - Civil Works**
**JLL Project and Development Services**
**Position Overview**
The QAQC Manager for Civil Works ensures all civil construction activities within JLL's Project and Development Services portfolio meet specified quality standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations through systematic inspection, testing, and documentation processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Management & Compliance**
Develop and implement comprehensive quality assurance and quality control plans for civil works projects including site development, earthworks, utilities, paving, drainage, and related infrastructure. Ensure all construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, building codes, and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to verify conformance with quality standards and identify non-conformities requiring corrective action.
  
  
**Inspection & Testing Coordination**
Oversee field inspection activities for concrete works, soil compaction, underground utilities, asphalt paving, and other civil elements. Coordinate with third-party testing laboratories for materials testing including soil density tests, concrete cylinder breaks, aggregate gradation, and asphalt quality verification. Review and approve test results, ensuring they meet project specifications before authorizing work progression.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting**
Maintain comprehensive QAQC documentation including inspection reports, test results, material certifications, non-conformance reports, and corrective action records. Prepare regular quality reports for project managers, clients, and stakeholders summarizing inspection activities, test results, and quality metrics. Ensure all quality records are properly filed and readily accessible for audits and project closeout.
  
  
**Contractor Management**
Review contractor submittals for materials, equipment, and construction methodologies to verify compliance with specifications. Conduct pre-construction meetings with contractors and subcontractors to communicate quality expectations and inspection requirements. Monitor contractor quality control activities and verify their internal QC processes are effective.
  
  
**Standards & Procedures Development**
Develop and maintain QAQC procedures, checklists, and standards specific to civil works within JLL's Project and Development Services. Implement industry best practices and lessons learned from previous projects to continuously improve quality management processes. Train project teams on QAQC procedures and quality documentation requirements.
  
  
**Non-Conformance Management**
Identify deficiencies and non-conforming work through systematic inspections and testing programs. Issue non-conformance reports and work with contractors to develop acceptable corrective action plans. Verify implementation of corrective actions and document resolution of quality issues.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication**
Serve as the primary point of contact for quality-related matters with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Participate in project meetings to provide quality status updates and address quality concerns. Coordinate with design teams to resolve constructability issues or specification clarifications affecting quality.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field required. Minimum 8-10 years of experience in quality assurance/quality control for civil construction projects. Prior experience with project and development services or construction management firms preferred.
  
  
**Technical Knowledge**
Thorough understanding of civil construction methods, materials, and specifications for earthworks, concrete, asphalt, utilities, and site development. Knowledge of relevant building codes, standards (ACI, ASTM, AASHTO), and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with construction testing procedures and acceptance criteria for civil works materials.
  
  
**Professional Certifications**
Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent professional certification preferred. QAQC-related certifications (CQM, CQA, or similar) highly desirable. Current knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems beneficial.
  
  
**Skills & Competencies**
Strong analytical skills with attention to detail for reviewing technical documents and identifying quality issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and interfacing with diverse stakeholders. Proficiency in quality management software, inspection tools, and Microsoft Office suite. Ability to read and interpret civil engineering drawings and specifications.
  
  
**Working Conditions**
Position requires regular site visits to active construction sites with exposure to outdoor weather conditions and construction hazards. Must be able to walk construction sites, climb ladders, and access all areas requiring inspection. Some travel between multiple project sites may be required depending on portfolio assignments.
  
  
*This position supports JLL's commitment to delivering exceptional project outcomes through rigorous quality management and continuous improvement in civil works construction.*

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) is a leading player in India’s power transmission and energy infrastructure sector, enabling seamless and efficient energy flow across the nation. With a strong presence in both operational and under-construction projects, AESL manages over 20,000 circuit kilometers of transmission lines and substations. As a part of the Adani Group, AESL is driven by the philosophy of #GrowthWithGoodness, aiming to build a sustainable and resilient energy future. Maintain strict adherence to safety and quality standards by implementing site-wide safety protocols and creating a zero-harm environment.

Build strong relationships with government authorities by engaging local government bodies, and coordinating with power grid operators and load dispatch centers for smooth system operations and substation charging.
  
  
Support interdepartmental collaboration by maintaining effective communication with internal departments and aligning on project goals.

Ensure cost efficiency by preparing and managing project budgets, tracking expenses, and controlling cash flow to align with project schedules.
  
  
Maintain accuracy in resource allocation by reconciling materials, overseeing billing, and ensuring compliance with budgetary guidelines.
  
  
**Risk Management**
Ensure project safety by rigorously implementing site-wide safety protocols and conducting regular safety audits, fostering a zero-harm environment for all personnel.
  
  
Minimize potential project delays by proactively identifying and assessing risks, allowing for timely mitigation strategies to be enacted throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**Technology Integration And Innovation**
Enhance project efficiency by integrating advanced project management software and tools, facilitating real-time monitoring and communication among all stakeholders.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement in project execution by adopting innovative techniques and technologies, resulting in optimized workflows and reduced operational costs.
  
  
**Team Management**
Foster a collaborative, productive team environment by coordinating with team members, providing guidance, and facilitating interdepartmental communication.
  
  
Support continuous learning and skill development by providing coaching, encouraging teamwork, and maintaining a respectful, cohesive work culture.

P8-M department
  
  
Engineering
  
  
HO
  
  
HODs

EPC Contractor
  
  
Electrical Inspector
  
  
OEM
  
  
STU
  
  
CTU
  
  
SLDC
  
  
NRLDC

B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering.

10-15 years of experience in electrical project execution, preferably within the substation, power transmission, or energy infrastructure sectors, with at least 3-5 years focused on high-voltage substation projects (e.g., 765/400 kV).
  
  
Proven experience in managing on-site electrical works, quality control, and safety protocols within large-scale infrastructure or utility projects.
  
  
Strong knowledge of quality, safety, and regulatory standards for substation projects, Experience coordinating with contractors, government authorities, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Familiarity with project management tools and site reporting systems for effective project tracking and execution.

title: Lead product Designer
description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Lowe's Commerce Solutions, we empower businesses with cutting-edge technology solutions, proven at scale, to accelerate growth, enhance omnichannel customer experience, and optimize operations. We offer a comprehensive suite of modular, easily integrable and cost-effective solutions, including checkout systems, retail SaaS, and AI-powered products, to transform businesses for the future.
  
  
Elevate your retail digital transformation with Lowe's Commerce Solutions.
  
  

* Drive seamless omnichannel expansion.
* Our solutions are tested and trusted in real-world retail environments.
* Effortlessly integrate with your existing systems.

**I. Job Summary**
The Lead Product Designer provides consultation and direction on translating business requirements into effective product designs. This includes responsibility for driving design decisions and leading the overall delivery of high-quality user flows, user journeys, wireframes, supporting visuals, prototypes, and pixel-perfect design comps for their portfolio.
  
  
This role serves as a product design expert for project teams throughout the process of conceptualizing and building product design solutions. The Lead drives the user experience (UX) process and participates in cross-functional prioritization and planning.
  
  
In addition, the Lead guides the development and delivery of design solutions for various complex technology applications across different business areas. The Lead Product Designer works with designers, engineers, product, content designers, researchers, and other UX teams to lead the delivery of assigned design projects promptly and efficiently and often provides creative approval of work completed by others on the design team.
  
  
II. Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  

* Oversees and consults on the architecture and design of high-quality and engaging experiences for customers and associates.
* Leads multiple design projects that span products or product groups. Reviews and signs off on high-impact, high-visibility design projects.
* Drives utilization of best practices and advanced knowledge to build user flows, wireframes, design comps, and low-fidelity prototypes to ensure products deliver optimal experiences; may lead efforts to improve product design best practices.
* Resolves complex design problems that span design projects at the product portfolio level; simplifies, optimizes, and removes bottlenecks for projects and project teams.
* Drives collaboration across UX, development, and product teams to maintain a cohesive design and experience throughout the product portfolio.
* Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders for UX planning and prioritization; aligns UX portfolio to agile processes.
* Coaches, guides, and mentor's junior-level team members; shares an in-depth understanding of company and industry methodologies, policies, standards, and controls.

III. Years of Experience
  
  
**8+ years of experience**
IV. Education Qualification & Certifications
  
  
**Required Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, CIS, or related field, or equivalent work experience in a related field.

V. Skill Set Required
  
  

* UX / Product Design: Own end-to-end UX from problem definition through validated solution.
* User Research: Interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing, persona/JTBD development.
* Interaction Design: User flows, task flows, information architecture, complex interaction patterns.
* UI / Visual Design: Strong typography, layout, hierarchy, responsive design and visual consistency
* Prototyping: High-fidelity interactive prototypes for validation and stakeholder alignment.
* Design SystemsBuild, govern and scale components, patterns, tokens and design standards
* Figma: Advanced Figma, components, variants, Auto Layout, variables and libraries
* Usability & Accessibility: WCAG/accessibility principles and inclusive design.
* Product Thinking: Translate business problems and user needs into effective product experiences.
* Design Leadership: Design reviews, mentoring, quality standards and influencing design direction.
* Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate design rationale to Product, Engineering and executives.
* Data-Driven Design: Use research, analytics, experimentation and usability findings to drive decisions

Secondary Skills (Desired)
  
  

* HTML/CSS: Good understanding of implementation constraints; coding expertise isn't mandatory.
* JavaScript / Front-End Concepts: Understand component-based applications and technical feasibility.
* React / Mobile Design Concepts: Familiarity with reusable components and web/mobile implementation patterns
* Analytics: Familiarity with tools/concepts such as funnels, conversion, engagement and behavioral analytics
* A/B Testing: Ability to define hypotheses and evaluate design alternatives.
* Motion / Micro-interactions: Understanding transitions, feedback states and interaction behaviors.
* AI-Assisted Design: Effective use of emerging AI tools for ideation, prototyping and design workflows
* Agile / Product Development: Strong collaboration within Product–Design–Engineering delivery teams.
* Design Documentation: Clear specifications, interaction rules and developer handoffs
* Domain Understanding: Ability to quickly understand complex business workflows and translate them into intuitive experiences

*Lowe's is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.*
Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

title: Motion Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Vervotech, a Constellation Inc company, specializes in transforming complex, messy supplier data into clean, conversion-focused inventory for travel and related industries. Its Vervotech Mapping solution helps clients standardize and enrich data to improve customer experience and booking performance. The Profit Maximizer product focuses on turning every confirmed booking into additional margin, enhancing profitability for partners. Together, these solutions enable data-driven growth and more efficient operations for organizations seeking to optimize inventory and revenue.

**What you’ll do**

***Brand language***

* Define and own Vervotech’s visual language: type, colour, layout, iconography, how we show product UI, and how things move.
* Turn it into a working Figma system with components, styles and templates that the team uses for social, events, decks and emails.
* Keep the brand guidelines current and make sure everything we ship looks like one company.

***Website and landing pages***

* Design flagship pages for the website rebuild: home, product pages and key landing pages.
* Design campaign landing pages fast, without breaking the system.
* Hand off in Figma Dev Mode with responsive layouts and motion specs, so the developer builds exactly what you designed. Then review the live page against your file.

***Motion***

* Animate our short product videos for LinkedIn, Instagram and the website. The current series uses kinetic type on white, a keyword that grows on a yellow block as it types, a product UI shot, a typed answer and a clean end card. You’ll take scripts from growth marketing and turn them into finished spots.
* Cut music to picture so the final hit lands on the end card and nothing audibly breaks.
* Deliver every video in several formats: square, 9:16 and 16:9, up to 4K at 60fps, with clear space for ad CTAs and captions.
* Prototype scroll and hover animation for the website.
* Build motion templates so a new video takes days, not weeks.

**What you need**

* **Original work. This matters more than anything else on this list.**
  Most B2B SaaS design looks the same right now: purple gradients, glassy cards, floating 3D shapes, AI-generated hero art, the same Dribbble layout with a different logo. We want someone whose work you’d recognise without seeing the name on it. Show us ideas that came from understanding the product, and a look you built around that idea. If your portfolio could be swapped with ten others and nobody would notice, this role isn’t the right fit.
* 2+ years of design experience across brand, web or motion
* Strong After Effects, especially kinetic typography and UI animation
* Strong Figma: components, variables, auto layout, and responsive web design
* At least one website or landing page you designed that went live
* An eye for timing. You can tell when a cut is four frames late.
* The confidence to push back on a brief when the design or the copy isn’t working

**How to apply**

Apply here, or send your work to sahil@vervotech.com.

**What happens next:**

1. We review every application and shortlist profiles.
2. Shortlisted candidates get an AI interview as the first round of screening.
3. We reach out directly to the candidates selected from that round for the next steps

title: Design Lead, Z Security
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
A career in IBM Z is built on shaping critical technology that underpins the global economy. Over 70 percent of global transactional workloads and leading financial, healthcare, and public sector organizations rely on IBM Z and LinuxONE for unmatched security, resilience, and operational scale.
  
  
As the Design Lead in IBM Z and LinuxONE Security and Automation, you will lead the user experience (UX) and product design for next-generation security and identity management offerings tailored to IBM Z enterprise clients. In this role, you will transform complex mainframe access graphs, telemetry signals, and security policy workflows into intuitive, efficient, and modern user experiences. You will collaborate closely with upstream product design teams, IBM Z product managers, technical architects, and enterprise clients to define and deliver enterprise-grade software interfaces that meet the rigorous operational standards of mainframe practitioners and security administrators worldwide.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Lead End-to-End Product Design: Own the UX and visual design strategy for IBM Z security products, creating user journeys, interaction models, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes that simplify complex administrative and observability tasks.
* Design for Mainframe and Security Personas: Deeply understand the operational needs of RACF administrators, mainframe system programmers, CISOs, and enterprise SecOps analysts, designing workflows that accelerate threat detection, access audits, and policy remediation.
* Collaborate with Upstream Design Teams: Partner with upstream platform design teams to maintain design system consistency, aligning Z-specific user workflows with the broader platform design language and IBM Carbon Design System standards.
* Conduct User Research and Validation: Plan and execute user research, usability testing, and concept validation sessions with enterprise mainframe clients to gather actionable feedback and iteratively refine product workflows.
* Partner with Engineering and Product: Collaborate daily with Product Management and Engineering squads to ensure design feasibility, articulate detailed design specifications, and support front-end implementation through agile delivery cycles.
* Champion Accessibility and Design Quality: Ensure all user interfaces adhere to strict accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA) and uphold high standards of visual craftsmanship, consistency, and clarity.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
'- Senior Product Design Experience: 5 or more years of experience in product design, interaction design, or UX architecture for complex B2B enterprise software, developer tools, or data-intensive platforms.
  
  

* Design Systems and Prototyping Tools: Advanced proficiency in industry-standard design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), with proven experience utilizing and contributing to comprehensive enterprise design systems.
* User Research and Usability Testing: Strong track record of planning, conducting, and synthesizing qualitative user research, concept testing, and usability evaluations with specialized technical users.
* Information Architecture and Complex Workflows: Demonstrated ability to structure complex data models, identity relationship graphs, and dense dashboards into clear, task-oriented navigation and visualizations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong collaboration skills working closely with product managers, software engineers, and technical architects to balance user needs with engineering feasibility.
* Aptitude for Mainframe and Security Systems: A strong curiosity and willingness to learn IBM Z security concepts, z/OS administrative workflows, and enterprise access governance.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
'- Security and Observability UX: Prior experience designing interfaces for cybersecurity tools, identity and access management (IAM), log analytics, SIEM platforms, or observability dashboards.
  
  

* IBM Carbon Design System: Familiarity with the IBM Carbon Design System or similar enterprise-grade design frameworks.
* Enterprise IT and Mainframe Context: Prior exposure to enterprise infrastructure, Linux environments, or IBM Z mainframe user workflows.
* Front-End Understanding: Basic familiarity with modern front-end technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) to facilitate seamless design-to-development handoffs.

title: Customer Insight Analyst
description:
**About the team:**

The Customer Insights & Experience (CX) team is the voice of the customer inside Decathlon India. We bridge the gap between raw customer data and strategic business decisions turning feedback, behavioral analytics, and qualitative research into experiences that delight users and drive long-term loyalty.

Working closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Support, we don’t just report on what customers are doing; we uncover why they do it and champion the changes that make their journey effortless.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a data-driven, empathetic Customer Insights Analyst to uncover the "why" behind customer behavior.

You will bridge the gap between raw behavioral data and direct customer feedback, translating complex quantitative and qualitative findings into actionable recommendations that drive product innovation, improve customer retention, and sharpen our go-to-market strategy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Analysis & Segmentation:**
  Analyze behavioral, transactional, and demographic datasets to identify trends, build customer segments, and map end-to-end customer journeys.
* **Primary & Secondary Research:**
  Design, execute, and analyze customer surveys, focus groups, usability tests, and in-depth interviews to capture Voice of the Customer (VoC) sentiment and pain points.
* **Campaign & Product Measurement:**
  Track key customer health metrics (e.g NPS, CSAT, churn rate, Customer Lifetime Value)
* **Reporting & Visualization:**
  Build and maintain self-service dashboards and automated reports that monitor customer behavior in real time.
* **Data Storytelling & Stakeholder Alignment:**
  Synthesize findings from disparate sources into clear, executive-ready presentations, pitching strategic recommendations to Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX teams.
* **Data Governance:**
  Ensure all customer research and data handling adhere strictly to data privacy regulations, consent protocols, and ethical research standards.

title: Staff Product Analyst, Consumer
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a high-impact role for an analyst who wants to own the data behind a core part of our Consumer business and use it to change what gets built. You'll partner directly with product, design, and engineering to drive how we grow the direct-to-consumer funnel — from the moment someone lands on the site, through quote and approval, to activating their policy.
  
  
It starts with a real understanding of our customers, our funnel, and the levers that move conversion and retention. That understanding is what makes your analysis worth acting on. You use it to find the highest-leverage questions, spot opportunities the team hasn't seen yet, and bring recommendations that change roadmap decisions rather than just describe what happened.
  
  
The AI infrastructure we've built changes what this role looks like day to day. Mechanical analysis is faster than it has ever been, which frees you to spend your time on the parts that need judgment: framing the right question, validating what the tools produce, and drawing the conclusion the business should act on. We're further along on this than most companies, and we're still writing the playbook — you'll help shape it.
  
  
You go deep in analytics and experimentation on your product area, and AI gives you the reach to cover more ground than a traditional analyst.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Own the analytics for your product area. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room.
* Be accountable for outcomes, not output. You're measured on the business impact of the decisions your analysis influences — conversion, approval rate, activation, retention — not the number of analyses you produce. You connect findings across experiments and cohorts to surface patterns a single analysis would miss.
* Own experimentation for your area. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments.
* Build deep customer and funnel understanding. Develop a rich picture of how different segments behave — return visitors, demographic cohorts, traffic sources — and turn it into product recommendations that improve conversion for each group.
* Own the quality of AI-assisted analysis. Our tools pull data, read configs, and draft analysis. You use them to move faster, and you own validating and sharpening what they produce. Human judgment over AI output, always.
* Make insights self-serve. Build dashboards and frameworks that let PMs and leaders answer their own questions, and communicate findings in clear narratives that drive alignment and action, including with senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 7+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with real impact in high-growth, consumer-facing environments.
* A track record of changing what a product team built or prioritized — not just reporting on what shipped.
* You don't wait for a fully specified ask. You see the gap, frame the question, build the answer, and land it with the right audience.
* Expert SQL, and fluency with a modern analytics stack — Snowflake and a product analytics tool like Amplitude. Python (or R) and dbt are a plus.
* Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing.
* Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non-negotiable.
* Strong communication and storytelling — able to turn complex analysis into clear, strategic narratives for PMs, engineers, and executives.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Data & Insights Consultant
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**

The Business Optimization team has a simple mission: we turn massive amounts of data into actionable insights that drive business value. Our analytic consultants and data analysts work with Visa’s clients and staff to improve portfolio and product performance, program profitability and cardholder experiences around the world. By coupling in-depth analysis of portfolio behavior with Visa’s world-class products, digital offerings and marketing capabilities, we ensure our clients’ programs operate at their peak potential and that cardholders have seamless commerce experiences in both the physical and digital world.

title: Performance Lead - E Commerce (Endemic Ads)
description:
Role - Performance Lead - E Commerce (Endemic Ads)

Experience Required: 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Performance Marketing — ideally in a digital agency, a D2C brand, a marketplace-first environment, or a retail media team.

Location: Bangalore

**About the Role**

The Program Manager — E-commerce is the operational and strategic backbone of the Endemic Ads mandate. You will own the end-to-end health of the programme — across seller pipelines, pod performance, campaign outcomes, and client governance — while being the centre of gravity for a team of Pod Leads, Team Leaders, and Ad Consultants.

At the core, you are an E-commerce and Performance Marketing practitioner who can both set strategy and hold the team accountable to executing it. You will work at the intersection of marketplace commerce, seller growth, performance advertising, data-driven decision-making, and people leadership. You understand how online retail ecosystems work — how products are listed, how sellers are activated, how campaigns drive discoverability and sales, and how marketplace metrics translate into real business outcomes for brands.

If you have built and optimised e-commerce programmes on platforms like Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, or equivalent Indian or global marketplaces — that is a strong advantage.

**What You Will Do**

**Programme Oversight**

* Own the overall health and performance of the Endemic Ads / E-commerce mandate — across all seller accounts, pods, and platform relationships.
* Track programme-level KPIs (seller activation rates, GMV contribution, campaign ROI, revenue targets, SLA adherence) and course-correct when numbers drift.
* Run structured scrums and reviews with Pod Leads; ensure nothing stays stuck at the pod level without escalation.
* Be the first line of accountability between the delivery team and the Account Lead.

**E-commerce Strategy & Seller Growth**

* Own the e-commerce strategy for the mandate — covering catalogue health, pricing competitiveness, content quality, seller onboarding velocity, and marketplace ranking signals.
* Guide sellers on the levers that drive organic discoverability on marketplaces — search rank, ratings, returns, and fulfilment metrics — and align paid advertising to reinforce those signals.
* Identify and activate new seller segments and product categories; work with the pipeline team to prioritise high-potential accounts.
* Advise clients on marketplace-specific levers: A+ content, brand store builds, flash sale participation, deal of the day, and category exclusives.
* Track category-level GMV performance and share of shelf across marketplace platforms; translate these into actionable seller strategies.

**Performance Marketing & Campaign Execution**

* Set the advertising strategy direction for the mandate — campaign structuring, targeting approach, creative guidance, and beta adoption on marketplace ad formats.
* Review and sign off on campaign plans before they go to clients; ensure alignment between client objectives and marketplace execution approach.
* Guide the team on campaign budgeting, pacing, and spend management — including large-budget accounts requiring senior oversight.
* Identify scaling opportunities and efficiency levers across the seller portfolio; push the team to act on insights, not just report them.
* Drive adoption of automation and tech tools across the AdOps team to improve reporting speed and campaign precision.

**Seller & Client Governance**

* Oversee all client-facing reporting — regular and ad hoc — ensuring depth of insight, not just data dumps.
* Lead Monthly, Quarterly, and Half-Yearly Business Reviews; represent the programme's e-commerce and advertising performance with clarity and confidence.
* Manage a portfolio of 4–6 anchor client relationships directly, while holding programme-level visibility on all accounts.
* Partner with the Account Lead on new business pitches — marketplace audits, e-commerce health assessments, and strategic recommendations.

**Seller Pipeline & Activation**

* Oversee the seller outreach, onboarding, catalogue audit, and activation pipeline; ensure the team runs a steady, clean funnel.
* Identify gaps in the pipeline early — stalled activations, catalogue gaps, under-performing sellers, credit blockers — and resolve or escalate decisively.
* Work with Pod Leads to prioritise the seller roster and focus team effort on highest-potential accounts.

**Data, Analysis & Insights**

* Hold the standard for analysis quality across the team — push for insights that drive e-commerce decisions, not vanity metrics.
* Oversee ad hoc deep-dives into campaign performance, category share, and seller health; present findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Stay current on marketplace trends, platform algorithm updates, e-commerce policy changes, and competitive activity relevant to the seller portfolio.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Pod Leads, Team Leaders, and Ad Consultants.
* Own Personal Development Plans (PDPs) for direct reports; track progress and course-correct as needed.
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability in the pods — no postman behaviour, no dependence on escalations for routine decisions.
* Identify hiring needs and support recruitment for the team as the mandate scales.

**What We Are Looking For**

You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Performance Marketing — ideally in a digital agency, a D2C brand, a marketplace-first environment, or a retail media team. You understand how online retail works from the inside: listing, ranking, advertising, and sales measurement. You have managed real seller portfolios and advertising budgets, and you know what good looks like.

title: Brand & Content Marketer
description:
**About Us**
Isaga is a subsidiary of Nuclei, a profitable SaaS company. Our group companies have worked with 20+ large banks, including HDFC, ICICI, and SBI, across India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Isaga currently works with 100+ startups across India, helping them access better pricing and benefits across their technology stack.
  
  
We’re a small, ambitious team, which means you won’t be limited to a narrow set of tasks. You’ll learn directly from experienced leaders, take ownership early, and have plenty of room to grow.
  
  
You can explore our product and business model here: https://bizdeals.gonuclei.com
  
  
**This role will be isaga's first marketing hire.**
**11:04 pm**
A CTO in Pune is about to sleep. His phone buzzes. AWS bill: up 40% from last month.
  
  
He has a board meeting on Friday. He thinks of three companies that could help him fix it.
  
  
Today, isaga is not one of those three. This job exists to change that.
  
  
**Why this job exists**
isaga helps companies spend less on AWS. Have you heard of listed company - Mamaearth. Yes, we work with them.
  
  
This year we lost deals we should have won. Our offer was not the problem. The buyer had simply never heard of us.
  
  
A good product nobody remembers loses to an average one everybody knows. That is a marketing problem. We want you to solve it.
  
  
**What We Think Marketing Is**
Most buyers are not buying today. In B2B, only about 5 in 100 are in the market at any time. The other 95 will buy later, and when they do, they choose from names already in their head.
  
  
So marketing has two jobs. Make the brand easy to think of when the need shows up. Make it easy to find and buy from at that moment.
  
  
Logos, posts, websites and events are all tools for these two jobs. Attention is the scarcest thing in marketing, and in hiring too. So here is a small task: prepare one slide, with three bullet points, on why we should hire you. Our first conversation will start there. We have put this task here, in the middle of a paragraph, only to see who reads carefully and who has attention to details. A brand people recognise in one second beats a clever campaign people forget. It only works if you keep at it.
  
  
**What You Will Build**
Every task below does one of the two jobs above.
  
  

* Brand assets people recognise. Colours, shapes, a story, a way of writing. The test: would someone know a post is ours with the logo hidden?
* Content on our own channels. The isaga LinkedIn page, the website, blogs and podcasts. Visual content first.
* Content on other people's channels. Communities, newsletters, other people's podcasts, the AWS Marketplace. Go where our buyers already spend time.
* Events. We believe offline is the future of B2B marketing: small rooms where our buyers meet each other and meet us. You will help us test this.

**Your first 6 months**
Content comes first, so you will spend most of your time on 1 and 2.
  
  

* Month 1: Learn how we sell. Sit in on customer calls. Make the isaga LinkedIn page something people notice, and post every week.
* Month 2: Rebuild the website around one clear story. We know what we want. You execute it, then make it better.
* Month 3-6: A content engine that runs without reminders. You work with outside agencies, for example on AI search. You plan our first event.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 2 years of marketing experience.
* You are the first hire. So you will end up doing a lot of things. You will set up the base for the future of marketing at isaga.
* You are curious and diligent. We mean it.

+ Diligent: It's not easy being diligent. You deliver on what is agreed. If you are falling behind, you tell us before we ask. This looks very simple, but not easy. This is how high performers work.
+ Curious: You ask how we can do a better job, and how we can create distinctive brand assets.

* You are ready to operate on the ground. Start with the isaga LinkedIn page: make it distinctive and keep posting interesting content. Then help us build a website with a real story. We know what we want. You execute, refine and improve. You will also work with outside agencies, for example on AI search.
* You use AI, but you think. You will not blindly copy-paste content from AI.
* You bring new ideas. Marketing is about building distinctive assets, so you should be able to come up with new ideas. We will make you think.
* You are passionate about building a great brand.

**Who Should Not Apply**

* You want to run ads and report clicks. That is not this job, at least not yet.
* You want a team and a big budget on day one.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You think a JD with a story in it is a bit much.

**You think this is risky?**
Being the first marketer at a small company.
  
  
Here is what is riskier: three years at a big company where nobody can point to one thing you built. At isaga, everything you make will carry your name, the good and the bad.
  
  
**December 2027**
A founder in Bengaluru asks a friend, "Who should I call about our AWS bill?" The friend says, "Talk to isaga."
  
  
Nobody paid for that sentence. You built it, one post, one page and one event at a time.
  
  
**Want to get our attention?**
We get a lot of applications, so don’t make yours just another CV in the pile.
  
  
**Here Are a Few Things You Can Do**

* Find the email ID of Aditya Kshirsagar and send your CV directly.
* Look at our website. Pick one thing that looks like every other AWS partner. Tell us how you would make it ours, in one page or a 3-minute video.

*This JD is version 1. If you join, your first task is version 2.*

**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**

* Client & Channel Leadership Act as the lead and primary point of contact for key digital marketing channels—including Search, Social, Programmatic Buying Units (PBU), Ad Operations, or Commerce (all or couple of them). Represent the Global Operations Center (GOC) in all channels wise agency/market interactions, ensuring expectations are managed and consistently met. Serve as the custodian of activation excellence for assigned channels, driving trust and accountability across global stakeholders.
* Campaign Activation & Performance Oversight Oversee the activation, and optimization of campaigns across multiple channels and designated markets. Ensure flawless execution that aligns with broader media strategies and brand objectives. Work in close partnership with local and regional teams to maintain consistency, enhance performance, and deliver measurable impact through detailed reporting and actionable insights.

Act as a strategic advisor, offering data-driven solutions tailored to regional needs while upholding global standards. Partner with leadership and internal clients to drive innovation, resolve challenges, and influence strategic decisions that contribute to business growth.

Enforce compliance with global taxonomy, quality assurance, and platform governance standards. Analyze operational data and feedback to identify improvement areas, ensure process adherence, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
* Team Leadership & Talent Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of subject matter experts responsible for campaign execution, optimization, and reporting. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team culture. Ensure efficient team resourcing, continuous skills development, and alignment with organizational objectives through regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluation.
* Innovation, Automation & Business Growth Proactively identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and emerging markets. Collaborate with directors and senior leadership to develop compelling discussions for onboarding new scopes of work. Champion the adoption of internal and external automation tools and technology solutions to drive operational efficiency and future-proof activation capabilities.
* Coordination with internal team to overall smooth running for operations.

****Skills And Experience****
If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:
  
  

* Graduation or Post Graduation Degree in Any stream
* 8+ year's professional experience in digital media execution
* You are an expert & executed on respective channel platforms
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheet
* Working knowledge in HubSpot, Smartly, 4C, Scibids, or third-party tools like Dataroma, Google Studio is an added advantage
* Experience managing multi-location media activation teams.
* Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.
* Experience providing service to local teams from a centralized location.
* Passion for everything digital, with an active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Possess a solution-oriented mindset and analytical skillset.
* Proactive, display exemplary leadership with a positive go-getter attitude.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Us:**

Trail is the context layer AI agents run on. We're building the missing layer between your company's rules, exceptions, and institutional knowledge and the agents trying to act on them. It's a governed graph that lets any agent or platform, including Trail agents, make the right call on your most complex business processes. Agents today fail not because models are weak, but because they're never given the judgment a business builds up over years. We're fixing that.

Visit our Website and Youtube to learn more!

**The role**

This is a builder's role. You'll work closely with the leadership and sales teams to identify high-potential opportunities, run GTM experiments and unlock new channels for growth. From testing a new customer segment to experimenting with account-based marketing or exploring an untapped channel, you'll own initiatives end-to-end and turn what works into repeatable growth engines.

We're looking for someone smart, driven, and entrepreneurial — someone who takes initiative, moves fast, and is comfortable figuring things out without a playbook. Founder experience is a strong plus.

**What you'll do**

**1. Run GTM experiments**

* Identify promising customer segments, use cases, and GTM approaches for Trail and its products.
* Design and execute experiments to test new messaging, ICPs, outreach strategies, and conversion levers.
* Analyse results, identify what works, and rapidly iterate to improve qualified pipeline generation.

**2. Build and scale outbound motions**

* Develop targeted outbound strategies for enterprise accounts across relevant industries.
* Experiment with prospecting approaches, account prioritisation, messaging, and outreach tools.
* Work closely with AEs to turn insights from customer conversations into more effective prospecting and pipeline generation.

**3. Create new GTM channels**

* Identify and test new ways to reach enterprise buyers through conferences, events, account-based marketing, partnerships, communities, content-led acquisition, and emerging GTM tools.
* Take new initiatives from idea to execution, measure outcomes, and scale the channels that demonstrate traction.
* Explore unconventional approaches to reaching decision-makers and generating qualified opportunities.

**4. Own outcomes end-to-end**

* Track funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and use data to make decisions.
* Build lightweight processes and repeatable playbooks around successful experiments.
* Work directly with leadership, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and taking ownership from strategy through execution.

**Who we're looking for**

* 5+ years with an undergraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute
* Founder or early-stage startup experience is strongly preferred. You've built something, taken an idea to market, or worked in an environment where you had to create your own playbook.
* You can break down ambiguous problems, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and turn ideas into action.
* You don't wait for instructions or perfect information. You take initiative, experiment quickly, and follow through.
* You understand how businesses buy, what drives customer decisions, and how to translate a product's value into demand.
* Curious about new AI and GTM tools and willing to use them to move faster and work smarter.
* Can engage with different stakeholders, articulate ideas clearly, and build conviction around new initiatives.

Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.

This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.

title: Senior Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
**The Company Behind the Products**

Every business talks about “better customer conversations.” SaaS Labs builds products that actually make them happen.

From JustCall to CallPage to ServiceAgent.ai, we help thousands of businesses communicate better.

Here's where we are: With 300+ people across India, the US, and beyond, we’re at an inflection point as AI reshapes business communication.

What it's like to work here? Total ownership. We’re a team that moves with purpose, builds with ambition, and loves seeing our work make real impact.

And, if you're already nodding along, let's start the conversation.

**The Flagship Product**

With JustCall we’re leading the innovation on how sales and service teams connect with their customers— using AI — across calls, texts, emails, WhatsApp, and whatever comes next!It’s a multichannel communication system that helps 7000+ of our customers serve theirs better- with 24/7 AI Agents, on-point integrations, and other forward-looking features.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Sr. IT Support Engineer to own and deliver end-to-end technical support across access management, user onboarding and offboarding, application support, and infrastructure and network management.

Your goal is reliable IT operations: resolving network, system, and software issues, managing licenses and access permissions, and provisioning laptops for new joiners. That means minimal downtime, a productive workforce, and business continuity.

As a senior member of the IT team, you will be the go-to person for complex issues, set the standard for support quality, and drive improvements in processes, security, and automation. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and vendors in a fast-paced environment.

**Location:**
Bangalore (in-office 5 days a week, as collaboration and quick problem-solving are best enabled through close teamwork)

**What you'll do**

* **Technical Support:**
  Provide end-to-end troubleshooting for desktop systems, applications, and network connectivity; resolve hardware, software, and OS-related issues.
* **Monitoring & Troubleshooting:**
  Proactively monitor and troubleshoot network, internet, hardware, and system issues to keep IT operations running smoothly and minimise downtime.
* **Hardware & Software Maintenance:**
  Install, configure, and maintain computers, peripherals, and mobile devices; ensure timely updates across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* **Laptop Provisioning & Allocation:**
  Manage laptop allocation, configuration, and handover for new joiners and existing employees, ensuring every device is ready and compliant on Day 1.
* **Network Management:**
  Support and troubleshoot LAN/WAN/VPN connectivity; manage routers, switches, and wireless networks to maintain secure and stable operations.
* **Access & Onboarding/Offboarding:**
  Manage user accounts, access permissions, and role assignments (JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian). Own the onboarding and offboarding lifecycle, including account setup and asset recovery.
* **License & IT Asset Management:**
  Manage software licenses, track IT hardware and inventory, and maintain software compliance. Ensure license usage is optimised and audit-ready.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for procurement, repairs, replacements, and IT infrastructure maintenance and issue resolution.
* **Security & Compliance:**
  Implement and monitor IT security policies; assist with SOC/ISO/HIPAA audits and ensure compliance with organisational standards.
* **Documentation & Training:**
  Maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. Create user guides and conduct training sessions on common tools and workflows.
* **Process Improvement & Automation:**
  Identify recurring issues and automate repetitive tasks (PowerShell/Bash) to improve turnaround time and the employee experience.
* **Mentorship:**
  Guide junior team members, review their work, and help raise the overall support standard.

**What we're looking for**

* **Education**
  : Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:**
  5–6 years as an IT Support, Desktop Support, or Systems Support Engineer, with hands-on expertise in access management, user onboarding/offboarding, laptop provisioning, and application management.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Strong working knowledge of macOS, Windows, and Linux, along with experience in Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other productivity tools.
* **Systems & Cloud:**
  Hands-on experience with identity and access management and device management platforms (JumpCloud, JAMF, Active Directory, LDAP). Exposure to cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* **Networking & Troubleshooting:**
  Solid understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi), diagnostics, and root-cause resolution of hardware and software issues.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Experience maintaining IT inventory, tracking licenses, and keeping documentation audit-ready.
* **Security Awareness:**
  Working knowledge of endpoint security, access controls, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA).
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with a customer-first approach. Able to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate across teams.

**Edges that help**

* Certifications such as CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, ITIL Foundation, CCNA, or MCSE
* Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell/Bash)
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Experience with endpoint management solutions (MDM, SCCM, Intune)
* Prior experience mentoring or leading junior IT staff

**How we work**

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to taking hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Linux System and Hardware Administrator
description:

Linux System and Hardware Administrator

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

Permanent, Full-Time

Open until filled

Yes
