**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.

We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters:**

You’ll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**

We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.

If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
**Manager – F&B**

**Z Hotels | Zolo**

Run the outlet like a business. Protect margins. Elevate the dining experience.

**Why this role exists**

At Z Hotels, F&B is not a support function.

It is:
**A revenue engine + a guest experience layer.**

Guests may come for the stay.

But dining experience significantly shapes:

* Guest satisfaction
* Reviews
* Repeat usage
* Brand perception

As hotel occupancy scales:

* Dining demand increases
* Peak-hour pressure rises
* Table turnover becomes critical
* Cost leakages compound quickly
* Guest expectations around food and service become non-negotiable

Without discipline, F&B operations quickly become:
**Low-margin + inconsistent + complaint-heavy.**

The biggest operational failures usually happen when:

* Revenue performance is not tracked daily
* Food costs and wastage remain uncontrolled
* Service quality becomes inconsistent
* Upselling and banquet opportunities are missed
* Hygiene and compliance standards weaken
* Teams operate without accountability and productivity visibility

Without strong outlet leadership:

* Revenue leakages increase
* Margins weaken despite occupancy growth
* Guest complaints rise
* Team discipline breaks down
* Brand experience becomes inconsistent

This role exists to ensure:

* F&B operates like a structured business unit
* Revenue is tracked and grown predictably
* Costs are controlled tightly
* Service quality remains consistent
* Hygiene and compliance remain non-negotiable

If this role is strong:

* Outlet revenue grows predictably
* Margins improve sustainably
* Guest experience strengthens significantly
* Teams operate with accountability and discipline
* Events and banquets execute smoothly

If this role is weak:

* Revenue leakages increase
* Food cost overruns hurt profitability
* Guest complaints rise
* Service quality becomes inconsistent
* Operations become reactive and chaotic

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + margin + guest experience + outlet performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Drive predictable F&B revenue growth
* Protect outlet margins through cost discipline
* Maintain strong service and hospitality standards
* Build a high-performing and disciplined team
* Ensure hygiene and compliance governance consistently

**This is not a floor management role.**

**This is outlet business leadership.**

**About Zolo and Z Hotels**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

Z Hotels operates on:

* Consistency
* Operational discipline
* Predictable guest experience

F&B directly contributes to:

* Revenue diversification
* Guest satisfaction
* Repeat usage and loyalty

The hospitality model works only when:

* Outlet performance is tracked daily
* Service quality remains consistent
* Cost and experience stay balanced
* Teams execute with accountability

At scale:
**F&B discipline determines sustainable profitability.**

This role directly impacts:
**Hotel profitability + guest experience + operational reliability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Revenue & Outlet Performance**

* Track daily:
* Sales
* Covers
* Revenue
* Average Bill Value (ABV)
* Design upselling and promotional strategies
* Improve banquet and event revenue opportunities
* Monitor outlet performance trends consistently
* Conduct weekly reviews and corrective action discussions

**2. Enforce Cost Control & Margin Discipline**

* Track food cost % daily and weekly
* Control wastage, portion sizes, and inventory leakages
* Monitor procurement and vendor pricing closely
* Ensure inventory accuracy and stock rotation discipline
* Conduct cost audits and identify operational leakages proactively
* Balance profitability without compromising guest experience

**3. Lead Guest Experience & Service Standards**

* Conduct regular service quality audits
* Monitor guest feedback and dining experience ratings
* Personally handle major guest escalations and complaints
* Train teams on:
* Service quality
* Etiquette
* Guest interaction standards
* Ensure SOP adherence during peak operations consistently

**4. Drive Team Leadership & Productivity**

* Conduct structured daily team briefings
* Plan staffing and shifts based on occupancy and demand forecasts
* Track productivity and accountability across teams
* Coach and correct underperformance proactively
* Build future supervisors and second-line leaders
* Maintain morale, discipline, and operational energy

**5. Govern Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Conduct regular hygiene and kitchen audits
* Ensure food safety and storage discipline consistently
* Maintain cleanliness standards across kitchen and dining areas
* Enforce grooming and hygiene SOPs strictly
* Maintain audit and compliance readiness at all times

**6. Execute Events & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Plan and execute banquet and event operations smoothly
* Coordinate with:
* Kitchen teams
* Front office
* Operations teams
* Ensure inventory and staffing readiness for events
* Prevent execution breakdowns during high-pressure situations
* Deliver seamless event guest experience consistently

**What success looks like after 12 months**

* Stable and predictable F&B revenue growth
* Increase in Average Bill Value (ABV)
* Food cost maintained within benchmarks consistently
* Minimal service-related guest complaints
* Strong hygiene and audit compliance scores
* Smooth and reliable banquet/event execution
* Predictable contribution to hotel profitability

The outlet begins to feel:
**Structured + Predictable + Scalable**
—not reactive.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You think commercially, not just operationally
* You track numbers and performance rigorously
* You enforce discipline without damaging morale
* You stay calm during peak operational pressure
* You balance cost and guest experience intelligently
* You naturally take ownership of outcomes

**Experience we value**

* 5–7 years in:
* F&B operations
* Restaurant management
* Hotel dining operations
* Experience managing:
* Outlet revenue
* Food cost control
* Team productivity
* Guest escalations
* Banquet and event execution exposure preferred

Hospitality background preferred.

**Commercial awareness is non-negotiable.**

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on hotel profitability
* Improve guest dining experience and reviews
* Control food cost and operational leakages
* Build disciplined and scalable F&B operations
* Strengthen Z Hotels’ hospitality brand perception

**Why join now**

Z Hotels is scaling rapidly across markets.

As occupancy increases:
**F&B discipline will determine whether revenue growth remains sustainable.**

This role offers:

* Ownership of a business unit within the hotel
* Strong exposure to revenue and operational leadership
* Direct impact on profitability and guest experience
* Growth into Cluster and Operations leadership roles.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Role Summary / Job Purpose**

The Senior Manager – Global Supply Chain & Depot Operations owns the operational performance, standards, capacity and controllable costs of AVASO's global depot network. The role ensures reliable warehouse execution, inventory integrity, secure asset handling, logistics coordination and customer-specific operational SLA compliance across owned and third-party locations.

The role leads distributed teams, manages operational budgets within delegated authority, develops network capacity and drives quality, WMS governance and continuous improvement. It works within AVASO's end-to-end service delivery framework: SCM is accountable for depot execution and readiness; the Global Services Organisation (GSO) retains accountability for applicable client service commitments and technical solution design. Strategic procurement and commercial pricing are outside this role's primary scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Global Depot & Warehouse Operations**

* Own daily depot performance, site readiness, staffing coverage, physical controls, storage effectiveness and safe working practices across the global network.
* Govern receipt, inspection, put-away, storage, picking, staging, packing, dispatch, returns and backlog, ensuring timely and accurate fulfilment.
* Apply consistent operating standards across owned and partner sites while meeting approved client-specific work instructions and service levels.

**B. Inventory Governance, Asset Custody & Loss Prevention**

* Ensure inventory accuracy, serial-level movement traceability and documented custody of customer assets through receipt, storage, transfer and disposition.
* Enforce cycle counts, reconciliations and controlled WMS stock adjustments; investigate variances, loss, damage and unauthorized movement.
* Own depot incident reporting and corrective action; coordinate evidence, claims, insurance support and recoveries with authorized functions.

**C. IT Asset Lifecycle, Security & ITAD**

* Govern staging, imaging, configuration, kitting, repair coordination, testing, refresh, return, grading, refurbishment and ITAD execution within approved scopes.
* Enforce controlled data erasure, verification evidence, certificates, disposal approvals, chain-of-custody records and compliant vendor handovers.
* Ensure customer and information-security requirements are documented and exceptions are escalated promptly.

**D. Logistics & Cross-Border Movements**

* Oversee shipment planning, domestic and international movements, courier collection, tracking, proof of delivery and shipment-exception recovery.
* Coordinate IOR/EOR, customs and shipping documentation with trade specialists and approved partners; control avoidable freight and expedite costs.

**E. Global Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Lead regional depot personnel and central operations teams; set priorities, coach managers and enforce performance ownership and training compliance.
* Manage schedules, deployment of approved resources, productivity and contingencies; propose structural headcount changes through the approval process.

**F. GSO Interface, Depot SLAs & Customer Escalations**

* Remain accountable for depot operational SLAs and corrective actions; alert GSO/Service Delivery early when depot failures threaten end-to-end commitments.
* Lead depot investigations, recovery execution and root-cause actions; coordinate customer-facing commitments and communications through the authorized service owners.
* Provide operational feasibility, dependencies and delivery evidence for GSO-led solutions, transitions and service reviews.

**G. Service Catalogue & Operational Standards**

* Align every depot service to approved AVASO Service Catalogue items, scope, SOPs, standard processing times, quality acceptance criteria and completion evidence.
* Control deviations from standard workflows and partner with GSO on feasibility and readiness for new or modified depot service capabilities.

**H. Financial Performance & Cost-to-Serve**

* Manage controllable depot operating expenditure within approved budgets; review variances, unit costs and productivity with Finance and SCM leadership.
* Monitor cost per device, repair, shipment and storage unit, plus overtime, rework, freight premiums, losses and obsolete-stock exposure.
* Deliver quantified efficiency improvements; exclude commercial pricing, customer margins and negotiated procurement rates outside delegated control.

**I. Global Depot Network Strategy & Demand Capacity**

* Maintain rolling volume forecasts and resource/capacity plans informed by live demand, new client pipeline, service transitions and regional coverage needs.
* Assess site utilization, geographic coverage, network bottlenecks, consolidation, expansion and make-or-buy / 3PL options; propose business cases for approval.

**J. WMS, Master Data & Systems Integration**

* Own WMS transaction accuracy, approved asset master-data controls, asset statuses, locations and standardised operational reporting.
* Reconcile key records across WMS, FFA/ServiceNow, order-management and ERP systems; work with IT on API integrations and exception controls.

**K. Third-Party Depot, Logistics & ITAD Governance**

* Set approved operating expectations for 3PL, logistics and ITAD partners, including SLAs, security obligations and required delivery/erasure evidence.
* Maintain partner scorecards, performance reviews and risk-based audits; coordinate remediation, vendor escalations and continuity alternatives.

**L. Quality, Operational Risk, OHS & Business Continuity**

* Implement standard depot audits, physical security, health and safety checks, corrective-action tracking and controls over asset and data exposure.
* Maintain documented depot contingency, recovery and alternative fulfilment arrangements; periodically test readiness and escalate material risks.

**M. Transitions & Capability Readiness**

* Lead SCM workstreams for depot launches, relocation, client transitions and new services, covering space, systems, staffing, SOPs and acceptance gates.
* Coordinate readiness with GSO, Field Services, Facilities, IT, Finance and HR without independently changing client contractual commitments.

**N. Performance Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a defined global depot scorecard, review performance monthly, assign corrective-action owners and escalate material deviations.
* Use Lean/Kaizen, process automation and data-led investigation to reduce handling time, errors, repeated incidents and cost-to-serve.

**Skills, Experience & Stakeholder Requirements**

**Required Skills & Technical Knowledge**

Leadership of global multi-site depot operations; inventory and custody controls; IT asset lifecycle/ITAD and data-security requirements; international logistics and trade; budgetingand cost-to-serve; WMS/ERP,FFA/ServiceNow and reporting; incident management, vendor governance, process improvement and executive communication.

**Education & Certifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain,Logistics, Operations or a relatedfield, or equivalent relevant experience. Lean/SixSigma, ITIL, ITAD, security or project-management certifications are desirable.

**Experience**

Minimum 10 years of relevantdepot, supply chain, warehousing, logistics or IT asset lifecycle experience, including 5+ years leading teams or multi-location operations. Experience in IT managed services, international trade, information security and third-party depot governance is strongly preferred.

**Stakeholder Management**

Works across SCM, GSO, GlobalField Services, ServiceDelivery, Account Management, IT/WMS, HR, Finance,Legal/Compliance, Facilities, customers, carriers, 3PL depots and ITAD partners.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Analysis
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition**
At First Citizens India, you’ll have the opportunity to be more than just an analyst, you’ll be a trusted partner in safeguarding the Bank’s credit portfolio.
  
  

* Global Exposure: Collaborate directly with Senior Credit and Risk professionals in the U.S., gaining insights into global credit practices.
* Impactful Work: Play a critical role in monitoring a multi-billion-dollar credit portfolio, helping the Bank stay resilient and client-centric.
* Career Growth: Build your expertise in Credit analysis while having access to structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to move into leadership roles.
* Innovation at Scale: Be part of a team driving process improvement and technology adoption in Credit monitoring.
* Culture of Stability & Growth: Join a Bank that has thrived for over 125 years, balancing stability with continuous growth and innovation.

**Job Details**

* Position Title: Senior Analyst, Credit Analysis
* Career Level: P2
* Job Category: Senior Associate
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

**About the Team: Credit Analysis**
We are a diverse and highly skilled team of Credit professionals, experienced in Origination, Underwriting, and end-to-end Portfolio Monitoring.
  
  
Our team specializes in Technology & Healthcare Accelerator & Growth, Corporate Banking, Sponsor Finance, Fund Banking, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Healthcare – Medical Office Building (MOB), Wine, Community Assistance Banking (CAB), and Community Development Finance (CDF) loans monitoring across Innovation Banking, Fund Banking, Commercial Finance and General Bank. Additionally, the team supports the Centralized Cash Management Team (CCMT). Team works closely with US-based Credit Solutions team, Credit Officers, and Portfolio Managers to perform monthly, quarterly & annual monitoring of the loans.
  
  
**Impact**
As a Senior Analyst in the Credit Analysis team at First Citizens India, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the Bank’s credit quality and supporting informed lending decisions. This role is critical to enabling the Bank to make confident lending decisions, manage risks effectively, and maintain trusted relationships with clients. In this role, you will Leverage tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, and other commercial lending platforms to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights.
  
  
You’ll Partner with Global Credit teams to ensure Risk management and strengthen Portfolio performance.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
As a Senior Analyst – Credit Analysis, you will play a critical role in supporting the ongoing management of Bank’s Credit portfolio. You will work closely with U.S. based Credit Officers, Portfolio Managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality analysis and monitoring insights that help safeguard the Bank’s Credit exposure while ensuring client success.
  
  
**General Functions May Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Credit Portfolio Monitoring: Support ongoing monitoring of assigned credit portfolio to identify potential risks and ensure compliance with Loan agreement and risk policies.
* Reporting Tasks Monitoring: Monitor and track monthly/quarterly reporting packages (arriving from US counterparts) to check for completeness of client information on the portal.
* New Client Addition and Modification: Set up/upload new client information in the portal in tune with Loan Security Agreement; monitor and update the modifications in the portal in accordance with Loan Modification Agreements.
* Financial Spreading & Analysis: Spread and analyze financial statements of borrowers in Moody’s CreditLens, identifying key trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Covenant Monitoring: Track borrower compliance with financial and non-financial covenants, raising early alerts on potential breaches.
* Borrowing Base Calculations: Perform accurate and timely borrowing base calculations, ensuring alignment with loan documentation and lending practices.
* Reporting & MI: Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports to provide insights into portfolio performance, sectoral trends, and emerging risks.
* Risk Alerts & Escalations: Support early identification of problem credits through financial deterioration, covenant breaches, or industry headwinds.
* Collaboration: Partner with U.S. stakeholders across Credit, and Operations to ensure consistent standards, accuracy, and timeliness in deliverables.
* Process Improvement: Contribute ideas to enhance automation, standardization, and efficiency in portfolio monitoring processes.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure high level of accuracy in performance of all tasks. Adhere to reporting, financial spreading and covenant calculation KPIs/metrics, completing work within agreed to turnaround times. Report incidents of non-compliance items (e.g., differences in financial statements provided by client) to lead analyst/manager on a timely basis.
* Mentoring juniors: Monitor tasks to be completed by other team members and support the manager in mentoring and training of new hire analysts.

**Skills And Qualification**
**Functional Skills:**

* Hands-on experience in spreading, covenant monitoring, and credit reporting.
* Strong knowledge of corporate lending products, credit documentation, and financial statement analysis.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while being an active team contributor.
* Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines
* Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask
* Ability to be flexible with shift timings (2 pm – 11 pm)

**Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce / MBA(Finance).
* Chartered Accountant / CFA / equivalent qualifications will be an added advantage.
* Experience: 3–5 years of experience in credit analysis, portfolio monitoring in a bank, NBFC, or financial services firm.
* Exposure to US accounting, GAAP, and IFRS
* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial analysis tools; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau is an advantage.

**Leadership Qualities**

* This is an individual contributor role; however, the role may require adhoc workflow management/ supporting team leaders/managers as warranted.
* High level of ownership and self-drive towards proactive portfolio risk management
* High on Self-management and situational leadership

**Relationships & Collaboration**
This role involves working with the Credit Analysis team, reporting to the Credit Analysis Manager. This role will have comprehensive training across credit analysis processes, owning and managing an independent portfolio and collaboration with the lending team and other stakeholders. This role also requires strong communication, and teamwork skills are essential.
  
  
**Accessibility Needs**
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.
  
  
Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Senior Manager, Paralegal, you lead the GBS Paralegal function within Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") GBS India Legal Center of Excellence, reporting to the Director of Legal. You own paralegal service delivery, setting standards that hold up across genuinely different subject matters while keeping day-to-day delivery consistent and dependable for Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance, and business stakeholders worldwide. This role calls for an experienced legal operations leader with strong people leadership, sharp organizational instincts and real depth across legal documentation, contract administration, entity governance and regulatory support.
  
  
FME is looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who can build a high-performing team from the ground up, push continuous improvement, and keep service quality high in a complex, multinational, tightly regulated environment.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
***Paralegal Leadership***

* Lead and manage the GBS Paralegal function, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across OHS, corporate/M&A, and litigation workstreams
* Set standards, policies, procedures and service-delivery models for paralegal activities that work across genuinely different subject matters without forcing artificial uniformity
* Build team capability, set operating priorities, and keep the function aligned with Global Legal Function objectives
* Drive resource planning, workload balancing and operational efficiency across the paralegal team
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and service excellence

***Corporate Governance & Entity Management Oversight***

* Oversee entity management activities delivered by the M&A/Corporate Paralegal workstream, including incorporation, dissolution, restructuring, maintenance, and governance compliance support
* Oversee board and committee support activities - resolutions, minutes, governance documentation, statutory filings, ensuring accuracy and consistency
* Ensure corporate records are maintained accurately and in line with legal and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, company secretaries and local legal teams to support governance obligations across jurisdictions
* Monitor governance calendars and filing requirements across the entity portfolio

***Legal Documentation Oversight***

* Provide leadership and oversight for preparation, review, administration and maintenance of legal documentation across the paralegal team
* Ensure legal documentation processes are standardized, compliant and efficient
* Maintain document quality standards and governance controls

***Compliance, Regulatory & Risk Support***

* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk and Regulatory Affairs teams to support key compliance initiatives, including OHS regulatory matters
* Coordinate legal documentation and responses related to audits, investigations, regulatory inquiries and litigation support activities
* Support implementation of governance and compliance programmes across regions
* Identify operational risks across the paralegal function and put appropriate mitigation measures in place

***Process Excellence & Operational Improvement***

* Drive continuous improvement to lift service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction
* Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates and playbooks across paralegal workstreams
* Monitor key performance indicators and service-delivery metrics for the function

***Knowledge Management & Legal Operations Support***

* Oversee legal knowledge repositories, templates and document management systems used by the paralegal team
* Ensure legal information is maintained, organized, accessible and properly governed
* Contribute to broader legal transformation initiatives and best-practice implementation led by the Director
* Promote knowledge sharing and operational consistency across the paralegal function

***Stakeholder Management***

* Build strong relationships with Legal leadership, Compliance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Internal Audit and business stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor on paralegal processes, governance matters and legal operational support requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, regulators, government authorities and third-party service providers where required

***People Leadership & Talent Development***

* Lead, coach and develop the team members
* Drive talent management, succession planning and employee engagement across the team
* Foster collaboration across the team's different workstreams and subject-matter areas
* Create an inclusive, supportive, high-performance team environment

**Our Requirements**
***Education***

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, Corporate Governance, or a related field
* Paralegal Certification, Legal Operations Certification, or equivalent professional qualification preferred
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are an advantage

***Professional Experience***

* 10+ years of experience in Paralegal, Corporate Governance, Legal Operations, or related legal support functions
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing teams
* Extensive experience supporting multinational organizations in a complex regulatory environment
* Demonstrated experience in corporate governance, entity management, contract administration and legal documentation
* Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or other highly regulated industries preferred
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and operational excellence initiatives
* Experience partnering with senior legal and business stakeholders across geographies

**Functional & Technical Competencies**
***Legal & Governance Expertise***

* Corporate Governance
* Board and Committee Administration
* Entity Management
* Legal Documentation Management
* Contract Lifecycle Support
* Regulatory Compliance Support
* Corporate Records Management
* Due Diligence Support
* Litigation and Investigation Support
* Legal Risk Awareness

***Legal Operations & Process Excellence***

* Legal Operations
* Process Standardization
* Continuous Improvement
* Service Delivery Management
* Policy and Procedure Development
* Operational Governance
* Quality Assurance
* Documentation Controls
* Vendor Coordination

***Technology & Systems***

* Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Tools
* Entity Management Systems
* Document Management Systems
* Legal Operations Platforms
* Microsoft 365 Applications
* Reporting and Analytics Tools
* Knowledge Management Platforms

**Leadership Competencies**
***People Leadership***
Motivates, develops and inspires the team while building a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  
  
***Strategic Execution***
Translates legal and business priorities into practical operational plans and delivers measurable results.
  
  
***Stakeholder Influence***
Builds credibility and trusted relationships with legal leadership, business partners and external stakeholders.
  
  
***Operational Leadership***
Drives efficiency, consistency, quality and governance across the paralegal function.
  
  
***Talent Development***
Builds organizational capability through coaching, mentoring, succession planning and capability building.
  
  
***Decision Making***
Uses sound judgment, legal awareness and business understanding to make balanced, timely decisions.
  
  
**Behavioural Competencies**
***Collaboration***
Works effectively across functions and organizational levels to reach shared objectives.
  
  
***Customer Focus***
Understands stakeholder needs and consistently delivers strong service.
  
  
***Communication***
Communicates clearly, professionally and confidently with diverse audiences, including senior stakeholders.
  
  
***Integrity & Ethics***
Operates with professionalism, discretion, confidentiality and sound ethical judgment.
  
  
***Accountability***
Owns commitments, delivers results, and follows through.
  
  
***Adaptability***
Stays effective through a changing regulatory and business environment, managing competing priorities well.
  
  
***Continuous Improvement***
Questions existing practices and actively looks for ways to improve processes and outcomes.
  
  
***Attention to Detail***
Maintains a high level of accuracy and quality, particularly in governance and legal documentation work.
  
  
***Problem Solving***
Analyzes issues proactively, identifies practical solutions and drives resolution.
  
  
**Success Measures**
The Senior Manager, Paralegal will be evaluated on:
  
  
  

* Quality and consistency of paralegal service delivery across all workstreams
* Corporate governance compliance and entity management effectiveness
* Stakeholder satisfaction and partnership effectiveness
* Process efficiency and operational improvement achievements
* Accuracy and timeliness of legal documentation and governance activities
* Team engagement, capability development and retention
* Adoption of standardized processes and best practices
* Contribution to legal operational excellence within the CoE

**Additional Skill Requirements**

* Working understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and the legal implications of generative AI technologies
* Experience supporting legal digital transformation and legal service modernization initiatives
* Ability to read legal operations data and translate it into operational improvements and recommendations
* Experience working with distributed teams across regions in virtual and matrix environments
* Understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, data privacy and corporate governance
* Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of new technologies and change initiatives across a legal organization

**Preferred Professional Certifications**
***Legal & Paralegal Certifications***

* Certified Paralegal (CP)
* Advanced Certified Paralegal (ACP)
* Professional Paralegal (PP)
* Certified Legal Manager (CLM)
* Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)

***Corporate Governance Certifications***

* Chartered Governance Professional (CGP)
* Corporate governance certifications through ICSA/CGI, the Society for Corporate Governance, or Diligent Governance Programs

***Legal Technology & AI Certifications (any)***

* CLOC Legal Operations Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Microsoft Power BI Certification
* Generative AI for Legal Professionals, Thomson Reuters AI Skills Programs, LexisNexis AI Certification Programs, or ACC Artificial Intelligence for Legal Professionals Programs
* Practical experience with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Icertis/Ironclad CLM, Diligent Entities, and Legal Tracker/Brightflag is a plus

**Our offer:**

* Growth Opportunity: Be part of the dynamic growth and transformation of Fresenius Medical Care India Global Hub.
* Career Development: Access to challenging and rewarding opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Hybrid Work Environment: Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup that supports productivity and work-life balance.
* Transportation Facilities: Convenient company-provided cab services for pick-up and drop-off.
* Comprehensive Medical Benefits: Attractive medical benefits coverage for employees and their families.
* Cafeteria Benefits: Complimentary lunch facility at the workplace.
* Global Exposure: Gain valuable global exposure and access to diverse learning and development opportunities

title: Senior Data Privacy Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
:
  
  
Tsaaro is dedicated to Data Privacy and Security as its core focus. Our team comprises specialized data privacy consultants, information security experts, and penetration testers, all working to empower our clients with seamless and highly efficient security solutions. Our approach is centered around customization, understanding the unique needs of each organization, and finding solutions that align with their budget and resource constraints.
  
  
At Tsaaro, we adopt a pragmatic, risk-based strategy to deliver practical and effective advice. By providing real-world guidance, support, and actionable recommendations, we confidently equip our clients to address a broad spectrum of security and privacy challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Data Privacy Consultant, you will be entrusted with the following key responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and implement data protection and privacy programs that cater to our clients' specific business needs, ensuring their sensitive information is well safeguarded.
* Evaluate and assess our clients' data protection and privacy practices, offering valuable insights and actionable recommendations for continual improvement.
* Demonstrate expertise in various standards, such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc., to assist clients in compliance and governance.
* Provide guidance and support to clients in adhering to a complex web of national and international laws and regulations, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other privacy laws.
* Assist in preparing policies, reports, and schedules for clients and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment with industry best practices.
* Conduct thorough audits of Privacy controls to monitor program effectiveness and compliance, ensuring data protection is at its optimal level.
* Utilize online tools to facilitate Incident Management and Data Subject Rights processes, ensuring efficient and timely responses to potential data incidents.
* Foster and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel, promoting effective collaboration and understanding of their specific needs.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to adhering to workplace policies and procedures, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality.
* Contribute to cybersecurity engagements, developing cybersecurity strategies, governance, risk, and compliance activities, and cybersecurity policies in line with ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
* Perform Gap Assessments, Risk Assessments, ISMS Documentation, Internal Audits, and support during Certification Audits to strengthen overall security frameworks.

**Requirements**
To be considered for this role, the candidate must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Possess a sound knowledge of fundamentals of information security systems.
* Have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the field.
* Demonstrate proficiency in standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc.
* Exhibit a good understanding of GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy laws.
* Display competence in governance and reporting, as well as a strong grasp of cyber and privacy risks.
* Hold relevant qualifications such as CIPM, CIPT, CIPP/E.
* Showcase excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Professional development opportunities, including training and certifications.
* Flexible working hours.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Opportunity to work with a passionate team dedicated to making a difference in data privacy and security.

title: Culture & Leadership Excellence Program Manager
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
Our
**Human Resources**
team helps drive business outcomes by empowering HPE team members. This includes creating an environment where everyone can participate fully in our inclusive and diverse work environment as we develop our ‘as-a-service’ model. We do that by securing and retaining strategic skills, advancing our culture through engagement, and by raising the bar on performance. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
At HPE, we believe culture and leadership are critical drivers of business success. Our Culture & Engagement team helps create an environment where team members feel connected, supported, and empowered to do their best work, while enabling leaders to foster high-performing teams built on trust, psychological safety, inclusion, accountability, and continuous growth.
  
  
Through leadership excellence, team member engagement, culture activation, and meaningful team member experiences, we strengthen our workplace culture and help create an environment where innovation, collaboration, and performance thrive.
  
  
If you are passionate about shaping culture, enabling leaders, creating exceptional team member experiences, and driving meaningful organizational impact, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Culture & Leadership Excellence Program Manager will play a key role in advancing HPE's culture and leadership priorities across India and the broader APJ region. This individual will support the design, coordination, implementation, and continuous improvement of initiatives that strengthen leadership effectiveness, foster psychological safety and inclusion, enhance team member engagement, and activate culture locally.
  
  
Working closely with business leaders, HR partners, and members of the global Culture & Engagement team, this role will help translate enterprise priorities into meaningful regional and local experiences that drive engagement, connection, and business impact.
  
  
The successful candidate will be highly collaborative, organized, and results-oriented, with strong program management capabilities and a passion for creating environments where people and teams thrive.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Culture Activation & Team Member Experience**

* Design and deliver culture initiatives that strengthen connection, collaboration, psychological safety, and inclusion across HPE.
* Partner with local HR and business leaders to activate culture priorities within India and support broader APJ initiatives.
* Develop and execute local team member experiences, engagement programs, site activations, and cultural moments that reinforce HPE's values and desired leadership behaviors.
* Create tools, resources, and activation plans that help embed culture priorities into the team member experience.
* Gather team member feedback and recommend actions that improve culture, engagement, and organizational effectiveness.

**Leadership Excellence**

* Support the design and delivery of leadership excellence programs focused on people leader effectiveness, coaching, team engagement, accountability, and leadership capability.
* Develop leadership resources, toolkits, communication materials, and action-planning tools that enable people leaders to create high-performing teams.
* Coordinate leadership workshops, speaker sessions, leadership forums, learning experiences, and development programs.
* Partner with leaders and HR teams to reinforce leadership behaviors that strengthen trust, collaboration, engagement, and inclusion.

**Psychological Safety & Inclusion**

* Support initiatives that foster respectful, inclusive, and psychologically safe work environments.
* Develop resources and guidance that help leaders create environments where team members feel comfortable sharing ideas, providing feedback, and contributing diverse perspectives.
* Partner across HR functions to integrate psychological safety and inclusion practices into culture and leadership programs.

**Program Management & Coordination**

* Lead project coordination across multiple Culture & Leadership Excellence initiatives, ensuring milestones, dependencies, risks, and action items are effectively managed.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, governance documents, dashboards, and status reports.
* Drive accountability by proactively tracking deliverables, following up on commitments, and ensuring timely execution of agreed actions.
* Coordinate work across multiple stakeholder groups, functions, and regions to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
* Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities and recommend practical solutions to maintain momentum.

**Communications & Engagement Campaigns**

* Develop communication plans and engagement campaigns that support culture, leadership, and team member experience initiatives.
* Create presentations, leader communications, talking points, toolkits, newsletters, promotional materials, and engagement content.
* Support internal communication efforts that drive awareness, participation, adoption, and action.
* Develop executive-ready materials and updates for leadership audiences.

**Events, Logistics & Execution**

* Plan and execute team member engagement events, leadership forums, workshops, listening sessions, culture activations, and team member experiences.
* Manage event logistics, schedules, communications, vendors, registrations, and participant experiences.
* Ensure successful execution of both virtual and in-person programs and events.
* Facilitate sessions and confidently present to team member and leadership audiences.
* Maintain project documentation, tracking tools, repositories, and operational records.

**Reporting & Insights**

* Analyze team member engagement data, program metrics, survey results, and feedback to identify trends and opportunities.
* Translate data and insights into actionable recommendations that improve leader and team member experiences.
* Support measurement and continuous improvement efforts across Culture & Leadership Excellence programs.

**Local Culture Activation – India**

* Serve as a key Culture & Leadership Excellence partner for India.
* Partner with site leadership and local HR teams to activate HPE's culture strategy through locally relevant programs and experiences.
* Help deliver leadership engagements, recognition initiatives, team member forums, cultural celebrations, and engagement activities.
* Gather local insights and feedback to help shape future programs and initiatives.
* Support regional culture and leadership priorities across APJ as needed.

**AI-Enabled Innovation & Operational Excellence**

* Demonstrates an AI-first mindset, proactively using AI tools to improve efficiency, strengthen work products, generate insights, and enhance program delivery.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance the delivery of the programs.
* Identify opportunities to improve team member and people leader experiences through AI-enabled solutions, personalized communications, targeted engagement approaches.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Increased Culture Blueprint awareness, adoption, and demonstrated leadership behaviors across the enterprise.
* Improved leadership readiness to lead AI-enabled teams and navigate organizational transformation.
* Full integration of culture and leadership expectations across talent processes and team member experiences.
* Measurable improvements in team member feedback indicators related to trust, psychological safety, engagement, and leadership effectiveness.
* Increased utilization and effectiveness of AI-enabled tools, insights, and interventions supporting culture and leadership outcomes.

**Basic Qualifications**
**What you need to bring:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 6-8 years of experience in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Team member Experience, Culture, Leadership Development, Change Management, Communications, or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex cross-functional projects and programs.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating stakeholders across global and matrixed organizations.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience developing communications, engagement campaigns, and leadership materials.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.
* Experience using Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration technologies to manage programs and communicate results.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cultures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting culture, team member engagement, team member experience, and/or leadership development programs.
* Experience planning and executing team member or leadership events and experiences.
* Experience facilitating workshops, learning programs, or team member engagement sessions.
* Knowledge of leadership effectiveness, psychological safety, organizational culture, team member listening, and change management principles.
* Project Management, Change Management, Facilitation, or Coaching certifications are a plus.

**Desired Skills & Behaviors**

* Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented with a strong bias for action.
* Excellent program and project management capabilities.
* Comfortable making informed decisions independently while exercising sound judgment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to build trusted partnerships across all levels of the organization.
* Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Comfortable with public speaking, facilitation, and presenting to leadership and team member audiences.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and personal responsibility for outcomes.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
* Passionate about leadership excellence, team member experience, culture, and organizational effectiveness.
* Ability to balance global consistency with local market needs.
* Willingness and ability to travel within India and the APJ region as business needs require.

title: Senior Trust & Assurance Program Manager - Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of Confluent’s Trust and Security organization. Its mission is to turn trust into growth by shortening sales cycles and enabling consumption, and to scale regulatory assurance by anticipating industry and customer requirements before they become blockers. The OCISO Enablement Lead will oversee and execute global trust enablement programs and capabilities to support global and regional teams in driving security and compliance assurance. This includes developing scalable processes for customer due diligence, contractual compliance, customer audits, and trust-focused external communications, incl. customer executive engagement programs. The role demands operational independence, with the ability to deliver initiatives at scale while seeking leadership direction when necessary. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential to manage processes effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization. This is a remote-based position.
  
  
Primary Responsibilities:
  
  

* Collaborate with GTM teams to implement and scale global and regional Field and Customer enablement programs
* Act as a subject matter expert on customer security assurance and regulatory requirements, providing actionable guidance on emerging regulations affecting cloud adoption, including privacy, data residency, digital sovereignty, and AI
* Execute the product trust and compliance roadmap in coordination with Product, Engineering, and Legal Teams.
* Build and continuously improve a Trust as a Service model that moves routine customer assurance to self-service and automation with relevant success criteria and metrics.
* Apply AI and automation to scale trust programs with human review, and translate AI governance expectations into customer-facing trust content
* Analyze feedback and metrics from Field and Customer processes to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement in OCISO operations
* Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Enterprise CISO and Compliance, Sales, CSG, Product, Engineering, Legal, and GRC teams to support trust-building initiatives and ensure alignment

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of experience in Information Security and Compliance.
* Expertise in cloud/SaaS environments with complex security and compliance requirements, either as a provider or customer.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional security and compliance programs.
* Knowledge of key regulations and frameworks, including GDPR, DORA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, CSA, NIST, and other regional/industry standards.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
Additional highly desirable experience:
  
  

* Current Security CISSP, CISA, CISM, CIPP, or equivalent certification completed or currently in progress
* Excellent verbal and written communication, organizational, and planning skills
* Knowledge of regulatory standards relevant to EMEA & APAC and regulated industries (e.g., APRA, MAS, HKMA, IRAP, OSPAR, DORA)
* Understanding of digital sovereignty and data residency requirements relevant to cloud adoption
* Familiarity with AI/ML security and governance considerations, including evolving regulatory expectations for AI in cloud environments
* Prior experience reviewing and negotiating security clauses within customer contracts a plus
* Able to independently lead and manage internal process and operational improvement programs

description:
**Role - Frontend Developer (React)**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a talented and passionate Frontend developer with good design understanding to join our team and contribute to the development of our modern web applications. **Qualifications:**

2. Proven experience of minimum 5-8 years as a Frontend developer in React.js and related libraries
3. Strong understanding of JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, and CSS
4. Expertise in Figma and a strong understanding of the React ecosystem.
5. Ability to write automated tests.
6. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

8. Familiarity with DevOps, Git and Test automation

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a dynamic and inclusive work environment. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe you have the skills and passion to succeed, we would love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst II
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating, licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured data that is both self-sourced and from third party content providers. The various Content teams report to the Chief Content Officer and have strategy, product management, operations and support responsibilities for each of the Content verticals- Research, Web Curation, Company Documents, and Structured Data. We have been experiencing a rapid growth cycle across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust and accountability in our relationships within the team and with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Business Analyst II will be part of a newly formed Content Strategy, Planning and Analysis team- a horizontal function working across all the lanes within the Content Organization. As a Content Analyst, you will work closely with the Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Operations and Revenue teams and contribute to the ideation, integration, and support of a variety of in-demand structured and unstructured content within our industry-leading AI platform (SaaS and Enterprise) and content strategy, and ultimately ensure we are successfully and continuously driving value for our users. The Content Analyst candidate we seek has experience in consulting, B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software application companies, with ideally a background in financial and corporate industries.
  
  
This role will report into the Director, Content Strategy, Planning & Analysis.
  
  
**Required**
Who You Are:
  
  

* Minimum 3 or more years experience in business intelligence, data analysis and due diligence, having worked in consulting management, financial and corporate services industries.
* A critical thinker, with attention to detail and effective organizational skills, who is able to manage diverse data and build effective presentations for product and content leaders with actionable suggestions to improve or influence operational decision making.
* Strong analytical skills, and ability to identify patterns from complex data, produce accurate conclusions, and report critical information or recommendations.
* Ideally some experience with data manipulation in SQL/Python/R, and Data visualization using Tableau/PowerBI/Looker.
* Possess the ability to multitask and work effectively under time pressure; a willingness to contribute independently; an eagerness to continue learning new skills; and a drive to deliver tangible results.
* Exceptional Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Google Sheets/Google Docs/Google Slides experience

**Strongly Preferred**

* Excellent domain knowledge, and familiarity with functions and user workflows across-buy-side/sell-side, investment banking/private Equity/Venture capital, Corporate and Consulting
* Subject-matter expertise with content feeds, metadata, assorted document and data delivery types
* A proactive self-starter who is able to develop and maintain effective working relationships with the wider team across different global locations, and stays focused to meet deadlines
* Strong presentation and effective communication skills - both written and verbal in English
* Bachelor's Degree in the information systems, statistics, computer science, business administration or a related field
* Experience with Product Development frameworks such as Agile, Kanban, etc., or process improvement methodologies such as SAFE or Six Sigma

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct due diligence and comparative analysis of existing and prospective content sources, and partnerships with the aim to support the build out of business cases/proposals/cost-benefit analysis scenarios
* Address ad hoc requests for data analysis and reporting, including usage, readership, coverage details across the AlphaSense content landscape and product offerings
* Provide support in investigating and/or addressing inquiries from internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors
* Run detailed data analysis to build dashboards and reporting in support of projects/programs, collaborating with Content Team and Business Intelligence functions
* Track, process and manage content requests in ProductBoard, and generate reports, dashboards and content presentations
* Track new industry trends, source new content sets, and compile competitive intelligence to better inform product and content strategy
* Rapidly get up to speed on AlphaSense, programs, processes and tools and be able to manipulate data effectively
* Support and identify internal process improvement opportunities, by performing a gap analysis of current and future state processes/workflows,and implementing the improved target state.
* Collaborate with the Content Leaders, BI Analytics, Finance and other key stakeholders for content usage trends, opportunities for improvement, and ad hoc analysis for content strategy inputs.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
We are looking for a Operations Specialist to join the Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) UK&I team and support the effective delivery of its day-to-day operations. The role will help maintain strong operational governance and high-quality data, while supporting financial management, reporting and consistent adoption of VCA processes, platforms and controls.
  
  
Working closely with consulting teams, other Operations Specialists, VCA Hub and cross-functional teams across Europe, you will address operational challenges, resolve data issues and deliver accurate financial and performance reporting.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The role will have a strong focus on identifying pain points and inefficiencies, both within Operations Specialist activities and across wider VCA processes, and exploring opportunities to leverage automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive, detail‑oriented individual who enjoys owning processes, increasing efficiency, and driving practical improvements that deliver real value to the business.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Champion end-to-end VCA operational processes, ensuring consistent execution and alignment with defined VCA and Visa policies and controls, while providing day-to-day operational guidance and support to the UK&I consulting team.
* Maintain high-quality project, operational and financial data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency across relevant systems, investigating discrepancies and supporting effective data governance and increased team self-sufficiency.
* Proactively assess manual and time-consuming Operations Specialist activities and develop automation solutions to reduce manual effort, improve efficiency and accuracy, and support their implementation and adoption across other Operations Specialists in other clusters.
* Identify pain points and inefficiencies across wider VCA processes and ways of working, leveraging automation and AI to develop practical solutions, while proactively exploring new AI tools and capabilities that can further improve how VCA operates.
* Produce financial and operational analysis, including revenue and cost pipeline tracking, P&L monitoring, AOP and Outlook support, translating data into clear and timely information to support decision-making.
* Support month-end and quarter-end financial activities, reviewing financial reports, analysing variances and data discrepancies, and working with Finance and relevant stakeholders to support accurate financial reporting.
* Drive adoption and effective use of VCA platforms and tools in the UK&I team, reinforcing data discipline and consistent ways of working
* Proactively surface operational pain points and opportunities, connecting consulting teams with the Hub and collaborating with other Operations Specialists, to share feedback, support improvements and embed best practices across clusters.

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with automation and AI tools, such as Microsoft Power Automate and Copilot, combined with the ability and curiosity to explore and apply new technologies to automate workflows and improve operational processes

Product Designer – UI/UX and Frontend

CentraPrime Technologies | Building CENTRAL

ROLE AT A GLANCE

• One full-time opening; 3–5 years of relevant experience.

• Annual CTC: ₹8–12 lakh, based on relevant skills and demonstrated work.

• On-site in Chennai, six days a week.

• Office: 2nd Floor, Anand Seethakathi Business Centre, Anna Salai, Thousand Lights, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600006.

• Preferred joining timeline: within 15–30 days.

CentraPrime Technologies is building CENTRAL, an app connecting personal goals with health and fitness information. The app is usable for internal testing, and we are building our initial team. Learn about the company before applying: https://centraprimetechnologies.com/

Our hiring team will review relevant experience and work evidence. Shortlisted candidates will discuss one CENTRAL journey and demonstrate how their proposed design works across different phone sizes, followed by a final discussion.
