The Design Technologist role will build and evolve design systems, design token frameworks, custom Figma plugins, and front-end configurations that power modular and flexible user experiences. You will pioneer AI-driven tools to enhance team efficiency, creativity, and product quality. This role is ideal for someone excited push systematized design forward to make configurable interfaces that are smarter, faster, and more adaptive through AI-driven innovation.
  
  
**About Evernorth Digital**
Evernorth is built on the recognition that health makes progress possible. Our health services are designed to redefine health care as we know it, and the Evernorth team is unified in the belief that we are responsible for the future of healthcare. This means that our products must inspire change in people that leads to positive pathways: pathways that lead to health, to healing, to preventative wellness and ultimate vitality.
  
  
The Evernorth Digital team is like few in comparable Technology companies today: we are a collective of carefully curated, specialized disciplines that, when whole, imagines, plans, defines, tests, instruments, measures, builds, deploys, monitors and optimizes end-to-end experiences that represent the health services suite of product offerings. We are united by our mission to improve life and health outcomes towards aspirational vitality, but we practice our crafts in a discipline orientation that allows us to perfect, excel, and stay current; we then bring our gifts together in an impressive expression of teamwork.
  
  
The mission of the Enterprise Design Systems team is to set the bar for design system disciplines and define the processes, work output, platforms and tools that will bring efficiency and quality to product delivery. This team incubates new design patterns that represent the evolution of the brand in the digital product environment, and innovative experiential concepts that push the expectations of users in the health-focused digital ecosystem. The design system is intended to deliver cohesive and consistent design standards to all product lines associated with health plan and health services, and to expand to represent the voices of the direct customer, the client, and the provider.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Design Technologist role will explore the intersection of design, content, and code. In this role, you’ll help shape and scale our design and content systems—leveraging design tokens, content tokens, and integrations with platforms like Contentful to enable cohesive, personalized, and context-aware experiences. You’ll explore new automated workflows that streamline the delivery of end-to-end experiences, from design intent to production-ready code. This role invites experimentation with UI personalization, agentic architectures, and intelligent systems that adapt to user needs.
  
  

* Help to drive the evolution and visual language standards across a multi-brand enterprise design system.
* Experience in creating micro-interactions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design intuitive and engaging user interfaces across various platforms, ensuring alignment with user needs and business goals.
* Investigate and propose ways to incorporate AI technologies to enhance user interactions, aiming to personalize and optimize the user journey.
* Explore generative AI technologies to create on-brand, asset libraries for illustration, photography, and iconography that meets design system specifications.
* Champion a data-drive, user-centered research and design approach to inform design decisions and validate solutions.
* Design and define patterns through components, documentation, and prototypes.
* Ensure patterns meet standards and guidelines for accessibility.
* Help in creating documentation and training materials for design system adoption.
* Collaborate to test components and patterns as needed to ensure usability and consistency.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience:**

* 12+ years of experience across Product Design, Design Technology, Front-End Development and Design Systems, with a strong track record of translating design intent into scalable digital experiences.
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Deep expertise in design systems, including component architecture, design tokens, patterns, libraries, documentation, governance and adoption across complex digital products.
* Strong systems-thinking mindset, with the ability to see beyond individual screens and components to define reusable patterns, scalable frameworks and connected experience ecosystems.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge design and engineering, translating design principles, interaction patterns and visual specifications into production-ready front-end experiences.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end technologies and frameworks, including React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, with an understanding of component-driven development.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, variables, tokens, prototyping and scalable library management; familiarity with other contemporary design and prototyping tools.
* Experience applying AI and emerging technologies to experience design, including AI-assisted workflows, intelligent interactions, prototyping and exploration of new human-AI interaction patterns.
* Strong foundation in product design and UX, with the ability to move from problem definition and concept development through prototyping, validation and implementation.
* High level of visual design craft, with a strong eye for typography, layout, hierarchy, interaction states, motion, micro-interactions and overall experience quality.
* Experience designing and evolving component libraries and shared UI foundations that create consistency across design and front-end implementation.
* Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, enterprise products and configurable experiences, with the ability to design for complex workflows, roles and use cases.
* Ability to identify opportunities for automation, tooling and technology-enabled improvements across design and product development workflows.
* Experience facilitating design workshops, technical explorations and collaborative problem-solving sessions across design, product and engineering teams.
* Strong ability to listen, synthesise ambiguity and translate complex problems into clear experience and system-level solutions.
* Ability to clearly articulate design rationale, system decisions and technical approaches to designers, engineers, product partners and senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable providing and receiving constructive critique, influencing design quality and helping teams make informed trade-offs across experience, technology and scalability.
* Strong written, verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex design and technical concepts clearly.
* Portfolio demonstrating high-quality product experiences, strong visual craft, design-system thinking and the ability to connect design with technology and implementation.

**CRITICAL COMPETENCIES**

* Drives Results – Pushes team and cross functional partners to deliver needed results in tough circumstances and expedited timelines

**Role Title:**
**VP - IAM Operations & User Experience**
**(L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
This is a people manager role responsible for leading enterprise IAM Security Administration, End User Operations, across people, technology, controls, and transformation. The VP will combine IAM expertise with practical AI and automation engineering capability to drive reliable identity lifecycle and privileged access operations, simplify access requests and fulfilment, and reduce repetitive manual work. The role will define automation strategy and requirements, partner with Automation and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions and safely operationalize Agentic AI and Generative AI with appropriate human oversight and security controls
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the enterprise IAM Security Administration and Automation functions, including people, operations, technology, controls, and transformation.
  
  

* Drive automation and access-experience transformation: Own the strategy to automate the majority of repetitive Security Administration activities using Agentic AI, Generative AI, RPA, Python, PowerShell, APIs, and self-service. Prioritize opportunities, modernize IAM access requests and fulfilment, and define requirements, business outcomes, and control objectives with Automation and Engineering teams. Drive automation of ServiceNow request, incident, change, and problem-management activities.
* Improve operations through data, AI, and user insight: Analyse IAM operational data, incidents, logs, knowledge articles, historical resolutions, and recurring issues to identify sustainable improvements. Use Generative AI, Splunk, and IAM telemetry to accelerate troubleshooting and root-cause analysis and establish AI-assisted monitoring and predictive capabilities. Gather end-user feedback to reduce friction, manual effort, and unnecessary process complexity.
* Establish governance and measurable outcomes: Maintain human-in-the-loop oversight, approvals, auditability, security, and segregation-of-duties controls for AI-driven operations. Set and track targets for automation coverage, manual effort reduction, provisioning success, recurring failure reduction, SLA adherence, incident resolution, first-time-right execution, operational reliability, and security-control effectiveness, with no compromise to governance or compliance.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that enhance the user experience and collaborate with the automation team to implement them.
* Build talent and lead cross-functional transformation: Lead, coach, and develop Security Administration and Operations teams, strengthening IAM, AI, Python, PowerShell, and RPA capabilities. Identify high-potential talent, establish succession plans and technical SME ownership, and promote automation-first thinking, engineering discipline, continuous improvement, and accountability. Partner with technology, Automation, control, business, and end-user communities to deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, and risk reduction.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Strong experience in IAM/IGA, identity lifecycle management, and Security Administration across SailPoint, NHID, Okta, Beyond Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Delinea/PAM, including provisioning, reconciliation, access governance, and privileged access operations.
* Ability to identify, assess, and prioritize IAM automation opportunities based on business value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and end-user experience. Working knowledge of Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Automation Anywhere/RPA, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and LLM-based capabilities to evaluate potential use cases and collaborate effectively with automation teams.
* Experience translating IAM operational needs into clear business requirements, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria for automation teams, including integration needs across IAM platforms, ServiceNow, and Splunk. Strong understanding of approval workflows, audit requirements, segregation-of-duties controls, and the safe use of AI.
* Demonstrated people leadership and IAM transformation capability, including team development, succession planning, operational ownership, and cross-functional collaboration. Ability to partner with automation teams through feasibility assessment, prioritization, user acceptance testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience developing and prioritizing an IAM automation roadmap, identifying opportunities for reusable solutions across processes, and partnering with automation teams to assess feasibility, dependencies, and expected benefits.
* Ability to identify use cases for AI-assisted monitoring, predictive insights, knowledge assistance, and intelligent troubleshooting to address recurring IAM failures and operational risks.
* Experience driving the adoption of automation and self-service across IAM, Active Directory, PAM, ServiceNow, and routine administrative processes, with measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, risk reduction, and end-user experience.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 9+years of IT experience with a minimum of 6 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.

**Atlassian Platform Operations**

* Manage and triage incoming Jira and Jira Service Management tickets.

* Coordinate with Technology, Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Application teams to route and resolve tickets.

* Support Confluence space administration, documentation management, and knowledge-base maintenance.
* Assist with user provisioning, access reviews, and license administration.
* Track and report on ticket volumes, trends, SLA performance, and backlog health.
* Support Atlassian governance initiatives and platform standardization efforts.

**CAPEX Reporting & Financial Governance**

* Prepare and maintain monthly CAPEX reporting packages.
* Validate Jira data used for capitalization reporting.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Finance teams to resolve data quality issues.
* Support monthly audit reviews and CAPEX compliance activities.
* Create and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into CAPEX utilization and project investment tracking.

**SharePoint & Knowledge Management**

* Manage Technology SharePoint sites and document libraries.
* Maintain project repositories, operational documentation, governance materials, and reporting artifacts.
* Ensure documents remain current, organized, and easily accessible.
* Support creation of collaboration workspaces for strategic initiatives and cross-functional programs.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Develop recurring operational reports and executive dashboards.
* Consolidate information from Jira, SharePoint, Excel, and Power BI.
* Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports for leadership.
* Analyze trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance reporting requirements.

**AI Enablement & Automation**

* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI tools to summarize information, draft operational content, analyze trends, and streamline routine reporting tasks.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation across Jira, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and reporting workflows.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, confidentiality, and alignment with company policies.
* Support documentation, adoption, and responsible-use practices for AI-enabled operational processes.

* Act as liaison between Technology, Product, Finance, PMO, Infrastructure, Security, and vendor teams.
* Follow up on outstanding actions and track key operational deliverables.
* Coordinate operational governance meetings and prepare supporting materials.
* Maintain action logs, RAID logs, and operational trackers.

title: Technical Specilist
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Global Delivery, Leadership & Project Coordination**

* Drive end-to-end deliverable coordination across distributed global engineering teams, ensuring synchronization on architectural milestones, timeline commitments, and deployment phases.
* Manage and steer multiple parallel micro-projects, taking personal accountability for scoping, resource allocation boundaries, risk mitigation, and successful delivery.
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for cross-functional leadership, bridging the gap between hardware layout designers, product managers, and global firmware execution teams.

**End-to-End MCU Design & FreeRTOS Architecture**

* Own the complete architectural blueprint for all heterogeneous MCU deployments across the organization (ARM Cortex-M/R, RISC-V, ESP32, and high-performance DSPs).
* Standardize and scale our FreeRTOS environment, establishing corporate frameworks for task topologies, deterministic scheduling, ultra-reliable inter-process communication (IPC), and customized memory management schemes.
* Review, refine, and sign off on all high-level and low-level firmware design specifications before they transition into active development sprints.

**Protocol Engineering & Special Component Capabilities**

* Enforce bulletproof execution of communication layers, designing unified state machines and strict error-handling systems for complex wired and wireless data buses (CAN-FD, Industrial Ethernet, TSN, PCIe, SPI, I2C, BLE, Wi-Fi).
* Integrate high-specification maker capabilities and special peripherals, managing dense data ingestion pipelines, advanced sensor hubs, and real-time DSP/audio interfaces (I2S, SAI, PDM) with optimized DMA setups.

**Test Framework Governance & Forensic Escalation**

* Dictate the automated validation blueprint for the global team, ensuring that rigorous off-target test-driven methodologies (GTest/GMock, CppUTest) and automated hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments are woven into all CI/CD pipelines.
* Serve as the ultimate engineering backstop for the global team, resolving blockades on critical runtime anomalies, complex race conditions, and deep silicon-level/GDB debugging problems.

**🎓 Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Experience: 15 to 20+ years of progressive engineering and technical delivery experience in embedded software systems.
* Global Coordination: Proven track record of leading and aligning cross-border/global development teams through complex product lifecycles.
* Project Governance: Direct experience managing multiple technical micro-projects or sub-systems using Agile, Scrum, or V-Model frameworks.
* Architectural Mastery: Deep, silicon-agnostic register and platform-level fluency across multiple major MCU vendors (e.g., STMicroelectronics, NXP, TI, Infineon).
* Core Tech Stack: Expert programming in C and modern Embedded C++, profound internals-level mastery of FreeRTOS, and a history of building enterprise-grade automated test pipelines.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree (preference in Finance, Economics, Business Management, Communications or Marketing).

* The ability to work collaboratively in a team setting. Experience of directly dealing with senior internal stakeholders is preferred.
* Strong research skills using a variety of proprietary and third-party systems and tools.
* A solid understanding of investment products, asset classes, and financial markets is a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Produce high-quality first drafts of RFP and due diligence questionnaires (DDQ); writing/editing answers, gathering data from multiple sources (not all centralized), and working closely with a variety of teams.

* Have a high-level understanding of Russell Investments OCIO and customized portfolio solutions businesses. Develop and apply a solid understanding of investment products, asset classes, and financial markets.
* Ensure content is current, accurate, and tailored to meet the specific requirements of each RFP. Attention to detail is a must.
* Qvidian/database management: Regularly review and enhance content to improve response quality and consistency.
* Manage quarterly tasks related to updating statistical data, organization charts and personnel information, housed across multiple repositories for use in RFPs and sales pitch decks
* Contribute to ad-hoc sales support tasks such as building prospect lists, research and updating sales collaterals for use by Go-To-Markets teams.

**Core Values**

* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management.
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines.
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong judgment and decision-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer-focused, action-oriented, results-driven culture.

* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.

title: UN Women National Consultant - Project Coordinator for WeSTEM and Link-Women India - Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
description:
**Background**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.
  
  
UN Women’s Country Office, based in New Delhi, India, works to accelerate the advancement of gender equality and the empowerment of women through the strengthening of strategic partnerships, technical and policy advisory services and advocacy with governmental, inter-governmental and civil society partners. In addition, UN Women CO is leading and coordinating the UN system’s work on gender equality, including through ensuring accountability for results.
  
  
UN Women India in its Strategic Note 2023-27 focusses on sustainable and inclusive growth through higher productivity, competitiveness in economic activities that create decent work, livelihoods and income, particularly for youth and women. UN Women is implementing 3 projects in Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat – WeSTEM, Link Women and We Empower (WE) India. The focus of all projects is to advance women’s skills and motivate women in higher/ technical/ vocational institutes/ITI's to pursue employment in the formal sector, focus on STEM education and careers. The projects target marginalized young women already enrolled in higher/technical/vocational education.
  
  
The projects undertake a holistic approach to empowerment offering pathways and support to access higher education, internships, apprenticeships and employment opportunities for women. The projects leverage partnerships with government departments, technical and higher education institutions, private-sector employers, implementing partners and other relevant stakeholders, using innovative approaches to support women’s access to education, skilling, internships, apprenticeships and employment.
  
  
In this context UN Women is looking for the services of a Consultant who would be responsible for coordinating the project related activities for Link Women and We-STEM projects and Districts. S/he will work under the day-to-day guidance and direct supervision of the Programme Officer – Private Sector and Employability, WEE and overall supervision of Country Programme Manager (WEE). S/he will provide support in management of project activities, coordinate with relevant team members, including the operations team, implementing partner organisations and government officials ensuring successful implementation of project activities. Based at the Skills, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Department (SEEID), Government of Maharashtra, the Consultant will serve as the key coordination focal point for the We-STEM and Link Women projects in the state. The Consultant will coordinate with government departments, ITI's, polytechnics, higher education institutions, implementing partners and other stakeholders to support the timely implementation of project activities. The role will include coordinating training and employment-related activities, supporting the development of joint training plans for faculty, facilitating gender and POSH-related activities, managing official communications and follow-ups, and coordinating with the Directorate of Vocational Education and Training (DVET) and other relevant government stakeholders.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
Project Implementation and Coordination
  
  

* Provide technical support for the implementation of the Empowering Women in STEM and the Link Women project/s in Maharashtra.
* Assist the state Department of Skill Development, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation (DSEEI), Government of Maharashtra, in undertaking actions and initiatives on issues related to skilling and employment and/or as per the mandate and priorities of the Department, and in line with the agreed workplan and in consultation with the UN Women supervisor.
* Coordinate and work with ITI's, HEIs and Polytechnics in the program districts and other nodal departments towards successful implementation of the project.
* Coordinate on the programmatic implementation with the Implementing partner, relevant stakeholders, partner organizations, and agencies in the state, including undertaking necessary field visits.
* Support in the convergence of the projects with other relevant departments/schemes/programmes.
* Coordinate for activities on women’s education, skilling, and employment with relevant team members within the Department and UN Women, and work with them in close collaboration to ensure successful implementation of the projects. This will also include facilitating systematic coordination between UN Women and the SEEID, Government of Maharashtra.

**Employment And Placement**

* Identify job opportunities for women passing out of ITI's, HEIs and Polytechnics from the program districts.
* Mobilize companies and connects for placement of women, especially those graduating in the STEM field.
* Organize job fairs/Industrial Bootcamps for the final year students graduating from the technical/vocational/higher education institutes in collaboration with the UN Women Implementing partner/s.

**Monitoring And Evaluation**

* Monitor the performance of implementing partner as per agreed work plan
* Work closely with M&E team at UN Women for reporting and quality assurance of documents.
* Support the M&E team in refining the project monitoring and evaluation framework for the projects and develop field monitoring tools and plans.
* Regularly monitor the progress of the projects against the indicators and inform the programme team, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Support development of baseline data and conduct assessment surveys and other related documents.
* Provide support in routine delivery and reporting of project supported activities.
* Develop/review monthly progress reports and quarterly progress reports on the project.
* Support the end evaluation of the project/s.

**Communication**

* Support development of material for the communications team on the progress of the project.
* Develop case studies from within the project to showcase on various media.
* Prepare briefing notes and updates on the status of women in Maharashtra, particularly on issues of skilling and employment, for use by program team.
* Support in developing visually compelling reports and knowledge products that communicate findings effectively to stakeholders, in collaboration with the communications team at UN Women.

**Miscellaneous**

* Any other duties assigned by Supervisors from time to time.

**Deliverables**

* Inception, Workplan and Monitoring Framework – An agreed inception report, consolidated programme workplan and monitoring and reporting framework, setting out the programme’s key deliverables, milestones, timelines, roles and responsibilities, reporting arrangements, agreed reporting formats, quality assurance mechanisms and coordination arrangements with the implementing partner. Monthly progress updates and quarterly monitoring reviews will also be provided throughout the assignment, with additional updates as and when required. – (Monthly Reporting)
* Technical Coordination and Programme Support – Technical briefs, research outputs and other programme documents incorporating gender perspectives in STEM education, skilling and employment, along with consolidated technical inputs and support to UN Women, the Government of Maharashtra and implementing partners, submitted as per agreed requirements and timelines. Quarterly technical input and ongoing support will be provided throughout the assignment. – (Quarterly Reporting)
* Private Sector Engagement and Employment Linkages – Employer networks and private-sector partnerships established and strengthened, with documented company participation in job fairs, apprenticeships, internships and employment opportunities. Linkages between We-STEM participants and WEPs signatories/private-sector partners established, with mentoring and industry exposure opportunities delivered throughout the assignment. Quarterly company mobilization, mentoring opportunities delivered every two months, and industry exposure visits as per the agreed programme schedule. (As and when required)
* Capacity Building and Gender/STEM Mobilization – Capacity-building sessions delivered for placement coordinators and relevant institutional stakeholders, alongside gender and STEM orientation sessions for girls, boys and communities, and mobilization of women and girls for enrolment in ITI's, polytechnics and HEIs. Capacity-building sessions will be delivered twice a year, with monthly mobilization and orientation sessions conducted as per the agreed programme schedule. (As and when required)
* Monitoring, Progress Reporting and Knowledge Management – Consolidated and quality-checked programme data and progress reports, with documented monitoring findings, follow-up actions, case studies and knowledge products capturing key results, participant experiences and institutional changes. Monthly progress reports and monitoring updates will be submitted throughout the assignment, with quarterly monitoring reviews and case studies documented, and knowledge products submitted twice a year. (Monthly and as required)
* Link Women and Programme Documentation– Link Women Phase 2 end-line data and findings documented, monitoring mission reports and follow-up actions recorded, and approved photo stories and films completed, supported by participant mobilization, consent and field logistics. End-line documentation and other programme outputs will be submitted as per the agreed Link Women and We-STEM milestones, with monitoring mission reports and follow-up actions documented quarterly. (As and when required)

Note: Travel and DSA will be reimbursed by UN Women on submission of F-10 form with original ticket stubs, vouchers, etc. as per actuals.
  
  
**Competencies**
**Core Values:**

* Integrity;
* Professionalism;
* Respect for Diversity.

**Core Competencies**

* Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
* Accountability;
* Creative Problem Solving;
* Effective Communication;
* Inclusive Collaboration;
* Stakeholder Engagement;
* Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:
  
  
**Functional Competencies**

* Good programme management, monitoring and evaluation skills
* Ability to create, edit and present information in clear and presentable formats;
* Ability to manage data, documents, correspondence and reports information and workflow;
* Good knowledge of technical area
* Ability to identify and analyze trends and opportunities.

**Education**

* Master's degree in Science, Social Sciences, Development Studies or a related field is required. A Bachelor's degree in the same fields, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience, may be accepted in lieu of a Master's degree.
* A degree or certification in management is an asset.

**Experience**

* At least 3 years of progressive experience in programme management, coordination, programme monitoring and evaluation, and capacity building is required.
* Experience working with government departments or agencies, preferably at the state level, is required.
* Experience in STEM education, skilling, employability or placement-linked programmes is desirable.
* Experience in women's economic empowerment or gender-focused programming is an asset.
* Experience working with technical and higher education institutions (ITI's, Polytechnics, HEIs) or with private sector employers is an asset.
* Experience working in the UN system is an asset.

**Language Requirements**

* Fluency in English and working knowledge of Hindi is required. Working knowledge of Marathi will be an asset.
* Knowledge of the other UN official working language is an asset.

**Application**
**Interested applicants should apply to this announcement through UN Women jobs site:**
Careers at UN Women | UN Women – Headquarters
  
  
UN Women will only be able to respond to those applications in which there is further interest.
  
  
**Evaluation And Selection Criteria**
Criteria for shortlisting of CVs will be based on the following assessment:
  
  

* Required Degree and Qualification (5 points).
* Minimum Experience relevant to the assignment (10 points).
* Working knowledge and experience of working with National/State Government (5 points).

The evaluation process for selection of the candidate will be based on the following assessment:
  
  

* Interview – (70 points)
* Writing Samples – (30 points)

**Please Note**

* For an assignment requiring travel, consultants of 65 years or more require full medical examination and statement of fitness to work to engage in the consultancy.
* Consultants are required to submit doctor's certificate to state fitness to work and travel for this assignment.
* Due to large number of potential applicants, only competitively selected candidates will be contacted for remaining steps of the service procurement process.
* The consultant is expected to use their own computer equipment. The office will not provide any computer equipment for this assignment.
* This is a full-time assignment. The consultant is expected to disclose any outside activity and shall not be permitted to take up any outside work during this assignment.

**Statements**
In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.
  
  
**Diversity And Inclusion**
At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.
  
  
If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.
  
  
UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

title: UN Women National Consultant - Project Coordinator for WeSTEM and Link-Women India - Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
description:
**Job Description**
**Background:**
UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.
  
  
UN Women’s Country Office, based in New Delhi, India, works to accelerate the advancement of gender equality and the empowerment of women through the strengthening of strategic partnerships, technical and policy advisory services and advocacy with governmental, inter-governmental and civil society partners. In addition, UN Women CO is leading and coordinating the UN system’s work on gender equality, including through ensuring accountability for results.
  
  
UN Women India in its Strategic Note 2023-27 focusses on sustainable and inclusive growth through higher productivity, competitiveness in economic activities that create decent work, livelihoods and income, particularly for youth and women. UN Women is implementing 3 projects in Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat – WeSTEM, Link Women and We Empower (WE) India. The focus of all projects is to advance women’s skills and motivate women in higher/ technical/ vocational institutes/ITI's to pursue employment in the formal sector, focus on STEM education and careers. The projects target marginalized young women already enrolled in higher/technical/vocational education.
  
  
The projects undertake a holistic approach to empowerment offering pathways and support to access higher education, internships, apprenticeships and employment opportunities for women. The projects leverage partnerships with government departments, technical and higher education institutions, private-sector employers, implementing partners and other relevant stakeholders, using innovative approaches to support women’s access to education, skilling, internships, apprenticeships and employment.
  
  
In this context UN Women is looking for the services of a Consultant who would be responsible for coordinating the project related activities for Link Women and We-STEM projects and Districts. S/he will work under the day-to-day guidance and direct supervision of the Programme Officer – Private Sector and Employability, WEE and overall supervision of Country Programme Manager (WEE). S/he will provide support in management of project activities, coordinate with relevant team members, including the operations team, implementing partner organisations and government officials ensuring successful implementation of project activities. Based at the Skills, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Department (SEEID), Government of Maharashtra, the Consultant will serve as the key coordination focal point for the We-STEM and Link Women projects in the state. The Consultant will coordinate with government departments, ITI's, polytechnics, higher education institutions, implementing partners and other stakeholders to support the timely implementation of project activities. The role will include coordinating training and employment-related activities, supporting the development of joint training plans for faculty, facilitating gender and POSH-related activities, managing official communications and follow-ups, and coordinating with the Directorate of Vocational Education and Training (DVET) and other relevant government stakeholders.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities:
  
  
Project Implementation and Coordination
  
  

* Provide technical support for the implementation of the Empowering Women in STEM and the Link Women project/s in Maharashtra.
* Assist the state Department of Skill Development, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation (DSEEI), Government of Maharashtra, in undertaking actions and initiatives on issues related to skilling and employment and/or as per the mandate and priorities of the Department, and in line with the agreed workplan and in consultation with the UN Women supervisor.
* Coordinate and work with ITI's, HEIs and Polytechnics in the program districts and other nodal departments towards successful implementation of the project.
* Coordinate on the programmatic implementation with the Implementing partner, relevant stakeholders, partner organizations, and agencies in the state, including undertaking necessary field visits.
* Support in the convergence of the projects with other relevant departments/schemes/programmes.
* Coordinate for activities on women’s education, skilling, and employment with relevant team members within the Department and UN Women, and work with them in close collaboration to ensure successful implementation of the projects. This will also include facilitating systematic coordination between UN Women and the SEEID, Government of Maharashtra.

Employment and Placement:
  
  

* Identify job opportunities for women passing out of ITI's, HEIs and Polytechnics from the program districts.
* Mobilize companies and connects for placement of women, especially those graduating in the STEM field.
* Organize job fairs/Industrial Bootcamps for the final year students graduating from the technical/vocational/higher education institutes in collaboration with the UN Women Implementing partner/s.

Monitoring and Evaluation:
  
  

* Monitor the performance of implementing partner as per agreed work plan
* Work closely with M&E team at UN Women for reporting and quality assurance of documents.
* Support the M&E team in refining the project monitoring and evaluation framework for the projects and develop field monitoring tools and plans.
* Regularly monitor the progress of the projects against the indicators and inform the programme team, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Support development of baseline data and conduct assessment surveys and other related documents.
* Provide support in routine delivery and reporting of project supported activities.
* Develop/review monthly progress reports and quarterly progress reports on the project.
* Support the end evaluation of the project/s.

Communication:
  
  

* Support development of material for the communications team on the progress of the project.
* Develop case studies from within the project to showcase on various media.
* Prepare briefing notes and updates on the status of women in Maharashtra, particularly on issues of skilling and employment, for use by program team.
* Support in developing visually compelling reports and knowledge products that communicate findings effectively to stakeholders, in collaboration with the communications team at UN Women.

Miscellaneous:
  
  

* Any other duties assigned by Supervisors from time to time.

Deliverables:
  
  

* Inception, Workplan and Monitoring Framework – An agreed inception report, consolidated programme workplan and monitoring and reporting framework, setting out the programme’s key deliverables, milestones, timelines, roles and responsibilities, reporting arrangements, agreed reporting formats, quality assurance mechanisms and coordination arrangements with the implementing partner. Monthly progress updates and quarterly monitoring reviews will also be provided throughout the assignment, with additional updates as and when required. – (Monthly Reporting)
* Technical Coordination and Programme Support – Technical briefs, research outputs and other programme documents incorporating gender perspectives in STEM education, skilling and employment, along with consolidated technical inputs and support to UN Women, the Government of Maharashtra and implementing partners, submitted as per agreed requirements and timelines. Quarterly technical input and ongoing support will be provided throughout the assignment. – (Quarterly Reporting)
* Private Sector Engagement and Employment Linkages – Employer networks and private-sector partnerships established and strengthened, with documented company participation in job fairs, apprenticeships, internships and employment opportunities. Linkages between We-STEM participants and WEPs signatories/private-sector partners established, with mentoring and industry exposure opportunities delivered throughout the assignment. Quarterly company mobilization, mentoring opportunities delivered every two months, and industry exposure visits as per the agreed programme schedule. (As and when required)
* Capacity Building and Gender/STEM Mobilization – Capacity-building sessions delivered for placement coordinators and relevant institutional stakeholders, alongside gender and STEM orientation sessions for girls, boys and communities, and mobilization of women and girls for enrolment in ITI's, polytechnics and HEIs. Capacity-building sessions will be delivered twice a year, with monthly mobilization and orientation sessions conducted as per the agreed programme schedule. (As and when required)
* Monitoring, Progress Reporting and Knowledge Management – Consolidated and quality-checked programme data and progress reports, with documented monitoring findings, follow-up actions, case studies and knowledge products capturing key results, participant experiences and institutional changes. Monthly progress reports and monitoring updates will be submitted throughout the assignment, with quarterly monitoring reviews and case studies documented, and knowledge products submitted twice a year. (Monthly and as required)
* Link Women and Programme Documentation– Link Women Phase 2 end-line data and findings documented, monitoring mission reports and follow-up actions recorded, and approved photo stories and films completed, supported by participant mobilization, consent and field logistics. End-line documentation and other programme outputs will be submitted as per the agreed Link Women and We-STEM milestones, with monitoring mission reports and follow-up actions documented quarterly. (As and when required)

Note: Travel and DSA will be reimbursed by UN Women on submission of F-10 form with original ticket stubs, vouchers, etc. as per actuals.
  
  
**Competencies :**
**Core Values:**

* Integrity;
* Professionalism;
* Respect for Diversity.

**Core Competencies:**

* Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
* Accountability;
* Creative Problem Solving;
* Effective Communication;
* Inclusive Collaboration;
* Stakeholder Engagement;
* Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:
  
  
**Functional Competencies:**

* Good programme management, monitoring and evaluation skills
* Ability to create, edit and present information in clear and presentable formats;
* Ability to manage data, documents, correspondence and reports information and workflow;
* Good knowledge of technical area
* Ability to identify and analyze trends and opportunities.

**Education:**

* Master's degree in Science, Social Sciences, Development Studies or a related field is required. A Bachelor's degree in the same fields, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience, may be accepted in lieu of a Master's degree.
* A degree or certification in management is an asset.

**Experience:**

* At least 3 years of progressive experience in programme management, coordination, programme monitoring and evaluation, and capacity building is required.
* Experience working with government departments or agencies, preferably at the state level, is required.
* Experience in STEM education, skilling, employability or placement-linked programmes is desirable.
* Experience in women's economic empowerment or gender-focused programming is an asset.
* Experience working with technical and higher education institutions (ITI's, Polytechnics, HEIs) or with private sector employers is an asset.
* Experience working in the UN system is an asset.

**Language Requirements:**

* Fluency in English and working knowledge of Hindi is required. Working knowledge of Marathi will be an asset.
* Knowledge of the other UN official working language is an asset.

**Application:**
**Interested applicants should apply to this announcement through UN Women jobs site:**
Careers at UN Women | UN Women – Headquarters
  
  
UN Women will only be able to respond to those applications in which there is further interest.
  
  
**Evaluation and Selection Criteria:**
Criteria for shortlisting of CVs will be based on the following assessment:
  
  

* Required Degree and Qualification (5 points).
* Minimum Experience relevant to the assignment (10 points).
* Working knowledge and experience of working with National/State Government (5 points).

The evaluation process for selection of the candidate will be based on the following assessment:
  
  

* Interview – (70 points)
* Writing Samples – (30 points)

Please note:
  
  

* For an assignment requiring travel, consultants of 65 years or more require full medical examination and statement of fitness to work to engage in the consultancy.
* Consultants are required to submit doctor's certificate to state fitness to work and travel for this assignment.
* Due to large number of potential applicants, only competitively selected candidates will be contacted for remaining steps of the service procurement process.
* The consultant is expected to use their own computer equipment. The office will not provide any computer equipment for this assignment.
* This is a full-time assignment. The consultant is expected to disclose any outside activity and shall not be permitted to take up any outside work during this assignment.

**Statements :**
In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion:**
At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.
  
  
If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.
  
  
UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)
  
  
**Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process**

**Position Overview**
The Associate – Finance Transformation will play a key role in modernizing finance processes through automation, advanced analytics, and emerging AI capabilities. This individual will redesign complex Excel-based workflows into scalable, controlled solutions using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, Tableau, and approved AI platforms. **Solution Design & Data Structuring**

* Apply strong data modeling principles to support scalable reporting solutions.
* Structure transformed data to enable reporting, trending, variance analysis, and future enhancements.
* Balance ideal-state architecture with practical tool constraints.

**Delivery Ownership & Initiative Coordination**

* Own E2E delivery of assigned transformation initiatives/JIRA stories
* Partner with stakeholders to define scope, requirements, objectives, and delivery
* Develop and maintain lightweight timelines
* Coordinate execution across Finance, Accounting, and Technology.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Partner directly with Finance, Accounting, and Investment stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into structured solution designs.
* Present findings and recommendations clearly using organized documentation and summaries.
* Support adoption and change management for new automated processes.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Finance or Accounting, Data Transformation, Financial Systems, Automation, or related roles
* Demonstrated experience automating complex Excel-based processes.
* Hands-on experience with Alteryx or comparable automation tools.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to redesign and improve processes.
* Exposure to AI tools, analytics platforms, or transformation program initiatives preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Excel (complex formulas, structured modeling).
* Strong Alteryx development experience.
* Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Experience with data transformation tools (Power Query or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of data modeling principles to support scalable reporting solutions.
* Experience implementing reconciliation checks and automated validation controls.
* Familiarity with AI platforms or automation frameworks is a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Structured analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Ability to evaluate processes holistically and challenge inefficient workflows
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort operating in an agile, evolving environment
* Ability to balance innovation with practical implementation constraints.

title: Lean Six Sigma Process Engineer
description:
**Process Engineers and Lean Specialists (Multiple Positions)**

**JDX Continuum | Full-time | Mumbai base, travel to client sites**

**About JDX Continuum**

**JDX Continuum is a manufacturing and operational excellence consultancy. We work inside our clients’ factories, on the shop floor, and help them run better: higher throughput, lower cost, stronger quality, safer work, and smoother flow.**

**The firm was founded by a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with over 15 years on factory floors across India, the US, and Canada. We are growing, and we are building a team of engineers who want to do real work in real plants.**

**We are hiring at every level**

**We have multiple open positions, from freshers to highly experienced Lean experts:**

* **Freshers and early-career engineers**
  who have some Lean Six Sigma exposure and want to learn fast
* **Experienced process engineers**
  who have delivered measurable improvements on the floor
* **Senior Lean experts**
  who can lead improvement work at a client site and coach the people around them

You will grow with the firm, and your responsibility will grow with what you show you can do.

**NOTE : This role involves travel - it is not a 9-5 desk job.**

**Our work happens at client sites, so travel is part of the job. You will travel to plants across Maharashtra and other states as projects need, and some assignments will mean staying near a client site for a while. Please apply only if you are comfortable with regular travel.**

**What you will do**

* Study how work actually happens on the floor through time studies, observation, and data
* Find bottlenecks, waste, and lost output, and turn them into clear opportunities
* Put Lean improvements in place: 5S, standard work, changeover reduction, line balancing, root cause problem solving
* Write SOPs and work instructions that operators actually use
* Train operators and supervisors so the improvements hold after we leave
* Measure the before and after and report results in plain numbers
* For senior roles: lead client engagements, manage the plant relationship, and mentor junior engineers

**What we are looking for**

* Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering
* Lean Six Sigma knowledge matched to your level, from real exposure for freshers to a strong delivery record for senior roles
* Comfort working on a live shop floor with operators, supervisors, and plant management
* A practical, adaptable mindset and a willingness to learn
* Good with data, and confident using a laptop and AI tools, which we use every day
* Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

**Good to have**

* Lean Six Sigma certification (Yellow, Green, or Black Belt)
* Experience in steel, stamping, fabrication, machining, assembly, or similar industries
* ISO 9001 exposure
* A driving license

**Why join JDX Continuum**

* Learn directly from a Black Belt with global plant experience
* Work across several industries and plants, not just one
* See your improvements take hold on the floor and own the results
* Join a growing firm early, where good work gets noticed and rewarded
* Built in India, Trained by the World.

title: CMS Content Manager
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.
  
  
Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a CMS Content Manager at Jellyfish, you will be responsible for publishing, updating and maintaining high-quality digital content across a range of content management systems (CMS).
  
  
You'll ensure that website content is accurate, consistent and aligned with client brand guidelines, supporting the delivery of engaging and optimised digital experiences. You'll work closely with content, SEO, UX, design and development teams to implement content updates, maintain quality standards and support efficient publishing workflows.
  
  
You'll bring strong attention to detail, technical curiosity and a proactive approach to problem-solving, helping ensure content is delivered accurately and on time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**CMS publishing & content delivery**

* Publish, update and maintain website content across CMS platforms, ensuring accuracy, consistency and adherence to brand guidelines
* Build and format web pages using existing templates and content components, including text, imagery, links and metadata
* Implement content updates and minor layout adjustments, using HTML where required
* Support content publishing workflows, ensuring updates are completed accurately and within agreed timelines
* Maintain content trackers, publishing schedules and documentation to support efficient delivery

**Quality assurance & optimisation**

* Conduct quality assurance checks before and after publication, identifying and resolving content, formatting and functionality issues
* Identify, document and escalate CMS-related issues, technical bugs and content inconsistencies
* Implement SEO and UX recommendations in collaboration with specialist teams
* Monitor basic content performance metrics and report insights to support ongoing optimisation
* Ensure published content meets accessibility, usability and brand consistency requirements

**Collaboration & continuous improvement**

* Work closely with project managers, designers, developers and other stakeholders to support content delivery
* Collaborate with SEO, UX and Paid Search teams to implement content optimisation initiatives
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve publishing processes and content quality
* Develop familiarity with new CMS platforms, content technologies and emerging tools, including AI and automation

**Qualifications**

* Experience publishing and managing website content using CMS platforms such as Sitecore, WordPress, Drupal or similar
* Working knowledge of HTML and web content formatting
* Strong attention to detail, with experience conducting content QA and maintaining brand consistency
* Foundational understanding of SEO principles, metadata and UX best practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving content issues
* Familiarity with design tools such as Figma or Photoshop is a plus
* Experience using project management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira or ServiceNow is a plus
* Interest in AI, automation and emerging content technologies is a plus

What success looks like
  
  

* You consistently publish accurate, high-quality content that meets client requirements and brand standards
* You manage day-to-day CMS tasks efficiently, meeting deadlines and maintaining clear visibility of progress
* You identify and resolve content issues proactively, escalating technical challenges appropriately
* You apply SEO, UX and accessibility best practices to support effective digital experiences
* You build strong working relationships with internal teams and contribute to smooth content delivery
* You develop your CMS expertise and identify opportunities to improve publishing efficiency and quality

*Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.*
**Additional Information**
Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.
  
  
💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.
  
  
💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely UK Shift hours.
  
  
🏦 Jellyfish contributes to your retiral benefits via Provident Fund (PF) contribution
  
  
Jellyfish provides best-in-class group medical insurance & life insurance cover to employees
  
  
*Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to*
*talentacquisition@jellyfish.com*

title: Coordinator - Grant Management
description:
**Reports to:**
Manager - Grant Management

**Job Overview:**

The role is responsible for coordinating and managing of corporate grants across varied stakeholders. The coordinator will be working closely with the Manager and AVP of Grant Management to reinforce relationships with donors, ensure that grant programmes operate efficiently, and streamline grant administration with self-implementing and sub-granting NGO Projects.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* To understand the project objectives and deliverables and study the execution plan for the project under the guidance of the Project Manager.
* Assist the Manager in developing proposals for ongoing partnerships and enhance the existing scale of impact through insights and impactful programme design.
* Create concept notes, Proposals, Budgets, and MOUs under the guidance of the Manager.
* Work collaboratively with the project implementation teams/project consultants. Monitor the project's implementation, actively track its progress on a regular basis, and anticipate risks, if any.
* Assist manager in Budget, Grants, and Fund Utilization for projects. Track the payment schedule. Maintain a tracker sheet for project updates.
* Ensure the project is following the Logical Framework Analysis and Gantt chart.
* Ensure corporate partners are aware of the impact of their community investments through field visits and other document reporting means.
* Collect data from the field and prepare reports/ presentation decks as per templates.
* To develop and nurture strong relations and collaborations with relevant stakeholders, such as various stakeholders like donors, NGO staff, government officials, etc., for the successful implementation of the projects.
* Document the project activities and outcomes on a regular basis and submit the project status reports to the donor according to the committed timelines.
* Plan timely monitoring visits to the project sites with the stakeholders, update donors on the progress of the projects implemented across different locations, and document the visits by creating reports. Track project milestones and utilization within the scheduled project timelines
* Coordinate rollout, adoption and ongoing maintenance of digitization systems at Suvidha Centres.
* Draft updates with the social media team for the social media updates and website upgrades of the projects.
* Develop annual implementation plans and actively undertake field-based monitoring of projects regularly.

**Profile requisites:**

* Minimum experience of 2-4 years.
* Graduates, preferably from social sciences background, demonstrable experience in programme implementation, monitoring and evaluation.
* Passionate about programme implementation.
* Proficient in spoken and written English.
* Proficient in basic computer skills- MS word and Excel operations and presentations.
* Good in interpersonal communication and organizing field-based programmes.
* Ability to meet deadlines and work in teams collaboratively.
* Willing to work from office as well as actively travel for field visits.
* Ability to interact and connect effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.

**Remuneration:**
Subject to relevant qualification, experience & merit; the salary range is INR 4.5 to 7 LPA. If you think you might be suitable, apply now and we'll reach out to you soon.

title: Founders Office Intern
description:
Founder's Office Intern

About Us

Resollect is a Mumbai-based startup fixing how debt recovery works in India. We work with banks, asset reconstruction companies (ARCs) and NBFCs, and the industry has been stuck with clunky, manual processes for far too long. We're changing that by combining legal processes (SARFAESI, Sec 13(2), Sec 14, DRT) with smart automation, clean design, and AI that actually does something useful. We're a small, founder-led team with deep domain expertise, and we move fast.

The Role

We're looking for a Founder's Office Intern to work directly with our founder on whatever matters most that week. One week you're researching how ARCs price stressed loan portfolios, the next you're building a pitch deck for a bank, and the week after you're turning messy recovery data into a one-page update for investors.

It's the fastest way we know to learn how a company is actually built and run. We're big on AI here. We don't want someone who does repetitive work by hand. We want someone who reaches for AI first, builds their own small tools, writes their own prompts, and automates the boring stuff out of existence.

What You'll Do

Drive special projects for the founder, from defining the problem to getting it done.

Research markets, competitors and regulation (RBI guidelines, SARFAESI and DRT developments) and turn it into clear recommendations.

Build pitch decks, proposals and presentations for banks, NBFCs and ARCs.

Prepare MIS, dashboards and investor updates.

Track OKRs and action items across the team and follow up so nothing slips.

Use AI to move faster. Write prompts, build small tools, and automate recurring work.

Pitch in on hiring, partnerships and client onboarding as needed.

What We're Looking For

High agency. You figure things out yourself and don't wait to be told what to do.

Structured thinking. You can take an ambiguous question and break it into something answerable.

Excellent writing. Clear, crisp English that a busy founder or banker can read in a minute (Hindi is a plus).

Strong in Excel / Sheets and Slides / PowerPoint.

AI-native and extremely organised. You already use AI daily, and you close loops without being chased.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Internships in consulting, banking, a startup, or a founder's office

Case competitions, research projects, or something you've built

Interest in BFSI, lending, legal-tech, or how AI is changing old industries

Why This Might Be Worth Your Time

You'll see every part of the business and how decisions actually get made.

You'll get direct mentorship from the founder, and your work goes straight into real decisions.

You'll get genuinely good at using AI to do real work.

Strong performers have a real shot at converting to a full-time Founder's Office Associate role.

If you want a steep learning curve, love a messy problem, and would rather build the deck than watch someone else present it, we'd like to meet you.

This is a paid internship.

Location: Mumbai (Andheri), in-office

title: Vice President Supply Chain
description:
To oversees the efficient flow of goods, information, and finances from raw material procurement to final product delivery while coordinating with suppliers, manufacturing plant and distributors to meet customer demands
 



  Supply Chain Manager: Oversee the entire supply chain, develop strategies to optimize efficiency, manage budgets, and coordinate with various stakeholders.
 



  Procurement Specialist: Should have understanding and experience of sourcing and purchase raw materials, negotiate with suppliers, manage contracts, and ensure cost\-effective procurement. Build strategic suppliers for packing material. Understand the various activities and implications of imports and fulfilment of advance licenses.
 



  Logistics Coordinator: Manage transportation, warehousing, and distribution of goods, ensure timely delivery, and optimize logistics costs.
 



  Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels, forecast demand, manage stock replenishment, and minimize excess inventory of raw material, packing material and Finished Products.
 



  Demand Planner: Predict future product demand, create demand forecasts, and align supply chain activities with market needs. Identify minimum quantities of raw material and packing material to be kept so that economies of purchase and continuity of production can be maintained while balancing the working capital. Do ABC analysis of stocks.
 



  Product Launches \& Collaboration: Partner with business teams (R\&D, Production, Quality etc.) to support global product launches (in\-house and CMOs). Ensure timely delivery of final outputs within defined budgets and timelines.
 



  CMO: Build supplier base and Oversee procurement of CMO products at cost effective prices with continued high\-quality product supplies. Ensure quality compliance of CMO\-manufactured products through effective coordination with CMO partners, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional teams.
 



  Cross functional activities – Plant and manufacturing coordination: Ensure seamless collaboration between Supply Chain, Production, and Quality functions to achieve timely dispatch of products while maintaining compliance and service levels. Understand the plant capacities and ensure the plant is running at optimum capacities.
 



  Risk Management: Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the supply chain such as supply shortages, supplier disruptions, regulatory changes and geopolitical issues. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address challenges and business continuity.
 



  Technology and Innovation: Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies and innovations in supply chain management software, data analyst and automation.
 



  





**Competencies** 




  Hands\-on knowledge and exposure related to procurement, logistics, commercial of related materials in pharmaceutical formulations industry.
 



  Awareness on domestic/International pharma regulatory guidelines on Supply chain management.
 



  Knowledge and understanding of industry 4\.0 and its applicability in pharmaceutical industry.
