title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About MTechZilla**
MTechZilla is a web, mobile app, AI app, and cloud app development agency based in India. We are an offshore engineering partner for US and EU companies. We work with US and EU engineering teams through three engagement models: staff augmentation, team augmentation, and software development outsourcing. Our clients are CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Directors of Engineering at tech companies with 50 to 500 employees.
  
  
  
**About the Role**
Our buyers are founders, CTOs, and technical decision-makers in the US and Europe. They judge us on credibility signals before they get on a call. Our marketing material and our event presence are some of the first things they see. We are hiring a UI/UX Designer at a junior level. Marketing creatives and event creatives are the primary part of this role. You will design for one brand, our own. You will also support product interface and design system work in Figma. You will use AI tools in your daily work to deliver faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketing creatives (primary)**
• Design creatives for our marketing channels. Examples: LinkedIn, X, and Instagram posts, carousels, announcement graphics, and case study snippets.
  
• Design ad creatives and email graphics.
  
• Design one-pagers, case study layouts, and presentation slides.
  
• Adapt one message to different formats. Make each version fit its channel.
  
• Keep the output consistent at high volume.
  
  
**Event creatives (primary)**
• Design material for events and conferences. Examples: booth graphics, banners, standees, and printed collateral.
  
• Design event presentations and digital assets.
  
• Prepare print-ready files. Follow the size and format rules of each event.
  
• Work to event deadlines.
  
  
**UI/UX Design**
• Design screens, flows, and prototypes in Figma for our own website and products.
  
• Turn briefs and wireframes into clear interface designs.
  
• Support user research. Help with interviews, feedback sessions, and notes.
  
• Prepare clean design files and hand off notes for developers.
  
  
**Brand and design system**
• Apply the MTechZilla brand system: typography, color, grid, iconography, and imagery style.
  
• Build and maintain reusable templates and components in Figma.
  
• Report when the system breaks down. Suggest fixes.
  
• Keep source files organized and reusable.
  
  
**AI in the workflow**
• Use AI tools to speed up research, ideation, copy, and visual exploration.
  
• Check all AI output for quality before you use it.
  
• Share the AI methods that work with the team. Video and motion (future scope)
  
• Edit short videos and make simple animated assets.
  
• This is not required on day one. We value it if you have it.
  
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Craft**
• 2 to 3 years of experience in UI/UX or digital design.
  
• Strong command of Figma: auto layout, components, variants, and prototyping.
  
• A portfolio that shows marketing design work and UI/UX work.
  
• Good knowledge of typography, hierarchy, grid, and layout.
  
• Good understanding of UX fundamentals: user flows and usability.
  
• Basic knowledge of accessibility and contrast standards (WCAG AA). AI tooling
  
• Practical use of AI tools in a design workflow. Examples: Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or equivalent. • You use AI to speed up your work. You do not use it in place of your own design thinking.
  
  
**AI tooling**
• Practical use of AI tools in a design workflow. Examples: Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or equivalent.
  
• You use AI to speed up your work. You do not use it in place of your own design thinking.
  

**Nice-to-haves**
• Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
  
• Basic video editing skills.
  
• Basic motion design skills.
  
• Experience in print and event design.
  
• Experience at a B2B SaaS company, agency, or dev studio that serves Western clients.
  
• Understanding of how design decisions affect engagement and conversion.
  
  
  
Benefits
  
  
• Competitive fixed salary, based on experience.
  
• Performance-based bonus.
  
• Annual appraisal cycle.
  
• PF (Provident Fund) and other statutory benefits.
  
• Paid time off.
  
• Paid sick leave and casual leave.
  
• Public holidays.
  
• Flexible working hours.
  
• Access to premium design tools.

title: Software Engineer
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
  
  
HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
  
  
We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled
**Software Engineer with 2–5 years of experience**
, having strong hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have excellent programming fundamentals, strong UI development skills, and practical experience building responsive, accessible, and maintainable web applications.
  
  
The role involves developing new features, enhancing existing applications, resolving technical and accessibility issues, and collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams.
  
  
We value
**depth of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and hands-on coding skills**
over exposure to a large number of technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain modern web applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, performant, and accessible UI components following frontend engineering best practices.
* Implement new application features, improve existing functionality, and resolve complex UI-related defects.
* Identify and fix accessibility issues through code-level changes, ensuring applications follow WCAG guidelines and accessible design principles.
* Work with Node.js to develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code.
* Debug and troubleshoot frontend and backend issues, including browser compatibility, UI behavior, and application performance.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, and development productivity.
* Review and validate AI-generated code before integrating it into applications.
* Work with GitHub, pull requests, and GitHub Actions-based development workflows.
* Collaborate with international engineering, product, and QA teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Take ownership of assigned development tasks, communicate progress proactively, and meet agreed commitments.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement activities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–5 years of hands-on software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and UI development.
* Excellent proficiency in React.js and TypeScript, including functional components, hooks, state management, component lifecycle, and API integration.
* Strong command of JavaScript , HTML5, and CSS3, including responsive layouts, Flexbox, CSS Grid, DOM manipulation, and browser behavior.
* Strong hands-on experience developing accessible web interfaces, including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, focus management, and implementing accessibility fixes.
* Good understanding of WCAG 2.1/2.2 guidelines and practical experience addressing accessibility issues in application code.
* Good working knowledge of Node.js, including REST API development, asynchronous programming, and backend integrations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Good understanding of Git, GitHub, pull requests, and basic GitHub Actions/CI/CD workflows.
* Familiarity with AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools, with an interest in applying reusable AI skills and coding workflows.
* Experience writing unit tests using Jest, React Testing Library, or similar frameworks.
* Strong debugging, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with minimal supervision.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with international teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, willingness to learn, and commitment to quality and delivery.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with AWS services.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
* Experience with frontend performance optimization and reusable component libraries.
* Familiarity with accessibility validation tools such as axe-core, Lighthouse, NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver.
* Experience using AI coding agents such as Devin and creating reusable AI development skills or workflows.
* Experience with Playwright or other end-to-end testing frameworks.

**What We Value**
We are looking for a
**strong hands-on developer with excellent frontend engineering fundamentals**
, rather than someone with superficial knowledge of many technologies.
  
  
The successful candidate should be confident in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and accessibility implementation, capable of independently solving development challenges, and willing to learn additional technologies as required.
  
  
We value technical depth, curiosity, ownership, effective communication, and a commitment to building high-quality software.

title: Technology Intern
description:
Tech Intern — GoGro

**Shopify & web development · D2C · Early-stage startup**

**Location:**
Gurgaon (Sector 32) ·
**Work from office**

**Type:**
6-month paid internship with a monthly stipend

**PPO:**
Pre-placement offer for a full-time role, based on performance

**Start:**
Immediate

**Reports to:**
Co-founder

The role in summary

Own the website end to end : build it, grow its traffic, and turn visitors into customers. This is not a role where you take tickets and wait. You will be the person who knows the site best. You will spot what's broken, find out what's next and ship it.

About GoGro

GoGro is an early-stage,
**D2C brand**
building a
**Stage-Right Development System**
for children aged 0–7: developmental toys, physical play kits and online tools, each designed for a specific stage, with expert-backed guidance for parents.
Founded by experienced entrepreneur, the company operates at the intersection of neuroscience, early childhood development, and consumer products.

What you will own

**Build and run the Shopify store**

* Build new pages, sections, landing pages and modules for kit launches, campaigns and partnerships
* Customise the theme in Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, beyond what the theme editor allows
* Integrate Shopify apps and third-party APIs (reviews, subscriptions, email, WhatsApp, payments)
* Keep the store fast, stable and bug-free on every device; manage products, collections and offers
* Get the store ready for international markets: multi-currency, shipping and localisation

**Get found: SEO, AEO and AAO**

* **SEO:**
  technical and on-page SEO (schema, meta data, internal linking, Core Web Vitals) so we rank for what parents search
* **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation):**
  structure content so GoGro appears in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers
* **AAO (AI Agent Optimisation):**
  make our product data and checkout easy for AI shopping agents to read, compare and buy from

**Own the conversion funnel**

* Own the numbers from first visit to purchase to repeat order
* Run A/B tests on layouts, copy, offers and page flows, and act on the results
* Set up analytics (GA4, Search Console, Meta Pixel, heatmaps) and share a monthly report with clear next steps

**Build tools for parents**

* Build interactive widgets that help parents with their child's development
* Help integrate the GoGro philosophy in our tech

Who you are

**An owner, not an executor.**
You treat the site as your own product. You notice problems before anyone points them out, figure things out from docs and forums without hand-holding, and measure yourself by results, not tasks completed. This matters more to us than any other skill.

**Must-have**

* **Hands-on Shopify development:**
  you have built or managed at least one live store (college, freelance and personal projects count)
* Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript; comfortable reading and editing Liquid
* Basic Python and a working understanding of REST APIs: consuming third-party APIs, handling JSON, authentication and frontend-backend communication
* A working grasp of SEO and conversion basics
* A sharp eye for design detail, and clear written and spoken English

**Good to have**

* React.js
* SEO, AEO or GEO work with results you can show
* A/B testing and behaviour analytics tools (VWO, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or similar)
* Canva or Figma for quick banners and edits
* Interest in D2C brands, parenting or early childhood

**Education:**
B.E. or B.Tech from a Tier 1 engineering college, final year or recent graduate. Your Shopify portfolio carries as much weight as your degree.

What you get

* **A monthly stipend for 6 months, and a PPO**
  for a full-time role in the GoGro team, based on performance
* **Real ownership**
  of a live D2C brand's website from day one, not a sandbox project
* **Early-stage startup experience:**
  speed, breadth, and work that real parents see every day
* Direct mentorship from seasoned Founders who built one of India's largest parenting platforms
* Exposure to an international D2C launch
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation

What success looks like

* **30 days:**
  You know the store inside out, have fixed the obvious issues and set up funnel tracking.
* **3 months:**
  You ship new pages within days of a request, A/B tests run every month, and the first parent tool is live.
* **6 months:**
  Traffic, AI visibility and conversion are measurably up, two parent tools are live, and the store is ready for new kits and international markets.

How to apply

1. Your CV
2. Links to Shopify stores or websites you have built or managed, with a line on your role in each
3. A short note (under 200 words): three things you would build on a D2C website to grow traffic or conversion, and one tool you would build for parents. Send to helloatgogrotoysdotcom

**Selection process:**

Application review --> Technical round -->Practical Technical task --> Conversation with the founder

description:
**Location:**

Delhi

Entry-Level | Fresh Graduates Welcome

**Function:**

Content Operations

**About the Role**

Adaan Digital is hiring a
**German Content Quality Specialist – AI/HITL**

for our AI-first content operations team.

We build lead-generation websites for SMBs across Europe. AI generates the first draft of website content and blogs;
**your job is to make sure the final output is accurate, natural, useful, and publish-ready.**

You will primarily work on German-language websites and may occasionally support similar AI-assisted workflows across other languages.

**What You'll Do**

* Review AI-generated German website content and blogs.
* Check content against customer briefs, product/service information and quality checklists.
* Detect hallucinations, factual errors, missing information and unsupported claims.
* Fix awkward, repetitive, generic or unnatural German.
* Manually rewrite content where AI output isn't good enough.
* Write/edit CTAs, button text, headings, meta titles/descriptions and alt text.
* Apply defined
  **SEO, AEO and GEO**

  content best practices.
* Ensure content supports the customer's intended audience and conversion objective.
* Use GPT and other AI tools to improve quality and productivity.
* Flag unclear information instead of making assumptions.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong practical written German.
* Good working English.
* Strong German grammar, vocabulary and language comprehension.
* Excellent attention to detail and critical thinking.
* Ability to understand and follow structured briefs.
* Comfortable learning and working with AI tools.
* Interest in digital content, SEO, AEO and GEO.
* Ability to learn quickly and take ownership of your work.

**Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.**

Candidates who studied
**German as a third language through Class 12**

may also apply. Formal German degrees or certifications are not mandatory; selection will be based on demonstrated German proficiency and performance in our practical assessment.

**AI-First Performance Culture**

At Adaan, AI isn't an occasional tool—it's part of everyday execution.

We expect you to use AI intelligently while remaining accountable for the final output. “AI generated it” isn't a reason to accept inaccurate or poor-quality content.

Performance is measured on quality, timeliness and productivity, including:

* **97%+ First Time Right (FTR)**
* **97%+ On Time Every Time (OTET)**
* Brief and checklist compliance
* Content accuracy and language quality
* Effective use of AI
* Continuous productivity improvement

Performance is reviewed through structured monthly check-ins.

Adaan works with global markets, so ownership of client delivery commitments is expected across time zones and, when genuinely required, weekends or Indian public holidays.

**Compensation & Growth**

We follow a
**fixed pay + performance-linked variable pay**

model.

High performers can earn disproportionately more. Average performance earns average pay.
**Impact is rewarded—not effort alone.**

You can grow from German HITL/content quality into
**Senior Content Quality, SEO/AEO/GEO, Multilingual Quality, AI Content Operations or AI Workflow Optimization**

roles.

**Why Adaan?**

This isn't a conventional content-writing job.

You'll learn to work at the intersection of
**German + AI + Content Quality + SEO + AEO + GEO + Digital Operations**

.

If you're curious about AI, strong with language, attentive to detail and want to build skills for the next generation of digital work, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Agricultural Research Analyst
description:
**Company**
: Saulikh, backed by SynVesCo Ventures Pvt. Ltd.

**Location**
: Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Reports to:**
Head of Product

**About Saulikh**

Saulikh is a verified B2B sourcing platform for herbs, spices and botanicals, connecting

global buyers with qualified suppliers. We are building the trust layer for global

botanical trade, where every supplier and buyer is verified and every transaction is

backed by reliable quality information. Saulikh is a venture of SynVesCo Ventures Pvt.

Ltd.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an Agricultural Research Analyst to build in-depth knowledge of

herbs, spices and botanicals. This person will research products, their quality, prices

and markets, and turn this into clear content and reports for our buyers and team.

Knowledge of international quality standards is a plus, and training will be provided

where needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research assigned herbs, spices and botanicals in depth, including varieties, growing regions, grades, harvest seasons and production trends
* Track what affects prices and availability, such as weather, crop conditions, government policy and global demand
* Learn the quality requirements buyers look for in each product, and help create simple product guides and specification sheets
* Write clear, easy-to-read product pages and reports for buyers and the internal team
* Review supplier quality documents and lab reports, and flag anything that looks incorrect or incomplete (training will be provided)
* Coordinate with farmers, FPOs, traders, processors and suppliers to gather information on quality, availability and pricing
* Visit mandis, farms or processing units occasionally to learn about products and validate research
* Maintain an organized record of research, price data and market contacts

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Botany, Food Technology, Agribusiness or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in agri research, quality, procurement or trading
* Good knowledge of at least one category: spices, herbs, medicinal plants or seeds
* Understanding of product quality and grading
* Interest in learning about export markets and international quality standards

**Skills & Attributes**

* Curious, research-minded and detail-oriented
* Good written English to prepare clear reports and product content
* Good communication with suppliers and farmers, including in local language
* Comfortable working with data in Excel or Google Sheets
* Open to occasional travel to markets, farms or processing units

**Good to Have**

* Experience with spice or herbal exporters
* Exposure to quality testing or lab reports
* Basic knowledge of export documentation

title: Global Service Catalog Design Architect
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Global Service Catalog Design Architect role owns the Securitas Service Catalog and Employee Center Pro portal from a technical design perspective. You will govern the consolidation of 1,500+ catalog items, establish AI-readable build standards, drive global UX consistency and ensure that every employee — across 44 countries — can find, request and receive the services they need through a single, intuitive portal experience. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. The catalog is the face of the ServiceNow platform for 340,000 users.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Catalog Consolidation & Governance

+ Own the end-to-end governance of the 1,500+ catalog item consolidation — rationalizing duplicate country specific catalogs into a single global taxonomy.
+ Audit the existing catalog estate, identify redundant, outdated and unowned items, and drive the decommission or rebuild of items that do not meet global standards.
+ Assign and enforce catalog ownership across all items — eliminating the item ownership gap and establishing a process that prevents recurrence.
+ Design and implement a global catalog governance framework — including item lifecycle management, review cycles, owner accountability and retirement processes.

**AI-Readable Catalog Build Standards**

* Define and enforce AI-readable catalog build standards across all catalog items — ensuring that item descriptions, keywords, metadata and fulfillment logic are structured for optimal Virtual Agent search and recommendation performance.
* Work directly with the AI and AI Search teams to validate that catalog items are surfaced correctly in virtual agent conversations and search results.
* Lead the rearchitecting of catalog items for Natural Language Processing (NLP) compatibility — enabling the virtual agent to handle catalog requests without human intervention.
* Build a quality gate process that all new catalog items must pass before promotion to production — including AI readability scoring.

**Employee Center Pro & Portal Design**

* Own the design and ongoing evolution of the Securitas Employee Center Pro (ESC) portal — creating a unified, intuitive self-service experience for all employees globally.
* Drive UX consistency across regions — ensuring the portal experience is equivalent for all users Globally
* Lead the migration from legacy Service Portal (SP) to Employee Center Pro — managing stakeholder alignment, phased rollout and change management.
* Define localization standards for portal content — working with regional teams to ensure language, cultural and accessibility requirements are met.

**Platform Demand Management**

* Serve as the technical reviewer for all catalog and portal-related demands in the ServiceNow demand management pipeline.
* Provide architecture guidance and T-shirt size estimates for catalog demands as part of the chargeback governance model.
* Ensure all new catalog items are designed to global standards from inception — reducing rework and technical debt.

**Innovation & Adoption**

* Drive self-service adoption globally — setting and tracking targets for catalog utilisation, deflection rates and user satisfaction scores.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities within fulfillment workflows — reducing manual fulfillment effort across the platform team.
* Lead the adoption of new ServiceNow catalog capabilities — including Dynamic Translation, Catalog Builder and AI-assisted fulfillment.

* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
7–10 years of hands-on ServiceNow implementation experience, with a minimum of 4 years specialising in Service Catalog design and Employee Center / Service Portal. Demonstrated experience leading large-scale catalog consolidation or rationalization programs — ideally in multi-region, multi-language environments. Track record of improving self-service adoption and deflection rates through catalog and portal optimization. Experience working with ServiceNow AI capabilities — including Virtual Agent, AI Search and Natural Language Understanding (NLU) topic design.
  
  

* Deep expertise in ServiceNow Service Catalog, including Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variables, Client Scripts and UI Policies.
* Strong experience with Employee Center Pro — design, configuration, branding and content management.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow Flow Designer and Workflow Editor for fulfillment automation.
* Experience with ServiceNow Virtual Agent design — including topic design, NLU training and catalog integration.
* Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and multilingual content management.
* Familiarity with Dynamic Translation and ServiceNow localisation capabilities.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

title: Social Media Executive & Content Writer (Wellness & Spiritual Content)
description:
**Social Media Executive – PMC Hindi**

**Location:**
New Delhi (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**About PMC Hindi**

PMC Hindi (Pyramid Meditation Channel Hindi) is a growing meditation and conscious-living media platform on a mission to make meditation and practical wisdom accessible to millions.

Through YouTube shows, podcasts, Instagram content, digital courses, our meditation app, and offline retreats, we create content that helps people understand themselves better, question their beliefs, and bring meaningful change into everyday life.

We're building a modern media platform where ancient wisdom meets contemporary storytelling — and we're looking for creative people who want their work to make a difference.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**creative, trend-savvy, and growth-oriented Social Media Executive**
who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch, share, and engage.

You'll be responsible for managing and growing PMC Hindi's presence across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and emerging social platforms.

From identifying viral content opportunities and writing engaging captions to planning content calendars, publishing posts, interacting with our community, and tracking performance — you'll play a key role in how millions discover and connect with meditation.

**This role is for someone who doesn't just consume social media but understands how to make content perform.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media Management & Execution**

* Manage day-to-day operations of PMC Hindi's Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other social media accounts.
* Plan, schedule, and publish Reels, Shorts, Stories, carousels, and other content consistently.
* Create and maintain weekly and monthly content calendars aligned with content releases, campaigns, and events.
* Ensure content is published with engaging captions, relevant keywords, hashtags, thumbnails, and strong calls-to-action.
* Coordinate with video editors, designers, and content teams to ensure timely delivery.

**2. Content Ideation & Copywriting**

* Identify engaging content ideas, trending topics, hooks, and storytelling formats relevant to our audience.
* Write compelling captions, short-form video scripts, carousel copy, and promotional content in Hindi, Hinglish, and English.
* Turn long-form podcasts, interviews, and spiritual discussions into engaging short-form content ideas.
* Identify high-potential moments and timestamps from long-form YouTube videos for Reels and Shorts.
* Simplify complex ideas around meditation, emotions, relationships, and personal growth into relatable everyday content.

**3. Social Media Growth & Trends**

* Stay updated on Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook trends, platform updates, and algorithm best practices.
* Research successful creators, content formats, and competitor strategies to identify new growth opportunities.
* Experiment with different hooks, formats, posting times, captions, and content styles to improve reach.
* Implement platform-specific SEO practices, including keywords, titles, descriptions, and hashtags.
* Develop creative ideas to increase organic reach, followers, shares, saves, and audience engagement.

**4. Community Management**

* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and audience interactions in a timely, thoughtful manner.
* Initiate conversations through interactive Stories, polls, questions, and community-driven content.
* Encourage meaningful discussions and participation around PMC Hindi's content.
* Identify audience questions, feedback, and experiences that can inspire future content.
* Help convert social media audiences into active participants in our meditation programs, app, and events.

**5. Analytics & Performance Tracking**

* Track social media performance using Instagram Insights, YouTube Studio, and Meta Business Suite.
* Monitor metrics such as reach, watch time, retention, engagement rate, follower growth, and shares.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting key insights.
* Identify top-performing and underperforming content and suggest actionable improvements.
* Use audience insights and performance data to continuously refine content strategies.

**6. Campaigns & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Support digital campaigns for meditation programs, workshops, retreats, events, and app launches.
* Work closely with the creative, production, and marketing teams to execute campaigns.
* Create platform-specific promotional content and coordinate campaign publishing.
* Ensure a consistent brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across social channels.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts for a brand, creator, media company, or digital platform.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Stories, Facebook, and platform-specific content strategies.
* **Excellent Hindi and Hinglish writing skills**
  , with the ability to create relatable, engaging, and grammatically correct content.
* Demonstrated experience planning content calendars, publishing content, and managing social media accounts independently.
* Understanding of social media analytics, audience behavior, and organic growth strategies.
* Ability to recognize trending formats and adapt them creatively for a brand.
* Strong sense of visual storytelling, hooks, copywriting, and audience engagement.
* Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* A proactive mindset, ownership of work, and willingness to experiment and learn.

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, Canva, and social media scheduling tools.
* Basic understanding of video editing and short-form content production.
* Experience growing a brand's Instagram or YouTube presence organically.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, content ideation, and improving workflows.
* Experience managing social media campaigns for events, communities, or digital products.
* Interest in meditation, psychology, personal growth, or conscious living is a plus.

**What You'll Get to Work On**

* Original podcasts and shows featuring meaningful conversations on life, meditation, and human behaviour.
* Short-form content that makes profound ideas simple, relatable, and shareable.
* Digital campaigns for meditation programs reaching people across India.
* Large-scale events, retreats, and a growing meditation community.
* Creative experiments with new formats, storytelling techniques, and audience engagement.

**If you're someone who loves social media, thinks creatively, understands what makes content work, and wants to use your skills to create a positive impact — we'd love to hear from you.**

**To Apply: Share your resume, links to social media accounts you've managed, and 2–3 examples of your best-performing content.**

title: Graphic Designer (Brand & Marketing)
description:
Graphic Designer (Brand & Marketing)
  
About Greenway

Greenway is a product innovation and energy transitions company serving more than 3.5 million customers in Asia and Africa. Our products reduce costs and drudgery for our customers, increase their quality of life, and expand renewable energy use. Our current product portfolio spans clean cooking, lighting and productive use covering energy generation, storage, and demand. Greenway leverages a range of financing models and builds lasting partnerships with governments, philanthropies, financiers, and carbon market players. We aim to reach 10 million customers by 2030.

Founded by graduates of IIM-Ahmedabad, FMS, and DTU in 2010, Greenway has distributed its products to 10+ markets. Communicating this impact clearly and consistently — to households, customers, partners, and funders — is central to how we grow.

Role Overview

The Graphic Designer (Brand & Marketing) will own the visual expression of the Greenway brand, producing high-quality creatives that support our marketing and sales efforts across:

* Social media
* Digital campaigns
* The new Greenway website (in development)
* Sales and partnership collateral (decks, brochures, proposals)
* Print and point-of-sale material for field sales
* Video and motion content

This is a hands-on role that combines design execution with brand and content thinking. You will turn briefs into finished work quickly, contribute to campaign strategy, and manage the external agencies that support Greenway’s creative output.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Design & Production

* Design a wide range of creatives — digital static, video and motion, and print — for online and offline marketing, sales, and social media
* Apply and uphold Greenway’s brand guidelines consistently across every touchpoint
* Deliver fast turnarounds without compromising on quality, managing multiple briefs in parallel

Content Strategy & Campaigns

* Contribute to content strategy for marketing campaigns, drawing on visual craft, audience and behavioural insights, and communication best practice
* Support Greenway’s digital marketing campaigns and the ongoing development of the website

Agency Management

* Work directly with agencies to brief, review, and deliver content on demand
* Scout and recommend agencies, support their onboarding, and manage ongoing relationships with agencies supporting Greenway’s creative work

Planning & Reporting

* Build and maintain a content calendar across channels
* Provide regular progress and performance reports to management

What We’re Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in graphic design, with a focus on brand and marketing creatives and social media
* A strong portfolio spanning digital, video/motion, and print work
* Proficiency in industry-standard design and editing tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Wondershare, Canva, etc.)
* Experience briefing and managing external agencies or freelancers
* A self-starter who takes initiative and can run with a brief without close supervision
* An out-of-the-box thinker who uses AI not to cut corners, but as a force multiplier for their creativity
* The highest standards of quality and accountability, and a person who thrives in an environment where feedback is continuous, immediate, direct, and constructive
* Ability to switch contexts quickly and handle multiple complex tasks at the same time
* Bonus: Experience designing for rural or vernacular audiences, or in the social impact or climate sector

Location & Work Arrangement

* Based in Delhi-NCR (non-negotiable), ideally Delhi or Noida

How to Apply

* Apply on LinkedIn with your CV and portfolio in a single PDF file. Alternatively, send your CV and portfolio with a short cover message to ganesh.ru@greenwayappliances.com

title: Research Manager

With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn more at www.tolunacorporate.com

**Role Overview:**

The Research Manager will be the key link between the clients and research teams. You’ll take ownership of projects end-to-end — from understanding client needs to designing research, ensuring smooth execution, analyzing data, and delivering insights that really make an impact.

**Key**
**Responsibilities**

Draft questionnaires/screeners/moderator guides/tag trees, do final link reviews, create tab specs/basic charts/charting instructions/templates, draft headlines/commentary (for senior sign-off).   **.**

  **.**

Begins to build trusted relationships with day‑to‑day client contacts, responding accurately to queries and managing basic issues independently. We’re looking for someone who’s excited by the idea of combining data, storytelling, and client collaboration.

title: Assistant Manager - Paid Media
description:
We are looking for a hands-on paid media professional who can independently set up, launch, manage and optimise campaigns across multiple platforms. This is primarily an execution role, with responsibility for campaign accuracy, budget control, daily monitoring, optimisation and reporting across multiple clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Campaign Setup & Launch**

* Set up and launch campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and X Ads.
* Translate approved media plans into platform-ready campaigns with the correct objectives, audiences, placements, formats, bids and budgets.
* Coordinate creatives, copy, landing pages, tracking links and UTMs, and complete detailed pre-launch checks.
* Ensure campaigns are approved and launched on time; resolve ad rejections, tracking errors and platform setup issues.

**Campaign Management & Optimisation**

* Monitor live campaigns daily and manage budget pacing to prevent overspend, underspend or delayed delivery.
* Optimise bids, budgets, audiences, placements, devices, formats and creative combinations based on performance.
* Troubleshoot delivery, audience, approval, tracking and platform-related issues independently.
* Monitor frequency, audience saturation and creative fatigue, and flag when fresh assets are required.
* Run structured A/B tests and reallocate spends after approval to improve campaign efficiency.

**Reporting & Budget Control**

* Maintain accurate campaign trackers, budget sheets, spend records, PO allocations and remaining balances.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports using data consolidated from multiple platforms in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Track relevant metrics including reach, impressions, frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, VTR, CPF, CPL, CPA and conversions.
* Clearly explain performance, changes made, issues identified and immediate next steps.

**Coordination & Planning Support**

* Work closely with account, content and creative teams to collect inputs, meet specifications and launch on schedule.
* Provide regular campaign updates and join routine client calls on status, spends and performance.
* Support execution-ready media plans with platform estimates and basic budget splits based on benchmarks and past performance.

**Must-Have Experience:**

* 3+ years of hands-on paid media experience, preferably in an agency or multi-client environment.
* Demonstrable experience personally setting up and managing campaigns in-platform, not only coordinating with another team or agency.
* Hands-on working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (Search and Display), YouTube, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and X Ads.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for budgeting, campaign tracking, analysis and reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets and timelines with strong attention to detail.
* Good understanding of campaign metrics and the actions required to improve delivery and performance.

**Good to Have:**

GA4, conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, UTM implementation and Looker Studio or similar dashboarding tools.

description:
**About TETR**

Five years ago, we started Masters’ Union; our vision: to redefine the landscape of business education. We posed a simple question: If aspiring doctors learn from seasoned physicians and budding lawyers learn from legal experts, why shouldn't future business leaders learn directly from industry experts?

After all, can a lecture on Accounting 101 truly compare to the hands-on experience of analyzing real PnL statements?

Today, Masters' Union has an unparalleled curriculum with faculty comprising Industry Leaders and practitioners unlike any other in the country. Our academic council includes CXOs, MDs, Eminent Public Leaders, and even Members of Parliament. In just four years of operations, our flagship PGP in Technology and Business Management has achieved remarkable success, surpassing the placement records of esteemed institutions like IIM Ahmedabad and ISB.

Masters’ Union is now ranked among the top 2 B-schools in the country based on placement records.

With our growing global recognition, we realized that the hands-on experience of building real businesses, which proved to be highly effective for students in India, could offer immense value to aspiring entrepreneurs worldwide.

title: Warranty Manager
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Warranty Manager – Projects**
As a Warranty Manager, your main objective will be to orchestrate end-to-end warranty support, fleet reliability, field technical interventions, and depot operations for the Vande Bharat Trainsets/ EMU /MEMU /Metro /Electric Locomotives fleet powered by Siemens propulsion systems. You will support the project leadership and serve as the critical technical and operational interface between Siemens internal and external stakeholders, Management, Indian Railways (Zonal Divisions, RDSO, Railway Board and Production Units like MCF/ICF/RCF). Your role will involve ensuring contractual fleet availability, prompt resolution of line failures, flawless execution of prototype and series trials, and stringent safety adherence during yard and depot maintenance activities.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Acting as the primary technical SPOC with Zonal Railway authorities across Indian Railways for all warranty-related operational matters.
* Coordinating and expediting critical site approvals, including Power Blocks, Non-OHE zone roof access, yard line allotment, shunting permissions, and dynamic trial slots at various railway yards.
* Maintaining proactive alignment with RDSO and Indian Railways / Zonal Divisions for fleet monitoring, warranty administration, claim settlements, and joint inspection sign-offs.
* Ensuring maximum trainset availability by driving rapid turnaround times (TAT) for trouble calls, line failures, and preventive maintenance checks.
* Leading the 24/7 on-call technical response team to troubleshoot critical operational issues during commercial service and trial runs.
* Leading detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure investigations report and Job Card Closure for component/system failures (Traction Converter, Auxiliary Converter, TCMS, High-Voltage roof gear, Pantograph, Traction Motors, Brake interface, etc.).
* Planning, monitoring and coordinating mainline dynamic performance checks and maintenance for series rakes undergoing revenue service on designated railway corridors.
* Planning and rolling out engineering change orders (ECOs), software upgrades, and hardware modifications across distributed train maintenance depots without impacting rake turnaround times.
* Enforcing strict adherence to high-voltage safety standards (25 kV AC), lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, Siemens Zero Harm Culture and Indian Railways General & Subsidiary Rules (G&SR) during roof-top and underframe inspections.
* Managing localized safety stock, critical rotable spares, and diagnostic test benches across designated maintenance sheds and depots.
* Supervising the reverse logistics and return of failed Line-Replaceable Units (LRUs) to manufacturing plants or central repair facilities for root cause failure analysis and warranty replacement.
* Generating weekly and monthly Fleet Reliability & Warranty Performance Dashboards tracking MTBF, MDBF, MTTR, and punctuality loss attribution.
* Issuing formal joint investigation reports (JIR) with Railway technical officers for disputed failure categories and maintaining comprehensive, audit-ready warranty documentation.
* Planning activities related to Warranty Management including Spares, tools and Manpower to ensure that warranty related topics are driven timely and effectively

**Desired Skills**

* You should have min 12 to 15 years’ hands-on experience in rolling stock customer service or warranty management in the Railway / Metro sector, along with a bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
* Direct working experience with Indian Railways operations, RDSO procedures, and Railway Maintenance Depots/Sheds (EMU/MEMU/Vande Bharat/Electric Locomotives/Metros).
* Deep technical familiarity with 25 kV AC propulsion equipment (IGBT-based inverters), Train Control & Management Systems (TCMS) architecture, Auxiliary Power Supplies, High-Voltage roof lines, Pantographs and dynamic braking systems.
* In-depth understanding of Indian Railways operating protocols, yard working rules, power block/traffic block procedures, Maintenance methodologies and depot escalation channels.
* Proven crisis management ability to stay composed and deliver immediate technical solutions during high-stakes punctuality and safety incidents on mainline tracks.
* Strong negotiation and diplomatic stakeholder management skills to interface effectively with Zonal Railways, RDSO, production units and depot technicians.
* Exceptional written communication skills for drafting formal Railway project letters, joint investigation notes, and technical memos, along with fluent verbal communication in English and Hindi.
* Detail-oriented approach with a high level of accuracy in reliability tracking, process adherence, and quality documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary field support teams and work effectively in a dynamic 24/7 operational environment.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based on Gurugram. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers. #SL

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
  
  
The team prepares and reports P&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, TRS, ETFs and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P&L to Front Office & Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P&L or other issues on an ad-hoc basis
* Front-to-Back analysis & reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month-end controls ensuring management vs financial P&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Excel Power Query or Alteryx would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

**Experience Range\***
2-5 years of experience in Global Markets
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Prior BFC experience for >2 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply

**Desired Skills**

* Must be proactive and be a highly-motivated self-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player

* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

1:30 PM to 10:30 PM

Hyderabad/Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Analyst I, GBS - Knowledge Management
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Analyst I, GBS - Knowledge Management**
will support the development, governance, maintenance, and continuous improvement of knowledge across Global Business Services.
  
  
The role will partner with process owners, SMEs, operations teams, and functional stakeholders to capture business-critical knowledge and convert it into
**clear, standardized, accessible, and reusable knowledge assets**
.
  
  
The Analyst will support SOP governance, knowledge repositories, process documentation, training and knowledge-transfer materials, while helping strengthen knowledge adoption and reduce dependency on individual or tribal knowledge.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Knowledge Capture & Documentation**

* Partner with SMEs, process owners, and GBS teams to capture operational and process knowledge.
* Create, update, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, process guides, FAQs, checklists, knowledge articles, and training materials.
* Convert complex process information into structured and easy-to-understand documentation.
* Support process mapping and documentation of critical operational workflows.

**Knowledge Repository Management**

* Maintain organized knowledge repositories using platforms such as Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Teams.
* Ensure knowledge assets are appropriately categorized, version-controlled, searchable, and accessible to relevant users.
* Perform periodic content reviews to identify outdated, duplicate, or obsolete documentation.
* Support repository structure, metadata, naming conventions, and document lifecycle management.

**Knowledge Governance**

* Support the implementation of Knowledge Management standards and governance across GBS.
* Track document ownership, review cycles, approvals, version history, and expiry dates.
* Coordinate periodic SOP and knowledge-asset reviews with process owners and SMEs.
* Maintain an audit-ready trail of approvals and document changes.

**Knowledge Transfer & Capability Building**

* Support structured knowledge-transfer activities during onboarding, transitions, process changes, and new service migrations.
* Develop training decks, quick-reference guides, FAQs, and onboarding materials.
* Coordinate KT sessions with process SMEs and track completion and knowledge readiness.
* Help identify recurring knowledge gaps and recommend appropriate training or documentation interventions.

**Continuous Improvement & Analytics**

* Monitor knowledge-management metrics such as SOP compliance, review-cycle completion, repository usage, content freshness, training completion, and knowledge gaps.
* Identify opportunities to simplify documentation, improve findability, and standardize knowledge-management practices.
* Support automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled knowledge-management initiatives where applicable.
* Prepare regular dashboards and status reports highlighting risks, gaps, overdue reviews, and improvement opportunities.

The emphasis on SharePoint, Teams, process mapping, SOP governance and repository management aligns with existing Kraft Heinz Knowledge Management positioning.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  

* Business-critical GBS knowledge is documented, current, and easily accessible.
* SOPs and knowledge articles follow established templates and governance standards.
* Knowledge repositories remain structured, searchable, and current.
* Document reviews and approvals are completed within agreed timelines.
* Knowledge-transfer activities are appropriately documented and tracked.
* Repetitive knowledge gaps and documentation issues are identified and resolved.
* GBS teams have reliable knowledge resources to support onboarding and day-to-day operations.

**Skills, Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Operations, Communications, Information Management, or a related discipline.

**About the Role:**

We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. ● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies

● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement

● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards

● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards

● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

● Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6+ years preferred.

● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology

● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors

● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation

● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams

**Nice to have**

● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes

● ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor or Lead Assessor certification

● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives

● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols

● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

About the Role

AZOCA Technologies is looking for a proactive and experienced Outreach Manager to oversee the daily operations of its Robotics Gallery at Science City, Ahmedabad.

The role involves managing gallery staff, coordinating visitor activities, maintaining operational standards, and ensuring a smooth and engaging visitor experience. The candidate will work closely with the Senior Manager, Science City Management, schools, colleges, and other stakeholders to support effective communication and efficient gallery operations.

Location Eligibility – Important

**This position is strictly on-site at Science City, Ahmedabad. Only candidates currently residing in Ahmedabad are eligible to apply. Candidates residing outside Ahmedabad will not be considered for this position.**

Applicants must be available to work on-site and manage day-to-day gallery operations in Ahmedabad.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations Management:**
  Oversee daily gallery operations and ensure smooth functioning of robotic exhibits and visitor areas.
* **Team Management:**
  Supervise tour guides, robotics operators, and gallery staff, ensuring effective duty allocation and staff deployment.
* **Attendance & Performance Monitoring:**
  Manage staff attendance, shift schedules, punctuality, discipline, grooming, and performance.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Coordinate with the Senior Manager, Science City Management, internal teams, and external stakeholders on operational and administrative matters.

  Liaise with schools, colleges, and educational institutions to coordinate group visits, student tours, and educational activities.
* **Visitor Experience:**
  Monitor visitor flow, address queries and complaints, handle escalations, and maintain high service standards.
* **Technical Coordination:**
  Coordinate with technical and support teams to resolve operational issues and ensure robotic exhibits remain functional and safe.
* **Communication & Follow-ups:**
  Share operational updates, address stakeholder concerns, and follow up on pending tasks.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
  Prepare daily operational reports, staff updates, visitor feedback summaries, and management reports.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Identify operational challenges and coordinate with relevant teams to improve operational efficiency and visitor engagement.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline from a recognized university.
* Candidates with degrees in Business Administration or Engineering are encouraged to apply.
* MBA/PGDM in Operations, Marketing, or General Management will be an added advantage.
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in operations management, team supervision, stakeholder coordination, outreach, or visitor management.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in stakeholder coordination and relationship management.
* Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to coordinate with senior management, educational institutions, and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office, documentation, and operational reporting.
* Interest in robotics, science, and technology is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be proactive, organized, and capable of managing teams, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and resolving day-to-day operational challenges. Strong communication, professional conduct, and a focus on visitor satisfaction are essential.

Compensation

**₹30,000–₹35,000 per month**
, depending on relevant experience and suitability for the role.

Interested and eligible Ahmedabad-based candidates are invited to apply.

**About the Role:**

We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. This role involves defining calibration processes, developing SOPs, planning setups for new parameters and capabilities, and driving measurement accuracy improvement through structured testing.

● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies

● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement

● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards

● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards

● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.

● Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6+ years preferred.

● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology

● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors

● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation

● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams

**Nice to have**

● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes

● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives

● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols

● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Head - Project Safety
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Head - Project Safety leads the strategic planning, execution, and continuous improvement of safety protocols for construction projects. The role ensures the implementation of safety best practices, compliance with regulations, and the integration of digital safety innovations to minimize risks.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Safety Planning:**
Develop and enforce safety management systems, policies, procedures, and programs focusing on preventive measures and proactive risk assessments ensuring a safe working environment across all projects.
  
  
Align safety initiatives with organizational goals, ensuring that safety practices are continuously optimized for evolving project needs.
  
  
**Budget Management**
Manage the safety budget, ensuring that resources for safety initiatives, training, and equipment are allocated effectively.
  
  
Implement cost-effective safety solutions without compromising safety standards, ensuring optimal use of financial resources.
  
  
**Project Safety Monitoring**
Conduct regular safety audits and site inspections to identify hazards and ensure compliance with safety protocols.
  
  
Implement real-time safety tracking systems to monitor safety metrics and drive corrective actions promptly.
  
  
Provide specialized safety input to engineering, construction, and contracts, thus ensuring that safety requirements are properly integrated into project planning, design criteria, construction plans and specifications and contracts
  
  
Ensure a robust construction safety framework is in place by defining Health & Safety minimum requirements during pre-sanction phase, pre-construction phase, construction phase of construction projects
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance**
Ensure full compliance with local, national, and international safety regulations and standards.
  
  
Engage with regulatory bodies and ensure that all safety documentation is up to date, accurate, and accessible.
  
  
**Incident Management And Reporting**
Lead investigations for any safety-related incidents, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and preventive action plans.
  
  
Utilize digital tools for incident reporting, enabling real-time tracking, data collection, and reporting automation.
  
  
**Risk Assessment**
Identify and mitigate potential project risks through thorough analysis and preventive measures.
  
  
Review and approve project-specific safety plans.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Act as the primary liaison with regulatory agencies and external safety organizations
  
  
Communicate safety performance metrics and initiatives to senior management and stakeholders
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Mentor and train the safety team, fostering a strong safety culture across all project teams.
  
  
Implement training programs on digital safety tools and advanced safety management techniques for continuous skill development.
  
  
**Digital Insights In Safety Management**
Leverage digital platforms, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) and IoT-based safety monitoring tools, to enhance real-time risk identification and management.
  
  
Integrate AI-driven predictive analytics to foresee potential safety risks and optimize safety decision-making.
  
  
Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and emerging safety technologies to continuously improve safety performance
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Chief Project Officer
  
  
Chief Airport Officer
  
  
Functional Heads
  
  
Project Management Team
  
  
Construction Engineers
  
  
Compliance and Regulatory Teams
  
  
Operations Team
  
  
Legal Department
  
  
Finance Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Regulatory Authorities
  
  
Contractors and Subcontractors
  
  
Safety Inspectors
  
  
Local Government Entities
  
  
Community Representatives
  
  
Independent Engineers
  
  
AAI
  
  
DGCA
  
  
BCAS
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education Qualification:**
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related field. Safety certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent are mandatory.
  
  
**Work Experience**
18+ years of experience in project safety management, with a focus on large-scale civil construction projects. Familiarity with digital safety tools and experience in the airport is preferred.
  
  
**Certification Required**
NEBOSH Certification in OHSAS/Health & Safety
  
  
American Society of Safety Professionals (ASSP)/National Safety Council (NSC)/ISO 45001/14001 Certifications

title: CBS-BMC-Brand and Marketing-Associate-Graphic Designer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on–brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
  
  
As an Associate — Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
* Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
* Stay up to date with latest design trends, socialize the same to peers
* Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
* Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
* Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
* Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
* Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
* Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
* Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)\*
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
* Strong visual design capability
* 1-4 years of relevant experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)

**What We Look For**

* Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
* Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
* Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
* Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
* Experience working with global clients
* Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
* A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

**What We Offer**
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
