title: Sr. Product Manager, Mobile
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
As the Sr. Product Manager for Mobile you will focus on delivering impactful innovations further accelerating the growth of Docusign's top-rated eSignature mobile apps, which is an important part of our millions of users' journey as we embrace the "anywhere economy". You will drive solutions that allow our customers to get to agreement anywhere on any device. You will work with cross-functional leaders to define a multi-year strategy and lead the efforts to build the roadmap, vision, and priorities for supporting this priority product area. You will deeply understand how Docusign can best deliver for our customers' needs and work with product development teams across Docusign to deliver product capabilities and solutions that support customers end-to-end agreement flows on mobile. Interacting directly with customers to validate needs will be a key part of your role.
  
  
Docusign has built award winning and the most pervasive technology for enabling businesses to automate their agreement processes - from generating agreements, negotiating between parties, getting agreements electronically signed, managing the workflows and integrations once an agreement is signed and analyzing and deriving insights from agreements. Today, Docusign's products meet the needs of customers extending from individual consumers to large Enterprises. You will serve as the subject matter expert guiding product development teams on what capabilities and solutions will best meet customers' mobile needs for their agreement challenges. Using qualitative and quantitative insights, you will deliver a strategy and product roadmap that both transforms how Docusign meets customer needs and drives measurable impact. In this position you will work cross-functionally with Design, Marketing, and Engineering and engage directly with customers to experiment and iterate.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Product Management.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Prioritize opportunities and lead product strategy and roadmaps focused on customer and business impact
* Build roadmaps by synthesizing customer needs, user research, data science, market and competitive insights, marketing input, and field feedback
* Develop a deep understanding of target personas, workflows, pain points, and jobs to be done through customer engagement and lifecycle research-from awareness and evaluation through adoption, renewal, and expansion
* Review competitors, vendors, adjacent solutions, industry trends, and relevant market channels to anticipate customer needs and identify opportunities for differentiation
* Define product vision, requirements, and functional specifications; translate them into developer-ready epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize and manage the feature backlog, dependencies, and tradeoffs to support effective release and sprint planning
* Lead and motivate a team of engineers and cross-functional representatives toward shared product outcomes
* Partner with Engineering, Design, User Experience, Research, and Program Management to take features from concept through launch while meeting quality, usability, performance, and reliability expectations
* Build business cases and gain stakeholder alignment for new capabilities, investments, and innovations
* Monitor, measure, and report on key business, product, and customer metrics; use telemetry, experimentation, and qualitative and quantitative feedback to drive continuous testing and optimization
* Identify and profile high-value use cases, partners, platforms, APIs, integrations, and ecosystem relationships that can expand product value and adoption
* Collaborate with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Support, Legal, Security, Compliance, Finance, and Business Development on go-to-market execution, enablement, adoption, and ongoing product growth
* Ensure product decisions account for applicable privacy, security, accessibility, legal, regulatory, and industry requirements

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* 8+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree, or 6+ years of relevant experience and a master's degree
* Experience in product management supporting SaaS products or technology-enabled services
* Experience delivering native mobile apps for iOS or Android using iterative or Agile methodologies
* Experience with usability principles and practices, including early and rapid prototyping and usability testing
* Experience with tools such as Mixpanel, Optimizely, JIRA, or comparable analytics, experimentation, and Scrum tools
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and delivering products using iterative or Agile methodologies, such as Scrum
* Experience with enterprise technology ecosystems, platforms, APIs, integrations, and common customer workflows

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Business Systems, or a related engineering or technical discipline
* Experience taking a product or major feature from concept to launch and through ongoing adoption and optimization
* Application of qualitative and quantitative testing and analysis to feature development and product decisions
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect strategy, customer needs, research, data, competitive intelligence, and industry trends
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Ability to influence others, build alignment, and deliver results in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* Success managing large-scale, new, existing, or legacy technology products across complex customer or business environments
* Proficiency in defining product success metrics, building dashboards or telemetry, and using data to evaluate product performance and guide prioritization
* Strong customer focus, including customer discovery, solution validation, and translation of insights into measurable improvements in customer outcomes
* Business case development and stakeholder buy-in for product investments, partnerships, and innovation
* Collaboration with partners and external stakeholders to scale product capabilities, integrations, or distribution
* Involvement in product launches, enablement, change management, and adoption across multiple customer segments or geographies
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, User Experience, Research, Product, Program Management, Sales, Marketing, IT, Compliance, Security, Legal, Business Development, and Support
* Background in consulting, marketing, strategy, operations, or related disciplines involving risk management, privacy, information security, compliance, or regulatory controls

Life at Docusign
  
  
**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
  
  
If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
  
  
**AI in Our Hiring Process**
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.
  
  
Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.

title: Quality Engineer II
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 As Quality Engineer you will prepare and compile product post market data and findings into comprehensive Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs) in compliance with regulatory requirements. You will be serving as a mentor to junior engineers, providing guidance and support in quality engineering practices within the realm of medical devices.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather and analyze data related to the performance and safety of medical devices.
* Drafting and authoring PSUR or CER documents.
* Partner with regulatory affairs and medical experts to ensure accurate and timely submission of PSURs to regulatory authorities.
* Continuously monitor and stay updated with evolving safety regulations and guidelines to ensure PSUR compliance.
* Develop templates and trainings based on the quality system regulations, applicable standards and guidance.
* Independently review all deliverables to ensure compliance with development process and the standard.
* Collaborates with engineering, regulatory affairs and manufacturing functions to ensure submission of safety reports.
* Participate when appropriate in audits.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* B E or B. Tech in Mechanical/Biomedical Engineering
* Minimum 4 to 8 years of quality engineering experience.
* Familiar with Literature review, PMCF,IMDRF coding, CAPA and NCMR.
* Demonstrates ability to effectively play multiple roles on a cross\-functional team including contributor, subject matter expert, leader, facilitator.
* Hands\-on experience on EU MDR, Risk Management, Design Controls for Medical Devices.
* Familiar with ISO 13485, ISO 14971,21 CFR part 820, 21 CFR part 11 and EU MDR and product specific industry standards.
* Understanding of post\-market surveillance processes and adverse event reporting.
* Knowledge of risk management principles and hazard analysis in the context of medical devices.
* Good verbal and written communication skills including plan / report development.

* ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor Certification.

title: Regulatory AI and Content Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
Title -
**Regulatory AI and Content Specialist**
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
  
  
Location : Hyderabad
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
**Mission**
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
As part of Roche’s Product Development (PD), Product Development Regulatory (PDR) strengthens regulatory capabilities through scalable models and sustainable solutions that support evolving regulatory requirements, global drug development priorities, and continuous innovation, leveraging automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and emerging technologies.
  
  
**The Position**
As a Regulatory AI & Content Specialist, you will serve as the bridge between Pharma Development Regulatory (PDR) , content management, and AI-enabled technology, driving the digital transformation of regulatory content within the PDR organization. In this role, you will leverage your understanding of regulatory documents, content structures, and submission requirements to design, standardize, and optimize reusable regulatory content for AI-powered authoring and automation. You will play a key role in setting up, configuring and managing content use cases and templates within the in house GenAI powered platform enabling efficient, consistent, and compliant regulatory document generation for a global regulatory organization.
  
  
You will also work directly alongside document authors supporting, and where needed leading, the drafting of regulatory documents using AI-enabled authoring capabilities ensuring that what the platform produces is genuinely usable, high quality, and submission-ready.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Regulatory Content & AI Expertise
  
  

* Have a strong understanding of regulatory documents across the drug development lifecycle, including clinical, non-clinical, CMC, and CTD-based submissions
* Apply knowledge of Generative AI, structured content, and regulatory authoring principles to support AI-enabled content creation and document standardization
* Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements, AI capabilities, and industry best practices

Regulatory Content Management & Platform Management
  
  

* Analyze regulatory documents and convert them into standardized templates, reusable content components, and structured content models within the in house GenAI powered platform
* Configure and maintain templates, metadata, and content assets to enable efficient, compliant, and AI-assisted regulatory authoring
* Support content governance through template lifecycle management, version control, and content quality

Platform Enablement & Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as a super user for the GenAI powered platform, providing business support, user enablement, and contribute towards continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform adoption and operational efficiency
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, and release readiness activities for new platform capabilities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across PDR, PD, PT (Pharma Technical) and RDT (Roche Digital Technology) colleagues to align regulatory content with business and platform requirements
* Identify opportunities to improve regulatory content development through AI, automation, and low-code/no-code capabilities

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Regulatory Affairs, or a related discipline
* 4–6 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Writing, Medical Writing, or a related pharmaceutical role
* Experience in leading/ supporting clinical or marketing authorization submissions, with a good understanding of the drug development lifecycle, ICH guidelines, CTD/eCTD structure, and regulatory expectations of major health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or Health Canada)
* Ability to critically review and interpret regulatory, clinical, and safety documents, and translate them into standardized, structured content for AI-enabled authoring
* Knowledge of Generative AI, AI-enabled content authoring, and digital technologies, with an interest in applying them to regulatory processes
* Experience with structured content authoring, document templating, content management, Regulatory Information Management (RIM), or AI-enabled authoring platforms; familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms is desirable
* Experience in leading/ supporting digital platform implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), or business validation activities is preferred
* Excellent analytical, written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with a continuous learning mindset and attention to detail.

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Deloitte USI- Human Capital – Instructional Design/OCM - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
HUMAN CAPITAL
  
  
Our Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. We guide teams in reimagining work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise, and help in transforming HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help provide insights and enable delivery to address questions such as: How do organizations access, develop, and motivate their workforce? What should the AI strategy be for the HR function? Do they have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to help make work better for humans and humans better at work.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Level: Consultant - Learning & Development
  
  
Work you’ll do:
  
  

* Support the Senior Consultant in delivering the workstream - taking ownership of discrete deliverables (e.g., a specific content module, pathway update, or reporting cycle) rather than the end-to-end workstream itself.
* Help facilitate approved interventions that address shortcomings identified in KPI results versus targets, and draft recommendations for Senior Consultant review.
* Draft detailed learning outlines (topic areas/modules with estimated completion time) and design learning storyboards that go beyond traditional learning to include interactive and gamified elements, as applicable to the learning need.
* Develop supporting learning materials - guidebooks, participant guides, impact maps, and scripts for learning videos - using the client’s existing tools, approved brand guidelines, and templates.
* Incorporate client review feedback into learning content, make approved updates to existing content, and submit the updated content to the LMS.
* Review existing content periodically and draft recommendations for updates; prepare obsolete content for retirement (at least quarterly) upon client LMS team sign-off.
* Coordinate with the LMS team to add virtual and on-demand learning content to the appropriate learning forum, publish training materials, and request updates to learning profiles (workforce data, competencies, skills, certifications, completion data) upon LMS team approval.
* Request assignment of required learning to the right audience and enrollment in on-demand or instructor-led learning (securing approvals per the SOP), and monitor enrollment thresholds and waitlists.
* Prepare instructors by creating trainer guides that also cover facilitation soft skills, and complete post-session activities such as updating attendance and sharing session recordings.
* Facilitate learning evaluation activities to confirm completion status; monitor completion against due dates, send reminder communications, and support escalations for non-compliance; and conduct learner surveys to collect feedback on training effectiveness.
* Use collaboration platforms (e.g., Teams) to enable knowledge sharing, connect people with similar interests or business problems, and foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support client- and vendor-facing conversations under Senior Consultant guidance, building foundational consulting skills such as needs-gathering and structured communication.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (content, learning technology/AMS, change management) to support integrated, high-quality delivery.
* Stay current with emerging L&D trends, learning technologies, and AI-enabled learning practices to bring fresh thinking to the account

The team:
  
  
Organization Workforce and Change
  
  
The Organization, Workforce & Change (OWC) practice is about transforming the organization (and the benefits providers that serve them) to support its business strategy. This involves helping our clients move from where they are today to where they need to be in the future. OWC begins by bringing together all solutions that serve the workforce lifecycle, including design of engaging learning solutions that help our clients build a learning organization and culture. It also focuses on evaluating and implementing the full learning technology stack and building the most effective strategies to support performance. Transformation may include changing the organization’s culture, modernizing specific functions, re-designing the organization structure, and requiring a combination of change management actions to execute. To enable our success, it is critical to use data and insights to inform better ways of working together.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience in Learning & Development, instructional design, or learning technology, including experience within a service delivery, managed services, or shared services environment.
* Experience executing against SLAs, including request/ticket tracking, prioritization, and status reporting.
* Hands-on experience applying instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM) to develop e-learning, ILT, or blended learning content.
* Working knowledge of LMS/LXP platforms (e.g., Cornerstone, Workday Learning, SAP SuccessFactors Learning) and authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Captivate).

title: Growth Lead
description:
LONSAE is a science-led consumer wellness and nutraceuticals brand. We’re looking for someone to build our growth engine—from the first ad click to the repeat order.

This is a hands-on role combining performance marketing with growth across the full AARRR funnel: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral and Revenue.

You’ll bring ideas, challenge assumptions and turn experiments into measurable business outcomes. Your initial focus will be acquisition, conversion and reliable measurement, with retention and referral programmes developing as our customer base grows.

What you’ll do

→ Build the growth roadmap and agree on key success metrics with leadership.

→ Personally plan, launch and optimise Meta and Google campaigns.

→ Develop creative concepts, hooks, testing plans and creator briefs alongside our creative team.

→ Improve landing pages, offers and checkout conversion.

→ Build email, WhatsApp and CRM journeys that support repeat purchases.

→ Track and optimise CAC, ROAS, MER, POAS and LTV:CAC, alongside contribution margin and repeat purchase rate.

→ Account for India’s D2C realities, including COD versus prepaid orders, return-to-origin rates and delivery coverage.

→ Work with our scientific and regulatory teams to keep product claims substantiated and customer communications aligned with applicable requirements.

You’re a fit if you

✔️ Have proven D2C or consumer growth experience.

✔️ Can independently execute Meta and Google campaigns.

✔️ Understand conversion optimisation, retention, analytics and unit economics.

✔️ Can prioritise experiments and work effectively with limited budgets.

✔️ Bring recommendations, explain your decisions and execute without daily direction.

Experience in wellness, nutrition, beauty or another consumer category where trust influences purchasing is a plus. Demonstrated results matter more than years of experience.

Compensation: ₹65,000–70,000 per month

Location / work mode: Hyderabad

Employment type: Full-time

How to apply

Send your CV and one strong growth case study to [deekshith@cosmicsource.in; syed@payism.in]. Include:

\* The challenge and starting metrics.

\* Your personal role, monthly spend and experiments.

\* Measurable results and how you verified them.

\* One failed test and what you learned.

Please also share examples of ads or creatives you conceptualised, briefed or tested, clearly stating your contribution. Anonymised case studies are welcome.

* We’re looking for someone who can identify the opportunity, execute the work and help the team learn from the results.

You decide what to write as well as how to write it. Calendars are approved monthly by the founder; day-to-day content and creative decisions are yours.Key Responsibilities: Content Strategy• Content pillars: define content pillars, audience segments and tone for each retainer, and revisit them quarterly.• Platform strategy: decide format mix and posting rhythm per platform — reels, carousels, statics, stories, YouTube Shorts — based on what each client's audience responds to.• Monthly content calendars: plan platform-wise calendars for each content retainer and get them approved before the month starts.• Campaign ideas: develop recurring series, seasonal and festive campaigns, and topical content tied to each client's business goals.• Performance review: read monthly post data (reach, watch time, saves, shares, profile actions) and change next month's plan because of it.• Social listening insights: turn the government account's listening data into content direction and write the insight section of its monthly report.Key Responsibilities: Ad Strategy• Funnel thinking: map ad creatives to funnel stages — awareness, consideration, lead, retargeting — for each real estate and lead-generation campaign.• Creative angles: develop angles per audience (end-users, investors, NRI buyers): location, price, amenities, lifestyle, urgency, trust.• Testing plans: with the performance marketer, plan structured creative tests — hooks, offers, formats, copy length — and write the variants.• Ad data: read cost per lead, CTR, hook rate and lead quality feedback, and use it to decide the next round of creatives.• Organic to paid: identify organic posts that should be turned into ads for existing content clients, and pitch those upsells with the founder.Key Responsibilities: Writing• Shoot briefs: write shoot briefs and shot lists with the DOP so a shoot day covers a month of content.• Scripts: write reel, shoot and video ad scripts in Telugu and English, with hooks, on-screen text and voiceover lines.• Social copy: captions, static post copy, carousel copy and hashtags for each client's calendar.• Real estate ad copy: headlines, primary text, lead-form copy and variants for Meta and Google lead-generation campaigns; scripts for walkthrough, location and testimonial videos; copy aimed at local and NRI buyers.• Landing pages: conversion-focused landing page copy for property projects — offer, location benefits, amenities, pricing cues and calls to action.• Compliance: ensure property ads carry required details such as the project's RERA registration number; no claims the client cannot substantiate.• Website content: page copy for client websites — home, about, services, product pages — written for clarity and search.• Collaterals: brochures, product descriptions, packaging copy, user manuals and other business collaterals for project clients.• Government communication: write accurate, appropriate Telugu content for public messaging; follow approval guidelines strictly.• Transcreation: adapt English content into natural Telugu and vice versa — not literal translation.• Revisions: turn around client and founder feedback quickly; maintain version control.• Brand voice: maintain voice documents and glossaries for each client, including Telugu terminology.• Time logging: log hours daily per client and task category.Must-Have Skills• Telugu: native-level writing — grammar, spelling and tone, including formal and conversational registers.• English: clean, persuasive writing for social, ads and web.• Short-form scripting: understands how scripts translate to shots, edits and on-screen text for reels.• Range: can switch voice across sectors — government, healthcare, real estate, food, fashion.• Content strategy: has built content pillars and monthly calendars for multiple clients, and can explain the reasoning behind them.• Ad strategy: understands Meta and Google ad funnels, creative testing and audience-based messaging; has written ads for lead-generation or sales campaigns.• Data literacy: reads Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager data — reach, retention, CTR, cost per lead — and turns it into creative decisions.• Direct-response writing: understands hooks, offers and calls to action that drive leads, not just engagement.• Speed: delivers multiple scripts per day to deadline without dropping quality.• Typing: comfortable typing in Telugu Unicode (Google Input Tools, Lekhini or similar).Good to Have• Real estate or property marketing copy experience.• Basic SEO writing knowledge for website content.• Experience with ad copy A/B testing.• Hindi as an additional language.• Interest in film, regional pop culture and social trends.Selection Process• Writing samples: scripts, captions or web copy you have written, in title: VP Client Relationship Servicing
description:
**Job Title: VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done.
  
  
Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
The role holder is equally accountable for the end-to-end client experience across CACS journeys: owning the process from first touch to completion, removing handoffs and delay between teams, and driving a continuous reduction in service SLAs/turnaround times - so clients experience a single, fast, joined-up service rather than a series of disconnected steps.
  
  
The role holder will oversee the general operations of the function including, but not limited to, financial planning/resource management, governance frameworks, digital implementation/adoption, performance management (OKRs, KPIs, SLAs), and stakeholder engagement, whilst additionally leading on ad-hoc initiatives as they arise to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of the function’s strategy and desired client outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes. Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live. Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines. Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. A natural go getter who moves things forward rather than escalating and waiting.
* Energised by ambiguity and comfortable running BAU, people, transformation agendas in parallel. Dedicated to being an early adopter of new technology and nurturing and environment where teams are excited to pilot new ways of working and technologies in the pursuit of sustainable improvements. Comfortable operating at the intersection of operations and technology, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements. Client-first mindset — instinctively thinks in terms of the client's end-to-end experience rather than individual internal process steps.
* Resilient under competing priorities and reprioritises on their own rather than needing structure imposed direction. CIB CRS / Servicing Operations leadership and regional/country teams. CIB CRS – Global and Regional Leads. Product partners and product teams (Trade, GPS, Credit) supporting CIB clients. Global Transformation and Technology delivery teams (product owners, business analysts, engineering) supporting servicing transformation and tooling. Control functions and key partners as required to support safe, compliant servicing delivery

description:

More about

and

.

As a KYC Operations Team Lead you will oversee the daily operations of a team of KYC Analysts. Your team is responsible for conducting thorough customer due diligence reviews, analysing various customer and business activities, and ensuring that our KYC records are kept up to date according to our internal policies. The KYC Operations Team Lead is a people lead with a mindset focused on building processes that put our customers first while being aware of the risks surrounding the industry and the wider regulatory environment.

Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
* Operational management Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.

Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.

Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.

* You are capable of identifying gaps in policies and processes and providing detailed feedback, including examples when possible, through the established communication channels.

Mentorship and Career Growth

**Join Us as FP&A Manager, VIACHAIN!**
Are you a hands-on finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Manager to play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision support across a global organization for VIACHAIN, an ORBCOMM company.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.
  
  
**Why You'll Love Working Here**
As an FP&A Manager, you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work environment, you will collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders located in the United States and Canada, gaining exposure to global operations and cross-functional business initiatives.
  
  
This role offers a highly visible opportunity to influence business performance through rigorous analysis, financial modeling, and insightful recommendations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Support the annual budgeting process, including development of assumptions, detailed financial models, and budget consolidations.
* Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions.
* Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models.
* Develop and track business unit capital expenditure ( CapEx ) and operating expenditure ( OpEx ) performance.

**Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Support monthly financial reporting processes, including Flash reporting and Growth Day materials.
* Maintain key financial and operational metrics used for performance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
* Perform variance analysis, including actual versus budget and forecast bridge analyses with clear driver-based commentary.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

**Business Partnering & Commercial Finance Support**

* Prepare initial deal models and supporting CRB presentation materials.
* Partner with Sales teams to validate deal assumptions and assess financial impacts.
* Conduct account-level pricing, profitability, and revenue impact analyses.
* Support budget control activities, including purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), invoicing, and related processes.

**Data Management, Modeling & Operational Support**

* Perform ad hoc financial analyses, reporting, and scenario modeling as required.
* Support month-end close activities and planning/BI data integrity initiatives.
* Work with large datasets and reporting tools to ensure accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, financial models, and analytical capabilities.

**Who You Are**
You are a highly analytical finance professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, financial modeling, and collaboration. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and partnering with stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.
  
  
**If You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance , Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
* Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.
* Progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance.
* Experience supporting global organizations and collaborating with international stakeholders.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis skills.
* Experience performing variance analysis and translating financial results into business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
* Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!
  
  
**The Benefits Of Working Here**
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.
  
  
**How We Hire**
ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.
  
  
**About Us**
At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at  www.orbcomm.com !
  
  
**Ready to Join Us?**
We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
**Job Description: Logistics Manager**

**Role Purpose**

Own the end-to-end logistics operation for The Sleep Company: primary and secondary distribution, transporter and 3PL management, freight cost, and delivery performance across India. You will make sure products reach warehouses, stores and customers on time, in good condition and at the right cost, and you will build a strong logistics partner network and team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage pan-India logistics covering inbound, primary (factory to warehouse), secondary (warehouse to store or distributor) and last-mile delivery
* Manage transporters, courier partners and 3PLs: onboarding, rate negotiation, contracts, SLAs and performance reviews
* Drive freight cost control: lane-wise cost tracking, vehicle utilization, route optimisation and budget adherence
* Monitor key KPIs such as OTIF, delivery TAT, transit damage, freight cost per unit and claims

* Handle reverse logistics, returns and replacements
* Ensure documentation and compliance: e-way bills, LRs, PODs, GST and statutory norms
* Prepare MIS and dashboards, and present logistics performance and cost analysis to leadership
* Lead and mentor the logistics team, set targets, and review performance
* Support new store launches, new product launches and peak-season planning with the right logistics capacity

**Must-Have**

* [8-12] years in logistics or supply chain in manufacturing, FMCG, consumer durables, furniture or e-commerce
* Proven experience in transporter and freight negotiation, and in managing 3PL and courier partners
* Hands-on experience in primary and secondary distribution planning for bulky or large-volume products
* Strong knowledge of freight costing, route planning, load planning and vehicle utilization
* Working experience with ERP/WMS/TMS (SAP or similar)
* Strong Excel and MIS skills, with the ability to analyze logistics cost and performance data
* Experience managing a team and cross-functional stakeholders

Reporting to the Customer Care Lead, you will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and strengthening customer relationships. Your goal is to ensure our products are always available to our consumers, wherever they shop. You will:

**We Are Looking For**
Someone Who Is Ready To Make a Tangible Impact On Our Business And Customer Satisfaction. You Thrive In a Dynamic Environment And Are Skilled At Building Relationships And Solving Complex Problems. We Are Looking For Someone With
  
  

* A strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, especially in an e-commerce or retail environment.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable using data to drive decisions and recommend improvements.
* A collaborative and proactive mindset, always looking for opportunities to innovate and streamline processes.

**What’s In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)

**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. The team is also responsible for running valuation controls to ensure fair value of balance sheet in accordance with internal valuation methodology and regulatory requirements. This includes independent price verification of both vanilla securities/derivatives and complex/illiquid assets such as exotic derivatives and distressed assets. Additionally, the team also calculates relevant valuation adjustments including adjustments for illiquidity, concentration, model limitations etc. as applicable. The team is also responsible for calculating and reporting prudential valuation adjustments on a quarterly basis.
  
  
The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, valuation control and methodology (GVG) teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
IPV Center of Excellence forms part of the GBAM CFO Group and is a control and business advisory function. The team’s work primarily covers valuation controls for various asset classes across Global Banking and Markets, with a dynamic book of work providing opportunities to centralize, enhance and implement best practices for global valuation routines.
  
  
We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the valuations control area for one or a group of asset classes within FICC Macro (Rates/FX/Commodities) / FICC Micro (Credit/Mortgages/Munis) / XVA / Equities businesses in Global Markets. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to functionally lead and deliver Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments, Prudent Valuations and Fair Value Hierarchy assessment, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation.
  
  
The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Finance and Global Valuations Group (GVG) teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job. The candidate should have extensive experience of functionally leading high performing teams that deliver valuation control capabilities. The candidate will be expected to leverage her/his extensive knowledge of processes and best practices within Finance, operations, risk management and talent management to ensure that the GBS team operates effectively as a key strategic component of the global GBAM Finance organization.
  
  
The team is also encouraged to take part in employee engagement and diversity and inclusion initiatives to help continue to make Bank of America a great place to work.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Performing the calculation and analysis of valuation controls including IPV, valuation adjustments and prudent valuation adjustments, as well as ownership for Fair Value Hierarchy levelling.
* Demonstrate strong SME knowledge with the ability to operate with end-to-end accountability.
* Working with the Global Valuation Group to ensure ongoing review & enhancement of valuation control methodologies and practices.
* Provide strong technical leadership on independent valuation principles.
* Strong understanding of trader’s risk positions and valuation principles, own the end-to-end desk communication and challenge process for GBAM Finance.
* Timely identification and escalation of red flags to Business Finance and Control leads and other independent stakeholders.
* Drive solid supervisory reviews and governance around implementation of the valuation framework.
* Work closely with the trading desks on valuation issues and valuation differences.
* Lead conversations with Front office with respect to IPV variances, changes in valuation adjustments etc.
* Assist with execution of month-end controls and supervisory review routines pertaining to valuation control.
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves.
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries and enable the business and be “Accurate & well controlled” across deliverables.
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance for the function as required by business finance policies, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Active participation and collaboration with global teams on regulatory topics pertaining to valuation of assets.
* Act as a catalyst in the execution of global strategic technology projects impacting valuations.
* Develop, standardize & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow.
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk.
* Be pro-active and engage control partners/ technology to identify and mitigate operational risks.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Valuation Control or Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale with US GAAP, IFRS, IAS reporting framework with an interest and aptitude for derivative products
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred.
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus.
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly.

**Experience Range\***
12 to 16 years with at least 8+ years’ experience in Global Markets Valuation Control role
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Alteryx / Tableau / Python knowledge would be an added advantage.
* Have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner.
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels.
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated self-starter.
* Should have good understanding of financial markets, Derivatives & structured notes-their hedging, funding, credit risk, valuation of derivatives, appreciation of methodologies related to calculating adjustments for liquidity, concentration etc.
* Should have a strong quantitative background and appreciation and understanding of basic quantitative models.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a globally matrixes and significantly multi-geography, multi-cultural offshore service delivery environment.
* Individual should have the resilience to handle internal pressures and conflicts in dealing with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience interacting with internal/external auditors and regulators will be a big plus.
* Has the gravity to interact at all levels of management to support resolution of complex business issues.
* A convincing executive presence which conveys composure and confidence in all situations, the credibility and stature to carry stakeholders through influence rather than via the hierarchy.

**Desired Skills**

* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure environment.
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner.
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions.
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

**Work Timings\***
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
  
  
**Job Location\***
Mumbai / Hyderabad

title: Team Lead - Collections
description:
**About Us**

Resollect builds software for banks and asset reconstruction companies to manage loan recovery and the legal process around it. When borrowers fall behind on loans, lenders need to reach them, recover what's owed fairly and keep track of any legal steps along the way, and our work helps them do that well.

**Role: Team Lead - Collections**

Apply here: https://helios.resollect.com/apply/team-lead-collections

**The Role**

We're looking for a Team Lead to run our collections contact centre in Mumbai, where a tele-calling team reaches out to borrowers on behalf of the banks and lenders we work with. This role matters because the team's results are what those clients see: how many borrowers we reach, how many commit to paying, and how much is actually recovered. That has to be done fairly and within the rules every time.

One day you're reworking how accounts are allocated across the floor for a portfolio that's falling behind, the next you're listening to calls and coaching a caller on how to turn a difficult conversation into a promise to pay, and the day after you're walking a client through the week's numbers and agreeing on what to change. You'll report to our Head of Operations.

**What You'll Do**

• Run the floor day to day: You'll manage the tele-calling team's allocation, productivity, attendance, call quality and coaching so the floor runs smoothly from the first call to the last.

• Keep clients informed, on time, every time: You'll send daily and weekly MIS reports (management information reports) to clients covering calls made, borrowers contacted, promises to pay and amounts collected.

• Shape the collection strategy: You'll segment portfolios by bucket and DPD (days past due, or how overdue a loan is), then plan scripts, call timing and allocation and keep improving them as the results come in.

• Own the numbers that matter: You'll be responsible for contact rate, promise-to-pay conversion (how often a borrower commits to paying by a set date) and amount collected against targets.

• Be the point of contact for client teams: You'll work with the lenders' own teams on targets, feedback and escalations so issues get resolved quickly and expectations stay clear.

• Keep every call within the rules: You'll make sure every conversation follows the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) rules on how lenders and their agents may conduct recovery.

**What We're Looking For**

• Deep collections experience: You'll do well here if you bring five or more years in collections contact centres, because you'll be setting the standard for a whole floor from day one.

• Proven team leadership: You've led a calling team for at least two years, so you know how to keep people motivated, productive and improving on difficult calls.

• Ownership of targets and reporting: You've been accountable for collection targets and for client MIS reporting before, so delivering both reliably is already second nature to you.

• Strong Excel skills: You're comfortable building and maintaining the reports our clients rely on, accurately and against daily deadlines.

• Sound knowledge of RBI recovery rules: You know what fair recovery conduct looks like under RBI guidelines and can make sure your whole team follows it on every call.

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

• Lender portfolio experience: It helps if you've worked on portfolios from banks, NBFCs (non-banking financial companies) or ARCs (asset reconstruction companies, which buy and recover overdue loans).

• Range across buckets: Experience with both early-stage and long-overdue accounts will help you adapt strategy across very different portfolios.

• Dialer or CRM experience: Familiarity with auto-dialling software or customer relationship management tools will help you get the most out of the team's time.

• Hindi and Marathi: Speaking both will help you coach callers and listen in on conversations with borrowers across the region.

**Why This Might Be Worth Your Time**

• A real say in strategy: You won't just run the floor, because you'll decide how portfolios are segmented, which scripts are used and when calls go out.

• Results you can see: You'll own clear numbers, so the impact of your decisions shows up directly in contact rates, promises to pay and money recovered.

• Direct work with clients: You'll work directly with lenders' own teams on targets and feedback, which builds relationships and visibility well beyond the contact centre.

• A company built around recovery: You'll join a company whose whole focus is helping banks and asset reconstruction companies manage loan recovery and the legal process around it.

**Where and When**

Full-time and office-based in Marol, Mumbai, six days a week, reporting to the Head of Operations.

If you're the kind of person who knows a collections floor inside out, takes pride in hitting targets the right way, and never sends a client report late, we'd like to hear from you, so please apply.

title: Head – D2C Operations & Supply Chain
description:
**WE ARE HIRING | HEAD – D2C OPERATIONS & SUPPLY CHAIN**

📍
**Location:**
Mumbai – Lower Parel (Work From Office)

💼
**Experience:**
8–12 Years

🏢
**Industry:**
D2C | Beauty | Cosmetics | Skincare | FMCG

**About Clayco Cosmetics**

Clayco Cosmetics is a growing D2C beauty and personal care company focused on building innovative products and delivering exceptional consumer experiences.

We are looking for a highly analytical, technology-driven and result-oriented Operations Leader who can take complete ownership of our D2C business operations, supply chain, procurement, warehouse management and fulfilment ecosystem.

This role requires someone who understands the complete operational lifecycle of a D2C business and can seamlessly connect sales, inventory, procurement, warehousing and logistics through data-driven decision-making.

Who Should Apply?

Who are we looking for?

✔ 8–12 years of relevant experience in D2C / E-commerce / Supply Chain Operations.

✔ Strong, practical and independent working knowledge of Unicommerce – Mandatory.

✔ Hands-on experience with Shopify and inventory management systems.

✔ Excellent command over Advanced Excel, MIS and data analytics.

✔ Experience managing warehouses, procurement, logistics and end-to-end supply chain.

✔ Prior experience in Beauty, Cosmetics, Skincare or FMCG will be preferred.

We are looking for an ownership-driven leader, not just a warehouse manager!

This is a leadership opportunity for someone who can connect technology, data, people and processes to drive the overall operational efficiency of a growing D2C business.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@clayco.in

Subject Line: Head – D2C Operations & Supply Chain

Key Responsibilities

**1. End-to-End D2C Operations**

* Take complete ownership of day-to-day D2C business operations.
* Manage the entire order-to-delivery lifecycle across online sales channels.
* Ensure seamless coordination between E-commerce, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse and Customer Experience teams.
* Plan operational readiness for new product launches, promotional campaigns and high-volume sale events.

**2. Shopify & Unicommerce Management**

* Strong hands-on working knowledge of Shopify and Unicommerce is mandatory.
* Manage order flow, inventory synchronisation, SKU mapping and fulfilment processes.
* Monitor order processing, cancellations, returns, inventory discrepancies and stock movement.
* Generate system-based reports and identify operational gaps through data analysis.
* Ensure accurate inventory visibility across multiple sales channels and warehouses.

**3. Data Analytics, MIS & Reporting**

* Independently analyse large datasets and translate numbers into actionable business insights.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports and operational dashboards.
* Track SKU-wise sales, inventory turnover, stock ageing, stock-outs and replenishment requirements.
* Monitor fulfilment rates, RTO, cancellations, returns and logistics performance.

**4. Warehouse & Inventory Management**

* Manage end-to-end warehouse operations, including inwarding, GRN, put-away, storage, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Oversee warehouse productivity, manpower utilisation and inventory accuracy.
* Manage multiple warehouse locations and ensure accurate stock reconciliation.
* Implement FIFO/FEFO practices, batch tracking and expiry management, particularly for cosmetics and skincare products.
* Conduct regular physical stock audits and minimise inventory losses, damages and discrepancies.

**5. Procurement & Supply Chain Management**

* Oversee the complete procurement flow in coordination with sourcing, purchase and production teams.
* Ensure timely availability of raw materials (RM), packaging materials (PM) and finished goods.
* Manage vendor coordination, purchase orders, procurement timelines and material inwarding.
* Align procurement planning with sales forecasts and inventory requirements.
* Establish minimum stock levels, safety stock and reorder points.
* Optimise working capital by preventing overstocking and stock-outs.

**6. Logistics, Fulfilment & Returns**

* Manage logistics partners, order dispatches and last-mile delivery performance.
* Monitor RTO, NDR, delivery success rates, freight costs and reverse logistics.
* Identify reasons for delivery failures and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure timely reconciliation and restocking of returned inventory.

**7. Cost Optimisation & Team Leadership**

* Identify opportunities to optimise warehousing, procurement, packaging and logistics costs.
* Develop scalable SOPs and system-driven operational processes.
* Lead warehouse, inventory and fulfilment teams.
* Establish accountability, operational discipline and performance monitoring.
* Work closely with senior management to improve business efficiency and operational scalability.

Mandatory Candidate Requirements

* 8–12 years of experience in D2C, E-commerce Operations, Supply Chain or Warehouse Management.
* **Strong hands-on expertise in Unicommerce is non-negotiable.**
* Practical working knowledge of Shopify and inventory management systems.
* Excellent data analytical skills with strong command over Advanced Excel and MIS.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end warehouse operations and inventory planning.
* Understanding of procurement, vendor management, logistics and fulfilment.
* Prior experience in Beauty, Cosmetics, Skincare, Personal Care or FMCG is highly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage operations, analyse business performance and drive corrective action.

We are looking for an ownership-driven leader, not just a warehouse manager!

This is a leadership opportunity for someone who can connect technology, data, people and processes to drive the overall operational efficiency of a growing D2C business.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@clayco.in

title: Vice President - Supply Chain and Operations
description:
**WE ARE HIRING: Vice President - Supply Chain and Operations**

**Location:**
India - Mumbai

**Company Industry:**
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Export

**Other Benefits :**
housing allowance, and transportation benefits

"Click Easy apply or share your resume to recruitment12@intalent.asia"

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and strategically driven
**Vice President - Supply Chain and Operations**
to lead end-to-end operational, export, financial, compliance, information technology, supply chain, logistics, and human resources functions within a pharmaceutical export organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business and Commercial Management**

* Negotiate commercial terms with manufacturers, suppliers, and strategic partners.
* Facilitate commercial agreements and support the successful closure of pharmaceutical export deals.
* Support revenue growth through effective coordination with sales, manufacturing, and international business partners.
* Evaluate operational and commercial risks associated with new markets, customers, and partnerships.
* Recommend commercially viable solutions that support long-term business growth.

**Export Operations and Regulatory Compliance**

* Oversee end-to-end pharmaceutical export operations from order receipt through final delivery.
* Ensure compliance with international trade laws, pharmaceutical regulations, DGFT requirements, and export documentation standards.
* Coordinate with production, quality assurance, logistics, supply chain, finance, and sales teams.
* Ensure shipments are delivered on time and in accordance with regulatory and customer requirements.
* Review commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates, shipping documents, customs records, and other export documentation.
* Resolve customs delays, documentation discrepancies, shipment issues, and international partner disputes.

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Lead and develop cross-functional teams across operations, exports, logistics, supply chain, IT, finance, and HR.
* Establish clear departmental goals, KPIs, accountability measures, and performance standards.
* Monitor team performance and implement corrective actions where required.

**Finanancial, Legal and Governance Oversight**

* Oversee operational budgets, cost control, resource allocation, and financial performance.
* Ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements, including the Companies Act, ROC requirements, labour laws, GST, TDS, and income tax regulations.
* Coordinate the finalization of accounts with internal and external auditors.
* Support tax planning and ensure timely filing of statutory returns.
* Establish and monitor strong internal controls to prevent fraud and maintain financial integrity.

**Information Technology Operations**

* Oversee IT infrastructure, applications, systems, service delivery, and support operations.
* Align IT strategy with business goals and operational requirements.
* Lead internal IT teams and manage external vendors, contracts, SLAs, and performance metrics.
* Ensure effective IT governance, cybersecurity, access control, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

**PPIC, Supply Chain and Logistics**

* Lead Production Planning and Inventory Control activities for finished pharmaceutical products.
* Oversee demand forecasting, production planning, material planning, and capacity optimization.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, sales, and finance teams.
* Ensure uninterrupted product availability and timely fulfilment of customer orders.
* Manage warehousing, transportation, distribution, and delivery of finished pharmaceutical products.
* Monitor stock levels, ageing inventory, order fulfilment, capacity utilization, and delivery performance.

.

**Human Resources and Administration**

* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, performance management, compensation, employee relations, and HR compliance.
* Implement HR policies, governance frameworks, and labour-law requirements.
* Lead workforce planning, succession planning, learning, and leadership-development initiatives.
* Ensure accurate management of payroll, attendance, leave, employee records, and statutory documentation.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Finance, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.
* Extensive senior-management experience in operations within the pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical export, healthcare, or regulated manufacturing sector.
* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical export regulations, DGFT requirements, customs procedures, and international trade documentation.
* Proven experience leading end-to-end export, supply chain, logistics, PPIC, finance, IT, and administrative functions.
* Strong understanding of statutory requirements, corporate governance, GST, TDS, income tax, ROC compliance, and labour laws.
* Experience in budgeting, cost control, internal controls, audit coordination, and financial reporting.

.
