title: Head of Operations
description: About UsResollect builds software for banks and asset reconstruction companies (ARCs, which buy unpaid loans from banks and work to recover them). When a borrower stops paying, a lender has to send notices, file cases and manage a legal process that can stretch across many cities, and our software helps them run that recovery and the legal work around it.Role: Head of OperationsApply here: https://helios.resollect.com/apply/head-of-operationsThe RoleAs Head of Operations, you'll own how everything Resollect promises its clients gets delivered on the ground: legal notices, court filings, newspaper publications and field enforcement, carried out through a network of more than 300 vendors in 250 cities. Our clients are banks and ARCs, and they rely on this work being done on time, done right and done within the rules. You'll report directly to the CEO, so your decisions go straight to the person who can back them.One day you're working out why notices in one region are running behind, the next you're settling a client escalation before it ever reaches the CEO, and the day after you're sitting with our tech team to automate a process you've just written down for the first time.What You'll Do• Own delivery across every service: You'll be accountable for SLAs (the turnaround times we commit to clients), quality and cost per unit across notices, legal filings, publications and field enforcement.• Lead the operations team: You'll manage the ops team, including the Delivery Managers and the Vendor Partnerships Manager, who will look to you for direction.• Run a national vendor network: You'll manage more than 300 vendors across 250 cities so that the work meets the same standard wherever it is carried out.• Resolve escalations within operations: You'll handle client escalations yourself and with your team, so they're settled by the people closest to the work instead of landing on the CEO's desk.• Document and automate: You'll write down every process and work with our tech team to automate it, so we grow by building better systems rather than by adding people.• Keep recovery compliant: You'll make sure all our work follows the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) rules on how lenders and their agents may recover loans.What We're Looking For• Deep operations experience: You've spent eight or more years in operations, which is what it takes to run delivery at this scale with confidence.• Real ownership: You've been the person accountable for outcomes like cost, quality and timelines, not only someone carrying out another person's plan.• Leading large teams: You've managed teams of 20 or more people and know how to keep a team that size focused and dependable.• Managing vendors or partners: You've run a network of vendors or partners and know how to hold external people to a standard you can't enforce through a reporting line.Nice to Have (Not Required)• Lending or legal-process background: Time in a collections team at an NBFC (a non-banking financial company, which lends without being a bank), at an ARC, at a legal-process company or in another vendor-driven operation would help you get up to speed quickly.• Process redesign: It's a plus if you've automated or redesigned processes to cut cost or improve quality.• Knowledge of RBI recovery rules: Familiarity with the RBI's rules on recovery practices will make the compliance side of the job easier from day one.Why This Might Be Worth Your Time• A direct line to the CEO: You'll report to the CEO, so there's nobody between your judgement and the decisions it shapes.• The whole operation is yours: Every service, the full ops team and a vendor network spanning 250 cities sit with you, which is rare scope for a single role.• Pay that follows your results: Part of your pay is tied to SLAs, cost and escalations, and you'll also receive ESOPs (employee stock options), so you share in what you help build.• Build systems, not headcount: You'll work alongside our tech team to automate what you design, so your improvements are built into the product rather than depending on more people.Where and WhenFull-time, working from our office in Marol, Mumbai, six days a week, reporting to the CEO.Shortlisted candidates will be invited to prepare a case and present it to us at our office.If you're the kind of person who has run large teams and vendor networks, takes full ownership of results and would rather fix a process than add headcount, we'd like to meet you.If this sounds like your next role, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Clinical Team Manager (Senior/Principal) - Internal Medicine

Responsibilities may vary based on project timelines.Provides input into preparation of forecast estimates for start-up and clinical activities. Responsible for start-up and clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.Education and Experience:Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualificationPrevious experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teamsStrong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team membersStrong interpersonal and problem-solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organizationSolid understanding of change management principlesComprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of start-up and clinical monitoringStrong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skillsEffective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiencyCapable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordinglyStrong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal managementStrong attention to detailIn-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.Capable of independently managing end to end studiesWorking Environment:PPD, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.Able to work in non-traditional work environments.Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.This role requires independent travel up to 20%, inclusive of traveling in automobiles, airplanes, and trains.Our 4i Values:Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – InvolvementIf you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

title: General Manager - Import-Export Trading (PSS08119)
description:
**About The Company**
A well-established international procurement organization supporting a diversified group with a presence across multiple African markets, with interests spanning retail, wholesale, FMCG, and pharmaceutical distribution. The organization manages global procurement, logistics, and warehousing operations, sourcing a broad range of products from Asian markets.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The
**General Manager**
role exists to lead business and import-export operations, overseeing P&L, accounting, processing, and documentation related to supply chain and warehousing. This position drives organizational development through technology enablement and team leadership across human resources, purchase, sales, and marketing. The role reports jointly to the CEO and the promoter, balancing leadership and individual contribution to build a sustainable, growth-oriented organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build out a full-suite trading company and cultivate an evolving organizational culture aligned with business goals.

* Shape and grow a full-suite trading company with evolving organizational culture and technology enablement.

title: Head - Admin and Operations
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai

**Experience:**
8–12 years in Administration, Operations, Facilities Management, or Hospitality

**About the Role:**

TIST Media is looking for a Head of Admin & Operations to take complete ownership of the company's administrative and operational functions, with the Founder's priorities taking precedence, followed by the needs of the teams and the wider business.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can anticipate requirements, solve problems independently, and ensure that everything behind the scenes runs seamlessly.

Working directly with the Founder, you will oversee everything that keeps the business running smoothly; from office infrastructure, vendors, procurement, events, travel, and gifting to leading the Admin & Operations team.

**Your immediate priority will be setting up TIST's new office end-to-end, from property search and negotiations to design, fit-out, and relocation, with a target completion of Q1 2027. This will require flexibility around working hours, frequent site visits, and hands-on involvement throughout the process.**

We are looking for someone who is resourceful, commercially sharp, discreet, and comfortable taking decisions without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Office Setup & Facilities Management**

* Take complete ownership of identifying and setting up TIST's new office ensuring the new office is operational within the agreed timeline.
* Source and evaluate properties, coordinate with agents, negotiate commercial terms, and manage related paperwork..
* Work closely with architects, designers, contractors, and vendors through the design and fit-out process.
* Handle ongoing office maintenance, facilities, and infrastructure requirements.

**Founder & Leadership Support**

* Manage the Founder's travel arrangements and related logistics end-to-end.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders on Founder-related requirements.
* Anticipate requirements, manage last-minute changes, and ensure seamless execution.
* Handle sensitive information and interactions with complete discretion.

**Administration & Operations**

* Own all administrative and operational requirements across TIST and establish efficient processes to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning across the organisation.
* Oversee procurement, vendor management, housekeeping, office supplies, and general administration.
* Build and maintain reliable vendor relationships while ensuring quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.
* Manage event logistics, gifting, travel arrangements, and other operational requirements.

**What Makes You a Strong Fit:**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in administration, operations, facilities management, or hospitality.
* Prior experience setting up, building, or relocating an office.
* Strong network of Mumbai-based vendors, including property agents, architects, contractors, housekeeping, and event production partners.
* Strong negotiation skills and the ability to evaluate vendor quotations, identify cost inefficiencies, and negotiate commercially favourable terms.
* Ability to take ownership, make decisions independently, and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong aesthetic sensibility and an understanding of the standards expected of a premium brand.
* High levels of discretion, integrity, and professionalism, particularly when working closely with the Founder.
* Comfortable managing site visits, vendor coordination, and calls beyond regular office hours when required.

**Salary:**
INR 30–38 LPA (Fixed). No variable component.

**Please Note:**
Candidates who can join at short notice will be preferred.

This is a dedicated Administration & Operations leadership role. It does not involve HR, Finance, Content, or Campaign Management.

title: Associate Director
description:
Location:
**Mumbai, India (Hybrid - 2 office days per week)**

**About the Role**

As ADVANZ PHARMA continues to strengthen its position as the partner of choice for specialty, hospital, and rare disease medicines, we are seeking an
**Associate Director, Technical Services**
to join our
**Scientific Affairs**
function.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for supporting ADVANZ PHARMA's established product portfolio through technical expertise in product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, and supply continuity. Working across oral solid dosage forms, liquids, and injectables, you will lead a team of experienced technical professionals while partnering closely with commercial teams, global regulators, and Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs).

The role combines strategic technical leadership with people management, offering broad exposure across global markets, manufacturing networks, lifecycle projects, product optimisation activities, and due diligence initiatives. You will play a key role in ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and uninterrupted supply across ADVANZ PHARMA's international portfolio.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Services specialists supporting ADVANZ PHARMA's established portfolio.
* Provide technical leadership across product lifecycle management activities, ensuring products remain robust, compliant, and commercially successful.
* Resolve complex manufacturing, packaging, quality, and supply-related technical issues through collaboration with CMOs and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Support lifecycle projects, including product improvements, manufacturing changes, and technical risk mitigation initiatives.
* Partner with commercial, quality, regulatory, supply chain, and external manufacturing teams to deliver business objectives.
* Provide technical input into product and company due diligence activities where required.
* Lead technical investigations, risk assessments, troubleshooting activities, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and approve complex technical documentation, scientific reports, technical justifications, and regulatory submission content.
* Manage technical project priorities, resources, budgets, and timelines to ensure successful delivery.
* Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives across the Technical Services function.
* Support the development, coaching, and progression of team members.
* Travel periodically (approx once per month) to manufacturing sites and CMOs across Europe and India as required.
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and take accountability for results.
* Embrace challenge and change, applying a growth mindset approach.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for an ambitious, resilient, and commercially aware technical leader who is passionate about delivering high-quality medicines to patients and driving business success.

You will bring strong pharmaceutical industry experience across product development, technical services, manufacturing science, or lifecycle management, together with proven people leadership capability.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or another relevant scientific discipline.
* Master's degree in Pharmacy or another technically relevant subject.
* Project management training or certification (e.g. Prince2)
  **(advantageous)**
* Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet advantageous.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

* Extensive working experience in a technical role within the pharmaceutical or medical device industry.
* Strong experience in Technical Services, Product Development, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Tech Transfer, Production, or Lifecycle Management.
* Demonstrated people management experience, ideally leading experienced technical teams.
* Experience supporting products for regulated markets.
* Strong understanding of GMP requirements, manufacturing operations, process validation, and quality systems.
* Experience managing technical issues that impact product quality, compliance, or supply continuity.
* Expertise across multiple pharmaceutical dosage forms, including oral solids, liquids, and injectables.
* Experience conducting technical investigations, root cause analysis, risk assessments, and troubleshooting activities.
* Strong technical writing and documentation review capabilities, including exposure to regulatory submissions and CMC documentation.
* Ability to manage complex stakeholder groups across quality, regulatory, supply chain, commercial, and external manufacturing functions.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to balance technical decision-making with business priorities.
* Positive, solutions-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Why Join ADVANZ PHARMA?**

At ADVANZ PHARMA, our purpose is clear: improving patients' lives by increasing access to medicines that matter. We are a fast-growing international pharmaceutical company where employees have the opportunity to make a tangible impact, take ownership, and contribute to meaningful work every day.

**A Place Where You Can Grow**

We foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous development. This role offers exposure to global markets, regulatory authorities, manufacturing partners, and a diverse product portfolio spanning multiple dosage forms and therapeutic areas.

**Entrepreneurial by Nature**

Our teams are empowered to make decisions, challenge convention, and create solutions that drive results. We value people who bring energy, accountability, and a desire to make things happen.

**A Meaningful Mission**

Every role at ADVANZ PHARMA contributes to improving access to important therapies for patients across the globe. The work you do will have a direct impact on healthcare professionals, healthcare systems, and ultimately the patients they serve.

**Flexibility and Support for Your Wellbeing**

Our agile and flexible working arrangements, paired with a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, are designed to support your health, career aspirations, and work-life balance.

**Rewards & Benefits**

We are delighted to offer a comprehensive package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and professional growth of our employees.

**Global Benefits**

* Global Recognition Programme
* Long Service Award
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Birthday Leave
* Wellbeing Day
* Volunteering Leave
* Compassionate Leave
* Agile Working
* Work From Anywhere (subject to local legislation)

**Our People Recommend Us**

We're proud that 82% of employees in our engagement survey said they would recommend ADVANZ PHARMA as a great place to work.

If you're looking for an opportunity to combine technical leadership, global exposure, and meaningful patient impact,
**apply today.**

****Shanghai****

**Who We Are**
At ICP, our values define us: we are Curious, Focused, Creative, Trustworthy, and Inclusive.
  
  
**We're A People First Company**
At ICP, we provide benefits that matter to our people and enable us to be engaged both in and outside of work. We foster a culture where
**work/life**
balance is nurtured and encouraged, offering hybrid working, generous paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, and Summer half-day Fridays. We also take care of our people with competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, mental health support, and a robust savings plan.
  
  
****Bring the Confidence****
Are you a relationship-focused, driven professional with a growth mindset? Do you thrive on breaking through challenges and excelling in competitive environments? You're not expected to have all the answers, but your passion for uncovering solutions and building strong partnerships makes you the perfect fit for this role. We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
The
****Manager, Account Operations****
plays a pivotal role in providing the necessary operational structure and guidance that allows our practitioners to focus on tactical day-to-day task execution required to deliver with excellence.
  
  
This position is responsible for the delivery and maintenance of client-facing account work, including satisfying contractual agreements per terms of SOWs, meeting SLAs, quality assurance, and ensuring process improvement. By focusing on maintaining processes, best practices, and establishing reporting and metrics, across all client projects, the Manager, Account Operations ensures high-quality service delivery and achievement of key milestones and metrics.
  
  
By facilitating open communication amongst cross-functional stakeholders including setting and maintaining expectations, Manager ensures delivery of agreed upon outcomes on time, and on budget.
  
  
The Manager, Account Operations is responsible for partnering with our dynamic, client-facing teams who are engaged in various operational and content-related activities. This role supports a portfolio of global companies where leadership, customer service, process adherence are crucial. The primary focus will be on leading a cross-functional account teams in the achievement of project objectives and business-related outcomes to ensure seamless day-to-day BAU (business as usual) operations, ongoing management of resources and risks and issues, as well as maintenance of standard operating and reporting documents.
  
  
The role will have a specialist focus on the delivery and governance of a global Fonts service, overseeing agency engagement, platform access, font usage reporting, compliance and ongoing service improvement. Alongside this specialist responsibility, the role will retain a broader operational management remit.
  
  
The role requires effective operations management, project management leadership, strategic thinking, tactical execution oversight, and excellent communication skills.
  
  
A proficient and inclusive leader, the Manager, Account Operations fosters achievement of objectives while balancing and maintaining a people-centric focus. Leading by example, they exhibit exceptional client-facing skills and service across various scenarios, ranging from day-to-day project operations to handling complex issues and proactively mitigating risks and challenges as they arise.

****Curiosity,****
****Collaboration****
,
****Adaptability****
,
****Focus****
,
****Creativity, Trust,****
and
****Inclusivity****
into their leadership approach, they will not only achieve success in this role but also contribute to the positive culture and growth of the organization.

title: Manager - Property Management
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)**
At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries.
  
  
www.godrejindustries.com
  
  
**About Godrej Ventures**
Godrej Ventures & Investment Advisers Pvt Ltd (GV) is a leading real estate investment management firm, focused on Grade A office developments across India’s top four cities: Bangalore, NCR, Pune, and Mumbai, managing 10 million sq. ft. portfolio of institutional-quality Class A office assets. Existing LPs and JV partners of GV are global pension funds, insurance cos. and leading financial institutions.
  
  
GV is fully integrated across the real estate value chain, with in-house capabilities spanning investments, fund management, design & development, leasing, and property management.
  
  
https://www.godrejventure.com/
  
  
**Role Objective**
The Manager – Property Management is responsible for overseeing the efficient operation, maintenance, and optimization of building facilities and infrastructure while ensuring a safe, compliant, and customer-centric environment. The role will support strategic facility planning, project transitions, vendor and contractor management, budgeting, customer engagement, sustainability initiatives, and operational excellence to enhance asset performance, tenant satisfaction, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Planning & Asset Optimization
* Support the development and execution of facility and real estate strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Assess current and future space utilization requirements and recommend optimization opportunities.
* Assist in planning and executing initiatives to improve operational efficiency and asset performance.
* Monitor industry trends and best practices in facilities and property management.
* Transition & Project Handover Management
* Coordinate smooth transition and handover of assets from project completion to operations.
* Review and maintain project handover documentation including floor plans, MEP drawings, DBR, TDS, warranties, AMCs, and compliance records.
* Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of building systems and infrastructure.
* Conduct snagging and de-snagging activities during property handovers.
* Review SOPs, preventive maintenance schedules, and operational checklists for all building services and equipment.
* Facilities Operations Management
* Manage day-to-day facility operations to ensure seamless functioning of the property.
* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities for building infrastructure and utilities.
* Ensure optimal performance of critical equipment including HVAC systems, chillers, transformers, DG sets, cooling towers, pumps, AHUs, STP, fire and life safety systems.
* Monitor service levels and ensure adherence to operational standards.
* Ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and statutory requirements.
* Vendor & Contractor Management
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers for facility-related services.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels and contractual obligations.
* Support contract administration, renewals, negotiations, and service reviews.
* Ensure timely closure of maintenance requests and operational issues by service providers.
* Verify work completion and service quality before processing certifications and payments.
* Budgeting & Cost Management
* Assist in the preparation and management of facility operating budgets and capital expenditure plans.
* Monitor expenses related to maintenance, utilities, repairs, and vendor services.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies.
* Track budget performance and support variance analysis and reporting.
* Ensure cost control while maintaining service quality and operational effectiveness.
* Customer & Tenant Relationship Management
* Act as a key point of contact for tenants and customers regarding facility-related concerns.
* Ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints, service requests, and escalations.
* Monitor tenant satisfaction and recommend service improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of customer engagement and experience enhancement programs.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless customer service delivery.
* Sustainability & Environmental Management
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy-efficiency initiatives across the property.
* Monitor utility consumption and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency.
* Assist in waste management, recycling, and environmental compliance programs.
* Promote green building practices and sustainable workplace initiatives.
* Support certifications and initiatives related to environmental sustainability.
* Risk Management, Safety & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and statutory regulations.
* Support implementation of emergency preparedness and response plans.
* Monitor compliance of fire and life safety systems and critical infrastructure.
* Conduct periodic facility inspections and safety audits.
* Assist in risk identification, mitigation planning, and closure of compliance gaps.
* Maintain all statutory records, certifications, licenses, and regulatory documentation.
* Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand facility requirements and operational priorities.
* Coordinate with project teams, tenants, consultants, government authorities, and service providers.
* Ensure effective communication on facility initiatives, service disruptions, and operational updates.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships to ensure seamless facility operations.
* Reporting & Analytics
* Prepare and maintain facility management reports, dashboards, and operational MIS.
* Track key performance indicators related to facility operations, maintenance, customer service, and costs.
* Analyze operational data and identify opportunities for service improvement and efficiency enhancement.
* Prepare presentations and management reports highlighting operational performance and key initiatives.
* Support periodic reviews, audits, and management meetings through accurate reporting and documentation.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in engineering/ hospitality/ management with 15 years of experience.
* Professional affiliation in a Facility management association with relevant certification will be an added advantage.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Proven skills and abilities relating to the transformation/ implementation to a fully integrated facility management model.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills specifically Excel, PowerPoint.
* Knowledge of web-based applications supporting corporate real estate requirements.
* Working knowledge of reporting tools to support site/ cross-site analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills.

**Work Experience**
12-15 years
  
  
**Benefits**
**Be an equal parent**
Childcare benefits for the birthing parent, commissioning parent (in case of surrogacy) or adoptive parent, and their partners
  
  

* 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers, flexible work options on return for primary caregivers
* 2 months paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Caregiver travel for primary caregivers to bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel

Coverage for childbirth and fertility treatment
  
  
**No place for discrimination at Godrej**
Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
  
  
Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses
  
  
Coverage for gender reassignment surgery and hormone replacement therapy
  
  
Community partnerships and advocacy
  
  
Persons with Disability (PwD) care
  
  
**We Are Selfish About Your Wellness**
Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top-up options
  
  
Elder care for those who might need to extend support to senior family members
  
  
Preventative healthcare support
  
  
Outpatient Department (OPD) coverage, including vaccinations, dental, vision, etc.
  
  
Uncapped sick leave
  
  
Flexible work options, including remote working and part-time work
  
  
Mental wellness and self-care programmes, resources and counselling
  
  
**Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way**
Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business-level achievements
  
  
Digital and offline instant recognition platforms
  
  
**An inclusive Godrej**
Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And it has been over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse - especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities - helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
  
  
We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
  
  
If this sounds like a role for you, apply now!
  
  
We look forward to meeting you.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Manager – First Choice is responsible for driving Blue Dart's continuous improvement agenda by leading the implementation of First Choice initiatives across the organization. The role focuses on enhancing operational efficiency, service quality, customer experience, and business performance through the application of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. The incumbent will partner with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, lead transformation projects, build continuous improvement capabilities through coaching and training, and ensure measurable business outcomes aligned with the organization's strategic objectives.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Manager – First Choice is responsible for leading and driving the implementation of First Choice measures across all locations. This role involves utilizing Six Sigma and Lean methodologies to improve service quality, enhance customer experience, and achieve process improvements. The incumbent will provide coaching on continuous improvement projects, data-driven solutions, and roadmaps, focusing on customer centricity and driving organizational change.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**First Choice Strategy and Process Improvement**

* Drive the implementation of First Choice initiatives across locations to improve process efficiency and customer service levels.
* Align First Choice and process improvement projects with organizational goals to maximize profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact initiatives with stakeholders, ensuring all projects are documented with clear milestones, baseline, and approvals.
* Develop a culture of continuous improvement through awareness programs, training, and campaigns.

**Financial and Operational Excellence**

* Prioritize process improvements that result in cost reductions and increased revenue for the organization.
* Analyze business processes to suggest improvements that lead to cost savings and process efficiencies.
* Generate Net Benefit and ROI reports to measure project success and improvements.
* Collaborate with regional teams to execute First Choice programs effectively across locations.

**Stakeholder Collaboration and Reporting**

* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure First Choice programs leverage the latest tools and methodologies.
* Monitor and report on project timelines and deliverables to senior management, ensuring proper communication of First Choice initiatives across the organization.
* Coordinate with Regional Management to ensure cross-departmental involvement in process improvement projects.

**Training and Development**

* Mentor business teams and provide coaching on First Choice methodologies.
* Organize and execute FC training programs, workshops, and awareness campaigns to enhance employee skills and promote continuous improvement.
* Maintain regular communication regarding First Choice developments and progress through internal channels such as newsletters and workshops.

**Project Management and Administration**

* Ensure proper project tracking and documentation of timelines, milestones, and outcomes.
* Organize and manage First Choice events such as awareness weeks and workshops.
* Oversee and support administrative aspects of First Choice training and certification programs.

**Quality Management System (ISO 9001)**

* Serve as the organization's ISO 9001 Management Representative / Process Excellence Lead.
* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 requirements across all functions.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and certification activities.
* Manage corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and ensure timely closure.
* Facilitate management reviews and report QMS performance metrics.
* Drive process standardization, documentation, and governance.
* Monitor customer feedback, complaints, and quality-related KPIs.

**Business Continuity Management (BCM/BCP)**

* Develop, implement, and maintain the organization's Business Continuity Framework.
* Conduct Business Impact Assessments (BIA) and risk assessments.
* Develop and periodically review business continuity and disaster recovery plans.
* Coordinate crisis management and incident response preparedness.
* Organize business continuity drills, simulations, and testing exercises.
* Ensure critical business processes have documented recovery procedures.
* Monitor regulatory and customer requirements related to resilience and continuity.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on continuity readiness and risks.

**Lean Six Sigma & Operational Excellence**

* Lead the organization's Lean Six Sigma strategy and deployment.
* Identify, prioritize, and govern improvement projects aligned to business objectives.
* Facilitate DMAIC, Kaizen, Lean, and process improvement initiatives.
* Build organizational capability through Lean Six Sigma training and certification programs.
* Establish performance dashboards and process control mechanisms.
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and service excellence initiatives.
* Apply statistical tools, control charts, process capability analysis, and root-cause problem solving.
* Measure and track benefits realization from improvement projects.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Essential: Graduate in any field
* Preferred: Postgraduate/Certification in Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or a related domain

**Experience Level**

* Required: 6-8 years of experience in process improvement, Six Sigma, Lean, or related continuous improvement methodologies, ideally in a logistics or customer service environment.
* Preferred: Experience in leading or managing large-scale projects, especially with a logistics service provider or in consulting roles using Lean/Six Sigma.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills And System Knowledge**

* Proficiency in Six Sigma tools (DMAIC, Kaizen, SPC, etc.) and methodologies.
* Familiarity with statistical tools like Sigma XL or MINITAB is a plus.
* Strong MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Experience in training facilitation and project management tools.

**Core Competencies**

* Process Improvement: Expertise in identifying and driving process improvements using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects, ensuring timely execution and adherence to objectives.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze data and identify areas for improvement in processes.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Collaboration: Ability to work across functions and build consensus on process improvements.
* Problem-Solving: Expertise in addressing operational inefficiencies and finding solutions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and stakeholder management.

**Key Performance Indicators:**
**Key Result Area**
**KPIs**
Process Efficiency
  
  
Number of projects successfully completed with measurable improvements.
  
  
Customer Satisfaction
  
  
Improvement in service quality and customer satisfaction levels.
  
  
Cost Savings
  
  
Percentage reduction in operational costs through process improvement.
  
  
Training Effectiveness
  
  
Number of employees successfully trained on First Choice methods.
  
  
Project Timeliness
  
  
Percentage of projects completed on time and within the established milestones.
  
  
**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
  
  
Here’s what makes us stand out:
  
  
  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work.

**Reconciliation (Senior Lead Analyst)**
As the world works and lives faster, FIS is leading the way. Our fintech solutions touch nearly every market, company and person on the planet. Our teams are inclusive and diverse. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.
  
  
**About The Team**
The primary function of the role will be to manage Exchange, broker and intercompany trade, position and cash reconciliations and General Ledger reconciliation.
  
  
This job role requires key attention to detail, good understanding of account structure at Exchange, CCP and broker, structure of reach reconciliations, working of OTC and ETD derivatives at various Exchanges / CCP’s, break investigation and provide resolutions in a timely manner.

* Identify, agree and escalate breaks in a timely manner to meet the required service standards
* Resolve open breaks by working with the appropriate teams internally or externally to correct the identified discrepancy
* Investigate and analyze root causes of breaks to try and prevent reoccurrence
* Compile reporting to key process stakeholders around the recs function
* Change Management/process improvements
* Proactively identify areas for performance and control improvements
* Understand the changes/amendments required in existing process functions or static for Reconciliations due to new client onboarding, market or broker changes or brokers onboarded, test the changes and ensure their implementation without any issues
* Articulate business cases to management/change/IT to execute and deliver on suggested improvements

* Co-ordinate with different teams like reconciliation, clearing and static for timely response and resolution of all queries
* Ensure accuracy and clarity in all deliverables to client stakeholders

* Ensure that the Daily/weekly/Monthly MI/KPI reporting been delivered accurately and as per the expected timelines
* Complete all admin related work for resources like leave management and resource staffing
* Ensure that the relevant professional disciplined in maintained as per established standard of the firm like work from office days and other basic expectation from resources. Any deviation should be addressed on time through proper channels
* Coordinate with other internal teams and ensure that the issues are addressed internally and then client is reached out in consolidated manner
* Extended roles and responsibilities
* As part of management group, ensure that the extended scope of deliverables are met as per the agreed timelines
* Represent the firm as FIS management lead in all possible scenarios facing the client irrespective it’s in purview of functional limits
* Wok constantly towards building better client services through better processes and contribute for such initiative for the firm

**What You Bring**

* Minimum of 8-10+ years of work experience in Futures/Options, OTC & Cash reconciliation function
* Good understanding of reconciliation tools and other ETD systems like GMI
* Good knowledge of Clearing Houses like LCH, EUREX, ICE Clear, CME, HKEX, SGX etc
* Front to back understanding of the recs function, upstream dependencies and how it impacts processes downstream around clearing, margin and brokerage, so that complex queries can be addressed accurately and in a timely manner
* Detailed understanding of exchange traded derivatives (OTC and Futures/Options)
* High attention to detail and quality of outputs delivered
* Manage multiple simultaneous deliveries to tight deadlines
* Analytical and can solve problems quickly and innovatively
* Dynamic outlook, with the ability to adapt and change plans on the fly
* Delivery focused; results driven
* Excellent communication and co ordinations skills
* Strong client service focus

**Qualifications**

* MBA Degree or equivalent

Competencies
  
  

* Skill in project management, organization, communications, analytical and people skills
* Skill in leading, supervising and managing effectively under pressure
* Ability to be comfortable interacting and maintain positive working relationship with other stakeholders
* Ability to analyze business needs and determine related information services support
* Ability to manage activities and problem areas
* Ability to delegate tasks to qualified subordinates as appropriate
* Ability to lead, direct and manage effectively
* Ability to operate independently
* Ability to exhibit solid decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
* Ability to build strategic roadmap for the function and further expansion of scope of functions
* Ability to contribute towards budget saving automation ideas
* Ability to meet conflicting priorities by ensuring effective prioritization and meeting the business demands

**Added Bonus If You Have**

* Experience dealing with large financial services clients
* Experience in Margins & Collateral Management for ETD & OTC Derivatives
* Experience in Trade Clearing & Lifecycle process for ETD & OTC Derivatives
* Knowledge of Front to Back Trade & Cash Settlement flows

What we offer you
  
  

* A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
* A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities – FIS is your final career step!
* A competitive salary and benefits
* A variety of career development tools, resources and opportunities

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
**Job Description**
The purpose of having a project manager is to coordinate all project activities from initiation to completion, ensuring that objectives are achieved on time, within scope, and budget. They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Project Planning: Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* Team Leadership: Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* Monitoring & Reporting: Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* Problem Solving: Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* Closing the Project: Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

* Leadership: Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to various stakeholders.
* Time Management: Skill in managing one’s own time and the time of others to meet deadlines.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Problem-Solving: Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* Negotiation: Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* Budgeting: Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)

* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL

* Participate in Mutual Action Planning (MAP) discussions with our CP/SI
* Attend Pre-bid and post bid technical meetings and drive Honeywell needs
* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.
* Supporting sales campaigns or programs in specific markets or for specific products
* Proven Presentation skills

**Specific Knowledge Required**

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. title: Copywriter (SEM Advertising)
description:
Madhive is the leading independent and fully customizable operating system built to help local media professionals build profitable, differentiated, and efficient businesses. Madhive empowers sales teams to extend their reach into streaming and connects local advertisers with the communities they serve. Madhive’s platform provides the unique ability to reach local audiences at national scale, with premium supply partnerships and end-to-end tools for planning, targeting, and measuring full-funnel campaign outcomes. Powering campaigns for over 30,000 small and medium businesses per day, Madhive is driving the evolution of local media.
  
  
We are seeking a detail oriented, fast moving Copywriter to join our growing Creative team. In this role, you will write high quality Search Engine Marketing (SEM) ads for small and local businesses across the United States and Canada, working in close partnership with leading media companies.
  
  
You'll combine strong natural writing skills with Madhive's proprietary AI powered SEM tool to produce ad copy at scale. The tool speeds up creation, and your expertise keeps every ad accurate, clear, and up to advertising standards through careful editing, fact checking, and refinement. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high volume, deadline driven environment and takes pride in polished, compliant, and effective advertising copy.
  
  
This role is based in Pune, India, with shift options of 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM IST or 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Write and edit SEM ad copy using Madhive's proprietary AI SEM tool
* Create complete SEM campaigns, including Responsive Search Ads (RSAs), callouts, structured snippets, and sitelinks
* Research and fact check business information using client websites, Yelp, and other trusted sources
* Ensure accuracy, compliance, and quality control across all ads
* Maintain consistent advertising and brand standards at a fast pace
* Complete approximately 6 to 10 SEM campaigns per day while maintaining high quality
* Collaborate with internal team members to meet daily production deadlines

title: Recruitment Associate
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




 The quality of school education available to students from low\-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high\-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.
 



  





 We run free and high\-impact schools and an exceptional college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world\-class professional development, our result\-oriented team culture, and our student\-centric school design. Read more about us at
 
 www.iTeachSchools.org
 
 .
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 The Recruitment Associate is a key member of the People Operations team and is responsible for building strong momentum around the secondary education movement and then leveraging it to find the best people for the organization. iTeach’s founding belief is “first who, then what” \- which means that we put all our bets on our people, making this role singularly important to the organization and the students’ success.
 



  





**Selection \& Sourcing \- 60%** 




  




* Drive the end\-to\-end sourcing and initial selection process for assigned roles, ensuring a strong and diverse candidate pipeline.
* Conduct CV screenings, phone/Video screenings and Walk\-ins to assess candidates against role requirements, competencies, and organizational values.
* Use multiple sourcing channels and recruitment portals effectively to identify and attract high\-potential candidates.
* Continuously experiment with innovative sourcing strategies and creative ways to reach and engage candidates, especially for hard\-to\-fill roles.
* Maintain strong candidate engagement, pool and momentum throughout the selection process.



  





**Interview Logistics \& Data Monitoring \- 20%** 




  




* Coordinate with the school Admin/ Principal for on ground interview logistics and ensure a smooth, timely, and positive experience for candidates and selectors.
* Work closely with selectors to ensure interviews are well planned, structured, and completed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment data across all stages of the hiring funnel.
* Use recruitment data and insights to support better decision\-making and continuously improve the hiring process.



  





**Recruitment Projects \& Process Improvement \- 20%** 




  




* Lead and support recruitment projects and initiatives aimed at improving sourcing, selection, candidate experience, and overall recruitment effectiveness.
* Monitor key recruitment metrics such as pipeline health, conversion rates, time\-to\-hire, offer acceptance, and attrition, and identify areas for improvement.
* Bring new ideas, test innovative approaches, and use learnings from recruitment data to continuously improve the organization’s ability to attract and select the right people.



  





**Prerequisites:** 




  




* Required: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree with strong performance.
* Preferred: 1 year of relevant work experience.
* Excellent communication skills \- written and verbal.



  





**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 4\.8 \- 6\.0 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

title: Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management, you will design learning experiences that help clients navigate technology and culture change within our Advisory practice. At PwC Acceleration Center India, this role connects workforce transformation with a human-centered approach to change. You will translate training needs into role-based curricula, blended programs, and learning materials for initiatives involving systems such as Workday, Oracle, or SAP. Drawing on adult learning principles and tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise 360, you will develop accessible content for learning platforms and use learner feedback and performance measures to refine it.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will own assigned learning workstreams and use critical thinking to resolve complex design questions while keeping broader client objectives in view. You will build client relationships, anticipate team needs, and adapt when requirements are unclear. By reviewing work and mentoring junior colleagues, you will reinforce professional and technical standards, including PwC’s code of conduct and independence requirements. You will also use feedback to develop your skills, apply judgment to learning data and emerging tools such as generative AI, and bring an instructional design perspective to project discussions and proposals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyzing client workforce needs, organizational structures, and process impacts to shape learning approaches for technology implementations and culture-driven change
* Mapping business processes and employee journeys to identify adoption barriers, diagnose root causes, and align training priorities with organizational goals
* Designing training needs assessments, curriculum architectures, and role-based learning plans with subject matter specialists, applying adult learning principles, ADDIE or SAM, and Bloom’s taxonomy
* Facilitating client workshops and developing storyboards, scenarios, activities, assessments, facilitator guides, participant materials, and instructor-led or virtual training decks
* Building accessible digital learning assets with Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, or comparable tools, using AI-assisted analysis and content development where appropriate
* Publishing and troubleshooting content in learning management or experience platforms, managing SCORM or xAPI packaging, version control, and accessibility requirements
* Evaluating learning outcomes through surveys, knowledge checks, and workplace performance measures using Kirkpatrick Levels 1 through 3 to refine programs and support adoption
* Managing assigned client delivery workstreams, communicating project updates, contributing learning estimates to proposals, and reviewing deliverables with junior colleagues

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity
* Mapping business processes and diagnosing adoption barriers while tailoring role-based learning for organizational change
* Facilitating design workshops and incorporating employee perspectives into technology and culture transformation programs
* Applying learning metrics and performance data when refining training for changing client needs
* Developing workforce learning content using AI-assisted analysis, prompt engineering, and digital tools
* Translating HR transformation needs into learning plans for Workday, Oracle, or SAP implementations
* Communicating change through audience-specific stories, interactive experiences, and clear stakeholder updates
* Mentoring junior colleagues while supporting client engagements and adapting delivery to feedback and ambiguity

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
We're Hiring | Human Resources Manager (HR Manager)

**📍 Location: NSP, Delhi**

**🏢 Company: Saya Stationeries Pvt. Ltd.**

**💼 Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**About SAYA**

Saya Stationeries Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's fast-growing stationery companies, offering an extensive range of innovative, high-quality products for students, professionals, and businesses.

With a strong pan-India distribution network, a rapidly expanding product portfolio, and ambitious growth plans, SAYA is building a dynamic organization driven by innovation, operational excellence, and people.

As we scale our operations, we are looking for a proactive, experienced, and result-oriented HR Manager who can strengthen our people processes, attract quality talent, and build a high-performance work culture.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on HR Manager to independently manage and continuously improve end-to-end HR operations across our manufacturing facility and corporate functions.

The ideal candidate will combine strong recruitment capabilities with expertise in HR operations, statutory compliance, employee relations, and HR technology.

This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who enjoys taking ownership, implementing structured processes, and contributing directly to the growth of an expanding organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

* Drive end-to-end recruitment across manufacturing, sales, operations, supply chain, and corporate functions.
* Partner with department heads to understand manpower requirements and execute timely hiring.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies, screening processes, and recruitment pipelines.
* Manage onboarding, induction, and employee documentation.

**2. HR Operations & HRMS Management**

* Oversee daily HR operations, including attendance, leave management, employee records, and payroll coordination.
* Manage and optimize Keka HRMS, ensuring accurate employee data, attendance, leave, and HR workflows.
* Implement HR automation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and transparency.
* Maintain HR dashboards, MIS reports, and workforce analytics.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Coordinate performance appraisals, KPI/KRA tracking, and employee feedback processes.
* Work with department heads to improve employee productivity and accountability.
* Identify training needs and coordinate employee development initiatives.

**4. Statutory Compliance & HR Policies**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws, including PF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, and other statutory requirements.
* Develop, implement, and regularly review HR policies, SOPs, and employee guidelines.
* Maintain compliance documentation and support statutory audits and inspections.
* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary processes, and workplace matters professionally.

5. Employee Engagement & Organizational Development

* Foster a positive, disciplined, performance-driven, and employee-friendly workplace.
* Plan employee engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives.
* Support leadership in building a strong organizational culture and improving employee experience.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, MBA (HR), or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in manufacturing, FMCG, consumer products, or a similar fast-growing organization.
* Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment, HR operations, employee relations, and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience with Keka HRMS is strongly preferred.
* Sound knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, HR analytics, and reporting.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage multiple HR priorities.

**What We're Looking For**

We value professionals who are:

* Execution-oriented: Someone who gets things done rather than just creating policies.
* Tech-savvy: Comfortable using HR technology and automation to improve processes.
* People-focused: Able to balance employee welfare with organizational discipline.
* Process-driven: Capable of building scalable systems as the organization grows.
* Growth-minded: Excited to contribute to a rapidly expanding Indian consumer brand.

**Why Join SAYA?**

* Be part of a rapidly growing Indian stationery brand with ambitious expansion plans.
* Take ownership of HR operations and contribute to organizational transformation.
* Work closely with senior leadership and department heads.
* Opportunity to introduce HR best practices, automation, and scalable processes.
* A dynamic environment that recognizes initiative, accountability, and results.

**Interested Candidates**

Apply directly through LinkedIn with your updated resume.

Join SAYA and help us build the people, processes, and culture behind our next phase of growth.

title: HR Manager Business Partner, APAC
description:

The HR Manager Business Partner (HRBP) APAC position strengthens our company's culture by partnering with practices to develop strategies that support retention, performance management and a high level of employee engagement. This role provides strategic and some operational HR support across work force planning, employee relations, talent development, performance management, training, and other key HR initiatives. The role includes oversight of the Talent Acquisition function, HR Administration and HR Business Partnering team, working with the Director of HR to provide leadership to develop the HR function as required. Experience of working in a global matrixed environment is essential, ideally in consulting or professional services.
  
  
This role is based out of the Gurgaon office will focus primarily on Milliman India for the initial 12 months.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work collaboratively with the broader HR teams to ensure that Milliman practices receive the highest standards of HR support.
* Builds the business partner relationship with executives, management, and teams; understands the business, goals, and challenges; and identifies and develops solutions to address systemic issues.
* Provides advice to executives and supports management teams in areas of organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee engagement, performance management, training, and development.

* Drive key HR team projects by taking a leadership role and managing project efforts including scheduling and resources as well as owning responsibility for holding project team members accountable for deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to develop and implement process improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for monitoring status, managing issues, and escalating when appropriate.
* Work with the HRST to ensure operational efficiency. Ensure Operational HR matters are dealt with accurately and effectively.
* Ensure POSH compliance and records are maintained, with any concerns being dealt with appropriately by the relevant team.
* Ensure that all HR data is managed with a zero tolerance for error or inaccuracy.
* Deal with annual review of all Employee Benefits. To work with Finance leader to ensure accurate maintenance of all employee benefits administration.
* Support the Performance Review Processes for local practices, ensuring that any performance issues are dealt with appropriately.

Provide oversight and support the end-to-end recruitment delivery across actuarial, technical and non-technical roles, requisition management, sourcing and interviewing through to onboarding.

**Skills & Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree and/or relevant industry experience.
* The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 15 years' experience in resolving complex employee relations issues.
* The ideal candidate must have working knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines, including compensation practices, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, diversity and inclusion, performance management, and respective employment laws.
* The ideal candidate must have previous experience working in a matrix environment, ideally consulting or professional services.
* Demonstrates a professional and consultative approach when working with executives, leaders, management, and employees at all levels, with a strong ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and drive outcomes.
* Must have strong communication skills.
* CIPD or SHRM certification or similar preferable.
* Must have previous experience with organizational design.
* Must have the demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information as well as possessing skills to handle situations in a professional and diplomatic manner.
* Must have the demonstrated ability to manage and follow through on multiple priorities and assignments.
* Must have the ability to be flexible, but also to distinguish when appropriate to maintain boundaries.
* Thrives in entrepreneurial environments with a high degree of autonomy and variability, using strong judgment and adaptability to navigate ambiguity and differing approaches across teams and practices.

**About Milliman**
Independent for over 77 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
  
  
Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Ten11 Hospitality Pvt Ltd is a fast-growing company in the hospitality sector, focused on building, managing, and operating railway lounges under the INEJ brand. The company creates premium transit experiences by offering thoughtfully designed spaces that combine relaxation, dining, and modern amenities for travelers. Its lounges at Mumbai Central, Chennai Central, Vadodara Junction, and INEJ Eats at Lucknow Junction serve thousands of passengers daily with comfort and efficiency. Ten 11 Hospitality is expanding to key transit hubs across India, guided by a philosophy of traveler-focused innovation, operational excellence, and strategic partnerships. The company aims to redefine transit hospitality in India with inclusive, sustainable, and experience-led spaces for millions of passengers every year.

**What You Will Own From Day 1**

1. Department Leadership & Stabilization: Take immediate charge of end-to-end HR operations—managing, mentoring, and driving daily accountability for junior HR/recruitment staff.
2. Strict Manpower Budget Governance: Track outlet-wise and HQ headcount allocations against approved budgets. Prepare categorical monthly HR allocation plans for executive sign-off—zero unapproved hiring or budget overextensions.
3. High-Velocity Multi-Unit Hiring: Drive fast turnaround on both outlet ramp-ups (chefs, bartenders, stewards, unit managers) and HQ roles (Projects, Finance, Purchase) through structured sourcing and strict candidate screening.
4. Attendance, Roster & Payroll Accuracy: Audit biometric/site attendance across all locations, flag absenteeism immediately, and deliver error-free monthly payroll inputs to Finance on strict deadlines.
5. Statutory Compliance & Employee Relations: Ensure 100% compliance with PF, ESIC, Shops & Establishments, and labor audits while handling floor-level grievances, disciplinary actions, and exits decisively.

**Non-Negotiables (Apply Only If You Meet All 4)**

Industry Fit:

**4-8 years of proven HR generalist + recruitment experience in F&B, Cafes, Hotels or multi-unit retail.**

Immediate Availability: Can join immediately or within 30 days maximum.

Numbers & Excel Grip: Strong command over MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, payroll/headcount trackers) and HRMS tools.

High Operational Stamina: Comfortable stepping onto restaurant/lounge floors for audits, handling tough negotiations, and operating in a fast-paced, no-excuses environment.

**Qualifications**

Strong expertise in core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.

Experience with HR operations such as HR policy development, payroll coordination, compliance with labor regulations, and HRIS management.

Skills in organizational development, including training design, talent development, and succession planning.

Proficiency in communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management, with the ability to build trust across diverse teams.

Background in hospitality or service-oriented industries is highly beneficial, especially in multi-site or frontline-staff environments.

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) are an advantage.

Demonstrated ability to work in a hybrid setting, manage priorities independently, and use HR and collaboration tools effectively.
