title: Manager Digital HR
description:
India, Gurugram
  
  
**Job Title:**
Manager Digital HR
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram, India
  
  
We are seeking an experienced HR Digital Manager to lead the digital transformation of HR processes, systems, and employee experiences during a critical carve-out program. This role will be responsible for driving the implementation, optimization, and integration of HR technology platforms, with a strong focus on Workday, UKG Time Management, and Strada Payroll.
  
  
Working at the intersection of Human Resources, Technology, and Business Transformation, you will partner with HR, IT, and business stakeholders to modernize HR operations, enhance employee experience, and enable data-driven decision-making through scalable and compliant digital solutions. This is a strategic yet hands-on role requiring expertise in HR technology, integrations, project delivery, and change management within a global environment.
  
  
**What You Will Get**

* Opportunity to play a key leadership role in a global HR transformation and carve-out program.
* Ownership of enterprise HR technology solutions including Workday, UKG Time Management, Strada Payroll, and related HR platforms.
* Exposure to global stakeholders and cross-functional teams across HR, IT, Payroll, and Business Operations.
* Ability to shape the future HR digital landscape by driving automation, process optimization, and data-driven HR decision-making.
* Experience working within a modern digital ecosystem focused on employee experience, analytics, governance, and operational excellence.
* Opportunity to contribute to large-scale transformation initiatives with global visibility and impact

**What you will do:**

* Lead the implementation, enhancement, and optimization of HR digital platforms, including HRIS, payroll, workforce management, talent management, and employee lifecycle solutions.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, IT teams, and business stakeholders to identify technology needs and deliver digital solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Manage end-to-end HR technology projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, quality standards, and timelines. Drive the integration of HR systems and processes to enable seamless data flow and operational efficiency across platforms.
* Evaluate emerging HR technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve employee experience and HR service delivery.
* Develop HR analytics and reporting capabilities to provide actionable insights that support strategic workforce decisions. Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across HR technology environments, including adherence to GDPR and other applicable regulations.
* Design and deliver training programs to support adoption of new HR technologies, tools, and processes.
* Serve as the HR technology subject matter expert, providing guidance, support, and issue resolution for HR digital platforms.
* Lead change management activities to ensure successful implementation, user adoption, and long-term value realization from HR transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders across regions to support continuous improvement and standardization of HR processes and systems.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in HR technology, HRIS management, digital HR transformation, or related roles.
* Proven experience implementing and optimizing enterprise HR platforms such as Workday, UKG, Strada Payroll, or similar solutions, with strong systems integration knowledge.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, compensation, learning, and offboarding.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex HR technology projects, digital transformation initiatives, and change management programs in a global environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working in global, matrixed organizations; proficiency in English, with carve-out, M&A, or large-scale transformation experience considered a strong advantage

title: HRIS Specialist
description:
**About Milliman**
Independent for over 75+ years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
  
  
Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance, and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Primary responsibility of this position is the support and maintenance of the HRIS (UKG). This individual serves as a technical point of contact for HR and payroll and assists subject matter experts with ensuring data integrity, testing, report writing, and analyzing data flows for process improvement opportunities. Additional duties include supporting system enhancements, implementations, and process improvements.
  
  
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide support for HRIS, including researching and resolving HRIS problems, unexpected results or process flaws; performing scheduled activities; recommending solutions or alternate methods to meet requirements.
* Recommend process/customer service improvements, innovative solutions, policy changes and/or major variations from established policy that must be approved by appropriate leadership prior to implementation.
* Assist with third-party vendors and other stakeholders (e.g., payroll and IT).
* Write, maintain and support a variety of reports or queries using appropriate reporting tools.
* Assist in the development of standard reports for ongoing business needs.
* Help maintain data integrity in HR systems by running queries, performing audits, and analyzing data.
* Develop and maintain user procedures, guidelines, and documentation.
* Support system users on new processes and functionality.
* Maintain awareness of current trends in HRIS, with a focus on product and service development, delivery, support, and emerging technologies.
* Continuously increase HR and HRIS application/tools knowledge through professional development, product resources, and industry forums.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum one year of HRIS experience or two to four years of HR generalist or specialist experience.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, human resources, business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP preferred
* System implementation experience preferred
* HRIS experience required; UKG preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook required; working knowledge of SharePoint preferred.
* Ability to work within a globally distributed organization.
* Project management and organizational skills, including the ability to prepare, prioritize, and complete work.
* Fully remote position.
* Required work schedule: U.S. Pacific Time Zone hours, currently 9:00 PM - 5:30 AM IST. Work hours may shift by approximately one hour at certain times of the year to maintain alignment with Pacific Time.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS Enablement Services | Strategy & Operations**
**Job Description**
**Supervising Associate**
**About The Team**
GDS Enablement Services Strategy & Operations partners with ES leadership and Service Functions to advance strategic priorities, operational excellence, and business performance. The team provides data-led insights and business advisory support, while positioning key priorities and performance for leadership forums.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Supervising Associate will serve as a trusted business advisor and delivery lead, partnering with senior leadership and Service Functions to advance strategic and operational priorities. The role encompasses business advisory, program management, reporting and analytics, and financial and operational governance, with responsibility for managing complex workstreams and delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Governance, Reporting & Business Insights**

* Own recurring and on-demand MIS and KPI reporting across ES and Service Functions, ensuring accurate, consistent, and decision-ready outputs.
* Partner with senior SF leadership and the Core Leadership Team (CLT) to deliver data-driven analysis, insights, and executive-level reporting.
* Analyse business, financial, people, client, compliance, and operational KPIs to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.
* Translate complex data into meaningful insights, dashboards, storyboards, and executive-level presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and AI-enabled tools.
* Develop agendas and content for leadership meetings, and track key deliverables, actions, and decisions through to closure.
* Maintain effective governance over SharePoint repositories, dashboards, reporting trackers, and key performance information.

**Strategic Program & Project Management**

* Lead the planning and implementation of strategic initiatives and transformation programs across ES.
* Manage programs and projects end-to-end, developing business cases, project plans, KPIs, governance structures, milestones, and leadership reporting to support accountability and successful delivery.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, governance meetings, workshops, brainstorming sessions, and leadership updates.
* Coordinate with GDS Finance, Talent, Procurement, Payroll, Service Excellence, BMC, Real Estate, and other enabling teams to deliver project outcomes.
* Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery challenges early and work with stakeholders to establish appropriate mitigation plans.
* Lead or support change impact assessments, stakeholder mapping, communication planning, and adoption activities for transformation initiatives.

**Business & Operational Advisory**

* Act as a trusted advisor to Service Function leadership on strategic, operational, and financial priorities.
* Translate performance insights into actionable recommendations that support informed decision-making and course correction.
* Collaborate with Service Functions and enabling teams to resolve operational issues and drive business priorities.
* Support workforce and headcount governance, including cost centres, departments, workforce pyramid, location strategy, and the alignment of headcount with organizational structures.
* Provide guidance on engagement codes, expense-code governance, and related operational requirements.
* Monitor compliance requirements, highlight gaps and risks, and work with relevant stakeholders to drive timely closure.
* Support real estate and workplace planning through analysis of seat requirements and utilization.

**Financial Planning & Performance**

* Lead or support ES planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities, including coordinating Service Function inputs and submissions in Hyperion.
* Provide analysis and insights on P&L, utilization, hiring, headcount, billability, indirect costs, and other financial drivers.
* Partner with Finance and Service Functions on rate-card inputs, cost optimization, workforce planning, and performance reviews.
* Review unbilled FTEs and hours, non-billable costs, and other financial indicators to identify potential revenue leakage and optimization opportunities.
* Support accounts receivable governance and timely resolution of outstanding items.

**Leadership, Stakeholder & People Management**

* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, Service Functions, regional stakeholders, and enabling teams, influencing alignment and outcomes.
* Provide strategic, evidence-based recommendations, offer constructive challenge where appropriate, and proactively identify and escalate risks.
* Represent Strategy & Operations in leadership forums and cross-functional initiatives, combining strategic thinking with effective execution.
* If direct reportees are assigned, manage goal setting, ongoing feedback, and performance review cycles, while supporting team learning, career development, and overall growth through regular coaching and guidance.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

* Relevant experience in strategy and operations, program management, analytics, finance, transformation, or a comparable field, supported by strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.
* Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality executive-level outputs.
* Should have Sound understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting, P&L, headcount, utilization, billing, and cost management.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI, with familiarity in Copilot, EYQ, and other AI-enabled tools considered desirable.
* Strong communication, analytical, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively and confidently with senior stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Corporate Function Internship
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
  
  
From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
  
  
Build business experience. Solve real problems. Contribute to meaningful work.
  
  
Bring your curiosity, business knowledge, and classroom learning to Lummus Technology. This internship provides hands-on experience supporting Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, and other non-technical functions. You will contribute to practical assignments, learn from experienced professionals, and complete a defined business improvement project that supports a meaningful departmental or operational need.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
Working with an assigned manager or mentor in Gurgaon, you will support project work and day-to-day business activities, collaborate with colleagues, and learn how your function contributes to Lummus Technology. Your assignment will be matched to departmental needs, your academic discipline, and your professional interests. You will complete a defined internship project and present your work at the end of the program.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Complete a meaningful, real-world internship project, final presentation, and handoff package.
* Follow applicable confidentiality, data privacy, ethics, safety, and company requirements.
* Learn and use relevant systems, tools, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues, communicate progress, and raise questions or risks promptly.
* Maintain accurate records and document assumptions, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
* Apply academic knowledge, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving to practical business challenges.
* Prepare clear reports, presentations, trackers, dashboards, communications, procedures, and other assigned deliverables.
* Assist with reporting, reconciliations, research, sourcing activities, process documentation, employee programs, or administrative coordination, depending on the assignment.
* Gather, organize, review, and analyze business information or data to support departmental objectives.
* Support projects and recurring activities within Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, or another assigned corporate function.

Business Areas
  
  

* Assignments may be available in one or more of the following areas:
* Human Resources: talent acquisition, onboarding, learning and development, employee data and reporting, engagement, and HR operations support.
* Procurement and Supply Chain: supplier research, sourcing support, spend analysis, purchase-order tracking, vendor documentation, and process improvement.
* Finance and Accounting: financial analysis, reporting, budgeting support, reconciliations, controls, and process documentation.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Commitment to ethical, confidential, accurate, and professional work practices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other productivity tools; exposure to ERP, HRIS, procurement, reporting, or analytics systems is preferred where applicable.
* Ability to collaborate in a professional, team-based environment and manage assignments with appropriate guidance.
* Effective written and verbal communication in English and the ability to present business information clearly.
* Analytical thinking, attention to detail, initiative, discretion, and a willingness to learn and receive feedback.
* Foundational business knowledge relevant to the assigned function, demonstrated through coursework, academic projects, internships, competitions, or student organizations.
* Third- or fourth-year student status at the time of the internship.
* Currently enrolled in a recognized college or university program in finance, accounting, commerce, economics, business administration, human resources, supply chain, procurement, or a closely related discipline.

**Your Internship Project: Business Improvement**
You will complete a presentation covering problem statements, approaches, analysis, results, and recommendations in a professional format.
  
  

* Explore: Gather approved information, review available data, or current practices, and consult relevant stakeholders.
* Develop: Create an analysis, report, dashboard, tracker, process map, communication resource, sourcing recommendation, or other practical business work product.
* Validate: Check accuracy and usability, document limitations, and incorporate stakeholder feedback.
* Present and hand off: Explain the approach, findings, results, and recommendations; provide supporting files and clear instructions.
* Required deliverables: project brief, completed work product, final presentation, and handoff package. Results should be documented against agreed success measures, with demonstrated outcomes distinguished from estimated opportunities.

**Future Opportunities**
**Future Opportunities Consist Of**
A portion of third-year university interns may be invited to return for a second internship the following academic year.
  
  
Selected fourth-year interns may be considered for permanent entry-level opportunities after graduation, based on business needs and performance.
  
  
Selected full-time graduates that accept a permanent offer, may participate in a structured development or rotational experience aligned with Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, or another business function, based on available opportunities.
  
  
**Program Details**
Our

* Upstream – Exploration and production including deep understanding in upstream economics and key terminologies used to assess quality and performance of upstream assets, gas processing and liquefaction, production operations and asset performance optimization
* Downstream – Refining operations including deep understanding of refined products value chain, refinery economics and measurable KPIs to assess performance, margin optimization and operational performance improvement

**What You’ll Do**

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Manager - Operations & Payroll
description:
**About the Company**

**About the Role**

Own and strengthen the organisation’s payroll, HR statutory compliance, employee lifecycle operations, HR systems and employee-data governance. The role will also manage compensation and benefits analytics, support compensation decisions through reliable data and calculations, and execute and track ESOP and other long term incentive plans in close coordination with HR leadership, Finance, Legal, Secretarial, external advisors and payroll partners.

**Responsibilities**

* Own and strengthen the organisation’s payroll, HR statutory compliance, employee lifecycle operations, HR systems and employee-data governance.
* Manage compensation and benefits analytics, support compensation decisions through reliable data and calculations.
* Execute and track ESOP and other long term incentive plans in close coordination with HR leadership, Finance, Legal, Secretarial, external advisors and payroll partners.

Key Result Areas

* Payroll governance, processing and controls
* HR statutory compliance, audits and risk closure
* Employee lifecycle and HR operations
* SAP SuccessFactors, employee master data and process automation
* Employee-data privacy, confidentiality and access governance
* Compensation and benefits analytics and administration
* ESOP and other long-term incentive plan implementation and tracking
* HR MIS, dashboards, workforce cost analytics and decision support
* Policy, SOP, vendor and stakeholder governance

1. Payroll Governance and Employee Benefits

* Own the complete monthly payroll cycle, including input collation, validation, processing, exception review, maker-checker controls, sign-offs and timely payroll closure.
* Validate new joiners, exits, attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, recoveries, loans/advances, full-and-final settlements and other pay-impacting transactions.
* Review payroll registers, bank advice, accounting inputs, variance reports, payroll-to-GL reconciliation and employee-wise exceptions before release.
* Coordinate with Finance, payroll vendors and internal stakeholders for accurate salary disbursement, statutory remittances, tax inputs, provisions and payroll accounting.
* Administer employee benefits and insurance programmes, including enrolment, additions/deletions, renewals, claims coordination, vendor reconciliation and employee communication.
* Maintain payroll calendars, process notes, control checklists, evidence and audit trails; track errors, root causes and corrective actions.

2. HR Statutory Compliance and Audits

* Own the HR statutory compliance calendar and ensure timely registrations, renewals, displays, records, returns, remittances and supporting documentation across applicable establishments and locations.
* Coordinate compliance relating to wages, social security, bonus, gratuity, leave, working conditions, employment records and other applicable labour requirements, with specialist advice where required.
* Maintain location-wise compliance trackers, statutory registers, licences, notices, contractor/manpower documentation and evidence repositories.
* Lead HR compliance reviews and support internal, statutory, customer and regulatory audits; ensure timely closure of observations and sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor changes in labour and employment regulations, assess operational impact and coordinate updates to policies, processes, systems and communications.

3. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle

* Manage employee lifecycle transactions from joining through confirmation, transfer, promotion, role/location/reporting changes, leave, benefits changes, separation and full-and-final closure.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely employee documentation, personal files, letters, approvals, workflows and records in line with defined authority and retention requirements.
* Drive consistent service standards, turnaround times, case tracking and resolution for employee HR operations queries.
* Maintain and periodically improve HR policies, SOPs, templates, checklists and process controls; ensure consistent implementation across locations.
* Manage HR operations vendors against scope, service levels, accuracy, confidentiality, controls and commercial terms.

4. SAP SuccessFactors, HR Data and Process Automation

* Act as process owner for relevant SAP SuccessFactors modules and employee master data, ensuring data quality, timely updates and alignment between HRMS, payroll and other downstream systems.
* Manage workflows, role-based access, user support, issue logs, data interfaces, testing, change requests and system/vendor coordination.
* Perform periodic data-quality checks, reconciliations and exception closure; maintain clear ownership and controls for critical employee data fields.
* Identify and implement opportunities for digitisation, workflow simplification, self-service, standardisation and reduction of manual interventions.

5. Employee-Data Privacy and Governance

* Apply need-to-know and role-based access principles to employee and compensation data; maintain access reviews, confidentiality controls and approval trails.
* Ensure secure collection, use, storage, sharing, retention and disposal of employee data in accordance with organisational policy and applicable requirements.
* Coordinate responses to employee-data requests, corrections, incidents and audits with Information Security, Legal and other relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure vendors handling employee data follow contractual confidentiality, security, retention and breach-notification requirements.

6. Compensation and Benefits Administration and Analytics

* Support salary benchmarking, compensation structures, annual increment and promotion cycles, salary corrections, offer-fitment analysis and benefits-cost reviews.
* Prepare accurate compensation calculations, scenario models, compa-ratio/range analysis, internal equity analysis, employee cost projections and decision-support packs.
* Manage approved compensation changes through documented inputs, validations, system updates, employee letters and payroll implementation.
* Analyse fixed pay, variable pay, benefits and workforce cost data to identify trends, exceptions, risks and opportunities; present concise insights to HR leadership.
* Maintain confidentiality and version control for compensation models, employee-level data, approvals and decision records.

7. ESOP and Other Long-Term Incentive Plans Implementation

title: Cluster Manager
description:
Cargo Players is transforming last-mile logistics in India with an EV-first, tech-first approach, delivering end-to-end intracity solutions across hyperlocal, quick commerce, and e-commerce last mile. Its carbon-neutral EV fleets are powered by IoT telematics, routing intelligence, and a real-time control tower to ensure efficient, data-driven operations. Through an EV-as-a-Service and 3PL hyperlocal and quick commerce model, Cargo Players helps brands reduce cost per drop, improve uptime, and scale sustainable logistics. City clusters with micro-hubs, trained riders, and SLA-driven processes enable reliable 10–120 minute and same-day deliveries across multiple quick commerce verticals. Headquartered in New Delhi, the company operates across all major metro cities, partnering with fast-growing brands to build the future of fast, affordable, green logistics.

The Cluster Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi,Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Haridwar, Agra, Jaipur, Chandigarh responsible for overseeing end-to-end operations within an assigned city cluster. The role involves managing micro-hubs, onboarding riders, managing and supervising rider teams, and ensuring adherence to service-level agreements for hyperlocal, quick commerce, and e-commerce deliveries. The Cluster Manager will monitor daily performance metrics, optimize routing and fleet utilization, and coordinate with the central control tower to maintain high uptime and delivery reliability. This position also includes stakeholder management with client partners, addressing operational issues, and implementing process improvements aligned with Cargo Players’ EV-first and sustainability-focused strategy. The Cluster Manager will lead local teams, ensure compliance with safety and operational standards, and support scalable growth within the cluster.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end-to-end EV fleet operations across assigned clusters.
* Drive EV deployment, fleet utilisation, vehicle availability, and operational efficiency.
* Lead ground teams, Team Leaders, and fleet operations personnel.
* Drive rider onboarding, productivity, retention, and fleet expansion.
* Monitor vehicle uptime, battery performance, charging and battery-swapping operations.
* Ensure timely resolution of vehicle maintenance and operational escalations.
* Manage client relationships, operational SLAs, and business performance.
* Drive scalable and sustainable EV fleet operations.

**Qualifications/ Experience**

* Candidates with experience managing EV fleets and last-mile delivery operations associated with leading platforms and organisations, including:Blinkit | Amazon Now | Zepto | BigBasket | Porter | Swiggy Instamart | Zomato | Other Quick-Commerce & E-commerce Platforms.
* Operational management skills, including experience overseeing last-mile or logistics operations, managing hubs or branches, and driving SLA compliance.
* Team leadership and people management capabilities, such as supervising field staff or riders, coaching teams, and handling workforce planning and performance management.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data, optimize routes and resources, and quickly address service disruptions.
* Customer and stakeholder management skills, including managing client relationships, handling escalations, and coordinating with internal cross-functional teams.
* Process and quality improvement skills, with experience in standardizing procedures, implementing best practices, and ensuring safety and regulatory compliance.

title: Fleet Manager - Last Mile(Delhi) - Contractual
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.As Fleet Coordinator – Last Mile, you will own day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across our hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR — making sure passengers move smoothly between buses and cabs, cab operators deliver to standard, and your ground team runs like clockwork.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead and manage day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across designated hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR.
* Ensure smooth, timely dispatch and coordination of last-mile cabs against bus arrival and departure schedules.
* Act as the on-ground escalation point, resolving operational disruptions (delays, no-shows, route changes, demand surges) quickly and calmly.
* Work closely with last-mile cab operators and drivers to drive app adoption, improve punctuality metrics, and elevate customer experience.
* Coach and support drivers on FlixBus standards, app usage, and service expectations.
* Manage the roster, shift planning, and day-to-day working of ground operations associates and last-mile associates.
* Allocate manpower against demand patterns and peak windows; track attendance, performance, and productivity of the ground team.
* Own last-mile cab operator governance — share performance reports regularly, run periodic review meetings, and manage the day-to-day partner relationship.
* Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.
* Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.
* Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**

* 3–6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).
* Proven experience managing frontline teams and third-party vendors or operators.
* Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.
* Data-literate — comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.
* Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .
* Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.
* Hone your stakeholder management skills by interacting with international stakeholders.

**Why Join Flix**
At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.
  
  
If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
We are looking for a highly driven, execution-focused Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead and scale operations across The Waffle Co. and Ammy’s Coffee.

The COO will serve as a key strategic and operational leader, working closely with the Founder to translate business vision and strategy into measurable business outcomes. The role will oversee day-to-day operations, supply chain, marketing, franchise management and business development, ensuring operational excellence, cross-functional alignment and sustainable business growth.

The ideal candidate will lead department heads, establish strong systems and accountability, and drive sustainable and profitable growth across company-owned and franchise outlets.

**Key Responsibilites**

**1. Business Operations & Operational Excellence**

* Own end-to-end operations of The Waffle Co. and Ammy’s Coffee.
* Ensure SOP compliance across company-owned and franchise locations.
* Improve operational efficiency, unit economics, quality control and customer experience.
* Monitor business performance daily, weekly and monthly, and lead improvement initiatives.
* Standardise processes to ensure new outlets can be replicated with consistent quality.

**2. Marketing Strategy & Brand Growth**

* Lead marketing strategy and execution.
* Oversee digital marketing, social media, influencer activities, promotions and marketing campaigns.
* Drive customer acquisition, loyalty and retention programmes.
* Own brand positioning, product-led marketing and identification of new market opportunities.
* Measure and improve marketing ROI and customer acquisition cost.

**3. Supply Chain & Dispatch**

* Oversee procurement, vendor management, inventory planning, warehousing and dispatch.
* Ensure timely, accurate and cost-effective delivery of products and supplies to all outlets.
* Optimise logistics costs, wastage, stock levels and operational workflows.
* Build strong vendor relationships and alternative supply options to ensure business continuity and protect margins.

**4. Franchise Operations & Business Expansion**

* Support franchise onboarding, training and ongoing operational guidance.
* Monitor franchise performance, brand standards and compliance, and address operational gaps.
* Lead new store launches, including site evaluation, setup, hiring, training and store opening.
* Develop and execute market expansion strategies, including new cities and business formats.

**5. Leadership, Team Management & Organisational Development**

* Lead and mentor department heads and key managers across operations, marketing, supply chain, franchise and business development.
* Build a performance-driven culture with clear ownership and accountability.
* Establish KPIs and structured review mechanisms, including daily huddles, weekly MIS and monthly business reviews.
* Strengthen succession planning, recruitment, employee training and retention.

**6. Financial Performance & Business Management**

* Monitor revenue, store-level P&L, profit margins and key operational metrics.
* Prepare regular business performance reports and dashboards for leadership.
* Identify and execute cost optimisation and revenue growth opportunities.
* Work closely with the finance team on budgeting, forecasting and capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning for new stores.

**7. Strategic Planning & Execution**

* Translate the Founder’s vision and organisational goals into actionable execution plans with defined ownership and timelines.
* Drive strategic growth projects and cross-functional initiatives to successful completion.
* Act as the primary link between ownership and operational teams to ensure alignment and execution.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Revenue growth and same-store sales growth.
* Store-level profitability and operating margins.
* Franchise performance and compliance scores.
* Marketing ROI and customer acquisition cost.
* Operational efficiency and cost control, including food cost, wastage and manpower cost.
* Customer satisfaction, NPS, ratings and complaint resolution time.
* Supply chain efficiency, fill rate, on-time dispatch and logistics cost.
* New store opening timelines and business ramp-up performance.

**Qualifications & Professional Experience**

* 7–15+ years of leadership experience in F&B, QSR, retail, franchising, hospitality or consumer brands.
* Proven track record of managing multi-unit operations, multiple teams and locations.
* Strong working knowledge of business operations, marketing, supply chain and P&L management.
* Experience in franchise business models and scaling brands is highly preferred.
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Business Management, Hospitality Management or a relevant field is mandatory.

**Leadership Skills**

* Strong leadership, people management and stakeholder communication skills.
* Data-driven decision-making with practical knowledge of MIS, dashboards and unit economics.
* Hands-on leadership approach with a strong ownership mindset and execution discipline.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented business environment.
* Ability to work closely with founders and balance business speed with structured processes.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with a brief note highlighting their experience in managing or scaling a multi-unit F&B, QSR business.

**﻿Company Description:**
Mirchi by Kim is a contemporary fashion and accessories brand rooted in Indian craftsmanship, bold design, and a love for all things unconventional. Founded by Kimaya Singh and inspired by her life between New York City and New Delhi, India, Mirchi brings together traditional hand-embroidery and craftsmanship with playful, modern silhouettes, vibrant colours, and statement-making designs. Through its collections, the brand celebrates Indian artistry and cultural influences with a contemporary, global perspective.

After two years of pop-ups, events, and activations across New York, Los Angeles, Nantucket, the Hamptons, Ibiza, and beyond, we're putting down roots in the city where it all began! We're opening our very
**first flagship at Dhan Mill, New Delhi,**

**tore Manager**

* Experience with premium, luxury, lifestyle, or contemporary fashion brands is strongly preferred.
* A genuine eagerness to learn, a love for fashion, an understanding of what makes Mirchi, Mirchi!
* **Must currently reside in Delhi**
  and be available to work on-site at Dhan Mill.
* Available to work a full-time, six-day workweek, including peak retail periods as required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Store Operations & Team Leadership**

* Take ownership of day-to-day store operations, team management, and overall performance.
* Manage, train, motivate, and schedule the retail team, including shift coverage and daily delegation.
* Oversee POS operations, cash reconciliation, inventory management, and daily opening and closing procedures.
* Coordinate stock replenishment, transfers, and deliveries with our Delhi production team.
* Maintain stock accuracy, loss prevention practices, and overall store organization.
* Ensure the store reflects Mirchi's aesthetic through thoughtful visual merchandising, store presentation, and strong product knowledge across the team.

**Sales, Clienteling & Customer Experience**

* Drive sales, monitor daily, weekly, and monthly targets, and identify opportunities to improve performance.
* Deliver an elevated, personalized, and distinctly Mirchi shopping experience.
* Build lasting relationships with customers and VIP clientele through personalized outreach, styling, and clienteling.
* Handle customer inquiries, feedback, complaints, exchanges, and special requests with care and professionalism.
* Encourage customer loyalty, repeat purchases, and help grow our in-store Mirchi community.

As our first flagship Store Manager, you'll have the opportunity to help build something from the ground up, work closely with the teams behind the brand, and contribute to both the operational and creative sides of a growing fashion business. We're looking for someone who wants to take ownership, bring fresh ideas to the table, and grow with us!

Please send your resume and a short cover letter introducing yourself, your relevant experience, and why you'd love to be part of Mirchi to
**careers@mirchibykim.com**

title: Senior Store Manager
description:
**About Vecmocon Technologies**
Vecmocon Technologies is an Indian EV technology company focused on developing advanced electronic and intelligent solutions for electric vehicles. The company specializes in EV electronics, battery management systems (BMS), motor controllers, vehicle intelligence, and connected mobility technologies.
  
  
With a focus on innovation, engineering excellence, and reliable manufacturing, Vecmocon contributes to the development of India's growing electric mobility ecosystem.
  
  

* Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Senior Store Manager**
to lead end-to-end stores, warehouse, inventory control, and material management operations.
  
  
The role will be responsible for ensuring inventory accuracy in Mi Cloud ERP, BOM-based material kitting, timely material handover to EMS partners, shortage management, and clearance of rejected materials.
  
  
The incumbent will lead a team of six members, including the Store In-charge, and work closely with Purchase, IQC, Production, Engineering, and EMS partners to ensure uninterrupted material availability and smooth manufacturing operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in electronics manufacturing inventory management, ERP operations, team leadership, and process improvement.
  
  

* Key Roles & Responsibilities
* Inventory Management & ERP Operations
* Lead overall inventory management and warehouse operations.
* Ensure 100% same-day posting of receipts, issues, transfers, returns, and rejections in Mi Cloud ERP.
* Maintain a minimum inventory accuracy of 99% between physical stock and ERP records.
* Monitor GRN, Delivery Challan (DC), stock transfers, and inventory reconciliation.
* Conduct monthly physical verification and periodic cycle counting.
* Identify and resolve stock discrepancies, negative inventory, incorrect entries, and duplicate part codes.
* Establish effective inventory controls, traceability systems, and stock management processes.
* BOM-Based Kitting & EMS Coordination
* Oversee BOM-based material kitting for electronic and mechanical components.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of material kits for EMS partners.
* Coordinate with R&D, Engineering, and Quality teams for approval of alternate components.
* Ensure substitutions, deviations, and BOM changes are approved before material issuance.
* Maintain accurate kitting records, approved-alternates lists, and ERP updates.
* Ensure proper signed material handover documentation with EMS partners.
* Reconcile materials issued against EMS consumption, including direct vendor-to-EMS supplies.
* Resolve material discrepancies and disputes with EMS partners within defined timelines.
* Material Shortage & Inventory Planning
* Conduct material shortage analysis against approved BOMs before each kitting cycle.
* Maintain daily shortage trackers with clear ownership and expected closure dates.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Planning, suppliers, and EMS partners for timely material availability.
* Proactively identify and escalate critical shortages that may impact production.
* Monitor excess, obsolete, slow-moving, ageing, and damaged inventory.
* Ensure timely replenishment of swap station and service inventory.
* Develop preventive measures to minimize recurring material shortages.
* Rejection & Material Disposition Management
* Ensure proper identification, segregation, tagging, and ERP recording of rejected materials.
* Coordinate with IQC and Purchase for rejection clearance, vendor returns, replacements, debit notes, and approved scrapping.
* Monitor rejection ageing and ensure timely closure.
* Follow up on replacement materials to prevent production delays.
* Ensure rejected materials remain segregated from usable inventory.
* Warehouse Operations, 5S & Safety
* Lead implementation and continuous improvement of 5S across warehouse and store operations.
* Ensure proper material identification, bin allocation, labelling, and FIFO practices.
* Maintain ESD-safe handling and storage of electronic components.
* Ensure Moisture Sensitivity Level (MSL) controls wherever applicable.
* Maintain warehouse hygiene, material safety, fire safety, and operational compliance.
* Conduct weekly 5S audits and implement corrective actions.
* Optimize warehouse space utilization and material movement efficiency.
* Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of six members, including the Store In-charge.
* Define responsibilities for GRN, material issuance, ERP posting, kitting, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct daily operational review meetings to monitor shortages, kitting status, rejections, and pending ERP transactions.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Train team members on Mi Cloud, BOM interpretation, material handling, ESD, 5S, and SOPs.
* Coordinate effectively with Purchase, IQC, Production, Engineering, and EMS partners.
* Drive operational discipline and continuous team development.
* MIS Reporting, Audits & Process Improvement
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering inventory, material shortages, kitting, GRN, dispatches, rejections, and stock ageing.
* Monitor operational KPIs and implement corrective measures where required.
* Develop, review, and implement stores and warehouse SOPs.
* Support internal, external, and customer audits.
* Drive process improvements to enhance inventory accuracy, material availability, and operational efficiency.
* Educational Qualifications
* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Operations or Supply Chain Management is an added advantage.
* Certifications in Inventory Management, Warehouse Management, ERP Systems, Lean Manufacturing, or Six Sigma are preferred.
* Technical Competencies
* Inventory Management: Expertise in inventory control, stock reconciliation, cycle counting, material traceability, and inventory optimization.
* ERP Operations: Strong hands-on knowledge of Mi Cloud, SAP, Oracle, Odoo, or equivalent manufacturing ERP systems.
* BOM-Based Kitting: Experience interpreting BOMs, managing material kits, approved alternates, and component substitutions.
* Electronics Manufacturing: Understanding of electronic components, PCB/PCBA materials, mechanical components, ESD controls, and EMS operations.
* Warehouse Management: Expertise in material storage, bin management, FIFO, warehouse layout, and stock movement.
* Material Planning: Knowledge of material requirements, shortage management, production planning coordination, and replenishment.
* Rejection Management: Experience handling IQC rejections, Return to Vendor (RTV), replacement tracking, and material disposition.
* Quality & Safety Practices: Understanding of 5S, ESD, MSL, warehouse safety, and process compliance.
* MIS & Reporting: Advanced MS Excel, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, dashboards, and operational performance reporting.
* Audit & Process Compliance: Experience with physical inventory audits, ERP reconciliations, SOP implementation, and corrective actions.
* Behavioural Competencies

**Leadership & People Management**

* Ability to lead, motivate, and develop store and warehouse teams.
* Strong delegation, performance monitoring, and team development skills.

**Ownership & Accountability**

* Demonstrates complete ownership of inventory accuracy, material availability, and operational deliverables.
* Takes responsibility for timely issue resolution.

**Planning & Organizing**

* Ability to prioritize multiple operational activities and meet manufacturing deadlines.
* Strong organizational and resource management capabilities.

**Problem-Solving & Decision-Making**

* Strong analytical thinking and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to resolve inventory discrepancies and operational challenges independently.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional teams, vendors, and EMS partners.

**Follow-Up & Escalation Management**

* Proactive approach to tracking shortages, pending deliveries, and rejected materials.
* Ability to escalate critical issues before they impact production.

**Attention to Detail**

* High accuracy in ERP transactions, stock records, BOM verification, and reporting.

**Result Orientation**

* Strong focus on inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and timely material availability.

**Adaptability & Stress Management**

* Ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively under production pressure.

**Continuous Improvement Mindset**

* Commitment to process standardization, warehouse improvements, 5S, and operational excellence.
* Experience Requirements
* 7–12 years of relevant experience in stores, warehouse operations, inventory management, or material control within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supervising stores and warehouse teams is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with ERP-based inventory management and stock reconciliation.
* Proven experience in BOM-based material kitting and coordination with EMS partners.
* Strong exposure to electronic and mechanical component inventory.
* Experience managing material shortages, rejection clearance, and warehouse audits.
* Candidates from EV, automotive electronics, electronics manufacturing, or EMS companies will be preferred.

title: Sr. Manager - Import Logistics
description:
**Job Role:**

The Manager – Logistics (Merchandising) will be responsible for managing import logistics, shipment documentation, customs clearance, freight coordination, and shipment cost control. The role will ensure regulatory compliance, timely delivery of merchandise, and seamless coordination between external logistics partners and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Prepare, review, and verify import documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, bills of lading, and certificates of origin.
* Validate shipment checklists and coordinate with Customs House Agents (CHAs) for necessary corrections and documentation accuracy.
* Verify HS codes, product descriptions, declared values, and other shipment details to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and CHA agents for smooth customs clearance and timely shipment delivery.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian customs regulations, import procedures, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor customs assessments, duty payments, and shipment clearance status to avoid delays.
* Verify freight charges, customs duties, handling fees, and other import-related expenses.
* Maintain shipment-wise cost records, import documentation, and supporting financial records.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for customs duty payments, freight invoices, and other import-related payments.
* Liaise with the Warehouse team to ensure timely shipment receipt, Goods Receipt Note (GRN) generation, and discrepancy resolution.
* Evaluate and select freight forwarders based on shipment origin, destination, delivery timelines, service quality, and cost optimisation.
* Track shipments proactively and resolve logistics-related issues to ensure timely and cost-effective movement of merchandise.

**Key Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, or a related field; relevant professional qualifications are an advantage.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in logistics, import operations, customs clearance, and freight management.
* Strong understanding of Indian customs procedures, HS classification, import documentation, and duty assessment.
* Proven experience managing CHAs, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners.

title: Offline Growth Manager (Remote)
description:
**Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?**

  
  

We are
**Emma – The Sleep Company**
. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.

  

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide.

  

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together.

  

**Ready to awaken your best with us?**

**What You'll Do**
You’ll own profitable same-store sales growth across Emma India’s existing experience stores. Working with franchise partners and store teams, you’ll identify what each location needs to grow and see those changes through on the shop floor. A dedicated expansion lead owns new store openings.
  
  

  
* Store performance: Set monthly sales plans with each partner. Review footfall, walk-in conversion, bill value and contribution to understand why a store is ahead or behind, then visit to test your diagnosis and track the result
  
* Local demand: Build a calendar of neighbourhood activities with store teams, from housing society mattress trials to customer referrals. Keep Google Business Profiles accurate and track which activities convert and justify their cost
  
* Conversion: Observe how customers try and compare mattresses, and coach teams on where sales are lost. Set up a simple follow-up routine for digital enquiries, booked visits and quotations
  
* Range and productivity: Use sales mix and lost-sale reasons to decide which mattresses each store displays. Work with supply and operations to close availability and delivery gaps, and test bundles for bill value and margin
  
* Franchise partners: Run regular business reviews covering sales, earnings and local marketing return. Pilot ideas in individual stores and roll them out when results hold
  
* Customer experience: Review ratings and complaints with store managers, trace recurring issues to the sales or fulfilment process, and check that fixes work
  
  
  

  
**Who We're Looking For**
  

  
* You have 2-5 years in retail growth, area sales or multi-store operations
  
* You can show how you improved sales or profitability in an operating store
  
* You’re comfortable with numbers and with analysing store data using Excel or Google Sheets
  
* You enjoy coaching on the shop floor and influencing franchise partners
  
* You’re happy to visit stores regularly
  
* You’re ready to travel a lot, around 2-3 weeks every month, to visit stores

  

**Become an Emmie**

  

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

 

  

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.

 

  

Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Head - Materials Management
description:
**Lead the team that keeps Hilti products available for customers across India.**

Department: Operations
  
  
Reporting to: Director - Operations
  
  
Team Size: 7 (on roll)
  
  
Base Location: Gurugram / Gurgaon, Haryana
  
  
Join us as Head – Material Management at Hilti India and take end-to-end ownership of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, inventory management and customs-clearance performance. You will lead the development of one integrated demand, supply and inventory plan that improves product availability, enables reliable customer fulfilment, optimizes working capital, and strengthens supply-chain resilience.
  
  
As a key member of the Operations leadership team, you will translate business priorities into executable material plans, drive cross-functional decisions and build a high-performing planning organization capable of anticipating demand and supply risks.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management and S&OP process to ensure optimal product availability, inventory productivity and customer serviceability
* Develop and maintain an integrated demand, supply and inventory plan by leveraging sales forecasts, market intelligence, customer insights and operational constraints.
* Lead the S&OP process that integrates demand planning, supply planning, and inventory management. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance to align demand and supply plans, optimize resource allocation, and ensure operational efficiency.
* Business strategy alignment: Collaborate with senior management to translate business priorities into material management strategies that improve serviceability, availability, working capital productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Lead the strategic flow of materials across Hilti locations in India, balancing stock availability, service levels, and inventory efficiency to ensure customer serviceability at optimized cost.
* Ensure efficient and compliant customs-clearance operations to support uninterrupted product availability and minimize avoidable supply chain costs.
* Build and develop a high-performing planning organization, driving continuous improvement, digitalization and data-driven decision-making across material management processes.
* Key Performance Indicators include forecast accuracy, material availability, inventory days / working capital, obsolescence, replenishment & supply reliability, cost optimization, continuous improvement, team capability & succession readiness

**What You’ll Bring**

* Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, MBA, or related field.
* Minimum 8-10 years of progressive supply chain experience, with minimum 4 years leadership responsibility for demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory management, and import or customs operations in a complex, multi-source business.
* Strong expertise in end-to-end planning, inventory optimization, forecasting, replenishment, ERP systems, and Lean practices.
* Strong commercial acumen, analytical decision-making, communication, and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced business environment.
* Proven ability to develop supply chain strategies, handle teams effectively, and lead, coach, and grow high-performing planning teams.

**What’s In It for You**
Known for our focus on providing fulfilling careers and a culture of Performance with Care, we are Ranked 19th amongst India’s Best Workplaces and 4th Among Asia’s Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work Institute® . Hilti India has also been recognized as one the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces for Millennials in 2024 by GPTW®.
  
  
**Why Hilti**
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
  
  
**Commitment to Inclusion**
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

The position will lead project procurement activities, manage the Design Engineering team, and supervise Project Coordinators located across India. The individual will serve as the central point of coordination between customers, suppliers, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and site teams to ensure successful delivery of crushing and screening projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales Support, Project Estimation & Technical Proposals

* Equipment supply
* Structural steel
* Chutes and material handling systems
* Electrical and automation systems
* Erection and commissioning activities
* Transportation and logistics
* Civil and infrastructure requirements
* Third-party vendor and subcontractor services

* Conduct technical and commercial risk assessments during bid evaluation.
* Participate in customer discussions, technical clarification meetings, and commercial reviews.
* Support preparation of budgetary quotations and capital cost estimates for greenfield and brownfield crushing and screening plants.
* Review project profitability and margin assumptions before proposal submission.
* Ensure lessons learned from previous projects are incorporated into future bids and estimates to improve estimating accuracy and project profitability.

* Lead end-to-end project management activities from order handover through commissioning and project closure.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation plans.
* Monitor project progress against scope, cost, schedule, and quality objectives.
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within approved budgets.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide regular performance reports to management.
* Manage project risks, mitigation plans, and escalation processes.
* Ensure smooth transition from sales handover to project execution.
* Project Procurement & Vendor Management
* Lead all project-specific procurement activities for assigned projects.
* Coordinate procurement of:
* Mechanical equipment like Gearboxes and conveyor accessories etc.
* Structural steel
* Electrical and instrumentation systems
* Automation systems
* Site services
* Contract labor and subcontractors
* Work closely with purchase and supply chain functions to ensure timely material availability.
* Evaluate vendor capabilities and participate in supplier selection processes.
* Monitor supplier performance, manufacturing schedules, and delivery commitments.
* Drive cost optimization and procurement efficiency initiatives.
* Minimize project delays arising from procurement bottlenecks.
* Design & Engineering Management
* Lead and manage the Design Engineering team supporting project execution.
* Ensure timely release of:
* General Arrangement (GA) drawings
* Plant layouts
* Structural drawings
* Fabrication drawings
* Equipment integration drawings
* Engineering documentation
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with customer specifications and industry standards.
* Coordinate design changes, engineering clarifications, and customer approvals.
* Drive engineering optimization for improved plant performance, constructability, maintainability, and cost control.
* Ensure effective collaboration between engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and site teams.
* Management of Project Coordinators
* Lead and mentor Project Coordinators for effective and intime deliveries.
* Establish project governance frameworks and reporting structures.
* Define individual performance objectives and development plans.
* Ensure consistency in project tracking, reporting, documentation, and customer communication.
* Facilitate effective coordination between regional offices, customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Build a high-performance project management organization capable of supporting business growth.
* Customer & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary customer interface during project execution.
* Conduct project kick-off, progress review, and project closure meetings.
* Manage customer expectations, scope changes, technical clarifications, and issue resolution.
* Develop strong customer relationships to enhance satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
* Coordinate with consultants, EPC contractors, and external project stakeholders.
* Financial & Commercial Management
* Monitor project budgets, cost performance, and profitability.
* Track project revenue recognition, invoicing milestones, and cash flow requirements.
* Manage project variations, claims, and change orders.
* Analyse project financial performance against original estimates.
* Drive margin improvement through proactive planning and robust project controls.
* Ensure commercial compliance with contracts and approved business commitments.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Implement project management best practices across all projects.
* Develop and improve project execution processes, templates, and reporting mechanisms.
* Standardize estimation models, procurement processes, and project controls.
* Capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications Experience:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.

* 15+ years of experience in project management within: Crushing & Screening, Aggregates, Mining Equipment, Mineral Processing Plants, Bulk Material Handling Systems
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams.

title: Manager LG Mortgage Asset Specialist, MSF
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Wealth and Personal Banking**
is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The bank primarily depends on the asset products (Mortgage, PIL, LAS, LAM, etc) to build its assets business. The assets business is extremely technical and with each region of India operating under different local regulations. Accordingly, The Branch assets specialist is a subject matter expert is needed for the fulfillment of asset product applications sourced by RMs building a support system to ensure seamless processing of these applications within the system.It involves interaction with various stakeholders both within HSBC and outside of HSBC ( Risk Team, Builders, Societies etc)
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Responsible for Asset product disbursals of the MSF Channel
* Back-end support to Branch RMs in the e-2-e process of sourcing to disbursal of any asset product applications.
* Effective co-ordination with internal & external stakeholders eg, CRU, CCR, INM, legal, etc…
* Regular monitoring of status of logged in applications.

**Leadership**
**& Teamwork**

* Developmental & coaching intervention for the Channel Partner
* Effective co-ordination with all stakeholders
* Identify cross-sell opportunities for other product lines and sell / refer these to the RMs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Discrepancy rates in applications
* Fraud control
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM WPB customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps need to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile, else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Role Dimensions**

* Primary responsibility for them is to help Relationship Manager achieve KPI targets by ensuring seamless asset product disbursals
* The incumbent would effectively carry the direct accountability for achieving assets disbursals of the Branch reporting directly into the BM.

**Qualifications - External**

* Graduate/Post Graduate (Masters)/ MBA with two to five years’ work experience

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India
