title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
  
  
For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

What We're Looking For
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.

*Тази длъжностна характеристика може да е била прегледана и подобрена с помощта на инструменти с изкуствен интелект с цел повишаване на нейната яснота, последователност и приобщаващ характер. Цялото окончателно съдържание, изискванията за длъжността и решенията за наемане остават предмет на преглед и одобрение от Aristocrat.*
**Философия на възнаграждението**
Предлагаме цялостен пакет от възнаграждения и придобивки, създаден да остане конкурентен на пазара, да подкрепя вашето благосъстояние и да признава приноса ви към нашия успех. Нашият подход се основава на принципа за възнаграждение според представянето, като насърчава и възнаграждава индивидуалния принос. Конкретният ви пакет на възнаграждение ще бъде определен въз основа на фактори като умения, опит, квалификации и местоположение.
  
  
В зависимост от вашата роля и местоположение може да имате право на годишни бонуси и стимули, придобивки за здраве и благосъстояние, платен отпуск, пенсионни планове, застрахователно покритие и други местни или законово установени придобивки.
  
  
Конкретни подробности относно възнаграждението и придобивките за тази позиция ще бъдат обсъдени по време на процеса на подбор.

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager-Ludhiana
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the
**International Wealth & Premier Banking team.**
**Job Introduction**
As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans.
  
  
You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions.

**Principal Responsibilities**
**HSBC Premier Relationship Manager**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products

**Client Management**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**
**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Industry Experience: More than 5 years of relevant experience.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.

* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licences and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

title: SIEM Knowledge Engineer
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.
  
  
Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
  
  
At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:
  
  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a skilled technical communicator with expertise in cybersecurity, SIEM software, and related technologies. In this role, you will serve as a critical bridge between development teams in India and documentation teams in the US, ensuring the delivery of clear, accurate, and user-focused product content.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a deep understanding of Securonix products, features, and enhancements.

* Create content that empowers customers to effectively deploy, manage, and succeed with our solutions.

**What You’ll Do & Achieve**

* Translate highly technical and complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for diverse audiences.

* Review and refine documentation to ensure technical accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Identify gaps in existing documentation and propose improvements based on user feedback and technical insights.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience as a Threat Intelligence Analyst, Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, Security Engineer, Threat Hunter, or related cybersecurity role.
* Proven hands-on experience with SIEM software, ideally Securonix SNYPR or Unified Defense SIEM (UDS), or tools such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Sentinel.
* Experience creating and using AI prompts to generate quality technical content.
* Proactive and self-motivated to seek information from various SMEs.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
* Proven ability to learn and master new products, tools, and technologies.

title: Paid Media Strategist
description:
Center of Excellence (COE)

**Paid Media Strategist**
-------------------------

Full-Time 7+ Years

Paid Media Strategist

**About Milestone**
  
Milestone Inc. is a leading Digital Experience Software and Services company dedicated to providing comprehensive solutions across all touch points that enhance customer engagement and drive business growth. Milestone mission is to pioneer the distribution and visibility of content with an innovative platform that drives discovery, personalized experiences, and conversions powered by data and AI. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture and commitment to excellence in everything we do.
  
  
**About Role**
  
As a Paid Media Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in designing, executing, and optimizing AI-driven performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital platforms.
  
You will lead strategic media planning, ensure campaign efficiency, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. This role requires hands-on expertise in Performance Max (pMax) and other AI-powered campaign types, coupled with a data-first mindset and a passion for innovation.

**Problems We Are Looking to Solve**

* How can we maximize performance and ROI using AI-driven automation in paid media campaigns?
* How can we integrate data intelligence to deliver smarter campaign decisions and personalization at scale?
* How can we transform traditional performance marketing into predictive, adaptive, and scalable media strategies?
* How can we create seamless collaboration between paid media, customer success, and analytics teams to enhance outcomes?
  

**Key Responsibilities -**
  
**Strategic Vision & Enterprise Leadership**

* Develop and execute AI-led paid media strategies that align with customer goals and Milestone's digital vision.
* Lead campaign innovation by leveraging Performance Max, AI bidding strategies, and cross-channel optimization.
* Translate business objectives into measurable campaign outcomes that drive brand and revenue growth.
  

**Operational Excellence & Scalable Growth**

* Manage end-to-end campaign setup, optimization, and reporting across Google, Bing, Meta, and programmatic channels.
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance to improve KPIs including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
* Implement automation and process standardization to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
  

**Innovation & High-Performance Culture**

* Integrate AI-driven tools, predictive analytics, and smart automation into campaign workflows.
* Stay ahead of emerging digital trends, new ad formats, and algorithm updates.
* Test and deploy new performance strategies, automation scripts, and AI agents to increase efficiency.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Alignment**

* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, analytics, and creative teams to align campaign execution with business goals.
* Participate in client meetings, presenting insights, results, and AI-enabled strategies.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to develop a unified and data-driven approach to campaign management.
  

**Customer-Centric Business Impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing actionable insights and measurable business recommendations.
* Ensure campaign strategies translate into tangible results that strengthen customer success and retention.
* Use data analytics and automation to deliver precision targeting and improved user engagement.
  

**Talent Cultivation & Empowerment**

* Share knowledge of AI-driven marketing best practices with peers.
* Contribute to process innovation and mentor junior media specialists on campaign excellence.
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
  
You are a data-driven performance marketer with a passion for innovation and AI integration. You excel at combining analytical depth with creative strategy to deliver measurable business outcomes. You thrive in fast-paced environments, love problem-solving, and are always seeking to experiment with new technologies that elevate campaign performance.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in Paid Media / Performance Marketing roles.
* Expertise in Google Ads (pMax, AI-driven campaigns) and Meta Ads; experience with Bing Ads and Programmatic platforms preferred.
* Strong understanding of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), attribution models, and data-driven decision making.
* Experience with automation, scripts, or AI agents is a strong advantage.
* Proven ability to deliver improved paid traffic efficiency and revenue growth.
* Excellent communication and client presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets.
* Flexibility to work in US time zones.
* Familiarity with tools such as Marin, Kenshoo, TradeDesk, or other DSPs preferred.
* Knowledge of SEM, SEO fundamentals, and keyword strategy beneficial.
  

**Key Focus Areas**

* AI-Powered Campaign Management
* Cross-Channel Paid Media Strategy
* Data Analytics and Automation
* ROI Optimization & Measurement
* Customer Partnership and Communication
  

**Capabilities**

* Strategic media planning and execution
* AI and automation integration
* Analytical decision-making and data interpretation
* Stakeholder management and communication
* Agile and outcome-focused mindset
  

**KPI and Metrics**

* Campaign ROI (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Conversion Rate)
* Efficiency gains through automation and AI
* Client satisfaction and retention scores
* Innovation in campaign execution and optimization
* Time-to-launch and overall campaign scalability
  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs
* A collaborative, innovation-driven work environment
* Career growth and AI-focused professional development opportunities
* Opportunity to shape the future of AI-led performance marketing in a global organization
  

**How to Apply**
  
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and vision for the role plus previous experience align with key attributes, responsibilities, clear wins or learnings.

**Why Milestone**
  
Founder Led, Award Winning Platform, Engaging Culture.

title: Assistant facility manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Assistant Facilities Manager
  
Work Dynamics
  
  
What this job involves
  
  
Delivery of Client Satisfaction
  
  
AFM will be responsible for managing all aspects of the facility management service delivery system at NTT DATA.
  
AFM is accountable for the achievement of all the key performance indicators.
  
Operations and maintenance, interface with senior managers in NTT DATA real estate / Facility team and business units.
  
Coordination with other key managers within NTT DATA and achieve customer satisfaction. Establish the vision and strategy of the account plan ensuring there is alignment with the client objectives and interests
  
Drive the account plan to deliver high quality results which exceed the client’s expectations. Become a reference for best in class service delivery that can be leveraged to expand Jones Lang LaSalle’s business. Recognizes opportunities for account growth, then articulate the value proposition and ensures its implementation across the platform.
  
Work with the client team, and leverages experts within the broader organization, to ensure exceptional results are delivered to the client, exceeding key performance indicators. Proactively solicits and responds to feedback and input from client
  
Establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect
  
  
Builds and Manages High Performing Teams
  
  
Oversee the operation, staffing, performance and development of the Facilities Management service delivery staff.
  
Ensure client satisfaction score achieved as per SLA
  
Have a seamless interface into NTT DATA Location Spoc.
  
Demonstrate leadership, responsiveness and creativity.
  
Understand the Facilities Management scope and develop client specific processes and procedures in consultation with Account Manager / Facility Manager and ensure implementation.
  
Support NTT DATA in the implementation of short and long-term projects.
  
Develop and implement the annual management plan; accomplish key performance indicators as identified by client.
  
Oversee compilation and deliver the appropriate monthly/quarterly/annual reporting.
  
Ensure compliance with JLL minimum audit standards.
  
Any other additional responsibilities assigned from time to time based on the client scope deliverables
  
Ensure Planned Preventive Maintenance activities are undertaken in accordance with the schedule.
  
Ensure implementation of Safe work practices
  
Implement regular inspections of the facility on energy conservation, maintenance practices, utility management, Housekeeping services, Maintenance of pest control, indoor plants and landscaping and building maintenance with risk management procedures.
  
Implement the pre-emptive maintenance program to reduce the risk of sudden failures of critical equipment
  
Provide training to on-site teams on equipment procedures and implementation.
  
Support service delivery teams on equipment maintenance and upkeep.
  
Conduct regular inspections to ensure that the procedures are being followed and updated as required.
  
Ensure labor & Statutory compliance are tracked and monitored from time to time for all monthly / quarterly audits.
  
Ensure all safety procedures, including Crisis Management/ Business Continuity and Emergency Procedures are maintained at all times.
  
Maintain Housekeeping equipment in all working conditions and apply all checks and control mechanism.
  
Ensure adequate control measures on all facility inventory for both engineering & soft services
  
Co-ordinate for all client events and hospitality management including overseeing cafeteria requirements.
  
Prepare / provide input to the site monthly report to be submitted to client.
  
  
Putting best practices in place
  
  
Teamwork should also be one of your strongest points, as you’ll work with a team to ensure that all performance targets set out in the contract are being met. To do this, you’ll develop tools that help measure the technical team’s performance on a quarterly or annual basis.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  
A technical hands on expert
  
An ideal candidate would have a university degree or professional qualification in engineering or facilities management, and over four years’ experience in facilities operation. A strong background in troubleshooting processes is a big plus.
  
  
Good communicator
  
Do you have an excellent command of spoken and written English language? Can you communicate technical issues to less able colleagues, clients and vendors? If you said yes to these, bring your ambition and explore our world of possibility.
  
  
Education and experience
  
BE/ Diploma in Electrical engineering with a minimum of 4 years experience as Facility manager
  
Implementation knowledge on ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001 would be an added advantage
  
Understanding of vendor management and AMCs
  
Good understanding of safety
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
**Additional Locations:** N/A

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Location****:**

Chennai & Pondicherry

**About the Position:**

Sells and promotes company products within a defined geographic territory by developing new accounts and expanding usage of company products by current accounts in an effort to meet a sales quota based on company sales goals and to directly increase sales revenue of the company.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

* Sells products by scheduling sales calls to meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

* Develops and implements sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.

* Develops action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of particular accounts and discussing issues with Regional Sales Manager to help the organization achieve its annual sales goals.

* Determines the needs (e.g., product and pricing), goals, product usage, and types of cases handled by specific customers by meeting with and asking in-depth questions of physicians and other hospital personnel to learn which Guidant products can best address their specific needs.

* Ensures clinical excellence by leveraging clinical, procedural, and product expertise to enhance credibility and provide solutions aligned with customer priorities and current & future needs. Observes actual procedures of the Interventional Cardiology and support in cath lab with imaging interpretation and rotablation techniques in the operating room of hospital accounts to gain insight into the specific nuances of each physician and each member of the lab staff.

* Establishes pricing packages by working with relevant personnel to establish price points that address specific customer's needs while satisfying company guidelines and policies.

* Responds to customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g. clinical research, pricing and/or marketing) to develop optimal solutions.

* Develops relationships with hospital personnel (e.g. through casual conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and to identify key purchasing decision makers in order to facilitate future sales.

**Requisition ID:** 638004

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. title: Product Compliance Engineer
description:
**JD for Product compliance Engineer**

·        You make compliance gaps, risks, and required actions visible and understood

·        You make sure compliance decisions are taken with a clear understanding of the risks and trade-offs

·        You bring compliance in early enough to shape decisions, so it never becomes a late-stage issue

·        Become the general quality resource for individual projects

You’ll know where AI adds value and where compliance judgment needs to lead. title: Senior Deal Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
We are seeking a Deal Strategy Analyst to quarterback complex, high-value customer deals for Global and Enterprise accounts in the Technology and Financial Services sectors. This role partners closely with Sales and Customer Success to navigate sophisticated contract negotiations, manage technical and commercial complexities, and ensure successful deal closure while protecting company interests.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience with Salesforce and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), a strong grasp of enterprise deal dynamics, and deep familiarity with complex contract structures common in Technology and Financial Services. This individual will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales and Customer Success teams—quarterbacking deals from initial requirements through close, navigating intricate commercial and legal requirements, identifying and mitigating risk, and ensuring alignment across Seismic teams while maintaining deal momentum on high-stakes transactions.
  
  
This role requires a highly organized, strategic, and detail-oriented professional with strong business acumen who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder deal environments. The ideal candidate can manage ambiguity in enterprise negotiations, think strategically about commercial structures, demonstrate sound judgment in navigating nuanced situations, and drive deals forward while managing competing interests across internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 5+ years of experience in Deal Strategy, Enterprise Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, or similar roles supporting large, complex customer deals.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Salesforce and comfort with complex opportunity management.
* Experience with CPQ tools and end-to-end enterprise sales processes; familiarity with contract-to-cash workflows.
* Strong understanding of enterprise pricing models, discount structures, and multi-stakeholder approval processes.
* Ability to review and interpret complex commercial agreements, Statement of Work structures, and technical requirements.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguity and competing interests.
* Excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and unwavering follow-through on commitments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and collaborate across all organizational levels.
* Ability to manage multiple complex, concurrent deals with competing demands and tight timelines.
* Ability to build credibility and influence with Sales leaders, executives, and cross-functional teams; comfortable navigating political and organizational dynamics.
* Ability to balance adherence to company policies and guidelines with sound judgment, flexibility, and strategic thinking in enterprise deal contexts.
* Shift timings : 2.30 AM to 11.30 AM shift, time zone aligned to Australian business hours

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Quarterback enterprise deals from opportunity discovery through contract signature and onboarding, serving as the central coordination point for Sales and Customer Success teams and ensuring alignment with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations.
* Lead strategic discussions on deal structure, commercial terms, implementation approach, and pricing models; use Salesforce and CPQ to create comprehensive quotes and proposals that reflect complex, multi-product configurations and sophisticated commercial arrangements.
* Conduct thorough discovery and due diligence on enterprise opportunities; surface technical, commercial, and contractual requirements early; identify gaps and risks that could impact deal closure.
* Validate pricing, discount structures, and commercial terms against policy and company risk tolerance; identify non-standard requests and negotiate favorable positions while maintaining strong customer relationships.
* Lead negotiations on complex commercial structures, including volume tiers, usage-based pricing, multi-year arrangements, professional services bundles, and sector-specific considerations common in Technology and Financial Services.
* Manage the approval process for large deals, engaging stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations; proactively manage timelines and escalate blockers to leadership to keep deals on track.
* Drive deal momentum by proactively managing timelines, orchestrating cross-functional collaboration, anticipating obstacles, and maintaining clear communication with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and customers throughout the sales cycle.
* Identify quoting, pricing, configuration, or workflow issues and bottlenecks; partner with appropriate teams to resolve them and implement streamlined solutions that minimize future manual effort.
* Escalate strategic issues and complex decisions to Deal Strategy leadership and business stakeholders; contribute business case analysis and recommendations to inform decision-making on high-value opportunities.
* Serve as the primary interface between Sales, Customer Success, and cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Product); facilitate alignment and resolve conflicts that could jeopardize deal closure.
* Ensure all deal documentation, commercial terms, contract language, Salesforce data, and approvals are accurate, complete, and properly communicated prior to booking and customer handoff to Customer Success.
* Manage concurrent large enterprise deals while maintaining focus and attention on each account's unique complexities and strategic importance.
* Maintain comprehensive and accurate deal records, including commercial terms, contract language, approvals, and contingencies within Salesforce and supporting systems.
* Identify patterns and best practices in successful enterprise deal closure; share insights and recommendations with the Deal Strategy team to inform process improvements and knowledge-sharing across the function.
* Support the development and maintenance of Deal Desk playbooks, sector-specific guidance, and best practices for navigating complex Technology and Financial Services deals.

**What we have for you:**

title: Technical Support Specialist I
description: OverviewThe L1 Technical Support Specialist provides front-line remote and telephonic technical assistance for critical security screening equipment, including baggage X-ray systems and trace detection products (e.g., ETD/BPI/RTT systems). This role focuses on basic L1 troubleshooting, customer/Field Engineer guidance, accurate part number identification using technical documentation, and efficient issue escalation to ensure maximum security checkpoint uptime.Responsibilities Level 1 Technical Support & Basic Troubleshooting Provide initial diagnostic and troubleshooting assistance over the phone and via remote access tools for baggage X-ray systems and Trace detection equipment. Diagnose basic hardware, software, power, and mechanical issues, Password issues including: X-Ray Systems: Conveyor belt jams, basic software crashes, power supply issues, image display artifacts, and operator interface errors. Trace Detection Products: Basic sample inlet/calibrator errors, clearing standard system alarms, flow rate/gas line issues, and basic sensor/detector warnings. Guide operators and Field Service Engineers (FSEs) through basic resolution steps, such as performing power cycles, running system self-tests, verifying cable connections, adjusting basic image settings, and clearing basic system jams. Part Identification & Schematic Lookup Analyze technical manuals, exploded-view diagrams, schematics, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to accurately identify correct replacement part numbers for X-ray and Trace product lines. Assist field personnel and customers with part identification to prevent order errors and minimize equipment downtime. Escalation & Documentation Log and track all incoming incidents in the ticketing system (CRM), maintaining clear records of symptoms, basic steps taken, and diagnostic results. Recognize when an issue exceeds L1 scope (e.g., complex generator failure, trace spectrometer calibration issues, deep network integration) and escalate promptly as per escalation matrix with complete case details. Customer Service & Compliance Deliver clear, concise instructions to both technical (FSEs) and non-technical (checkpoint operators, airport security) personnel under high-pressure security environments. Stay current on technical product updates, service bulletins, and basic regulatory requirements for checkpoint screening. Technical Skills Product Familiarity: Basic understanding of X-ray imaging components (conveyors, generators, detectors) and Trace Detection technologies (ETD). Part Lookup: Demonstrated ability to read technical diagrams, assembly drawings, and schematics to isolate correct part numbers. Systems & Networking: Solid grasp of basic computer hardware, OS navigation, remote access tools, and fundamental networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity). Soft Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong customer-first orientation. Strong active listening skills to de-escalate urgent situations in critical operational environments. High organizational skills and ability to manage multiple open support tickets effectively. Working Conditions This is a 5-day working role with 2 rotational offs. Must be comfortable working in rotational shifts to support global operations. Preference will be given to candidates who can align their schedules to cover key business hours in time zones like GMT and PST. Qualifications Education: Associate degree or vocational certification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience. Experience: 3-4+ years of experience in technical support, helpdesk, or field service—preferably supporting security screening, medical imaging, or trace detection systems.

title: Service Desk Specialist
description:
**Our Global Structure**
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
  
  
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our ET Service Desk is a global, 24x7 team that acts as the first line of defence for Deliveroo’s internal technology, supporting employees across offices, care vendors, and remote locations worldwide. We work closely with Workplace Tech, Security, IAM, Networks and application owners to resolve issues end-to-end, escalating only when something is outside our tools, access or expertise.
  
  
The team handles everything from access management for core platforms to device, basic networking and collaboration tooling issues, following robust runbooks and service management practices.
  
  
We are a collaborative, metrics-driven group that continuously improves our knowledge base, processes and automation to deliver a consistently great experience for our internal customers.
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Service Desk Specialist**
to join our
**Service Desk**
team located in
**Hyderabad**
. In this role, you will be owning complex tickets from first contact through to resolution and coordinating incident response for high-impact issues. You’ll troubleshoot across Google Workspace, macOS, Windows, ChromeOS, MDM, Slack and core internal tools, using your depth of experience to unblock users quickly and safely.
  
  
Beyond BAU support, you’ll lead and contribute to the improvement of the projects, refine playbooks, and mentor other analysts to uplift the overall capability of the Service Desk.
  
  
Get to know our
**Service Desk**
team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
  
  
**Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like**

* Be the first point of contact in Operations, helping people resolve problems and delivering an excellent customer experience in a 24x7 environment.
* Take ownership of standard and complex technical issues, diagnosing, researching, tracking, and resolving them.
* Collaborate with colleagues across our global team to share knowledge and solve problems.
* Escalate and coordinate incident response for critical issues affecting the firm.
* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, user accounts, trading environments, operating systems, and mobile devices.
* Look for opportunities to improve how we work and share your ideas with the team and management.

**What You’ll Need To Thrive**
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
  
  

* A passion for customer service and a commitment to delivering an outstanding support experience.
* More than four years of experience in IT Operations, IT Support, or Technical Support, working directly with users.
* A strong interest in technology and how it helps our people deliver for Deliveroo.
* Experience supporting Google Workspace (G Suite), macOS, Windows 10 and above, and MDM tools such as Mosyle and Intune.
* Experience in technical support within a growing technology company, bringing an understanding of effective service delivery.
* The ability to contribute to and lead projects that match your expertise, while guiding colleagues and sharing your knowledge.
* A collaborative approach, with experience mentoring, training, or creating knowledge resources for your team.
* Flexibility to work morning, afternoon, and night shifts as part of a 24x7 service desk supporting Deliveroo’s global business.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed**
We’d love to hear from you if you have exposure to or experience with some of the following, you don’t need to know them all:
  
  

* Productivity and collaboration: Google Workspace (G Suite), Slack, and Google Workspace admin tools.
* Operating systems and devices: iOS, macOS, Windows 11, and ChromeOS.
* Device management: MDM tools such as Mosyle and Microsoft Intune.
* Service management and reporting: Jira Service Management (JSM), Data Studio, and Looker.
* Networking and access: An understanding of networking fundamentals and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Meeting room technology: Supporting audiovisual (AV) and video conferencing systems, particularly Google Meet.
* Service delivery: Familiarity with ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
* Relevant professional certifications are also welcome.

**Why Join Us?**
At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
  
  
We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To
  
  
**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale**
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
  
  
🌱
**See your impact, fast**
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
  
  
environment.
  
  
**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership**
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
  
  
**🌎A culture built for builders**
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  
  
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 2-3 stages.
  
  
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
  
  
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
  
  
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
  
  
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

* Exceptional communication skills for effective collaboration and presentation to stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong customer service management skills, including the ability to use personal initiative and be a self-starter.

* Working experience with Microsoft 365, including MS Teams, Outlook and other MS products.

* Good knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP).
* AI Tools (Claude & ChatGPT) proficiency.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service orientation and Interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL Foundation knowledge (certification preferred).
* Any of these certifications CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft certifications (e.g., MSCE/MSCA).
* Experience with remote support tools and MDM/endpoint tools (Company portal and Jamf).
* Understanding of incident management and SLA concepts.

**Key Skills and Competencies:**

* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in fast paced environments.
* Quick learner and self-disciplined.
* Should be a good Team player.

customer communication history.

enablement, and post-change validation.

weekends, and public holidays as part of the operations support schedule.

This position supports service channel operations across South and West India, coordinating external service providers, managing technical escalations, and driving service performance through data analysis and process execution. * Prepare dashboards, presentations, and management reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Support onboarding, governance, compliance activities, and technical training for service providers and field teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering and 6+ years of experience in technical service support, service operations, field service, or medical device service environments.
* Experience troubleshooting and supporting medical capital equipment or related healthcare technologies.
* Experience managing customer escalations, technical inquiries, and service issue resolution.
* Experience coordinating external service providers, channel partners, or field service organizations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, data analysis, and operational reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting ventilators, patient monitors, cautery systems, surgical drills, debriders, or similar medical devices.
* Experience managing third-party service providers within a medical technology environment.
* Knowledge of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) and Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) processes and commercial service operations.
* Experience with Power BI, automation tools, or artificial intelligence-enabled process improvements.

title: ST - Telco-Aria Billing Cloud -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – Senior – Telecom Billing Analyst**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
* Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O – SCM Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a
**Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations – Supply Chain Management Manager**
to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the stability and effectiveness of our D365 F&O system in the supply chain domain. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions and improve process outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in inventory management, procurement and sourcing, sales and marketing, warehouse management and asset management functions within D365 F&O, helping clients streamline operations and achieve operational excellence.
  
  
**Important - This role requires working in US hours to support clients effectively.**
***Working hours: 3rd Shift (5:00 PM - 2:00 AM)***
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert support and consulting for D365 F&O Supply Chain modules (Inventory Management, Procurement and Sourcing, Sales and Marketing, Warehouse Management, Asset Management).
* Provide priority support for high severity cases identifying options to get past the initial issue and deliver the necessary long-term solution. Collaborate with internal teams and clients as needed for deliver root cause analysis for these cases.
* Monitor and respond to incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Evaluate reported issues to identify where they stem from and work with the necessary team to resolve. This includes but is not limited to customer specific code, Crowe Metals Accelerator (CMA) and Microsoft functionalities.
* Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period-end/year-end business activities.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F&O.
* Continuous self-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O
* Strong functional knowledge of D365 F&O SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Product Information Management, Warehouse Management).
* Microsoft certifications for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.
* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting integrations between D365 SCM and 3PL, shipping carriers, or EDI platforms.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and distribution best practices.
* Experience with multi-entity or global deployments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience managing business transformation and debottlenecking projects.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Good functional knowledge of D365 F&O SCM Asset Management

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About This Role**
The Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace is responsible for the day-to-day delivery of IT support services to internal employees and business functions across India and the EMEA region. IT Field Engineers at EMEA sites report into this role, making it accountable for field engineering coverage, standards, and service quality across the region.
  
  
In addition to site service delivery, this role is the operational service owner for the digital workplace across the global KGS tenant, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings. Ownership means day-to-day service quality, user support, adoption, and migration delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations
  
  

* Supervise daily IT support operations, including incident handling, service requests, and problem resolution across the supported sites in India and EMEA.
* Monitor and track service desk performance metrics (ticket resolution time, backlog, first-contact resolution) to ensure adherence to SLAs.
* Serve as an escalation point for operational issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams.
* Provide day-to-day direction and support to service desk analysts, desktop support staff, and IT Field Engineers across the region.
* Provide team leader support for collaboration and coordination of workflow, process, and guidance to other team members.
* Implement process improvements and standard procedures to increase efficiency and consistency.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams (infrastructure, applications, security) to support service delivery needs.
* Maintain documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Contribute to regular reporting on service performance for internal stakeholders.

Digital Workplace Services (Global)
  
  

* Own the day-to-day service quality of the digital workplace and collaboration services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings.
* Apply the Teams and SharePoint standards set by the governance and cyber security teams to provisioning, naming, lifecycle, external sharing, and guest access requests.
* Execute license assignment and group membership changes for digital workplace services within approved access policies, escalating exceptions to the policy owner.
* Lead migration and consolidation work, including file share and legacy platform migrations into SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
* Drive adoption and change management through training, champion programs, and communications that raise usage and reduce support demand.
* Monitor tenant health, service advisories, and roadmap changes; assess impact and communicate upcoming changes to the business.
* Action information protection, retention, and eDiscovery requests as directed by the cyber security, compliance, and legal owners.

Service, Incident & Vendor Management
  
  

* Use ITIL Service Request, Incident, Problem, and Change Management principles to complete and reduce tickets in the ITSM tool.
* Prioritize incidents and service requests and ensure timely escalation to third-level support groups to enable resolution within SLA.
* Lead major incident coordination during India and EMEA hours and hand off cleanly to the IT Service Delivery Regional Manager (Americas).
* Engage in Problem Management by tracking and analyzing recurring problems and providing proactive communications on remediation steps.
* Support vendor coordination for routine operational issues (e.g., hardware replacements, software support).
* Partner with the IT Service Delivery Regional Manager (Americas) to keep standards, tooling, reporting, and escalation paths consistent across locations.

**Regional Team Leadership (India & EMEA)**
Lead the IT Field Engineering team across EMEA, with field engineers at regional sites reporting directly into this role.
  
  
Set goals and performance expectations for the regional team, hold regular one-on-ones, and build skills development and succession plans.
  
  
Own the EMEA coverage model, including staffing levels, shift and holiday scheduling, on-call rotations, and after-hours support for critical operations.
  
  
Standardize field engineering practice across EMEA sites so device builds, comms-room standards, onboarding, and escalation paths are consistent from site to site.
  
  
Manage regional managed service provider and contractor performance against contracted service levels, driving remediation where targets are missed.
  
  
Contribute to regional IT budget planning for support staffing, end-user hardware, and site services, tracking spend against plan.
  
  
Site Support (Assigned Site)
  
  

* Support the site with best-in-class service, delivering a reliable end-to-end IT experience for employees, site leadership, and visiting executives; as needed, support both Site leadership and IT Site leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with the Site Leader and functional managers, translating business priorities into IT plans and project commitments.
* Represent site and user needs to the Site Leader, IT Business Relationship Managers, and global IT leadership.
* Support the Site Leader on IT readiness for audits, business continuity exercises, and site-level projects such as moves, expansions, and manufacturing changes.
* Track digital workplace licensing consumption, flagging right-sizing and consolidation opportunities to the platform and finance owners.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 8 years' experience in IT support or service operations.
* Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft 365 digital workplace and collaboration workloads: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, with hands-on Incident, Problem, and Change Management experience in an ITSM tool.
* Experience leading or supervising technical staff across multiple sites, countries, and time zones.
* Able to work onsite at the assigned KGS site in India.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.
* Flexible schedule to accommodate overlap with the Americas and Europe and occasional on-call needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader modules highly desirable.
* Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or Teams Administrator Associate.
* Deep knowledge of ITSM tools (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Ivanti).
* Solid understanding of enterprise IT environments (hybrid cloud, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, endpoint management).
* Experience delivering SharePoint Online migrations and file share consolidation at enterprise scale.
* Experience deploying and supporting the wider Microsoft productivity stack (Viva Engage, Loop, Planner, Project, Visio, Forms, Bookings, Stream).
* Working knowledge of desktop support and endpoint management (Intune, SCCM).
* Experience supporting a manufacturing or distribution site, including IT/OT coordination.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to translate technical issues into business impact.
* Strong customer service orientation, displaying professional standards.
* Keen attention to detail in delivering quality service.
* Analytical mindset, using data to drive decisions and improvements.
* Able to work autonomously and follow direction as provided.
* Highly self-motivated; actively seeks development opportunities.
* Able to manage conflicting priorities and maintain calm under pressure during incidents.
* Coaches and develops others, building capability within the team.
* Works effectively with vendors and managed service providers.
* Collaborates as an equal partner with peers in other locations, sharing standards across time zones.
* Ability to lead projects and/or support roles.
* Challenges the status quo and drives improvement.

Strong organizational and task management skills in a fast-paced support environment.
  
  
**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.
