title: Specialist Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**Specialist Infrastructure Engineer**
**The Opportunity**
Based in Hyderabad, joining a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
  
  
Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
  
  
Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
An Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and supporting the infrastructure that enables an organization's IT systems and services to run smoothly. This includes working with hardware, networking, virtualization, cloud environments, and security systems to ensure the organization's IT infrastructure is efficient, reliable, and scalable. Infrastructure engineers often work closely with software engineers, IT support teams, and system administrators to optimize performance, mitigate risks, and deliver high-quality services to end-users.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Manage the design, procurement, installation, upgrading, operation, control, maintenance, and effective use of specific technology services.
* Follow standard approaches and established design patterns to create new designs for systems or system components. Apply agreed standards and tools to achieve a well-engineered result.
* Carry out and also improve system software development and maintenance tasks by updating the product design to automate routine system administration tasks using standard tools and software development practices.
* Contribute to identification and prioritized adoption of Technology Engineering community practices within the products where you work.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the Product manager.
* Participate in Product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with Product goals.

**What Should You Have**

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience working with network and system administration for Linux/Unix and Windows servers.
* Experience with traditional disaster recovery & data backup solutions (Commvault, Acronis).
* Cloud and Virtualization Platforms Proficiency in virtualization (Vmware, Hyper-V, Nutanix) and familiarity with cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) platforms.
* Networking Understanding of virtual networks, VPNs, and firewalls.
* Operating Systems Knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Scripting and Automation Skills in scripting languages like Bash or PowerShell and familiarity with infrastructure automation and management tools (Ansible, Terraform).
* DevOps practices Experience with Git, infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Security Best Practices Familiarity with IT security practices and compliance.
* Problem-Solving Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Product and customer-centric approach.
* Experience with other programming languages (Python, Java) is a nice to have.

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.
  
  
**Primary Skills**
AWS Cloud, Infrastructure Engineering, Linux Administration, Windows Server Administration, CI/CD Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure Automation, Terraform, Ansible, Bash/PowerShell Scripting, Networking (VPNs, Firewalls, Virtual Networks), IAC and AI tool (copilot etc.)
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Containers (Docker, Kubernetes), Azure, Python, VMware, AWS Certifications.
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
Additional location(s) Compensation Information
  
  
**Required Skills**
Amazon Web Services (AWS), Bash Scripts, CI/CD, C Shell Scripting, Firewalls, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure Administration, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Infrastructure Building, Linux System Administration, Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Microsoft Copilot, Shell Scripting, Terraform, Virtual Networking, Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), Windows Server Management
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Docker Container, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, Python (Programming Language), VMware

description:
**Role Overview**

The primary responsibility of this role is to secure sponsorships and brand partnerships for TOT's original events and event properties. The individual will be responsible for identifying potential sponsors, pitching sponsorship opportunities, negotiating commercial agreements and closing sponsorship deals.

In addition, the individual will drive corporate business development by acquiring clients looking for corporate event planning, management and execution services.

**About Microcare**

* Microcare is an enterprise technology solutions company. We provide, implement, and manage both the hardware and the software our clients run their businesses on, across four practices:
* Enterprise infrastructure — compute, storage, networking, and data centre build-out, as an authorised HP and HPE partner
* Cloud — migration, workload modernisation, and managed cloud operations Cybersecurity — security architecture, implementation, and managed security services
* Software solutions — enterprise application selection, licensing, implementation, and support
* We do not just resell and we do not just advise. We scope the solution, deliver it, and stay accountable for it running. Our clients are mid-market and large enterprises across India, in both the commercial and public sectors.
* We are building our commercial enterprise sales engine, and hiring a founding cohort of three business development executives to build it with us.

**The Role**

* You will own the front end of Microcare’s enterprise sales pipeline. Your job is to find companies that need what we build, reach the people who decide, earn the first conversation, and hand a qualified opportunity to your Senior Sales Manager.
* This is not an account management role on day one. It is a role where you learn enterprise selling by doing the hardest part of it — starting conversations from zero — and then grow into owning accounts. We have written that path out below, and we mean it.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

**Prospecting and research (40%)**

* Build and maintain a target account list within your assigned segment (industry vertical and revenue band assigned at onboarding)
* Research each account for buying signals across all four practices: expansion and new facilities, IT leadership changes, funding rounds, compliance and audit mandates, end of-life hardware refresh cycles, security incidents, publicly announced digital or ERP initiatives, hiring patterns that reveal a technology programme underway
* Map the full buying committee with verified contact details. Infrastructure and security decisions sit with the IT Head, CIO, CISO, and Head of Infrastructure. Software and cloud decisions increasingly originate with a business-function owner — Finance, HR, Operations, Plant Head — with IT as approver rather than initiator. You are expected to work both paths.

**Outbound engagement (40%)**

* Run structured multi-channel outreach: cold calls, email sequences, LinkedIn
* Hit a daily and weekly activity floor (defined in your first week, reviewed monthly as you ramp)
* Handle objections, gatekeepers, and rejection without losing momentum
* Log every touch accurately in CRM — pipeline hygiene is part of the job, not admin overhead

**Qualification and handoff (15%)**

* Qualify opportunities against a defined framework: current environment, pain, budget authority, timeline, competing incumbent
* Write a clean handoff brief and transition the meeting to your Senior Sales Manager
* Attend the meetings you set — you learn the second half of the sale by watching it happen

**Deal support (5%)**

* Assist on proposal and RFP documentation, quote coordination with hardware OEM distribution and software licensing partners, and follow-up cadence on open opportunities

**Growth Path**

Stage - Timeline - What Changes

**BDE**
— Ramp Months (1–3)

* Training, certifications, shadowing. Activity targets only.

**BDE**
— Full Months (4–12)

* Own segment, full activity and qualified meeting targets, pipeline contribution measured.

**Senior BDE**
- Months (12–18)

* Larger accounts, own discovery calls independently, mentor the next cohort.

**Account Manager**
- Month 18+

* Own named accounts end-to-end, including revenue and renewals.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Mall Marketing Executive – Job Description**
**Position Title:**
Mall Marketing Executive
**Department:**
Marketing & Operations
**Reports To:**
Marketing Manager / Mall General Manager
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Mall Marketing Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring marketing initiatives that drive footfall, enhance tenant relationships, and strengthen the mall's brand presence within its catchment area. This role bridges creative campaign development with operational execution, working closely with tenants, vendors, and internal teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
The role involves developing and implementing the mall's marketing calendar, including seasonal campaigns, promotional events, and tenant collaboration activities designed to increase visitor traffic and dwell time. The executive coordinates with tenants and brand partners to align promotional activities with mall-wide initiatives, ensuring consistent messaging and maximizing mutual benefit.
  
  
Managing social media channels, digital advertising, and content creation falls within this role, along with tracking engagement metrics to refine strategy. The executive also oversees on-ground event execution, from concept approval through vendor coordination, logistics, and post-event evaluation.
  
  
Budget management is a core function, requiring the executive to plan marketing spend across campaigns, negotiate with vendors and media partners, and report on return on investment to senior management. Building and maintaining relationships with local media, influencers, and community organizations supports broader brand visibility efforts.
  
  
The role also includes conducting competitor and market analysis to identify trends, benchmark mall performance against comparable properties, and recommend strategic adjustments. Regular reporting on footfall data, campaign performance, and tenant satisfaction feeds into quarterly business reviews with mall ownership or management.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
A bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field is typically required, with two to five years of relevant experience in retail marketing, mall operations, or a similar consumer-facing environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, along with proficiency in digital marketing tools, social media platforms, and basic analytics reporting.
  
  
Key Skills
  
  
Successful candidates typically demonstrate strong project management abilities, creative thinking balanced with commercial awareness, negotiation skills for vendor and tenant interactions, and comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms is advantageous.

title: Director, Content & Creative Services
description:
****Description****
**Who is USP?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
****Brief Job Overview****
USP is seeking a Director, Content & Creative Services to source content into compelling, customer-centric digital experiences. The role will build the operating model, creative standards, workflows, technology, and partner ecosystem needed to produce reusable video, audio, articles, social content, infographics, email modules, campaign assets, and internal training at speed and with consistent quality.
  
  
This role will
**build and scale USP’s Digital Studio**
, with a strong focus on:
  
  

* Content atomization strategy and studio operations
* Multiformat digital production and creative quality
* Cross-functional governance, distribution, measurement, and reuse

Working across Scientific Affairs, Education, Global Communications, Digital Marketing, Industry Programs, regional teams, and external partners, this leader will turn high-value source material into coordinated content journeys that expand customer knowledge, strengthen thought leadership, improve engagement, generate leads, and support measurable business and education outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The following are the main responsibilities for the Director, Content & Creative Services
  
  

* Digital Studio Strategy & Operating Model
* Establish the vision, roadmap, service model, and annual plan for USP’s Digital Studio and content atomization capability.
* Build a scalable operating model that progresses from agency-supported pilot to a sustainable insourced center of excellence.
* Define intake, prioritization, briefing, production, review, publishing, and reuse workflows.
* Translate enterprise priorities and customer needs into a focused studio portfolio and production roadmap.
* Content Atomization & Multiformat Production
* Turn webinars, seminars, expert presentations, education programs, and other source assets into coordinated suites of reusable content.
* Lead production of short-form video, audio and podcasts, articles, social posts, infographics, email snippets, campaign modules, and internal training.
* Ensure each asset is audience-relevant, channel-appropriate, accessible, on brand, and designed for reuse across the customer journey.
* Apply AI-enabled and digital production tools responsibly to improve speed, consistency, versioning, and scale.
* Creative Direction, Quality & Governance
* Set creative direction, production standards, templates, and quality controls across video, audio, design, and digital content.
* Partner with scientific and communications owners to preserve scientific accuracy while making complex topics clear and engaging.
* Embed brand consistency, accessibility, rights management, and SMRP/PMRC requirements into studio workflows.
* Maintain review discipline, version control, and production documentation for every deliverable.
* Agency, Technology & Studio Operations
* Select, brief, and manage agency and production partners against clear scope, quality, timeline, and budget expectations.
* Own studio capacity planning, production schedules, vendor performance, and investment decisions.
* Define requirements for video and audio editing, design, recording, collaboration, and digital asset management tools.
* Build repeatable processes and internal capability that reduce one-off effort and improve time to market.
* Cross-Functional Activation & Content Reuse
* Lead collaborative planning with Scientific Affairs, Education, Industry Programs, Global Communications, Digital Marketing, and regional teams.
* Convert shared priorities into actionable creative briefs, channel plans, and coordinated content packages.
* Enable distribution across USP-owned channels, the Education LMS, webinars, email and Marketo nurture, social platforms, regional channels, and the USP Store.
* Promote systematic tagging, storage, discovery, adaptation, and reuse through the content library and digital asset management ecosystem.
* Measurement, Learning & Scale
* Define and report studio KPIs, including throughput, reuse, engagement, views, leads, education impact, conversion contribution, and production efficiency.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve formats, workflows, channel activation, and investment choices.
* Document pilot results, codify lessons learned, and scale successful approaches across topics, regions, and business priorities.
* Present studio performance, risks, recommendations, and roadmap decisions to senior leadership.

****Note:****
As part of the recruitment process, USP's Global Talent Acquisition team may contact candidates through a variety of communication channels, including Microsoft Teams, telephone, email, and WhatsApp (voice calls and text messages). These communications may be used to schedule interviews, provide updates on application status, discuss career opportunities, and answer questions about employment with USP.
  
  
To help ensure timely communication, candidates are encouraged to keep their contact information current and to engage only with individuals who clearly identify themselves as authorized USP representatives. USP will never request payment, banking details, or other financial information as part of the hiring process.
  
  
****Fraud Alert:****
USP is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment fraud. Legitimate employment-related communications will come only from authorized USP representatives. If you are unsure whether a communication is authentic, please verify it through USP’s official careers website before sharing personal information.
  
  
**Who is USP Looking For?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital media, design, journalism, business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in digital content, creative services, studio operations, content marketing, or integrated production.
* 7+ years leading teams, agencies, vendors, or multidisciplinary production operations.
* Demonstrated success building or scaling a content studio, center of excellence, or high-volume content production capability.
* Strong portfolio of multiformat work spanning video, audio, design, editorial, social, email, and campaign content.
* Experience translating technical or complex subject matter into clear, audience-relevant digital experiences.
* Expertise in creative operations, production planning, agency management, budgeting, briefing, and quality assurance.
* Proven ability to lead across a global, cross-functional, matrixed environment and influence senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, brand governance, content rights, review workflows, digital asset management, and performance measurement.

****Additional Desired Preferences****
Desired preferences include highlighting any additional preferred levels of expertise for the role—reminder: items listed here are not requirements and do not disqualify a candidate from consideration.
  
  

* Experience in scientific, healthcare, education, standards, or another regulated or technically complex environment.
* Deep expertise in:
* Content atomization and modular content strategy
* Video, audio, visual design, editorial, and social production workflows
* Digital asset management, metadata, and enterprise content reuse
* Familiarity with:
* AI-enabled content tools, marketing automation, analytics dashboards, webinar and recording platforms, and creative design suites
* Experience launching a new capability, managing an agency-to-insource transition, or operating within a global center of excellence.

****Supervisory Responsibilities****
Yes, 1 report (Content Strategy Lead)
  
  
****Benefits****
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Campaign Operations and Management
  
  

* Define and own the campaign management standard: the lifecycle from request to close, required

statuses and sync, and the definition of done at each stage. Keep it current, set the bar for best-inclass and measure compliance.
  
  

* Build the reference implementations that production and agents work to: program and campaign

templates, tracking and status patterns, and QA checklists.
  
  

* Stay hands-on in the platforms: set up, track and manage complex or high-visibility campaigns,

troubleshoot sync, tracking and data issues, and act as the expert escalation for MAT. MAT is
  
  
responsible for the quality and quantity, and the COE owns the accountability.
  
  

* Collaborate with MAT to monitor live campaigns for tracking integrity, and run post-campaign reviews

that feed back into the standard.
  
  

* Automate campaign setup, tracking and QA wherever patterns are stable, building out use cases for

the agentic roadmap.
  
  
Operating Model and Governance
  
  

* Own the campaign operations operating model across GTM Ops: stage ownership, handoffs, decision

rights, escalation paths, and one published ownership map across the vertical teams, Brand, Web,
  
  
Events, Paid Media, MAT and the COE.
  
  

* Publish operational KPIs and measure practice against the standard.
* Own marketing intake: the brief, the readiness criteria and the gate that stops incomplete requests

before work starts. Lead triage, prioritisation, SLAs and routing our COE team.
  
  
Workflow, Automation and Cross-Functional Partnership
  
  

* Own and improve the campaign operations workflow from intake through delivery, including

readiness criteria, routing, status visibility, QA points, and handoffs across MAT, MOPs, Web,
  
  
Events, Paid Media and Sales Ops.
  
  

* Partner with platform and process owners across Marketo, Salesforce, Asana, event platforms,

web/forms, paid media and sales-facing tools to ensure campaign workflows are clear, connected
  
  
and aligned to data, consent, routing and attribution standards.
  
  

* Identify recurring blockers, manual steps and quality risks in campaign delivery, then turn them into

playbooks, templates, workflow improvements or automation opportunities.
  
  

* Pilot practical automation and agentic workflow use cases where patterns are stable, such as

campaign setup support, intake completeness, tracking QA, status monitoring, self-serve guidance
  
  
and reporting.
  
  

* Measure automation and workflow improvements against simple baselines, including time saved,

accuracy, adoption, escalation rate and impact on campaign quality.
  
  

* Recommend when to build, configure or research external capabilities, while partnering with the

appropriate system owners for technical validation and implementation.
  
  
Enablement, Change and Improvement
  
  

* Build and maintain SOPs, playbooks and training, and lead operational readiness for process and

platform changes across globally distributed teams.
  
  

* Report on cycle time, SLA attainment, request readiness, rework, standards compliance and

automation impact, and use the data to prioritise improvement.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Campaign management craft and standard-setting
  
  

* Operating model and process architecture
* Multiplatform fluency
* Agentic and automation design with sound controls
* Analytical rigour with honest

baselines
  
  

* Influence without authority across senior stakeholders and time zones
* Clear writing and

change leadership
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 10+ years in marketing operations, campaign operations, program management, business operations

or process excellence, including leading a large-scale process transformation with measured adoption.
  
  

* Hands-on design and operation of intake, workflow and automation in Asana or an equivalent

enterprise work management platform.
  
  

* Hands-on experience setting up, tracking and managing campaigns end to end in a marketing

automation platform (Marketo preferred) and Salesforce, including programs, campaign and member
  
  
statuses, tracking and attribution, plus working knowledge across the wider martech ecosystem.
  
  

* Built and run automations in production, including AI-agent or LLM-enabled workflows, with an

understanding of their risks and controls. Evidence of your own builds is welcome. Experience with
  
  
globally distributed teams.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Event, web, CMS, forms, chat and sales engagement platforms; Power Automate, n8n or Make, and APIs
  
  
or scripting; Adobe Analytics or Salesforce reporting; Lean, Six Sigma, PMP or Asana certification; B2B
  
  
software, ideally with nonprofit, education or healthcare familiarity.
  
  
Strategic Impact
  
  

* Turns campaign execution from knowledge held in individual conversations into a visible, repeatable

and increasingly automated model.
  
  

* Frees senior MAT capacity for quality, strategy and enablement, and gives leadership trusted visibility

into capacity, risk and delivery

title: Area Retail Sales Manager -ARROW
description:
**Company Description**
Arvind Fashions Limited is a leading lifestyle company in India, offering one of the widest portfolios of fashion brands across categories and price points. With roots in Arvind Ltd, India’s largest integrated textile player, the company combines a strong heritage with contemporary brand-building expertise. It introduced Arrow as one of the first international fashion brands in the country and continues to expand a future-ready portfolio that includes premium and luxury global brands. Its products are sold through over 1,300 standalone stores, around 5,000 departmental and multi-brand outlets in more than 192 cities and towns, as well as through its own e-commerce platform NNNOW.COM and leading online marketplaces. * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Management, or a related field; relevant experience in apparel or lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Comfort working on-site, with flexibility to travel within the assigned territory as required.

, and associated integrations and business workflows.

* Manage operational service requests and access requirements.

* Track vendor cases and escalations through resolution.
* Support periodic user access reviews and internal audit activities.
* Maintain SOPs, production runbooks, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, and support documentation.
* Participate in KT sessions and production-readiness activities for new functionality and platforms.
* Support critical retail events and high-volume business periods as required.
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, transaction validation, monitoring, and operational processes.
* Participate in rotational weekday shifts and weekend/on-call production support.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 4–6 years of production support/application operations experience.
* Experience supporting retail, POS, payment, eCommerce, or hospitality technology platforms.
* Experience with or strong knowledge of retail/POS transaction workflows.
* Experience troubleshooting APIs, integrations, transaction failures, and application logs.
* Understanding of payment-processing workflows.
* Experience with Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience with production deployments and release validation.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, GitLab/GitHub, and CI/CD processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Platform Skills**
Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable
  
  

* Salesforce POS
* Adyen Payments
* InfoGenesis
* BentoBox
* Retail/POS platforms
* Payment gateways/processors
* REST APIs and third-party integrations

**Additional Preferred Skills**

* Understanding of payment authorization, capture, refund, settlement, and reconciliation processes.
* Experience supporting high-volume retail/POS environments.
* Experience coordinating with SaaS and technology vendors.
* Monitoring and observability experience.
* Basic SQL and scripting/automation knowledge.
* ITIL/ITSM knowledge.

Key Success Measures
  
  

* Retail and POS platform availability
* Payment-processing reliability
* Incident SLA adherence
* Successful production deployments
* Reduction in recurring transaction failures
* Timely vendor issue resolution
* Operational readiness during critical retail events
* Audit and access-management compliance
* Increased automation and proactive monitoring

\*\*Comfortable with rotational shifts (includes night shifts as well)\*\*

title: Deputy Manager Import Export Operations
description:
**About BASF In India**
BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2024, BASF had 2,411 employees in India with 8 production sites and 42 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2024, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.4 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in.
  
  
**Objectives of the Position**

* Lead and manage end-to-end customs clearance operations for both imports and exports.
* Ensure pre- and post-transaction compliance under the Customs Act, Foreign Trade Policy, and all applicable Allied Acts and Rules for Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Human and Animal Nutrition, Agricultural, and Food Products.
* Analyze and implement changes in customs laws and EXIM regulations, including those under allied legislations, ensuring timely communication and compliance across the organization.
* Strategize and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process notes for various customs-related transactions to ensure consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Handle customs audits, investigations, and represent the company before customs and regulatory authorities.
* Maximize duty savings and export incentives through strategic planning, accurate classification, and leveraging available trade benefits.
* Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders—including business units, customs brokers, 3PLs, consultants, and regulatory bodies—to ensure smooth execution of customs and trade operations.
* Supervising Ongoing and Pending Litigation under Customs, Foreign Trade, Excise and Other Regulations.

**Main Tasks**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end customs operations related to import and export transactions, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
* Ensure clearance lead times and other KPIs are consistently met for all import and export activities.
* Identify, monitor, and ensure compliance with applicable provisions under Customs and Allied Acts and Rules for all cross-border transactions.
* Develop, implement, and audit SOPs and process documentation for customs operations to ensure adherence and continuous improvement.
* Draft or review responses to queries raised by Customs, DGFT, and other government authorities, including matters related to classification, valuation, and license/NoC applicability.
* Provide expert guidance on technical and operational matters related to customs and foreign trade regulations.
* Review and validate product classification, duty rates, and exemptions, including those under Free Trade Agreements (FTAs).
* Ensure compliance for related-party imports, including the management of NIL investigation reports and maintenance of SVB order status.
* Monitor and coordinate responses to notices, show cause notices, deficiency letters, and litigation matters; attend hearings and approve legal submissions.
* Administer audits under various indirect tax frameworks such as CERA, OSPC/PBA, EA 2000, and legacy service tax laws; manage investigations from DRI, DGCEI, and other enforcement bodies.
* Drive the application, maintenance, and compliance for AEO T3 certification, ensuring alignment with CBIC guidelines.
* Lead the implementation of new initiatives focused on duty/tax savings, regulatory compliance, and digital transformation of customs processes.
* Support audits (statutory, tax, IFC, internal) by providing reconciliations, contingent liabilities, tax demands, and revenue recognition data.
* Manage export-import incentive schemes including Advance Authorization, EPCG, RoDTEP, IGST refunds, and Duty Drawback (AIR/Brand Rate/Section 74).
* Conduct training and awareness sessions for internal stakeholders on customs and trade compliance requirements.
* Liaise effectively with customs, DGFT, and other regulatory authorities to resolve operational and compliance issues.
* Generate and maintain MIS reports on legal matters, incentives, and compliance metrics for internal and external reporting.

**Minimum Education And Qualification Required For The Position**
**Education and Working Experience:**

* Post graduation and Law Graduate / Diploma in Taxation law
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in customs, foreign trade, and indirect taxation, preferably in the chemical, Agro , pharmaceutical, Nutrition sectors.
* Proven track record of managing end-to-end import/export operations and customs compliance.
* Experience in handling audits, investigations, and litigation under Customs, DGFT, and other allied regulations.
* Hands-on experience with incentive schemes such as Advance Authorization, EPCG, RoDTEP, and Duty Drawback.
* Exposure to working with government authorities including Customs, DGFT, DRI, and other regulatory bodies.

**Technical & Professional Knowledge:**

* In-depth knowledge of the Customs Act, Foreign Trade Policy, and allied acts and rules (Hazardous Waste, Drugs & Cosmetics, FSSAI, Animal Quarantine etc.
* Strong understanding of product classification (HSN), valuation principles, and duty structures including FTA benefits.
* Proficiency in handling customs documentation, ICEGATE, DGFT portals, and SAP (EXIM module preferred).
* Knowledge of audit frameworks PBA and tax litigation procedures.
* Familiarity with AEO certification processes and compliance requirements.
* Experience of Handling Investigations – DRI, SIIB etc.
* Experience of Handling Litigation Management – Drafting Replies, Liasoning with Legal Attorneys etc. Attending PH & Representing Company.
* Experience of Handling Incentives Management.

**Core skills:**

* Regulatory Compliance: Ability to interpret and apply complex customs and trade regulations.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong skills in analyzing duty structures, classification, and compliance risks.
* Leadership & Team Management: Capable of leading cross-functional teams and mentoring staff.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting replies, reports, and stakeholder coordination.
* Decision-Making: Sound judgment in resolving classification, valuation, and regulatory issues.

**Job-related preferred skills:**

* Strong stakeholder management skills, including coordination with internal departments, service providers, and government agencies.
* Ability to develop and implement SOPs and conduct internal audits/health checks.
* Training and capability-building experience for internal teams on customs and EXIM matters.
* Familiarity with international trade practices and global compliance standards.
* Experience in digital transformation projects related to customs and trade compliance.

**Travel**
**required for the position:**

* Visits to various customs ports. Customs Offices, DGFT and Other Government Offices

description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President (AVP) / Vice President (VP) – Legal

**Company:**
Equentis wealth advisory Services Limited

**Department:**
Legal & Compliance

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Company -**
Equentis Wealth Advisory Services Limited is a SEBI registered Investment Advisor, Portfolio Manager, Alternative Investment Fund and acts as distributor of third-party financial products. Equentis has more than 65000 subscribers in the investment advisory side and managing AUM of more than 150 crore in PMS and more than 200 crores under its AIF. The Company is in the process of further expansion by setting up offices in the GIFTCITY and in Dubai and obtaining Insurance Broking license.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute legal professional at the AVP/VP level to lead end-to-end transaction documentation, fund formation legalities, and commercial contracting. The ideal candidate will act as a strategic business partner, independently managing legal drafting and negotiations across Alternative Investment Funds (AIF), Portfolio Management Services (PMS), and Investment Advisory (IA) verticals, alongside general corporate and investment transactions.

The role will directly report to Chief Operation and Compliance Officer of the Equentis Group.

**1. Fund Formation & Regulatory Registrations (AIF, PMS, IA)**

* Draft, review, and negotiate fund formation and onboarding documentation, including Private Placement Memorandums (PPMs), Trust Deeds, Investment Management Agreements (IMAs), Contribution Agreements, and Side Letters for AIFs.
* Lead legal documentation and structuring required for SEBI registrations and ongoing compliance across
  **AIF, PMS, and IA**
  licenses, including Client Agreements, Disclosure Documents, and Advisory Agreements.
* Liaise with SEBI, trustees, custodians, merchant bankers, and external legal counsels during fund launches, scheme filings, and regulatory inspections.

**2. Investment Transaction Documentation**

* Independently draft, structure, and negotiate definitive transaction documents for fund investments and corporate deals, including Term Sheets, Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Shareholders’ Agreements (SHA), Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), and Debenture Subscription Agreements (DSA).
* Conduct and oversee legal due diligence on target companies, identify red flags, and structure conditions precedent (CPs) and conditions subsequent (CSs) to mitigate commercial and regulatory risks.
* Manage deal closings, cap table reconciliations, and post-closing compliance filings (including FEMA/RBI reporting for cross-border investments).

**3. Commercial & Operational Contracting**

* Draft, vet, and negotiate day-to-day operational and commercial contracts, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Vendor Agreements, Distribution Agreements, and Technology/SaaS Licensing Agreements.
* Standardize contract templates and playbooks to streamline turnaround times for internal business, procurement, and distribution teams.

**4. Litigation management**

* Handle pre-litigation notices, cyber security complaints, dispute resolution, and coordination with external litigation counsels when required.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  LL.B. from a recognized university (LL.M. or CS qualification is an added advantage).
* **Experience:**
  8 to 12 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) with a strong background in a reputed law firm (PE/VC, Funds, or Corporate M&A practice) and/or in-house legal team at an AMC, AIF, Wealth Management, or Financial Services firm.
* **Domain Mastery:**
  Proven hands-on expertise in drafting and negotiating SHAs, SSAs, SPAs, PPMs, and PMS/IA client documentation.
* **Regulatory Acumen:**
  Deep working knowledge of SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, Indian Contract Act, Companies Act, and FEMA.

**Core Competencies**

* Sharp commercial acumen with the ability to balance legal risk against business objectives.
* Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and redlining skills with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple high-stakes transactions simultaneously under tight timelines.
* Strong stakeholder management skills to interface effectively with regulators, institutional investors (LPs), founders, and senior leadership.

title: Legal Associate
description: About UsResollect builds software for banks and asset reconstruction companies to manage loan recovery and the legal process around it. When a loan goes unpaid, lenders have to work through a great deal of paperwork and legal steps to recover what they're owed, and our tools help them do that faster and more reliably.Role: Legal AssociateApply here: https://helios.resollect.com/apply/legal-associateThe RoleWhen a bank or an asset reconstruction company (an ARC, a firm that buys bad loans from lenders and works to recover them) needs to know whether a loan file will hold up, someone has to read it closely and give a clear answer. As our Legal Associate, that someone is you: you'll carry out legal due diligence on banking and loan documents, own each matter through to sign-off, and write the findings note that our clients and our legal operations team act on.One day you're working through a loan agreement and its sanction letter, the next you're tracing a title chain with a gap in it, and the day after you're reviewing an intern's file or helping our legal ops team on a recovery matter.This is modern legal work, not paper-pushing. Our AI tools read the documents first, pull out the key terms and flag issues, and your job is to verify that work, catch what the tools missed, and apply the judgement that only a careful lawyer can.What You'll Do• Review banking and loan documents: You'll carry out legal due diligence on loan agreements, sanction letters (the lender's letter approving a loan and setting its terms), security and mortgage documents, title papers and notices.• Check what the AI finds, and what it doesn't: You'll verify the terms and issues our AI tools extract and flag, and catch anything they missed, so nothing reaches a client unchecked.• Own each matter to sign-off: You'll take every file you're given all the way to a final sign-off, which means the conclusion on that matter is yours.• Write the findings note: You'll write the final note on each matter that the client or our legal ops team acts on, so it has to be clear, accurate and ready to use.• Take on the harder files: You'll handle the matters that need real judgement, such as defective security, title chains with gaps in the ownership history, and files with missing documents.• Review interns' work: You'll review the work of our legal interns as they join, acting as the second pair of eyes on their files.• Support recovery matters: You'll support our legal ops team on recovery matters under SARFAESI (the law that lets secured lenders enforce their security without going to court first) and Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act (the law that makes a bounced cheque a criminal offence).What We're Looking For• A completed law degree: You'll need an LLB or BA LLB already in hand, because you'll be signing off legal findings that others rely on.• Fresh graduate to two years in: Fresh graduates are welcome, as is anyone with up to about two years of experience, and you don't need Bar enrolment or court practice since this work is about documents rather than appearances.• A careful reader of dense documents: You'll do well here if you enjoy reading long legal and financial documents slowly and properly, and you notice the clause, date or signature that doesn't quite fit.• Hands-on review experience: You've already done real document review, due diligence or drafting, whether in internships or a first job, so you know what a thorough check looks like.Nice to Have (Not Required)• Banking law knowledge: Some familiarity with banking law, SARFAESI or Section 138 will help you get up to speed on our matters faster.• Time on a relevant legal team: Experience at a law firm, a bank, an NBFC (a non-banking financial company that lends money) or an ARC legal team will make our files feel familiar.• Comfort with AI tools: It helps if you're already at ease working alongside AI tools and checking what they produce.Why This Might Be Worth Your Time• Real ownership from the start: Even early in your career, you'll take matters through to sign-off and write the note that decides what happens next.• Judgement over paper-pushing: Because our AI tools handle the first read, your time goes on the thinking: verifying, questioning and catching what a machine can miss.• The interesting files: You'll be the one handed the defective security and the broken title chains, which is where you learn the most.• Responsibility for others' work: Reviewing our interns' files means you'll be trusted as the person who checks the work, not just the one who does it.Where and WhenThis is a full-time role based in our Mumbai office in Marol, working in office six days a week.If you're the kind of person who reads every line of a document, enjoys untangling a messy file, and wants to own your conclusions, we'd love to hear from you, so please apply.

title: Legal Intern
description: Legal InternAbout UsResollect is a Mumbai-based startup fixing how debt recovery works in India. Precise, clean legal English.Solid research skills on SCC Online, Manupatra or similar.Obsessive attention to detail. A wrong date or section number in a notice matters.AI-curious. You're interested in using AI to draft, review and research faster, and in checking its work critically.Organised and reliable with deadlines and follow-ups.Nice to Have (Not Required)Prior internships in banking, debt recovery, litigation or a law firm's banking & finance teamExposure to DRT or magistrate court proceedingsHindi or Marathi (useful for notices and local coordination)Why This Might Be Worth Your TimeYou'll get hands-on with recovery law that most law students only read about.You'll see how legal-tech is built, and help build it.You'll work directly with the founder and legal team, on real client matters.Strong performers have a real shot at a full-time role.If you like precise drafting, want to see banking law in action, and are curious about where AI fits into legal work, we'd like to meet you.This is a paid internship.Location: Mumbai (Andheri), in-office

* Manage and coordinate assigned (within the wider Insurance and Incident Management Team) Major Incidents and Shipment Incidents from initial notification through stabilization, investigation and resolution.
* Undertake early assessment to identify potential operational, cargo, vessel, liability, insurance and legal exposures.
* Coordinate with relevant internal functions and external stakeholders to establish an appropriate incident response and claims strategy.
* Arrange and coordinate surveyors, experts, correspondents and external counsel where required.
* Support evidence preservation, investigations, surveys, documentation and fact gathering.
* Coordinate incident-related stakeholder communication and ensure timely escalation of significant developments.
* Support loss mitigation, recovery opportunities and appropriate allocation of incident-related costs.
* Participate in emergency response and provide out-of-hours support in accordance with the team's 24/7 incident response arrangements.
* Maintain appropriate case documentation, records and reporting throughout the lifecycle of the incident.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned incidents and claims matters.
* Maintain effective relationships with internal business functions, insurers, clubs, brokers, surveyors, experts, correspondents and legal counsel, as applicable.
* Provide clear, timely and practical guidance to stakeholders throughout incident and claims handling.
* Promote effective collaboration across the integrated Insurance & Incident Management function.

Process & Capability Development
  
  

* Contribute to continuous improvement of incident and claims processes, procedures and controls.
* Participate in GEMBA, knowledge-sharing and cross-training activities.
* Support development of broader incident and insurance capability across the team.
* Identify recurring issues, trends and opportunities for process improvement, loss prevention and cost reduction.

Key Accountabilities / Measures of Success
  
  

* Timely and effective response to incidents and claims.
* Clear end-to-end ownership of assigned matters.
* Appropriate and timely insurance notification and escalation.
* Quality and accuracy of claims assessment, documentation and case records.
* Effective stakeholder communication, coordination and responsiveness.
* Appropriate mitigation of exposure, costs and identification of recovery opportunities.
* Compliance with agreed processes, controls and reporting requirements.
* Contribution to team capability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Primary Stakeholders
  
  

* Fleet Management
* GRM
* MIAS
* Marine Insurers (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances)
* Maersk Maritime law

Knowledge & Experience
  
  

* Any Graduate with 5+ yrs of Experience within marine claims, marine insurance, shipping, incident management or a related discipline.
* Good understanding of marine operations and H&M insurance principles.
* Ability to assess complex incidents and distinguish between potential H&M, P&I, contractual and other exposures.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to make sound decisions in time-sensitive and high-pressure situations.
* Comfortable working across functions and coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

The Legal Counsel will be responsible for providing end-to-end legal support to the Bank across corporate, commercial, lending, regulatory, and dispute matters. The role involves drafting and vetting documentation, advising business units, mitigating legal risks, managing litigation, and ensuring compliance with banking laws and regulatory guidelines .The role will also involve assisting senior team members/segment heads and Vertical heads in any deals/matters being referred.
  
  
**SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE**
**Responsibilities**
**KPIs**
**Strategy and Planning**

* The counsel is expected to partner closely with business, risk, compliance, credit, and operations teams to facilitate transactions while safeguarding the Bank’s interests.

Early-stage involvement to advise on optimal deal structures (secured/unsecured, syndicated, bilateral, escrow, guarantees).
  
  
Align the transaction structure with the bank’s risk appetite, regulatory conditions, and security enforceability.
  
  

* Develop standardized templates for facility agreements, security documents, pledge deeds, mortgages, and inter‑creditor arrangements to reduce TAT.
* Interpret RBI Master Directions, circulars, KYC/AML rules, Embed legal safeguards into product features in relation to setting up/launching of new products or structuring any deals including drafting/vetting and negotiating all contracts, agreements and other documentation.
* While negotiating with third parties/lawyers orsettling non standard documents/client documents for new products ensure that the interest of the Bank is protected from a legal perspective
* Map critical cases in DRT, NCLT, High Courts, consumer forums, arbitrations, criminal complaints.
* Prioritize high-value exposures, reputationally sensitive matters, and systemic risks.
* Ensure meeting up with TAT as a single contributory or that of a team

**Advisory ,Policies, Processes & Procedures**

* Helping business lines and function structure transactions, products, contracts, set up procedures along best practices, negotiate arrangements and legal terms with third parties, resolve legal problems, and propose and advise on solutions that help the business lines complete their transactions/resolve issues within the bank’s operational/legal framework.
* Assist the General Counsel/Corporate Legal Head /seniors in compliance with Bank legal policies and assist in setting up, where necessary, relevant local legal policies and procedures to reflect specific legal requirements of India.
* Ensure that all transaction/Document is in consonance with Applicable Law and/or Policies and Process as stipulated by the Bank.
* Any policy renewals for other stakeholders/LRM to be reviewed, updated and adhered to
* Advise on substantive legal issues and questions of law.
* Provide legal advice and support as required generally by business teams and other functions like human resources, finance, compliance etc.
* Advise and support businesses in relation to the structuring, negotiation and execution of third-party agreements entered into by relevant legal entities within India
* Develop standard agreements and templates together with legal guidelines for products and documentation as appropriate and keep such documentation and guidelines updated.

**Stakeholder Management**
**In Consultation With Team Leads And Seniors**

* Highlight the consequences and liabilities to the stakeholders/management so as to ensure that calculated calls are taken
* Primary responsibility will be to provide support and legal advice to Large Corporates/Wholesale Banking/Structured deals/Trade Finance/Transaction Banking Products/Recovery Teams/IBU etc
* Provide legal advice and support and transaction management services for all Bank business activities.
* Provide general advise to the Bank branches, subsidiaries and affiliates, as required, on legal issues arising from the organization and management of the relevant legal entities within India including corporate structure governance and operations.
* Regular coordination and joint meetings with stakeholders to ensure that any teething issues are resolved.
* Maintain harmonious and cordial rapport with stakeholders.

* Monitor trends in the regulatory and statutory environment for their impact on an organization and suggest an action plan for addressing them.
* Keeping abreast with latest legal developments.
* Monitor legal developments which may affect the businesses especially bank business operations and provide appropriate legal advice and support in relation to such issues.

**Cost Management**

* Endeavour to prepare/draft documents or address legal issues in house without any dependence on external counsels or law firms.
* Ability to draft bespoke documents/communications/Policies, Processes etc.

**Dispute Resolution and Litigation**

* Manage Disputes, Co-ordination and follow-up with outside legal counsels and drafting of Complaints, Replies, Misc Applications, Affidavits etc. in Civil as well as Criminal litigation matters including Recovery of debts.

title: Lead - Contract Administration
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - Contract Administration is responsible for executing plans, negotiating contract terms, and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations. The Lead oversees the preparation, review, and modification of contracts, and works closely with project managers and other stakeholders to ensure that contracts are aligned with project goals and timelines. Additionally, the Lead provides guidance and support to team members to ensure efficient contract management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Oversee Contract Management:**
Lead the management and oversight of entire process of contract preparation, review, and modification and ensure that all contracts are executed accurately and within the required timelines by drafting contract terms, coordinating with relevant departments for input, and ensuring that all necessary approvals are obtained before finalizing contracts.
  
  
Develop and support business plans related to contracts, focusing on efficiency and effectiveness.
  
  
Possess expertise in various contract types, including fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, time and materials, and performance-based contracts.
  
  
Apply knowledge to manage and modify contracts according to their specific structure.
  
  
**Research And Analysis**
Undertake comprehensive research on market trends, best practices, and benchmarks relevant to contracts and service delivery. Oversee the preparation and processing of Non-Financial Assessments (NFA), ensuring all necessary documentation is complete and accurate.
  
  
Gather data and insights to support decision-making processes for Service Development and Contract Managers.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring And Reporting**
Monitor, collate, and analyze contract performance information, producing detailed reports to track contract compliance and effectiveness.
  
  
Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards, presenting data in a clear and actionable format for management review and decision-making.
  
  
Prepare and submit financial documents as required by the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA), ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory timelines.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance And Risk Assessment**
Ensure that all contracts comply with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as company policies and procedures and monitor compliance with contractual obligations and address any issues promptly to avoid legal or financial repercussions.
  
  
Analyze risks associated with specific contract terms, providing recommendations for mitigation strategies.
  
  
**Tender Management**
Assist in the preparation and submission of tenders by accurately identifying the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and defining the scope of work, ensuring clarity for potential contractors.
  
  
Manage the contractor selection process by floating tenders, facilitating negotiations with bidders, and verifying all submitted documentation for compliance ensuring selection of qualified contractors who meet project requirements effectively.
  
  
**Claim Management**
Oversee the management of claims related to contracts, ensuring they are resolved in a timely and efficient manner.
  
  
Coordinate with relevant departments and legal teams to assess, negotiate, and settle claims while minimizing financial and operational impact.
  
  
**Letter Writing And Communication**
Review and finalise professional letters and official communications related to contract administration.
  
  
Ensure all written communications align with organizational standards and effectively convey necessary information to internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Maintain a strong communication channel with stakeholders to ensure transparency and clarity throughout the contract management process.
  
  
**Dispute Resolution**
Monitor project activities to identify potential disputes early and facilitate open communication among stakeholders.
  
  
Lead mediation sessions, ensuring adherence to contractual terms, maintaining thorough documentation and conducting post-resolution analyses to enhance future processes.
  
  
**Performance And Quality Systems**
Support the implementation of performance and quality systems across area teams, facilitating consistent monitoring and improvement of contract-related activities.
  
  
Collaborate with stakeholders to establish clear performance and quality standards, ensuring these metrics are effectively measured and adhered to, thereby promoting compliance and enhancing overall project outcomes.
  
  
**Brand Protection And Image Promotion**
Promote and protect the company’s brand and image, advising colleagues on appropriate use and representation.
  
  
Ensure timely payments to contractors and vendors, maintaining positive relationships and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Regularly assess and recommend modifications or renewals of contracts based on project requirements and performance evaluations.
  
  
Collaborate with internal teams to identify sources for labour, machinery, and materials, enhancing operational efficiency.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Management**
Advise on and deliver workforce development initiatives necessary for the successful implementation of contracts.
  
  
Organize and hire relevant personnel for contract execution and devise development plans for key team members.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Head - Contract Administration
  
  
Project Teams
  
  
Procurement Department
  
  
Legal Team
  
  
Finance Department
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Vendors/Suppliers
  
  
Clients/Customers
  
  
Regulatory Bodies
  
  
Consultants
  
  
Auditors
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Law, Finance, or a related field.
  
  
**Certifications**
Project Management Professional (PMP)
  
  
Certified Contract Manager (CCM)
  
  
**Work Experience**
12+ years of experience in Contracts Administration or a related field.

title: Business Analyst - Application Support
description:
TITLE
  
  
Senior Business Analyst - Application Support
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a Senior Business Analyst within the Application Support team, you will serve as the functional subject matter expert for Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR). You will own the end-to-end analysis and resolution of complex client issues, translate reinsurance business needs into effective application solutions, and drive continuous improvement in service quality and product performance. Working closely with clients, functional consultants, Product, Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will act as a trusted advisor, support releases and change initiatives, mentor less-experienced analysts, and help ensure strong customer outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide expert-level functional support for DCR and own complex client issues end-to-end, serving as the primary functional escalation point. Lead impact assessment, prioritization, investigation, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resolution validation, and closure.
* Elicit and analyze client requirements and translate them into functional specifications, configuration recommendations, defect reports, or enhancement requests aligned with reinsurance business objectives.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, functional consultants, and external partners to resolve issues, manage risk, and ensure timely follow-through.
* Lead or support functional configuration, test planning and execution, release readiness, deployment validation, and post-release stabilization for DCR updates, patches, and enhancements.
* Monitor incident trends, case aging, service-level performance, and application health indicators; implement improvements that strengthen reliability, support efficiency, and the client experience.
* Develop and maintain functional guides, troubleshooting procedures, known-error records, and knowledge articles; lead problem-management reviews for recurring or high-impact issues.
* Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor by clearly communicating impacts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead regular client follow-up meetings to provide assistance, review backlog priorities, and deliver timely updates throughout the full lifecycle of client-reported issues and tickets.
* Coach and mentor less-experienced analysts, review complex cases, and promote consistent support standards and share knowledge across the team.
* Maintain current expertise in DCR functionality, reinsurance industry practices, IT service management, and emerging support technologies.
* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers/ Reinsurance to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Insurance, or a related field with an analytical focus; equivalent relevant experience may be considered
* 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in application support, business analysis, enterprise software, or insurance technology, with demonstrated success owning complex client issues
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional investigation and resolution of production support issues and communicating with client stakeholders
* Working knowledge of reinsurance business processes and enterprise application support practices
* Experience applying incidents, problems, change, and release management practices in a production environment

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR) or a similar reinsurance administration platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, and service management or case-management platforms
* ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies in application support and product environments

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Advanced functional analysis and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex application and business-process issues independently
* Strong knowledge of DCR functionality, configuration concepts, and reinsurance workflows, or the ability to rapidly build deep product expertise
* Proven end-to-end case ownership, prioritization, judgment, and accountability in high-impact client situations
* Strong requirements elicitation, process analysis, and functional documentation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable solutions
* Ability to interpret system behavior, configuration, logs, data, and performance metrics to support root-cause analysis and informed decision-making
* Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and release management practices
* Experience with enterprise software testing, user acceptance testing, release cycles, deployment validation, and post-release support
* Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive issues to timely resolution
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor communication for technical, non-technical, client, and executive stakeholders
* Trusted-advisor mindset with the ability to manage expectations, explain risk, and recommend practical solutions
* Ability to mentor analysts, review case quality, facilitate knowledge transfer, and strengthen team capability
* Strategic and continuous-improvement mindset; ability to use trends and service metrics to identify opportunities and implement improvements
* Strong organization, resilience, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and critical incidents in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with support tools, case-management systems, application monitoring platforms, and knowledge-management practices
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current on DCR functionality, reinsurance developments, and application support best practices

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/

title: Travel Sales Executive
description:
About Fly Bagna

Fly Bagna is a Mumbai travel company that runs premium hosted group departures, such as Japan in cherry blossom season, and custom luxury holidays. We are known for handpicked hotels and service well above the usual group tour. We are a small team, so your work shows directly in the results.

Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your CV to travel@flybagna.com with the subject "Travel Sales Executive".
