title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
Are you a Sales Executive passionate about driving sales for innovative healthcare products? If so, this opportunity could be for you! Join us in at B. Braun in India, a leader in the medical devices industry, where your skills and experience will be recognized and celebrated. Take the next step in your career with us and help shape the future of healthcare!
  
  
As a Territory Sales Executive at B. Braun Group you will play a vital role maintaining efficient production processes for the manufacturing of our high-quality medical products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* To look after the territorial sales in terms of all aspects including achieving sales targets in terms of Values, Units , SBA (Applicable for Cluster 2) & managing the territorial distribution network.
* Achieving desired market shares in defined area
* Meeting customers as per customer list and reaching required call average , coverage & compliance.
* Conduct product, therapy related activities as per company marketing guidelines.
* Responsible for establishing strong customer base for company products.
* Generating demand from the customers, hospitals.
* Driving company strategies.
* Report daily calls and other effort parameters as defined as per the company guidelines in Company internal portal
* Enhancement of product knowledge through trainings and self learnings.
* Collecting monthly stock and sales statements of the dealers and reporting sales in Company internal portal with utmost accuracy.
* Monthly uploading of Secondary data in Company internal portal ( Applicable only for ORS Business).
* Regular Updates on MCL ( Must to See Customer List) in company internal portals.
* Develop strong Key Opinion Leader (KOL) base
* Monthly Quarterly update of database of customers
* Understanding the market, the customer and the competition, gather insights from the market place.
* Reporting Lead Generation in company internal portal as per BU Norms

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Show Trust, Value Diversity, Be Accountable to performance delivery.
* Initiative and execution towards active learning in order to be competitive and effective.
* Ability to plan logically and conduct numerical analysis.
* Innovativeness and ability to drive ideas and change and include different perspectives.
* Positive influencing skills and ability to act with customer focus in order to achieve in clinic leadership.
* Excellent written, communication & listening skills and empathy.
* Demonstrate performance and result orientation and utmost integrity , equity.
* Preferred to Have – Graduation or Masters in Science/Pharmacy/Biotechnology/Biomedical engineering.
* Post graduation in Management would be an added advantage.
* Graduation is a MUST.
* Experience: 8-10years of preferable sales experience in Healthcare/Life Sciences/Pharmacy , most preferred being Medical Device industry.

**What sets B. Braun apart?**
B. Braun is one of the world's leading medical technology companies headquartered in Germany. We are proud to say that since the inception of our India operations in 1984, we have made significant strides in the Indian healthcare market. We supply more than 5,000 products and 120,000 articles in areas like anaesthetics, intensive care medicine, cardiology, extracorporeal blood treatment and surgery.
  
  
Our core values of Innovation, Efficiency, Sustainability, Trust, Accountability, and Diversity foster a performance-driven culture where we challenge each other constructively to grow personally and professionally. Recognized through awards such as 'Dream Companies to Work For' and 'Great Place to Work,' we invite you to join our team driven by a shared vision – to protect and improve the health of people around the world.
  
  
**What can we offer you?**

* Exciting sales incentives
* Mediclaim & life insurance
* Recognition & rewards to celebrate your efforts.
* Learning programs & skill development to accelerate your growth.
* Global exposure to broaden your horizons.
* Paternity & birthday leave for life’s special moments.
* Mental wellness support with counselling and mindfulness sessions.

**What’s next?**
Upon receiving your application, our dedicated Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If you stand out, you’ll be invited to engage in dynamic interviews, ranging from phone calls to video chats and in-person meetings. Throughout this process, we will keep you informed and inspired with regular updates and feedback. Finally, if you shine through and decide to join us, we will lead you into our seamless onboarding experience. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!
  
  
We appreciate different perspectives, thoughts, experiences and backgrounds. By strengthening an appreciative, inclusive, respectful and equal working environment, we create a culture in which all our employees feel free to be who they are. description:
**Job level:**
Mid-level

**Location:**
Mumbai (studio at Cuffe Parade)

**Type:**
Full-time

3-5 years in B2B or premium sales

**Reports to:**
Founders (Alpana Shah and Harshil Shah)

**Compensation:**
₹25,000 - 30,000 per month fixed + commission on every paid order

**The Role**

We're looking for a relationship-led B2B seller who can open doors with the businesses that buy luxury florals and gifts: corporates, hotels, cafés, interior designers, developers and planners.

This isn't a telecalling job. You'll research the right decision-makers, reach out across LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email and phone, get our product in front of them through samples and studio visits, and close long-term partnerships. You'll also help the founders decide where to focus and how to grow conversion.

**About Our Client**

Our client is a Mumbai-based luxury floral studio and bespoke gifting house. They work with hotels, cafés, members' clubs, corporates, developers, designers and planners, on everything from a single hamper to programs of 5,000+ pieces. In their first year, they've been featured in Grazia India's Valentine's Day Gift Guide and styled high-profile private celebrations and café launches. They are a small, fast-growing team, and this role will shape how their B2B business grows.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Build pipelines across our key segments**

* **Corporates:**
  HR, admin, procurement and marketing teams for festive, client and employee gifting.
* **Hotels, cafés, restaurants and clubs:**
  GMs, F&B and front-office heads for lobby and venue florals, on project or subscription.
* **Interior designers and architects:**
  partnerships that bring us residential and commercial projects, including HNI homes.
* **Real estate developers:**
  sample flats, sales galleries and clubhouses.
* **Wedding and event planners:**
  a trusted-vendor relationship for décor and gifting.

**2. Run multi-touch outreach**

* Research the right decision-maker for every account using LinkedIn, Instagram, directories and referrals.
* Open with a personalised LinkedIn, WhatsApp or email intro using our B2B deck, then follow up by phone.
* Book discovery meetings, visits and sample presentations.
* Respond to inbound B2B enquiries within the same working day.

**3. Pitch and close**

* Understand each client's brief, budget and brand, and recommend the right product and partnership model: Project Partnership, Preferred Partner or Subscription Service.
* Make the business case clearly, for example how Forever Rose installations cut floral display costs compared with weekly fresh arrangements.
* Send quotations with the founders, negotiate within approved limits, and secure advances and confirmations.
* Hand every closed deal to our Client Experience Manager with a complete written brief.

**4. Sell to the season**

* Plan pushes for corporate Diwali and New Year gifting, Valentine's Day, wedding season and Mother's Day.
* Start corporate festive outreach 8-10 weeks ahead to lock in bulk orders.

**5. Shape the sales strategy**

* Set monthly and quarterly plans with the founders: target segments, priority accounts and revenue goals.
* Track what converts best by segment and channel, and recommend where to focus.
* Bring back market feedback on pricing, objections and new product or bundle ideas.

**Must have**

* 3-5 years of B2B or premium sales experience, with a record of hitting targets.
* Experience selling to businesses: corporates, hotels, F&B, designers, developers or planners.
* Confidence reaching out to senior decision-makers across phone, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.
* **Excellent spoken and written English**
  and Hindi; Marathi or Gujarati is a plus.
* The discipline to work productively in a hybrid setup and report honestly every day.

**Good to have**

* Experience in corporate gifting, hotel or banquet sales, wedding and events, luxury retail, interiors or lifestyle brands. Floral experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
* An existing network among corporates, hotels, designers or planners in Mumbai.
* An eye for aesthetics and an understanding of luxury clients.

title: Medical Reviewer 2
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.

Job responsibilities:

* Evaluate manuscripts, posters, slide decks, educational material, medical literature, etc., provided by clients for data accuracy.

* Identify missing sources in documents and gaps in scientific logic.
* Check for grammar, syntax, style, and compliance with style guides, regulatory guidelines, and publishing requirements.
* Be responsible for the quality of the documents/projects fact checked/QCed.
* Ensure effective communication of QC/fact check findings with the client/medical writers.
* Deliver QC reports to the stakeholders and identify quality trends.
* Ensure timely delivery of documents.

* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.

#LI-Remote

Qualifications and prerequisites:

* Minimum 2 years of experience in the medical writing industry; freshers with substantial knowledge of the publication landscape or clinical research are also eligible.
* Master’s degree in research, or equivalent industry experience.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently, multitask, and prioritize.
* Excellent attention to detail and zero tolerance to errors.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Functional with MS Office.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing project priorities and work assignments.

Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a **Technical Assessment**, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task, followed by a **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers. The final round will be the **HR Interview**. All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams**.

**Equal Opportunity**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.

We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

About Us:

Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com) is a leading medical communication company headquartered in Princeton, NJ, with nine global offices. Its expertise lies in delivering scientific content across the product lifecycle with a focus on science, innovation, and efficiency. The company specializes in providing impactful medical strategy, custom operational models, content development and dissemination, and promotion of patient inclusion for biopharmaceutical organizations. Cactus Life Sciences’ scalable solutions cater to the challenges encountered in product development, guiding brands, and organizations towards their future objectives. With a client-centric approach, the company prioritizes understanding their evolving needs and technology trends to drive its growth. Cactus Life Sciences is a subsidiary of Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com/), a leading science communication and technology company.

title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager
description:
You Will Own Delivery, Client Relationships, and Technical Estimates

MTechZilla is a custom software development company. We build web, mobile, cloud, and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe. Our team of 30+ has delivered 40+ products.

You will own the technical estimate behind every quotation we send, and the delivery of the projects that come out of those quotations. You will also be the person clients come to with their questions, from the first discovery call through the final release.

You need to be a former engineer who can design and estimate a solution, and organized enough to run several client projects at once without anything slipping.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

Delivering every project on time, on budget, and at margin

* Own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent client projects, from kickoff to release and handover.
* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Keep plans, milestones, budgets, and timelines current as priorities shift.
* Track risks, blockers, and dependencies every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Manage scope and turn change requests into approved, billable change orders.
* Coordinate with QA on test plans and release checklists so every release is ready before a client sees it.
* Escalate in writing, before the deadline, when something outside your control puts a milestone at risk.

Manage client relationships

* Act as the main delivery contact for clients across time zones.
* Answer your clients’ questions, technical and non-technical: architecture, feasibility, timelines, costs, scope, and how we work.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.
* Run status reviews and sprint demos, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Present delivery status, risks, and roadmaps to client founders and executives.
* Understand each client’s business and propose technical solutions to their problems.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

Turning client briefs into requirements developers can build from

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features and maintain roadmaps based on business value, effort, and risk.

Design solutions and own estimates for new leads

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead’s technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations, and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation template: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones, and timeline.
* Know what each role on a project costs in the market, so the team you propose in a quotation is priced correctly. Margins are already set; you make sure the inputs are right.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client’s budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

Build delivery processes and documentation that scale

* Run projects in Jira and keep documentation in Confluence: requirements, architecture decisions, release notes, and handover notes.
* Set the documentation standard that every project follows.
* Build a reusable estimation model from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Define and improve our processes for sprints, QA gates, releases, and client reporting.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk, and decisions needed.

Leading and growing the engineering team

* Lead the developers, team leads, and contractors on your projects, and keep them aligned on priorities.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Collaborate with business, marketing, sales, QA, HR, and client teams.
* Take part in hiring, interviews, and decisions on team structure.

Technical Skills You Need

You do not need to write production code every day. You do need to design a system, judge whether a developer’s estimate is realistic, and hold your own with a client’s CTO.

* At least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into lead or delivery roles.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps, and notifications.
* Working knowledge of security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD, and architecture diagrams.

Experience and Qualifications:

Required

* 5 to 6 years of total experience, including at least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* A track record of estimating software projects, with examples of estimates compared to actual delivery.
* Experience leading delivery, projects, or an engineering team.
* Experience running more than one software project at the same time.
* Experience working directly with US or European clients.
* A track record of owning end-to-end delivery and independently driving process improvements.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, release planning, and QA coordination.
* Daily, hands-on use of Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of market salaries and rates for engineering roles in India.
* Clear written English for estimates, PRDs, and status reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience in a software services company, agency, or consulting firm, especially on fixed-price projects.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment, or logistics.
* Ability to create wireframes, workflow diagrams, and POC briefs.
* Experience with Claude and other AI tools.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Sophos, and other IT tools for setting up the right security configurations.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 6 Months

* You produce quotations and estimates for new leads without the CEO filling in technical or timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member could pick up and work from.
* We have an estimation model built from at least 10 past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Director - Engineering
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

The Director's primary goal is to establish, nurture, and guide a team that can integrate seamlessly with the rest of the company's teams to deliver high-quality work and guarantee client satisfaction.

Directors find balance between the needs of the Client & Program, their People & the Company & Craft, as described in the Key Responsibilities section below.

Scope of influence is across Formula.Monks, their Foundry and the Staff, Manager, Senior Manager & Associate Director levels.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Client & Program**

* **Client Success**: Provide strategic oversight for client relationships across various programs. Foster strategic partnerships with executive client stakeholders to ensure long-term retention. Serve as the ultimate escalation point for addressing critical issues relevant to the Foundry. Utilize industry trends and historical data to proactively anticipate and address client needs. Analyze client feedback systematically to identify recurring issues and direct necessary improvements.
* **Delivery Excellence**: Drive account strategy & vision, ensuring a clear and impactful direction. Establish the north star for quality delivery. Introduce innovative technologies and methodologies to improve the effectiveness of delivery processes. Collaborate closely with peers to align delivery strategy, ensuring consistency and integration of best practices.
* **Account Growth:** Contribute to the development of new service offerings, enhancing the company's market competitiveness. Work closely with marketing and sales teams to drive initiatives that support account growth. Take ownership of major pitches and proposals, ensuring that they are strategically aligned with business goals.

#### **People**

* **People Development**: Craft and maintain high performance standards through clear expectation setting, mentoring, and coaching. Lead learning and development programs to enhance team capabilities, knowledge expansion, and adoption of new technologies. Cultivate leadership within the team, spearheading initiatives targeted at the development of leaders and high-potential individuals. Oversee and strategically plan for succession to ensure long-term organizational resilience and growth.
* **Culture**: Lead by example to uphold and promote company values, actively evangelizing and coaching the team on the core tenets of our culture. Lead efforts that strengthen company culture and engagement. Analyze trends that could indicate cultural challenges and propose improvements
* **Building High-Performing Teams**: Take ownership of building & continuously improving the Foundry. Design cross-functional teams by identifying necessary skills and assembling a team that meets project needs. Foster healthy, inclusive, and collaborative dynamics, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable. Encourage the development of autonomous and self-healing leadership teams. Cultivate communities of practice to enable continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and innovation among team members. Build organizational structures that are scalable and flexible, so teams can adjust to evolving business demands and new technologies.

#### **Company & Craft**

* **Company Strategy**: Cultivate alignment within the team with Formula.Monks goals, ensuring that every decision made supports overarching strategy. Define and lead forward-thinking strategic initiatives that impact Formula.Monks. Manage the budget for internal initiatives, maximizing organizational effectiveness and strategic impact. Lead company growth initiatives.
* **Company Processes**: Maintain compliance with company policies, actively contributing to the improvement and optimization of operational processes. Continually refine Foundry best practices by identifying opportunities for improvement and spearheading changes. Carefully evaluate the necessity of processes, recognizing where flexibility, automation and/or common sense are warranted to optimize efficiency. Lead efforts to share highly impactful processes across teams.
* **Information Exchange**: Effectively communicate strategic decisions from the company to the team. Keep the rest of the leadership team in the loop about significant risks. Create mechanisms to eliminate silos within the team, promoting collaboration across Foundries. Own internal communication to enhance clarity and effectiveness. Engage with the team by eliciting and thoughtfully responding to their questions, concerns, and feedback, fostering an open and transparent communication culture. Lead external evangelism & thought leadership initiatives.
* **Talent Management**: Strategically forecast and plan for future staffing needs, ensuring the organization is prepared to meet both immediate and long-term demands. Optimize the use of both billable and non-billable resources to align with project needs and organizational objectives. Regularly update and refine job descriptions to reflect current expectations and requirements. Play an active role in the onboarding of new leaders, working to continuously improve the leadership onboarding process. Define and execute retention strategies to reduce turnover.

  

### **Competencies**

See Foundry Competencies Matrix (TBD)

### **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in leadership and people management roles.
* Experience building and shipping technical products with complex scope.
* Excellent consulting and communication skills.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, and team-building experience.

### **Reporting Structure**

People at the Director level report to Senior Directors and above.

**About Monks**

**Role Overview\***

The Social Media & Creative Executive will manage social media activities and create content for both brands. The role includes content planning, graphic design, photography, video production, copywriting, community management and paid advertising.

**\*Key Responsibilities\***

- \*Content planning and research:\* Prepare monthly content calendars; research competitors, audience interests and trends to propose relevant ideas for each brand.

- \*Graphic design:\* Create posts, carousels, promotional creatives, banners and campaign graphics that follow each brand’s identity.

title: Manager - Regulatory Affairs
description:
**Responsibilities**:

**Regulatory Strategy and Submissions**: Develop and implement regulatory strategies for new and existing products. This includes preparing, submitting, and managing product registration dossiers, notifications, and applications to various regulatory bodies. The manager must stay informed on the latest regulations to advise on product formulations, claims, and labelling to ensure market entry and continued compliance.

**Documentation and Compliance**: A core duty is maintaining meticulous records. The manager oversees the creation and maintenance of technical files, safety dossiers, and other documentation required for product registrations. They are responsible for ensuring ongoing compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), labelling requirements, and advertising standards.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**: The regulatory manager works closely with various departments, including Research & Development (R&D), Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Legal. They provide regulatory guidance throughout the product lifecycle, from initial concept and formulation to marketing and post-market surveillance. For example, they advise the marketing team on permissible health claims and the R&D team on ingredient compliance.

**Liaison with Regulatory Agencies**: They serve as the main point of contact for regulatory authorities. This includes responding to inquiries, addressing deficiencies, and negotiating with agencies to expedite product approvals. They also represent the company at industry forums and consultations.

**Audits and Inspections**: The manager prepares for and manages internal and external audits by regulatory bodies or third-party certifiers. They ensure all facilities, processes, and documentation are inspection-ready at all times.

**Regulatory Intelligence and Risk Management**: They proactively monitor the global regulatory landscape, including new and proposed legislation, guidelines, and industry trends. They then assess the potential impact of these changes on the company's product portfolio and develop risk mitigation strategies.

Preparation and filing of new drug applications (NDA), for submission to regulatory authorities.

Liaise with CDSCO, State FDA, DCGI, and port offices for various regulatory submissions and approvals.

Ensure product labels and artworks comply with D&C Rules, FSSAI (if nutraceuticals), and other applicable standards.

**Essential Qualifications and Skills**

**Education**: A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field such as Regulatory Affairs, Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, or Pharmaceutical Sciences is typically required.

title: Manager Strategic Forecasting
description:
Job Description
  
  
**Position Overview:**  
  
  
We are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. We seek colleagues who are passionate about combining data, analytics, business judgment and insight to improve decisions across the end-to-end commercialization process, from business development and pipeline planning through launch and late lifecycle management. 
  
  
Market Access, Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global capability responsible for long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across Human Health, including Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital, Specialty and Primary Care. The portfolio spans early- and late-stage clinical assets, business development opportunities and launched products. Forecasting deliverables inform planning and decisions across commercial, finance, manufacturing, supply, research and development, and country teams. In addition to delivering high-quality forecasts, the team advances methods, standards and reusable solutions that bring greater rigor, speed, consistency and scalability to decision-making. 
  
  
We are seeking a Manager, Strategic Forecasting who brings strong foundational forecasting capability, analytical curiosity and effective stakeholder partnership. The role will be responsible for delivering forecasts within an assigned therapy area or portfolio, contributing insights to business decisions and improving forecasting approaches under the guidance of senior forecasting leaders. The individual will also explore practical uses of advanced analytics, automation and AI, while keeping sound forecasting methodology, transparency and human judgment at the center of the work. 
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**  
  
  

* Support one or more therapy areas or assets, developing strong knowledge of the disease area, product, market, competitive environment and key business questions.
* Build and deliver high-quality strategic forecasts using fit-for-purpose qualitative, epidemiology-based, patient-based, demand-based and statistical approaches.
* Translate defined business questions into structured forecast frameworks, assumptions and scenarios, seeking guidance for highly ambiguous, novel or enterprise-level questions.
* Develop and maintain forecast models, including patient flows, market and share assumptions, analogs, launch curves, scenarios, sensitivities, risks, opportunities and uncertainty ranges.
* Apply pharmaceutical and commercial judgment to identify important forecast levers, test assumptions and ensure models are transparent, appropriately simple and aligned to the decision need.
* Partner with Commercial, Finance, Market Access, Manufacturing, Supply and country stakeholders to gather inputs, reconcile perspectives and build robust assumptions.
* Communicate forecast outputs clearly, highlighting key drivers, uncertainties and business implications. Escalate material risks, unresolved assumptions and decisions requiring senior input.
* Deliver forecasts and analyses on time, with strong quality control, documentation, version management and adherence to agreed processes and governance.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of forecasting methods, templates, scenario planning, range forecasting, documentation and performance monitoring.
* Contribute emerging ideas and informed perspectives on forecasting practices, bringing relevant external methods or examples into team discussions and helping translate them into practical improvements.
* Participate in peer reviews and communities of practice, share lessons learned and support consistent forecasting standards across the team.
* Use AI, machine learning and automation selectively to support forecasting activities such as research and synthesis, analog identification, data preparation, event monitoring, scenario exploration and repeatable workflow steps.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, traceability and business plausibility. Retain ownership of forecast logic and assumptions and escalate limitations or risks appropriately.
* Identify potential AI or automation use cases within assigned work, support pilots with senior or technical colleagues, and document whether the solutions improve quality, speed or user experience.
* Apply or build working knowledge of analytical techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, range forecasting, analog analysis, conjoint approaches, clustering, natural language processing and other advanced methods where relevant.
* Contribute to standardization and automation of models and processes while maintaining flexibility for asset- and market-specific needs.
* Support capability building by sharing methods, documenting good practices and providing day-to-day guidance to junior colleagues where appropriate.

**Qualification and Skills:**  
  
  

* Postgraduate degree in business, engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, economics, statistics, data science or a related discipline.
* 3 years of relevant experience, including meaningful hands-on exposure to pharmaceutical strategic forecasting, commercial analytics or a closely related decision-support role.
* Working knowledge of core pharmaceutical forecasting, including forecast framework design, epidemiology and patient flow, market and share assumptions, analogs, launch curves, scenario and sensitivity analysis, uncertainty and range forecasting.
* Working understanding of pharmaceutical development and commercialization, including clinical development, regulatory milestones, market access, competition, manufacturing, supply and lifecycle management.
* Ability to develop an informed point of view, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions constructively and translate analysis into clear recommendations within the assigned scope.
* Demonstrated curiosity about evolving forecasting methods and evidence of contributing ideas, reusable approaches or process improvements. Enterprise-wide thought leadership is not required at this level.
* Working knowledge of Monte Carlo simulation and range forecasting; exposure to other advanced forecasting or modeling methods is advantageous.
* Practical awareness of how generative AI, machine learning and automation can support forecasting. Experience applying these tools in analytics workflows is preferred, but deep AI engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to recognize common limitations of analytical and AI-enabled methods, including data quality, validation, explainability, bias, confidentiality and responsible use, and to seek expert guidance when needed.
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail and comfort working through ambiguity with appropriate support.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and geographies and to manage multiple deliverables and timelines.

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
Business Analysis, Marketing, Numerical Analysis, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, Waterfall Model
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**

title: Training Associate
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a Learning Associate to join the Design & Content team within NIQ's Global Knowledge & Training function. In this role, you will build and update digital learning assets, including e-learning modules, instructional videos, presentations and job aids, that support Client Training and internal learning programs for a global audience.

This is an individual contributor role for someone early in their learning design career who enjoys hands-on creation and wants to keep growing. You will work from approved briefs, storyboards, templates and design standards, independently complete routine content changes and maintenance, and work alongside more experienced colleagues on new learning solutions, complex interactions and substantial design changes.

**Key Responsibilities – What you will do**

* Build and update e-learning in Articulate Storyline 360, Rise or similar tools, using approved briefs, storyboards, templates and design standards. Work with more experienced colleagues on complex interactions such as advanced variables, branching or custom logic.

* Produce and edit learning videos from approved scripts and storyboards, including screen recording, editing, voiceover integration and captioning.

* Create on-brand visual assets such as icons, infographics, presentations and job aids that follow NIQ brand and design standards.

* Complete routine content changes and maintenance independently, keeping existing learning assets accurate and up to date.

* Apply instructional design fundamentals and adult learning principles to the content you build. You can recommend learning approaches, with senior review for more significant design decisions.

* Check quality before release by reviewing content accuracy, visual consistency, accessibility and functionality against established quality criteria.

* Prepare assets for publication and, where assigned, upload and update content on NIQ’s learning platforms. Check that published content and links work as intended, and raise issues that need additional design or technical expertise.

* Work with subject matter experts and stakeholders outside the immediate team to gather information and understand requirements, normally in partnership with a more senior colleague.

* Manage defined pieces of work independently against an agreed brief and deadline, keeping your lead informed of progress and blockers.

* Support localization workflows, where assigned, by preparing source files and assets for translation and checking localized versions for layout and quality.

* Apply feedback from reviewers, learners and colleagues to improve your work and build your capability in instructional design, digital and visual design, video production and learning technologies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in instructional design, digital media, graphic design, education, communications or a related field.

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience creating digital learning or digital media content. Internships, freelance work and portfolio projects all count.

* Conceptual knowledge of instructional design and adult learning principles, and the ability to apply them using established practices and standards.

* Hands-on experience with Articulate Storyline 360 and/or Rise, including building from templates, using states, layers and triggers, and publishing content for an LMS.

* Video editing skills using tools such as Camtasia, Adobe Premiere Pro, ScreenPal or equivalent, including adding captions.

* Visual design skills for learning, including layout, typography, visual hierarchy and brand consistency, using tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva or equivalent.

* Basic awareness of digital accessibility, such as captions, color contrast, alt text and keyboard navigation.

* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to checking accuracy, consistency and functionality.

* Good organization and time management, with the ability to deliver defined pieces of work to an agreed brief and deadline.

* Clear, open communication: you share information clearly, ask questions and check for understanding, and you are comfortable working with colleagues across time zones.

* Fluency in English (written and spoken).

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams.

Preferred Qualifications – Nice to have

* Familiarity with Workday Learning or another LMS, including uploading and testing content.

* Experience preparing content for translation or checking localized layouts.

* Experience with additional authoring tools such as EasyGenerator.

* Experience using AI-enabled image, video or voiceover tools (e.g., Synthesia) responsibly within a defined workflow.

* Familiarity with SharePoint pages and document libraries.

* Additional languages beyond English.

The
**Analyst I, Technical Product Ownership**
plays a key role in supporting and enhancing Icertis Contract Intelligence solutions by partnering with business stakeholders to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, manage delivery backlogs, coordinate releases, and ensure solutions align with business objectives. This role focuses on product ownership responsibilities, stakeholder engagement, requirements management, solution validation, and delivery governance across the Icertis platform and related enterprise applications.
  
  
**Primary Duties**

* Lead business requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders to identify business problems, priorities, and system needs related to Icertis and connected enterprise applications.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, implementation plans, and process improvement recommendations.
* Perform Business Systems Analyst activities including gap analysis, solution documentation, stakeholder communication, and post-implementation validation.
* Configure and maintain Icertis Contract Intelligence solutions, including workflows, rules, templates, metadata, and related platform capabilities.
* Act as a functional and technical contributor by supporting configuration and development activities where required to meet business and delivery objectives.
* Support end-to-end testing activities including SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, and release validation to ensure quality delivery.
* Provide production support, issue troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and ServiceNow ticket resolution for platform and integration issues.
* Design, troubleshoot, and support integrations between Icertis and enterprise systems, including Salesforce and SAP Ariba.
* Analyze integration failures, identify root causes, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and support corrective actions to restore and stabilize services.
* Support data migration, deployment activities, release management, business training, and post-production stabilization efforts.

Detailed Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as a bridge between business users such as Legal, Procurement, Sales, and Finance and technical teams supporting Icertis solutions.
* Gather and document business requirements for Icertis CLM and related enterprise solution needs.
* Analyze contract workflows, clauses, approvals, obligations, and related business processes to define effective solutions.
* Define functional designs, workflows, rules, metadata, templates, and supporting solution artifacts.
* Work closely with developers, support teams, testing teams, and integration teams to explain requirements and support implementation.
* Participate in requirements inspections, peer reviews, post-implementation analysis, and quality checkpoints to confirm that business requirements are fulfilled.
* Prepare or oversee the preparation of user requirements, solution documentation, support documentation, and training materials for delivered capabilities.
* Support configuration tasks, issue resolution, enhancements, and deployment activities across multiple workstreams and priorities.
* Provide solution recommendations and participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned to platform standards.
* Monitor and support platform usage, production issues, and operational processes to improve system stability and user experience.

Solution Design
  
  

* Design fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with business users and leveraging the capabilities of the Icertis platform to meet functional and operational requirements.
* Validate solutions for feasibility, scalability, maintainability, and operational readiness across the delivery lifecycle.
* Guide the creation and refinement of functional specifications, user stories, process documents, test scenarios, and support documentation.

Configuration
  
  

* Execute configuration activities across templates, clauses, business rules, workflows, metadata, and related Icertis components.
* Support configuration updates and technical changes required for enhancements, fixes, deployments, and support activities.
* Assist in data migration, mapping, and validation activities during implementations, enhancements, and release cycles.

Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Support post-implementation activities such as upgrades, enhancements, issue resolution, user support, and training.
* Troubleshoot incidents and service requests, perform root cause analysis, and work toward timely resolution of production and support issues.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies across platform support and delivery.

Communication Management
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, testing teams, integration teams, and support teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives within the team.
* Support stakeholder communication and help drive alignment across business and technical groups.

**Experience**

* 2-4 years of relevant experience in Business Systems Analysis, Functional Consulting, Enterprise Application Support, or related roles.
* Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and solution documentation.
* Experience with Icertis Contract Intelligence (ICI) or other Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms is preferred.
* Strong capabilities in system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution design/solutioning.
* Experience with production support, ServiceNow ticket management, and incident resolution is advantageous.
* Knowledge of Salesforce and SAP Ariba integrations, including failure analysis, issue troubleshooting, and cross-functional team coordination, is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
* Good understanding of end-to-end testing and regression testing in lower environments, with the ability to: Execute and document test scenarios and results. Validate system functionality against business requirements. Provide formal testing sign-off and validation confirmations prior to production deployment.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).

title: Digital Content & Learning Technology Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

• We are looking for an organized, analytical, and digitally confident Learning Operations & Content Associate to join our Learning team.

• This role combines learning administration, reporting and analysis, and learning content support. You will help ensure that learning activities are accurately managed, clearly reported, and supported by practical, engaging learning materials.

• You will work with learning colleagues, facilitators, subject-matter experts, and other stakeholders to maintain learning records, prepare reports and dashboards, identify patterns in learning data, and create or update learning materials using established standards and templates.

• This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys working with both data and content, pays close attention to detail, and wants to build experience across learning operations, reporting, analytics, and content development.

**Key Responsibilities – What you will do:**

**Learning management and administration**

• Support the administration of learning programs, courses, and learning activities in relevant learning platforms and tracking systems.

• Create and maintain accurate course, learner, attendance, assignment, and completion records.

• Support course setup, enrollment, assignment, scheduling, completion tracking, and other routine learning administration activities.

• Perform regular data-quality checks and follow up on missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information.

• Maintain learning documentation, trackers, shared files, templates, and supporting process materials.

• Respond to routine learning administration and reporting questions, escalating more complex issues when appropriate.

• Follow established processes and data-handling requirements when working with learner and business information.

**Reporting and analysis**

• Prepare and maintain recurring learning reports using established reporting processes, templates, and definitions.

• Collect, clean, validate, and organize learning data from different sources.

• Support the maintenance of Excel reports, trackers, dashboards, and Power BI reporting solutions.

• Monitor agreed learning measures such as registrations, attendance, completion, learner feedback, assessment results, and learning activity volumes.

• Investigate routine data discrepancies and resolve standard reporting issues using defined procedures.

• Analyze learning data to identify patterns, gaps, and areas requiring follow-up.

• Summarize findings in clear, practical language for learning colleagues and stakeholders.

• Support improvements to reporting accuracy, usability, consistency, and efficiency.

• Maintain clear documentation of data sources, reporting definitions, and recurring reporting processes.

**Learning content creation and maintenance**

• Create and update learning materials using established design standards, templates, and processes.

• Support the development of learning assets across formats such as presentations, job aids, facilitator materials, learner guides, microlearning, videos, and basic digital learning.

• Write clear, learner-focused content, scripts, instructions, and supporting communications.

• Translate technical or complex information into practical language that learners can understand and apply.

• Make routine updates to existing learning content independently, including corrections, minor revisions, formatting changes, and content maintenance.

• Work with more experienced colleagues on new content, substantial revisions, or more complex learning requirements.

• Apply accessibility, brand, quality, and consistency standards to learning materials.

• Incorporate stakeholder and learner feedback into content updates.

**Collaboration and continuous improvement**

• Work with learning colleagues, facilitators, subject-matter experts, and stakeholders to gather information and clarify routine requirements.

• Ask questions and check understanding when requirements, data, or expected outputs are unclear.

• Manage defined pieces of work against an agreed brief, timeline, and quality standard.

• Balance routine reporting, administrative, analytical, and content-related priorities.

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, or simplify recurring processes.

• Contribute to the testing and adoption of templates, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools.

• Apply feedback and experience to build capability across learning operations, analytics, learning technology, and content development.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in learning and development, business, data analytics, education, communications, human resources, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Around 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning operations, learning administration, reporting, data analysis, content creation, or a related field.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including confidence working with formulas, filters, tables, data validation, and pivot tables.

• Experience preparing recurring reports, maintaining trackers, or working with structured data.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Ability to analyze information, recognize standard patterns, and identify inconsistencies.

• Clear written communication skills, with the ability to organize information logically and make complex information easier to understand.

• Experience creating or updating presentations, guides, instructions, job aids, or other structured content.

• Good organizational skills and the ability to manage several defined tasks and deadlines.

• Confidence working independently on routine activities while asking for guidance on unfamiliar or more complex work.

• Ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Fluency in English.

**Additional qualifications and experience**

• Experience using a learning management system such as Workday Learning, Skilljar, SAP SuccessFactors, or a similar platform.

• Experience with Microsoft Power BI or another reporting and dashboard tool.

• Experience with Power Query, data transformation, or basic reporting automation.

• Experience with digital learning tools such as Articulate Rise, Easygenerator, or similar authoring platforms.

• Understanding of instructional design, adult learning, or digital learning principles.

• Experience supporting virtual or instructor-led learning.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, or other Microsoft 365 tools.

Master's Degree

description:
**Company Description**

For more than a decade, 3SC has been helping some of the world’s most recognised brands run smarter, faster and more resilient supply chains. Our one-stop intelligence platform connects planning and execution on a single AI-native supply chain stack. From demand planning and replenishment to supply management, we help enterprises execute end-to-end supply chain decisions, replacing fragmented systems and guesswork with data-driven decisions at scale. What sets us apart is depth and solution reliability. Our teams of data scientists, engineers and supply chain consultants have built expertise that few can match. We turn complex, messy operational data into decisions that help expand the customer, cut costs, strengthen resilience and reduce emissions, delivering outcomes that are real-time and highly predictable with AI and measurable, evert single day. With delivery centres in India and the Netherlands, we serve clients across geographies with the reach of a global organisation and the agility of a focused specialist. Backed by GEF Capital ($2 Billion fund), we are firmly funded: our SaaS and AI business is expanding rapidly, and we are investing in the people who will take our proven platform to even more of the world’s leading enterprises.

**Role Description**

• Run discovery with planners, operations leaders and IT, arriving with a point of view on their business,

and decide early whether a pursuit is worth our effort, including saying no when it isn’t.

• Build and run tailored demos around the client’s own processes and, wherever possible, their own data.

agrees to upfront.

the client’s own numbers that can stand up to their finance team.

• Own the solution design, fit-gap and effort estimate, and flag early when a design would pull our product

off its roadmap.

owner for each piece.

title: Strategy Lead
description:
**Build the gold standard of the MBA for the digital & AI first world**

Digiaccel Learning is looking for a strategic and execution-oriented professional to work closely with the Leadership Team in scaling its Enterprise Business. The role will focus on building capabilities, developing scalable systems, and strengthening Digiaccel’s positioning as a thought leader in Sales & Marketing (S&M) upskilling.

The individual will play a key role in understanding enterprise learning needs, developing tailored solutions for clients, and driving strategic initiatives that contribute to business growth.

The key reasons why you should apply for this role are:

• Learn from ex Marketing Managers and Directors from India’s CEO Factory, Hindustan Unilever Limited.

• Solve hard problems that are new to education but have been solved in some other sectors.

• Opportunity to see your work directly impacts thousands of people. Most tenured professionals and academicians don’t get the opportunity to do that.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Drive initiatives to strengthen Digiaccel’s positioning as a thought leader in S&M enterprise upskilling.

• Build scalable systems and processes to improve enterprise outreach and engagement with relevant businesses.

• Develop a strong understanding of Digiaccel’s enterprise offerings and identify relevant solutions for potential clients.

• Identify and engage with enterprise and startup leaders to understand their learning and upskilling requirements.

• Lead the development of client-facing solutioning decks and presentations.

• Analyse evolving skill gaps within S&M teams and identify opportunities to enhance existing and future learning programs.

• Work closely with the Leadership Team to conceptualise and execute strategic initiatives for scaling the Enterprise Business.

• Track the impact of strategic initiatives through relevant business metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements.

**Key Requirements**

• MBA with at least 2 years of relevant work experience.

• Prior experience in FMCG Sales, Consulting, or Strategy roles is preferred.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a first-principles approach.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to structure complex problems and translate insights into actionable solutions.

• High ownership, intellectual honesty, attention to detail, and a passion for excellence.

• Strong analytical, research and collaboration skills and the ability to interpret market trends and business data work in a fast-paced environment.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome-oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment. We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. You’re the storyteller and solutionist in the room. You show customers how EmployeeWorks gives every employee one AI front door to find answers and get work done across business systems, and how HRSD connects HR cases, knowledge and employee journeys—then you find the path to production. Your focus splits evenly across both. You lead complex sales cycles independently and mentor other Solution Consultants. * Act as the EmployeeWorks, HRSD and AI expert for Account Executives and Senior Solution Sales Executives, leading deal strategy across complex sales cycles.

* Guide strategic programs in top accounts, including roadmap alignment, employee journey mapping and outcome planning.
* Document requirements for a clean handover to Customer Success, and feed customer and competitive insights to Product Management.
* Mentor and coach Solution Consultants, and share best practices and reusable assets across the team.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience supporting enterprise application platforms.
* Experience applying and evaluating AI in enterprise environments, including automation, AI-powered tools and data-driven insights.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture and RESTful APIs, and proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or deep technical experience with other enterprise cloud software. Familiarity with RPA, iPaaS and low-code platforms; scripting is a plus.

title: Associate - ENR (Capital Projects)
description:
**About Us**
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s Energy and Natural Resources (ENR CoE) team, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support BAIN ENR practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The ENR CoE consists of 45+ team members, organized into ~10 teams, working across various sectors such as oil and gas, power and utilities, chemicals, mining, fertilizers and agri-business
  
  
As the ENR sector personnel, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for our clients in Oil and gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Wastewater Recycling, etc. The primarily objective of the sector professionals is to collaborate with practice/ case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products and topic expertise to answer strategic questions of Bain’s ENR clients.
  
  
An Associate works as a team member/contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently.
  
  
In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to solve open-ended problems
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different ENR sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Petrochemicals, etc.)
* Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where data is not easily available or explicitly published
* Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from ME offices)

title: Commercial Finance Analyst GTR Europe
description:

On the one hand you will be involved in regional strategic planning discussions, resource allocation modelling, regional P&L reporting and management and submission of budget estimates. On the other, you will be getting into the details on Europe sales performance, working with the commercial teams to identify opportunities & drive delivery, managing costs & tracking KPIs in Europe P&L.
  
  
**About You**
You must be Fearless to challenge & influence decision making across GTR, mixing the detail and bigger picture to identify opportunities for growth in line with strategy & to manage P&Ls.
  
  
You must demonstrate a Founder’s mentality, balancing brand and commercial priorities to help us achieve the best results with our customers, and to help GTR beat our dynamic plan.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT & PLANNING**
:
  
  
Help manage Europe performance, supporting profitable P&L delivery and manage month-end, quarter-end and year-end reporting processes, with the following specific responsibilities:
  
  

* Partner with the European Commercial team to prepare monthly P&L landing estimates by analyzing business trends, key drivers, and emerging opportunities.
* Develop detailed monthly regional performance reports (market, brand, customer level) covering NSV, GP, GM%, DBC and variance analysis vs. budget.

**COMMERCIAL DECISION SUPPORT:**
Act as Business partner to Sales Managers and Customer Marketing Managers with the following specific responsibilities:
  
  

* Support the Commercial team in identifying pricing opportunities to improve margin and drive profitable growth.

* Share variance analysis of Travel & Entertainment actual spends vs Budget and update Forecast on monthly basis.

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in financial/ strategic analysis gained from experience in a consumer goods/ retail environment or professional services
* Advanced Excel skills, ability to build advanced excel models, explain variances to estimates, identify business risks and opportunities, and make appropriate recommendations
* Ability to manage projects/tasks independently to ensure successful delivery (on time and within budget) while identifying potential issues/risks. Able to prioritize effectively and manage workload against tight deadlines

* Change Agility: You have a deep natural curiosity, desire to experiment and ability to effectively deal with the heat of change. You have a growth and learning mindset: ready to test, stumble, learn and apply from experience

title: Associate - Capital Markets
description:
**Associate - Capital Markets (debt & structured finance)**
**Location:**
Remote (India)
  
  
**Experience:**
3–6 Years
  
  
**Working hours requirement:**
Must overlap a minimum of 6 hours daily with US Central Time.
  
  
**Compensation:**
$1.5K – $5K per month
  
  
**Start preference:**
Only apply if you're ready to join immediately or within 30 days
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Associate, Capital Markets to lead the financial engineering behind our capital deployment. This role is designed for a technical expert who understands the nuances of the capital stack and can navigate complex debt structures.
  
  
**This position supports US-based real estate transactions and financing structures. Experience working on US loan products, credit documentation, or US underwriting standards is strongly preferred.**
Reporting directly to the Capital Lead, you will play a pivotal role in how we finance, scale, and optimize our portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deal structuring & execution: Architect complex debt instruments, including construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing. Lead the analysis of term sheets to optimize pricing, leverage, and flexibility. (All transactions are tied to US real estate financing structures.)
* Advanced capital modeling: Build and maintain sophisticated, dynamic models to evaluate IRR, term sheets, and WACC.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend optimal funding strategies by balancing cost of capital against risk and operational constraints.
* Lender relations & syndication: Act as a point of contact for institutional partners and banks. Manage the "Due Diligence" vault and streamline the closing process for new credit facilities. (This includes coordination with US-based lenders and institutional capital partners.)
* Portfolio surveillance: Proactively manage the debt maturity ladder and monitor key covenants (DSCR, LTV, LTC).

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–6 years in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Structured Finance.
* Modeling Mastery: Expert-level Excel skills are required. You must be comfortable building complex debt waterfalls and automated tools (VBA or Power Query experience is a significant advantage).
* Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards. Experience reviewing US credit agreements or supporting US loan transactions is preferred.
* Strategic Communication: Ability to translate technical financial data into high-level strategic memos for the Executive Leadership team.
* Availability to overlap at least 6 hours with US Central Time is mandatory.

**Why this role?**

* Direct impact: You aren't just "running the numbers"; you are advising the Head of Capital on how to move millions of dollars in capital.
* Visibility: Direct exposure to senior leadership and institutional capital partners.
* Autonomy: We value an ownership mindset - you will be given the runway to improve our processes and lead deal workstreams.

ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. title: Impact Leadership Fellow, Growth & Strategy
description:
**Work type:**
Full time
  
  
**Department:**
Growth & Strategy
  
  
**Workplace:**
On-Site, New Delhi, Delhi, India
  
  
**About Wadhwani AI Global**
Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a next-generation AI transformation partner for governments and multilaterals across Africa, Latin America, and Asia. We institutionalise AI across health, education, and agriculture in the Global South, combining cutting-edge AI products with deep advisory capabilities to improve public services at scale. Working at the intersection of strategy advisory and technology scaling, we build and deploy AI solutions with governments and partners to unlock large-scale impact.
  
  
**About The Impact Leadership Fellowship**
The fellowship gives early-career professionals a focused year inside one team, with real ownership and direct access to leadership. Each fellow is hired for, and placed with, a single team for the full 12 months. Fellows who perform well convert into full-time Associates on their host team.
  
  
**The Role**
The Growth & Strategy Fellow contributes to key pieces of WAIG's growth engine, from market and deal workstreams to live proposals and go-to-market execution. You will support market insights, assist with proposal and commercial analyses, help keep active opportunities moving, and work closely with product, tech, and marketing teams to position solutions for scale, and take on ownership of defined pieces of work early.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Growth Strategy**

* Support market expansion and sector growth initiatives
* Help identify white space opportunities and define where Wadhwani AI Global should and shouldn't play

**Push Deals Forward**

* Support proposal development for select opportunities
* Support senior leaders in high-stakes conversations with ministries and multilaterals
* Help shape partnership structures, pricing logic, and investment cases

**Execute Go-to-Market**

* Help translate AI products into compelling GTM narratives for different countries and sectors
* Track deal momentum and help unblock issues across teams
* Support early-stage negotiation prep and commercial thinking
* Own a defined workstream, such as a proposal or a go-to-market play, with support from your manager

**Who You Are**
You are an early-career professional with 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience and the potential to grow into a full-time Associate. You bring some of the core skills of a growth and strategy role and learn new ones quickly.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years in consulting, growth strategy, corporate development, or startups
* Exposure to deal structuring, business modelling, and partnership management
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder influence, and storytelling skills
* Comfortable operating in fast-changing, under-defined environments

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with tech, AI, or impact sectors

**What You Gain**

* Global exposure: you work at a global AI organisation, with the possibility of travel to the countries where we operate
* AI in public services: you work directly on WAIG's projects and may join field visits to Sub-Saharan Africa and SouthEast Asia, to see how AI is deployed to improve public services
* Early ownership: as an early-stage organisation, we give fellows ownership of high-impact projects and the chance to work directly with leadership
* Regular guidance: a dedicated manager, structured check-ins, and a clear way to raise concerns

title: Finance Executive
description:
A finance executive is responsible for overseeing a company's financial operations, including budgeting, financial reporting, cash flow management, and strategic financial planning, by analyzing financial data, identifying trends, and providing insights to senior management to optimize profitability and achieve organizational goals; they ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulations while managing financial risks and making informed financial decisions.
  
  
Key responsibilities may include:
  
  

* Financial Planning and Analysis:

+ Developing annual budgets and forecasts
+ Performing variance analysis and identifying areas for cost reduction
+ Monitoring key financial metrics and KPIs
+ Conducting in-depth financial analysis to identify trends and opportunities

* Financial Reporting:

+ Preparing accurate and timely financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
+ Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and regulations
+ Presenting financial reports to senior management and stakeholders

* Cash Flow Management:

+ Managing working capital and optimizing cash flow
+ Forecasting cash needs and managing liquidity
+ Overseeing accounts receivable and payable processes

* Investment Analysis:

+ Evaluating potential investments and capital allocation strategies
+ Managing company assets and liabilities

* Risk Management:

+ Identifying and mitigating financial risks
+ Implementing internal controls to protect assets and ensure data integrity

* Compliance and Audit:

+ Ensuring adherence to tax regulations and filing requirements
+ Coordinating with external auditors and managing audit processes

* Team Leadership:

+ Leading and mentoring finance team members
+ Developing and implementing financial policies and procedures

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Expertise in financial accounting principles and reporting standards
* Proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Leadership abilities and ability to manage a team
* Advanced knowledge of financial software and systems
* Relevant accounting or finance degree (CPA or CFA preferred)

Note: The specific responsibilities of a Finance Executive may vary depending on the size and industry of the company, as well as the seniority level of the position.
