title: Manager, Agency Sales(Gurgaon)
description:
**About the Role**

Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
**Manager – Agency Sales**
to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of
**advertising, data, commerce and fintech**
. You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.

The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

**What You’ll Own**

**Agency Relationship & Business Development**

* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
  **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams**
  .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data-led, commerce-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.

**Advertiser & Revenue Development**

* Identify high-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
  **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities**
  .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
  **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories**
  .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.

**Consultative & Solution Selling**

* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
  **audience intelligence, transaction-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement**
  .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory-led selling.

**Agency GTM**

* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.

**Campaign Success & Account Growth**

* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.

**Market Intelligence & Product Feedback**

* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will be measured primarily through:

**Agency penetration:**
Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.

**Active advertisers:**
Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.

**Quality advertisers:**
Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.

**Advertiser retention:**
Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.

**Pipeline creation:**
Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.

**Revenue:**
Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.

**Strategic relationships:**
Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long-term partnerships.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **5–8 years of experience**
  in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
  **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies**
  in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
  **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising**
  .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience working at an
  **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function**
  .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
  **performance and branding solutions**
  .
* Exposure to first-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.

**The Person We’d Like to Hire**

We are looking for someone who is
**well-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow**
.

The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

title: SEO Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior SEO Executive – On-Page Focus to take ownership of on-page, content, and technical SEO across multiple client projects. This role requires hands-on experience in website audits, content optimization, generative engine optimization (GEO), Core Web Vitals, and GA4/GSC analysis, along with the ability to guide and review off-page work executed by a separate team.

The ideal candidate is execution-driven, data-oriented, and capable of translating SEO insights into clear action plans for content writers, developers, and off-page executives.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**On-Page and Content SEO**

* Own on-page SEO strategy and execution for 15–25 client projects simultaneously.

* Perform detailed on-page audits covering content, meta tags, headings, internal linking, and URL structure.

* Optimize content based on search intent, SERP analysis, and competitor content gaps.

* Improve click-through rates (CTR) using Google Search Console data, including titles, meta descriptions, and structured content.

* Address thin content, duplicate content, keyword cannibalization, and content hierarchy issues.

* Plan and implement topic clusters and internal linking strategies.

* Apply local on-page SEO principles, including NAP consistency and location pages.

* Use AI-assisted content optimization tools while following Google guidelines.

**Technical SEO**

* Address crawlability and indexing issues involving robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, and redirects.

* Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, and INP) in coordination with developers.

* Conduct technical audits using Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, SE Ranking, and similar tools.

* Ensure SEO best practices are followed during website changes, migrations, and new page launches.

**Analytics and Reporting**

* Set up and analyze GA4, Google Search Console (GSC), and Google Tag Manager (GTM) events.

* Track organic performance, landing-page metrics, and conversion data.

* Use performance data to prioritize optimization tasks and measure impact.

**Off-Page Coordination (Oversight Only)**

* Guide off-page teams on anchor-text strategy, link-quality standards, and page-level link priorities.

* Review off-page deliverables for alignment with SEO strategy; direct backlink execution is not required.

**Collaboration and Ownership**

* Collaborate closely with content writers, developers, and project managers.

* Create clear SEO briefs and actionable optimization plans.

* Meet deadlines, maintain quality standards, and drive measurable SEO improvements.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of hands-on on-page and technical SEO experience; agency experience is preferred.

* Strong understanding of search intent, content optimization, technical SEO fundamentals, Core Web Vitals, and page experience.

* Practical experience with GA4, GSC, GTM, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and/or SE Ranking.

* Experience optimizing websites across multiple industries.

* Ability to manage high-volume project workloads with a structured approach.

* Good written and verbal communication skills for coordination with content and development teams.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.

* Comfort working collaboratively in a team environment.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field; 2–5 years of SEO experience and a strong SEO portfolio are preferred.

* Proven experience as an SEO specialist.

* Strong understanding of Google algorithm updates and SEO best practices.

* Analytical mindset with a focus on practical execution.

* Experience using Google Analytics for SEO analysis.

* Experience with generative engine optimization (GEO), including AI Overviews and AI search tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

description:
***Marketing Manager***

***Experience- 12+ years in B2B marketing***

***Location-Kolkata, New Delhi***

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We provide game development, art, co-development, and custom software services to studios, publishers and enterprises worldwide. We need a senior marketing leader who can turn marketing into a predictable, measurable pipeline engine for a long-cycle, high-ticket services business.

You will own the full marketing mandate: positioning, demand generation, content, SEO and AI-search visibility, paid media, ABM, events and marketing operations. You will be accountable for pipeline and revenue contribution, not just traffic and leads. This is a player-coach role: strategic enough to set direction with leadership, hands-on enough to audit, review and fix.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Strategy, Positioning & Planning

Build the annual and quarterly marketing plan, budget and forecast, tied to revenue targets and ideal customer profiles (ICPs).

Define positioning, messaging and differentiation by service line (game dev, art, co-dev, QA, software) and by segment (studios, publishers, enterprises).

Set quarterly OKRs with measurable key results, and run monthly reviews with leadership.

Own the marketing funnel model (MQL > SQL > Opportunity > Closed-won), with clear definitions agreed with Sales.

2. Demand Generation & Pipeline

Run a multi-channel inbound and outbound-support engine across organic, paid, email, events and partnerships.

Build and manage ABM programs: target account lists, tiering, personalised campaigns and sales-aligned plays.

Build lead scoring, nurture journeys and handoff SLAs with Sales to improve lead quality and speed-to-lead.

3. SEO & GEO (AI Search)

Lead organic strategy: keyword mapping by funnel stage, pillar-cluster architecture, technical health, on-page optimisation and content refresh cycles.

Run white-hat link building and digital PR, and manage Clutch, GoodFirms and DesignRush profiles and reviews.

Build visibility in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and similar tools through entity signals, structured data and answer-ready content.

Guide Development on Core Web Vitals, schema, indexation and site architecture.

4. Content & Thought Leadership

Own the content engine: blogs, case studies, whitepapers, original research, webinars, video and tools or

calculators.

Make sure every asset maps to an ICP, a funnel stage and a conversion path.

Build executive and brand thought leadership through LinkedIn, speaking slots, awards and industry publications.

5. Performance Marketing

Plan, direct and optimise Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and retargeting.

Own CPL, cost per MQL, CAC and lead quality, and manage budget allocation across channels based on pipeline impact.

6. Events, Community & Brand

Plan event strategy (GDC, Gamescom, Devcom and others): pre-event outreach, on-site execution, post-event follow-up and ROI.

Grow brand presence on LinkedIn, YouTube and industry communities (Reddit, Discord and others).

7. Marketing Operations, CRO & Analytics

Own the CRM and marketing automation stack (HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho), data hygiene and lead routing.

Drive conversion rate optimisation across landing pages, forms and CTAs through structured testing.

Set up and govern GA4, GTM, Search Console and dashboards (Looker Studio or similar), with multi-touch attribution.

Report pipeline, revenue contribution, CAC and ROI to senior leadership every month.

8. Leadership & Collaboration

Lead, hire and mentor a cross-functional team; set goals, review output and build capability.

Manage agencies and freelancers on scope, quality, cost and outcomes.

Partner with Sales, Business Development, Delivery and Leadership for case studies, account insights and shared targets.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

12+ years in digital and B2B marketing, with 6+ years in IT services, software outsourcing or game development.

Proven record of generating qualified inbound pipeline for long-sales-cycle, high-ticket services, backed by measurable results.

Strong hands-on understanding of SEO (technical, on-page, off-page), Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with the ability to audit and direct specialists.

Experience building ABM programs and working in close alignment with Sales.

Expertise with GA4, GTM, Search Console, an SEO tool (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a CRM/automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho).

Experience leading teams of 5+ and managing external agencies and budgets.

Experience marketing to the US, UK, EU and Middle East markets.

Strong communication, stakeholder management and executive reporting skills.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or Communications (MBA preferred).

**Preferred**

Understanding of the game development lifecycle and the studio/publisher ecosystem.

Exposure to GEO, AI-assisted content workflows and original research or digital PR.

Certifications: Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot.

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - QBB-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Banking Book (QBB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products, in particular lending products
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes
* Play an active role in mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Required to review, analyse and concur with tasks completed by junior staff
* Flexibility to work across projects involving model audits, validation and development activities


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Complete, end\-to\-end understanding of credit risk model development or validation for the banking book portfolio (PD/LGD/EAD)
* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience


**What We Look For**
* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: GRC Consultant – Compliance & Audit Readiness
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organised around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Act as the trusted bridge between customers and independent auditors. You will identify security and compliance gaps, drive practical remediation, strengthen evidence readiness, and guide customers through external audits to timely closure without compromising auditor independence.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Own the audit journey for an assigned portfolio of global customers - from gap assessment and readiness through external audit fieldwork, findings resolution and closure.
* Assess security controls, cloud environments, organizational policies and operating practices to identify control, evidence and implementation gaps early.
* Turn identified gaps into practical, risk-based remediation plans with Engineering, IT, DevOps and leadership teams, balancing audit urgency with operational reality.
* Review evidence for relevance, completeness and consistency before submission, and maintain a clear, audit-ready trail of requests, responses and decisions.
* Serve as the coordination point between customers and independent auditors - facilitate requests, clarify how controls operate and help teams respond accurately without compromising auditor independence.
* Track open evidence requests, dependencies, exceptions and delivery risks; communicate progress clearly and escalate roadblocks before they threaten timelines.
* Guide customers across SOC 2 Type I and Type II examinations and ISO/IEC 27001 audits, with exposure to ISO/IEC 27701, HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS where relevant.
* Work flexibly across EU and US hours to support international customers and audit firms during time-sensitive stages of an engagement.
* Improve reusable playbooks, evidence guidance and audit workflows by turning recurring issues into scalable practices for the Central Audits Team.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 2-5 years of relevant experience in information security, IT audit, compliance consulting or a closely related customer-facing advisory role; strong candidates with deeper experience are also welcome.
* Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 Type I and Type II and ISO/IEC 27001, including control design, evidence expectations, readiness and external audit workflows.
* Direct experience participating in, coordinating or supporting third-party security audits and responding to auditor requests or findings.
* Comfort with AWS, GCP or Azure, SaaS architectures, identity and access management, and the technical context needed to assess how controls operate.
* A practical problem-solver who can distinguish a documentation gap from a control-design or operating-effectiveness gap and drive the right remediation.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to align technical teams, executives, customers and external auditors around facts, ownership and next steps.
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple parallel engagements, changing priorities and time-sensitive evidence requests.
* Willingness to work with flexibility across EU and US working hours.
* Nice to have: CISA, CISM, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer, or a relevant privacy credential.
* Nice to have: experience with a compliance automation platform, cybersecurity consultancy or fast-scaling B2B SaaS company supporting international customers.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director - Financial Crime Compliance
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
  
  
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
  
  
We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
  
  
**About The Position**
As a Director in our Financial Crime Compliance Managed Services group, you will be responsible for exercising leadership and strategic direction over client projects, while supporting the growth of AMLRS' business and people. The successful candidate should possess strong working knowledge and understanding of Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”) regulatory requirements and industry best practices to direct teams to produce high quality deliverables for clients on projects; as well as possess the ability to lead the development of new methodologies and approaches to address client needs.
  
  
The Director should understand and have the ability to work in an agile, dynamic environment and be able to exercise governance and oversight on multiple AML/financial crime projects.
  
  
This role requires collaboration with cross-jurisdictional teams and requires the ability to exercise sound judgment and AML knowledge to manage risk and ensure that product deliverables are executed with a high level of quality in within project timelines.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Provide operational soundness and compliance on AML/FC engagements:
  
  

* Lead financial crime engagements in accordance with terms of service agreements stipulated in the executed statement of work (SOW)/contract.
* Set the tone for quality standards and issue escalation and management on the engagement.
* Serve as a point of contact for issues escalated by the Manager and Senior Managers on the engagement and ensures prompt resolution of potential issues while managing client expectations.
* Define and review KPI/ KRI/ dashboard reports needed to effectively manage risks on the engagement.
* Define and review all pertinent client deliverables prior to submission to the client.
* Attend key client meetings and ensure that internal and external meetings are attended by the appropriate AMLRS team members.
* Oversee the engagement leverage model to ensure that it is continuously assessed and adequate to meet the needs of the client; as well as consider and escalate any contractual amendments required to maintain sound operation and execution of the engagement.
* Ensure that Senior Managers on the engagement exercise appropriate oversight and management over Time reporting by all members of the engagement team.
* Ensure that client billing is completed timely and correctly and approve invoices in a timely manner.
* Work with Senior Managers on the engagement to ensure that performance reviews are completed appropriately and timely.

Client Relationship Management:
  
  

* Leverage knowledge and experience to help identify new client opportunities (through client interaction and governance and oversight of the engagement team) and discuss with Account Management and Sales functions.
* Organize and lead periodic touch points with client stakeholders to assess their needs and obtain feedback around AMLRS performance, including organizing and leading bi-annual/annual executive meetings with the client key stakeholders.
* Manage and coordinate certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr Managers and Managers and providing updates to practice leads and rest of the organization as appropriate.

Mentor and coach Engagement Teams:
  
  

* Establish and set the tone for developing strong, inclusive mentoring and coaching relationships on the engagement, across all staff levels.
* Set the tone and encourage personal development on the engagement (i.e. encourage attendance of AMLRS trainings and personal development events and initiatives)
* Partner with Shared Service teams to address human capital and information technology related needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Overall, 18- 22 years or more of AML / Financial Crimes experience, with an understanding of regulatory requirements as it pertains to areas such as transaction monitoring, AML policies and procedures, KYC, EDD and AML independent testing, and compliance transformation
* Proven ability to lead, mentor and coach teams of up to 200+ analysts.
* Very strong entrepreneurial spirit - highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Effective issue management skills.
* Demonstrated client and team relationship management and development experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CAMS Certification
* MBA

AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

title: Head - Electrical Engineering
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Lead Grid Compliance leads the development and implementation of strategies to ensure wind turbines meet regulatory requirements for grid connection, power quality, and dynamic grid support. This role oversees the design and integration of SCADA systems, focusing on real-time monitoring, control, and data acquisition to optimize turbine performance. The Lead manages testing and validation processes, including power quality assessments and grid support simulations, and prepares compliance reports for regulatory bodies. This position also addresses cybersecurity risks within SCADA systems, drives continuous improvement in grid interaction technologies, and mentors a team of engineers to enhance their expertise in grid compliance and SCADA operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
2. Generator & Power Conversion3. Grid Integration & Compliance4. Controls, SCADA & Electrical Interfaces5. Design Verification & Validation6. Reliability & Product Performance7. Certification & Engineering Compliance8. Localization & Supplier Engineering9. Manufacturing & Service Support10. Engineering Leadership
  
  

* WTG Electrical System Architecture
* Own the overall electrical architecture of wind turbine platforms from concept through serial production.
* Define system/sub-system requirements, technical specifications, interfaces and design criteria.
* Lead engineering of:

+ Generator and generator interfaces
+ Power converters
+ Main and auxiliary transformers
+ Pitch electrical system
+ Low-voltage and medium-voltage systems
+ Switchgear and protection systems
+ UPS and auxiliary power systems
+ Cable and harness systems
+ Earthing and lightning protection interfaces
+ Electrical panels and power distribution systems

* Ensure robust electrical interfaces across converter, generator, controls, transformer, switchgear and grid connection systems.
* Provide technical leadership for generator selection, specification, integration and validation.
* Lead converter architecture, sizing and performance requirements, including thermal and electrical interfaces.
* Drive system-level optimization between generator, converter, transformer and turbine control.
* Review component design margins, losses, efficiency, temperature rise and operating envelopes.
* Lead WTG electrical engineering support for grid-code compliance and turbine-grid integration.
* Guide power quality, reactive power, voltage/frequency response and protection philosophy.
* Coordinate engineering inputs for electrical modelling, grid studies and compliance verification.
* Ensure electrical design supports applicable project and market-specific grid requirements.
* Work closely with Controls and SCADA engineering teams to ensure complete integration of electrical equipment into the turbine control architecture.
* Define sensors, measurements, alarms, protections, interlocks and operational sequences.
* Lead interface management among electrical hardware, turbine controller, converter controller and SCADA.
* Support troubleshooting of turbine-level electrical and control interactions.
* Establish electrical DVP&R / verification and validation plans for components and turbine systems.
* Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and engineering sign-offs.
* Define prototype, laboratory, bench and turbine-level validation requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis for electrical failures using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis and RCA.
* Drive corrective and preventive engineering actions based on field and test observations.
* Own electrical reliability improvement across the WTG lifecycle.
* Analyse recurring failures involving converters, generators, transformers, pitch electrical systems and other electrical components.
* Drive improvements in thermal management, electrical protection, component life and system robustness.
* Develop design improvements based on testing, manufacturing and field-performance feedback.
* Ensure electrical designs are compliant with applicable wind turbine certification and electrical engineering requirements.
* Coordinate engineering activities with certification bodies and external technical agencies where required.
* Maintain design documentation, calculations, specifications, compliance evidence and engineering change records.
* Support WTG type certification and platform upgrades from an electrical engineering perspective.
* Drive localization and alternate-source development for critical electrical components.
* Develop technical specifications and qualification criteria for suppliers.
* Participate in supplier capability assessment, technical reviews and component qualification.
* Work with Supply Chain and Quality teams on technical closure of supplier deviations and engineering changes.
* Drive design-to-cost and value-engineering initiatives without compromising reliability or compliance.
* Provide engineering support for manufacturing ramp-up and serial production.
* Address electrical non-conformities and recurring manufacturing issues through permanent engineering solutions.
* Support commissioning and service teams on complex turbine electrical failures and field issues.
* Translate field lessons learned into product/design improvements.
* Build and lead a strong Electrical Engineering organization covering core electrical systems and relevant specialist competencies.
* Establish engineering processes, design standards, review mechanisms and technical governance.
* Mentor engineers and develop technical competency in WTG electrical technology.
* Manage engineering priorities across new-product development, localization, cost reduction, field issues and platform improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and international engineering partners on technology development.

**Qualifications**

* Qualification: B.E./B.Tech – Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering; M.E./M.Tech preferred.
* Experience: 15–22 years, preferably in WTG / Wind OEM engineering.
* Strong expertise in WTG electrical systems, generators, converters, grid integration, controls/SCADA and validation.

title: Deputy Manager, Regulatory Affairs
description:
**Job Description**
The role is responsible for end-to-end CMC regulatory leadership for complex injectable products, from development-stage strategy through submission, agency review, and post-approval changes. It requires hands-on technical assessment, sound interpretation of regulatory requirements, effective cross-functional coordination, and accountability for submission quality and timelines.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities (Key Accountabilities)**
**Essential Candidate Requirements**
**Essential Functions and Performance Expectations**

* Regulatory Strategy and Product Development
* Develop and execute product-specific regulatory strategies for complex injectable products, primarily for the US and EU, with Canadian market support where applicable.
* Lead CMC input into US ANDA and 505(b)(2) NDA strategies, identifying development requirements, submission risks, and supporting data needs early in the program.
* For 505(b)(2) applications, collaborate with relevant functions to define the reliance approach, bridging requirements, and scientific justification supporting the proposed development and filing pathway.
* Lead CMC preparation for pre-IND, pre-ANDA, and other agency interactions, including briefing packages, focused questions, supporting rationales, and implementation of agency feedback.
* Translate regulatory requirements into clear, actionable recommendations for development, manufacturing, analytical, and quality teams.
* Technical Review, Dossier Compilation, and Submission
* Independently lead compilation, critical review, and finalization of CMC dossiers, ensuring scientific adequacy, internal consistency, and readiness for submission.
* Own Module 3 content and coordinate relevant Module 1 and Module 2 inputs with responsible functions.
* Critically assess formulation and process development, specifications, analytical validation, impurity controls, sterilization/aseptic processing, container closure systems, extractables and leachables, and stability data.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions; drive their resolution through scientifically justified and practical recommendations.
* Ensure alignment among development reports, batch records, validation documents, specifications, stability commitments, and proposed commercial practices.
* Deliver complete, accurate submissions within agreed timelines, supporting first-cycle approval objectives and minimizing preventable deficiencies.
* Agency Responses and Lifecycle Management
* Lead the preparation and technical review of responses to FDA, EU regulatory authority, and Health Canada queries, as applicable.
* Develop clear, scientifically supported responses that directly address agency concerns and remain consistent with submitted data and commitments.
* Evaluate the regulatory impact of changes to formulation, manufacturing processes, facilities, equipment, analytical methods, and packaging components.
* Recommend appropriate filing strategies and supporting documentation for amendments, supplements, variations, and other lifecycle submissions.
* Maintain traceability of agency correspondence, commitments, and their implementation across development and commercial documentation.
* Regulatory Intelligence and Risk Management
* Interpret applicable FDA, ICH, EU, and Canadian requirements and relevant pharmacopeial standards, assessing their impact on assigned programs.
* Use authoritative guidance, agency feedback, and relevant public assessment information to support regulatory decisions.
* Distinguish explicit regulatory requirements from scientific recommendations and internal practices when advising stakeholders.
* Proactively identify regulatory risks, evaluate options, and recommend mitigation measures with clear implications for data requirements, timelines, and approval.
* Cross-Functional Leadership and Team Development
* Lead cross-functional discussions to resolve technical issues, establish responsibilities, and secure timely delivery of submission-ready documents.
* Develop realistic submission plans, track critical dependencies, and escalate risks promptly with proposed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members in technical review, scientific writing, guidance interpretation, and dossier preparation.
* Establish consistent standards for document quality, version control, technical accuracy, and submission traceability.
* Support inspection and audit readiness by ensuring consistency between regulatory submissions, supporting records, and applicable commitments.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in CMC regulatory submissions for injectable products, including independent ownership of significant dossier sections or complete programs.
* Strong working knowledge of US ANDA requirements and practical experience with 505(b)(2) development, submissions, or agency interactions.
* Sound technical understanding of sterile product development, manufacturing, analytical controls, and stability.
* Ability to critically evaluate source data, identify scientifically meaningful gaps, and develop defensible regulatory positions.
* Strong scientific writing skills, with experience preparing agency responses and technical justifications.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, challenge unsupported conclusions constructively, and drive cross-functional issue resolution.
* Relevant qualification in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
* Take ownership of regulatory deliverables from strategy development through submission and agency response.
* Deliver technically robust dossiers within agreed timelines.
* Identify critical gaps early and drive timely closure.
* Reduce avoidable deficiencies through rigorous technical review and consistent documentation.
* Maintain clear visibility of submission status, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Strengthen team capability through practical mentoring and review feedback.

**Education**

* B. Pharm B. Pharm - Required
* M. Pharm M. Pharm - Preferred

**Company:**
Dash Technologies Inc.
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (On-site)
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
US Eastern Time, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM ET

8 to 15 years overall
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About Dash Technologies**
Dash Technologies Inc. is a software development and technology services company delivering enterprise software, web and mobile applications, AI/ML, data science and digital transformation solutions to clients across the US and globally. We help businesses envision, build and run more innovative and efficient products.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a sharp, street-smart Associate Director, Business Development to own and convert high-volume inbound leads into high-value, long-term clients. Inbound buyers usually reach out to several vendors at once, so speed, the right messaging and the ability to build confidence in the very first conversation are what set a winner apart. Prior travel to the US and a strong understanding of US business culture are mandatory for this role.
  
  
This role is not about closing every lead that comes in. It is about finding the needle in the haystack: identifying the right accounts with strong lifetime customer value (LTV) and growth potential and winning them. You will book meetings, run discovery, shape the winning strategy and convert opportunities into Dash client logos, with support from our senior sales leadership team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage a high volume of inbound leads from our inbound platforms, including the Dash website, Bark and Upwork, responding quickly and with tailored messaging.
* Qualify and priorities leads and accounts using strong business acumen, focusing on opportunities with high LTV and long-term growth potential.
* Book discovery meetings promptly and build credibility and trust with prospects in the first meeting.
* Identify buyer personas, decision-makers and their personalities, and understand what will resonate to win each customer.
* Define a clear win strategy for each priority opportunity and differentiate Dash from competing vendors.
* Own the full cycle from first response through proposal, negotiation and closure, working closely with senior sales leadership, solution architects and delivery teams.
* Own and deliver against a revenue quota.
* Maintain accurate pipeline, activity and forecast data in the CRM (HubSpot).
* Share market and customer insights with leadership to improve inbound messaging, qualification criteria and conversion rates.

**Must-Have Skills And Qualifications**

* 8 to 15 years of overall experience in business development or sales for software development, IT services or technology services.
* Proven track record of handling high-volume inbound leads and converting them into closed business.
* Demonstrated ownership of a revenue quota with consistent achievement.
* Strong business acumen and the judgement to priorities accounts by fit, value and LTV.
* Ability to act fast, write and speak with crisp, persuasive messaging, and build confidence in first meetings.
* Street smarts in reading buyer personas, stakeholder dynamics and what it takes to win.
* Excellent spoken and written English for working with US clients.

+ Prior travel to the US and very good experience with, and understanding of, US culture and business etiquette (mandatory).

* Willingness to work on-site in Ahmedabad on US Eastern shift (7:30 AM to 5:00 PM ET).
* Hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience selling custom software, AI/ML, data, cloud or digital transformation services.
* Familiarity with inbound platforms and lead marketplaces such as Upwork, Bark and website inbound forms.
* Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise clients.
* Exposure to multiple industries such as healthcare, fintech, retail, logistics or SaaS (industry-specific experience is not required).
* Understanding of solution scoping, estimation and proposal writing.
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field; an MBA is a plus.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Fast response times and a high meeting-booked rate on qualified inbound leads.
* Strong conversion from first meeting to closed deal on priority accounts.
* New client logos with high lifetime value and repeat business.
* Consistent achievement of revenue quota.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and proactive Social Media Executive who can take ownership of UltraCare PRO's social media presence and turn ideas into engaging, relevant, and brand-aligned content.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of social media platforms, a good eye for creative content, excellent communication skills, and the ability to stay ahead of trends. You will work closely with the marketing and creative teams to plan, create, publish, and optimize content across UltraCare PRO's social media channels, and to run our influencer marketing programme end to end.

**Key Responsibilities1. Social Media Management**

* Manage the day-to-day presence across UltraCare PRO's channels, with
  **Instagram and YouTube as primary platforms**
  , followed by
  **LinkedIn**
  .
* Maintain secondary channels (Facebook, Reddit) in line with the overall content plan.
* Plan and maintain monthly and weekly content calendars across all platforms.
* Schedule and publish posts consistently.
* Ensure all content follows UltraCare PRO's tone, messaging, and visual identity.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience interactions.

**2. Content Planning & Creation**

* Develop creative content ideas based on brand objectives, campaigns, events, product launches, and industry trends.
* Write engaging captions, post copy, hooks, and short-form content.
* Work with designers and video editors to create high-quality social media creatives.
* Identify opportunities to turn company activities, events, insights, and industry developments into social content.
* Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for different platforms.

**3. Influencer Marketing**

* Identify and shortlist influencers and creators relevant to UltraCare PRO's categories, audience, and campaign objectives.
* Handle outreach, negotiation, commercials, and contracting with influencers and their agencies.
* Brief creators clearly on product usage, messaging, claims, do's and don'ts, and deliverables.
* Track deliverables, timelines, approvals, and payments through to completion.
* Analyse influencer performance against agreed metrics — reach, views, engagement, cost per view, cost per engagement, clicks, and conversions.
* Maintain a running influencer database with past performance, rates, and category fit.
* Continuously refine the influencer strategy — creator mix, content formats, briefs, and commercial terms — based on what the performance data shows.

**4. Instagram, YouTube & Short-Form Content**

* Develop ideas and scripts for Reels, Shorts, and long-form YouTube videos.
* Coordinate with the creative team for production, editing, and delivery.
* Write titles, descriptions, thumbnails briefs, and tags that improve discovery on YouTube.
* Identify opportunities for educational, informative, entertaining, and trend-based video content.
* Understand what makes short-form content engaging and shareable, and apply it consistently.

**5. Trends & Social Media Insights**

* Stay updated with the latest social media trends, formats, hashtags, memes, and content styles.
* Identify trending topics that are relevant to UltraCare PRO.
* Experiment with new content formats and ideas.
* Monitor competitor and industry social media activity and identify opportunities.

**6. Community Management**

* Respond to comments, messages, and relevant audience interactions in a timely and professional manner.
* Monitor brand mentions and conversations.
* Build and maintain meaningful engagement with the online community.

**7. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track key metrics across platforms — reach, impressions, engagement, followers, watch time, retention, clicks, and conversions.
* Prepare regular social media and influencer performance reports.
* Identify high-performing and underperforming content and creators.
* Use insights to improve future content, influencer selection, and overall social media strategy.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in Social Media Management, Social Media Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Content Marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of major social media platforms, particularly Instagram and YouTube, followed by LinkedIn.
* Hands-on experience running influencer collaborations, including shortlisting, outreach, and performance tracking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong copywriting and storytelling abilities.
* Good understanding of social media trends and audience behaviour.
* Comfort with platform analytics and basic reporting in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to manage multiple content pieces and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with designers, video editors, and marketing teams.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to health, wellness, fitness, or D2C consumer brands.
* Familiarity with influencer discovery and tracking tools.
* Basic hands-on ability with editing or design tools (CapCut, Canva, or similar) for quick turnarounds.

title: Manager - Digital LAMF & Operations
description:
**Manager / Assistant Manager – Digital LAMF Business & Operations**

**1. Job Summary**

Chinmay Finlease Limited is looking for a dynamic, result-oriented professional to manage and grow its Digital Loan Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) business.

The candidate will be responsible for driving lead generation, customer acquisition, business development, channel partner relationships and end-to-end digital lending operations.

The role involves managing the complete digital loan lifecycle, including customer onboarding, mutual fund portfolio verification, digital lien marking, loan disbursement, collateral monitoring, repayment management and customer servicing.

The ideal candidate should possess a combination of business development capabilities, digital lending operations experience and a strong understanding of mutual fund-backed lending.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

A. Lead Generation & Business Development

• Drive lead generation and customer acquisition for the Digital LAMF business.

• Identify business opportunities through mutual fund distributors (MFDs), independent financial advisors (IFAs), wealth management companies, fintech platforms and financial intermediaries.

• Develop and maintain relationships with channel partners to generate consistent business leads.

• Coordinate with Marketing teams for digital campaigns, referral programs and customer acquisition strategies.

• Manage the lead funnel from sourcing to loan disbursement.

• Identify new sourcing channels and strategic partnership opportunities.

• Achieve monthly lead generation, customer acquisition and loan disbursement targets.

• Monitor lead quality, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs and channel-wise performance.

B. End-to-End Digital Loan Operations

• Independently manage the complete Digital LAMF loan lifecycle from application to closure.

• Monitor digital onboarding, KYC, mutual fund portfolio verification and loan eligibility.

• Ensure seamless digital documentation, e-signing, sanction and loan disbursement.

• Track application processing and resolve operational exceptions.

• Ensure timely processing of loans within defined turnaround times (TATs).

• Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Finance and Technology teams for smooth operations.

• Manage loan renewals, enhancements, repayments and closures.

C. Digital Lien Management

• Manage digital lien marking, modification and release of mutual fund units.

• Coordinate with CAMS, KFin Technologies, AMCs and technology partners.

• Monitor lien marking success rates and resolve pending or failed transactions.

• Ensure successful lien confirmation before loan disbursement.

• Handle partial lien releases, additional collateral marking and closure-related lien releases.

D. Collateral & Portfolio Risk Monitoring

• Monitor daily NAV movements and pledged mutual fund valuations.

• Track Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios through automated monitoring systems.

• Identify margin shortfalls, LTV breaches and collateral-related risks.

• Coordinate margin calls, additional collateral requests and partial repayments.

• Work with Risk and Collections teams for timely resolution of overdue and margin-deficient accounts.

• Ensure adherence to approved collateral and risk management policies.

E. Digital Disbursement & Repayment Operations

• Coordinate with Finance and Banking teams for timely digital disbursements.

• Ensure accurate loan booking in the Loan Management System (LMS).

• Monitor interest calculations, repayment schedules and outstanding balances.

• Handle payment failures, reconciliation issues and repayment-related exceptions.

• Coordinate loan closure, settlement and timely lien release.

F. Technology & API Coordination

• Coordinate with internal Technology teams and external Digital LAMF platform providers.

• Monitor API integrations for mutual fund portfolio fetching, lien marking, NAV updates and loan processing.

• Identify system failures, API errors and digital customer journey drop-offs.

• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system enhancements and operational issue resolution.

• Recommend automation and process improvements to increase efficiency and scalability.

G. Channel Partner & Customer Relationship Management

• Build and maintain relationships with sourcing partners, fintech platforms and financial intermediaries.

• Support partner onboarding, training and operational coordination.

• Monitor partner-wise leads, conversions and disbursement performance.

• Resolve customer queries related to onboarding, disbursement, repayment and lien release.

• Manage customer escalations and ensure timely complaint resolution.

• Improve customer experience throughout the digital lending journey.

H. Compliance & Operational Risk Management

• Ensure adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, KYC/AML requirements and internal lending policies.

• Maintain accurate digital records, transaction logs and audit trails.

• Monitor operational risks, transaction exceptions and reconciliation discrepancies.

• Coordinate with Compliance, Risk and Internal Audit teams.

• Ensure timely resolution of audit observations and regulatory compliance issues.

I. MIS, Reporting & Business Performance

• Prepare daily, weekly and monthly Digital LAMF business and operations MIS.

• Track lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion rates and disbursement volumes.

• Monitor application approvals, rejection rates, processing TAT and digital journey performance.

• Track outstanding loan portfolio, LTV breaches, repayments and overdue accounts.

• Analyse sourcing channel performance and identify business improvement opportunities.

• Present business performance, operational challenges and growth opportunities to management.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Banking, Business Administration or related field.

• MBA in Finance or Marketing preferred.

Professional Experience

• 2–6 years of experience in fintech, NBFC, digital lending, secured lending or financial services.

• Prior experience in Digital Loan Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) or Loan Against Securities (LAS) preferred.

• Experience in lead generation, channel partner development and customer acquisition.

• Understanding of digital loan processing and mutual fund lien operations.

• Experience working with lending technology platforms and financial intermediaries.

**4. Required Skills**

• Strong business development and lead generation capabilities.

• Knowledge of mutual funds, NAV, LTV and lien marking processes.

• Understanding of digital lending operations and loan lifecycle management.

• Familiarity with CAMS, KFin Technologies and mutual fund lending infrastructure.

• Knowledge of Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Loan Management Systems (LMS) and API-based integrations.

• Strong Microsoft Excel, MIS reporting and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management abilities.

• Strong problem-solving and operational execution skills.

• Ability to independently manage business targets and day-to-day operations.

**5. Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates currently working with:

• Fintech companies offering Digital Loan Against Mutual Funds.

• NBFCs and banks providing Loan Against Mutual Funds or Loan Against Securities.

• Digital secured lending platforms.

• Wealth management companies and mutual fund distribution networks.

• Financial technology companies supporting digital lending and lien management.

Candidates with hands-on experience in both LAMF business sourcing and digital lending operations will be given preference.

**Key Expectations from the Candidate**

The selected candidate should be capable of:

• Independently managing and expanding the Digital LAMF business.

• Generating quality leads through multiple sourcing channels.

• Building productive channel partner relationships.

• Achieving monthly loan disbursement and business growth targets.

• Ensuring smooth digital onboarding, lien marking and disbursement.

• Managing collateral monitoring, repayments and operational risks.

• Coordinating with Technology, Risk, Finance and Compliance teams.

• Improving customer conversion, operational efficiency and portfolio quality.

title: Head – AIF Fund Accounting
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* We are seeking a highly experienced and qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) to lead the Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Regulatory Compliance functions of our Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) business. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in AIF accounting, fund operations, taxation, investor reporting, financial controls, and SEBI regulations, with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in the AIF industry.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead AIF fund closing activities, including scheme closure, investor exits, final NAV computation, distribution accounting, and fund liquidation processes.
* Manage investor redemption, drawdown, capital call, distribution, and investor capital account reconciliation activities.
* Perform and review NAV calculations, including management fee, carried interest, performance fee, commission structure, expense allocation, accruals, and waterfall calculations.
* Handle investor taxation matters, including pass-through taxation, TDS computation, capital gains reporting, tax certificates, and resolution of investor tax-related queries.
* Ensure accurate accounting and reporting of investor transactions, redemptions, transfers, and distributions.
* Coordinate with custodians, trustees, fund administrators, auditors, and bankers for fund accounting and closure-related activities.
* Review portfolio valuation and ensure timely NAV finalization and investor reporting.
* Ensure compliance with SEBI AIF Regulations, Income Tax, GST, and other regulatory requirements.
* Manage direct and indirect taxation, including TDS, GST, tax assessments, and statutory filings.
* Support audits, regulatory reporting, and financial statement preparation for AIF schemes.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
* Minimum 5-7 years of Hands-on exposure to AIF fund closing, investor redemptions, NAV computation, management fee calculations, carried interest/waterfall calculations, investor taxation, capital distributions, and resolution of investor tax queries is mandatory.

**Preferred**

* Additional certifications related to AIF, Fund Management, or Financial Markets will be an added advantage.

title: Assistant Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Power Limited (APL):**
Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role is responsible for managing billing processes, revenue, and payment collection by ensuring accurate and timely updates on various portals, responds to disputes, and provides detailed financial reporting.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Assistant Manager - Regulatory & Commercial**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
  
  
Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
  
  
Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
  
  
Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
  
  
Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
  
  
Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
  
  
**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
  
  
In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
  
  
Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
  
  
Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
  
  
Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
  
  
**Portal Management**
Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
  
  
Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
  
  
Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
  
  
Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
  
  
Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
  
  
**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
  
  
Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
  
  
Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
  
  
**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
  
  
Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
  
  
In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Finance Team
  
  
Corporate Affairs Team
  
  
Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Team
  
  
Fuel Management Team
  
  
Power Sales Team
  
  
Business Development (BD) Team
  
  
ABEX Team
  
  
Commercial Controller Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
DISCOMs/Procurers
  
  
Regulatory Authorities
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
Freshers permitted
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.
