title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for an energetic, target-oriented, and result-driven Sales & Marketing Executive to promote and sell solar energy solutions. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, identifying potential customers, conducting field visits, explaining solar products and services, converting leads into sales, and achieving monthly sales targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and approach potential residential, commercial, and industrial customers for solar installations.
* Generate new leads through field visits, references, telecalling, and other marketing activities.
* Explain the benefits, features, and cost savings of solar energy systems to customers.
* Prepare and present quotations and proposals to prospective customers.
* Follow up with customers and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Achieve monthly sales targets assigned by the management.

**2. Marketing Activities**

* Conduct direct marketing and promotional activities to increase brand awareness.
* Promote the company's solar products and services through various marketing channels.
* Identify new market opportunities and potential business areas.
* Participate in exhibitions, campaigns, customer meetings, and promotional events.
* Develop customer relationships and generate business through referrals.

**3. Customer Relationship Management**

* Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solar solutions.
* Regularly follow up on pending enquiries and quotations.
* Coordinate with the technical and installation teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Address customer queries and provide necessary information regarding solar installation.

**4. Field Sales & Reporting**

* Conduct daily field visits and customer meetings.
* Visit residential areas, commercial establishments, shops, industries, and other potential locations.
* Maintain daily records of leads generated, customer visits, follow-ups, and sales conversions.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports to the management.
* Update customer information and sales activities in the company's records.

**5. Coordination & Company Policies**

* Coordinate with the telemarketing, technical, documentation, and installation departments.
* Ensure proper communication of customer requirements to the concerned departments.
* Follow company pricing, quotation, payment collection, and sales procedures.
* Ensure all customer payments are made only through the official company bank account or approved company payment channels.
* Maintain professional conduct and represent the company positively.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum qualification: Plus Two / Degree in any discipline.
* Experience in sales and marketing preferred.
* Experience in solar energy or electrical industries will be an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and convincing skills.
* Strong negotiation and customer-handling abilities.
* Basic computer knowledge and MS Office skills.
* Willingness to travel and conduct field marketing activities.
* Target-oriented attitude with the ability to work independently.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of new leads generated.
* Number of customer visits and meetings conducted.
* Number of quotations submitted.
* Monthly sales target achievement.
* Lead-to-customer conversion ratio.
* Revenue generated through sales.
* Customer satisfaction and follow-up efficiency.

**Additional Expectations**

* Maintain discipline, punctuality, and professionalism.
* Achieve the sales targets assigned by the management.
* Provide accurate information about solar products, pricing, and installation procedures.
* Do not make unauthorized commitments or offer discounts without management approval.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer details and company information.

title: Senior Account Executive - Inside Sales
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. **There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
  
  
  
  
***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

**Job Description**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-velocity, customer-centric
**Senior Account Executive**
to join our fast-growing, high-performance global sales team. In this critical mid-market/SMB role, you will sit at the intersection of incoming market demand and proactive expansion, capitalizing on a steady stream of marketing-qualified leads and high-value channel partner opportunities to drive predictable revenue velocity.

The ideal candidate is a consultative closer who excels in a fast-paced SaaS environment, possesses deep empathy for buyer pain points, and understands how to navigate the full sales lifecycle smoothly. If you are highly autonomous, masterfully articulate value over features, and thrive on winning business within the competitive North American market, this role is built for you.

**1. Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Full Lifecycle Funnel Ownership:**
  Own and orchestrate the entire sales cycle from initial qualification, deep technical discovery, and tailored product demonstrations through to proposal architecture, contract negotiation, and final deal closure.
* **Inbound & Partner Opportunity Conversion:**
  Rapidly engage, qualify, and convert premium inbound leads and partner-registered opportunities, successfully positioning our SaaS solution as the definitive answer to the prospect's business needs.
* **Tailored Executive Presentations:**
  Deliver compelling, ROI-focused product demonstrations (primarily virtually) that showcase the platform's unique value proposition, specifically tailored to resonate with North American SMB decision-makers and C-suite stakeholders.
* **Precision Forecasting & Pipeline Hygiene:**
  Maintain strict, meticulous pipeline management within our CRM system (Salesforce/HubSpot). Generate accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts, ensuring healthy pipeline coverage to consistently exceed individual quotas.
* **Early Account Expansion:**
  Identify immediate upsell and cross-sell expansion opportunities within newly acquired accounts post-sale to maximize initial Contract Value (ACV).
* **Cross-Functional Synergy:**
  Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to provide a real-time feedback loop on lead quality, partner with Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) on account handoffs, and sync with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure a frictionless onboarding experience.
* **Continuous Sales Excellence:**
  Continuously refine your objection-handling techniques, stay ahead of competitive landscape shifts, and master advanced sales methodologies to maintain a high-converting win rate.

**2. Impact You Can Create**

* **Accelerate International Revenue:**
  Your execution will directly expand our market share and brand presence within the highly competitive North American region.
* **Optimize Funnel Velocity:**
  By mastering consultative, discovery-first qualification, you will shorten sales cycles and minimize pipeline stagnation, turning raw interest into closed-won revenue faster.
* **Shape Product & Marketing Strategy:**
  Acting as the primary voice of the customer, your strategic feedback loop will help align corporate marketing campaigns and product roadmaps directly with the evolving needs of the SMB market.

**Qualifications**

**3. Skills & Competencies**

* **Consultative Discovery & Execution:**
  Mastery of deep discovery techniques; ability to look beyond superficial feature requests to diagnose complex underlying business challenges and frame value-based, solution-driven proposals.
* **Command of Sales Methodologies:**
  Deep familiarity with world-class sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, SPIN Selling, or Sandler) to systematically qualify and de-risk opportunities.
* **Objection Handling & Commercial Closing:**
  Exceptional negotiation acumen with a proven ability to proactively anticipate, counter, and navigate complex pricing, security, or legal objections smoothly.
* **Cultural Nuance & Communication:**
  Flawless verbal and written English communication skills, with a native understanding of North American business etiquette, professional cultural nuances, and corporate communication expectations.
* **Advanced Tech Stack Fluency:**
  Comfortable navigating modern SaaS tech stacks and highly proficient with sales engagement tools (e.g., SalesLoft, Outreach.io, ZoomInfo) and enterprise CRMs.

**4. Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience Baseline:**
  3 to 7 years of demonstrable success as a quota-carrying Account Executive in a B2B SaaS environment, with a clear history of meeting or exceeding individual targets, specifically within the SMB/Mid-Market space.
* **Global Market Experience:**
  Documented experience managing and closing deals with clients based in the North American geography.
* **Operational Shift Alignment:**
  Flexibility and willingness to work in specialized shifts explicitly aligned with regional North American time zones to ensure maximum market coverage and live engagement.
* **Academic Credentials:**
  A Bachelor’s degree is mandatory.
* **Industry Preference (Desired):**
  Prior experience selling within highly specialized technical domains, such as FinTech, HR Tech, or Healthcare SaaS ecosystems, is highly advantageous.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Sales Consultant
description:
**Company:**
Eldego
  
  
**Job Role:**
Sales Consultant - (B2C)
  
  
**Experience:**
0–2 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Most travel companies sell trips. We sell the trip someone has been waiting their whole life to take.**
Our customers are 55+. Many spent decades putting kids and parents first. When they call us, they're not browsing — they're booking the moment they stopped postponing. Your job is to hold that conversation with the patience and skill it deserves.
  
  
**About Eldergo**
India's first travel brand built for senior travellers. Comfortable pace, safety-first execution, group experiences that feel like family. Hundreds of trips delivered — Mysore to Mauritius, Kashmir to Kyoto. Founder-led, fast, and obsessed with how every customer feels.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
You'll close warm leads. No cold calling, no campaigns. Start on weekend getaways, graduate to international (Bali, Bhutan, Dubai → eventually Japan, Europe) as you earn the trust-weight of bigger tickets.
  
  
**WHERE THIS LEADS**
Trainee → Junior Sales Executive → Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Principal Sales Executive (sell flagship trips, report to the founder) or Sales Team Lead → Sales Head. Published bar at every level. No vibes-based promotions.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Hit your monthly seat target — close them with discipline, not pressure.
  
  
Build trust on every call — answer the unsaid fear behind every question before it's asked.
  
  
Run a clean CRM — every lead, every note, every follow-up logged. No exceptions.
  
  
Protect the brand — customer ratings count as much as closes.
  
  
**YOU'RE A FIT IF**

* 0 - 2 years in inside sales / travel / EdTech / real estate — anything closing-heavy.
* Fluent English + Hindi. A third Indian language is a real edge.
* Comfortable on the phone with someone older than your parents — and respected on the call.
* Number-driven. You check your pipeline at 9pm to know where you'll close from tomorrow.

**Compensation & Role Details**

* Total earning potential: Up to ₹10 LPA (fixed + performance incentives)
* Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
* Location: Bengaluru (remote during probation, office-based after confirmation)
* Reporting to: Founder / Head of Sales

**INCENTIVE BREAKDOWN**
**Three engines: fixed pay + per-seat incentive + milestone share when trips fill.**

* Fixed pay: Monthly salary that grows with every promotion.
* Booking incentive: Paid per seat closed. Bigger trips = bigger incentive.
* Performance multiplier: Your monthly tier multiplies your incentive. Top tier earns multiple times the base.
* Milestone share: Pool that pays out as trips fill. You win when the trip wins.
* Strong performers earn meaningfully above the base. Top performers earn well into senior-management territory.

About the Role

We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and well-organized **Accounts & Administration Executive** to manage day-to-day accounting, financial coordination, dispatch operations, logistics, and administrative activities.

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling end-to-end accounts coordination along with operational and administrative responsibilities. This role is not limited to finance; it involves coordinating with vendors, customers, internal teams, transporters, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth business operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Accounts & Bookkeeping**

* Maintain day-to-day accounting records and bookkeeping.
* Record and maintain sales, purchase, and expense entries.
* Maintain proper documentation of financial transactions.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable records.
* Verify bills, invoices, vouchers, and supporting documents.
* Maintain and update cash, bank, and ledger records.
* Assist with monthly account closing and financial reports.

**2. Invoicing & Payment Reconciliation**

* Prepare and generate customer invoices, quotations, and bills.
* Verify invoice details, GST information, and supporting documents.
* Maintain invoice records and track outstanding payments.
* Perform customer payment reconciliation against invoices.
* Reconcile vendor payments and outstanding balances.
* Follow up with customers for pending payments.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding payment status and discrepancies.

**3. Expense Management & Reconciliation**

* Track and maintain daily operational and administrative expenses.
* Verify employee claims, bills, receipts, and expense vouchers.
* Perform monthly expense reconciliation.
* Maintain records of office expenses, travel expenses, logistics expenses, and other operational costs.
* Ensure all expenses are properly documented and approved.

**4. Dispatch & Logistics Management**

* Coordinate daily dispatch activities and delivery schedules.
* Arrange transportation and courier services for goods and materials.
* Prepare dispatch documents, delivery challans, invoices, and e-way bills wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with warehouse teams, vendors, transporters, and customers.
* Track shipments and ensure timely deliveries.
* Maintain dispatch registers, delivery records, and proof of delivery.

**5. Vendor & Customer Coordination**

* Communicate with customers regarding invoices, delivery status, and payment follow-ups.
* Maintain vendor and customer records.
* Resolve basic billing, payment, and delivery-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication with internal departments and external stakeholders.

**6. General Administration**

* Handle day-to-day office administrative activities.
* Maintain office records, files, bills, and important documents.
* Coordinate office purchases, stationery, and other requirements.
* Monitor utility bills, service bills, and recurring expenses.
* Support management with administrative coordination and documentation.

title: Business Execution Consultant
description:
**About this role:**

Corporate & Investment Banking (“CIB”) delivers a comprehensive suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services. A trusted partner to our clients, we provide corporate and transactional banking; commercial real estate lending and servicing; investment banking; equity; and fixed income solutions including sales, trading, and research capabilities to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients across the globe.

Wells Fargo’s Structured Products Group (SPG), part of the Markets division in CIB, provides direct structured lending in addition to the underwriting and distribution of asset-backed securities for clients who access the bond markets through securitizations. The India team works as an extension of the global SPG team across a broad range of asset classes, covering large domestic and international clients, including corporates, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), financial institutions, insurers, mortgage and real estate finance companies, and investment funds.

The Business Execution role supports the SPG Portfolio Management and Underwriting team across controls and governance, data management, credit administration, change management, and transformation initiatives. The role also supports SPG leaders with management reporting, business and headcount updates, and analysis to inform franchise strategy and priorities. The successful candidate will work closely with SPG colleagues in Bangalore and the U.S., with opportunities to learn, develop, and contribute as an integral member of the business.

**In this role you will:**

  

* Maintain the control inventory, including up-to-date control descriptions, ratings, and procedure links, and provide subject-matter inputs.
* Track Shared Risk Platform (SHRP) change requests and coordinate their status and completion with the center of excellence.
* Coordinate Independent Testing & Validation (IT&V) and other audit engagements, including collecting and organizing testing artifacts, uploading evidence to SharePoint, tracking change requests and progress, and coordinating subject-matter expert walkthroughs.
* Perform and track control-monitoring activities in line with approved procedures and frequencies, including:
* Quarterly: Anti-Tying, Deal File Checklist, Record to Apply Jointly, Daily DNT QFC Scrub, and UCC Monitoring.
* Annually: Medallion Stamp, Notary, and Affiant.
* Track issues and remediation actions, coordinate monthly updates with COO and Controls partners, and escalate overdue items or emerging concerns.
* Prepare periodic controls and governance reporting, highlighting status, exceptions, remediation progress, and items requiring management attention.
* Maintain workflow trackers and perform documented checks to monitor control implementation and identify exceptions for follow-up.
* Support the development and maintenance of policies and procedures, risk assessments, and control frameworks in collaboration with relevant business and control teams.
* Support periodic governance reviews, change management, access reviews, and related activities.
* Liaise with SPG Business Execution, COO, and other teams on business priorities, data management, and U.S.-based COO activities.

**Leadership Reporting and Strategy Support**

* Assist SPG leaders in preparing management reports, business updates, presentations, and briefing materials for senior leadership and governance forums.
* Consolidate and analyze headcount and workforce updates, including capacity, and utilization, in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Support leaders in developing and tracking franchise strategy, business plans, and strategic initiatives through analysis, presentation development, and progress reporting.
* Translate business and operational data into concise insights, highlighting performance trends, key risks, dependencies, and matters requiring leadership decisions.
* Coordinate reporting inputs across teams, validate data accuracy and consistency, and track milestones and follow-up actions against agreed timelines.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

* An MBA or equivalent qualification.
* 2+ years of experience in business execution, project management, or a COO function; experience in controls or risk management is preferred.
* Experience in a banking or captive environment; knowledge of asset-backed finance or securitization would be an advantage.
* Technical knowledge of audit, compliance, or governance is preferred.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely.
* Ability to prepare executive-ready presentations, management reports, and business updates, with clear narratives and actionable insights.
* Ability to consolidate and analyze business, headcount, and capacity data, identify trends, and provide decision-support insights to leaders.
* Strong stakeholder coordination skills, including gathering inputs, constructively challenging inconsistencies, and following through on deliverables across teams.
* Strong organizational, project management, and process improvement skills, with attention to detail and adaptability to evolving requirements.
* A proactive, self-starting approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership with minimal supervision or follow-up.
* Ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
* Ability to handle sensitive business, workforce, and strategy information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Flexibility to work a partial U.S. shift, as business requirements dictate.

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for management presentations; experience with Power BI or reporting automation would be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

**Posting End Date:**

22 Nov 2026

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. **Additional****responsibilities****may****include:**

* Contribute to cross-functional projects with other workstreams.

We reach across disciplines and borders to serve our global organization. We are the engine of Deloitte. In Deloitte Global, everyone has an opportunity to lead. We see the importance of your perspective and your ability to create value. We want you to fit in—with an inclusive culture, focus on work-life fit and well-being, and a supportive, connected environment; but we also want you to stand out—with opportunities to have a strategic impact, innovate, and take the risks necessary to make your mark.

**Who****you’ll****work****with:**
==================================

The Global Operate team is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission-critical services to support Global Operate’s overall success. Whether focused on sales excellence, delivery transformation, quality and risk management, contracts management, finance and operations, capability build, communications and change management, knowledge management, marketing and market intelligence, or other activities, these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people can effectively serve clients every day.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, finance, economics, data analytics, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred where relevant.

* Relevant experience in professional services, pricing analysis, business intelligence, or data analysis; previous experience with a top-tier consulting firm is preferred.

* Hands-on experience extracting, cleaning, reconciling, analyzing, and visualizing data, with strong Microsoft Excel skills. Experience with any of the following is preferred: SQL, Python, Tableau, or Power BI.

* Ability to work with structured project-management practices to maintain plans, actions, risks, issues, dependencies, and status information.

* Experience with benchmarking tools or pricing data is preferred. Ability to conduct research, apply critical thinking, and communicate basic findings and recommendations for senior review.

* Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet agreed deadlines.

* High attention to detail, clear writing skills, and confidence communicating with colleagues, senior leaders and stakeholders.

* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, inclusive team with colleagues from different countries, cultures, and time zones.

* Ability to make connections across projects and identify ways to extend the use of existing materials.

* Microsoft Excel certification is preferred; certification in Tableau or Power BI is an advantage.

* Location: Bengaluru preferred; may be extended to the broader USI network.

**How****you’ll****grow:**
==========================

Deloitte Global inspires leaders at every level. We believe in investing in you, helping you embrace leadership opportunities at every step of your career, and helping you identify and hone your unique strengths. We encourage you to grow by providing formal and informal development programs, coaching and mentoring, and on-the-job challenges. We want you to ask questions, take chances, and explore the possible.

Deloitte’s Total Rewards program reflects our continued commitment to lead from the front in everything we do — that’s why we take pride in offering a comprehensive variety of programs and resources to support your health and well-being needs. We provide the benefits, competitive compensation, and recognition to help sustain your efforts in making an impact that matters.

**Corporate****Citizenship**
============================

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skills-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** Senior HR Business Partner, India

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:** Hybrid, Bengaluru based

**Employment Type(Permanent/Contract/Part-time/Intern):** Permanent, Full-Time

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**Reporting Line:** Head of People

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview:**

Our India team of around 50 people works across consulting delivery, technology and shared services, and they need one senior People partner they can trust. As Senior HR Business Partner, India, you will own employee relations, performance management, engagement and compliance for the India team, and you will run our Bengaluru office. You will work directly with business leaders in India and North America, and with our Finance and Corporate Technology teams. This is a hands-on role in a small People team: you set the approach and you do the work.

**Mandate:**

* Be the first point of contact for every People matter in India, for employees and leaders alike.
* Handle employee relations cases fairly, quickly and with clean documentation, escalating to the Head of People where needed.
* Run India's performance and engagement cycles on time and to standard.
* Keep FIQ fully compliant with Indian labour law and statutory obligations, with nothing missed and nothing late.
* Make India HR processes run the same way, whoever runs them.

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 6 to 10 years in HR, including at least 3 years as an HR Business Partner or HR generalist owning a site or business unit in India.
* Hands-on employee relations experience: investigations, performance improvement plans, disciplinary processes and exits, documented to a standard that holds up.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance, including the Labour Codes, POSH, the Maternity Benefit Act and the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act.
* Experience running performance review cycles and coaching managers through difficult conversations.
* Comfort with HR data: you pull and analyse your own reports from an HRIS (BambooHR, greytHR or similar) and use AI tools to work faster.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to advise senior leaders across India and North America.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Employee Relations**

* Advise employees and managers across India on People matters, and be the person they come to first.
* Investigate and resolve grievances and conduct issues, and run performance improvement plans and disciplinary processes with clear documentation.
* Manage exits end to end, including exit interviews and the themes that come out of them.
* Support our POSH Internal Committee and external member on process and record keeping.

**Performance Management**

* Run the India side of FIQ's semi-annual performance cycle: timelines, manager training, calibration support and follow-through.
* Coach managers to write fair, evidence-based assessments and to have direct conversations.
* Track probation outcomes and make sure confirmations happen on time.

**Engagement and Culture**

* Turn engagement survey results for India into action plans with leaders, and follow up until they are done.
* Run the Bengaluru office engagement calendar and our hybrid attendance standards.
* Roll out FIQ's recognition program in India.

**Compliance and Policy**

* Own India's People compliance calendar, including POSH annual reporting, Maternity Benefit Act obligations and policy updates under the Labour Codes.
* Flag legal risk early and escalate to the Head of People and outside counsel where needed.

**HR Operations and Office**

* In the first half of 2027, oversee our outsourced HR operations partner across onboarding, offboarding, payroll inputs to Finance, full and final settlements and HR vendors.
* Hold that partner to a ready first day for every joiner (induction, benefits enrolment, payroll setup and system access with Corporate Technology) and a clean, compliant exit for every leaver (access removal, asset return, clearances and full and final inputs to Finance).
* Over the same period, work with Finance and our external chartered accountants on statutory matters such as PF, ESI, PT and gratuity.
* Over the same period, keep employee data in BambooHR accurate and reconcile it with Finance every month.
* Build and run regular HR reports from BambooHR, such as headcount, attrition, leave and onboarding status, for India leaders and the Head of People.
* Manage the Bengaluru office with our building and facilities partners.
* Document and maintain the India People SOPs.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Meet every India leader and the People team, and understand the open employee relations cases, the compliance calendar and our HR operations partner's scope.
* Take ownership of all open employee relations cases.
* Agree a day-one readiness checklist with Finance, Corporate Technology and our HR operations partner.

**60 Days In**

* Lead India's preparation for the next performance and increment cycle.
* Close or move forward every open employee relations case, with documented outcomes.
* Confirm the India compliance calendar is current, with no gaps.
* Identify gaps in India HR policies and agree a plan with the Head of People to close them.

**90 Days In**

* Deliver India's performance cycle on time.
* Agree engagement action plans with India leaders.
* Publish updated India People SOPs and a first monthly India People report.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Zero missed statutory or compliance deadlines in India.
* Employee relations cases resolved within agreed timelines, with complete documentation.
* 100% of India performance reviews and probation confirmations completed on time.
* Improvement in India engagement scores and survey participation.
* Regretted attrition in India held at or below target.

**Why You Will Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we do not just build supply chain solutions, we build long-term careers. We give our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you are leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have visible impact. We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Compensation is a competitive annual CTC based on experience. We discuss compensation openly at the first screening call.

**India**

**Health and Wellness**

* Employee wellness programs where applicable

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. title: Senior SuccessFactors Integration Manager
description:

* Experience with integration platforms such as SAP CPI, Dell Boomi, or middleware tools.

**Expectations from you in this position:**

title: Consultant, Data Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

### **Role Summary:** **Lead enterprise-wide Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives across** **client, product, third-party, and account** **domains, ensuring high-quality, integrated master data to support our data governance and digital transformation goals.**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Own and lead assigned Master Data subdomains** (e.g., Client, Product, Reference Data), ensuring data integrity, consistency, and alignment with enterprise standards
* Drive **end-to-end data quality initiatives**, from profiling and issue identification through root cause analysis, remediation design, and execution
* Perform **deep-dive data analysis and profiling** to identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improving data accuracy and completeness
* Define and implement **data quality rules, controls, and monitoring frameworks** to proactively manage data issues
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to **resolve data issues at source**, influencing process and system changes for sustainable improvement
* Lead **data governance and stewardship activities**, including management of critical data elements (CDEs), metadata, lineage, and business rules
* Collaborate with technology and architecture teams on **data ingestion, integration, and MDM enhancements**, ensuring alignment to the target operating model
* Drive **continuous improvement initiatives** across master data processes, including automation, standardization, and optimization of data flows
* Support delivery of **regulatory, operational, and analytical data requirements**, ensuring trusted data is available for downstream consumption
* Act as a **subject matter expert (SME)** for assigned domains, guiding junior analysts and contributing to best practices across the MDM organization

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Advanced SQL skills** with the ability to query, join, reconcile, and analyze large datasets across multiple systems
* Strong experience in **data profiling** and identifying data patterns, anomalies, and quality issues
* Proven capability in **data quality management** including rule definition, defect analysis, and remediation tracking
* Solid understanding of **Master Data Management (MDM)** concepts (match/merge, survivorship, golden record, stewardship)
* Experience with **data governance practices**, including metadata, lineage, and critical data element (CDE) management
* Demonstrated ability to **perform root cause analysis** and drive resolution of data issues at source
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights and work effectively with business and technology stakeholders
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field

**Preferred Experience:**

* 6-9 years of Experience into Data Management/MDM.
* Experience with data governance / data quality tools (e.g., Collibra or similar)
* **Exposure to financial services,** regulatory, or client, account, product, reference data domains
* Experience with Python or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) for advanced analysis and reporting

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

* Build a joined up global partner approach, including consistent partner tagging and migration practice.
* Work closely with Marketing to drive engagement and create more opportunities for both teams.
* Coach and develop the leaders and managers beneath you, and build a strong succession pipeline.
* Partner with Sales Development, Pre Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, Legal and Finance to deliver one joined up go to market approach.

* Senior leadership of large, multi region sales organisations in software or SaaS, covering both high velocity SMB and more complex, higher value selling.

* Strong coaching and talent development, with a track record of building leaders and succession.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

**Your role and responsibilities:**

This is a 'Sales Support Specialist - Electrification' role in Process Industries Division. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (Process Industries division) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your technical skill by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Process Industries business. Main stakeholders are customers, EPCs/consultants, sales and engineering teams, product management, and project execution functions.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Delivering technical consultation and optimized electrification solutions by analyzing customer requirements, reviewing specifications, and defining clear scopes with transparent cost and responsibility mapping.
* Preparing comprehensive techno-commercial proposals including bill of quantities, cost estimation, and competitive bid strategies while identifying and managing commercial, technical, and contractual risks.
* Collaborating with engineering, service, vendors, and product units to develop value-driven proposals and support sales growth through technical presentations, workshops, and customer problem resolution.
* Managing customer engagement and pre-sales activities to acquire orders, improve profitability, and meet key performance metrics including order intake, Net Price Variance (NPV), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Ensuring business objectives are met, including revenue growth, volume targets, and profitable expansion across assigned product portfolios, industries, and geographic markets.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed university or institution.
* 10-18 years of experience in technical sales, bids & proposals, engineering, or solution development for large-scale electrification projects across Mining, Metals, Cement, Paper, and other process industries.
* Extensive technical proficiency in Electrical Power Distribution Systems, including HV Substations (AIS & GIS), MV & LT Switchgear, Intelligent MCCs, Transformers, Busducts, Battery Chargers, Cable Management Systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Extensive knowledge of motor and drive sizing, selection, and application engineering for process industry requirements, particularly in mining equipment, metals processing plants, profile mills, cement plants, and paper manufacturing facilities.
* Hands-on experience in preparing techno-commercial proposals, solution engineering, and customer-facing technical discussions, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.
* Proficiency in electrical system studies and engineering tools such as ETAP, with additional experience in E-house solutions, substation automation systems, and integrated electrification solutions considered a strong advantage.

**More about us:**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

Software should help a business move as one. But too often, disconnected systems, scattered data, and fragmented workflows get in the way.

Our platform brings together people, AI, data, and workflows so IT and service teams can anticipate what matters, act faster, and keep the business moving forward together. Organizations including Bridgestone, McLaren, New Balance, S&P Global, and Sony Music trust Freshworks to power the services their employees and customers depend on every day.  
  
We bring that same belief in coordinated action to how we work by giving people the ownership to make bold moves at speed, and a team that moves with them.

As a **Sales Manager (New Business Acquisition) -** you will drive growth and consistently exceed revenue goals within a defined territory. You’ll win new (strategic/enterprise) accounts, strengthen relationships with existing customers, and apply your SaaS expertise to engage effectively with both business and technical decision-makers.  
  
What you will do:  
  

* **Engage, Discover & Drive Results:** Execute territory strategies to win enterprise business, grow market presence, and consistently exceed targets in an aligned territory (MEA)
* **Execute the Sales Process:** Lead the full sales cycle, from prospecting to negotiation and closure, to deliver predictable, high-performance results.

**Who We Are**

Acuiti Labs is a specialist Global SAP consulting firm headquartered in London, UK, servicing clients globally for ‘Consume to Cash’ process transformation and optimization.

We solve business challenges using fit-for-purpose solution architecture and technology that align with client requirements, enable optimum functionality, and deliver market-winning digital strategies. With expertise in technology R&D, business strategy, and digital transformation, we design efficient solutions, build software platforms, and enable innovation.

For more information, please visit: http://acuitilabs.com

We take pride in having a diverse and talented workforce spread across multiple geographies. As a gender-neutral organization, we strongly believe in Diversity and Inclusion. Our core values include:

* + Excellence
  + Integrity
  + Learning
  + Organisational Pride
  + Respect

**What We Do**

As an SAP Partner specializing in SAP BRIM, Acuiti Labs delivers business technology solutions and digital transformation on SAP S/4HANA and cloud applications such as Subscription Billing, CPQ, and Entitlement Management.

Our expertise supports subscription and consumption-based Target Operating Models across industries: Mobility-as-a-Service, Tourism-as-a-Service, Ports-as-a-Service, Postal-as-a-Service, Telco-as-a-Service, and Software-as-a-Service.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Associate Lead – Talent Acquisition to independently manage end-to end recruitment, primarily for our India operations, while supporting international hiring requirements. The ideal candidate will have strong in-house recruitment experience, proven expertise in SAP S/4HANA hiring, and hands-on experience managing campus recruitment.

The role also requires effective use of AI-powered recruitment tools, ATS platforms and automation to improve hiring efficiency. The candidate should be comfortable working independently with minimal supervision and supporting other HR activities as required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, negotiations, offers and onboarding.
* Drive recruitment for SAP S/4HANA and other niche technology roles.
* Plan and execute India campus hiring, including college relationships, campus drives, graduate recruitment and internship programmes.
* Manage the recruitment process through Keka Hire or another ATS, ensuring accurate data, timely updates, recruitment MIS and reporting.
* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs, provide market insights and ensure timely closures.
* Use AI tools such as LinkedIn Hiring Assistant or equivalent AI-powered sourcing solutions, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for sourcing, Boolean searches, profile analysis, job descriptions, candidate communication and recruitment reporting.
* Identify opportunities to use AI agents, automation and other tools to streamline recruitment workflows and improve productivity.
* Manage salary discussions and offer negotiations, with a strong understanding of Indian compensation structures and market benchmarks.
* Coordinate background verification (BGV) for all new hires and ensure timely completion.
* Support international hiring requirements and work across UK and EST time zones when required.
* Contribute to recruitment process improvements, employee referrals and employer branding initiatives.
* Support other HR activities and projects as required by the business.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 7–10 years of overall Talent Acquisition experience, with at least 5 years in in-house recruitment.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on SAP S/4HANA recruitment experience – mandatory.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment with minimal supervision.
* Mandatory experience independently managing India campus hiring, including campus drives, college relationships, graduate hiring and internships.
* Hands-on experience with Keka Hire or another ATS, including recruitment data management and reporting.
* Practical working knowledge of AI tools, including LinkedIn Hiring Assistant or an equivalent AI-powered recruitment solution, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
* Ability to apply AI tools and automation effectively across sourcing, screening support, recruitment operations and reporting, while maintaining candidate confidentiality and human oversight in hiring decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of Indian salary structures, compensation practices and hiring trends.
* Experience coordinating BGV for new hires.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and take complete ownership of recruitment deliverables.
* Flexibility to support UK and EST time zones as required.

**Good to Have**

* SAP BRIM recruitment experience.
* Exposure to global campus hiring or university partnerships.
* Understanding of compensation benchmarks and hiring practices in the US, UK and Canada.
* Knowledge of international hiring processes and visa requirements.
* Experience with AI agents, recruitment automation and workflow optimisation.

title: Executive Chef - South Indian Cuisine
description:
Group Executive Chef – South Indian Cuisine & Banqueting

**Company:** Madras Square  
**Salary:** ₹1,00,000–₹1,20,000 per month  
**Experience required:** 20+ years in South Indian cuisine  
**Role:** Member of the Madras Square management team, with responsibility across all outlets and the corporate kitchen

About the role

Madras Square has 10 years of experience operating leading food and beverage outlets in Tamil Nadu, with banqueting at every outlet. We are hiring a hands-on Group Executive Chef to develop Indian dishes across our outlets, lead bulk cooking for banquets from our corporate kitchen, and shape the culinary direction of a luxury South Indian fine-dining project.

Key responsibilities

* **Lead culinary operations across the group.** Work with management, outlet chefs and the banqueting team to plan menus, staffing, kitchen capacity and food budgets.
* **Develop new Indian dishes for every outlet.** Trial dishes with outlet teams, assess guest feedback and sales, and introduce recipes that suit each restaurant’s clientele and price point.
* **Build the South Indian fine-dining menu.** Draw on first-hand experience of Karaikudi, the wider Chettinad region and Kongunadu to showcase distinctive ingredients, spice blends and regional cooking techniques.
* **Lead banquet production from the corporate kitchen.** Plan ingredient quantities, batch sizes, staffing, cooking schedules and dispatch for each event, including simultaneous functions at different outlets.
* **Oversee banquet service at the venue.** Coordinate with banquet managers on confirmed guest counts, dietary requirements, buffet replenishment and service timings. Check that dishes retain their flavour, texture and serving temperature from kitchen to buffet.
* **Maintain hands-on command of the South Indian kitchen.** Guide teams on the tawa and cooking range and across tiffin, meals, gravies, biryanis and starters. Set standards for both made-to-order à la carte service and bulk cooking.
* **Standardise recipes and train teams to execute them.** Prepare recipe cards with ingredient weights, yields, portion sizes, batch instructions, food cost and presentation standards.
* **Control food cost and wastage.** Review a weekly report comparing purchases, sales, opening and closing stock, transfers and recorded wastage. Investigate differences between expected and actual consumption and follow up with the chef responsible.
* **Build and manage kitchen teams.** Recruit and mentor sous chefs and section heads, prepare duty rosters, conduct pre-service briefings and develop deputies who can lead service independently.
* **Maintain hygiene and food safety standards.** Oversee receiving, storage, stock rotation, allergen handling, temperature control, cleaning and safe transport between the corporate kitchen and outlets.
* **Lead ingredient sourcing and equipment procurement.** Build a dependable vendor database for regional South Indian ingredients. Evaluate suppliers on quality, consistency and price, and select equipment suited to both bulk production and fine-dining service.
* **Report culinary performance to management.** Present food cost, wastage, menu performance, banquet feedback and staffing needs, with specific actions and follow-through.

Candidate requirements

* At least **20 years of professional experience in South Indian cuisine**, with senior leadership responsibility for kitchen teams.
* Proven experience in **both high-volume banquet cooking and à la carte operations**, including planning production for multiple outlets or events.
* First-hand culinary exposure through travel across Tamil Nadu, with the ability to explain how regional ingredients and methods have influenced dishes you have developed.
* A track record of launching menus, maintaining consistency across teams and using recipe costing, inventory and sales data to make decisions.
* The ability to contribute at the management table and lead from the kitchen during a demanding service.

How to apply

Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please include **the number of outlets and kitchen staff you have managed, the largest banquet you have personally led, and two Tamil regional dishes you have developed or introduced**.

**The team**

Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting

practitioner’s help clients identify and solve their most critical information and transformational challenges. With market-leading expertise in 17 industry segments, superior business transformation capabilities, and deep technical expertise, our global network of more than 33,000 consulting practitioners create unmatched market offerings to solve our clients’ toughest business issues.

Mergers & Acquisitions team helps strategize, design, and implement end-to-end solutions for successful transactions, from advance-planning to post-transaction restructuring. The team helps drive performance for businesses in every key M&A-related function: project management, commercial activity optimization, operations and supply chain, IT systems, human capital management, and finance activities. Learn more about our Strategy & Transactions Practice

  

**Your work profile**

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end-to-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step- wise separation road map
  

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans
  

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre-deal or post-deal M&A transactions in healthcare/pharma/hospitals space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of healthcare chain from a business standpoint
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking
* Relevant understanding of technology landscape of a Healthcare organization would be a key differentiator
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework. MBA preferred
* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Leadership qualities and the ability to mentor junior consultants and analysts
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* This role involves travelling.

Take ownership of major pitches and proposals, ensuring that they are strategically aligned with business goals.

* **People Development**: Craft and maintain high performance standards through clear expectation setting, mentoring, and coaching. Lead learning and development programs to enhance team capabilities, knowledge expansion, and adoption of new technologies. Cultivate leadership within the team, spearheading initiatives targeted at the development of leaders and high-potential individuals. Oversee and strategically plan for succession to ensure long-term organizational resilience and growth.
* **Culture**: Lead by example to uphold and promote company values, actively evangelizing and coaching the team on the core tenets of our culture. Lead efforts that strengthen company culture and engagement. Analyze trends that could indicate cultural challenges and propose improvements
* **Building High-Performing Teams**: Take ownership of building & continuously improving the Foundry. Design cross-functional teams by identifying necessary skills and assembling a team that meets project needs. Foster healthy, inclusive, and collaborative dynamics, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable. Encourage the development of autonomous and self-healing leadership teams. Cultivate communities of practice to enable continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and innovation among team members. Build organizational structures that are scalable and flexible, so teams can adjust to evolving business demands and new technologies.

#### **Company & Craft**

* **Company Strategy**: Cultivate alignment within the team with Formula.Monks goals, ensuring that every decision made supports overarching strategy. Define and lead forward-thinking strategic initiatives that impact Formula.Monks. Manage the budget for internal initiatives, maximizing organizational effectiveness and strategic impact. Lead company growth initiatives.
* **Company Processes**: Maintain compliance with company policies, actively contributing to the improvement and optimization of operational processes. Continually refine Foundry best practices by identifying opportunities for improvement and spearheading changes. Carefully evaluate the necessity of processes, recognizing where flexibility, automation and/or common sense are warranted to optimize efficiency. Lead efforts to share highly impactful processes across teams.
* **Information Exchange**: Effectively communicate strategic decisions from the company to the team. Keep the rest of the leadership team in the loop about significant risks. Create mechanisms to eliminate silos within the team, promoting collaboration across Foundries. Own internal communication to enhance clarity and effectiveness. Engage with the team by eliciting and thoughtfully responding to their questions, concerns, and feedback, fostering an open and transparent communication culture. Lead external evangelism & thought leadership initiatives.

Optimize the use of both billable and non-billable resources to align with project needs and organizational objectives. Regularly update and refine job descriptions to reflect current expectations and requirements. Play an active role in the onboarding of new leaders, working to continuously improve the leadership onboarding process. Define and execute retention strategies to reduce turnover.

People at the Director level report to Senior Directors and above.

title: Sales & Operations Manager
description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
