I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team

***Objective / Purpose:***

The Senior Manager, Pharmacovigilance Operations, serves as a key liaison and point of contact for vendor operations and oversight, including vendors supporting case management, case intake and call-center activities, scientific literature review, and related services. The role provides subject-matter expertise during audits and inspections involving case processing, case management, literature monitoring, legal case processing, and vendor oversight. In collaboration with stakeholders across the broader PSPV organization, the Senior Manager supports harmonized operations and integrated processes that promote regulatory compliance. The role also leads initiatives to improve quality, compliance, productivity, innovation, and efficiency across case processing and related activities.

***Accountabilities:***

* Oversee day-to-day PSPV and PV Operations activities, including the intake, processing, evaluation, reconciliation, follow-up, and regulatory reporting of ICSRs and other safety information for marketed and investigational products. Monitor work against established timelines, quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements, and address operational issues as they arise.
* Implement and maintain PV Operations procedures, SOPs, case-handling conventions, work instructions, metrics, and monitoring activities. Provide practical guidance to local operating companies, affiliates, and delivery teams on ICSR processing, follow-up with reporters and healthcare professionals, targeted safety questionnaires, and applicable privacy and risk-management requirements.
* Manage and develop PV Operations team members through line management, performance management, mentoring, training, delegation, development planning, and day-to-day workload coordination. Promote effective collaboration and consistent execution across the team.
* Coordinate the day-to-day activities and deliverables of BPO/CRO and other PV vendors supporting case intake and processing, expedited reporting, post-marketing activities, literature review and surveillance, and related services. Monitor performance against Quality Management Plans, SLAs, KPIs, MSAs, budgets, timelines, and quality requirements; review deliverables; track issues and escalations; and coordinate corrective actions.

* Work with Business Partners, Vendor Alliance, Quality, Compliance, Commercial Quality, alliance partners, affiliates, and CROs to support safety data exchange and quality agreements, PVA compliance, partner reconciliation, case exchange, and the evaluation, processing, follow-up, and reporting of ICSRs.
* Coordinate the preparation of submission-ready reports from the Global Safety Database and monitor the timely transmission of adverse-event reports to health authorities, alliance partners, and other applicable recipients in accordance with regulatory timelines, agreements, and privacy requirements.
* Coordinate the review, exchange, reconciliation, and follow-up of product complaints and medical-information requests that may represent potential adverse events, working with Quality Assurance and Commercial Quality as needed.
* Monitor global literature-search and review activities and associated vendor deliverables for investigational and post-marketing products. Help ensure that safety information from market research, patient-support programs, IISR studies, post-marketing observational programs, and other sources is appropriately routed into PV Operations.
* Support audit and inspection readiness and execution by coordinating preparation activities, document requests, responses, interviews, root-cause investigations, corrective and preventive actions, implementation, and effectiveness checks for internal and external PV, GMP, and GCP audits and inspections.

* Coordinate and execute process-improvement and change-management activities, including PV system projects affecting the Global Safety Database, UAT, metric reviews, vendor-task quality checks, training, and the development and maintenance of SOPs, job aids, SharePoint materials, and other operational documentation.
* Coordinate with Clinical, Project Management, and other stakeholders to forecast case volumes, support vendor capacity and staffing plans, and execute ad hoc case-processing activities, including legal cases and cases generated through market research, patient-support programs, and post-marketing surveys.
* Organize and facilitate vendor and stakeholder operating meetings to review KPIs, SLAs, quality, demand forecasts, escalations, service delivery, action items, process changes, and improvement activities. Communicate operational requirements, track decisions and follow-up actions, and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
* Support budget planning with Finance and Project Management; monitor vendor spend, review and approve invoices, confirm billing accuracy, and track delivery against contractual and MSA requirements.
* Perform other duties and contribute to additional initiatives as assigned by PV Operations leadership.

***Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):***

* Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in a scientific or medical field is preferred.
* At least 6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, including a minimum of 5 years of pharmacovigilance experience and at least 3 years of experience managing CROs, vendors, and external partnerships. Global experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, including team building, mentoring, motivating, developing, and managing performance.
* Strong knowledge of global pre- and post-market pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and ICH GVP requirements, as well as medical and scientific terminology.
* Advanced understanding of safety databases, including data entry, navigation, case processing, and the use of coding dictionaries such as MedDRA and WHO Drug.

* Proven ability to manage external partner relationships, negotiate effectively, make sound decisions, and represent the department and company professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong strategic, critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions in complex, cross-functional, and global environments and contribute to process improvement aligned with Takeda’s business needs and strategy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present effectively at internal and cross-functional meetings and develop, review, and author SOPs, job aids, and other operational documents.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and flexibly in a fast-paced environment; identify and implement efficiencies; manage multiple competing priorities; and resolve critical issues under pressure.
* Exceptional organizational skills, accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize individual and departmental activities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.

**Travel Requirements:** Local and international travel across Takeda sites may be required based on business needs.

**BENEFITS:** It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career.

Amongst our benefits are:

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children

* Employee Assistance Program

**ABOUT ICC IN TAKEDA:**

* Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We’re not just transforming our company; we’re improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day.

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

Job Description

Diversity & Inclusion Operations Manager for APAC is an advisor and regional connector who partners with leaders, HR and key stakeholders to integrate inclusion into workforce, culture, talent and employee-experience priorities. You will develop and execute the APAC D&I roadmap, enables Employee Resource Groups and site-based engagement, and establishes practical governance, capabilities and measures of impact.

You will work across countries, cultures and time zones and might require regional travel.

* Build shared accountability across business and HR team members by establishing clear operating rhythms, decision rights, tools and capabilities that embed inclusion into leadership and people practices.

**The Essentials – You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Development, Psychology, Social Sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

We welcome professionals with experience in business, HR, organisational development, employee engagement, ERGs, site engagement, change management, or programme leadership who want to improve their careers in Diversity & Inclusion. Relevant D&I training and support will be provided.
* Translate enterprise strategy into regional plans and delivering complex programmes across multiple countries, cultures and partner groups.

* Professional fluency in English and the ability to work across APAC time zones.

* Working knowledge of cultural, workforce and regulatory considerations across multiple APAC markets.
* Manage budgets, external partners, vendors or programs.
* Additional APAC language capability.

**Leadership Competencies Required:**

* Business Insight: Connects D&I priorities to business, workforce, culture and talent outcomes.
* Collaborate: Builds trusted partnerships and shared accountability across a complex matrix organisation.
* Provide clear, audience-relevant advice, facilitation and recommendations.
* Improve Results: Converts strategy into focused plans, governance, measures and sustainable operating rhythms.
* Balances Stakeholders: Integrates enterprise direction, regional needs and local context into sound decisions.
* Cultivate Innovation: Use data, external insight and employee perspectives to improve and scale practices.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team

***Objective / Purpose:***

The Associate Director of PV Ops is responsible for overseeing pharmacovigilance operational activities, including the intake and processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) for Takeda’s marketed products and investigational medicinal products (IMPs). The role provides expertise aligned with established principles and standard practices for operational activities supporting Development and Post-Marketing programs. In addition, the Associate Director is responsible for directing and overseeing PV vendors, operational strategy, contract compliance, the quality and timeliness of deliverables, and continuous improvement across outsourced PV operations. The Associate Director provides line management for PV Operations team members, including setting objectives, supporting professional development, managing performance, and fostering a high-performing and collaborative team. The Associate Director also partners with key stakeholders within and outside the PV organization to ensure harmonized global PV operations and maintain high standards within an integrated operating environment.

***Accountabilities:***

* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for PSPV, PV Operations, and related vendor activities, ensuring the timely, compliant, and high-quality intake, processing, evaluation, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting of ICSRs and other safety information for marketed and investigational products.
* Define and maintain global standards, processes, case-handling conventions, SOPs, policies, metrics, and monitoring mechanisms for PV Operations in compliance with applicable global, regional, regulatory, privacy, and risk-management requirements. Establish guidance for local operating companies and affiliates regarding ICSR processing and follow-up, including reporter and healthcare-professional outreach and targeted safety questionnaires.
* Lead the management and development of the PV Operations organization, including recruitment, retention, line management, performance management, succession and development planning, mentoring, training, delegation, and fostering a high-performing and collaborative team.

* Direct and oversee BPO/CRO and other PV vendors responsible for case intake and processing, expedited reporting, post-marketing activities, literature search and surveillance, and related services. Establish vendor oversight and quality-agreement procedures; monitor performance against Quality Management Plans, SLAs, KPIs, MSAs, budgets, timelines, and quality standards; review deliverables; manage escalations; and represent vendor perspectives within the PV function.
* Partner with Business Partners, Vendor Alliance, Quality, Compliance, Commercial Quality, alliance partners, affiliates, CROs, and other stakeholders to develop, review, and approve safety data exchange agreements and quality agreements; ensure appropriate safety-reporting requirements; oversee PVA compliance; manage partner reconciliation and case exchange; and coordinate the evaluation, processing, follow-up, and regulatory reporting of ICSRs.
* Ensure the preparation of submission-ready regulatory reports from the Global Safety Database and the timely delivery of adverse-event reports to global health authorities, alliance partners, and other applicable parties in accordance with regulatory timelines, safety data exchange agreements, and privacy requirements.
* Oversee the collection, exchange, review, identification, reconciliation, and follow-up of product complaints and medical-information requests that may represent potential adverse events, in collaboration with Quality Assurance and Commercial Quality.
* Provide oversight of global literature-search and review processes, including vendor services supporting investigational and post-marketing products. Ensure that activities associated with market research, patient-support programs, IISR studies, post-marketing observational programs, and other sources of safety information are appropriately connected to post-marketing PV Operations.
* Lead audit and inspection readiness for PV Operations, including preparation activities, participation in internal and external PV, GMP, and GCP audits and inspections, support for inspector interviews and document requests, preparation of responses, root-cause investigations, corrective and preventive action plans, implementation, and effectiveness checks.
* Lead continuous-improvement, change-management, and operational-transformation initiatives, including PV business-system projects affecting the Global Safety Database, UAT, process improvements, metric reviews, ad hoc vendor-task quality control, ongoing training, and the development and maintenance of operational materials and SharePoint resources.
* Coordinate with Clinical, Project Management, and other relevant teams to forecast case volumes, plan vendor capacity and staffing, and manage ad hoc case-processing projects, including legal cases and adverse events or serious adverse events generated through market research, patient-support programs, and post-marketing surveys.
* Lead and facilitate joint operating committee meetings with vendors and stakeholders to review KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, demand forecasts, escalations, service delivery, change-management activities, continuous-improvement initiatives, and innovation opportunities.
* Partner with Finance and Project Management on budget planning, review vendor spend, approve invoices, confirm billing accuracy, and ensure delivery in accordance with contractual and MSA terms.
* Provide guidance to delivery teams, ensure consistent quality across PSPV Operations, communicate operational requirements and expectations, and perform other responsibilities as assigned by PV Operations leadership.
* Perform other duties and contribute to additional initiatives as assigned by PV Operations leadership.

***Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):***

* Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in a scientific or medical field is preferred.
* At least 10 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, including a minimum of 7 years of pharmacovigilance experience and at least 3 years of experience managing CROs, vendors, and external partnerships. Global experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, including team building, mentoring, motivating, developing, and managing performance.
* Strong knowledge of global pre- and post-market pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and ICH GVP requirements, as well as medical and scientific terminology.
* Advanced understanding of safety databases, including data entry, navigation, case processing, and the use of coding dictionaries such as MedDRA and WHO Drug.
* Proven ability to manage external partner relationships, negotiate effectively, make sound decisions, and represent the department and company professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong strategic, critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions in complex, cross-functional, and global environments and contribute to process improvement aligned with Takeda’s business needs and strategy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present effectively at internal and cross-functional meetings and develop, review, and author SOPs, job aids, and other operational documents.

* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and flexibly in a fast-paced environment; identify and implement efficiencies; manage multiple competing priorities; and resolve critical issues under pressure.
* Exceptional organizational skills, accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize individual and departmental activities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.

**Travel Requirements:** Local and international travel across Takeda sites may be required based on business needs.

**BENEFITS:** It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career.

Amongst our benefits are:

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms

* Reimbursements – Home Internet & Mobile Phone

* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.

description:
Brand Fortunes is an end-to-end e-commerce solutions provider helping brands grow their businesses across leading online marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Ajio and others. Founded by professionals with over 30 years of combined experience in leading fashion and e-retail companies, we work closely with brands to manage, operate and grow their online marketplace businesses.

We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented and hands-on E-Commerce Operations Manager who can lead our marketplace operations team, manage the business performance of our partner brands and ensure seamless execution across all online marketplaces.

This is an ownership-driven role that requires someone who can manage people, drive business growth, solve complex operational problems and take quick decisions when things don't go as planned.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Team Management & Leadership**

* Manage and supervise a team of approximately 6 E-Commerce Operations Executives responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple partner brands.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure clear ownership of tasks across the team.
* Monitor daily productivity, work quality and timely completion of operational activities.
* Train, guide and mentor team members to improve their marketplace knowledge and operational capabilities.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), processes and reporting mechanisms to improve team efficiency.
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective action to ensure consistent execution.

**2. Partner Brand Business Management & Growth**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the marketplace business and performance of assigned partner brands.
* Regularly monitor sales, revenue, inventory, catalogue performance and other key business metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales through better product availability, catalogue optimisation, pricing and marketplace execution.
* Analyse business performance and identify the reasons behind sales declines, poor-performing products and operational bottlenecks.
* Work closely with partner brands to understand their business requirements and develop action plans to improve performance.
* Proactively identify business opportunities and recommend initiatives to drive marketplace growth.
* Conduct regular business reviews and share actionable insights and performance reports with partner brands.

**3. Problem Solving & Escalation Management**

* Take ownership of critical operational issues and ensure they are resolved on a priority basis.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex marketplace-related problems faced by the operations team or partner brands.
* Resolve urgent issues relating to orders, inventory, catalogue listings, account health, marketplace penalties, payment issues and other operational disruptions.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams and partner brands to ensure quick resolution of critical issues.
* Anticipate potential operational risks and take preventive action before they impact business performance.
* Demonstrate the ability to think on your feet, prioritise effectively and make quick decisions in challenging situations.

**4. Marketplace Operations & Process Excellence**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Ajio and other marketplaces.
* Oversee catalogue management, order processing, inventory management, returns and other operational activities.
* Ensure adherence to marketplace policies, guidelines and operational requirements.
* Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements to enhance productivity and reduce operational errors.
* Develop dashboards and MIS reports to track business performance, team productivity and operational efficiency.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 4–7 years of experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management or online business management.
* Prior experience managing a team, preferably in e-commerce or marketplace operations.
* Strong understanding of Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Ajio or other online marketplace operations.
* Good understanding of marketplace business metrics, including sales, revenue, inventory, catalogue performance and order fulfilment.
* Strong analytical skills with good working knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to take ownership, make independent decisions and drive tasks to completion.
* Proactive approach with a strong bias for action and execution.

**Who Should Apply?**

This opportunity is particularly suitable for candidates who have previously worked as:

* E-Commerce Operations Managers.
* Marketplace Operations Managers.
* Amazon or Flipkart Account Managers.
* E-Commerce Team Leaders or Senior Executives.
* Marketplace Business Managers.
* E-Commerce Category or Business Operations Professionals.

Candidates who have managed teams, handled multiple marketplace accounts and taken responsibility for business performance will be preferred.

**Important:** We are looking for hands-on professionals who are comfortable getting into operational details, solving problems themselves when required and taking complete ownership of outcomes. This is not a purely supervisory or reporting-oriented role.

**Why Join Brand Fortunes?**

* Opportunity to lead and build an e-commerce operations team.
* Direct responsibility for managing and growing the online businesses of multiple brands.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Job Description – Area Sales Manager (ASM)

\*Industry:\* FMCG / Sports & Sporting Goods / Channel Sales / Distribution

\*Experience:\* 5–10 Years

\*Job Location:\* South India (Regional Travel Required)

\*Employment Type:\* Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and experienced \*Area Sales Manager (ASM)\* to drive sales growth, strengthen distribution networks, and expand market presence across the assigned region.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in FMCG, channel sales, and distribution management, along with proven capabilities in leading sales teams, managing distributors, developing new markets, and achieving business targets.

The candidate will be responsible for driving regional sales performance, improving market penetration, building strong customer relationships, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

1. Qualifications & Requirements

- Any graduate with \*5–10 years of relevant experience\* in FMCG, Channel Sales, Distribution, or related industries.

- Proven experience in managing regional or area-level sales operations.

- Strong understanding of distributor management, retail channel development, and market expansion.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and team management skills.

- Proficiency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of regional languages will be an added advantage.

- Willingness to travel extensively across South India as per business requirements.

- Strong analytical, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

- Ability to work independently and deliver results within defined timelines.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

A. Sales & Business Development

- Develop and execute effective sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.

- Drive revenue growth, market penetration, and product-wise sales performance across the assigned territory.

- Identify new business opportunities, potential markets, and untapped customer segments.

- Develop and implement regional business plans aligned with the company's overall sales objectives.

- Monitor sales performance and take corrective actions to ensure consistent target achievement.

B. Distribution & Channel Management

- Build, strengthen, and manage an effective distributor and dealer network across the assigned region.

- Identify and appoint new distributors, dealers, and key retail partners to expand market reach.

- Improve distributor productivity, secondary sales, stock availability, and market coverage.

- Ensure effective order planning, inventory management, and timely market replenishment.

- Monitor distributor performance, business potential, and operational efficiency.

- Develop strategies to improve retailer engagement, dealer activation, and channel loyalty.

C. Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Lead, motivate, and manage the regional sales team to achieve individual and overall business targets.

- Assign clear territories, responsibilities, sales targets, and performance expectations to team members.

- Conduct regular performance reviews and business plan review meetings with the sales team.

- Accompany team members on market visits to monitor field performance and provide on-the-job coaching.

- Identify performance gaps and implement structured performance improvement plans.

- Focus on continuous training, motivation, mentoring, and professional development of the sales team.

- Recognise high performers and take appropriate corrective action in cases of consistent non-performance.

D. Market Development & Competitor Analysis

- Conduct regular market visits and research to understand market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities.

- Analyse competitor pricing, product positioning, promotional schemes, and distribution strategies.

- Recommend innovative sales initiatives and market development strategies to strengthen the company's competitive position.

- Identify opportunities for new product launches, market penetration, and business expansion.

- Provide actionable market intelligence and feedback to management.

E. Marketing, Promotions & Brand Visibility

- Plan and execute regional promotional activities, visibility programs, and dealer engagement initiatives.

- Develop creative promotional strategies to attract new customers and strengthen existing customer relationships.

- Drive product awareness, brand visibility, and retail activation across the assigned territory.

- Recommend effective schemes, campaigns, and market activation programs based on regional business requirements.

- Ensure effective execution and monitoring of promotional activities in the market.

F. Customer Relationship & Business Coordination

- Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, dealers, retailers, and key business partners.

- Ensure customer satisfaction through regular engagement, timely issue resolution, and business support.

- Develop long-term customer relationships to improve retention and business growth.

- Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth execution of sales operations and customer commitments.

- Build professional networks to generate referrals and identify new business opportunities.

G. Reporting & Business Review

- Prepare and review periodic sales reports, territory performance reports, and business development updates.

- Track sales targets versus achievements and identify areas requiring improvement.

- Monitor key business indicators, including primary sales, secondary sales, distribution reach, outlet coverage, and collection performance.

- Conduct periodic business review meetings with the sales team and distributors.

- Share regular market feedback, competitor insights, and growth recommendations with management.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

- Achievement of regional sales targets.

- Distributor appointment and network expansion.

- Secondary sales growth and retail market penetration.

- Improvement in active outlet coverage and dealer productivity.

- Sales team productivity and target achievement.

- Collection efficiency and outstanding receivables management.

- Brand visibility and promotional activity execution.

- New market development and customer acquisition.

4. Desired Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive and business-minded sales professional who:

- Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for regional business performance.

- Has the ability to lead teams and drive results through effective execution.

- Possesses excellent market knowledge and distributor relationship management skills.

- Is commercially aware and capable of identifying growth opportunities.

- Has a strong field-oriented approach with a willingness to work closely with the sales team.

- Is committed to building a high-performance, disciplined, and achievement-oriented sales culture.

\*If you are passionate about sales leadership, market expansion, and building successful distribution networks, we would love to hear from you!\*

Lead the end-to-end Business Support function for WPP Production, ensuring reliable 24/7 support across front-line application support, client-facing digital support and technology service management. The role owns the support operating model from initial demand and L1 triage through L2 service ownership and escalation to L3 engineering, vendors or managed service providers. It is accountable for establishing, maturing and owning the Service Introduction capability, alongside service governance, operational readiness and acceptance, platform stability, stakeholder communication and continual improvement. Working side by side with Product, Engineering and DevSecOps, the role will address the current Service Introduction capability gap by creating a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach through which frequent product change, major releases and increasingly complex integrations transition efficiently into BAU support. The role also provides governance and performance oversight for managed service providers, including alignment of service-introduction and acceptance requirements.

**What you'll be doing:**

**KRA 1: Service Leadership and Operational Performance**  

* Set and lead the 24/7 support strategy, service model and operating structure across retained and managed service teams, with clear escalation routes to L3 engineering and suppliers.
* Ensure demand received through service management channels is understood, categorised, prioritised, resolved or routed appropriately, with clear ownership and communication through to closure.
* Maintain a responsive, SLA-driven service for internal teams and client agencies, minimising disruption and ensuring support interactions are clear, structured and professional.

  
**KRA 2: Service Introduction, Transition and Operational Readiness**  

* Establish, mature and own the Service Introduction and support-acceptance capability for new and changed services, addressing the current capability gap and ensuring changes transition efficiently into BAU support.
* Design, implement and continuously improve proportionate, risk-based Service Introduction and operational-readiness criteria for incremental product change, major releases, new platforms and complex integrations.
* Work with Product, Engineering, DevSecOps, delivery teams and service providers early in the lifecycle so support requirements, dependencies, monitoring, documentation, knowledge transfer and escalation models are established before release.
* Ensure service-introduction and operational-readiness requirements align with the acceptance standards of relevant managed service providers, including Kyndryl where applicable.
* Establish clear ownership and support models for end-to-end integrations that span applications, engineering teams, suppliers and service providers.

  
**KRA 3: Service Governance, Stability and Risk**  

* Define and maintain service governance, support structures, change enablement, path-to-production and regular service reviews, with clear boundaries between delivery ownership and support acceptance.
* Safeguard the health, reliability, scalability and long-term stability of business-critical workflow, production and digital platforms through monitoring, maintenance, upgrades and production control.
* Ensure releases and changes are operationally ready and followed by appropriate validation and service-health checks.
* Ensure appropriate processes for user access, permissions, password resets and application licence administration, including coordination with service providers where required.

  
**KRA 4: Incident, Problem and Escalation Management**  

* Provide senior oversight for major or complex incidents; ensure timely escalation from L1 to L2 and onward to L3 engineering or suppliers, with effective stakeholder updates.
* Drive proactive Problem Management, recurring-incident reduction, root-cause analysis and follow-through of corrective actions.

  
**KRA 5: Managed Service Provider and Supplier Management**  

* Govern managed service providers and key support suppliers, ensuring clear operational interfaces, performance management, escalation, service reviews and continuous improvement.
* Ensure retained and outsourced support teams operate as an effective end-to-end service and that provider acceptance requirements are integrated into Service Introduction.

  
**KRA 6: Continuous Improvement and Service Performance**  

* Drive process optimisation, automation, documentation, reporting and system improvements that increase service quality, efficiency and operational resilience.
* Establish measures for both BAU service performance and the maturity and effectiveness of Service Introduction, including transition quality, operational readiness and avoidable post-release support issues.

* Lead and develop the three managers and their distributed teams, building clear accountability, capability, succession and effective collaboration across support levels and service providers.

  
**KRA 8: Commercial and Financial Management**  

* Oversee platform cost management, purchase orders and invoices, and support Enterprise Technology budget and forecasting activity for the agencies, subject to agreed ownership.
* Support effective commercial and performance governance of managed service providers and suppliers.

  
**KRA 9: Cross-functional Alignment**

Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.

  

**Experience:** 10+ years.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Lead the Consulting delivery**

* Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
* Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
* Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
* Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
* Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
* Own engagement P&L, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
* Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
* Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
* Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
* Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
* Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.

  

**Shape and deliver Data & AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle**

* **Ideate:** Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
* **Design:** Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
* **Build:** Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
* **Operate:** Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
* **Sunset:** Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.

  

**Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening**

* Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
* Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
* Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractal's footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
* Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio. **Technical Skills**
* Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
* Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
* Familiarity with the client's native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI, Azure and related components, enough to guide solution design, technical conversations and delivery on it.
* Fluency in GenAI: how GenAI applications are designed, built, evaluated, governed and run, and where they do and do not fit a business problem.
* Ability to hold credible conversations with technical stakeholders and to translate business requirements into technical language and solution designs that BI, engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI teams can act on.
* Understanding of how analytics solutions are run and retired: monitoring, model and data drift, cost of ownership, support and decommissioning.
* Knowledge of a variety of advanced analytics and machine learning techniques (for example segmentation and forecasting), and the ability to evaluate and bring in new techniques that add value for clients.

• Ability to design and review new solution concepts, with a record of leading the delivery of high-impact analytics solutions and programs for global clients. • Functional familiarity across one or more of the areas our use cases span: the enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement, with the ability to apply domain and analytics knowledge to them. • Experience designing KPI frameworks and executive dashboards that make performance measurable and decisions data-driven.

* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps delivery practices and how to apply them to analytics and BI programs.

  

**Non-Technical Skills**

* Exceptional consulting skills with a proven track record of delivering high-value solutions. Ability to Engages stakeholders, spots likely business problems, builds compelling POVs for execution roadmaps that grow Fractal's business.
* Executive presence, with a track record of engaging at Senior Director and VP level, the ability to influence and engage senior client and internal stakeholders, and the ability to drive senior groups to conclusions.
* Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: structures ambiguous business problems clearly, innovates where required and looks beyond the build to long term value and cost of ownership.
* 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in leadership roles, leading teams distributed across multiple locations.
* Excellent project and program management skills, with experience managing multiple work streams and projects at the same time.
* Business acumen to manage revenue profitably and meet financial goals consistently, with the ability to quantify business value for clients and create win-win commercial propositions.

  

**Education Qualification and Certifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Advanced degrees (MBA, MS) or relevant certifications are preferred. Examples include Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, other cloud platform and machine learning project certifications, Lean Six Sigma, and Agile or program management credentials.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Senior Manager - Commercial Reporting Excellence
description:
Posted date Nov. 19, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-264686

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-264686 **Date posted** 11/19/2026

**GCL: E**
----------

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to industrialise how reporting is delivered—using process excellence, AI and agentic workflows—to absorb growing demand without adding manual effort? This role develops the future of commercial reporting by transforming fragmented processes into a scalable, consistent, and increasingly agent-assisted operating model. It frees teams to focus on high-value interpretation and decision support.

As the enterprise-wide lead for reporting transformation, you will be responsible for the roadmap, set common standards, and build reusable capabilities that improve cycle time, quality and cost-to-serve. You will work horizontally across reporting teams to eliminate unnecessary work, rationalise the portfolio and orchestrate adoption of AI-enabled workflows that are safe, governed and trusted. How would you redesign end-to-end workflows to put human judgement where it adds the most value?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Transformation Roadmap Ownership: Build an end-to-end view of reporting demand, services, workflows, technology, capacity, cost and performance. Lead the cross-portfolio approach to reporting excellence, setting the direction for standardisation, automation and agentification.
* Process and Workflow Redesign: Challenge established processes, hand-offs and controls before automating. Apply Lean and process-excellence methods to eliminate failure demand and unnecessary activity. Redesign workflows around human and AI-agent delivery and lead a prioritised backlog from discovery through adoption and benefits realisation.
* Portfolio Optimisation: Maintain visibility of demand, usage, value, cost-to-serve, ownership and lifecycle status. Apply a consistent framework to retain, enhance, consolidate, automate, convert to self-service, AI-enable or retire reporting assets. Lead cross-service solutions that reduce duplication, manual effort, variation and technical debt.
* AI Enablement and Agentification: Embed AI, generative AI, intelligent automation and agentic workflows into development, production, quality and consumption. Develop reusable capabilities for commentary, quality assurance, anomaly detection, conversational access, documentation, lineage, developer productivity and workflow coordination. Assess opportunities for value, feasibility, scalability, adoption, quality, cost and sustainability, retaining human oversight where it contributes.
* Standards and Reusable Capabilities: Set enterprise-wide standards for development, user experience, documentation, testing, deployment and lifecycle management. Establish common definitions, metrics, frameworks, templates and technical components to support scalable, automated and self-service delivery. Monitor adoption and challenge exceptions that create avoidable cost, complexity or risk.
* Responsible AI and Governance: Establish practical guardrails covering security, privacy, access, accuracy, hallucination and model risk, oversight, explainability, lifecycle monitoring and cost. Define when AI is the right answer versus standard reporting, conventional automation or process simplification. Align with enterprise technology, data, information security and governance standards.
* Ecosystem Partnership and Adoption: Co-create priorities with business partners, anchoring change in customer problems and outcomes. Partner across technology, data and automation teams to align roadmaps, reuse capabilities and avoid duplication. Adopt enterprise platforms, data products, components and agents where they meet needs, and build a reporting-excellence community of practice.
* Measurement and Benefits Realisation: Baseline demand, effort, cost, cycle time, quality, usage and customer experience. Maintain a clear scorecard covering demand absorbed without proportional growth, capacity released and reinvested, workflows redesigned, assets retired, automation/agentification, reuse, quality, cycle time, cost-to-serve, adoption and satisfaction; ensure benefits are evidenced, sustained and reported.
* Time-Phased Outcomes: Immediate (0-6 months): baseline demand, assets, workflows, effort, cost, quality and cycle time; agree standards and roadmap; mobilise the top five to ten opportunities.
* 6-12 months: release measurable capacity; deploy controlled agent-assisted workflows; consolidate low-value reporting; reuse common components; improve cycle time, quality and cost-to-serve.
* Manage growing demand over 12-24 months without proportional resource growth. Deliver a significant share of repeatable reporting using standardized, automated, or agent-assisted workflows. Refocus human effort on interpretation, decision support, and exceptions.
* Longer term: evolve from leading the initial transformation to owning continuous excellence, productivity and innovation in reporting—optimising the human-and-AI delivery model, increasing reuse and autonomous delivery, managing portfolio economics and preventing the reintroduction of unnecessary complexity and manual work.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* 8-12 years across reporting, BI, commercial analytics, process excellence, digital transformation or a related field.
* Proven enterprise reporting transformation through standardisation, rationalisation, automation or AI, including complex cross-functional process redesign.
* Strong understanding of reporting operating models, lifecycle management, AI, generative AI, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, Databricks, Snowflake or comparable platforms.
* Strong structured problem-solving, business-case, benefits, stakeholder-management and influencing skills in a global matrix.
* Life Sciences or pharmaceutical commercial reporting experience strongly preferred.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

Human and AI-agent operating models; process mining, value-stream mapping, Lean or Six Sigma; portfolio rationalisation; AI governance and model risk; automation programmes; communities of practice; benefits tracking; pharmaceutical data and compliance.

**Why AstraZeneca:**
--------------------

Here you will help power the enterprise so teams across science and the business can focus on what matters most: delivering life-changing medicines to patients. We bring unexpected teams into the same room to turn bold ideas into working solutions, combining modern AI with practical delivery and a culture that values curiosity, persistence and ambition. You’ll collaborate across a global network, leverage enterprise platforms and rich data products, and have the trust and accountability to run fast, learn quickly and make measurable impact on efficiency, quality and outcomes.

**Call to Action:**
-------------------

Take the lead in architecting the future of commercial reporting at scale and turn your expertise in AI and process excellence into lasting impact for AstraZeneca and the patients we serve.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

**Reasons to Join**

**What we offer**

### **Lifelong learning**

Our development opportunities are second to none. You'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly as you accelerate your career. From leadership projects and constructive coaching to overseas talent exchanges and global collaboration programmes, you'll never stand still.

Experience the power of shaping your career how you want to. We are a high-performing learning organisation with autonomy over how we learn. Make big decisions, learn from your mistakes and continue growing — with performance-based rewards as part of the package.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https:// www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd

**Global Corporate Solutions**  
Reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Administrative Officer, Global Corporate Solutions (GCS) brings together the functions of Corporate Real Estate and Corporate Services.
  
  
**About the Unit**  
The Corporate Services (GCSCS) division within GCS provides services to the WBG in the areas of Travel and Visa Services; Food and Conference Services; Staff Services, including Commuter Services, Child Care, and Fitness Center; Mail and Shipping Services; the Art Program; Translation and Interpretation; Customer Service; Design and Publications; Printing; and Interactive Media. GCSCS also provides administrative oversight to the WBG Family Network and 1818 Society and is responsible for setting the policy framework and service standards, and for delivering services through a combination of staff and vendors at WBG headquarters (HQ) in Washington, DC and in Country Offices. GCSCS has about 130 staff and about 500 contractors.  
  
To achieve its mission, GCSCS is organized into four main units: (i) Travel and Client Services (GCSTC), (ii) Business Services (GCSBA), (iii) Innovation and Client Solutions (GCSIS), and (iv) Global Business Centers (GCSBC). This position is part of the GCSIS unit’s Processing & Analytics (GCSPA) team.  
This position will be based in Chennai, India, and reports to Senior Program Manager, GCSPA, located in Washington, DC (HQ). This position is also expected to work a night shift (up until 12:00am) to support a global client base.  
  
**DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**  
  
The Program Analyst will provide operational support the World Bank Group’s Fleet Management and Asset Management work programs. The role will provide analytical, transactional, and support to HQ teams and Country Offices. It will help maintain reliable records, strengthen controls, monitor requests, and improve service delivery across both programs.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
  

* Support Fleet and Asset Management operations by coordinating requests, tracking actions, following up with stakeholders, and maintaining clear process records.
* Maintain accurate fleet and asset data, including vehicle inventory, ownership, location, mileage, insurance, maintenance, asset master records, property numbers, inventory status, and disposal information.
* Support vehicle request reviews, consolidation, prioritization, procurement follow-up, delivery tracking, replacement planning, and disposal activities using approved criteria and available information.
* Process and review asset-related activities, including asset creation, bulk uploads, SAP master data updates, inventory reviews, disposal worklists, asset retirement, and supporting documentation.
* Analyze operational data, volumes, costs, aging, utilization, maintenance trends, inventory results, and pending requests. Prepare dashboards, regular reports, and management updates.
* Work with multi-stakeholders across many time zones, including Country Offices, Accounting (CTR), Corporate Procurement (WBP), Corporate Security (CSD), IT (ITS), vendors, and other partners to resolve issues, improve data quality, and support timely completion of requests.
* Document procedures, strengthen controls, support SAP ARIA testing and process validation, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and continuous improvement
* Provide comprehensive vendor cost analysis and historical spend data to support RFP evaluations and management.
* Provide historical spend, market comparisons, and vendor cost analysis to support procurement exercises, budget reviews, and management decisions.
* Work closely with GCS Corporate Real Estate as it relates to policy governance of both Asset Management and Fleet Management policies (both pending).

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, interpret, and present complex operational and financial data to support decision-making.
* Experience in data analytics, reporting, business process analysis, transaction processing, or operational support functions.
* Experience with fleet management, asset management, and/or procurement is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop dashboards, management reports, performance metrics, and actionable insights for business stakeholders.
* Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across organizational and geographic boundaries.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy.
* Strong client-service orientation with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate analytical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, vendors, and stakeholders from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, SAP, or similar business intelligence platforms.
* Experience in utilizing AI tools, where appropriate, to improve work efficiency, productivity, and the quality of outputs.

  
**KEY COMPETENCIES**  

* Delivery Results for Clients: Adds value by constantly looking for a better way to get more impactful results. Identifies and proposes solutions to mitigate and manage risks.
* Collaborate Within Teams and Across Boundaries: Ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues in multidisciplinary teams, brings differing ideas into the forefront, and initiates collaboration across boundaries.
* Lead and Innovate: Contributes to new insights to understand situations and develops solutions to resolve complex problems. Identifies and pursues innovative approaches to resolve issues.
* Create, Apply and Share Knowledge: Leverage departments and WBG body of knowledge by applying lessons learned and expertise. Actively invests in knowledge and seeks feedback.
* Make Smart Decisions: Seeks diversity of information and inputs, researches possible solutions, and generates recommended options. Identifies and understands risks and proposes recommendations. Based on risk analysis, makes decisions in a timely manner within own area of responsibility, considering the interests and concerns of stakeholders.
* Client Orientation: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for timely response to client queries, requests, or needs, working to remove obstacles that may impede execution or overall success.
* Flexibility: Able to adapt strategy, and objectives; making corresponding structural or organizational changes as needed, to move the work forward and meet the needs of the situation.
* Business Judgment and Analytical Decision Making: Analyzes facts and data to support sound, logical decisions regarding own and others' work.
* Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively and sensitively in a multi-cultural and multi-ethnic workplace.
* Pressure: Ability to handle demands related to the delivery of multiple tasks within demanding and occasionally conflicting time constraints.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies

*The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.*

*We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.*

description:

**Key Account Manager**
– Client Delivery | Scope Governance | Digital Strategy Full-Time | Work From Office | Banjara Hills, Hyderabad | Reports to: Pod Manager

**Company Description**

Digital Mojo is a results-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high-impact marketing campaigns.

**Key Account Manager**

You own day-to-day client communication, delivery tracking, scope discipline, and performance reporting across social media, SEO, and performance marketing. You are expected to understand the numbers, ask the right questions, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

This is not a coordination assistant role. This is an ownership role.

* Not someone who only forwards feedback between teams
* Not a passive participant in client calls
* Not someone who escalates every issue upward
* Not a reporting-only or scheduling-only function

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client SPOC and Communication**

* Act as the single point of contact for all assigned client accounts
* Own client communication across WhatsApp, email, and calls with speed and professionalism
* Lead weekly review calls and monthly performance discussions
* Translate client requirements into clear internal briefs for creative, performance, and SEO teams

**2. Scope Governance and Delivery Management**

* Own the scope document for each account and protect it
* Track all monthly deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing

* Read and interpret dashboards and reports across all channels with confidence

* Identify upsell or expansion opportunities through active client conversations
* Flag new requirements or scope additions to the Pod Manager

* Client Satisfaction Score

* On-Time Delivery Percentage
* Client Retention Rate
* Report Accuracy and Submission Timeliness
* Communication Turnaround Time
* Escalation Response Time

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 2 - 4 years of experience in a digital marketing agency in a client-facing role
* Strong working knowledge of social media marketing, SEO, and performance marketing
* Ability to read and interpret marketing dashboards, ad reports, and analytics
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4, and SEO reporting tools
* Experience handling multiple client accounts simultaneously
* Strong English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in managing client calls and difficult conversations
* Organised, detail-orientated, and consistent with follow-through
* Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field preferred

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Agency experience is mandatory
* Has managed at least 4-6 accounts simultaneously in a previous role
* Understands performance marketing and SEO well enough to hold strategic conversations
* The character in the sitcom is Rachel

**Reporting Structure**

Key Account Manager → Pod Manager → Group Account Manager → Delivery Head

Full-Time, Work From Office, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad

Health Insurance | Provident Fund | Leave Encashment

description:
