Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
You are customer-obsessed and a trusted advisor in both AI solutions and organizational change management. For companies on their Agentic Enterprise journey, the path to value isn't just about turning the software on — it's about continuous optimization, cultural adoption, and governance of AI solutions.
  
  
As a Customer Success Senior Manager, you are a key driver of value for your customers. You move beyond initial implementation to ensure deep, operationalized adoption of contracted use cases. You help keep the "AI Flywheel" spinning by collaborating with a cross-functional ecosystem of internal Salesforce teams and consulting partners, leveraging agent telemetry to drive data-informed improvements, and identifying the next high-impact opportunities for your customers.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Support the Customer Center of Excellence (CoE): Partner with customers in building and nurturing their internal CoE. Train "Agent Champions" and empower customers to independently iterate, govern, and scale their AI footprint.
* Data-Driven Governance & Telemetry: Monitor agent performance telemetry, success rates, and friction points to identify where agents are stalling. Use data-driven insights to proactively recommend optimizations to the customer's workflows.
* Ecosystem Collaboration: Support the customer's Agentic Enterprise journey by coordinating with Salesforce Account Executives, Professional Services, and Third-Party Consulting Partners/SIs to ensure a unified customer experience.
* Drive Deep Consumption: Proactively manage the roadmap for contracted licenses and consumption credits. Success is measured by the customer's ability to fully utilize their investment against high-impact processes.
* Value Realization & ROI: Define, track, and report on quantifiable business impact. Move the conversation from "technical deployment" to "business outcomes" (e.g., reducing stock-outs, automating manual triage, and improving planner productivity) using platform data.
* Consultative Use Case Identification: Use your knowledge of industry processes to identify opportunities where deploying additional AI agents can solve real business friction points. Help build the business case for new use cases, shifting customers from reactive usage to proactive, strategic expansion.
* Remove Adoption Barriers: Identify and help neutralize friction — whether it's data quality issues in Data Cloud, user resistance, or business process misalignment — that prevents the scaling of Agentforce.
* Voice of the Customer: Serve as a bridge between the customer's operational reality and Salesforce Product and Engineering teams to help ensure the roadmap addresses real-world challenges.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 9+ years of work experience, with 3+ years in Customer Success, Professional Services, or Management Consulting, focused on adoption and change management for enterprise SaaS — preferably in Supply Chain/Manufacturing or Financial Services.
* Governance Support: Experience participating in or supporting governance frameworks or Steering Committees for large-scale digital transformation projects.
* Analytical Fluency: Strong ability to interpret platform telemetry, usage data, and performance dashboards to derive actionable insights for customers.
* Consumption Model Experience: Track record of managing consumption-based accounts, focusing on driving utilization through value-based activity.
* Strategic Communication: Strong ability to present AI outcomes to senior business stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into tangible business value.
* AI Fluency: A solid understanding of AI/LLM logic and the ability to translate technical "agentic" capabilities into business outcomes.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Industry Domain Expertise: Experience navigating complex business processes within Supply Chain/Manufacturing (ERP, MRP, Logistics) OR Financial Services (Banking, Insurance, Wealth Management, Regulatory/Compliance workflows).
* Systems & Back-office Process Familiarity: Experience working within complex enterprise ecosystems (ERP, MRP, TMS) and understanding manufacturing/logistics workflows.
* Salesforce Ecosystem: Familiarity with Data Cloud, Agentforce, or Slack-based workflow automations.
* Certifications: Salesforce certifications (e.g., Administrator, AI Associate) a plus.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-Manager IAM Consultant-ISAM**
As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 8 – 14 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

title: Manager, Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced
**Manager, Solution Architecture**
to lead and scale our team of Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Solution Architects (SAs) & Implementation Engineers (IEs). In this role, you will be responsible for building, mentoring, and leading a high-performing team that delivers both hands-on technical architecture during implementations and long-term technical account management throughout the customer lifecycle. You will serve as an escalation point for enterprise clients, optimize technical delivery methodologies, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership to drive customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* People Leadership: 10+ years of experience in managing customer-facing technical teams (e.g., TAMs, Solution Architects, Implementation Engineers, or Solutions Engineers) in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Technical Background: 6+ years of hands-on experience in technical architecture, API integration design, RESTful web services, and enterprise data modeling.
* Enterprise Systems Experience: Deep domain expertise in CRM integrations (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365), SSO standards (SAML/OAuth), and SQL/SOQL.
* Strategic Operations & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of managing enterprise escalations, defining operational KPIs, accelerating team operations through AI-powered workflows, and presenting to client C-suite stakeholders.
* Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to bridge technical and business discussions across internal and external teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Prior experience scaling post-sales technical teams in Sales Enablement, Enterprise Content Management, or MarTech SaaS platforms.
* Experience managing a dual-function team (combining professional services/implementation with post-sales advisory).

**What you’ll be doing:**
**Team Leadership, Mentorship & Enablement**

* Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Account Managers and Solution Architects.
* Provide ongoing coaching, technical mentorship, and performance management to support individual career growth across both technical architecture and account management tracks.
* Establish clear team KPIs, capacity planning, and resource allocation models to balance implementation workloads with ongoing account advisory needs.
* Technical Delivery, Strategy & Governance
* Define and standardize best practices for technical onboarding, integration design (APIs, SSO, SMTP, MCP, data models, CRM integrations), and solution architecture documentation.
* Oversee technical account management frameworks to ensure proactive health checks, SLA compliance, and systematic risk mitigation across key enterprise accounts.
* Serve as the executive technical escalation point for critical client integrations, complex architecture challenges, and high-stakes account reviews.
* Cross-Functional Strategic Collaboration
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to communicate customer feedback, synthesize technical requirements, and influence product roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Account Executives (AEs) to align technical delivery with commercial goals, contract renewals, and account expansion opportunities.
* Drive continuous operational improvements across Global Services to increase time-to-value for new client onboardings and boost long-term retention.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

For our customers who wish to get the most value out of Salesforce with an enterprise experience, they purchase our Signature Success Plan. Signature drives the right insights and people at the right time - which can make all the difference. When you have Signature, you unlock our deepest level of partnership, most skilled expertise, and tools to stay agile.
  
  
The Frontline Senior Manager - Customer success manager ensures that their team of 8-15 Customer Success Managers consistently offers a premium Signature experience to our customers. This role isn’t just about leadership; it’s about encouraging collaboration across various facets of Salesforce, from ensuring efficient allocation of the team to aligning the right resources for customer delivery. Simultaneously, they cultivate valuable executive relationships, handle risk with foresight, and deepen connections with our broader Salesforce teams.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Lead and develop a dedicated team of Customer Success Managers, emphasizing the delivery of our Signature customer experience.
* Ensure efficient allocation of Customer Success Managers and collaborate with delivery leaders to align the best resources for our customers.
* Lead all aspects of the execution of Signature offers for designated clouds, focusing on customer satisfaction and success score metrics.
* Develop executive relationships with customers and assist in handling customer issues and improving the value derived from their Signature investments.
* Proactively identify and address high-risk customers, aligning internal teams including executive sponsors and corrective actions
* Partner closely with Account Executives and other Salesforce teams, ensuring cohesive relationships.
* Partner with the Renewals team and Success Plan Sales to ensure Signature Success Plan renewals and growth across teams.
* Ensure that team activities adhere to the obligations of the Signature Offer and Account Success goals.
* Cultivate the professional growth of the team in alignment with Account Success and individual career path objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Successful track record in customer success or related roles, with at least 5 years in a front-line leadership position.
* Demonstrable experience in leading customer success teams, with a focus on customized customer experiences.
* Strong ability to collaborate and drive outcomes across multiple internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to drive effective and influencing conversations at the C-level.
* Facilitate difficult discussions and be adept at handling objections.
* Knowledge in one or more lines of business.
* Proficient in risk management, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential issues.
* Drive important metrics related to Customer Success Score, Customer Satisfaction, and Signature Adoption.

* Diligent. Nothing gets overlooked.

description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
The Pre-Sales Engineer Team is an integral part of the Sales team with a focus on delivering pre-sales demonstrations and technical leadership to enhance the prospecting experience in the sales process. Pre-Sales Engineers (PSEs) focus on selling and demoing our technology platforms in addition to TriNet's applications. The Pre-Sales Engineer Manager is responsible for overseeing a team of PSEs and managing all levels of the PSE role effectively. This role will provide guidance to both the PSE team and partners. This individual is also responsible for supporting PSEs in answering technical inquiries from prospects regarding technology, features, solutions, applications as well as articulate TriNet's technology and product positioning. The PSE Manager will be driving the success and results for the Pre-Sales Engineer team. This person will be responsible for managing the daily activities of the PSE team and process documentations for the Sales team. The Pre-Sales Engineer Manager is required to effectively document and communicate customer needs for the implementation and sales teams to ensure a positive customer experience. This individual will be lead on projects to drive operational effectiveness and revenue. The Pre-Sales Engineer Manager will be the lead to build relationships with supporting departments and coordinate training for all PSEs. The role will also be tasked with owning all major projects, awards and roll outs.

**Experience Qualifications**

title: Director, RCM Digital Innovation
description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**Director, RCM Digital Innovation** **Location:** India ( Hyderabad)

**Department:** Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Operations

**Reports to:** AVP, RCM Operational Excellence

### **About ModMed**

At ModMed, we are transforming healthcare by placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where the software we build increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes. Our culture is powered by people who **create customer delight**, **save time**, **innovate boldly and make things happen**, **align passion with purpose**, and **think big, have fun, and do good**.

### **The Opportunity**

As ModMed scales its Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations in India, we are seeking a visionary **Director, RCM Digital Innovation** to serve as the primary catalyst for digital and data-driven transformation. In this newly created leadership role, you will re-engineer core RCM workflows by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and scalable analytics. You will partner closely with onshore and India-based service delivery teams, ModMed Product and Engineering, and external technology vendors to build future-state solutions that minimize manual effort, elevate operational quality, and save valuable time for the medical practices we serve.

### **What You Will Do**

* **Drive Enterprise RCM Transformation:** Act as the primary RCM Services subject matter expert across internal and external stakeholders. Map current workflows, identify high-impact transformation opportunities, supply process maps and test data, validate solutions prior to launch, and lead change management across ModMed teams and partners.
* **Build & Lead a High-Performing Data Analytics Team:** Recruit, mentor, and scale a dedicated RCM Data Analytics team (including 2–3 managers and a broader organization of 30–50 team members). Establish scalable data models, predictive analytics, and executive dashboards to empower data-driven decision-making.
* **Architect the Digital Innovation Roadmap:** Design and execute a strategic roadmap integrating AI, Machine Learning (ML), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and modern workflow tools into RCM operations. Develop data-backed prototypes and business cases to demonstrate measurable ROI to leadership.
* **Lead Pilots, POCs & Vendor Evaluations:** Spearhead technology proofs-of-concept (POCs) and pilot programs from initial concept through enterprise-wide rollout. Evaluate external vendor solutions and oversee end-to-end implementation.
* **Champion Operational Quality & Continuous Improvement:** Partner cross-functionally across global business units to resolve systemic bottlenecks proactively, strengthen compliance and deliverable quality, and drive continuous innovation.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* **Experience:** 15+ years of hands-on experience in core Provider Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), with deep mastery of end-to-end RCM processes, workflows, and applications.
* **Proven Transformation Track Record:** Demonstrated success delivering at least 5 digital or transformational projects within the RCM space, including 2–3 major technology or data platform implementations.
* **People & Team Leadership:** Proven experience recruiting, building, and scaling high-performing Data Analytics and operations teams from the ground up, with strong leadership and change-management skills.
* **Technical Fluency:** Deep working knowledge of AI platforms, RPA, APIs, modern workflow tools, and advanced data analytics/BI stacks (such as SQL, Tableau, and Power BI).
* **Global Collaboration & Communication:** Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with a track record of aligning cross-functional onshore and offshore teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required; a background in Science with Mathematics or Statistics is preferred.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Advanced analytical expertise with hands-on exposure to AI/ML deployment in healthcare RCM.
* Experience with specialized healthcare API integrations and modern cloud data architectures.

### **Why You’ll Love Working at ModMed**

* **Purpose-Driven Impact:** Your work directly removes administrative friction from healthcare, enabling doctors to spend more time with patients.
* **Bold Innovation:** We encourage you to experiment, challenge the status quo, and bring cutting-edge AI and automation ideas to life.
* **Inclusive & Collaborative Culture:** We celebrate diverse perspectives, foster global teamwork between India and the US, and believe in thinking big while having fun along the way.

*ModMed is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** follows a strict, merit-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.  
  
**We do not:**

* Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;
* Authorise any individual, employee, or third party to collect any such payments (regardless of nomenclature) to offer or facilitate or recruitment opportunities; or
* Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.

All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.  
  
We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .  
  
**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About Us**

Resollect builds software for banks and asset reconstruction companies (ARCs: firms that buy unpaid loans from banks and work to recover them). When loans go unpaid, lenders have to track them, follow up and often go to court, and our software helps them manage that recovery and the legal process around it. We're a small team where people own their work end to end and work directly with the people who built the company.

**Role: HR - Talent Acquisition**

Apply here: https://helios.resollect.com/apply/hr-talent-acquisition

**The Role**

A company is, in the end, the people it hires. As our Talent Acquisition lead, you'll decide who those people are. You'll be the first person at Resollect whose whole job is hiring. You'll run it end to end: finding people, talking to them, assessing them, closing offers and making sure they settle in well. You'll report directly to our founder and CEO.

The work is varied. One day you're on the phone with someone who wasn't looking for a new job, persuading them this one is worth a conversation. The next you're running an in-person test for a candidate at our office in Marol. The day after you're negotiating an offer, working out a notice-period buyout, and making sure last week's new joiner has everything they need on their first morning.

We'll track how it's going in plain numbers. Junior roles should be filled within 30 days of opening and senior roles within 45. At least 80% of the people you hire should go on to pass their probation. Together, those targets mean hiring quickly and hiring well, and you'll always know where you stand.

**What You'll Do**

• Run hiring end to end: You'll take every role from the first sourcing message through screening calls, in-person tests, the offer and onboarding. The experience a candidate has of Resollect is one you designed.

• Keep conversations going all the time: You'll start 15 to 20 new conversations with potential candidates every week, even when no role is open. When a role does open, you're starting from people you already know rather than from zero.

• Build a bench for every role in the plan: For every role in our 12-month hiring plan, you'll keep three to five people who have already been assessed and are ready to talk. This is how roles get filled in weeks instead of months.

• Source where the people actually are: You'll find candidates on LinkedIn and job boards like Naukri, iimjobs and Instahyre. You'll also use the ICAI portal, the job portal of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, along with referrals and colleges. Reaching out directly, rather than waiting for CVs to arrive, is what makes the weekly numbers possible.

• Run the referral programme: You'll run our employee referral programme. The people we already trust are often the best route to the next good hire.

• Design how people apply: You'll write the application form for each role, including knock-out questions: short questions that screen out applicants who don't meet a basic requirement. That way your time goes into the candidates who can actually do the job.

• Close offers: You'll negotiate offers within the agreed band for each role. You'll also handle notice-period buyouts and counter-offers from a candidate's current employer, which is often where a good hire is won or lost.

• Make the first day work: You'll make sure every new hire is ready to start properly on day one. You'll then check in with them at 30, 60 and 90 days, so problems surface early while they're still easy to fix.

• Keep the pipeline honest: You'll record every candidate in Helios, the system we use to track candidates. Every Monday, you'll review the pipeline with the CEO, so you both see the same picture and decisions get made quickly.

**What We're Looking For**

• One to three years of working with people against a goal: You'll do well here if you've spent one to three years in recruitment, at an agency or a startup. A people-facing sales role counts too. If you're a salesperson who is great with people and wants to move into hiring, your skills carry straight over.

• Comfortable selling a role: Much of your day will be on the phone, often with people who weren't looking to move. You enjoy those conversations, and you can explain honestly why this job might be worth their time.

• Organised, with records you can trust: You'll be running many candidates across several roles at once. You keep track of every one, so nobody falls through the cracks, and you keep clean records of every hire so the numbers always add up.

• High ownership: As our first hiring person, you'll decide how hiring runs here. You're trusted to act on it without waiting to be told what to do next.

• Mumbai-based, or ready to move: The role is office-based in Marol, Mumbai, six days a week. You'll need to be in Mumbai already or willing to relocate.

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

• Closed hires end to end: If you've taken a hire all the way from sourcing to an accepted offer, you already know where candidates tend to drop off and how to keep them engaged.

• Sourced directly: Experience finding candidates yourself on LinkedIn or job boards, not only working from inbound CVs, will make the weekly conversation targets feel natural from the start.

• Hired in finance, operations, sales or collections, or worked in lending: Knowing these roles, or having worked at a startup, a fintech, or an NBFC (a non-banking financial company: a lender that isn't a bank), means you'll recognise a strong candidate faster and speak their language.

• Worked to numbers: If you've hit or tracked numeric targets such as hires, closures, calls or conversions, our 30- and 45-day targets and Monday reviews will feel familiar.

• Run a referral programme, campus hiring or volume hiring: Any of these would give you a head start on the referral programme and on building benches across several roles at once.

**Why This Might Be Worth Your Time**

• The whole job, not a slice of it: You'll own hiring from the first message to the 90-day check-in, rather than one narrow piece of it. That is the fastest way to get good at it.

• You build it from the start: As the first person whose whole job is hiring, you'll design how Resollect hires: the forms, the process, the referral programme and the bench.

• A direct line to the CEO: You'll work directly with the founder, with nobody in between. Your ideas go straight to the person who can act on them, every Monday and in between.

• Unusual exposure: We're a small company working on real problems. The people you bring in will shape what we build and how quickly we build it.

**Where and When**

Full-time, office-based in Marol, Mumbai, six days a week. Immediate joiners are preferred. If you're currently serving a notice period, we can look at buying it out so it doesn't stand in the way.

If you're the kind of person who enjoys talking someone into a conversation they weren't expecting, keeps every candidate on track without being chased, and wants to build hiring from the ground up, we'd like to meet you.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: US Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Company: We Care Staffing Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Weekends: Saturday and Sunday off

Shift Timings: 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM or 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM

Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in US healthcare staffing

About the Role

We Care Staffing is looking for a motivated and results-driven Healthcare Recruiter with experience in US healthcare staffing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience recruiting qualified healthcare professionals for nursing and allied healthcare positions across the United States.

The recruiter will be responsible for the complete recruitment lifecycle, from candidate sourcing and screening to credential verification, interview coordination, and offer closure.

Key Responsibilities

· Candidate Sourcing: Source qualified healthcare professionals through job boards, resume databases, LinkedIn, referrals, internal ATS, and other recruitment channels.

· Healthcare Recruitment: Recruit for US healthcare positions, including:

o Registered Nurses (RN)

o Licensed Practical Nurses (LPN/LVN)

o Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA)

o Certified Medical Assistants (CMA)

o Allied Healthcare Professionals, including Radiology Technologists, Medical Laboratory Technicians, Respiratory Therapists, and other allied specialties.

· Screening and Evaluation: Conduct initial candidate screenings to assess clinical experience, specialty expertise, qualifications, work history, availability, location preferences, and compensation expectations.

· Candidate Vetting: Verify candidate qualifications, relevant work experience, employment history, professional references, and other requirements before submission.

· Licenses and Certifications: Collect and verify required professional licenses, certifications, BLS/ACLS credentials where applicable, and other client-specific compliance documents.

· Interview Coordination: Coordinate interviews between candidates and clients, provide timely updates, and prepare candidates for interviews.

· Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment activity, submission status, interview schedules, and follow-up notes in the ATS.

· Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates to improve engagement, responsiveness, and placement success.

· Target Achievement: Meet recruitment KPIs related to sourcing, qualified submissions, interviews, offers, and successful placements.

Required Qualifications

· Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in US healthcare staffing and recruitment.

· Experience recruiting RN, LPN/LVN, CNA, CMA, and/or allied healthcare professionals.

· Strong understanding of US healthcare recruitment processes, clinical job requirements, and professional licensing and certification requirements.

· Experience with candidate sourcing, screening, credential collection, submission, interview coordination, and offer closure.

· Familiarity with US healthcare job boards, ATS platforms, MSP/VMS systems, and recruitment databases is preferred.

· Excellent communication, follow-up, negotiation, and candidate relationship management skills.

· Ability to work in a target-driven environment and manage multiple open positions simultaneously.

· Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

What We Offer

· A supportive and performance-driven work environment.

· A company culture that recognizes and values employee contributions.

· Opportunities to develop expertise in US healthcare staffing.

· A structured Monday-to-Friday work schedule.

· Saturday and Sunday off.

· The opportunity to grow with a healthcare staffing company focused on quality, teamwork, and results.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for recruiters who understand the US healthcare staffing industry, take ownership of their requirements, and can independently manage candidates from initial sourcing through successful offer closure.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume with our recruitment team.

Join We Care Staffing and become part of a team that connects qualified healthcare professionals with organizations that care.

to lead our recruitment function and drive hiring across technical and business roles. The role requires someone who can manage a team of recruiters, work closely with business leaders and personally handle critical and senior-level positions.

The ideal candidate should bring strong recruitment execution, stakeholder management and team leadership skills, with a focus on hiring quality, timely closures and candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Recruitment Planning & Stakeholder Management**

* Work with business heads to understand hiring needs, role expectations and timelines.
* Translate approved manpower requirements into recruitment plans with clear priorities and ownership.
* Validate job descriptions, candidate profiles and screening criteria before initiating hiring.
* Share regular updates on hiring progress, challenges and decisions required from stakeholders.

**End-to-End Recruitment**

* Own recruitment from sourcing and screening through interviews, offer negotiation and joining.
* Drive hiring across Sales, Inside Sales, Presales, Support, Projects, Technology, Marketing, CRM and corporate functions.
* Personally manage critical, niche and leadership hiring.
* Build candidate pipelines through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, recruitment partners and direct sourcing.
* Maintain candidate engagement during the notice period to improve joining conversions and reduce offer dropouts.

**Recruitment Team Management**

* Lead, coach and review the performance of the recruitment team.
* Allocate positions based on priority, complexity and recruiter capacity.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews and support recruiters in resolving sourcing and closure challenges.
* Improve screening quality, interview coordination and follow-up discipline.

**Recruitment Operations & Analytics**

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and stage-wise updates in the ATS/HRMS.
* Track time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversions, offer acceptance, joining ratios and hiring costs.
* Identify hiring bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure timely interview feedback and proper documentation of hiring decisions.
* Coordinate with HR Operations for a smooth handover from offer acceptance to onboarding.

**Employer Branding & Process Improvement**

* Create effective job postings and support recruitment campaigns, walk-in drives and employee referrals.
* Build relationships with recruitment agencies, institutes and other sourcing partners.
* Improve recruitment workflows, reporting and automation.
* Ensure a professional and consistent candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in IT hiring, including a minimum of 5 years leading and managing a Talent Acquisition team.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment in an IT, software or technology organisation.
* Proficiency in hiring strategies and workforce planning to support business growth and organizational needs.
* Experience leading recruiters while independently closing critical positions.
* Strong understanding of technical and enterprise technology sales hiring.
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn sourcing, Naukri, job portals and an ATS/HRMS.
* Ability to assess candidate suitability beyond keywords and coordinate effectively with hiring managers.
* Strong communication, negotiation and planning.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills across diverse teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, manage multiple requisitions, and meet agreed hiring timelines.
* A graduate degree; an MBA or postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Timely closure of approved positions.
* Quality of hires and hiring manager satisfaction.
* Offer-to-joining conversion and reduction in candidate dropouts.
* Recruitment team productivity and pipeline quality.
* Accuracy of recruitment data and reporting.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About Us:

AirBorne Recruiting has been India’s leading cruise line manning agency since 1986 and works with premium cruise line brands globally. Our vision is to continue to be India’s most trusted and respected cruise line manning agency.

Please note this is an office based recruitment role with AirBorne, not a position on board a ship.

The Role:

You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines for your assigned client accounts. Sourcing is the core of this job. We are looking for someone who actively goes out and finds talent rather than waiting for applications to arrive, and who then carries those candidates through documentation and selection with a high standard of service.

Key Responsibilities:

**Sourcing (primary focus)**

* Source candidates across job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referral networks, hospitality institutes and walk in drives
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for assigned positions and clients, so requirements can be filled quickly when they arise
* Keep approved candidates engaged while they wait for a suitable vacancy, so strong talent is not lost to other agencies
* Track which sourcing channels produce the best results and adjust your approach

**Screening and selection**

* Review applications and shortlist candidates against client requirements
* Conduct or coordinate prescreening interviews and skill assessments
* Schedule and coordinate client interviews, including preparing candidates beforehand
* Record interview outcomes and maintain accurate candidate records in our recruitment system

**Documentation**

* Manage candidate documentation end to end, from application through to joining
* Guide candidates on the certificates, medicals and travel documents required for their position and client
* Verify documents are complete and accurate before files are submitted to clients

**Customer service**

* Act as the main point of contact for your candidates, keeping them informed at every stage
* Respond promptly and clearly to candidate queries by phone, email and messaging
* Handle rejections and delays with care, since every candidate is a reflection of AirBorne

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with recruiting coordinators and support their day to day work
* Maintain requisition trackers and report progress against targets to your manager
* Follow AirBorne’s recruitment processes and standards consistently

What We Are Looking For:

**Essential**

* Prior experience in talent acquisition, recruitment or sourcing
* Proven ability to source candidates proactively, not only from inbound applications
* Strong written and spoken English
* Highly organised with real attention to detail
* Comfortable managing several candidate pipelines at once
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
* A genuine customer service mindset

**Preferred**

* Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel or high volume recruitment
* Familiarity with an applicant tracking system
* Experience coordinating or mentoring junior team members

What Success Looks Like:

In your first six months, you will have built active pipelines for your assigned accounts, be filling requirements within client timelines, and have candidates who speak well of how they were treated during the process.

description:

* Source and attract high-quality talent across APAC(Manila, HongKong, Singapore and other countries) including India by leveraging AI-augmented sourcing tools, social platforms, job boards, research communities, and direct outreach strategies to build robust candidate pipelines.

* Apply market intelligence and talent mapping to sharpen sourcing strategies, ensuring outreach targeting and messaging are informed by real-time insights on talent availability, competitor activity.
* Develop and iterate AI-powered tools and workflows that enhance the reach and effectiveness of candidate outreach, continuously improving how the team engages with passive talent at scale.
* Partner closely with Recruitment Partners to understand hiring priorities, technical skill requirements, translating business needs into targeted sourcing campaigns that deliver quality and speed.
* Screen and assess candidates at the top of the funnel, providing Recruitment Partners with a well-qualified shortlist and a clear summary of each candidate’s technical background, domain expertise, and potential.
* Track and analyze sourcing metrics to measure pipeline health, outreach effectiveness, and conversion rates, using data to refine approaches and share insights with the wider team.

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a APAC Non Technology Talent Sourcer, you will be the engine behind our recruitment capability, using intelligent sourcing tools, market intelligence, and AI-augmented technology to identify, attract, and engage the talent we need to power MSCI.
  
  
Working closely with our Recruitment Partners and APAC +India Recruitment team, you will own the top of the funnel for Non Technology hiring, bringing creativity, curiosity, analytical thinking, and strong technical understanding to how we reach and nurture candidates across India and other APAC countries.
  
  
If you are energized by the search, passionate about people and technology, and excited to push the boundaries of what modern AI-enabled sourcing looks like, this is your opportunity to make a difference.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* Early career experience or demonstrated interest in BFSI talent sourcing, recruitment, talent intelligence, or a research-intensive role, with a genuine passion for finding and engaging exceptional technology talent.
* Exposure in hiring across India and the other APAC countries
* Strong interest in sourcing and the ability to understand skill sets in various APAC geographies.
* Hands-on experience with sourcing tools, social platforms such as LinkedIn, job boards, including the ability to engage passive candidates through personalized and compelling outreach.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for embracing AI and emerging recruitment technology, with an appetite for building, testing, and improving tools that make sourcing smarter and more efficient.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar platforms to support sourcing, research, outreach, and workflow productivity.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to craft clear, engaging, and targeted messaging that resonates with different candidate audiences.
* An analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to use sourcing metrics and market intelligence to guide decisions and refine strategies.
* A collaborative, team-first approach, with the organizational skills to manage multiple pipelines simultaneously and keep Recruitment Partners well-informed and supported.
* A proactive attitude and a desire to learn and grow, deepening market knowledge, building AI sourcing capability, and developing the craft of finding exceptional talent in competitive markets across APAC region.
* Experience using ATS platforms such as iCIMS would be an added advantage, though not mandatory.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: Inbound Sales Executive - Only Mumbai Candidate Prefered
description:
**Company Description**

WEQ Technologies is not just a software company but strives to become a technology partner for its clients. We builds software for businesses that require industrial automation, smart inventory management and other IT solutions to stay ahead in market. At WEQ, we are aware that creating client-oriented solution takes a mixture of technical excellence and clear communication. We know that every client is unique, and we strive to deliver an individual, innovative and cost effective solution every time. We provide Technological Partnership & Support, Software Product Development, Website Development, Digital Marketing.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description – Inbound Sales Executive**

**Company:** WEQ Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Mumbai & Pune

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** IT Services & Software Development

**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years

**About WEQ Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

WEQ Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides technology solutions to businesses, including web and mobile application development and custom software solutions. We work with clients to understand their business requirements and deliver technology solutions that support their growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a confident, customer-focused, and target-driven **Inbound Sales Executive** to manage incoming business inquiries and convert potential clients into successful sales opportunities.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding client requirements, presenting suitable IT services, preparing proposals, managing follow-ups, negotiating commercial terms, and closing deals. The ideal candidate should have experience selling IT services or software development solutions, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to achieve sales targets.

This role is ideal for someone who can understand business needs, communicate the value of technology solutions, and build long-term client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inbound Sales & Lead Conversion**

* Handle incoming leads and inquiries received through the company website, email, calls, social media, and other business channels.
* Respond to inquiries promptly and maintain consistent communication with potential clients.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives, project scope, budget, and expected timelines.
* Qualify leads based on their requirements, budget, decision-making authority, and project readiness.
* Conduct discovery calls to understand client challenges and identify suitable technology solutions.
* Present the company's services, including web development, mobile app development, custom software development, and other IT solutions.
* Schedule client meetings and coordinate discussions with relevant technical or business teams when required.
* Prepare and share proposals, quotations, and commercial offers based on client requirements.
* Follow up with potential clients regularly to move opportunities towards closure.
* Handle client objections, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and convert qualified leads into confirmed projects.
* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the company's revenue growth.

**2. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

* Build strong professional relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand client expectations and communicate service offerings clearly.
* Explain project requirements and coordinate with technical teams to assess feasibility, timelines, and estimated costs.
* Ensure timely responses to client questions and maintain a professional client experience.
* Manage client communication throughout the sales cycle, from the initial inquiry to deal closure.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Coordinate smooth handover of confirmed projects to the project management or delivery team.

**3. Sales Pipeline & Follow-Up Management**

* Maintain an organized pipeline of incoming leads, qualified prospects, proposals, and ongoing negotiations.
* Track all client interactions, follow-ups, meeting outcomes, and deal status in the CRM or designated tracking system.
* Ensure timely follow-ups with interested prospects and minimize missed sales opportunities.
* Reconnect with leads that require additional time or information before making a decision.
* Monitor lead conversion rates and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.
* Maintain accurate sales records and provide regular updates to the reporting manager.

**4. Proposals, Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare professional sales proposals, quotations, presentations, and client documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams to gather technical inputs and prepare suitable proposals.
* Maintain records of client requirements, commercial discussions, and agreed terms.
* Prepare regular reports on lead status, meetings, proposals, conversions, and revenue generated.
* Track individual performance against monthly sales targets and other assigned KPIs.
* Ensure all sales-related documentation is accurate and shared within the required timelines.

**5. Coordination with Marketing & Technical Teams**

* Work with the marketing team to understand lead sources, campaign performance, and lead quality.
* Share client feedback and market insights to help improve service positioning and lead conversion.
* Coordinate with developers, project managers, and other relevant teams to understand project feasibility.
* Communicate client expectations accurately to internal stakeholders.
* Support business growth initiatives and contribute ideas to improve the overall sales process.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in inbound sales, inside sales, or business development within an IT services or software development company.
* Experience in selling web development, mobile application development, custom software, or related technology services.
* Proven ability to manage inbound leads, qualify prospects, follow up consistently, and close deals.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client-handling, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and communicate technical services in simple, business-focused language.
* Experience preparing proposals, quotations, presentations, and sales reports.
* Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management processes.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* A target-oriented mindset with a focus on revenue generation and client satisfaction.

**Good to Have**

* Experience handling domestic and international clients.
* Basic understanding of web technologies, mobile applications, APIs, and software development life cycles.
* Experience coordinating with technical teams for project estimation and proposal preparation.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, sales dashboards, and pipeline reporting.
* Experience in B2B technology sales and managing medium- to high-value projects.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be measured based on:**

* Speed and quality of response to incoming leads.
* Number and quality of leads qualified.
* Lead-to-meeting and lead-to-proposal conversion rates.
* Proposal follow-up effectiveness and deal closure rate.
* Monthly sales target achievement and revenue generated.
* Accuracy of CRM records and timely reporting.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.
* Effectiveness of follow-ups and management of the sales pipeline.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive salary package based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives linked to individual sales achievements.
* Attractive incentive structure with uncapped earning potential, subject to company policy.
* Medical insurance benefits.
* Career growth and professional development opportunities.
* Performance-based rewards, vouchers, and team outings.
* Supportive work environment with flexible working arrangements, subject to business requirements.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for a proactive sales professional who understands the IT services industry and can convert business inquiries into revenue-generating opportunities. The ideal candidate should be confident in client conversations, skilled at identifying project requirements, consistent with follow-ups, and motivated to achieve sales targets.

If you have experience selling IT services and enjoy building client relationships while closing business opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Skills

Lead Qualification & Requirement AnalysisRevenue Generation & Target Achievementroposal Preparation & Commercial QuotationExcellent Verbal & Written CommunicationSales Negotiation & Deal Closure

 **Additional Information**

### **Mission of the Role**

This role is responsible for Coordinating with clients & inspection team, preparation of inspection certificate/reports, invoices and collection of payment as per the guidelines of company within the stipulated time.

### **Main Accountabilities**

The Inspection Coordinator cum Operations Executive is responsible for coordinating inspection activities, managing customer nominations, ensuring timely execution of inspections and certifications, maintaining operational records, and supporting business growth through efficient customer service and compliance with VOC scheme requirements.

The role acts as a critical link between clients, inspectors, technical reviewers, laboratories, certification teams, and finance to ensure smooth end-to-end processing of VOC projects.

* Receive and review inspection nominations from clients.
* Verify completeness of documentation and application requirements.
* Allocate inspection assignments to inspectors based on location, competence, and availability.
* Coordinate inspection schedules with clients and inspectors.
* Monitor inspection progress and ensure completion within agreed timelines.
* Track pending inspections and proactively follow up for closure.

**Operations Management**

* Manage the complete VOC process from nomination receipt to certificate issuance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable VOC regulations, importing country requirements, and internal procedures.
* Coordinate with technical reviewers for document assessment and approval.
* Maintain accurate operational records in ERP/CRM systems.
* Generate operational reports and MIS as required by management.

**Customer Service**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients regarding inspection status and certification requirements.
* Respond promptly to customer inquiries, complaints, and requests.
* Provide guidance on document requirements and certification processes.
* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.

**Documentation & Certification**

* Review inspection reports and supporting documents for completeness.
* Ensure all required documents are available prior to certification.
* Coordinate with certification teams for timely issuance of CoC/Certificates.
* Maintain proper electronic and physical filing systems.
* Ensure traceability of all inspection records.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with inspectors, laboratories, technical experts, certification teams, and clients.
* Coordinate with finance regarding invoicing, payment follow-up, and certification holds.
* Work closely with business development teams to support customer requirements.

**Compliance & Quality Management**

* Adhere to ISO 17020, ISO 17065, and applicable accreditation requirements.
* Ensure confidentiality, impartiality, and integrity of operational processes.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Participate in corrective and preventive actions related to operational issues.

**Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Maintain inspection trackers and project status reports.
* Report operational KPIs including:

  + Turnaround Time (TAT)

  + Certificate Issuance Timeliness
  + Customer Satisfaction
  + Outstanding Cases
* Escalate delays, compliance concerns, and customer issues to management.

description:
Position Title: Executive – Quotations & Renewals  
Company: SKD Insurance Broking & Services Pvt. Ltd.  
Department: Operations & Underwriting Support  
Location: Mumbai, India  
Reporting To: Team Leader / Operations Head

About SKD Insurance Broking & Services Pvt. Ltd.

SKD Insurance Broking & Services Pvt. Ltd. is a licensed Insurance Broker governed by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI). We deliver tailored risk management, corporate insurance solutions, and retail insurance services across India.

Role Summary

We are looking for an energetic, detail-oriented Quotations & Renewals Executive with 1 to 5 years of experience in General Insurance operations. The ideal candidate will handle daily quote creation, policy renewals across Motor, Health, and SME lines, liaise with insurer coordinators, and ensure compliance with IRDAI standards.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Quotation & Processing Support

Multi-Line Quotations: Generate, analyze, and deliver competitive quotes for Motor Insurance (Two-Wheeler, Private Car, Commercial Vehicles – Comprehensive & Act Only) and Health Insurance (Individual & Family Floater).

Non-Motor Quotes: Assist in obtaining quotes from insurance companies for Workmen’s Compensation (WC), Group Personal Accident (GPA), Group Mediclaim (GMC), Fire, and Travel policies.

Insurer Coordination: Follow up daily with PSU and Private Insurance company co-ordinators to obtain quotes, policy copies, and endorsement approvals.

Pre-Inspections: Arrange self-inspection links and coordinate with inspection agencies for break-in motor policies and property risks.

2. Renewals & Retention

Renewal Pipeline: Track daily/monthly renewal lists to ensure zero policy lapses for existing clients.

Client & Intermediary Support: Provide proactive renewal notices, comparative quotation grids, and updated terms to clients, agents, POSPs, and sales partners.

Endorsement Handling: Process routine policy endorsements (e.g., address changes, vehicle/owner transfers, NCB transfers, member additions/deletions).

3. MIS, Reconciliations & Operations

Daily MIS Maintenance: Update and maintain daily policy booking logs, quote logs, and pending renewal reports using MS Excel (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables).

Payout & Grid Checks: Verify payout grids, commission reconciliations, and premium payment settlements against insurer statements.

B2B Portal Management: Operate insurer web portals, CRM systems, and broker management systems for swift policy booking.

4. IRDAI Compliance & Guidelines

Strictly adhere to IRDAI (Insurance Brokers) Regulations and Policyholders' Interest Protection Rules.

Ensure 100% compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) document collection prior to policy issuance.

Maintain transparency regarding policy deductibles, sub-limits, exclusions, and Terms & Conditions when sharing quotes.

Candidate Profile & Eligibility

Education & Experience

Education: Graduate (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, or equivalent) from a recognized university.

Experience: 1 to 5 years of hands-on experience in General Insurance operations, quote creation, or renewals within an IRDAI-registered Insurance Brokerage, Direct Insurer, or Agency channel.

Technical & Functional Skills

Product Knowledge: Clear understanding of Motor (Own Damage, Third Party, Add-ons), Health, and basic Commercial/Non-Motor policies.

Computer Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (MS Excel: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) and familiarity with B2B insurer portals/CRMs.

Regulatory Understanding: Fundamental knowledge of IRDAI renewal timelines, NCB rules, break-in procedures, and KYC requirements.

Soft Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills (English, Hindi, Regional languages).

Quick learning ability, attention to detail, and good follow-up skills.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

1. Quote Turnaround Time (TAT): Delivering motor/health quotes within designated SLAs (1–2 hours).

2. Renewal Retention: Achieving target renewal percentage on assigned portfolios.

3. Data Accuracy: Zero errors in policy endorsements, NCB calculations, and customer records.

4. Compliance: 100% adherence to KYC norms and IRDAI documentation guidelines.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their updated Resume/CV to careers@skdinsurance.com with the subject line "Application for Executive - Quotations & Renewals (1-5 Yrs Exp)".

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month
