description:
**About ICP**

ICP is a global leader in Content Operations, partnering with some of the world's most recognizable brands, including Unilever, Diageo, Coca-Cola, Mars, P&G, Starbucks, Coty, L’Oréal, NBCU, and Aetna. Our expertise spans content management, logistics, creative operations, production, and digital commerce enablement, ensuring a seamless flow of content across all systems and channels. We empower brands to achieve operational excellence and confidently manage their content. Content confidently.™

With offices in **Atlanta, London, Mexico City, Mumbai**, and **Shanghai**, we operate on a global scale, delivering world-class solutions that drive exceptional business outcomes.

**Who We Are**

At ICP, our values define us: we are Curious, Focused, Creative, Trustworthy, and Inclusive.

**We're A People First Company**

At ICP, we provide benefits that matter to our people and enable us to be engaged both in and outside of work. We foster a culture where *work/life* balance is nurtured and encouraged, offering hybrid working, generous paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, and Summer half-day Fridays. We also take care of our people with competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, mental health support, and a robust savings plan.

**Bring the Confidence**

Are you a relationship-focused, driven professional with a growth mindset? Do you thrive on breaking through challenges and excelling in competitive environments? You're not expected to have all the answers, but your passion for uncovering solutions and building strong partnerships makes you the perfect fit for this role. We’d love to hear from you!

The **Manager, Account Operations** plays a pivotal role in providing the necessary operational structure and guidance that allows our practitioners to focus on tactical day-to-day task execution required to deliver with excellence.

This position is responsible for the delivery and maintenance of client-facing account work, including satisfying contractual agreements per terms of SOWs, meeting SLAs, quality assurance, and ensuring process improvement. By focusing on maintaining processes, best practices, and establishing reporting and metrics, across all client projects, the Manager, Account Operations ensures high-quality service delivery and achievement of key milestones and metrics.

By facilitating open communication amongst cross-functional stakeholders including setting and maintaining expectations, Manager ensures delivery of agreed upon outcomes on time, and on budget.

The Manager, Account Operations is responsible for partnering with our dynamic, client-facing teams who are engaged in various operational and content-related activities. This role supports a portfolio of global companies where leadership, customer service, process adherence are crucial. The primary focus will be on leading a cross-functional account teams in the achievement of project objectives and business-related outcomes to ensure seamless day-to-day BAU (business as usual) operations, ongoing management of resources and risks and issues, as well as maintenance of standard operating and reporting documents.

The role will have a specialist focus on the delivery and governance of a global Fonts service, overseeing agency engagement, platform access, font usage reporting, compliance and ongoing service improvement. Alongside this specialist responsibility, the role will retain a broader operational management remit.

The role requires effective operations management, project management leadership, strategic thinking, tactical execution oversight, and excellent communication skills.

A proficient and inclusive leader, the Manager, Account Operations fosters achievement of objectives while balancing and maintaining a people-centric focus. Leading by example, they exhibit exceptional client-facing skills and service across various scenarios, ranging from day-to-day project operations to handling complex issues and proactively mitigating risks and challenges as they arise.

By infusing ICP core values of **Curiosity,** **Collaboration**, **Adaptability**, **Focus**, **Creativity, Trust,** and **Inclusivity** into their leadership approach, they will not only achieve success in this role but also contribute to the positive culture and growth of the organization.

This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Account Operations

Must be able and willing to collaborate across time zones to accommodate our global clientele and delivery teams.

**How you will make an impact:**

* Identify opportunities for process optimization to streamline workflows, enhance efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Oversee daily account operations for all assigned workstreams.
* Oversee the day-to-day delivery of the global Fonts service, acting as a key point of contact for operational queries and coordinating activity across agencies, platform partners and client stakeholders.
* Manage agency onboarding and enablement, including training, guidance and ongoing support, while overseeing Monotype access and permissions in line with agreed governance standards.
* Oversee font usage reporting and compliance, including validation of agency submissions, monitoring of exceptions, management of compliance risks and maintenance of appropriate font library and usage standards.
* Manage Fonts stakeholder engagement, service reviews and complex escalations, working with relevant stakeholders and governance groups, including the Fonts Council, to support effective decision-making and issue resolution.
* Oversee quarterly Fonts reporting, ensuring accurate data, consistent reporting standards and identification of trends, risks and opportunities to improve service governance, processes and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Sr. Manager, Operations Management to develop, enhance, document, and manage operations processes, SOPs, toolkits, and best practices.
* Support in development and implementation of quality assurance processes.
* Find continuous improvement opportunities within current processes.
* Ensure activities remain on time and within scope and budget.
* Manage resourcing; raise resourcing concerns or constraints to key ICP account team leadership including Client Partner, to ensure the appropriate operating model and resources are in place to deliver with excellence.
* Oversee collection and analysis of pertinent data to ensure SLAs + KPIs are being met and measured consistent with client expectations.
* Responsible for reporting on account status.
* Make strategic recommendations to Client Partner team regarding areas of opportunity for account growth based on data and observation.
* Partner with cross-functional team members to improve tools and processes
* Maintain open and proactive communication with internal and client stakeholders and cross-functional team leads to ensure proper account operations
* Lead, motivate, and support a team in a fast-paced environment
* Provide QA for all workstreams
* Provide support for client platforms
* Create and enforce content governance & quality / compliance checks to include qc of systems process, workflow alignment and the wider and appropriate use of the tool for the client business.
* Support production of process, content and platform insight, analytics, satisfaction & improvement programs reporting on system usage and process engagement and making appropriate recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Implement programs and processes to help clients get more value from their technology platforms including (but not limited to) – optimising user set-up and configuration, assisting with personalisation, providing best practice and power-user support

**What you will bring:**

Requires a BA/BS and a minimum of 5-7 years' experience in Operation or Project Management, marketing operations and technology, digital commerce and/or creative technologies or related field, including a minimum of 5 years’ experience in a client-facing agency or consulting role.; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

  

* Experience in developing platforms for internal processes
* Understanding of Business Process / Business Process Mapping.
* Experience in coaching project team members
* Proficiency with Project Management Software & Microsoft Excel
* Knowledge of content management systems and platforms
* Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM); Workflow Management; or MRM platform preferred.
* Experience or familiarity with font management, font licensing, Monotype or similar platform governance and compliance processes would be advantageous.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with effective presentation skills
* Familiarity with agile methodology
* Must have acute attention to detail
* Creative Operations experience
* Basic technical and operational knowledge across various industry segments
* Creative problem-solving mindset and a deeply curious nature
* Ability to clearly articulate complex technical situations / ideas and lead discussions with clients, colleagues, and leadership
* Ability to adapt to evolving client needs, industry trends, and internal processes

Job Title: UK Operations Manager, Property Maintenance (Andheri East, Mumbai)

Company: Star Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Andheri East, Mumbai (office-based)

Job Type: Full-time

Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST, Monday to Saturday

Salary: ₹ per month as per experience

About the Role

We manage a portfolio of 200–300 properties in the UK and are hiring a UK Operations Manager to run day-to-day maintenance operations from our Andheri East office. You will be the central point of control between tenants, our London office and contractors, owning every job from first report to final sign-off. You won’t do repairs yourself. Your job is to keep operations running smoothly, make sure every party is informed and chased, and give management a clear picture of where everything stands. This is a high-volume, high-ownership role for someone who thrives on organisation, follow-up and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Operations management

* Own the full maintenance cycle across 200–300 UK properties: request, quote, approval, contractor visit, completion and sign-off

* Log every tenant request and assign it to the right contractor

* Prioritise jobs by urgency and escalate delays or emergencies immediately

* Monitor contractor performance: response times, quality and reliability

Coordination and follow-up

* Work closely with our London office team as their day-to-day operations partner in India

* Keep tenants, contractors and the London office informed at every stage by phone, email and WhatsApp

* Chase contractors for quotes, visit dates and completion until each job is closed

* Chase approvals and invoices with the London office team

Reporting

* Maintain an accurate, up-to-date job tracker throughout the day

* Send an end-of-day update to management and the London office covering jobs opened, progressed and closed, what’s pending, who is being chased and any escalations

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports in PowerPoint, with flowcharts showing job progress and bottlenecks

* Saturdays focused on reporting, tracker review and weekly summaries

Process improvement

* Identify recurring issues and suggest ways to speed up job closure

title: Account Executive, LE EU
description:
**About this role:**

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

**What you will do:**

* Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services
* Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell
* Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.
* Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.
* Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.
* Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

**What you will need:**

* 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives
* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.
* Willingness to conduct travel as needed.
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!
* Uncapped commission structure
* World-class sales training programs and skill development programs
* Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Job Description – Sales Manager (Pest Control)

**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** [Mention Location]

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and experienced Sales Manager to lead our sales and business development activities in the pest control industry. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, managing the sales team, and achieving revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Generate new business opportunities through direct sales, corporate networking, referrals and market development.
* Identify and approach potential clients across residential, commercial, industrial, hospitality, healthcare and institutional segments.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to ensure repeat business and customer retention.
* Promote pest control services, including general pest management, termite treatment, rodent control, mosquito management and other specialized services.
* Prepare and present quotations, commercial proposals, tenders and service agreements.
* Conduct client meetings, site visits and inspections to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable pest management solutions.
* Lead, motivate and monitor the performance of the sales team to ensure achievement of individual and team targets.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and pricing strategies to identify new business opportunities.
* Coordinate with operations and service teams to ensure smooth execution of contracts and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain sales reports, sales pipeline, CRM records and periodic performance reports.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collection from customers.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
* 4–5 years of experience in sales and business development, preferably in the pest control, facility management, hygiene or related service industry.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and acquiring new customers.
* Strong knowledge of B2B and B2C sales processes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
* Ability to develop and manage a sales team.
* Strong networking, relationship-building and client-handling abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and CRM software.
* Strong leadership, planning and problem-solving skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* New customer acquisition and business development.
* Revenue growth and profitability.
* Customer retention and renewal of AMC contracts.
* Sales team productivity and performance.
* Collection efficiency and payment follow-ups.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be an energetic, self-motivated and target-driven professional with a strong understanding of service-based sales. Prior experience in selling pest control services or Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) to corporate and institutional clients will be an added advantage.

**We are looking for someone who can independently drive business growth, build a strong sales pipeline and lead the sales team towards achieving organizational goals.**

My recommendation

For this position, I would particularly focus on candidates who have:

* Experience in B2B corporate sales and acquiring large clients.
* Experience in selling Annual Pest Control Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
* Existing contacts in hotels, hospitals, restaurants, factories, warehouses and commercial establishments.
* Experience in managing a team of 2–5 sales executives.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Experience: 8–14 years

\*1. Role Objective\*

Salesable is looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded Customer Success & Account Growth professional to manage, retain and expand a portfolio of key B2B accounts.

This is a business-critical role that goes beyond traditional client servicing. The individual will own account growth, revenue expansion, client retention, commercial governance and overall relationship management.

The primary expectation is to grow existing accounts by 50–100% year on year, while managing a portfolio of ₹4 Crores or more, ensuring delivery excellence, maintaining account profitability and building long-term strategic relationships with clients.

The individual will serve as the central link between clients and internal delivery teams, ensuring that client expectations, commercial commitments and delivery capabilities remain aligned.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, understands the commercial aspects of service delivery and can independently drive account growth and profitability.

\*2. Key Responsibilities\*

\*A. Strategic Account Management & Revenue Growth\*

\* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic B2B accounts with an annual business value of ₹4 Crores or more.

\* Drive 50–100% year-on-year revenue growth through account expansion, cross-selling and upselling.

\* Develop and execute account-specific growth strategies and revenue expansion plans.

\* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, solutions and service lines within existing accounts.

\* Expand relationships across departments, business units, geographies and stakeholder groups.

\* Identify new projects, business requirements and opportunities within existing client organizations.

\* Build and maintain a qualified account-level sales pipeline and revenue forecast.

\* Drive commercial discussions, proposals, negotiations and closure of new opportunities.

\*B. Executive Relationship & Stakeholder Management\*

\* Develop trusted relationships with C-suite executives, CXOs, business heads and senior decision-makers.

\* Build relationships beyond operational contacts to establish strategic partnerships with clients.

\* Map client organizations, including decision-makers, influencers, budget owners, procurement teams and key stakeholders.

\* Understand the client's business objectives, growth priorities, challenges and changing requirements.

\* Conduct regular executive reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

\* Proactively identify relationship gaps, dissatisfaction and potential client retention risks.

\* Represent Salesable in strategic client discussions and business planning sessions.

\*C. Client–Delivery Alignment & Governance\*

\* Act as the primary catalyst between the client and internal delivery teams.

\* Translate client expectations into clearly defined deliverables, timelines, responsibilities and measurable outcomes.

\* Ensure alignment between client commitments and internal delivery capabilities before confirming any deliverables.

\* Facilitate discussions between clients and delivery teams to resolve disagreements, conflicts and execution challenges.

\* Manage escalations objectively and drive timely resolution while protecting client relationships and business interests.

\* Ensure delivery teams are aligned with agreed SOWs, timelines, SLAs and performance expectations.

\* Establish structured communication, review mechanisms and accountability across internal teams.

\* Monitor delivery performance and proactively address gaps before they escalate into client dissatisfaction.

\*D. SOW, Scope & Change Management\*

\* Own the preparation, negotiation and execution of Statements of Work (SOWs), renewals and commercial amendments.

\* Ensure all deliverables, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, responsibilities and acceptance criteria are clearly documented.

\* Identify scope creep and ensure additional requirements are commercially evaluated.

\* Coordinate with delivery teams to assess the operational and financial impact of client change requests.

\* Secure formal agreement from both the client and internal delivery stakeholders before implementing changes.

\* Ensure all scope changes, additional deliverables and revised commitments are documented and approved.

\* Protect delivery capacity, commercial interests and account profitability while maintaining client satisfaction.

\*E. Commercial Management, Billing & Collections\*

\* Take ownership of account commercials, renewals, billing coordination and payment follow-ups.

\* Ensure invoices are raised accurately and within agreed timelines.

\* Drive collections and ensure payments are received within contractual credit periods.

\* Coordinate with client finance, procurement and commercial teams to resolve payment delays.

\* Proactively monitor outstanding receivables and escalate overdue payments.

\* Ensure additional work and scope changes are commercially recognized and billed appropriately.

\* Monitor account-level revenue, gross margins, resource utilization and servicing costs.

\* Identify opportunities to improve account profitability and minimize revenue leakage.

\*F. Account Planning & Business Intelligence\*

\* Develop comprehensive strategic account plans for every assigned client.

\* Establish quarterly and annual account growth targets with measurable action plans.

\* Maintain detailed account maps covering:

\* Organizational hierarchy and reporting structure.

\* C-suite executives and key decision-makers.

\* Business units and potential service opportunities.

\* Existing services and revenue contribution.

\* Cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

\* Budget cycles and procurement processes.

\* Competitor relationships and incumbent service providers.

\* Buying signals and potential business triggers.

\* Relationship health and account risks.

\* Conduct monthly account performance reviews and quarterly strategic business reviews.

\* Maintain updated opportunity pipelines, revenue forecasts and account growth plans.

\* Identify early warning signals that could affect retention, revenue or client satisfaction.

\*3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)\*

Performance will be measured against the following business outcomes:

\* Performance Parameter

\* ₹4 Crores+

\* 50–100% YoY

\*Essential Experience\*

\* 8–14 years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Key Account Management or Client Relationship Management within B2B services.

\* Proven track record of managing portfolios worth ₹4 Crores or more.

\* Demonstrated ability to grow existing accounts by 50–100% year on year.

\* Experience managing enterprise and mid-market B2B clients.

\* Proven experience in managing C-suite and senior executive relationships.

\* Strong understanding of commercial negotiations, SOWs, renewals, scope management and collections.

\* Experience coordinating multiple delivery teams and managing complex client engagements.

\* Demonstrated ability to manage escalations, resolve conflicts and protect client relationships.

title: CMS Content Manager
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

### **Job description**

As a CMS Content Manager at Jellyfish, you will be responsible for publishing, updating and maintaining high-quality digital content across a range of content management systems (CMS).

You'll ensure that website content is accurate, consistent and aligned with client brand guidelines, supporting the delivery of engaging and optimised digital experiences. You'll work closely with content, SEO, UX, design and development teams to implement content updates, maintain quality standards and support efficient publishing workflows.

You'll bring strong attention to detail, technical curiosity and a proactive approach to problem-solving, helping ensure content is delivered accurately and on time.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**CMS publishing & content delivery**

* Publish, update and maintain website content across CMS platforms, ensuring accuracy, consistency and adherence to brand guidelines
* Build and format web pages using existing templates and content components, including text, imagery, links and metadata
* Implement content updates and minor layout adjustments, using HTML where required
* Support content publishing workflows, ensuring updates are completed accurately and within agreed timelines
* Maintain content trackers, publishing schedules and documentation to support efficient delivery

**Quality assurance & optimisation**

* Conduct quality assurance checks before and after publication, identifying and resolving content, formatting and functionality issues
* Identify, document and escalate CMS-related issues, technical bugs and content inconsistencies
* Implement SEO and UX recommendations in collaboration with specialist teams
* Monitor basic content performance metrics and report insights to support ongoing optimisation
* Ensure published content meets accessibility, usability and brand consistency requirements

**Collaboration & continuous improvement**

* Work closely with project managers, designers, developers and other stakeholders to support content delivery
* Collaborate with SEO, UX and Paid Search teams to implement content optimisation initiatives
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve publishing processes and content quality
* Develop familiarity with new CMS platforms, content technologies and emerging tools, including AI and automation

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Experience publishing and managing website content using CMS platforms such as Sitecore, WordPress, Drupal or similar
* Working knowledge of HTML and web content formatting
* Strong attention to detail, with experience conducting content QA and maintaining brand consistency
* Foundational understanding of SEO principles, metadata and UX best practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving content issues
* Familiarity with design tools such as Figma or Photoshop is a plus
* Experience using project management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira or ServiceNow is a plus
* Interest in AI, automation and emerging content technologies is a plus

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* You consistently publish accurate, high-quality content that meets client requirements and brand standards
* You manage day-to-day CMS tasks efficiently, meeting deadlines and maintaining clear visibility of progress
* You identify and resolve content issues proactively, escalating technical challenges appropriately
* You apply SEO, UX and accessibility best practices to support effective digital experiences
* You build strong working relationships with internal teams and contribute to smooth content delivery
* You develop your CMS expertise and identify opportunities to improve publishing efficiency and quality

*Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.*

**Additional Information**

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

Custom Work Environment: Work remotely UK Shift hours.

Jellyfish contributes to your retiral benefits via Provident Fund (PF) contribution

Jellyfish provides best-in-class group medical insurance & life insurance cover to employees

*Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to* *talentacquisition@jellyfish.com**.*

title: Business Executive - Indore
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial growth and build trusted, professional relationships with healthcare partners across Indore. Your role involves designing and delivering territory plans that drive business outcomes while supporting improved patient care. We seek clear communicators who act with integrity, curiosity, and practical commercial thinking. This role offers meaningful impact, strong learning opportunities, and the chance to work with a team united by science and technology to get ahead of disease together. Join us to grow your career and make a real difference. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Build and maintain trusted, professional relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams, and institutional partners across Indore. - Design, execute, and monitor territory business plans that meet commercial targets and support better patient outcomes. - Conduct professional visits and educational meetings to share clear, evidence-based information responsibly. - Gather market and customer insights to refine plans and improve performance locally. - Collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and ensure timely, quality delivery. - Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and local regulations. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution; a background in science, pharmacy, or medicine is an advantage. - 1 to 3 years of experience in customer-facing roles such as sales, field roles, or account management. - Strong spoken and written communication skills in English and relevant local languages spoken in Indore (e.g., Hindi, Marathi). - Comfortable using digital tools like Word, Excel, and mobile reporting applications. - Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory. - Customer-focused mindset with integrity and a commitment to ethical conduct. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Previous experience in healthcare, hospital, or pharmaceutical field roles. - Ability to clearly explain clinical or scientific information to diverse audiences. - Planning, organisation, and analytical skills to develop and monitor territory performance. - Experience organising professional meetings or educational events. - Comfortable working independently and as part of a cross-functional team. - Fluency in additional regional languages relevant to Indore and surrounding areas. Work pattern and location This role is on-site in Indore with regular travel across the assigned territory. Most of your time will be spent in the field, building relationships and engaging with healthcare teams. Some flexible time for administrative work may be possible. Ready to apply? If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we want to hear from you. Please share your CV and a brief note telling us why you are excited about this opportunity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people who value inclusion to apply. Join us and help unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

**Skills**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. **GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

description:
**Company:** Devdutt Exports Bharat Pvt. Ltd. (Minar Spices)  
**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Department:** Customer Relationship Management (CRM)  
**Reporting To:** Management / Head of Department

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior CRM professional to independently manage the company's customer relationship operations, payment follow-ups, credit control, outstanding recovery and sales coordination.

The candidate must have strong practical experience in handling B2B customers, monitoring outstanding payments, managing credit limits, resolving payment disputes and ensuring timely collections.

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling critical customer matters, coordinating with Sales, Accounts and Finance teams and ensuring smooth business operations with minimum supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Payment Follow-up & Outstanding Recovery**

* Manage and monitor all customer outstanding payments and receivables.
* Ensure timely payment follow-ups through calls, emails and WhatsApp.
* Maintain customer-wise outstanding and ageing reports.
* Follow up on overdue invoices and ensure timely collections.
* Escalate delayed payments, payment defaults and high-risk accounts to management.
* Coordinate with Sales and Accounts teams to resolve payment-related issues.

**2. Credit Management & Credit Control**

* Monitor customer-wise credit limits, outstanding balances and credit periods.
* Ensure orders are processed within approved credit limits and payment terms.
* Identify overdue and high-risk customers and take corrective action.
* Recommend credit limit revisions, payment restrictions and credit holds.
* Coordinate with management and Finance for credit approvals.
* Monitor customer payment behaviour and ensure adherence to company credit policies.

**3. Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage key accounts and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
* Handle customer queries, complaints, payment disputes and escalations.
* Coordinate with Sales, Dispatch, Accounts and Operations teams.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Handle important B2B, institutional and distributor accounts.
* Maintain customer records and communication history.

**4. Sales & Order Coordination**

* Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams for order processing and execution.
* Monitor pending orders, dispatch schedules and delivery-related issues.
* Ensure payment status and credit approvals are checked before order processing.
* Follow up on pending purchase orders, invoices, debit notes and credit notes.
* Resolve customer issues related to pricing, shortages, claims and returns.

**5. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly outstanding and collection reports.
* Maintain customer-wise ageing reports (30, 60, 90 days and above).
* Track collection targets versus actual collections.
* Monitor credit utilisation, overdue accounts and payment commitments.
* Present critical accounts and recovery status to management.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and customer databases.

**6. Team Coordination & Process Management**

* Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Finance, Dispatch and Management teams.
* Supervise CRM executives and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Establish systematic payment follow-up and escalation procedures.
* Improve collection efficiency and reduce overdue receivables.
* Independently handle critical customer escalations.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Graduate in Commerce / B.Com / MBA (Finance or Marketing preferred).
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in CRM, Credit Control, Receivables or Payment Recovery.
* Strong practical experience in B2B payment follow-ups and outstanding recovery.
* Excellent knowledge of credit management, credit limits and payment terms.
* Experience handling overdue accounts, payment disputes and customer escalations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Tally / ERP and CRM software.
* Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage key accounts and critical customer matters.

**Preferred Industry Background**

* FMCG and Food Processing
* Manufacturing & Trading
* Wholesale and Distribution
* Import & Export Companies
* Spices and Food Ingredients
* Institutional and B2B Sales

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The candidate should be responsible, organised and commercially aware, with the ability to independently manage the company's CRM and credit control activities.

Must have strong follow-up and negotiation skills, the ability to handle difficult customers professionally, ensure timely payment recovery and maintain healthy customer relationships.

**Important:** Practical experience in B2B payment recovery, outstanding management, credit control, customer escalations and MIS reporting is mandatory. Candidates with experience limited to telecalling, customer support or routine order coordination will not be preferred.

**Salary**

As per industry standards and candidate's experience and capabilities.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – HVAC Estimation Executive**

**Company:** Aerosys HVAC Solutions  
**Location:** Pune  
**Department:** Sales

**Company Description**

Since 2016, Aerosys HVAC Solutions has been committed to helping businesses navigate the complexities of HVAC systems through comprehensive HVAC commissioning and audit services that enhance building sustainability, energy conservation, and operational efficiency. We specialize in precision engineering services backed by expertise in energy efficiency and NEBB/ASHRAE certifications.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically sound HVAC Estimation Engineer to join our team at Aerosys HVAC Solutions.

The Estimation Engineer will be responsible for reviewing project requirements, preparing accurate cost estimates, developing BOQs (Bill of Quantities), and preparing techno-commercial proposals for HVAC commissioning, testing, balancing, auditing, and energy-saving solutions.

The role involves close coordination with the sales and technical teams to understand project requirements, assess resource requirements, calculate project costs, and ensure timely submission of accurate and competitive estimates.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Review customer enquiries, RFQs, tender documents, technical specifications, and project requirements.
* Study HVAC drawings, layouts, equipment details, and project scope for estimation purposes.
* Prepare detailed BOQs (Bill of Quantities) and cost estimates based on project requirements.
* Calculate project costs, including manpower, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, and other applicable expenses.
* Prepare techno-commercial proposals, quotations, and estimation sheets.
* Coordinate with the technical and sales teams to understand project scope, technical requirements, and execution methodology.
* Obtain and evaluate vendor/subcontractor quotations wherever required.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of cost calculations, pricing, and commercial documentation.
* Identify project-specific requirements, assumptions, exclusions, and additional costs while preparing estimates.
* Revise estimates and commercial proposals based on updated project requirements or client specifications.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of estimates within defined timelines.
* Maintain proper records of estimates, BOQs, quotations, and supporting documents.
* Follow up internally for technical clarifications and missing project information required for estimation.
* Support the sales team with technical and commercial inputs during proposal preparation.
* Coordinate with the project/technical team during post-award handover to ensure clarity on the estimated scope and costs.
* Stay updated with HVAC industry practices, service costs, equipment pricing, and estimation methodologies.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering.
* Experience in HVAC estimation, costing, or technical proposal preparation will be preferred.
* Knowledge of HVAC systems, air conditioning, ventilation, refrigeration, and associated engineering services.
* Understanding of BOQ preparation, cost calculation, and techno-commercial documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other relevant estimation tools.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings, specifications, and project documents.

**Qualities & Skills**

* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good planning and time management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams.
* Reliable, self-motivated, and result-oriented.
* Ability to manage multiple estimation assignments simultaneously.
* Kind, humble, and willing to learn.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹49,000.00 per month

Data and security will be equally important. title: Senior Lead - ITSM Change and Release Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Senior Lead, Change & Release Management is a senior individual contributor responsible for supporting the effective execution, governance, risk management, and continuous improvement of enterprise Change and Release Management practices.

The role serves as a subject matter expert for complex and high-risk changes and releases, partnering with Application Development, Infrastructure, Engineering, Testing, Operations, Information Security, Risk & Control, and other technology stakeholders to promote safe, predictable, and efficient production deployment.

The position has a strong focus on **production stability, change risk assessment, release readiness, reduction of change-caused incidents, process compliance, data-driven improvement, and automation**.

This positioning aligns with the current Release Management process, which includes stage-gate tracking, release coordination, compliance, portfolio reporting, Change integration, and Post-Release Review activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Change Management & Risk Governance**

* Act as a senior SME for Change Management processes, controls, standards, and governance requirements.
* Perform detailed reviews of **high-risk, major, complex, and emergency changes** to assess implementation readiness.
* Evaluate change impact, risk assessments, testing evidence, implementation plans, dependencies, validation plans, and rollback strategies.
* Facilitate and actively contribute to Change Advisory Board (CAB) and other change-governance forums.
* Challenge inadequate risk assessments or implementation plans and work with technology teams to resolve gaps before production implementation.
* Monitor compliance with Change Management processes, SLAs, controls, and governance requirements.
* Support analysis of failed changes and change-caused incidents to identify systemic issues and preventive actions.
* Provide Change Management expertise during audit, control-testing, and risk-management activities.

### **Release Management**

* Provide hands-on coordination and governance support for complex application and infrastructure releases.
* Partner with Release Owners and technology teams to ensure release plans meet established governance requirements.
* Track and validate completion of required **Release Management stage gates, artifacts, approvals, and evidence**.
* Conduct or facilitate release-readiness reviews and identify unresolved risks, dependencies, and control gaps.
* Coordinate with Change Management teams to ensure changes supporting releases are appropriately planned, submitted, approved, and scheduled.
* Support Post-Release Reviews and ensure lessons learned and improvement actions are documented and tracked.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming releases, significant dependencies, implementation risks, and potential production impacts.

### **Production Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze failed changes and **change-caused Sev1, Sev2 and Sev3 incidents** to identify recurring failure patterns and systemic weaknesses.
* Perform root-cause and trend analysis across applications, infrastructure, vendors, change types, risk classifications, and implementation methods.
* Recommend preventive controls and improvements based on identified failure patterns.
* Partner with Testing, Engineering, Application and Infrastructure teams to improve implementation quality and production readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve change success rates and reduce emergency changes, failed changes, rollbacks, and production incidents.
* Support Post-Implementation Reviews for material failed changes and ensure corrective actions address underlying causes rather than symptoms.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Change and Release Management.

### **Data, Reporting & Insights**

* Develop actionable insights from Change and Release Management operational data.
* Monitor key measures such as: Change success/failure rate Change-caused incidents Emergency change volume High-risk change performance Release success and predictability Stage-gate compliance Control exceptions Repeat failure patterns
* Prepare executive-ready analysis highlighting emerging risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Support monthly operational and production-stability reviews.
* Track improvement actions and provide visibility into progress and measurable outcomes.

### **Automation & Modernization**

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Change & Release Management activities.
* Partner with Process Owners and Product Owners on **ServiceNow** workflow and process improvements.
* Support automation of routine validations, risk checks, governance controls, notifications, and reporting.
* Promote better integration between ITSM processes and modern engineering delivery practices such as Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD.
* Use analytics and automation to identify potentially high-risk changes and improve change decision-making.
* Support adoption and testing of new Change & Release Management capabilities and workflow enhancements.

### **Stakeholder Partnership & SME Responsibilities**

* Serve as a trusted Change & Release Management SME for technology and business stakeholders.
* Provide guidance to Change Owners, Release Owners, application teams, infrastructure teams, and other delivery stakeholders.
* Influence teams to address identified implementation, testing, risk, or readiness concerns.
* Escalate significant production risks and control gaps through appropriate governance channels.
* Collaborate with Risk & Control, Audit, Cybersecurity, Testing, Engineering, and Operations on Change and Release risk.
* Share best practices and provide subject matter guidance to Change and Release Management practitioners.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of standards, procedures, controls, and operational guidance.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* **12+ years of IT experience**, with significant experience in service management, production operations, application/infrastructure delivery, or related disciplines.
* **8+ years of hands-on Change and/or Release Management experience** in a large, complex technology environment.
* Strong knowledge of **ITIL / ITSM Change Enablement and Release Management** practices.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating high-risk or complex production changes and releases.
* Strong understanding of testing, implementation planning, dependency management, operational validation, and rollback/recovery planning.
* Experience investigating failed changes and change-related incidents and translating findings into practical preventive actions.
* Strong working knowledge of **ServiceNow** or comparable enterprise ITSM platforms.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience operating in a regulated or governance-intensive environment, preferably financial services.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM / Change Management experience.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and modern CI/CD tooling.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe knowledge/certification.
* Financial services experience.
* Working knowledge of ITGC, technology risk, audit, and control frameworks.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The Senior Lead will contribute to measurable improvements in:

* **Reduction in change-caused Sev1/Sev2/Sev3 incidents**
* Improved change success rates
* Reduction in repeat change failures
* Improved quality of risk assessments and testing evidence
* Better adherence to Release stage gates
* Increased release predictability
* Reduction in avoidable emergency changes
* Improved control compliance
* Increased automation of Change & Release activities
* Faster identification and remediation of systemic production risks

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

You will work closely with our Marketing and content team and the founders, and you will have real ownership over how the brand grows in its first year and beyond.

**What You Will Do**

**Go-to-market strategy**

* Build and execute go-to-market plans for the brand launch and every new product or shade release that follows
* Define target audiences, customer segments, and positioning for each channel, informed by market research and competitor analysis
* Own the promotional and campaign calendar, including launches, seasonal moments, festive periods, and sale events
* Partner with product and sales to plan pricing, bundles, offers, and launch sequencing

**Performance marketing**

* Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta (Instagram and Facebook), Google (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max), and emerging channels

* Run structured creative and audience testing, and turn results into clear next steps for the content team

**Digital marketing and retention**

* Grow owned channels including email, WhatsApp, and SMS, with lifecycle journeys such as welcome, browse and cart recovery, post-purchase, and replenishment

* Work with the content and social team to keep messaging, storytelling, and brand voice consistent across every touchpoint
* Support influencer and creator programs with tracking, performance analysis, and amplification of top-performing content through paid media

**Measurement and reporting**

* Build weekly and monthly dashboards covering acquisition, retention, and revenue performance
* Translate data into recommendations that the founders and team can act on quickly
* Track market trends, competitor activity, and consumer behaviour in the Indian beauty space, and bring those insights into planning.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years running performance marketing for a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce brand.
* Proven experience managing meaningful paid media budgets on Meta and Google, with results you can speak to in numbers
* Experience planning and executing a product or brand launch from strategy through to measurement
* Strong working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and at least one email or CRM platform such as Zoho, Klaviyo, WebEngage, or MoEngage
* Comfort with data: building reports in spreadsheets or dashboard tools, reading attribution, and running clean tests
* A good eye for creative and an understanding of what makes beauty content perform, especially on Instagram and short-form video
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across creative, product, and sales teams
* Strong organisational skills and comfort managing several priorities in a fast-moving, early-stage environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with luxury, premium, beauty, skincare, or wellness brands
* Familiarity with marketplace marketing on Nykaa, Amazon, or Myntra
* Experience working with influencers and creators at scale
* Understanding of the Indian D2C landscape and regional audience nuances

**D2CX by Inc42**
— our fastest-growing IP and India's most credible voice on building consumer brands.

The mandate is simple to state and hard to execute:
**make D2CX the single best source of content on D2C and consumer brand building in India**
, and get every meaningful stakeholder in the D2C and ecommerce ecosystem — founders, operators, investors, agency and enabler teams, category managers, and aspiring brand builders — following us.

You will own
**Instagram**
as the primary growth engine,
**build and scale our YouTube channel**
from strategy to publishing cadence, and set up the social playbook for
**new IPs Inc42 launches**
in this space. This is a builder's role, not a scheduler's role — you'll decide what gets made, why it will travel, and how it compounds into audience.

Our ideal candidate is a creative, obsessive, insight-led social professional from a modern media brand, a content-first startup, or a creator-led business — someone who watches a reel and instinctively knows why it worked.

**About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India’s #1 startup media & intelligence platform that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated events & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015, and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India’s startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch and other major outlets hundreds of times.

We also track over 50,000+ startups and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and events for startup & business leaders across India.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 150+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**What winning looks like**

* **D2CXbyInc42 becomes the default follow**
  for anyone building or backing a consumer brand in India — measured on follower growth, reach, saves, shares, and share of voice in the category.
* **A real YouTube channel, not a dumping ground**
  — with defined formats, a publishing rhythm, and watch-time and subscriber growth that compounds month on month.
* **A repeatable content engine**
  where every D2CX session, cohort, event, report, and founder conversation converts into multi-format social output without extra lift.
* **Social becomes a demand channel**
  — driving qualified applications and enrolments into D2CX programs, not just vanity reach.
* **Every new Inc42 IP launches with a social playbook ready on day one.**

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Instagram — Own & Scale D2CX**

* Own the end-to-end strategy, calendar, and growth of the @d2cxbyinc42 handle across Reels, carousels, Stories, collabs, and broadcast channels.
* Define the content pillars that make D2CX the authority on D2C — brand decodes, category breakdowns, founder playbooks, operator insights, data drops, and myth-busting.
* Set the format mix and publishing cadence, and hold the line on it.
* Build a hook-and-retention discipline: study drop-offs, iterate on openers, kill formats that don't travel, double down on the ones that do.
* Drive collaborative posts and cross-posting with founders, brands, creators, and partner handles to expand reach beyond our own audience.
* Own comments, DMs, and community engagement as a growth lever, not an afterthought.

**YouTube — Build The Channel**

* Build the YouTube content strategy from the ground up: channel positioning, format architecture, long-form vs Shorts mix, and publishing cadence.
* Design repeatable formats — founder interviews, brand teardowns, category deep-dives, session cuts, and explainers — and run them as series, not one-offs.
* Own packaging: titles, thumbnails, hooks, chapters, descriptions, and end screens; A/B test relentlessly.
* Own YouTube SEO and discovery — keyword research, tagging, playlists, and Shorts-to-long-form funnel design.
* Track watch time, retention curves, CTR, and subscriber conversion, and use them to shape the next slate.

**Content Strategy & Production**

* Convert D2CX's raw material — cohort sessions, Basecamp and Runway conversations, events, DataLabs reports, founder interviews — into a high-volume, high-quality social pipeline.
* Write and direct scripts, hooks, captions, thumbnail copy, and carousel narratives in the D2CX voice: founder-to-founder, tactical, no fluff.
* Work with design, video, and editorial to run production sprints that keep the calendar full without dropping quality.
* Maintain and evolve the D2CX content and design system so output stays instantly recognisable across formats.
* Build a repurposing engine — one session should yield reels, shorts, carousels, quote cards, newsletter blocks, and a long-form cut.

**New IP Launches**

* Build the go-to-market social playbook for every new IP Inc42 launches in this space — positioning, handle setup, content pillars, launch calendar, and first-90-days growth plan.
* Set up measurement, reporting, and iteration loops for each new handle from day one.
* Codify what works on D2CX into templates other IPs can run with.

**Creators, Founders & Partnerships**

* Build and manage a network of D2C founders, operators, and creators who contribute to and amplify D2CX content.
* Plan and execute influencer and creator collaborations, takeovers, and co-created series.
* Deliver on brand and sponsor social commitments across D2CX programs and events without diluting audience trust.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Own weekly and monthly reporting across Instagram and YouTube — reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, watch time, retention, and traffic/conversion contribution.
* Run structured post-mortems on top and bottom performers, and turn findings into the next content bet.
* Benchmark against category and competitor handles in India and globally, and bring the best ideas back.
* Share clear, decision-ready performance reads with founders and key stakeholders.

**Professional Traits**

**A. Mandatory Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in social media, content marketing, or creator-led content, with hands-on ownership of a brand or IP handle.
* **Demonstrated growth on social platforms**
  — you can point to handles you scaled and explain exactly what drove it.
* Strong Instagram craft: short-form video instincts, hook writing, format design, and an actual read on why things go viral.
* Working knowledge of YouTube growth — packaging, retention, SEO, Shorts strategy, and channel building.
* Sharp writing skills in English, with a natural feel for Hinglish where the audience calls for it.
* Comfortable with numbers — able to read analytics and change the plan because of them, not despite them.
* Experience with social and scheduling tools (Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, Later, Buffer/Hootsuite, or equivalent) and analytics platforms.
* Genuine interest in D2C, consumer brands, retail, and ecommerce — and in the Indian startup ecosystem broadly.
* Creative mindset with an eye for detail; heavy consumer of content across social, OTT, newsletters, and creator media.

**B. Preferable Skills:**

* Experience at a modern digital media brand, content-first startup, D2C brand, or creator-led business.
* Hands-on with editing and design tools (CapCut, Premiere, Canva, Figma) enough to prototype without waiting on a queue.
* Exposure to performance marketing, email/WhatsApp lifecycle, and community-led growth.
* Experience launching a new social handle or content IP from zero.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple IPs running in parallel.

description:
Job Description: Account Manager (Social Media \& Content Strategy)
 



  





 Vertical: At Buzz (Atraski)
 



 Location: CR Park, South Delhi (On\-site)
 



 Salary (CTC): ₹2,16,000 – ₹3,00,000 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time, Immediate Joiner
 



  





 About Atraski:
 



  





 Atraski is a national integrated services powerhouse designed to bridge the gap between creative vision and commercial execution. We operate through a "Hub \& Spoke" model, delivering excellence across four specialised pillars:
 



  





 1\. At Buzz is our flagship marketing and digital growth arm.
 



 2\. Atraski Studios is the vertical is our high\-end content house.
 



 3\. Atraski Experiences is our on\-ground activation wing, realities through high\-stakes corporate summits, immersive product launches, and large\-scale brand activations.
 



 4\. Atraski Technology Transformations (ATT) is the tech vertical.
 



  





 The Mission:
 



  





 We are seeking a Process\-First Account Manager for At Buzz who has successfully managed a portfolio of brands in a high\-pressure agency environment. This is not just an execution role—you are the architect of the Content Infrastructure. You must build the systems that allow our creative talent to thrive and deliver excellence to our clients consistently.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. Vision to Execution (The Core):
 



  




* Strategic Calendar Planning: Create the Monthly Social Media Calendar before the month begins. This must be a Visual Grid Strategy that balances engagement, education, and sales.
* Mood Boarding: Create detailed Mood Boards for every campaign or shoot. You need to visualize the aesthetic, color palette, lighting, and vibe of the brand and get it approved by the client before production starts.
* Detailed Designer Briefing: Act as the translator between the Client and the Creative Team. Provide highly detailed briefs to Graphic Designers and Video Editors (specifying fonts, timestamps, audio, and reference links) to minimize revisions.



  





 2\. Hands\-On Execution:
 



  




* Canva Pro Mastery: Use Canva Pro for creating quick layouts, stories, presentations, and urgent static creatives without depending on the design team for minor tasks.
* Mobile Video Editing: Edit on the fly using VN/CapCut—stitching BTS footage, syncing audio beats for Trending Reels, and adding subtitles or text overlays quickly.



  





 3\. Inter\-Departmental Coordination:
 



  




* Performance Marketing Team: Ensure the ads team receives high\-quality, high\-converting creatives on time.
* Influencer Team: Brief them on the brand language so they hire the right creators.
* Tech, SEO \& Strategy: Coordinate website banners and long\-term roadmaps.
* Finance \& Delivery (The Gatekeeper): Confirm to the Finance Team that all deliverables are completed and approved so that invoices can be raised.



  





 4\. Client Servicing:
 



  




* Act as the Single Point of Contact (POC) for your accounts.
* Lead monthly/weekly status calls and present performance reports.
* Manage client expectations and approvals.
* Take care of the client growth



  





 Candidate Requirements
 


* Experience: 1\+ year in a Marketing/Creative Agency. You must have handled a portfolio of 6–8 active retainers simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Expansion Exposure: Proven track record in an agency that scaled its operations. You understand how to maintain quality control even when the volume of content and number of clients increase.
* Process Skills: Advanced ability to develop Creative Workflows, Approval SOPs, and Briefing Structures from the ground up to minimize revisions and delays.
* Technical Proficiency: Expert\-level knowledge of Canva Pro, VN/CapCut (for quick edits), and Google Workspace (Sheets/Slides for reporting).
* Mindset: A "Systems\-Thinker" who values stability, discipline, and professional accountability over chaos. You don't just "fix" problems; you build systems to prevent them.

title: Marketing Communications Manager
description:
**Company Description**
PappaRoti, founded in Malaysia in 2003, is a global café brand known for its signature coffee-coated butter bun. This distinctive snack combines a crispy, coffee-flavored crust made from high-quality ingredients with a soft, buttery center, freshly baked just before serving. The brand’s unique flavor, aroma, and texture have attracted a loyal following worldwide, with over 410 cafés across multiple countries. PappaRoti enhances this experience with a range of complementary beverages, creating a welcoming café environment for guests. Team members join a growing international brand focused on quality, consistency, and memorable customer experiences.
  
**Role Description**
The Marketing Communications Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for planning and executing marketing communication strategies that build brand awareness and drive customer traffic to PappaRoti outlets. Day-to-day activities include developing and managing campaigns, drafting press releases, creating content for digital and offline channels, and coordinating with design, operations, and franchise teams to ensure consistent brand messaging. The Manager will monitor media coverage and campaign performance, maintain relationships with media and partners, and oversee timelines and budgets for communications projects. This role also involves identifying local marketing opportunities, supporting promotional events, and ensuring that all communications reflect PappaRoti’s brand standards and values.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and marketing communications skills, with the ability to craft clear, engaging messages for diverse audiences.
* Experience in strategic communications and press releases, including media relations and brand storytelling.
* Proficiency in project management, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple campaigns on schedule.
* Background in digital and social media marketing, content creation, and basic analytics to track campaign effectiveness.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in marketing communications or a similar role, preferably in food & beverage, retail, or hospitality.
* Strong writing and editing skills, attention to detail, and ability to adapt tone and style to different channels.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and external partners, and to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of the Delhi market and consumer trends; familiarity with regional languages is an advantage.
