title: Lead Research Executive
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and research-driven **Lead Research Executive** to identify potential business clients and build accurate, relevant prospect databases for our sales and business development team.

You will research businesses using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, and other online sources. Your responsibilities will include identifying suitable businesses, finding business owners and decision-makers, collecting and verifying contact information, and identifying companies that may benefit from our digital marketing services.

The ideal candidate enjoys online research, understands how to evaluate business prospects, and takes pride in maintaining clean, reliable, and well-organized data.

**Our priority is lead quality, data accuracy, and prospect relevance—not simply collecting large volumes of random contacts.**

Key Responsibilities1. Online Business & Prospect Research

* Research businesses using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, business directories, and other relevant online sources.
* Identify potential clients based on industry, location, business type, company size, and other defined criteria.
* Research businesses that may need digital marketing, website development, SEO, paid advertising, or related agency services.
* Explore different industries and local markets to discover relevant business opportunities.
* Follow research guidelines and maintain consistent standards when identifying potential clients.

2. Contact & Decision-Maker Research

* Identify business owners, founders, directors, marketing heads, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Find available business contact information, including company email addresses, business phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and website details.
* Research company websites and public business profiles to understand their services and operations.
* Verify available contact information before adding it to the prospect database.
* Record the source of information where required to support accuracy and future verification.

3. Prospect Identification & Lead Qualification

* Identify businesses that may have a genuine need for digital marketing services.
* Research newly launched businesses and companies showing signs of growth or expansion.
* Identify businesses with weak websites, outdated online information, limited social media activity, or other potential improvement opportunities.
* Look for publicly visible indications that businesses are investing in advertising or marketing.
* Evaluate prospects against defined criteria and prioritize those that best match the target customer profile.
* Distinguish relevant business prospects from companies that do not fit the requirements.

4. Data Verification & Database Management

* Build and maintain organized prospect databases using Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM systems.
* Check contact details and company information for accuracy and relevance.
* Remove duplicate records and flag invalid, outdated, or incomplete information.
* Standardize company names, locations, contact fields, and other database information.
* Segment prospects by industry, location, business category, and other useful criteria.
* Maintain clear and consistent records so the sales team can use the data efficiently.

5. Research Reporting & Process Improvement

* Maintain records of research sources, completed lists, and prospect qualification status.
* Follow assigned research criteria, deadlines, and data quality standards.
* Report incomplete information, recurring data issues, and difficulties in finding relevant prospects.
* Identify useful directories, research methods, and sources that improve lead quality.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development team to understand which prospects are most valuable.
* Refine research methods based on feedback and the quality of leads generated.

Tools & Platforms

* **Business Research:** Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART
* **Professional Research:** LinkedIn and company websites
* **Additional Sources:** Business directories and other relevant public online sources
* **Data Management:** Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* **Lead Management:** CRM software and internal tracking systems

Skills & Qualifications

* Strong online research and information-gathering skills.
* Ability to identify businesses based on specific industry, location, and customer criteria.
* Familiarity with Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, or similar research platforms.
* Ability to identify business owners and relevant decision-makers.
* Understanding of contact research, data verification, and prospect database building.
* Basic knowledge of B2B lead generation and lead qualification.
* Good attention to detail and ability to identify duplicate or inaccurate records.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and organized data entry.
* Ability to follow instructions, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent research quality.
* A proactive approach to identifying useful information and relevant business opportunities.

Prior experience with lead research, data research, market research, contact research, or B2B prospecting is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

**Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Freshers with strong online research skills, attention to detail, and basic spreadsheet knowledge can apply.

Candidates with experience in lead research, B2B prospect research, data research, market research, contact databases, or lead generation will be preferred.

How Success Is Measured

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Relevance of businesses identified against the target customer profile.
* Accuracy and completeness of contact information.
* Quality of decision-maker identification.
* Number of valid, verified, and usable prospects delivered.
* Consistency in removing duplicates and maintaining clean databases.
* Ability to identify promising businesses with potential digital marketing needs.
* Timely delivery and adherence to research criteria.
* Feedback from the sales team on the usefulness of the leads.

We value **accurate research, qualified prospects, and actionable business data over raw database size.**

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for freshers, online researchers, data research executives, lead research executives, and candidates interested in B2B prospecting and business development.

If you enjoy researching businesses, finding useful information online, identifying potential customers, and organizing accurate data, we encourage you to apply.

**Apply now to help our sales team discover relevant businesses and build a reliable pipeline of potential clients.**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Anand Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager (Finance & Strategy)

**Company:** Special You  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Location:** New Delhi

About Special You

Special You is a growing e-commerce and quick-commerce business selling products through platforms such as Amazon, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other online channels.

We are looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of the company's financial planning, cash flow, profitability and business performance. This role goes beyond accounting and bookkeeping. You will work closely with the founders and help the business make better financial decisions, manage costs and plan for growth.

Key Responsibilities

**Financial Planning & Business Analysis**

* Prepare budgets, financial forecasts and business plans.
* Analyse sales, expenses, profit margins and overall business performance.
* Evaluate the profitability of products, brands and sales channels.
* Support decisions related to pricing, discounts, marketing expenses, inventory and business expansion.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce unnecessary costs.

**Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare and review monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Prepare financial reports and dashboards for management.
* Track key business metrics such as gross margin, contribution margin, marketing ROI, inventory turnover and cash flow.
* Analyse financial data and provide meaningful insights to the founders.

**Cash Flow & Financial Management**

* Monitor daily cash flow and maintain cash flow forecasts.
* Plan working capital requirements and ensure sufficient funds for business operations.
* Track payments, receivables, marketplace settlements and vendor dues.
* Monitor settlement cycles across Amazon, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other platforms.
* Identify potential cash shortages in advance and suggest solutions.

**Accounts & Financial Control**

* Review and supervise the work of the accountant, including accounting records, bills, reconciliations and financial reports.
* Ensure marketplace settlements, commissions, fees and other charges are properly recorded and reconciled.
* Maintain accurate financial records and proper internal controls.
* Ensure financial reports are accurate and prepared on time.

**Taxation & Compliance**

* Oversee GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliance.
* Coordinate with the accountant and external CA for tax filings, audits and compliance.
* Ensure the company maintains proper financial documentation and remains audit-ready.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Business Finance or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow management and financial planning.
* Good knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and profitability.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Experience with accounting software such as Tally or Zoho Books.
* Understanding of GST, TDS and Indian taxation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to explain financial information in simple language.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in e-commerce, D2C, retail or quick-commerce businesses.
* Familiarity with marketplace settlements, commissions and fees on Amazon, Blinkit, Zepto or Swiggy Instamart.
* Experience working in startups or fast-growing businesses.
* Exposure to fundraising, banking, loans or investor reporting.

What We Are Looking For

* Someone who takes ownership of the company's financial health.

* Good communication and coordination skills.

* Ability to handle multiple bookings and work under deadlines.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email, and other computer applications.

\*Job Title:\* Customer Care & Sales Executive

Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Customer Care & Sales Executive who can manage customer queries, drive sales conversions, handle order processing, and coordinate with logistics partners. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, hands-on experience with MS Excel (especially VLOOKUP), and a strong understanding of e-commerce operations and logistics.

Key Responsibilities

\*1. Customer Care & Support\*

- Handle customer queries through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and other communication channels.

- Provide timely updates regarding order status, dispatch, delivery, returns, and replacements.

- Resolve customer complaints professionally and ensure customer satisfaction.

- Follow up with customers regarding pending orders, delivery issues, and feedback.

- Maintain proper records of customer interactions and complaints.

\*2. Sales & Conversion\*

- Follow up with potential customers and convert enquiries into successful orders.

- Handle abandoned cart (ABDN) follow-ups and generate sales.

- Identify sales opportunities and achieve assigned monthly sales targets.

- Maintain relationships with existing customers and encourage repeat purchases.

- Follow up on pending and incomplete orders to improve conversion rates.

\*3. Order Management\*

- Handle order confirmation for COD and prepaid orders.

- Monitor order processing, dispatch, and delivery status.

- Coordinate with the warehouse and internal teams for timely order fulfilment.

- Maintain records of pending, confirmed, cancelled, and dispatched orders.

\*4. Logistics & Courier Coordination\*

- Coordinate with logistics partners such as Shiprocket and courier companies.

- Handle NDR (Non-Delivery Reports), RTO (Return to Origin), and delivery exceptions.

- Follow up with courier partners for delayed, undelivered, and stuck shipments.

- Ensure timely resolution of delivery-related issues.

- Maintain daily logistics reports and track shipment performance.

\*5. MS Excel & Reporting\*

- Strong knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.

- Hands-on experience with VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, and data filtering.

- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and customer support reports.

- Maintain order tracking sheets, NDR reports, RTO reports, and follow-up records.

- Analyse data and prepare reports to monitor team performance and sales conversions.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

- 1–3 years of experience in customer care, sales, or e-commerce operations.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong knowledge of MS Excel, especially VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.

- Understanding of e-commerce order management and logistics operations.

- Knowledge of COD confirmation, NDR, RTO, and shipment tracking.

- Good follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work with targets and manage multiple responsibilities.

- Familiarity with Shopify, Shiprocket, CRM, or similar platforms will be an added advantage.

Preferred Candidate

A candidate who is responsible, target-oriented, comfortable handling customers, and capable of managing both sales and operational activities independently

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Overview**

Enterprise Digital Sales, part of Microsoft's Digital sales organization, empowers our customers through the unique value of the Microsoft Cloud by building a globally-led, digital-first scale organization aligned with partners. As part of our local subsidiaries or Digital Sales centers around the world, you will engage a dedicated set of enterprise customers to identify and achieve their business objectives through best-in-class digital engagement and partner co-selling. You will also have an opportunity to work collaboratively across teams while living our shared SMC and Digital Sales Culture priorities: Diversity and Inclusivity, Wellbeing, Sustainability, and Customer Obsession. If you have a passion for driving digital-first solutions and delivering customer satisfaction, we invite you to learn more about Enterprise Digital Sales and the value we bring to our customers, partners, and one another, every day.

As part of our transformation, one of our key areas of focus is the modernization of our sales motions. The Digital Sales organization is an organization with a charter to accelerate Microsoft’s growth in its cloud-first, mobile-first businesses along with the traditional businesses.

The focus of the Digital Enterprise Support Specialist’s role is to drive and close Microsoft Enterprise Support opportunities to ensure customers are supported throughout all stages of the product lifecycle, improving their health and enabling customer outcomes and consumption. The Digital Enterprise Support Specialist leverages Microsoft’s unique expertise, including direct access to product teams, to help customers use their Microsoft investments as productively as possible.

We are always learning. Insatiably curious. We lean into uncertainty, take risks, and learn quickly from our mistakes. We build on each other’s ideas because we are better together. We stand in awe of what humans dare to achieve and are motivated every day to empower others to do more and achieve more through our technology and innovation. Together we make a difference. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Engages in conversations with customers to introduce how Unified Support could enable digital transformation areas that is aligned with the customer's industry in collaboration with the Account Teams and Services. Shares learning on digital transformation through seminars, workshops, webinars, and direct engagement.
* Collaborates with team members to discover new Unified Support opportunities. Drives incremental revenue growth through personal campaigns (e.g., portfolio analysis) or internal sources (e.g., Marketing). Collaborates with account teams, and services to track and qualify new Unified Support opportunities. Collaborates with other teams (e.g., account teams) and services to build pipeline. Interfaces with customers and builds relationships via social selling. Applies Microsoft's sales process (MCEM) to determine the quality of the opportunity and whether to proceed.
* Identifies Unified Support opportunities to drive consumption and grow business with existing customers by initiating conversations, providing demos or quotes, and collaborating with internal teams (e.g., Technical Sales Professionals, Global Black Belts.
* Identifies customer business needs and technical readiness. Collaborates with internal teams, and services to propose prioritized solutions that align with customers' needs. Leverages the value propositions to communicate business impact of proposed solutions. Listens to customers to understand business outcomes.
* Develops an understanding of external stakeholders' mapping, including who the decision makers and influencers are. Participates with account teams (e.g., Account Executives) in communication with business or subject matter decision makers at the customer's business.
* Implements strategies to help accelerate the closing of deals in collaboration with other team members. Implements close plans (e.g., how to map timeline, engage the customer, get customer buy-in and commitment) to de-risk and drive predictable deal closure.

  
**Qualifications**

**Sales Excellence**

* Collaborates with internal resources and leverages customer insights or industry knowledge. Contributes to exploring business and emerging opportunities to optimize the portfolio and support customer innovation.
* Reviews feedback report and coaches others on ensuring customer satisfaction and decreasing dissatisfaction by establishing recovery action plans to improve clients' overall experience. Manages and/or orchestrates sales and delivery success through the account team and Customer Success team.
* Engages with internal and external stakeholders on business planning, Rhythm of Business (ROB) meetings to review and plan for accounts in the assigned territory.
* Collaborates with extended sales team, partners, and marketing to conduct business analysis (e.g., whitespace analysis, identify industry trends) to pursue high-potential customers and develop a target list of potential business.

**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience.
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND 3+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience.
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND 4+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: E-commerce Executive — Marketplaces & D2C
description:
**What this role actually is**

You will run our online business across every channel we sell on — the orders, the stock, the listings, the reconciliation, and the relationships — and help us launch new ones as we add them.

It is not a listing job. Uploading products is perhaps a day a month. The rest is making sure we're paid correctly, stocked correctly, priced correctly, and visible where it matters.

Our own website matters as much as the marketplaces and will matter more over time.

**What you'll do**

* **On the marketplaces**
* Process purchase orders, book appointments, track inward and GRN discrepancies
* Reconcile every settlement against invoices, explain every deduction and credit note
* Track availability at store level and plan replenishment with the plant
* Keep listings accurate and work with each platform's category team
* Run and measure platform visibility spend
* **On our own site**
* Product content, pricing, stock and merchandising
* Order flow, returns, customer queries
* Campaigns and performance — what's selling, what isn't, and why
* **As we grow**
* Help launch each new platform: onboarding, contracts, catalogue, first orders
* Keep our platform register current so nothing depends on one person's memory
* Flag margin and pricing problems before they become losses

**What we need**

* You understand e-commerce commercially, not just operationally. Outright, sale-or-return, marketplace, consignment, D2C — you know how each one moves money, and where the risk sits.
* You are strong in Excel. VLOOKUP, pivot tables, comparing two files to find what doesn't match. Roughly half this job is reconciliation.
* You notice when two numbers don't agree, and you chase it. Everything else is teachable. This isn't.
* You write clear, professional English email.

Contact Person: Tarun Parashar: 9079401082 - Share your resume on WhatsApp first.

**What you get**

* Exposure to both sides — the platforms and our own brand
* A manufacturer that makes what it sells, so you'll understand the whole chain
* This role grows into managing the function. We will review title and scope within six months to 1 year.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

title: Director - Engineering
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. The Director's primary goal is to establish, nurture, and guide a team that can integrate seamlessly with the rest of the company's teams to deliver high-quality work and guarantee client satisfaction.

Directors find balance between the needs of the Client & Program, their People & the Company & Craft, as described in the Key Responsibilities section below.

Scope of influence is across Formula.Monks, their Foundry and the Staff, Manager, Senior Manager & Associate Director levels.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Client & Program**

* **Client Success**: Provide strategic oversight for client relationships across various programs. Foster strategic partnerships with executive client stakeholders to ensure long-term retention. Serve as the ultimate escalation point for addressing critical issues relevant to the Foundry. Utilize industry trends and historical data to proactively anticipate and address client needs. Analyze client feedback systematically to identify recurring issues and direct necessary improvements.
* **Delivery Excellence**: Drive account strategy & vision, ensuring a clear and impactful direction. Establish the north star for quality delivery. Introduce innovative technologies and methodologies to improve the effectiveness of delivery processes. Collaborate closely with peers to align delivery strategy, ensuring consistency and integration of best practices.
* **Account Growth:** Contribute to the development of new service offerings, enhancing the company's market competitiveness. Work closely with marketing and sales teams to drive initiatives that support account growth. Take ownership of major pitches and proposals, ensuring that they are strategically aligned with business goals.

#### **People**

* **People Development**: Craft and maintain high performance standards through clear expectation setting, mentoring, and coaching. Lead learning and development programs to enhance team capabilities, knowledge expansion, and adoption of new technologies. Cultivate leadership within the team, spearheading initiatives targeted at the development of leaders and high-potential individuals. Oversee and strategically plan for succession to ensure long-term organizational resilience and growth.
* **Culture**: Lead by example to uphold and promote company values, actively evangelizing and coaching the team on the core tenets of our culture. Lead efforts that strengthen company culture and engagement. Analyze trends that could indicate cultural challenges and propose improvements
* **Building High-Performing Teams**: Take ownership of building & continuously improving the Foundry. Design cross-functional teams by identifying necessary skills and assembling a team that meets project needs. Foster healthy, inclusive, and collaborative dynamics, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable. Encourage the development of autonomous and self-healing leadership teams. Cultivate communities of practice to enable continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and innovation among team members. Build organizational structures that are scalable and flexible, so teams can adjust to evolving business demands and new technologies.

#### **Company & Craft**

* **Company Strategy**: Cultivate alignment within the team with Formula.Monks goals, ensuring that every decision made supports overarching strategy. Define and lead forward-thinking strategic initiatives that impact Formula.Monks. Manage the budget for internal initiatives, maximizing organizational effectiveness and strategic impact. Lead company growth initiatives.
* **Company Processes**: Maintain compliance with company policies, actively contributing to the improvement and optimization of operational processes. Continually refine Foundry best practices by identifying opportunities for improvement and spearheading changes. Carefully evaluate the necessity of processes, recognizing where flexibility, automation and/or common sense are warranted to optimize efficiency. Lead efforts to share highly impactful processes across teams.
* **Information Exchange**: Effectively communicate strategic decisions from the company to the team. Keep the rest of the leadership team in the loop about significant risks. Create mechanisms to eliminate silos within the team, promoting collaboration across Foundries. Own internal communication to enhance clarity and effectiveness. Engage with the team by eliciting and thoughtfully responding to their questions, concerns, and feedback, fostering an open and transparent communication culture. Lead external evangelism & thought leadership initiatives.
* **Talent Management**: Strategically forecast and plan for future staffing needs, ensuring the organization is prepared to meet both immediate and long-term demands. Optimize the use of both billable and non-billable resources to align with project needs and organizational objectives. Regularly update and refine job descriptions to reflect current expectations and requirements. Play an active role in the onboarding of new leaders, working to continuously improve the leadership onboarding process. Define and execute retention strategies to reduce turnover.

  

### **Competencies**

See Foundry Competencies Matrix (TBD)

### **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in leadership and people management roles.
* Experience building and shipping technical products with complex scope.
* Excellent consulting and communication skills.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, and team-building experience.

### **Reporting Structure**

People at the Director level report to Senior Directors and above.

**About Monks**

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

**Customer:** Government DISCOM (Power Distribution Utility)

Should have managed at least two large System Integration projects preferably with Central/State Government or Private Organizations in the Power Sector.  
  
  
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract
  
**Role Overview**
  
We are seeking an experienced **SAP Assistant Project Manager** to lead a large-scale **SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) Greenfield Implementation** for a Government Power Distribution Company (DISCOM) in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, stakeholder management, governance, risk management, quality assurance, and successful implementation of SAP industry best practices across utility business processes.
  
The Project Manager will act as the primary liaison between the customer, implementation partner, SAP, system integrators, and other stakeholders while ensuring timely and budget-compliant project execution.
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Project Leadership & Governance**

* Lead complete lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA PCE Greenfield implementation from project initiation to go-live and hypercare.
* Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Establish project governance framework and conduct Steering Committee meetings.
* Ensure compliance with Government, DISCOM, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage project scope, change requests, and contractual obligations.

**SAP Program Management**

* Drive SAP Activate methodology and implementation best practices.
* Coordinate solution design, realization, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Manage multiple workstreams including:
  + Finance & Controlling (FI/CO)
  + Materials Management (MM)
  + Sales & Distribution (SD)
  + Asset Management (EAM/PM)
  + Project Systems (PS)
  + Human Capital Management (HCM/SuccessFactors integration)
  + SAP IS-Utility integrations
  + Analytics and Reporting

**Stakeholder Management**

* Engage with Government officials, DISCOM executives, business heads, consultants, SAP teams, and vendor partners.
* Facilitate requirement workshops and executive presentations.
* Manage communication across all project stakeholders.
* Present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to senior management.

**Utility Industry Transformation**

* Understand and align utilities business processes such as:
  + Power Distribution Operations
  + Metering and Billing
  + Procurement and Inventory
  + Asset Lifecycle Management
  + Financial Accounting
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Budget and Capital Project Management

**Risk & Quality Management**

* Identify project risks, dependencies, and issues proactively.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Ensure quality assurance across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
* Monitor project health through KPIs and dashboards.

**Team Management**

* Lead cross-functional teams comprising SAP consultants, developers, infrastructure specialists, and business users.
* Manage project resource allocation and performance.
* Mentor junior project managers and functional leads.

**Testing and Deployment**

* Oversee:
  + SIT (System Integration Testing)
  + UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
  + Performance Testing
  + Security Testing
  + Cutover Planning
  + Go-Live Readiness

**Change Management & Training**

* Drive organizational change management activities.
* Ensure user adoption strategy and training plans are executed.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer sessions and hypercare support.

**Required Qualifications**
  
**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, or equivalent.
* MBA/PGDM preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **10+ years of SAP project management experience**.
* Minimum **2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation projects** as Project Manager.
* At least **1 Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation** experience.
* Experience working with Government, PSU, Utilities, Power Distribution, Electricity Board, or DISCOM organizations preferred.
* Experience managing projects valued above ₹20 Crore preferred.

**Mandatory Skills**

* SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE)
* SAP Activate Methodology
* SAP Project Management
* Greenfield Implementation Experience
* Program Governance
* Risk Management
* Budget and Resource Management
* Vendor Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management
* Agile and Waterfall Delivery Models
* SAP Solution Manager / Cloud ALM
* Strong Documentation and Reporting Skills

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Activate Project Manager Certification
* SAP S/4HANA Project Management Certification
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* PMI-ACP (Preferred)
* ITIL Foundation

**Desired Industry Experience**
  
Preference will be given to candidates having experience in:

* Power Distribution Utilities (DISCOM)
* State Electricity Boards (SEB)
* Energy & Utilities Sector
* Government ERP Projects
* Smart Metering Programs
* Utility Asset Management Projects

**Key Competencies**

* Leadership and Team Management
* Executive Communication
* Government Stakeholder Handling
* Conflict Resolution
* Negotiation Skills
* Strategic Planning
* Analytical Thinking
* Decision Making
* Problem Solving
* Customer Focus

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: Program Director / Engagement Manager
* Customer Interface: DISCOM Leadership, IT Head, Finance Head, Operations Head, PMU, Government Officials
* Team Size Managed: 25-100+ SAP and Technical Resources

**Location & Travel**

* **Work Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Site)
* Willingness to work onsite throughout project duration.
* Travel within DISCOM operational locations as required.

**Success Criteria**

* On-time project delivery
* Budget adherence
* Successful SAP S/4HANA go-live
* User adoption and business process transformation
* Compliance with government and utility regulations
* Customer satisfaction and stabilization during hypercare phase

This role is ideal for a senior SAP Project Manager with strong SAP S/4HANA transformation experience and proven delivery capability in Government Utility/DISCOM environments.

Graduate

At IntelliJ Technologies, we build tailored digital solutions that help businesses scale. title: Sales Team Leader
description:
**1. Job Overview**

The Sales Manager is responsible for leading the sales team, achieving vehicle sales targets, managing customer relationships, generating new business, and ensuring a smooth end-to-end vehicle sales process. The role involves managing sales executives, monitoring leads, converting enquiries into bookings, improving customer satisfaction, and driving revenue through vehicle sales, finance, insurance, accessories, and other value-added services.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Sales & Revenue Management**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Drive sales of new and pre-owned vehicles.
* Monitor daily sales performance, bookings, retail, deliveries, and revenue.
* Develop strategies to improve conversion ratios and increase sales.
* Identify opportunities for additional revenue through finance, insurance, accessories, extended warranty, and other products.
* Ensure maximum utilisation of available inventory and timely stock movement.

**B. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team.
* Allocate leads, customer enquiries, and sales responsibilities.
* Set individual targets for Sales Executives.
* Conduct daily sales meetings and performance reviews.
* Monitor employee productivity, discipline, attendance, and performance.
* Train team members on product knowledge, sales techniques, negotiation, and customer handling.
* Support team members in closing difficult or high-value deals.

**C. Lead Management & CRM**

* Ensure all customer enquiries are properly recorded in the CRM.
* Monitor lead allocation, follow-ups, response time, and lead conversion.
* Ensure no lead is left unattended.
* Track lead status, including:
* New enquiry
* Contacted
* Appointment scheduled
* Test drive completed
* Quotation shared
* Negotiation
* Booking
* Vehicle delivery
* Lost lead
* Analyse lost leads and implement corrective measures.
* Maintain accurate customer records and sales reports.

**D. Customer Relationship Management**

* Ensure a professional customer experience throughout the sales journey.
* Understand customer requirements, budget, preferences, and usage.
* Handle customer complaints, escalations, and negotiation issues.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and customer satisfaction.
* Build long-term customer relationships to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Coordinate with customers regarding booking, documentation, finance, insurance, and delivery.

**E. Product Knowledge & Market Analysis**

* Maintain detailed knowledge of vehicle models, variants, specifications, features, pricing, and offers.
* Stay updated on competitor pricing, promotions, products, and market trends.
* Conduct competitor analysis and identify business opportunities.
* Ensure the sales team is regularly updated about new launches and product changes.
* Understand customer preferences and market demand.

**F. Finance, Insurance & Value-Added Services**

* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for vehicle financing.
* Drive finance penetration and insurance sales.
* Ensure the team offers accessories, extended warranty, service packages, and other relevant products.
* Monitor finance approval, insurance issuance, and documentation processes.
* Maximise customer convenience while improving dealership profitability.

**G. Vehicle Booking & Delivery Coordination**

* Coordinate with inventory, operations, accounts, finance, and registration teams.
* Monitor vehicle availability and booking status.
* Ensure timely vehicle allocation and delivery.
* Verify customer documentation, payment status, registration, insurance, and delivery readiness.
* Ensure vehicles are delivered in proper condition and on the committed date.
* Maintain proper records of bookings, cancellations, pending deliveries, and completed deliveries.

**3. Daily Activities**

* Review previous day's sales performance.
* Check new leads and pending customer follow-ups.
* Assign leads to Sales Executives.
* Conduct daily team briefing and target review.
* Monitor customer visits, test drives, quotations, and bookings.
* Review pending finance approvals and vehicle deliveries.
* Coordinate with inventory and operations teams.
* Handle escalated customers and closing negotiations.
* Track sales targets versus actual achievements.
* Prepare daily sales reports and update CRM.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Sales Manager will be evaluated based on the following performance parameters:

KPI

Performance Measurement

Monthly Vehicle Sales

Total vehicles sold against target

Target Achievement

Percentage of monthly target achieved

Lead Conversion Ratio

Enquiries converted into sales

Test Drive Conversion

Test drives converted into bookings

Booking Conversion

Bookings converted into retail/delivery

Lead Response Time

Speed of response to new enquiries

Follow-up Compliance

Timely follow-up with prospective customers

Finance Penetration

Percentage of vehicle sales financed

Insurance Penetration

Insurance sales against total vehicles sold

Accessories Sales

Revenue from accessories and add-ons

Customer Satisfaction

Feedback, complaints, and customer experience

Team Productivity

Individual sales executive performance

Lost Lead Management

Proper tracking and analysis of lost leads

**5. Reporting & MIS**

The Sales Manager shall prepare and maintain:

* Daily Sales Report (DSR)
* Monthly Sales Performance Report
* Sales Executive Performance Report
* Lead Funnel & Conversion Report
* Test Drive Report
* Booking & Cancellation Report
* Vehicle Delivery Report
* Finance & Insurance Penetration Report
* Lost Lead Analysis
* Inventory Ageing Report
* Customer Follow-up Report
* Monthly Target vs. Achievement Report

**6. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field preferred.
* 3–7 years of experience in automobile sales.
* Minimum 1–3 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role.
* Experience in automobile dealerships, multi-brand car sales, new cars, or pre-owned cars preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
* Experience working with CRM software and sales reporting systems.

**7. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Sales planning and target achievement.
* Problem-solving and decision-making.
* Strong follow-up and closing abilities.
* Knowledge of automotive products and market trends.
* CRM management and data-driven sales analysis.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Professional attitude and customer-centric approach.

**8. Decision-Making Authority**

The Sales Manager shall be authorised to:

* Allocate leads and sales opportunities to team members.
* Monitor team performance and recommend corrective action.
* Conduct customer negotiations within approved pricing and discount limits.
* Recommend sales promotions and marketing initiatives.
* Escalate special pricing, discounts, or commercial approvals to management.
* Recommend hiring, training, and performance improvement plans for the sales team.

**9. Coordination with Other Departments**

The Sales Manager will work closely with:

* Marketing Team – lead generation and campaigns.
* Operations Team – vehicle availability and delivery.
* Finance Team – payments, finance approvals, and commercial reconciliation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly and annual export sales revenue.
* Number of new international buyers acquired.
* Number of qualified leads and conversion rate.
* Number and value of export orders secured.
* Repeat business and client retention.
* Timely order execution and payment collection.

title: Territory Manager (Perinthalmanna)
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
As a Territory Manager based inPerinthalmanna, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus onRetail promotion alongside vitalDoctor/HCP support. You will champion ourOTC (Over the counter) andOTX (Over The Counter and Prescription) portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines.
* HCP Support: Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through targeted scientific communication, relationship building, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and support OTX prescriptions.
* Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
* Merchandising& Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market.
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
* Strategic Meetings& Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits.

Who You Are
  
  

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* You have proven practical experience inpharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working withOTC (over-the-counter) and/orOTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products.
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies.
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Coimbatore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

The position will be responsible for translating the Group's strategic vision into executable business plans, ensuring projects are commercially viable, delivered efficiently, and aligned with approved budgets, timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Identify opportunities to enhance the commercial value of projects.

* Drive productivity, cost optimization, and effective resource utilization.

11. **Exhibition & Sample Order Support:** Coordinate exhibition-related operational requirements, allocation of work, courier arrangements and preparation of sample orders for required products.

description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

title: CSS - PM - Manager

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting Support Services – Manager**
**The opportunity**

* CSS enables Consulting Project team’s efficiency and delivery through the key project management and coordination activities.
* We take responsibility for end–to–end project lifecycle essential for project delivery. We manage project financial analysis, tracking and reporting, project communication, compliance & governance activities across all Field of Play.

**Your Key Role And Responsibilities**

* Conceptualizing visuals based on consulting business requirements – presentation and documentation
* Exceptional writing, speaking, proof-reading and organizational skills
* Responsible for developing timely, cohesive, high-quality and competitive proposals
* Responsible for layout, formatting, production of proposals for presentations, white papers and other documents
* Familiar with creating story boards and illustrations for consulting (business & technical) pursuit deals
* Provide guidance regarding changes necessary in content, style and organization
* Have techno functional mindset with lateral thinking for providing differentiated customer experience, best suited to meet requirements leading to deal win.
* Showcase innovative and unique design skills to represent data and proposal decks in EY/Client specific format while being compliant to branding guidelines

**Business management**

* Manage deployment and utilization of team assigned, span of 10-20, Staff, Senior and AMs
* Manage operational activities like co-ordination, supervision, work allocation and compliance
* Source and share feedback with team members, contribute to mid-year/annual appraisal cycles
* Expand CSS integration across member firms through building networks and developing new services
* Involve in people initiatives including recruiting and training professionals and act as a role model
* Lead and collaborate on team and consulting level initiatives
* Quality control, review of the team's work, and ensuring overall adherence to SLAs and KPIs
* Support quality and risk management needs across consulting practices (InfoSec, Data Privacy etc.)
* To facilitate transition of new work from project initiation to 'business as usual' and focus on continuous improvement/efficiency gains
* Be insightful about the Consulting Fields of Plays and utilize that knowledge to make suggestions and/or recommendations
* Full time role
* Onsite/work from office needed (hybrid)
* Flexible to work with different time zones
* Willing to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement
* Willing to travel, within the country and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Any Graduate/Postgraduate, preferably B.Com/BBA/Economics/B.Tech or master’s degree
* Good to have CSM/PSM, CAPM/Prince2/PMP, Project Management Fundamentals or Six sigma certification
* Prior experience of 2+ years in creative and content designing, preferably working on drafting responses on RFPs/RFIs
* Professional services design teams or advertising agencies exposure with consulting firms are a big plus
* Adobe cloud software's like Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After effects, Premiere Pro
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications (PowerPoint, Excel - charts and graphs and Word)
* Blender, Templafy, Deck Robot and other leading applications
* Worked on sales pitch enhancement tools like Prezi
* Familiarity with animation and creating storyboard marketing videos are valued skills.
* Involvement during presales stages
* Exposure with building Murals and Visio flow
* Web design and understanding of user interface principles are good to have.
* Strong English communication - both written and verbal
* Attention to detail even when dealing with routine tasks
* Confident, Assertive, with strong communication and influencing skills
* Ability to comprehend EYs business, think strategically, adapt to change
* Experience with go to market activities, should have proposal drafting and strong presentation skills
* Ability to identify problems, perform research, solve complex business problems and recommend solutions
* Prior experience working with Global cliental required
* Self-starter, excellent team player, organized and self-disciplined. Ability to work with senior leadership

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role
  
  
with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: General Manager - Quality
description:
**Company Description:**

Sance Laboratories Pvt Ltd is an established pharmaceutical manufacturer specialising in Cephalosporin antibiotics, backed by over two decades of expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing. Its existing WHO-GMP and PIC/S GMP-compliant facility manufactures Dry Powder Injections, Tablets, Capsules and Dry Syrups, catering to multinational pharmaceutical companies, leading Indian pharmaceutical brands and its own domestic product portfolio.

As part of its strategic growth and global expansion plans, Sance Laboratories is developing a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility dedicated to the production of high-quality, life-saving pharmaceutical products for highly regulated international markets, particularly the United States (US) and the United Kingdom (UK).

To spearhead this strategic initiative, we are seeking an accomplished and visionary General Manager – Quality to provide overall leadership to Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) functions. The incumbent will play a pivotal role in designing, establishing and implementing robust, globally benchmarked quality systems and ensuring the facility's readiness for regulatory inspections and sustained compliance with USFDA, UK MHRA, EU GMP and other applicable international regulatory requirements.

Job Description:

Reporting to: Managing Director

Department: Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Location: Greenfield Project / Existing Manufacturing Facility near Pala, Kottayam District - Kerala

1. Position Purpose

To provide overall leadership for the Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions of the organisation, with primary responsibility for establishing and operationalising a comprehensive Quality Management System (QMS) for the proposed greenfield pharmaceutical manufacturing facility catering to regulated markets, particularly the USA and UK.

The incumbent will lead quality-related activities from the project planning and infrastructure development stages through facility commissioning, qualification, validation, regulatory inspections and commercial operations. In addition, the incumbent will provide strategic guidance and periodic oversight to the quality operations of the existing manufacturing facility.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Greenfield Project – Quality Establishment

· Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive QMS aligned with USFDA, UK MHRA, EU GMP, PIC/S GMP, WHO-GMP and applicable ICH requirements.

· Participate in the planning, design and development of manufacturing facilities, laboratories, utilities and associated infrastructure to ensure GMP compliance.

· Establish quality systems, SOPs, specifications, documentation practices, organisational structure and manpower requirements for QA and QC.

· Oversee facility, equipment and utility qualification, process validation, cleaning validation, analytical method validation and computerised system validation.

· Ensure effective technology transfer, process scale-up and analytical method transfer.

· Coordinate with Projects, Engineering, Production, R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams to incorporate quality requirements at every stage.

· Develop and implement a regulatory inspection readiness plan, including gap assessments, mock audits and corrective action programmes.

B. Quality Assurance and Quality Control

· Exercise overall responsibility for QA and QC operations and ensure consistent product quality and regulatory compliance.

· Establish and maintain robust systems for deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT investigations, quality risk management and document control.

· Oversee raw material, packaging material, in-process and finished product testing, stability studies and batch documentation review.

· Ensure effective product release systems, product quality reviews, complaint handling and product recall procedures.

· Monitor quality trends and drive continual improvement in manufacturing and laboratory practices.

C. Regulatory Compliance and Audits

· Lead regulatory inspections and customer audits, particularly those conducted by USFDA, UK MHRA, EMA and other applicable international authorities.

· Ensure sustained inspection readiness through internal audits, compliance reviews and periodic mock inspections.

· Lead responses to regulatory observations and audit findings, ensuring timely and effective CAPA implementation.

· Monitor changes in international regulatory requirements and ensure their effective implementation.

· Oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits and quality agreements with external service providers.

D. Quality Systems and Data Integrity

· Ensure compliance with cGMP, GLP, applicable FDA 21 CFR requirements and relevant international regulatory standards.

· Establish robust data governance systems in accordance with ALCOA+ principles.

· Ensure appropriate controls over electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails and computerised systems, including applicable 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

· Promote a strong quality culture based on accountability, documentation discipline, risk prevention and continual improvement.

E. Existing Plant – Quality Oversight

· Provide strategic and technical guidance to the existing plant's QA and QC functions.

· Periodically review quality performance, regulatory compliance, deviations, CAPAs, audit observations and product quality trends.

· Guide the existing quality team in resolving critical quality issues and maintaining inspection readiness.

· Promote harmonisation of quality systems and best practices across both facilities, wherever appropriate.

F. Leadership and Team Development

· Build, lead and develop competent QA and QC teams capable of meeting international regulatory expectations.

· Establish departmental objectives, budgets, manpower plans and training programmes.

· Work closely with cross-functional heads to ensure quality accountability throughout the organisation.

· Provide regular updates to senior management on project quality milestones, regulatory risks, compliance status and operational readiness.

3. Key Performance Expectations

Performance will primarily be assessed against the following outcomes:

· Timely establishment of a comprehensive and effective QMS for the greenfield facility.

· GMP compliance of facility design, infrastructure, utilities and equipment.

· Timely completion of qualification and validation programmes.

· Regulatory inspection preparedness for USFDA, UK MHRA and other applicable authorities.

· Effective management and timely closure of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.

· Sustained data integrity and laboratory compliance.

· Development of a competent and accountable QA/QC organisation.

· Continuous improvement in the quality performance of the existing facility.

4. Educational Qualifications

· M.Pharm / M.Sc (Chemistry / Pharmacy / Pharmaceutical Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology) or equivalent discipline.

· MBA or an additional qualification in Quality Management or Pharmaceutical Management will be an advantage.

5. Experience and Professional Background

· 15–20 years of overall experience in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.

· Minimum 5–8 years in senior Quality leadership positions such as Head – Quality, General Manager – Quality or equivalent.

· Proven experience in managing integrated QA and QC functions in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

· Experience in greenfield pharmaceutical projects, facility commissioning, GMP implementation and regulatory readiness will be a significant advantage.

· Practical experience in handling international regulatory inspections, particularly USFDA and UK MHRA, is strongly preferred.

· Exposure to regulated markets, particularly the USA, UK and Europe, is highly desirable.

6. Technical and Functional Competencies

· Strong knowledge of cGMP, WHO-GMP, PIC/S GMP, EU GMP, USFDA and UK MHRA requirements.

· Sound understanding of ICH guidelines, pharmaceutical quality systems and Quality Risk Management.

· Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Parts 210, 211 and 11, as applicable.

· Expertise in validation, qualification, technology transfer, data integrity and laboratory controls.

· Knowledge of process validation, cleaning validation, analytical method validation and stability studies.

· Exposure to sterile and non-sterile manufacturing requirements, as relevant to the company's product portfolio.

7. Leadership and Behavioural Competencies

· Strong strategic thinking, leadership and team-building capabilities.

· High professional integrity and commitment to quality and compliance.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.

· Ability to independently handle complex regulatory and quality-related challenges.

· Effective communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

· Proactive, result-oriented approach with the ability to build a quality-driven organisational culture.

description:
**Job Description: Presales Executive (Lead Generation & Business Development) - Civil Engineering Background Mandatory**

**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep large-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kael” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**The Role:**

We are looking for an articulate, proactive Presales Executive with a civil engineering background to drive lead generation and prospect engagement at Inkers. You will be the first voice of Inkers to our prospects: generating leads, following up consistently, understanding what prospects need, and scheduling discovery calls with our Account Managers. You will also represent Inkers at construction-tech summits, trade shows and exhibitions, where many of our best prospects are found. This is a growth role, and with strong performance you will move into an Account Manager position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Lead Generation & Follow-ups**

● Generate new leads through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels, targeting developers, contractors, EPC firms, PMC and consulting companies.

● Screen and qualify incoming enquiries and event leads against defined criteria.

● Follow up with prospects consistently and on time until they are ready for a sales conversation or are disqualified.

**Prospect Engagement & Call Scheduling**

● Speak with prospects to introduce Inkers and Observance, and understand their project needs and challenges.

● Schedule and confirm discovery and demo calls between prospects and Account Managers.

● Brief Account Managers with prospect background and requirements before every call.

● Research prospects and companies to enrich lead data.

**Events & Industry Presence**

● Participate in construction-tech summits, trade shows, exhibitions and webinars; engage visitors and capture leads.

● Coordinate event preparation with the team and run structured post-event follow-ups.

● Be willing to travel for events when required.

**Database, Reporting & Sales Support**

● Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of leads and conversations in the CRM and sales database.

● Track and report key metrics: calls made, conversations held, meetings scheduled and lead conversion.

● Support the sales team with documentation, presentations and proposals when required.

**Qualifications:**

● Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Civil Engineering; an MBA is an added advantage.

● Excellent spoken and written communication in English; confident on calls and in face-to-face conversations. Knowledge of Hindi or Kannada is an advantage.

● Prior experience in presales, inside sales, business development or lead generation is preferred; strong freshers are welcome.

● Good understanding of construction processes and project lifecycle; awareness of BIM or construction technology is a plus.

● Comfortable with cold calling and persistent follow-ups; self-motivated, organised and target-driven.

● Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

● Keen to build a career in B2B technology sales and grow into an Account Manager role.

**Career Growth:**

Presales Executive to Account Manager, based on performance and demonstrated ownership of the prospect journey.

**What We Offer:**

● Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in the construction technology sector.

● A defined growth path from Presales to Account Manager.

● Exposure to industry events, summits and senior decision-makers in construction.

● Collaborative and innovative work environment.

● Competitive salary and benefits package.

● Access to the latest scanning and modeling technologies.

**Work Location: Bangalore (On-site), with occasional travel for events**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Solutions Architect (SA)**

**Location:**
Bangalore

8–12 Years

**About Lucidity**

Lucidity helps enterprises save up to 40% of their cloud costs. Its AI Action Engine is a set of AI agents that deliver savings, not just recommend them. Most cloud cost tools stop at a dashboard. Our agents find waste that generic FinOps tools miss, work out which changes are safe for each workload, and make them in production with a human in the loop. Every change is monitored, verified and reversible.

We started with the hardest layer, live block storage. Our platform right-sizes disks as workloads grow and shrink, moves them to the right performance tier, and cleans up idle disks, all without downtime, across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. We are now extending the same approach to object storage and compute, so customers can cut up to 40% across their cloud bill.

Today Lucidity works with 100+ enterprises. We have identified more than $500M in savings and taken over 1.5M autonomous actions on production infrastructure.

Why join us

* Build AI agents that safely change live production infrastructure for large enterprises.
* Ranked among LinkedIn Top Startups India three years in a row Linkedin Top Startup 2026 , a Gartner Cool Vendor 2025 Link and a CRN Stellar Startup 2025 Link
* Series A company with $31M raised from WestBridge Capital, Alpha Wave Global and Beenext.
* Work closely with co-founders Vatsal & Nitin.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**Solutions Architect**
who can operate as the single technical owner for our most complex, high-value enterprise accounts - someone who needs minimal direction to take a customer from technical evaluation through large-scale production rollout. This is not a role for someone who executes a playbook; it's for someone who can build the playbook, defend it in front of a customer's CTO, and adapt it on the fly when the environment doesn't cooperate.

You'll be the senior-most technical voice in the room for enterprise accounts - trusted to make architectural calls independently, to push back on both customers and internal teams when the easy answer isn't the right one, and to represent Lucidity credibly to VP- and C-level technical stakeholders.

* Independently own end-to-end technical architecture and solution design for Lucidity's largest and most complex enterprise engagements, across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments - with minimal oversight from leadership.

* Working experience across Windows and Linux environments.
* Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers/architects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing technical documentation, whitepapers, or presenting at events.
* Strong account and project management skills - able to run multiple complex, concurrent enterprise engagements.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites/locations as necessary.
* Public cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in the storage domain is a strong plus.
