title: Growth Marketing Manager, Amazon Fashion
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fashion is one of the largest and fastest-growing businesses within Amazon India. Fashion is also one of the most dynamic and competitive categories in e-commerce, requiring continuous innovation across customer acquisition, traffic generation, engagement, and retention.
  
  
We are seeking an analytical, customer-obsessed, and highly entrepreneurial Marketing Manager to own one of the most critical functions within the category - Growth & Traffic for Amazon Fashion.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with exceptional execution capabilities, thrive in ambiguity, influence large cross-functional teams, and demonstrate a relentless bias for action. This role requires deep understanding of customer behavior, traffic channels, marketing experimentation, and performance measurement.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Traffic Ownership & Growth Strategy
  
  

* Own end-to-end topline traffic growth for Amazon Fashion, including customer visits (RCVs), glance views (GVs) and share of site growth.
* Serve as the category advocate with central marketing teams.
* Develop quarterly and annual growth plans, identifying key traffic opportunities, risks, and investment priorities.
* Develop traffic strategy and own execution plans for High Velocity Events, including central sale events (ARTs) and category specific tier-1 events (eg- Wardrobe Refresh Sale).
* Own category marketing investments across performance marketing, sale events, customer promotions, and emerging growth channels, continuously optimizing ROI and business outcomes.

Traffic Channel Optimization
  
  

* Build deep expertise across all traffic-driving mechanisms, including internal and external traffic channels.
* Identify and scale high-impact traffic drivers while continuously optimizing channel efficiency and effectiveness across paid channels like Associates, Paid Search, Paid Social, messaging channels etc.
* Partner with channel owners to influence roadmap, improve customer experience, and unlock incremental traffic opportunities for Fashion.
* Own traffic initiatives for priority customer segments including Prime, Premium, Gen-Z, and New-to-Amazon customers.
* Identify, pilot and scale new traffic and customer acquisition opportunities, like AI-led discovery experiences, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), social commerce etc.

Experimentation & Performance Analytics
  
  

* Build and execute a robust experimentation roadmap across traffic channels and marketing programs.
* Conduct deep-dives to identify growth opportunities, diagnose business performance, and quantify impact of marketing initiatives.
* Establish mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to track performance and influence business decisions.
* Own retrospective analysis for experiments, BAU and event strategies to consolidate learnings across controllable marketing channels and turn them into repeatable playbooks to optimize for business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Partner with Product, Prime, XCM, Finance, Ads, and external agency teams to deliver growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with brands to unlock incremental traffic through co-funded marketing investments.
* Present recommendations, business reviews, and growth strategies to senior leadership.
* Influence category, product and central marketing roadmaps to improve customer discovery, experience, conversion and long-term business growth.

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day involves reviewing traffic and customer funnel performance, identifying growth opportunities, prioritizing experiments, and influencing cross-functional teams to improve business outcomes. You will work closely with channel owners, product teams, and business leaders to solve traffic problems, launch marketing programs, and build scalable mechanisms that drive long-term growth. The role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and data-driven decision making.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
* Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience collaborating and influencing multiple teams across multiple organizations
* Experience performing statistical analysis of data using SQL, Excel and other tools
* Experience with marketing experimentation, traffic optimization, and/or customer lifecycle management
* Experience owning traffic, growth, acquisition, or lifecycle marketing programs in e-commerce
* Experience building customer segmentation and targeting frameworks
* MBA or equivalent business experience

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Full-time, office-based role in India supporting a US-based medical practice group offering hair restoration, cosmetic, and vein services. Daily overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours is required.

Role purpose

Execute the marketing program through consistent content, campaigns, and lead generation. This hands-on role turns marketing agency recommendations into completed work, manages GoHighLevel, and tracks qualified consultation opportunities.

Key responsibilities

• Content and social media: Edit recordings, scripts, photos, and approved patient stories into branded videos, reels, posts, and email assets using Canva and AI video tools. Manage active channels, publishing, community engagement, and escalation of patient questions.

• Production planning: Maintain an organized asset library and content calendar. Within 30 days, propose a measurable production and publishing schedule. Meet deadlines and flag bottlenecks early.

• GoHighLevel and campaigns: Build, maintain, test, and troubleshoot contacts, tags, forms, pipelines, calendars, workflows, and dashboards. Run approved email and nurture campaigns with accurate segmentation and unsubscribe handling.

• Lead operations: Test acknowledgments, routing, notifications, and follow-up tasks. Monitor unassigned inquiries and overdue responses and escalate them. Track lead sources and quality, and recommend campaign improvements.

• Agency coordination: Coordinate execution of agency recommendations for content, SEO, forms, landing pages, and tracking, with clear owners, deadlines, and completion records.

• Reputation and approvals: Manage review requests, business profiles, and response drafts; escalate complaints. Maintain each brand's voice, obtain physician approval for clinical content, and follow privacy and security policies.

Required qualifications

• Proven digital marketing and content production experience, preferably in medical, cosmetic, hair restoration, or consultation-based services, with a portfolio showing personal contributions and results.

• Advanced hands-on GoHighLevel skills, including automation, lead routing, campaigns, reporting, and troubleshooting.

• Strong Canva and video editing skills, including captions, audio cleanup, platform formatting, and efficient use of AI tools.

• Excellent written and spoken English, attention to detail, and independent project management.

• Ability to interpret analytics, improve campaigns, and document repeatable workflows.

• Willingness to work from the office during hours that overlap with United States Eastern Time.

Performance and reporting

Performance is measured on on-time content delivery, reliable lead routing and tracking, qualified inquiries and consultation bookings by source, and engagement and reputation. A brief weekly dashboard is required.

First 90 days

• Days 1 to 30: Audit channels, assets, agency recommendations, and GoHighLevel. Fix urgent gaps and establish baseline metrics and an approved content calendar.

• Days 31 to 60: Deliver the agreed hair restoration content and email cadence, complete priority agency tasks, and report lead quality and campaign results.

• Days 61 to 90: Refine campaigns, document workflows, and prepare for expansion to cosmetic and vein services.

Hiring process

Candidate evaluation includes a live GoHighLevel demonstration and a short video editing sample.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About This Role**
Xoxoday’s largest wins come from landing and growing enterprise accounts, and HubSpot is the system that runs how we find, engage and convert them. We’re hiring a HubSpot CRM & ABM Manager to own that system and the account-based programs built on top of it.
  
  
You’ll own and operate HubSpot across CRM, Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, and use it to power targeted, multi-channel campaigns, automation and reporting. You’ll work closely with Sales and Product Marketing, and your work will show up in pipeline and revenue.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**HubSpot CRM, workflows and reporting**

* Own and operate HubSpot (CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub), including properties, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, lead routing, sequences and integrations.
* Build and maintain automated workflows for lead nurturing and for the journey from MQL to SQL to closed-won, including upsell and cross-sell.
* Build dashboards and reports on account engagement, funnel conversion, pipeline influenced, attribution and campaign ROI, and share insights with the team.
* Keep CRM data clean, enriched and reliable so targeting and reporting can be trusted.
* Set up signal-based triggers, waterfall data enrichment and CRM syncs that move high-intent accounts to Sales quickly.

**ABM programs**

* Identify decision-makers and buying-committee personas in target accounts using tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Clay.
* Plan and run personalized campaigns across email, LinkedIn, paid media, outbound and events that reach the full buying committee.
* Use buying signals such as intent data, job changes, funding news and website activity to time and prioritize outreach.
* Create ABM playbooks, messaging and sales plays, and work with Sales and Product Marketing to drive adoption.

**AI and GTM automation**

* Use AI tools and agents for account research, personalized messaging, lead enrichment and outbound at scale.
* Build automated outbound and enrichment workflows using tools like Clay and Zapier, with APIs and webhooks where needed.
* Manage outbound infrastructure and email deliverability, including domain setup, warm-up and sequencing, with tools like Apollo, HeyReach, Outreach or Salesloft.

**Experimentation and tooling**

* Run A/B tests on messaging, channels and audiences, measure results, and scale what works.
* Evaluate new AI and GTM tools, and own the marketing tech stack and its cost.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Demonstrate expert-level HubSpot skills across workflows, lead scoring, dashboards, reporting and integrations.
* Bring 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing across ABM, demand generation or marketing automation, including at least 2 years running ABM or target-account programs.
* Show hands-on experience with ABM and prospecting tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Lusha or Cognism, Clay, 6sense or Demandbase, and G2 intent data, along with outbound tools such as HeyReach, Outreach or Salesloft.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, personalization and workflow automation, including writing effective prompts.
* Work with no-code or low-code automation (Zapier, Make, n8n) and basic APIs and webhooks. SQL or scripting is a plus.
* Show a track record of campaigns that influenced enterprise pipeline, built in close partnership with Sales.
* Apply strong analytical skills to funnel metrics, attribution and market research.
* Switch between strategy and hands-on execution.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Hold HubSpot certifications.
* Bring experience marketing to global enterprise buyers, or to HR, rewards or fintech audiences.

What Makes You a Strong Fit
  
  

* Treat the CRM as the foundation of revenue operations, and keep its data and workflows dependable.
* Build before you scale, and prefer a working automation over a perfect plan.
* Partner with Sales as a peer, and shape plays together with them.
* Test ideas quickly and let the data decide what to keep.
* Stay comfortable in both the strategy deck and the HubSpot workflow builder.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Every campaign, handoff and report depends on a CRM that works. This role keeps HubSpot accurate, automated and trusted, and connects it to focused account-based outreach. The systems, data and playbooks you build will shape how Marketing and Sales work together on our most important accounts.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  

* Own and operate our HubSpot environment and ABM motion, with real ownership and high visibility.
* Work in a fast-paced environment with plenty of room to learn.
* Join a team of talented young professionals across offices in Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, California, New York, Dubai, Singapore and Dublin.
* Market products used by over 2000 global clients: Plum, Empuls and Compass.
* Receive the comprehensive benefits that Xoxoday offers.

title: Product Marketing and GTM - Senior Manager
description:
**Role: Product Marketing and GTM - Senior Manager**

Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore

Prev. Experience: 5-7 yrs

**Life at Qoruz**

**Build. Experiment. Own. Grow.**

Qoruz is a
**150+ member team**
working across India, building technology and campaigns for the creator economy.

Life at Qoruz is
**fast-paced, competitive and collaborative**
, with a flat hierarchy that gives you the freedom to take ownership, experiment, work closely with leadership, and turn ideas into real impact.

We work with some of the world’s leading brands, including
**BMW and Google**
, while continuously taking on bigger challenges as we grow.

If you’re a
**go-getter who enjoys ownership, learning, experimentation and building things from scratch**
, you’ll fit right in.

**About the Role**

This is a hands-on GTM role responsible for turning Qoruz’s product priorities and market problems into campaigns that create enterprise demand.

When we identify an opportunity, launching a new product, building leadership around a category, responding to competition, or changing how the market perceives Qoruz: you will own how we take on that problem in the market.

You will design and run these programs end-to-end across narrative, content, video, web, PR, distribution, sales enablement, ABM, and other relevant touchpoints.

You will be measured on whether these programs create qualified enterprise attention, interest and influence over the pipeline, not based on the number of activities executed.

**What You’ll Own**

* Turn a clear business goal or product priority into a campaign plan and take it live
* Own major product and category campaigns end-to-end, from the initial idea and messaging to launch, distribution, and results
* Decide what each campaign needs across medium - website, content, videos, reports, customer stories, PR, email, sales material, and other formats, and drive them to completion
* Work with PR, SEO, and design teams, to make sure every part of the campaign works together
* Equip ABM and Sales with the narratives, assets, proof, and campaign hooks required to create and progress enterprise opportunities
* Track whether campaigns are creating qualified interest, sales opportunities, and pipeline, and improve them based on what works

**Right fit**

* 5–7 years of experience across B2B SaaS product marketing, GTM, demand generation, integrated marketing, or enterprise marketing
* Has independently taken campaigns or product launches from a broad business brief to a complete market-facing program
* Strong at turning a business problem into a campaign idea, narrative, content plan, distribution strategy, and execution roadmap
* Comfortable coordinating multiple teams and specialists while remaining personally accountable for the final outcome
* Commercially minded and comfortable being measured on qualified demand, opportunities, and pipeline contribution
* Can think strategically about where Qoruz should show up while still being hands-on with execution

**Not a Right fit**

* Needs a detailed campaign brief before being able to start execution
* Experience is primarily in managing individual channels only (social, emails, content or PR)
* Previous KRAs were largely limited to content creation only. (blogs or sales collateral)
* Has primarily coordinated agencies or specialists without personally owning the campaign

If you think in systems, care about outcomes, and want to build a real revenue engine, we’d love to move this quick.

title: AI Marketing Intern
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a curious, creative and tech-savvy AI Marketing Intern who is excited about exploring the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, marketing and business growth.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who enjoys experimenting with AI tools, building creative marketing campaigns, automating workflows and finding innovative ways to reach and engage audiences.
  
  
You will work closely with the Founder’s Office to explore how AI can transform traditional marketing activities, improve productivity, create engaging content and drive measurable business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* AI-Powered Marketing & Content Creation
* Leverage Generative AI tools to create marketing content, campaign ideas, brand messaging and promotional materials.
* Experiment with AI tools to generate social media posts, blogs, newsletters, ad copies and marketing creatives.
* Use AI-powered image, video and design generation tools to develop engaging marketing assets.
* Build effective prompts to generate high-quality, relevant and brand-aligned content.
* Explore new AI tools and identify creative applications for marketing.
* AI Marketing Automation
* Explore AI-powered tools to automate repetitive marketing tasks and workflows.
* Experiment with AI agents and automation platforms to improve marketing efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate content distribution, lead research, audience segmentation and campaign workflows.

* AI-Driven Growth & Campaigns
* Research and experiment with AI-powered growth marketing strategies.
* Use AI tools for market research, competitor analysis and identifying target audiences.
* Develop creative campaign concepts using AI-driven insights.
* Experiment with AI-assisted SEO, search visibility and content distribution.
* Support lead-generation initiatives through AI-powered research and outreach.
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimisation.
* AI + Social Media & Brand Marketing
* Explore AI-powered tools for managing and scaling social media content.
* Create reels, short-form videos, graphics and campaign creatives using AI tools.
* Experiment with AI video generation, editing, voiceovers and image-generation platforms.
* Identify emerging content trends and use AI to develop innovative brand storytelling.
* Support brand-building initiatives across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms.
* AI Research & Innovation
* Stay updated on emerging Generative AI tools, marketing technologies and industry trends.
* Research new AI products and identify their potential marketing applications.
* Experiment with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and other emerging platforms.
* Explore ways to combine different AI tools to create end-to-end marketing solutions.
* Present innovative ideas and recommendations to improve marketing processes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, digital marketing, growth and technology.
* Hands-on curiosity about Generative AI tools and their practical applications.
* Good understanding of social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
* Ability to write effective prompts and generate useful outputs using AI tools.
* Creative thinking and an experimental mindset.
* Good communication, research and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools and work in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Ability to take ownership of ideas and execute them independently.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar AI tools.
* Exposure to AI image and video generation tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Canva AI or similar platforms.
* Basic understanding of marketing automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or Make.
* Familiarity with SEO, analytics, email marketing or performance marketing.
* Experience building personal projects, AI workflows, social media pages or marketing campaigns.

**What You Will Gain**

* Direct exposure to the Founder’s Office and strategic business initiatives.
* Hands-on experience implementing AI in real-world marketing workflows.
* Opportunity to experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies.
* Exposure to growth marketing, brand building and marketing automation.
* Freedom to experiment, build prototypes and implement innovative ideas.
* Opportunity to work on projects where AI and marketing come together.

**Who Should Apply?**
We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited about AI and its potential to transform marketing. You could be a fresher, student, content creator, technology enthusiast or someone who regularly experiments with AI tools and enjoys building new things.
  
  
We value practical experimentation, curiosity and execution over theoretical knowledge.
  
  
**If you love experimenting with AI, creating innovative marketing ideas and building the future of marketing, this role is for you!**

This is a paid internship.Skills: marketing,campaigns,building,social media,artificial intelligence,marketing automation

* Be part of a team delivering content to passionate combat sports fans worldwide.

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Iberia
description:
**Job Description**

* Performance Marketing Manager – Iberia

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Reports to:**
Head of Growth Marketing Hub – Iberia & Europe (this role based in Bangalore, and will report to the COE Director)
  
  
**Purpose of Role**
The Performance Marketing Manager owns the paid acquisition strategy, media investment and performance across all Iberia schools, ensuring paid media generates qualified demand and enrolments at the strongest possible commercial return. The role combines deep performance-marketing expertise with portfolio-level judgement to direct investment, identify growth gaps and turn media and funnel performance into timely action.
  
  
As the specialist owner of paid acquisition within the Growth Marketing Hub, the role works within ISP Group technology, data and brand standards and partners with Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, CRM, Digital, Creative and Growth Performance & Insights. It owns paid acquisition performance while remaining distinct from Group platform governance and Digital Marketing ownership of SEO and broader website optimisation.
  
  
**Role in the Operating Model / Scope**

* Owns paid acquisition strategy, online media investment and paid acquisition performance, translating portfolio growth priorities into channel strategy, allocation decisions and optimisation.
* Regional Marketing Managers own school and market business priorities and local growth requirements; this role owns the specialist paid acquisition response and its performance.
* The Director of Marketing & Growth owns overall marketing strategy and cross-market investment principles across MEA; the Head of Growth Marketing Hub & Innovation owns overall Hub capability and delivery.
* This role is responsible to phase, pace and reallocate online media investment across schools, markets and channels based on pipeline gaps, lead quality, enrolment return and available capacity, within agreed investment parameters.
* Works through agencies and specialist resources for execution, setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable for commercial outcomes.
* Owns paid acquisition and paid-funnel optimisation; partners with Digital/Web on CRO and website changes, and with Group/Data teams on platform, privacy, tracking and measurement standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Paid Acquisition Strategy & Portfolio Planning**
Own the annual and in-cycle paid acquisition strategy across markets, aligning investment and channel plans to enrolment targets, phasing, school capacity, admissions calendars and local market dynamics.
  
  
**Media Investment & Commercial Return**
Own online media allocation, phasing, pacing and reforecasting across the portfolio. Make evidence-based trade-offs and reallocate investment to maximise qualified demand, enrolment outcomes and return. Track invoicing and accruals, reconciling agency fees and media spend with purchase orders/invoices.
  
  
**Full-Funnel Performance & Intervention**
Own paid acquisition performance from demand generation through downstream enrolment outcomes, diagnosing material gaps and acting on Marketing-controlled levers while escalating or partnering on issues owned elsewhere.
  
  
**Optimisation, Experimentation & Scaling**
Lead disciplined optimisation and test-and-learn across paid acquisition, quantify commercial impact and scale successful approaches across markets without losing local relevance.
  
  
**Channel, Measurement & Performance Standards**
Set the specialist approach and quality standards for paid channels, tracking, attribution and platform optimisation, ensuring investment is optimised toward lead quality and downstream outcomes within Group data, privacy and martech standards.
  
  
**Agency & Specialist Resource Leadership**
Direct and challenge paid media agencies and specialist resources, setting clear commercial expectations, service standards and evidence-based ways of working, and holding partners accountable for performance.
  
  
**Cross-Hub Conversion Integration**
Identify paid-funnel conversion leakage and define performance requirements or testing hypotheses across landing pages, creative, CRM and Admissions hand-offs, partnering with the relevant owners on implementation. This includes briefing the creative team when needs for improved paid media ads.
  
  
**Performance Insight, Innovation & Capability**
Translate performance and enrolment data into clear portfolio recommendations and interventions, while advancing scalable performance-marketing standards, emerging platform capability, AI-enabled optimisation and shared learning across the division.
  
  
**Functional Capabilities Required**

* Paid Acquisition Strategy & Platform Expertise – Deep expertise across major paid platforms and the ability to set scalable channel, account, audience, bidding and optimisation approaches across markets.
* Media Investment & Commercial ROI Management – Ability to allocate, phase, reforecast and reallocate significant media investment against qualified demand, enrolment outcomes and portfolio return.
* Full-Funnel Performance & Conversion Optimisation – Ability to diagnose performance from traffic through enrolment, distinguish root causes and improve Marketing-controlled conversion levers in partnership with adjacent owners.
* Measurement, Attribution & Data Fluency – Strong working knowledge of tracking, GA4, tagging, offline conversion feedback, attribution and privacy-aware measurement sufficient to ensure reliable optimisation and decision-making.
* Experimentation & Performance Optimisation – Ability to design disciplined tests across audiences, creative, bidding, offers and campaign structures, quantify impact and scale proven approaches.
* Agency & Performance Operations – Ability to set outcome-based expectations, challenge external specialists with evidence and establish scalable standards, governance and delivery discipline.
* Emerging Performance Technology – Strong fluency in AI-enabled campaign tools, automation and evolving measurement capabilities, with sound judgement on their commercial application within Group standards.

**Leadership Capabilities Required**

* Commercial & Portfolio Judgement – Makes investment and prioritisation decisions based on enrolment, return and portfolio opportunity rather than platform metrics alone.
* Analytical & Root-Cause Thinking – Diagnoses complex performance problems, separates symptoms from causes and focuses intervention on the levers most likely to change outcomes.
* Ownership & Decision-Making – Takes accountability for paid acquisition performance, acts quickly on material risks and makes clear trade-offs with imperfect information.
* Influence & Constructive Challenge – Communicates performance, recommendations and investment choices clearly to senior stakeholders and challenges agencies or partners where evidence supports a different course.
* Capability Leadership – Sets high specialist standards, shares learning and builds scalable performance-marketing maturity across agencies, teams and markets.

**Essential**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Significant performance-marketing / paid-media experience with deep hands-on expertise in acquisition, optimisation and lead-generation funnels.
* Proven ownership of paid acquisition across multiple markets, brands, sites or business units, balancing scalable standards with local market requirements.
* Demonstrated ownership of substantial media budgets, including allocation, pacing, reforecasting and evidence-based reallocation to improve commercial return.
* Track record of optimising toward downstream commercial outcomes such as qualified leads, sales or enrolments rather than media metrics alone.
* Strong measurement and funnel-analysis experience, including conversion tracking, attribution, offline conversion feedback and performance dashboards.
* Experience managing and challenging agencies and/or specialist resources against clear commercial KPIs and service expectations.
* Experience partnering across digital/web, CRM and customer-conversion teams to improve lead quality and end-to-end acquisition performance.

**Preferred**

* Experience in private education, multi-site consumer services or another considered-purchase sector; Iberia/Europe/Middle East/Asia exposure is advantageous.
* Relevant degree and/or platform certifications are advantageous; demonstrated capability and commercial results are more important than formal credentials.

**Core KPIs / Success Measures**

* Qualified Demand & Enrolment Contribution – Performance of paid acquisition against agreed qualified-enquiry and enrolment targets and phasing.
* Paid Acquisition Efficiency & ROI – Commercial efficiency of media investment, including cost per qualified outcome and return across markets and schools.
* Funnel Quality & Conversion – Quality and downstream conversion of paid demand, with material leakage identified and addressed through the appropriate owner.
* Investment Allocation Effectiveness – Quality of budget pacing, reforecasting and reallocation decisions in response to portfolio opportunity, capacity and pipeline gaps.
* Optimisation & Scaled Learning – Measurable impact of test-and-learn activity and successful interventions scaled across relevant markets.
* Agency & Specialist Performance – Effectiveness of agencies and specialist resources against agreed commercial outcomes, service expectations and quality standards.

title: Senior Associate - Social Media
description:
About the Role
  

We are looking for a creative and proactive Senior Associate – Social Media who can manage and execute social media strategies for multiple brands and internal pages.

This role is ideal for someone who understands the evolving social media landscape, knows how to create engaging content, stays updated with emerging trends, and can independently manage day-to-day social media activities.

You will work closely with internal teams, designers, video editors, and content creators to plan and execute social media campaigns, improve brand presence, and drive engagement across platforms.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond just posting content – someone who understands what works, why it works, and how to make brands stand out in an increasingly competitive digital space.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Social Media Strategy & Execution
  
  
  

* Plan and manage monthly social media content calendars for multiple brands.
* Develop platform-specific content strategies for Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Plan content around brand objectives, campaigns, product launches, events, and important announcements.
* Take ownership of content planning, scheduling, publishing, and execution.
* Ensure consistency in brand communication, tone, and visual identity across platforms.

2. Content Planning & Coordination
  
  
  

* Work closely with designers, video editors, writers, and other internal teams to execute content.
* Plan and coordinate engaging Reels, carousels, static posts, stories, and short-form videos.
* Brief creative teams with clear content requirements, references, and timelines.
* Review content before publishing and ensure quality, accuracy, and brand alignment.
* Manage feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure timely delivery.

3. Brand & Account Management
  
  
  

* Independently manage day-to-day social media activities for assigned brands and internal pages.
* Understand individual brand requirements, audiences, and communication styles.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns and deliverables.
* Support hiring campaigns, employer branding, events, product launches, and other brand initiatives.
* Take ownership of assigned accounts and ensure all deliverables are completed on time.

4. Engagement & Community Management
  
  
  

* Monitor comments, DMs, and audience interactions across platforms.
* Draft and manage responses in line with the brand's tone and communication guidelines.
* Identify relevant trends, conversations, and opportunities for brands to participate in.
* Explore ways to improve audience engagement and build stronger online communities.

5. Performance Tracking & Reporting
  
  
  

* Track key metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, and clicks.
* Prepare weekly and monthly social media performance reports.
* Analyse content performance and identify what is working and what needs improvement.
* Suggest actionable changes to improve engagement, reach, and overall content performance.
* Use performance insights to improve future content planning and execution.

6. Trends, Research & Innovation
  
  
  

* Stay updated with the latest Instagram, LinkedIn, and other social media trends.
* Understand platform algorithms, content formats, hooks, retention, and audience behaviour.
* Actively explore trending Reels formats, memes, creator content, and new-age storytelling techniques.
* Bring fresh content ideas and references to the team regularly.
* Experiment with new formats and creative approaches to improve brand visibility and engagement.

Who Are We Looking For?
  

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in social media management, content marketing, or digital marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram and LinkedIn, including their algorithms, audience behaviour, and content formats.
* Experience in independently managing social media accounts and content calendars.
* Good understanding of Reels, carousels, stories, short-form videos, and platform-specific content.
* Ability to identify trends and convert them into relevant content ideas for different brands.
* Experience coordinating with designers, video editors, writers, and other creative teams.
* Ability to analyse social media performance and suggest improvements based on data.
* Strong communication, coordination, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* A creative mindset with a good understanding of current trends, memes, creators, and digital culture.
* Proactive, organised, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced agency environment.

Why Work With Us?
  
**Flexible Work Culture**
We focus on outcomes, not rigid rules. You'll have the autonomy to manage your work in a culture built on trust and accountability.
  
**Health & Accident Insurance**
Your well-being matters to us. We provide health and accident insurance coverage to support you when it counts.
  
**Complimentary Meals**
Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are on us, so you can stay focused and energised throughout the day.
  
**Sports & Outdoor Activities**
From cricket and badminton to monthly hikes, we keep things active with regular sports and outdoor activities.
  
**Upskill With Us**
Get access to learning platforms like Udemy, mentorship, and opportunities to continuously build your marketing and professional skills.
  
**Performance Gets Rewarded**
We recognise and reward great work through regular incentives, quarterly and annual awards, and ongoing appreciation.
  
Why Should You Join Us?
  

* If you enjoy working on real and challenging marketing problems.
* If you value learning directly from founders and experienced industry professionals.
* If you like having the freedom to experiment, take ownership, and try new ideas.
* If you want to work alongside genuine, supportive, and driven people.
* If you believe in contributing beyond your defined responsibilities and being recognised for your efforts.
* If you are passionate about continuous learning and want an environment that invests in your long-term growth.
* If you want to work on evolving marketing challenges using the latest tools, platforms, and strategies.
* If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow along with the organisation.

Why Shouldn't You Join Us?
  

* If you are specifically looking for a product-based company, we aren't one.
* If you prefer a highly structured corporate environment with rigid roles and responsibilities, our work culture may not be the right fit. We operate as a nimble, bootstrapped organisation.
* If your primary expectation is a salary in the top bracket of the industry, we may not be the right fit.

**Work Location:**
Bommanahalli, Bangalore
  
**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday (On-site) + Saturday Half Day (WFH)
  
**Experience Required:**
1–3 Years

title: Social Media Executive
description:
**Social Media Executive | Nerige Story | Bangalore (Full-time)**

We don't just sell sarees. We tell the stories behind them. Come help us tell them to millions.

**ABOUT NERIGE STORY**

"Nerige" is Kannada for the pleats of a saree, the small folds that give it shape and grace. That's how we see our work: carefully bringing back India's textile heritage so it feels fresh, personal and relevant again.

We're the brand that started the vintage saree collection. We revive the designs, patterns and colour combinations of the 1960s to 80s, the sarees you see in your grandmother's photos and your mother's wedding pictures.

Social media is where Nerige comes alive. Our community connects with us through nostalgia, memory and the bond between mothers, daughters and grandmothers. It has made us one of India's fastest-growing saree brands, online-first and now with a flagship store in Jayanagar, Bangalore.

See what we do: https://www.instagram.com/nerige.story/

**THE ROLE**

You'll run Nerige's day-to-day presence on Instagram, YouTube and our other channels. You'll plan what goes out, make sure it feels unmistakably Nerige, and build a community that keeps coming back. You'll work closely with our shoot and editing team and report directly to the founders.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

• Plan and run the content calendar: collection launches, festive drops, store events and ongoing content series.

• Build our regional channels from scratch: help launch and grow Nerige's regional-language social media channels, from finding the voice to setting up the content and building the audience.

• Come up with ideas: Reel concepts, hooks, trends and formats that fit the Nerige story, never forced or generic.

• Write the words: captions, on-screen text and stories in the warm, nostalgic Nerige voice.

• Coordinate shoots: write briefs and shot lists, and work with the shoot and editing team to get the content we need.

• Build the community: reply to comments and DMs, reshare customer photos and stories, and turn followers into loyal customers.

• Bring the store online: cover events, launches and customer moments at our Jayanagar flagship.

• Work with influencers and creators: find the right voices, coordinate collaborations and track how they perform.

• Track what works: follow reach, engagement and follower growth, and share what's working and what isn't every week.

• Stay ahead: watch trends, platform changes and what other brands are doing.

**YOU'LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU**

• Have 1–3 years of experience handling social media for a brand, ideally fashion, lifestyle or D2C

• Can show accounts or content you've managed, with results

• Write well in English. Kannada, Telugu or Tamil is a big plus.

• Know Instagram inside out (Reels, Stories, Collabs, Broadcast channels) and are comfortable with YouTube

• Can do basic design and quick edits in Canva, CapCut or similar tools

• Understand Instagram Insights and can turn numbers into decisions

• Love Indian culture, textiles, old films and family stories, the things that make our content land

• Are organised, quick and comfortable working on tight timelines, especially during festive seasons

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US**

You won't be working in a big team where your ideas get lost. You'll work directly with the two people who built Nerige's voice and look from day one.

Shashank Sivapurapu: Co-founder & Creative Director

Shashank is the creative mind behind every Nerige campaign. The vintage collection storytelling, the nostalgic reels that made people call their mothers, our content series: he shapes the concept, the narrative and the emotion behind all of it. He has 18 years in sales and brand-building and runs a digital marketing agency for luxury hotels, so he knows what makes content connect and convert. You'll learn how to build a story that people feel first and buy later.

Pooja Nadig: Founder & Face of Nerige Story

Pooja is the face of the brand. You'll see her in our shoots, campaigns and reels. She leads styling and product, and has a sharp eye for drapes, colours, borders and how a saree should look on camera. Working with her, you'll learn to see sarees the way our customers do: as memories, not just products.

**WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU**

• Learn how a brand voice is built, from the person who built ours

• Learn styling, product and the Nerige look from Pooja herself

• Your ideas reach the founders directly. No layers, no waiting.

• See your work drive real results for a fast-growing brand, online and in store

• Be part of the journey as Nerige grows from online to a flagship store and more stores

• Join a team that loves Indian culture, craft and a good story as much as you do

**Location: Bangalore**

**Work mode: Work from office only**

**Working days: Monday to Saturday**

title: Engineering Executive Manager
description:
**Organisation**

At CommBank, we help people and businesses make confident financial decisions and move forward. The Chief Technology Office enables this purpose through simpler, faster and more secure technology platforms and engineering practices.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

Automation & Test Automation

* Lead the design and build of scalable automation and test automation solutions across applications, APIs and services.
* Embed automated testing and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable feedback.

* Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing and automation where it demonstrably improves speed, quality or productivity.

* Develop reusable automation frameworks supporting API, integration, contract and end-to-end testing.
* Apply strong software engineering practices to automation code, including coding standards, source control, maintainability.

Use automation to prevent recurring defects and improve release confidence, engineering productivity and quality.  



Enterprise Initiatives & Strategic Transformation

* Own the end-to-end delivery of enterprise-level identified automation engineering initiatives for CTO, turning strategy into clear roadmaps, milestones and measurable outcomes.

* Lead strategic transformation across engineering platforms, practices and ways of working, balancing ambition with risk, capacity and change readiness.

* Make transparent trade-offs across scope, speed, quality, cost and technology health, and escalate decisions early with a clear recommendation.

Influence & Stakeholder Management

* Build trusted relationships with CTO, Group Technology, business and Australian leadership, and keep sponsors aligned on direction, progress and risk.

* Influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority, using evidence, data and clear articulation of customer, risk and economic trade-offs.

* Constructively challenge and negotiate across competing priorities, resolving conflicts and securing the investment and support transformation requires.

Leading People & Technical Leadership

* Lead a team of Principal Engineers, Staff and Software Engineers, setting clear mandates, accountabilities and decision rights, and creating leadership leverage rather than dependency.

* Partner with Chief and Distinguished Engineers, who hold the broadest technical authority for the portfolio, so that technical direction and delivery priorities stay aligned.

* Manage performance, recognition, career development and succession for senior engineers, including Bar Raiser readiness and promotion pathways.

Driving Adoption & Change

* Champion responsible adoption of AI-powered engineering where it measurably improves quality, productivity and cost. Shape adoption approaches that scale, including domain-led, self-service onboarding, communities of practice, enablement and clear communications.

* Define adoption measures and use data to track uptake, find barriers and course-correct, so success is measured by sustained use rather than activity alone.

Governance, Risk & Engineering Excellence

* Ensure transformation outcomes are secure, resilient and compliant, partnering with cybersecurity, risk, architecture and platform teams.

Embed engineering standards, guardrails and controls into the way teams work, in line with the CBA engineering practice and job architecture.  

  

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* This is an automation-first engineering role. Strong hands-on software engineering and automation experience is mandatory, with substantial experience in test automation.

* Demonstrated experience building modern automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD.

* Strong programming capability in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or equivalent.

* Experience across API, integration and end-to-end automation.
* Proven track record of leading enterprise-scale initiatives or strategic transformation programs, from strategy through to sustained adoption.

* Exceptional influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage and challenge senior executives and technical leaders.

* Experience leading senior technical leaders, such as Chief Engineers, Principal Engineers or equivalent, and leading people through other leaders.

* Demonstrated success driving adoption and change across large, distributed engineering communities, supported by clear measures of uptake and outcomes.

* Strong engineering foundation across software delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud (AWS) and engineering platforms, with enough depth to challenge and guide technical decisions.

* Sound judgement in managing risk, technical debt and trade-offs across scope, speed, quality and cost, ideally in a regulated environment such as banking.

* Experience with agile and lean ways of working, outcome-based planning and metrics such as DORA.

* Awareness of AI-powered and agentic engineering, and how to adopt it responsibly at scale.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complexity for executive audiences.

* A curious, customer-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement and developing others.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 18+ years of experience in software or platform engineering, including significant experience in engineering leadership.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering (B.E/B.Tech), MCA or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

You are customer-obsessed and a trusted advisor in both AI solutions and organizational change management. For companies on their Agentic Enterprise journey, the path to value isn't just about turning the software on — it's about continuous optimization, cultural adoption, and governance of AI solutions.
  
  
As a Customer Success Senior Manager, you are a key driver of value for your customers. You move beyond initial implementation to ensure deep, operationalized adoption of contracted use cases. You help keep the "AI Flywheel" spinning by collaborating with a cross-functional ecosystem of internal Salesforce teams and consulting partners, leveraging agent telemetry to drive data-informed improvements, and identifying the next high-impact opportunities for your customers.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* **Support the Customer Center of Excellence (CoE):** Partner with customers in building and nurturing their internal CoE. Train "Agent Champions" and empower customers to independently iterate, govern, and scale their AI footprint.
* **Data-Driven Governance & Telemetry:** Monitor agent performance telemetry, success rates, and friction points to identify where agents are stalling. Use data-driven insights to proactively recommend optimizations to the customer's workflows.
* **Ecosystem Collaboration:** Support the customer's Agentic Enterprise journey by coordinating with Salesforce Account Executives, Professional Services, and Third-Party Consulting Partners/SIs to ensure a unified customer experience.
* **Drive Deep Consumption:** Proactively manage the roadmap for contracted licenses and consumption credits. Success is measured by the customer's ability to fully utilize their investment against high-impact processes.
* **Value Realization & ROI:** Define, track, and report on quantifiable business impact. Move the conversation from "technical deployment" to "business outcomes" (e.g., reducing stock-outs, automating manual triage, and improving planner productivity) using platform data.
* **Consultative Use Case Identification:** Use your knowledge of industry processes to identify opportunities where deploying additional AI agents can solve real business friction points. Help build the business case for new use cases, shifting customers from reactive usage to proactive, strategic expansion.
* **Remove Adoption Barriers:** Identify and help neutralize friction — whether it's data quality issues in Data Cloud, user resistance, or business process misalignment — that prevents the scaling of Agentforce.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Serve as a bridge between the customer's operational reality and Salesforce Product and Engineering teams to help ensure the roadmap addresses real-world challenges.

**Minimum Requirements**

* **9+ years** of work experience, with **3+ years** in Customer Success, Professional Services, or Management Consulting, focused on adoption and change management for enterprise SaaS — preferably in Supply Chain/Manufacturing or Financial Services.
* **Governance Support:** Experience participating in or supporting governance frameworks or Steering Committees for large-scale digital transformation projects.
* **Analytical Fluency:** Strong ability to interpret platform telemetry, usage data, and performance dashboards to derive actionable insights for customers.
* **Consumption Model Experience:** Track record of managing consumption-based accounts, focusing on driving utilization through value-based activity.
* **Strategic Communication:** Strong ability to present AI outcomes to senior business stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into tangible business value.
* **AI Fluency:** A solid understanding of AI/LLM logic and the ability to translate technical "agentic" capabilities into business outcomes.

* **Systems & Back-office Process Familiarity:** Experience working within complex enterprise ecosystems (ERP, MRP, TMS) and understanding manufacturing/logistics workflows.

title: Senior Support Lead
description:

title: Business Execution Senior Manager
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Execution Senior Manager.This role is required to establish dedicated senior leadership for the Payments Operations Strategy and Response group and to bring together activities that currently span multiple non-production and business-support functions. This is a regional leadership role managing teams spread across India and Manila.

* Manage and develop a team of Business Execution Consultants while ensuring successful planning, integration, impasse resolution, and measurement of operations with moderate to high complexity and visibility
* Defining and executing the Payments Operations strategic roadmap
* Conduct Business Update Reviews (BURs) and oversee the portfolio of key initiatives, driving strategic alignment, execution rigor, risk management, and transparent reporting to senior leadership
* Leading enterprise-wide transformation and business improvement initiatives.
* Strengthening operational resiliency, recovery capabilities, and incident response
* Driving organizational performance through KPIs, business reviews, executive reporting, and leadership support
* Establishing clear accountability, governance, and execution discipline across the organization

title: CMS Content Manager
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

### **Job description**

As a CMS Content Manager at Jellyfish, you will be responsible for publishing, updating and maintaining high-quality digital content across a range of content management systems (CMS).

You'll ensure that website content is accurate, consistent and aligned with client brand guidelines, supporting the delivery of engaging and optimised digital experiences. You'll work closely with content, SEO, UX, design and development teams to implement content updates, maintain quality standards and support efficient publishing workflows.

You'll bring strong attention to detail, technical curiosity and a proactive approach to problem-solving, helping ensure content is delivered accurately and on time.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**CMS publishing & content delivery**

* Publish, update and maintain website content across CMS platforms, ensuring accuracy, consistency and adherence to brand guidelines
* Build and format web pages using existing templates and content components, including text, imagery, links and metadata
* Implement content updates and minor layout adjustments, using HTML where required
* Support content publishing workflows, ensuring updates are completed accurately and within agreed timelines
* Maintain content trackers, publishing schedules and documentation to support efficient delivery

**Quality assurance & optimisation**

* Conduct quality assurance checks before and after publication, identifying and resolving content, formatting and functionality issues
* Identify, document and escalate CMS-related issues, technical bugs and content inconsistencies
* Implement SEO and UX recommendations in collaboration with specialist teams
* Monitor basic content performance metrics and report insights to support ongoing optimisation
* Ensure published content meets accessibility, usability and brand consistency requirements

**Collaboration & continuous improvement**

* Work closely with project managers, designers, developers and other stakeholders to support content delivery
* Collaborate with SEO, UX and Paid Search teams to implement content optimisation initiatives
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve publishing processes and content quality
* Develop familiarity with new CMS platforms, content technologies and emerging tools, including AI and automation

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Experience publishing and managing website content using CMS platforms such as Sitecore, WordPress, Drupal or similar
* Working knowledge of HTML and web content formatting
* Strong attention to detail, with experience conducting content QA and maintaining brand consistency
* Foundational understanding of SEO principles, metadata and UX best practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary teams
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving content issues
* Familiarity with design tools such as Figma or Photoshop is a plus
* Experience using project management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira or ServiceNow is a plus
* Interest in AI, automation and emerging content technologies is a plus

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* You consistently publish accurate, high-quality content that meets client requirements and brand standards
* You manage day-to-day CMS tasks efficiently, meeting deadlines and maintaining clear visibility of progress
* You identify and resolve content issues proactively, escalating technical challenges appropriately
* You apply SEO, UX and accessibility best practices to support effective digital experiences
* You build strong working relationships with internal teams and contribute to smooth content delivery
* You develop your CMS expertise and identify opportunities to improve publishing efficiency and quality

*Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.*

**Additional Information**

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

Custom Work Environment: Work remotely UK Shift hours.

Jellyfish contributes to your retiral benefits via Provident Fund (PF) contribution

Jellyfish provides best-in-class group medical insurance & life insurance cover to employees

*Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to* *talentacquisition@jellyfish.com**.*

title: Sr. Automation Eng QA
description:
**Job Description**

Senior Automation Engineer QA – Sage Intacct
  
  
About Sage
  
  
Sage is a global technology company that provides software and services to help businesses manage their finances, operations and people. Sage supports businesses of different sizes with solutions spanning accounting, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payroll and financial management.
  
  
Sage Intacct is a cloud-based financial management solution designed to help organisations streamline accounting processes, gain financial visibility and make informed business decisions. Quality, reliability and integration capabilities are essential to delivering a trusted experience for customers.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who combines strong functional testing expertise with hands-on test automation and API testing skills. The role involves validating Sage Intacct business workflows, ERP functionality and payment integrations, while developing reliable automated tests to improve quality, coverage and delivery confidence.
  
  
The ideal candidate can independently understand requirements, identify functional and integration risks, design and execute test scenarios, investigate defects, and automate high-value regression scenarios.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Functional QA and Domain Validation
  
  
- Understand business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
  
- Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end testing across Sage Intacct workflows.
  
- Validate ERP business processes, data accuracy, business rules, transaction processing and system behaviour.
  
- Test payment-related workflows and integrations, including transaction outcomes, error handling and reconciliation scenarios.
  
- Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential business risks.
  
- Investigate defects and collaborate with engineering and product teams to drive resolution.
  
  
Test Automation and API Testing
  
  
- Design, develop and maintain automated tests using Selenium and/or Playwright with Python or Java.
  
- Perform API testing of RESTful services, validating endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, request and response payloads, authentication and error handling.
  
- Use API testing tools and frameworks to validate service behaviour, integration contracts and data consistency across systems.
  
- Develop and maintain reusable automation components and automated regression suites.
  
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures to distinguish product defects from test or environment issues.
  
  
Quality Engineering and Delivery
  
  
- Participate in requirement reviews, test planning, defect triage and release readiness assessments.
  
- Collaborate with developers, product managers, business analysts and QA engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  
- Report test progress, risks, defects and quality metrics clearly.
  
- Contribute to continuous improvement in test strategy, API and UI automation coverage, and overall product quality.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
- Hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright.
  
- Programming experience in Python or Java.
  
- Working knowledge of REST APIs and API testing, including request/response validation, HTTP methods, status codes and authentication.
  
- Exposure to REST API testing tools or frameworks, such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.
  
- Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing.
  
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  
- Familiarity with version control and defect tracking tools.
  
  
Functional and Domain Knowledge
  
  
- Experience testing enterprise applications, preferably ERP or financial software.
  
- Understanding of business workflows, transaction processing, data validation and system integrations.
  
- Exposure to payment processing or financial integrations is highly desirable.
  
- Ability to understand complex business requirements and validate both functional outcomes and technical behaviour.
  
  
DevOps and Delivery Fundamentals
  
  
- Familiarity with build pipelines, CI/CD practices and test execution across environments.
  
- Basic troubleshooting of environment-related issues.
  
- Experience working within Agile development teams.
  
  
Experience and Qualifications
  
  
- Typically 6+ years of QA experience combining functional testing and test automation.
  
- Demonstrated ability to own testing for a feature or business workflow from requirement analysis through release validation.
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
  
- Experience in ERP, accounting, financial software or payment integrations is an advantage.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
- Business-critical workflows and integrations are thoroughly validated before release.
  
- Functional defects and API integration risks are identified early.
  
- Automation improves UI and API regression coverage and reduces repetitive testing effort.
  
- Releases are supported by clear evidence of test coverage, quality risks and readiness.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Functional QA and Domain Validation
  
- Understand business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
  
- Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end testing across Sage Intacct workflows.
  
- Validate ERP business processes, data accuracy, business rules, transaction processing and system behaviour.
  
- Test payment-related workflows and integrations, including transaction outcomes, error handling and reconciliation scenarios.
  
- Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential business risks.
  
- Investigate defects, analyse expected versus actual behaviour, and collaborate with engineering and product teams to drive resolution.
  
  
Test Automation and API Testing
  
- Design, develop and maintain automated tests using Selenium and/or Playwright with Python or Java.
  
- Perform API testing of RESTful services, validating endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, request and response payloads, authentication and error handling.
  
- Use API testing tools and frameworks to validate service behaviour, integration contracts and data consistency across systems.
  
- Develop and maintain reusable automation components and automated regression suites.
  
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures to distinguish product defects from test or environment issues.
  
  
Quality Engineering and Delivery
  
- Participate in requirement reviews, test planning, defect triage and release readiness assessments.
  
- Collaborate with developers, product managers, business analysts and QA engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  
- Report test progress, risks, defects and quality metrics clearly.
  
- Contribute to continuous improvement in test strategy, API and UI automation coverage, and overall product quality.
