title: Sr. Manager; Platform Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

Visa's Data Trust & Platform Engineering (DTPE) organization delivers the foundational platforms that power Visa's enterprise data, analytics, AI, and cloud ecosystem. DTPE is responsible for advancing secure, scalable, governed, and resilient data platform capabilities spanning hybrid-cloud infrastructure, compute, storage, streaming, orchestration, data governance, privacy, quality, and platform engineering services.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Platform Engineering to lead a team of highly skilled engineers responsible for building, operating, and modernizing critical platform services that power Visa's data, analytics, and AI ecosystem. This leader will drive engineering execution, platform reliability, cloud transformation, automation, and customer success while fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth, people leadership, operational excellence, and a passion for building scalable platforms that serve enterprise-wide customers.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical & Platform Leadership:

* Lead the design, development, deployment, and operation of large-scale platform engineering solutions supporting analytics, AI, data processing, and enterprise workloads.
* Drive architecture and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-efficient platform services.
* Partner closely with architects, principal engineers, and product stakeholders to define technical roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Lead platform modernization initiatives across hybrid-cloud environments, cloud-native architectures, container platforms, and developer self-service capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices covering scalability, resiliency, observability, automation, security, and performance.

Cloud & Data Platform Engineering:

* Lead adoption of cloud-native technologies across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Databricks and modern platform engineering ecosystems.
* Drive development of reusable platform services for data engineering, analytics, AI/ML workloads, and enterprise applications.
* Enable large-scale distributed compute and storage platforms supporting petabyte-scale data processing.
* Build and operationalize data platform capabilities including orchestration, streaming, metadata management, governance, and workload automation.
* Improve platform efficiency, utilization, and cost optimization through automation and infrastructure engineering.

Engineering Delivery & Operational Excellence:

* Own engineering execution, service delivery, platform availability, and customer commitments.
* Drive continuous improvements in reliability, scalability, incident reduction, and operational maturity.
* Lead production readiness reviews, incident management, root-cause analysis, and remediation efforts.
* Define and track operational KPIs including service availability, latency, reliability, customer satisfaction, and engineering productivity.
* Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, observability, alerting, and capacity planning practices.

Generative AI & Intelligent Engineering:

* Drive adoption of GenAI-powered engineering capabilities including AI-assisted development, code generation, intelligent troubleshooting, and operational automation.
* Partner with AI and platform teams to enable secure and governed GenAI infrastructure and services.
* Identify opportunities to leverage LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation frameworks to improve engineering productivity and customer experience.
* Promote responsible AI practices, governance controls, security, and compliance requirements for enterprise AI solutions.

People Leadership:

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams across multiple locations.
* Drive hiring, talent development, performance management, and career growth for engineers and technical leads.
* Foster a culture focused on technical excellence, innovation, accountability, inclusion, and continuous learning.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, technical mentorship, and engineering craftsmanship across teams:

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

* Partner with Data Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Security, Operations, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities.
* Act as an advocate for platform customers by improving platform usability, self-service adoption, and developer experience.
* Collaborate with business and engineering stakeholders to prioritize investments and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, operational health, and roadmap updates to leadership.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 10+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or data platform engineering experience.
* 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems in production environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure.
* Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering fundamentals, system design, networking, storage, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience building highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed services.
* Experience driving automation using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) and CI/CD practices.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging GenAI, machine learning, or intelligent automation technologies to improve engineering outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

Cloud & Infrastructure:

* Strong knowledge of AWS services such as EKS, EC2, S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, ECS, and IAM.
* Strong knowledge of Databricks services
* Experience with Azure services including AKS, Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric, Storage, and Entra ID.
* Experience building hybrid-cloud platform solutions spanning on-premises and cloud environments.
* Expertise in Kubernetes, container management, service mesh, and cloud-native infrastructure.

Data Platform Engineering:

* Experience operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Knowledge of Hadoop, Spark, Trino/Presto, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting large-scale batch, streaming, AI, and analytics workloads.
* Understanding of metadata, governance, data quality, lineage, privacy, and access management capabilities.

Platform Engineering & SRE

* Experience with developer platforms and self-service engineering models.
* Strong understanding of observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, ELK, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience implementing SRE practices including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, reliability engineering, and operational automation.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning experience across distributed environments.

Generative AI:

* Understanding of LLM architectures and enterprise GenAI platforms.
* Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, AI agents, and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with GenAI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Crew AI, Autogeny, or equivalent.
* Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, observability, security, and privacy requirements.

Leadership Expectations:

* Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
* Customer-Centric Platform Mindset
* Execution with Excellence
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence
* Innovation Through Automation and AI
* Talent Development and Coaching
* Collaboration Across Teams
* Ownership and Accountability
* Continuous Learning and Growth

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Mainframe Storage System Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

  

As a Mainframe Storage System Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise mainframe storage environments. You will manage DASD and tape infrastructure, DFSMS, DFHSM, DFRMM, storage allocation, replication, and disaster recovery solutions to ensure high availability, performance, security, and data integrity across critical z/OS systems.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and support enterprise-wide z/OS storage solutions, ensuring scalability, availability, and performance.
* Administer and govern DFSMS/SMS environments, including ACS routines, Storage Groups, Storage Classes, Data Classes, and Management Classes.
* Manage and optimize DASD storage infrastructure, monitor utilization trends, perform capacity planning, and support storage growth initiatives.
* Maintain VTOC, VTOCIX, and catalog environments, resolving allocation, extent, connectivity, and catalog-related issues.
* Administer DFSMShsm and DFSMSdss services, supporting backup, migration, archiving, disaster recovery, and recovery operations.
* Monitor storage subsystem performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and drive continuous service improvements.
Mentor junior engineers, create technical documentation, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the storage organization.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 9+ years of hands-on experience in IBM Mainframe z/OS and Storage Administration supporting large-scale enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in z/OS upgrades, zCloud migration initiatives, storage architecture, and storage device management.
* Experience with DASD and Tape infrastructure, including configuration, migration, provisioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in mainframe utilities and subsystems including TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, ISMF, JES2, Catalogs, Datasets (PS, PDS, PDSE, GDG), REXX, SAS, SDSF, and Spool management.
* Extensive experience in Tape and DASD Management utilizing: DLM (Disk Library Manager) Dell EMC Data Domain DFSMS Suite (DFSMSDFP, DFSMSHSM, DFSMSDSS, DFSMSRMM) ICF Catalog and IDCAMS CA Products (CA-Disk, CA-Allocate, CA-1) FDR Backup and Restore Products ICKDSF Utilities
* Strong knowledge of Space Management, including troubleshooting B37, D37, and E37 abends, volume management, and capacity planning.
* Experience in storage disaster recovery, backup/recovery processes, and business continuity planning.
Strong troubleshooting, problem determination, automation, and operational support skills in a 24x7 production environment.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Hands-on experience supporting and administering enterprise storage infrastructures, ensuring high availability, performance, data protection, and operational stability.
* Proven expertise in storage migration projects, including: DASD-to-DASD migrations Tape-to-Tape migrations Storage hardware refresh and platform consolidation initiatives Data movement and volume reallocation activities with minimal business disruption
* Experience with storage replication technologies such as IBM Global Mirror, FlashCopy, XRC, EMC SRDF, and Copy Services Manager to support business continuity and disaster recovery requirements.
Experience working in a 24x7 support model, including incident management, root cause analysis, problem determination, and on-call support.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Assistant Manager - HDE
description:

Role SummaryThe Assistant Manager – Helpdesk is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the helpdesk/call center function, ensuring timely and effective resolution of service requests, complaints, and inquiries from clients, tenants, or employees. This role supports the Helpdesk Manager in driving service quality, team performance, and process improvements within a facilities or IT service management environment.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Management

Monitor queue volumes, response times, and resolution rates; escalate bottlenecks proactively.
  
Ensure proper use of the CAFM/CMMS or ticketing system (e.g., Corrigo, ServiceNow, SAP) for accurate work order tracking.
  
Team Supervision
  
Lead, train, and mentor helpdesk executives/associates, including shift scheduling and workload distribution.
  
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching to improve productivity and service quality.
  
Handle escalations from team members and resolve complex or sensitive client issues.
  
Client & Stakeholder Coordination
  
Liaise with facilities, engineering, housekeeping, and security teams to ensure prompt closure of raised tickets.
  
Act as a point of escalation for client/tenant complaints, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  
Support client satisfaction surveys and feedback loops; implement corrective actions where needed.
  
Reporting & Compliance
  
Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on ticket volumes, SLA adherence, and root-cause analysis.
  
Maintain audit-ready documentation in line with JLL and client compliance requirements.
  
Monitor adherence to health, safety, and data privacy standards in all helpdesk interactions.
  
Process Improvement

Support the rollout of new tools, SOPs, or training programs related to helpdesk operations.

Problem-solving and conflict-resolution ability under pressure.
  
Organizational and multitasking skills to manage shifting priorities.
  
Basic understanding of SLA/KPI frameworks in a service delivery environment.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. title: Senior Cyber Security GRC Analyst
description:
Role Introduction:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cybersecurity GRC Analyst to be responsible for cybersecurity risk assessment across OneAdvanced. The role reports to the Head of Cybersecurity Risk and Controls. You will carry out risk assessments, evaluate security controls and evidence, maintain the risk register, and report on risk and remediation progress. You will work with security, technology and business teams on cybersecurity risks.

What You Will Do:

**Cybersecurity Risk Assessment & Management:**

* Carry out cybersecurity risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, technology processes and security operations.
* Identify threats, vulnerabilities and control gaps, and assess their likelihood and impact.
* Assess inherent and residual risk, taking into account the design and effectiveness of existing controls.
* Document risk statements, evidence and findings, and recommend treatment.
* Agree treatment plans with risk owners: mitigation, acceptance, transfer or avoidance.

**Risk Register & Lifecycle Management:**

* Maintain the cyber risk register, including owners, ratings, treatment decisions, actions and review dates.
* Track remediation, validate progress and escalate overdue or material risks.
* Reassess risks when threats, systems, business exposure or controls change.
* Assess risk acceptance and security exception requests and make a recommendation.

**Security Control Assessment & Assurance:**

* Evaluate security controls and evidence against internal policies and industry frameworks.
* Assess controls in areas such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, cloud and application security, incident response, resilience and data protection.
* Apply NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 when assessing control gaps.
* Work with control owners on remediation and keep the supporting documentation.

**Risk Governance, Monitoring & Reporting:**

* Prepare risk reports, dashboards and management updates on exposure, trends, exceptions and remediation progress.
* Provide input to cybersecurity risk reviews and governance forums.
* Monitor key risk indicators and flag emerging or changing exposures.
* Keep cyber risk records in line with enterprise risk management processes and internal methodology.

**Continuous Improvement & Process Enhancement:**

* Improve risk assessment templates, scoring, control mapping and reporting.
* Use automation or AI tools where they help with evidence review, analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the cyber risk methodology and control library.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Work with security operations, engineering, application security, infrastructure, technology and business teams.
* Explain technical risks and treatment options to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Will Have:

**Skills and Experience:**

* **Minimum of 5 years** in cybersecurity, including **at least 4 years of hands-on cybersecurity risk management.**
* Experience personally carrying out risk assessments, evaluating control gaps, documenting risk and tracking remediation, beyond audit or compliance coordination.
* Experience maintaining risk registers and managing risks through their lifecycle.
* Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2, applied in risk assessments and gap analysis.
* Technical understanding of identity and access management, vulnerability management, network, cloud and application security, incident response and resilience.
* Experience assessing inherent and residual risk and reviewing control evidence.
* Ability to turn technical findings into business risk and produce clear management reports.
* Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities with limited supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, IT, Risk Management or equivalent experience.
* CRISC, CISA, CISSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer.
* Exposure to third-party or supplier cybersecurity risk, including due diligence, assurance review and tracking remediation.
* Experience with GRC platforms, risk and reporting tools, or AI and automation tools.

**Behavioural Attributes:**

* Practical, risk-based judgement, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Organised and attentive to detail.
* Takes ownership of deliverables and works with limited supervision.
* Dependable, and escalates early when something slips.

#LI-PB1

What We Do For You:

* **Annual Leave** – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays

  + **Development Programmes** – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go

* **Personal Accident Insurance** - providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* **Performance Bonus** – Our Group-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success

Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: Associate Director, AI Go-to-Market
description:
**Job Summary**
The role will drive the adoption, utilisation and value realisation of priority AI initiatives across the Bank. Working within the AI Go-to-Market team, the role will partner with AI product teams and business stakeholders to shape and execute adoption strategies, establish success measures, identify barriers to utilisation and translate data and user insights into interventions that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Working closely with AI product teams and business stakeholders, the role will drive Go-to-Market, adoption and value-realisation activities for priority AI initiatives, from launch through to sustained adoption, performance measurement and optimisation.

**AI Go-to-Market & Adoption**

* Drive the development and execution of GTM and adoption strategies for priority AI initiatives, including user segmentation, launch, enablement, engagement and sustained adoption.
* Partner with product and business teams to understand user needs, identify adoption barriers and develop targeted interventions to improve utilisation.
* Develop repeatable GTM and adoption approaches that can be scaled across the AI portfolio.

**Utilisation, Insights & Value Realisation**

* Define appropriate adoption, utilisation and success measures for different AI solutions, including Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Analyse telemetry, user insights and business measures to identify trends, diagnose performance and recommend actions.
* Develop value hypotheses, baselines and measurement approaches covering productivity, efficiency, user experience and relevant business outcomes.
* Work with stakeholders to validate benefits and demonstrate the value realised from AI initiatives.

**Stakeholder & Portfolio Support**

* Act as a GTM partner to AI product and business teams, providing guidance and constructive challenge on adoption, utilisation and value realisation.
* Build effective relationships across business, product and technology teams to drive agreed outcomes.
* Provide insight-led reporting and recommendations on adoption, utilisation and value, highlighting areas requiring intervention or management attention.
* Contribute to the continued development of the Bank's AI GTM, adoption and value-realisation practices.

**Skills And Experience**

* We are looking for someone with 7–10 years of relevant experience who is analytical, commercially minded and comfortable working at the intersection of AI, data and business. The ideal candidate will be able to independently structure complex problems, work effectively across product and business teams, and translate data and user insights into strategies and interventions that drive sustained adoption, utilisation and measurable value.
* Strong experience across AI or digital transformation, technology/product adoption, analytics, strategy, consulting or value realisation, with experience driving initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Strong understanding of AI and Generative AI, with knowledge of emerging capabilities such as AI agents and agentic AI and how their adoption, utilisation, performance and value can be measured.
* Strong understanding of adoption and utilisation, including user segmentation, activation, active usage, frequency, repeat usage and sustained engagement.
* Experience defining success measures and value-realisation approaches, including baselines and KPIs across productivity, efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to combine telemetry, business data and user insights to diagnose issues and recommend practical interventions.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively across senior business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex AI, data and business topics into clear insights and recommendations.
* Financial services or regulated-environment experience is advantageous but not essential.

**Motivations**

* Motivated by turning AI innovation into sustained adoption and measurable business value, rather than viewing technology deployment as the end goal.
* Energised by solving complex and ambiguous problems, using data, user insights and structured thinking to identify opportunities and drive practical outcomes.
* Enjoys working across business and technology, influencing stakeholders, challenging existing thinking and helping shape how AI is adopted and measured across the organisation.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 7–10 years of relevant professional experience in AI or digital transformation, technology/product adoption, analytics, strategy, consulting, value realisation or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving complex digital or technology initiatives across multiple business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Experience developing and executing adoption strategies, including user segmentation, rollout, enablement, engagement and sustained utilisation.
* Experience defining and applying KPIs, measurement frameworks and benefits/value approaches to assess adoption, utilisation and business impact.
* Experience using data, telemetry and user insights to diagnose performance, identify underlying issues and recommend interventions.
* Experience presenting insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions across multiple teams.
* Experience with AI, Generative AI or other emerging technologies is strongly preferred.
* Financial-services or regulated-environment experience is advantageous.

**Certifications / Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant discipline.
* No mandatory professional certification required; relevant AI, data, product, benefits-realisation or change qualifications are advantageous.

**Languages**

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

title: Marketing Head
description:

Why Kumaran?

At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The B2B Marketing Lead – Enterprise Technology & IT Services is responsible for defining and executing the overall marketing strategy to drive business growth across key service lines such as ERP, legacy modernisation, data solutions and managed services. This role will own demand-generation from end to end, building scalable programmes that consistently generate qualified leads, strengthen the sales pipeline and influence revenue.
  
  
The role will focus on sharpening Kumaran’s brand positioning in the enterprise technology and IT services market, with a strong emphasis on banking and financial services and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) offerings. It combines strategic planning with hands-on execution across account-based marketing (ABM), digital campaigns, technical SEO, content marketing and targeted paid media.
  
  
The B2B Marketing Lead will collaborate closely with sales and business leaders to define lead qualification standards, improve conversion rates and track marketing effectiveness using CRM and analytics platforms. The role also involves exploring emerging AI-powered search and answer engines to enhance content visibility and discoverability. This position requires someone who can operate independently in a lean setup, manage modest budgets with strong ROI orientation, and confidently present performance, insights and growth initiatives to the Co-CEO, senior leadership and the board.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the overall B2B marketing strategy aligned with business growth objectives.
* Build and scale demand-generation programmes to drive qualified leads, sales pipeline and revenue.
* Strengthen brand positioning and market visibility across enterprise technology and IT services segments.
* Drive account-based marketing (ABM), digital campaigns, technical SEO, content marketing and targeted paid media.
* Develop compelling content and thought leadership materials for enterprise technology and risk leaders.
* Work closely with sales and business teams to define lead qualification standards, improve conversions and track marketing effectiveness.
* Leverage CRM platforms and marketing analytics to measure campaign performance, pipeline contribution and ROI.
* Explore emerging AI-powered search and answer engines to improve content visibility and discoverability.
* Manage marketing budgets and resources effectively, with clear accountability for business outcomes.
* Present marketing performance, insights and growth initiatives to senior leadership and the board.

**Primary Skillsets**

* Strategic B2B Marketing & Demand Generation
* Domain & Industry Knowledge
* Digital Marketing, ABM & SEO
* CRM, Analytics & Marketing Operations
* AI, Search & Content Discoverability
* Ownership, Independence & Budget Management
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Desired Skills**
**Desired Skills & Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with at least 5 years in IT services, enterprise technology or consulting.
* Experience marketing ERP, legacy modernisation, data solutions or managed services to large enterprises. Exposure to banking and financial services is an added advantage.
* Proven track record of building demand-generation programmes from the ground up, with measurable outcomes in qualified leads, pipeline and revenue influence.
* Strong understanding of enterprise buying cycles, decision-makers and business drivers, particularly for legacy modernisation and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) solutions.
* Hands-on experience in technical SEO, content strategy, account-based marketing and targeted B2B digital campaigns.
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho preferred), marketing analytics and lead management processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology offerings into clear and credible business messaging.
* Ability to work independently in a lean team environment, manage modest budgets and take ownership of outcomes.
* Comfortable working directly with the Co-CEO and senior leadership, presenting performance metrics and driving continuous improvement.

Resumes can be shared with devika.raju@kumaran.com

title: Human Resources Associate
description:
**Human Resources Associate — Platestory**
 📍 Chennai | 🏢 Work from Office | Full-Time

**About Platestory**

We're a premium custom cake brand operating across Chennai, Hyderabad, and Coimbatore. We build celebration cakes around craft, finish, and storytelling — and we're scaling fast. People are our only real competitive advantage.

**The Role**

We're hiring our first dedicated Human resource associate. This is a ground-up role — you'll own hiring across every level of the business (yes, from facility staff to senior city leads), and build the learning systems that shape how our teams grow.

If you're early in your career and want to learn fast, do real work, and grow into a full HR function — this is the role for you.

**What You'll Do**

🔹 
**Hiring (your biggest hat)**

* Source and hire across a wide range — housekeeping, delivery ops, bakers, sales executives, marketers, and senior team members
* Build sourcing channels suited to different profiles: walk-ins and referrals for ops, culinary institutes for bakers, LinkedIn for senior roles
* Run structured assessments — practical trials for kitchen staff, work samples for creative hires, structured conversations for leadership
* Build a bench for high-churn roles so we're never caught off guard

🔹 
**Learning & Development**

* Help run Platestory's internal training institution — a structured curriculum for our baker and ops teams
* Own onboarding: every new hire gets a clear first-30-days plan regardless of role
* Build SOPs, training checklists, and role handbooks in coordination with team leads

🔹 
**People Ops**

* Manage offers, documentation, and employee records across cities
* Be the first point of contact for employee concerns — with speed and fairness
* Flag retention risks early; don't wait for someone to resign

**Who We're Looking For**

✅ Fresher (2024/2025 grad) with a genuine interest in HR and recruitment.

✅ OR 1 year of HR experience, especially in hiring — you've sourced, screened, and closed candidates before · 
**₹15,000–₹20,000/month based on experience**

✅ Comfortable hiring across levels — you don't have a one-size-fits-all approach

✅ Fluent in Tamil | Working English | Basic Hindi (minimum)

✅ Based in Chennai, available to work from office

✅ Flexible — launches, hiring surges, and training cohorts don't follow a 9-to-5

✅ You're a builder, not a form-filler

**What 6 Months Looks Like**

Coimbatore is fully staffed and onboarded on time. A talent bench exists for every critical role. The training institution is running with real cohorts. Every employee knows what's expected of them in their first 30 days.

**Why Join**

→ Work directly with the founder → Real ownership from day one — not a support role → Build an HR function from scratch across 3 cities → Full-time salary: 
**₹15,000–₹20,000/month**
 based on the person → If you're a fresher, one of the fastest ways to grow in HR.

title: DGM - Company Secretary (Listed company)
description:
**Role summary**

The Company Secretary will be responsible for the listed company’s secretarial function and independently manage its corporate governance and regulatory compliance. The role covers the full process, from preparing Board papers, disclosures and statutory filings to coordinating approvals, completing submissions and following up on decisions. The role will also work closely with directors, senior management and business functions.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Board and Committee meetings.**
  Plan the annual meeting calendar and prepare notices, agendas, agenda notes, resolutions, minutes and certified extracts. Coordinate the circulation of meeting papers, attend meetings and follow up on decisions with the responsible teams.
* **Shareholder meetings and postal ballots.**
  Manage AGMs, EGMs and postal ballots. Draft notices, explanatory statements, resolutions and proceedings. Coordinate e-voting, scrutiniser reports, voting results and related filings.
* **Listed company compliance and disclosures.**
  Maintain the compliance calendar and prepare periodic and event-based disclosures, including Board meeting intimations and outcomes. Assess disclosure requirements, obtain internal approvals and complete submissions to the stock exchanges and the Registrar of Companies within applicable timelines.
* **Corporate governance and annual reporting.**
  Advise the Board and management on governance matters, related-party transactions and approval requirements. Prepare the Board’s Report, Corporate Governance Report and other secretarial sections of the annual report. Maintain statutory registers, governance policies and website disclosures.
* **Insider trading compliance.**
  Manage trading window closures and reopenings, designated person records, pre-clearances where applicable and the Structured Digital Database. Coordinate with relevant teams on the handling of unpublished price sensitive information.
* **Corporate actions and transactions.**
  Manage the secretarial aspects of capital issuances, ESOP allotments, dividends, acquisitions and restructurings. Prepare approval notes, resolutions, disclosures and filings, and coordinate with external counsel, stock exchanges, depositories and the registrar and transfer agent through completion.
* **Audits and regulatory correspondence.**
  Prepare records and responses for secretarial audits and regulatory queries. Address observations, escalate matters requiring management intervention and track corrective actions to closure.
* **Team guidance and development.**
  Set priorities and work alongside team members on assignments. Review drafts and filings, explain the reasoning behind edits and coach team members to manage their assigned responsibilities independently.
* **Cross-functional collaboration.**
  Work with Finance, Legal, Tax, corporate Finance, HR, Investor Relations and business teams to identify approval and disclosure requirements early, secure inputs and resolve issues that could delay meetings, transactions or filings.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Qualified Company Secretary and member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) within 7- 10 years of experience
* Post-qualification experience independently managing corporate secretarial and compliance matters for an Indian listed company.
* Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, applicable SEBI regulations, Secretarial Standards and stock exchange filing processes.
* Experience drafting Board and shareholder documents, preparing regulatory disclosures, executing corporate actions and guiding a secretarial team.

In this role, you will work closely with global stakeholders, suppliers, and project teams to identify and secure installation services that balance methodology, risk, experience, and commercial value. Working alongside Category Managers and Project Procurement Managers, you will evaluate suppliers, conduct market analysis, manage RFx processes, negotiate contracts, and support contract administration. You will collaborate with technical specialists, project teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure procurement activities align with project requirements and business objectives.

* Translate customer and project requirements into supplier requests and RFx documentation
* Evaluate suppliers, technologies, methods, and new geographical markets
* Conduct market analysis, supplier assessments, and financial evaluations

* Support supplier onboarding, registration, and contract lifecycle activities

The position is based in Chennai, India, reporting to the Senior Manager, Procurement Competence Centre. International travel of up to 15 days per year may be required based on business needs.

You enjoy working with people across different functions, cultures, and locations. You are organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
  
  
Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
  
  
Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
  
  
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
  
  
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.
  
  
Practice Development
  
  
Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
  
  
Coaches team to use evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.
  
  
Provides their team with a holistic perspective of customer/partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with customers/partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy.
  
  
Thought Leadership
  
  
Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team across the subsidiary level. Holds teams accountable for sharing insights with v-team members to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.
  
  
Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**Company Description**
S3 Datacom Solutions Private Limited is a growing organization focused on providing technology-driven solutions to business clients. The company is committed to delivering reliable services that help organizations optimize their operations and improve performance. Team members collaborate closely with clients to understand their needs and provide practical, results-oriented support. The work environment encourages learning, professional development, and exposure to real-world business challenges. Joining S3 Datacom Solutions offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful projects while building foundational business skills.

**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Business Development Intern role is based in Banjara Hills and supports the company’s growth initiatives. The intern will assist in identifying potential clients, and maintaining databases of prospects and opportunities. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting market research, analyzing industry trends, and preparing reports to support business development strategies. The role also involves supporting customer communication, coordinating with internal teams, and assisting with presentations, proposals, and meetings. The intern will work closely with senior Business Development Executive, gaining exposure to sales processes, client engagement, and business decision-making.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and the ability to interpret data and market trends.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills and a professional, customer-focused attitude.
* Candidates should possess basic understanding of sales or business development processes.
* Candidates should possess Market Research skills and an interest in studying industries, competitors, and customer needs.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills and the ability to handle inquiries and support client interactions.
* Ability to work on-site in Madhapur and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software); familiarity with CRM tools is an advantage.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in Business, Management, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Self-motivated, organized, and willing to learn in a fast-paced business environment.

title: Proposal Manager
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Proposal Manager will provide bid leadership and support for complex strategic proposals for APAC Data Center opportunities, client accounts or new services. The Proposal Manager supports the Regional Sales Operations Director and Team Leaders to instill an inclusive culture within the team that values diversity of thought and lives Jacobs’ Culture of Caring. As a member of the team, you actively contribute to mentoring and capability development within Sales Operations. You will practice and model the collaborative consulting skills needed to form partnerships within complex stakeholders in the business and continue to develop your coaching, leadership, and facilitations skills. You need to be effective at bringing the ideas of others to market; have good judgment about which ideas and suggestions that work; and be able to manage the work winning and creative process of others.
  
  

* As Proposal Manager, you facilitate and lead the application of the end-to-end Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) process to help position Jacobs to win specific projects, programs and develop meaningful client relationships
* You focus on specific opportunities, client accounts or new services that contribute overall growth for our region partnership with our Outside Sales Market Directors
* You collaborate and challenge the Sales Lead and Capture Manager/Operations in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position.
* Leverage global network to identify and put forward Jacobs’ unique capabilities and resources
* Organize, direct, and motivate multidiscipline opportunity teams to develop sales deliverables for specific proposals to grow the business

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 12+ years of thorough experience
* As a Proposal Manager, you will work closely with Client Account Managers, Market Sales Directors and Head of Sectors on opportunity and client positioning activities of business critical opportunities which involve developing appealing differentiations for all levels of our client organizations, including C-suite.
* Within the function, you pro-actively initiate, facilitate and lead the application of the end-to-end Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) process to help position Jacobs to win major projects, programs and develop meaningful client relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Advocating and implementing our bespoke process. Autonomy is a given, but the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment is important to being successful.
* You collaborate, motivate, and challenge your partners in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position.
* Leverage global network to identify and put forward Jacobs’ unique capabilities and resources. Organize, direct, and motivate multidiscipline opportunity teams to develop sales deliverables across the portfolio to grow the business.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Managing Consultant, Account Management.
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Managing Consultant, Account Management.
  
  
Managing Consultant, Services Account Management, Acquiring & Processing
  
  
Mastercard Services, the professional services arm of Mastercard, provides payments-focused consulting services to financial institutions and merchants worldwide. Within Services, the Acquiring & Processing practice helps financial institutions, processors, fintechs, merchants, and other ecosystem participants navigate the evolving payments landscape and unlock growth opportunities.
  
  
We are seeking a Managing Consultant, Services Account Management, to support the regional teams driving the growth of Mastercard’s Acquiring & Processing business across Asia Pacific. This role combines subject matter support, client engagement support, and industry expertise to help identify opportunities, support the shaping of client solutions, and support the commercialization of Mastercard Services capabilities led by authorized regional teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of acquiring, processing, acceptance, payment infrastructure, and merchant ecosystems, coupled with the ability to translate client challenges into actionable growth opportunities.
  
  
Key questions for candidates
  
  
Are you passionate about helping clients solve complex acquiring, acceptance, and payment processing challenges?
  
  
Can you leverage your industry expertise to support the identification of business opportunities and contribute to client value?
  
  
Do you enjoy working across clients, account teams, and product specialists to bring innovative solutions to market?
  
  
Serve as a subject matter expert in acquiring, payment acceptance, processing, merchant acquiring, and payment infrastructure trends.
  
  
Support the Regional Services Business Development teams and Account Management teams to identify, qualify, and advance acquiring & processing opportunities.
  
  
Support the development of client growth plans, business cases, and solution recommendations that address key client priorities.
  
  
Engage with clients to understand business challenges, document opportunities, and articulate the value of Mastercard Services capabilities, with the direction of the regional team.
  
  
Support in preparing proposal content, commercial inputs, and client presentations for the regional team.
  
  
Support the development of trusted working relationships with client stakeholders across acquiring banks, processors, fintechs, merchants, and payment ecosystem participants.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams including Consulting, Product, Customer Solutions Center, and regional market teams to support integrated solutions for clients.
  
  
Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies impacting the acquiring and processing landscape.
  
  
Support pipeline tracking, opportunity documentation, and reporting accuracy for the regional Services team.
  
  
Contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing activities within the Acquiring & Processing practice.
  
  
**Experience**
6-10 years of experience in acquiring, payment processing, merchant payments, acceptance, fintech, payments consulting, or related financial services fields.
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of merchant acquiring, payment processing, acceptance ecosystems, payment gateways, processor economics, or related areas.
  
  
Prior experience supporting account management, solutioning, consulting, product management, or partnership coordination.
  
  
Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to translate complex industry concepts into clear business value propositions.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking capabilities.
  
  
Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  
  
Professional level English language capability required.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Tendering Engineer
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
Job Summary
  
  
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
  
  
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
  
  
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:
  
  

* Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines
* Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance
* Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application
* Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments
* Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories
* Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting
* Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network
* Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order
* Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers
* Indirect management & co-ordination with multidisciplinary functions as part of the bid preparation
* Preparation of high-quality technical/commercial offers in line with market requirements
* Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation
* Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices, and measures in place to mitigate the risks.
* Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department
* Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage
* Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors
* Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team
* Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

**Work experience**
: >5 years
  
  
**Expertise (e.g. Professional, Technical)**

* Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)
* Structured way of working, ability to break down complex issues together with the bid team
* Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: pump design, international tender or sales, project management or equivalent
* Ideally intercultural competences
* Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and accessories

What we offer you
  
  
Medical insurance for self and family
  
  
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days
  
  
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: Proposal Manager
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Proposal Manager will provide bid leadership and support for complex strategic proposals for APAC Data Center opportunities, client accounts or new services. The Proposal Manager supports the Regional Sales Operations Director and Team Leaders to instill an inclusive culture within the team that values diversity of thought and lives Jacobs’ Culture of Caring. As a member of the team, you actively contribute to mentoring and capability development within Sales Operations. You will practice and model the collaborative consulting skills needed to form partnerships within complex stakeholders in the business and continue to develop your coaching, leadership, and facilitations skills. You need to be effective at bringing the ideas of others to market; have good judgment about which ideas and suggestions that work; and be able to manage the work winning and creative process of others.
  
  

* As Proposal Manager, you facilitate and lead the application of the end-to-end Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) process to help position Jacobs to win specific projects, programs and develop meaningful client relationships
* You focus on specific opportunities, client accounts or new services that contribute overall growth for our region partnership with our Outside Sales Market Directors
* You collaborate and challenge the Sales Lead and Capture Manager/Operations in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position.
* Leverage global network to identify and put forward Jacobs’ unique capabilities and resources
* Organize, direct, and motivate multidiscipline opportunity teams to develop sales deliverables for specific proposals to grow the business

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 12+ years of thorough experience
* As a Proposal Manager, you will work closely with Client Account Managers, Market Sales Directors and Head of Sectors on opportunity and client positioning activities of business critical opportunities which involve developing appealing differentiations for all levels of our client organizations, including C-suite.
* Within the function, you pro-actively initiate, facilitate and lead the application of the end-to-end Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) process to help position Jacobs to win major projects, programs and develop meaningful client relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Advocating and implementing our bespoke process. Autonomy is a given, but the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment is important to being successful.
* You collaborate, motivate, and challenge your partners in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position.
* Leverage global network to identify and put forward Jacobs’ unique capabilities and resources. Organize, direct, and motivate multidiscipline opportunity teams to develop sales deliverables across the portfolio to grow the business.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Rest The Case is a legal-tech company bridging the gap between legal professionals and individuals or businesses seeking legal assistance. With products designed for both consumers and lawyers, our goal is to make legal access simple, fast, and reliable.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Consultant role based in the Pune District. The Sales Consultant will engage prospective and existing users, understand their legal and compliance needs, and recommend appropriate services and solutions offered by Rest The Case. The role involves conducting product demos, explaining service features and pricing, handling inbound inquiries, and following up with leads to drive conversions. The Sales Consultant will collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding, maintain accurate records in CRM tools, and support customers throughout the sales cycle. Daily responsibilities also include tracking performance metrics, gathering feedback to improve offerings, and contributing to customer satisfaction and long-term client relationships.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated Sales Consulting skills, including lead generation, solution selling, and closing deals.
* Strong Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction focus, with the ability to build trust and maintain long-term relationships.
* Excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and confidently.
* Consulting mindset, with the ability to understand client needs, analyze options, and recommend suitable legal and compliance solutions.
* Relevant experience in B2B or B2C sales, preferably in services, legal-tech, SaaS, or compliance-related domains.
* Comfort working with CRM systems, digital collaboration tools, and basic data/reporting dashboards.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune District, manage time effectively, and meet measurable sales targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
