title: Business Partnerships Manager
description:
**Summary of the Role**

The Business Partnership Manager, within Lhasa Limited’s Applied Sciences team, is accountable for growing revenue and membership across India through the sponsorship of Lhasa Limited’s in-silico solutions. The role holder will build a network of business relationships with prospective and existing members, working closely with Lhasa Limited’s Application Scientists to combine commercial acumen with scientific credibility. This is a fully remote, India-based role.

**Why Lhasa Limited?**

Lhasa Limited is a successful not-for-profit company and educational charity, with an enviable reputation for collaborative scientific development. We develop meaningful science and software that supports the delivery of life-enhancing solutions, including the development of safe chemicals to market such as drugs and cosmetics, as well as making a positive contribution to reducing animal testing. Our charitable status enables us to make altruistic decisions for the public benefit and to work with some of the leading organisations in the world to really make a difference.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Grow revenue and membership across India by developing new business opportunities and upselling Lhasa Limited’s in-silico solutions.
* Establish and proactively develop a network of strong business relationships with prospective and existing member organisations
* Respond to enquiries and offer tailored advice, confidently introducing Lhasa Limited’s solutions to prospective members
* Scope member needs alongside Lhasa Limited’s Application Scientists, drawing on an understanding of prospective workflows to identify the right solution
* Proactively promote Lhasa Limited’s in-silico solutions through scientific communication, such as workshops, exhibitions and conferences across India
* Obtain member feedback after evaluation and renewal to support solution development and improve service delivery
* Work closely with Marketing to drive demand, identify lead-generation activity, and research new opportunities and competitive threats in India

**About You**

* Proven sales or business development experience, ideally selling software (SaaS) solutions or within the pharmaceutical or chemical industry (essential)
* Skilled negotiator, able to secure favourable outcomes in high-value commercial discussions (essential)
* Demonstrable track record of meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets in a B2B environment (essential)
* Willingness to travel extensively and regularly across India, and internationally as required (essential)
* An undergraduate degree, master’s or PhD in a relevant chemistry or toxicology-related discipline (essential)
* Proactive, innovative and commercially aware
* Able to work as part of a multidisciplinary team and independently without close supervision
* Able to influence end users and decision-makers
* Interpersonal skills and sensitivity to cultural differences
* Able to understand and communicate confidently in English

**Please submit your CV and a short covering letter outlining your relevant experience.**

title: Demand Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Opening:**
Demand Relationship Manager

**Location:**
Delhi NCR (HQ)

**Experience:**
2-4 years

**Compensation:**
Upto 12 Lacs (As per experience)

**About Antal:**

Antal International, East Patel Nagar Delhi, is a leading recruitment consultancy having expertise in connecting top talent across IT, Manufacturing and FMCG industries with leading organizations.

**About the Company:**

Our client is a digital platform that enables end-to-end sourcing and management of raw materials for the construction industry. They connect buyers — builders, contractors, developers and project teams — with a vetted network of suppliers and manufacturers, and manage the entire journey: discovery, pricing, ordering, financing, logistics and delivery, all in one place.

Construction is one of the largest sectors of the economy, yet it still runs on phone calls, paper challans, opaque pricing and fragmented, unreliable supply chains. Their mission is simple to say and hard to do: to corporatize, catalyze and cleanse the construction sector — and to bring joy back to building.

**About the role:**

They are hiring a Demand Relationship Manager to build and own their builder, contractor and project-team network. This is not a transactional sales role — it is a hands-on, on-the-ground relationship-building mandate to earn the trust of buyers in a traditionally offline, relationship-driven trade, and make their platform the default way to source for the builders.

A full-time role based in Delhi NCR, with a clear path to Category Manager, City / Cluster Lead, or Growth Manager roles as we scale.

**Why This Role Is Different**

* Build the market, not maintain it. you will bring builders, contractors and project teams onto a platform that doesn't yet have the trust and habit an offline trade has built over decades — you are creating that habit.
* Ownership from day one. you will own a buyer cluster or set of accounts — activation, order growth and repeat usage — with real, measurable targets.
* Two-sided commercial fluency. you will understand how a contractor buys, what drives their sourcing decisions, and how to read BOQs, quotations and margins well enough to negotiate credibly.
* Present where the real work happens. sites, project offices and contractor hangouts are your workplace as much as any office — you close the gap between the offline reality and the digital platform.
* Mentored by founders and senior leaders. you will work directly alongside the people setting the company's direction.
* A fast path to leadership. this role is the entry point to becoming a Category Manager, City / Cluster Lead, or Growth Manager as we scale.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Buyer acquisition & activation —**
  identifying, meeting and onboarding builders, contractors and project teams; getting them to place their first order on the platform, and beyond.
* **Relationship ownership —**
  becoming the trusted point of contact who understands a buyer's sourcing needs and consistently solves for them.
* **Demand growth —**
  driving repeat usage, larger basket sizes, and adoption of the platform as a buyer's default way to source materials.
* **Commercial fluency —**
  understanding BOQs, quotations and margins well enough to negotiate credibly and advise buyers with confidence.
* **Data & process discipline —**
  capturing what happens on the ground into clean data and repeatable playbooks that let the business scale.
* **On-ground presence —**
  being physically present at sites, project offices and wherever buyers are, to build and protect the relationship.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* 2-4 years of experience in identifying, meeting and onboarding builders, contractors and project teams.
* Engineering background — mandatory. A B.E. / B.Tech in any discipline is a non-negotiable requirement for this role.
* Mechanical, Mining or Metallurgical Engineering — a strong plus. Given the materials, plant and industry context this role operates in, though we welcome all engineering disciplines.
* Working knowledge of MS Office and AI tools. comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and equally comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude and similar) to work faster and think sharper.

2-3 years

We are looking for a Key Accounts Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of 4–5 key accounts. This is a client-facing, revenue-focused role where you will be responsible not only for maintaining strong relationships but also for identifying opportunities, increasing account value, and generating business from existing clients.The ideal candidate will have experience working with clients in a design, creative, digital, IT, or technology environment and should be comfortable balancing client relationships with commercial targets.

title: Group Account Manager
description:
**Brand Catapult**

Brand Catapult is a leading marketing agency specializing in the
**luxury and lifestyle sector**

, headquartered in New Delhi. With over a decade of experience, we have partnered with renowned brands across
**45+ industries in 9 countries**

, delivering cutting-edge creative solutions and impactful campaigns. 

Our portfolio includes some of the most exciting names in
**hospitality, fashion, luxury retail, and nightlife,**

making us one of the most sought-after agencies in the space. We pride ourselves on combining strategic thinking, innovative ideas, and seamless execution to drive measurable results.

As we expand our portfolio and push creative boundaries, we’re looking for ambitious leaders who want to be part of our dynamic growth journey and contribute to shaping the next chapter of Brand Catapult.

**Job Overview**

As a Group Account Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of brand managers while also managing your own portfolio of clients. This role requires a sharp eye for content quality, a finger on the pulse of social media trends, and a strong foundation in F&B and lifestyle marketing. You will act as a bridge between clients, internal teams, and creative output to ensure smooth execution and exceptional delivery across all brand touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team & Client Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of 3-4 Brand Managers, ensuring quality work and growth.
* Independently manage 2-3 key client accounts, including calendars, stories (Canva), and BAU postings.
* Take full ownership of client brands under your and your team’s purview.
* Ensure all deliverables and campaigns are executed on time and to the highest standard.

**Creative & Content Oversight**

* Review and approve all creative output to maintain brand excellence.
* Create/approve mood boards and coordinate shoots with teams and clients.
* Ensure content aligns with trends, brand tone, and client expectations in F&B, nightlife, and luxury.
* Oversee content calendars, story banks, topical posts, and campaign timelines.

**Client Relationship & Escalation Management**

* Act as senior point of contact for client discussions and escalations.
* Provide strategic direction and actionable solutions.
* Ensure internal and external timelines are strictly met.

**Performance & Reporting**

* Guide the team in tracking and reporting paid ad performance (no campaign execution, just   performance note-taking and reporting).
* Conduct quarterly reviews for direct reports with clear KPIs.
* Drive continuous improvement through performance review processes

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 4+ years in social media/digital brand management, ideally in an agency.
* Hands-on experience with F&B, hospitality, or luxury lifestyle brands.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire teams.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram & Facebook marketing (LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube a plus).
* Proficient in Meta Business Suite and Google Sheets/Docs.
* Up-to-date with social media trends, especially in F&B/lifestyle.
* Excellent client communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of performance marketing metrics.

**Location:**

Shahpurjat, Delhi

**Working Days:**

Monday to Saturday (Except 1st and 3rd Saturdays)

**Working Hours:**

10:30 AM to 7:00 PM

title: Relationship Manager - SME TASC
description:
**Job Summary**
To achieve agreed business financial and non-financial targets by acquiring, growing and retaining TASC - Trust, Association, Society and Club customers within acceptable risk parameters with a team of TASC relationship Managers
  
  
Contribute toward achieving team’s overall target and delivering optimal portfolio return.
  
  
Collaborate and build effective partnerships with TASC segment, as well as colleagues in CDD teams and partners in risk, compliance, other support functions, and product
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**
Achieve business financial and non-financial targets while contributing towards team’s overall deliverables through:
  
  

* Building trusted client relationships in TASC segment – primarily CA, SA, TD & other banking products as required by the segment
* Implement agreed business plan to achieve sales/ revenue targets
* Working on solutioning pertaining to TASC clients in close association with Product team,
* Generate creative ideas on TASC customer acquisition and products/ services
* Team management of TASC RM’s and their productivity
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and to take care of compliance in client engagement, internal stakeholder management and other business conduct

**Processes**

* Drive continuous improvement of the operational efficiency and effectiveness of processes to increase the consistency of systems and processes.
* Support the framework for effective management of operational risks across the Business and compliance with applicable internal policies, and external laws and regulations at a global level.
* Support the execution of Business strategy in a safe and well-controlled manner and on an end-to-end basis – incorporating infrastructure requirements and ensuring that they are fit-for-growth.
* Conduct regular and timely customer due diligence (CDD) reviews
* Ensure CDD profiles are error free for timely sign off
* Follow and comply with AML CDD policies and procedures where applicable

* Timely handling of customer issues, complaints, and product enquiries in accordance with established procedures

**Risk Management**

* Abide by appropriate frameworks to guarantee that business is carried out within the Group’s risk appetite and relevant risks are appropriately managed in conjunction with line managers other stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards and practices as defined by internal and external requirements. This includes compliance with regulations and guidelines on Sanctions, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM).
* Abide by the Group’s values and code of conduct and foster a robust culture to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees.
* Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant superiors and/or Risk Committees.
* Do what is right in order to avoid reputational risks and operational losses

**Governance**

* Ensure relevant systems and controls pertaining to the role remit are in compliance with Group and Business policies, procedures, standards and codes, including those governing all Risk types, Compliance, Operational Risk, Technology and Operations, Finance and Reputation

Ensure adherence with the following Regulatory Compliance policies and processes (as is applicable):
  
  

* Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and all applicable money laundering prevention procedures
* Client Due Diligence & Related Periodic Reviews
* Client Suitability Standards
* Treating Customers Fairly
* Approval & review of Credit Applications
* Maintain Documentary standards
* Data Confidentiality
* Cross-Border Policy

* Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC)
* Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees form part of the culture
* Engage with all audit report findings and ensure feedback is acted upon

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

* MS Excel. Word and other computer knowledge to run the operations

**Qualifications**
**Education**

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

**What We Offer**

title: Vice President - Global Indian Premier RM
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Description**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Personal Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
To grow and nurture HSBC NR Premier relationships (the HNI segment of the PLB customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan. Manage clients with a portfolio between USD 0.5M to USD 1M. To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and RBWM performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch RBWM Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider RBWM businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant MI to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
**Typical Targets And Measures**

* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales
* Through disciplined portfolio management, develop strategies to increase wallet share of existing clients and actively manage a prospect pipeline
* Specific metrics include, but not limited to: Revenue , AUM, TRB, number of products sold to client, number of referrals, total balance of relationship portfolio
* Client experience and/or client satisfaction metric
* Measured by client retention
* Measured by increase in portfolio penetration with diversified product and service mix
* Measured by adoption of global target operating model
* Measured by evidence of the development of a network of internal relationships
* Measured by Feedback from Colleagues
* Measured by Feedback from Clients
* Measured by compliance to KYC requirements, credit, service standards and reducing operational losses.
* Measured by internal audit standards
* Measured by number of information security breaches (none)
* Measured by client complaints
* Measured by no adverse feedback received from Local Credit Team, Global Wealth credit, or from a Credit Risk Review

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum of five years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Accreditations**

* Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market AMFI & IRDA

**Additional Information**

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

Full-Time

About Royal Impact Certification Limited

Royal Impact Certification Limited (RICL) is a leading organization providing certification, auditing, inspection, testing, and training services across various industries. We are looking for a proactive, experienced, and result-oriented Tender Manager to manage government and PSU tender opportunities and support our business growth across India.

Job Summary

The Tender Manager will be responsible for identifying relevant government and PSU tender opportunities, managing the complete bidding process, preparing technical and financial proposals, handling GeM and e-procurement portals, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate submission of bids.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of government procurement procedures, tender documentation, bid management, GeM operations, and business development.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify, evaluate, and track government, PSU, and private-sector tender opportunities relevant to the company's services.
* Manage tender submissions through GeM, CPPP, e-procurement portals, and other government procurement platforms.
* Prepare, review, and submit technical bids, financial bids, commercial proposals, EOI, RFP, RFQ, and tender documents.
* Ensure compliance with tender requirements, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, and submission deadlines.
* Prepare and maintain tender documentation, including company profiles, credentials, experience certificates, financial documents, certifications, declarations, affidavits, and other supporting documents.
* Coordinate with internal departments for collecting technical, financial, legal, and operational information required for bidding.
* Manage EMD, bid security, performance security, bank guarantees, tender fees, and related documentation.
* Monitor tender status, bid openings, technical evaluations, financial evaluations, clarifications, negotiations, and award announcements.
* Handle pre-bid meetings, queries, clarifications, and communication with government departments and procurement authorities.
* Maintain a tender database, bidding pipeline, submission tracker, and MIS reports.
* Analyze tender requirements and assess business opportunities, competition, eligibility, and commercial viability.
* Support business development activities for Certification, Auditing, Inspection, Testing, and Training Services.
* Develop strategies to improve tender participation, bid success rate, and government business revenue.
* Follow up on submitted bids and coordinate post-award formalities, contracts, and onboarding requirements.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a relevant discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in tender management, government procurement, bid management, or business development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of GeM portal and government e-procurement systems.
* Experience in preparing technical and financial bids, tender documents, and commercial proposals.
* Excellent knowledge of government tendering procedures and procurement documentation.
* Strong communication, coordination, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and online tender portals.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and deadline management.
* Ability to independently manage multiple tenders and bidding processes.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following sectors will be preferred:

* ISO Certification and Auditing Services
* Inspection and Third-Party Inspection (TPI)
* Product Testing and Laboratory Services
* Quality Assurance and Compliance
* Government and PSU Business Development
* Consultancy, Assessment, and Training Services

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of relevant tender opportunities identified.
* Timely and accurate bid submissions.
* Tender compliance and documentation accuracy.
* Bid-to-win ratio.
* Government and PSU business development.
* Revenue generated through successful tenders.
* Effective tender pipeline and reporting management.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon, and the leader in providing secure, reliable, scalable, and innovative cloud services that help more than a million businesses across the global scale and grow. We are expanding in several areas, and our Industry team in India is looking for a seasoned industry leader with experience in business development/sales, driving top line growth and overall end-customer technology adoption across Manufacturing Process Industries including Metals, Mining, Minerals and related sectors. The ideal candidates will possess a strong business development/sales background and Manufacturing Process Industry technology experience that will enable them to engage directly with customers, coach sales teams, and lead tactical and strategic initiatives to deliver innovative solutions to the Manufacturing Process Industry.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in designing and deploying technology solutions that support multiple areas within the Manufacturing Process Industry technology landscape.
  
  

* Knowledge of the critical systems needed to support the Manufacturing Process Industry across the value chain including production planning, asset management, quality control, supply chain optimization, and operational technology (OT) systems.
* Understanding of the workflows needed to support the various business functions within Manufacturing Process Industries including predictive maintenance, process optimization, energy management, safety and compliance monitoring, and mine-to-market operations.
* Understanding of the business, technical, and operations needs of Manufacturing Process Industry customers in India, with ability to translate into technology solutions powered by cloud and AI.
* Relationships with, and an understanding of, key system integrators and independent solutions vendors in the Manufacturing Process Industry, to include an understanding of top named ISV solutions, and SI-led service offerings.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
Effectively position AWS as a strategic and trusted partner to our India Manufacturing Process Industry customers.
  
  
Coach account teams and help define the strategic direction for top accounts, with a focus on line-of-business solutions and business sponsors.
  
  
Lead pre-sales activities for Manufacturing Process Industry accounts, work with AWS Marketing to support lead-generation and sales-acceleration activities, and influence downstream activities with global and multi-national customers.
  
  
Identify and help define the requirements for new service or packaged offerings, in collaboration with the Manufacturing Process Industry Market Development team, AWS Professional Services, AWS services teams, partners, and Amazon product teams.
  
  
Conduct executive workshops with industry leaders and executives and translate into priority areas for transformation and innovation.
  
  
Effectively position AWS in Manufacturing Process Industries through participation in industry conferences, executive briefings, and other public speaking opportunities.
  
  
Work closely with AWS technical experts in solutioning, developing, and delivering AWS-based solutions to customers.
  
  
Support the AWS Partner Network and key industry technology providers with their solutions and service line offerings developed and running on AWS.
  
  
Understand and exploit the use of Salesforce and internal Amazon systems for campaign tracking and pipeline management.
  
  
Prepare and present business reviews to senior management regarding progress and roadblocks.
  
  
Travel may be required for this role, up to 50%.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Define the strategic direction for top Manufacturing Process Industry accounts, with a focus on line-of-business solutions and business sponsors.
  
  
Identify and Engage with strategic stakeholder in priority accounts with aim to engage them on business critical challenges and co-create transformation roadmaps that align AWS capabilities with their strategic priorities.
  
  
Lead pre-sales activities for Manufacturing Process Industry accounts, work with AWS Marketing to support lead-generation and sales-acceleration activities, and influence downstream activities with global and multi-national customers.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
* 5+ years of professional or military experience
* 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
* 5+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
* 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* 5+ years of working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. experience
* 5+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
* 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of publisher ad tech stacks and/or advertising technology
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
* Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
* Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
* Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

title: Plant Solution Manager
description:
SMRT(i)PL, we have Rock Processing as a business area, which is a leading supplier in equipment, services, support and technical solutions for construction and mining industry and specialist in Crushing, Screening, Mobile plants, and attachments. We are a leading provider of eco-efficient rock processing solutions. Leveraging more than 160 years of engineering excellence, we help our customers optimise their comminution and material handling operations for maximum performance, safety, and efficiency.

We apply our profound industry expertise in crushing, screening, feeding, loading and wear protection, to bring an unrivalled equipment line-up to the market. This unique offering is underpinned by our expert process knowledge, full range of digital tools, high-quality OEM spare parts, consumables, and life-cycle services. Employing around 3000 professionals worldwide, Rock Processing is a business area of the global, high-tech engineering group Sandvik. For more information, please visit https://www.home.sandvik/

**Role :: Plant Solution Manager**

**Job Location :: Gurgaon**

**Role Synopsis:**

Plant Solution Manager will be responsible for the complete project lifecycle, from pre-sales estimation and technical proposal development through engineering, procurement, execution, commissioning, and project closure. The role will provide technical and commercial support to the Sales team during bid preparation while ensuring profitable, safe, and timely project delivery after order acquisition.

The position will lead project procurement activities, manage the Design Engineering team, and supervise Project Coordinators located across India. The individual will serve as the central point of coordination between customers, suppliers, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and site teams to ensure successful delivery of crushing and screening projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Support, Project Estimation & Technical Proposals**

* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to develop competitive techno-commercial proposals for Crushing & Screening projects.
* Review customer RFQs, tender documents, technical specifications, project requirements, and contract conditions.
* Prepare and validate project cost estimates including:

* Equipment supply
* Structural steel
* Chutes and material handling systems
* Electrical and automation systems
* Erection and commissioning activities
* Transportation and logistics
* Civil and infrastructure requirements
* Third-party vendor and subcontractor services

* Collaborate with Design Engineering teams to develop preliminary plant layouts, process flows, and engineered solutions during the proposal stage.
* Develop project execution strategies, schedules, delivery plans, and resource estimates for project bids.
* Conduct technical and commercial risk assessments during bid evaluation.
* Participate in customer discussions, technical clarification meetings, and commercial reviews.
* Support preparation of budgetary quotations and capital cost estimates for greenfield and brownfield crushing and screening plants.
* Review project profitability and margin assumptions before proposal submission.
* Ensure lessons learned from previous projects are incorporated into future bids and estimates to improve estimating accuracy and project profitability.

**2. Project Execution & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end project management activities from order handover through commissioning and project closure.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation plans.
* Monitor project progress against scope, cost, schedule, and quality objectives.
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within approved budgets.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide regular performance reports to management.
* Manage project risks, mitigation plans, and escalation processes.
* Ensure smooth transition from sales handover to project execution.

**3. Project Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Lead all project-specific procurement activities for assigned projects.
* Coordinate procurement of:

* Mechanical equipment like Gearboxes and conveyor accessories etc.
* Structural steel
* Electrical and instrumentation systems
* Automation systems
* Site services
* Contract labor and subcontractors

* Work closely with purchase and supply chain functions to ensure timely material availability.
* Evaluate vendor capabilities and participate in supplier selection processes.
* Monitor supplier performance, manufacturing schedules, and delivery commitments.
* Drive cost optimization and procurement efficiency initiatives.
* Minimize project delays arising from procurement bottlenecks.

**4. Design & Engineering Management**

* Lead and manage the Design Engineering team supporting project execution.
* Ensure timely release of:

* General Arrangement (GA) drawings
* Plant layouts
* Structural drawings
* Fabrication drawings
* Equipment integration drawings
* Engineering documentation

* Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with customer specifications and industry standards.
* Coordinate design changes, engineering clarifications, and customer approvals.
* Drive engineering optimization for improved plant performance, constructability, maintainability, and cost control.
* Ensure effective collaboration between engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and site teams.

**5. Management of Project Coordinators**

* Lead and mentor Project Coordinators for effective and intime deliveries.
* Establish project governance frameworks and reporting structures.
* Define individual performance objectives and development plans.
* Ensure consistency in project tracking, reporting, documentation, and customer communication.
* Facilitate effective coordination between regional offices, customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Build a high-performance project management organization capable of supporting business growth.

**6. Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary customer interface during project execution.
* Conduct project kick-off, progress review, and project closure meetings.
* Manage customer expectations, scope changes, technical clarifications, and issue resolution.
* Develop strong customer relationships to enhance satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
* Coordinate with consultants, EPC contractors, and external project stakeholders.

**7. Financial & Commercial Management**

* Monitor project budgets, cost performance, and profitability.
* Track project revenue recognition, invoicing milestones, and cash flow requirements.
* Manage project variations, claims, and change orders.
* Analyse project financial performance against original estimates.
* Drive margin improvement through proactive planning and robust project controls.
Ensure commercial compliance with contracts and approved business commitments.  

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Implement project management best practices across all projects.
* Develop and improve project execution processes, templates, and reporting mechanisms.
* Standardize estimation models, procurement processes, and project controls.
* Capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support digitalization and implementation of project management tools and dashboards.

**Key Interfaces**

**Internal Stakeholders ::** Sales & Business Development **,** Design & Engineering **,** Procurement & Supply Chain **,** Manufacturing **,** Service & Commissioning **,** Finance & Commercial **,** Product Support Teams **,** Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

**External Stakeholders ::** Customers **,** EPC Contractors **,** Consultants **,** Suppliers & Vendors **,** Subcontractors **,** Regulatory Authorities

**Required Qualifications Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related engineering discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.
* MBA in Operations, Project Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage.

* 15+ years of experience in project management within: Crushing & Screening, Aggregates, Mining Equipment, Mineral Processing Plants, Bulk Material Handling Systems
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams.
* Proven experience in: Project estimation, technical proposal preparation, Project procurement, Engineering coordination, Plant installation and commissioning
* Customer-facing project management

**What we offer:**

You will have the opportunity to shape regional strategy, strengthen organisational capability and build long-term value for customers, employees and stakeholders. You will be part of a culture that values accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration, where your impact is visible and your contribution directly supports the long-term success of the business.

**Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub , LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

**Application**

We look forward to your application and ask you to send it no later than December 7th, 2026.

title: Legal Lead - Corporate
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
Adani RMRW: Encompassing Adani Road Transport Limited and Adani Water, Adani RMRW is a key infrastructure business of the Adani Group, focused on driving sustainable development. Adani Road Transport Limited specializes in the construction, operation, and maintenance of highways and expressways, ensuring seamless connectivity across India. Adani Water addresses critical water challenges through innovative projects such as desalination plants, water treatment facilities, and irrigation systems, enhancing water availability and sustainability. Together, these businesses aim to deliver world-class infrastructure while fostering environmental stewardship and community impact, making Adani RMRW a leader in India's infrastructure and resource management sector.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Legal Lead is overseeing all legal aspects of the division's operations, providing strategic legal advice, managing litigation and arbitration, ensuring compliance with regulations, and mitigating legal risks. facilitating legal and compliance processes by drafting and managing contracts, advising on project and business legal matters, and collaborating with stakeholders to safeguard company interests and maintain legal integrity.

Coordinating with external Legal counsel and in consultation with the Management, giving appropriate instructions to external Legal counsel from time to time.

* Offer strategic legal counsel on business initiatives, mergers, acquisitions, and other corporate actions.
* Identify potential legal risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Stay updated on changes in legislation and regulations that may impact the company’s operations.
* Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management:
* Support the Management in ensuring compliance with local, state, and national Laws.
* Strategic Business Advisory:
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior management, providing legal insights that influence key business decisions.
* Offer strategic legal counsel on business initiatives, mergers, acquisitions, and other corporate actions.
* Influence management decisions by providing timely and relevant legal advice.
* Develop and implement legal policies and procedures to ensure organizational compliance and mitigate legal risks.
* Stakeholder Management, Team Development and Legal Liaisoning:

* Refine data collection procedures to ensure relevant data is available for analytic systems.
* Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.

* Address customer concerns regarding forecasting issues and data quality, and write codes to perform forecasting checks.

title: Data Engineer - Marketing Automation and Customer Acquisition
description:
**Role**
: Data Engineer
  
**Contract**
: Permanent
  
**Starting Date**
: Immediate
  
  
We are looking for a commercially driven, technically capable Data Engineer to build, operate and optimize the data infrastructure, automated acquisition pipelines and AI-powered systems responsible for driving customer growth at
**Commoditopia**
.
  
  
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. You will be directly responsible for identifying target customers, building prospect databases, building and running pipelines, executing customer acquisition strategies, developing email and social media outreach strategies, and achieving customer registration and onboarding targets.
  
  
**What You'll Be Building**
:

:
  
  
1. You will be employed as a Merchant Acquisitions Data Engineer
  
2. Once your system consistently achieves merchant acquisition targets, a successor will take your role and you will be promoted to becoming a Commercial Data Engineer
  
3. Thereafter, you become a Senior Data Engineer
  
4. There are bonuses and opportunities to work on AI, LM & ML workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  
• Identify specific customer targets by commodity, industry, geography and business category
  
• Develop customer acquisition strategies for buyers, sellers, suppliers, distributors and other marketplace participants
  
• Build, manage and continuously expand large-scale prospect databases
  
• Collect, enrich, validate and segment prospect data
  
• Take ownership of achieving defined target-customer acquisition numbers
  
• Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified prospective marketplace participants
  
• Build and operate automated email acquisition pipelines
  
• Develop personalized email sequences for different customer segments
  
• Build automated LinkedIn and social media prospecting sequences
  
• Develop multi-channel outreach strategies and workflows
  
• Implement automated follow-up systems
  
• Develop and deploy AI agents for inbound and outbound customer communication.
  
• Build automated calling and conversational workflows.
  
• Configure AI agents to introduce Commoditopia, explain its marketplace and qualify prospective customers.
  
• Develop automated responses to customer enquiries.
  
• Integrate conversational AI with CRM, prospecting and onboarding systems.
  
• Take direct responsibility for achieving monthly free-plan registration targets.
  
• Convert identified prospects and qualified leads into registered Commoditopia users.
  
• Develop and operate automated registration and onboarding campaigns.
  
• Guide customers through account creation, verification and initial marketplace participation.
  
• Identify and resolve bottlenecks preventing prospects from joining the marketplace.
  
•Ensure acquired customers successfully complete the required onboarding process.
  
• Work with the software engineering team to develop proprietary customer acquisition technology.
  
• Build systems that enable customer acquisition to scale without proportionally increasing manual work.
  
• Translate commercial requirements into technical specifications and functional systems.
  
  
This position carries direct responsibility for customer acquisition outcomes. Performance will be assessed on both the systems developed and the commercial results delivered.
  
  
The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering agreed monthly customer acquisition and free-plan registration targets, not merely developing the systems intended to achieve them.

title: Associate Director - Cross Discipline
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Associate Director Cross channel who will do:
  
  

* Client & Channel Leadership Act as the lead and primary point of contact for key digital marketing channels—including Search, Social, Programmatic Buying Units (PBU), Ad Operations, or Commerce (all or couple of them). Represent the Global Operations Center (GOC) in all channels wise agency/market interactions, ensuring expectations are managed and consistently met. Serve as the custodian of activation excellence for assigned channels, driving trust and accountability across global stakeholders.
* Campaign Activation & Performance Oversight Oversee the activation, and optimization of campaigns across multiple channels and designated markets. Ensure flawless execution that aligns with broader media strategies and brand objectives. Work in close partnership with local and regional teams to maintain consistency, enhance performance, and deliver measurable impact through detailed reporting and actionable insights.
* Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership Build and maintain strong relationships with internal market teams (Europe, U.S., Asia, MEA, AUNZ), agency partners, and cross-functional groups. Act as a strategic advisor, offering data-driven solutions tailored to regional needs while upholding global standards. Partner with leadership and internal clients to drive innovation, resolve challenges, and influence strategic decisions that contribute to business growth.
* Operational Excellence & Governance Design, implement, and manage scalable workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency, campaign quality, and consistency. Enforce compliance with global taxonomy, quality assurance, and platform governance standards. Analyze operational data and feedback to identify improvement areas, ensure process adherence, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
* Team Leadership & Talent Development Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of subject matter experts responsible for campaign execution, optimization, and reporting. Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team culture. Ensure efficient team resourcing, continuous skills development, and alignment with organizational objectives through regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluation.
* Innovation, Automation & Business Growth Proactively identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and emerging markets. Collaborate with directors and senior leadership to develop compelling discussions for onboarding new scopes of work. Champion the adoption of internal and external automation tools and technology solutions to drive operational efficiency and future-proof activation capabilities.
* Coordination with internal team to overall smooth running for operations.

****Skills And Experience****
If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:
  
  

* Graduation or Post Graduation Degree in Any stream
* 8+ year's professional experience in digital media execution
* You are an expert & executed on respective channel platforms
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheet
* Working knowledge in HubSpot, Smartly, 4C, Scibids, or third-party tools like Dataroma, Google Studio is an added advantage
* Experience managing multi-location media activation teams.
* Experience training and maintaining quality standards at scale.
* Experience providing service to local teams from a centralized location.
* Passion for everything digital, with an active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Possess a solution-oriented mindset and analytical skillset.
* Proactive, display exemplary leadership with a positive go-getter attitude.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft MCAPS-Core is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft's most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.
  
  
MCAPS-Core is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers' digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions, delivered through strategic engagements with customers across the globe and powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  

* Model: Live our culture; embody our values; practice our leadership principles.
* Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes; enable success across boundaries; help the team adapt and learn.
* Care: Attract and retain great people; know each individual's capabilities and aspirations; invest in the growth of others.

Account Delivery Management
  
  

* Supports strategic relationships with key stakeholders in the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
* Supports new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft.
* Communicates the current view of delivery to customer executives on a regular cadence, as appropriate.

Intellectual Property (IP)
  
  

* Ensures the use, reuse, and creation of intellectual property (IP) in delivery, as applicable.

Relationship Development
  
  

* Manages stakeholder relationships both internally (e.g., with Customer Success, Engineering product teams, Operations, Finance, local Consulting management) and externally (e.g., with partners and partner leads).
* Synthesizes and combines broad insights from personal or teams' experience regarding former delivery experiences with customers.
* Closely collaborates with the Global Pursuit Organization (e.g., on domain approvals, lead to order, sales handover).
* Proactively leverages relationships to resolve complex staffing issues and to create clarity.
* Partners with Software Quality Assurance and Delivery Excellence to monitor delivery portfolio health.
* Engages in a regular cadence with Global Capacity Management Resource Managers to assist in staff matching for Project Managers on new engagements.
* Resolves issues identified and escalated by Consulting Project Managers from internal and external teams and customers (e.g., across the Microsoft organization and with partners) regarding internal or critical customer issues (e.g., personnel change requests, threat of customer dissatisfaction, inability to deliver the customer's outcome, delivery quality issues and dispute management), and manages internal executive engagement for escalations, as needed.
* Establishes escalation standards and process improvements for the practice and implements escalation management governance processes.
* Understands customer and subcontractor obligations, and engages in obligation management.
* Drives Consulting Project Managers to maintain the right contacts in service systems and target surveys.
* Champions the creation of feedback plans based on survey and constructive feedback.
* May serve on customer executive steering committees for an engagement.
* Oversees through Project Health Reviews that internal and external compliance requirements have been met.
* Acts as an escalation point where a compliance or security breach has been identified, to understand impact and ensure notification through the correct channels.

Contracting
  
  

* Reviews and approves the original contract and subsequent change requests.
* Acts as an escalation point should the contract not be of the required quality, or has created ambiguity in the delivery of professional services to the customer.
* Reviews and approves subcontractor onboarding (e.g., purchase orders, invoice approvals).

Presales
  
  

* Adds input into deal construct and deliverability early in the pre-sales cycle.
* May work within the pre-sales team for exceptionally large consulting deals.

Planning
  
  

* Sets expectations through the Solution Review Meeting conditions of approval and throughout the engagement to tactically direct the Project Manager.

Monitoring and Controlling
  
  

* Steps in to take remedial actions with Consulting Project Managers on specific engagements if key performance indicators (KPIs) or certain metrics are not at the quality levels required, to understand and remediate any issues.
* Reviews risks and issues directly with Consulting Project Managers in Project Health Reviews.
* Acts as the primary escalation point to establish consensus and a unified message to the customer.
* Acts as the primary escalation point for any technical issues and is accountable overall for the quality of the technical delivery of the engagement.
* Reviews and approves customer change control processes.
* Ensures Consulting Project Managers' adherence to internal financial rhythms of business (ROBs).
* Acts as the primary escalation point for budgetary issues and serves as the primary approver for the release of any Risk Reserve required on engagements.
* May be positioned as an Executive Steerco Member on customer engagements.
* Facilitates across organizational boundaries to gain consensus and direction on the delivery.
* Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams (e.g., Sales, Architects).
* Models and encourages others to develop and/or expand awareness of internal mechanisms in order to best address customer needs.
* Establishes accountabilities, when appropriate, to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place.

Closure
  
  

* Validates the customer sign-off on the Proof of Delivery/Delivery Acceptance Form.
* Seeks themes in lessons learned and delivery constraints/issues, and documents and socializes them with relevant internal Microsoft teams to improve intellectual property (IP) and feed into continuous improvement.

Portfolio Management
  
  

* Acts as centralized management for one or more project portfolios to achieve strategic objectives.
* Oversees a broad portfolio of deliveries managed and supported by Consulting Project Managers.
* Impacts the global community to drive change and initiate additional customer outreach.
* Oversees a broad portfolio of complex accounts, when appropriate.
* Supports management and assurance of the all-up delivery of consulting engagements.
* Proactively reviews portfolio health and ensures challenged engagements receive support and are monitored to execute against Go-to-Green Plans.
* Establishes operational processes and standards to mitigate delivery issues for the organization to adopt.
* Ensures methodology, processes, and quality standards are consistently implemented and tools are leveraged appropriately.
* Monitors and manages metrics, intervenes to course correct, and uses tools/dashboards to identify issues and inform solutions.
* Understands business implications, recommends insights for the business, and briefs senior-level leaders on proactive solutions.

Business Growth
  
  

* Owns the financial health of the portfolio (e.g., revenue attainment, accurate forecasting and portfolio planning, cost management, and utilization, skills, and capacity planning).
* Identifies opportunities to accelerate and drive consumption and delivery.
* Owns and drives backlog risk management.
* Drives incremental business on top of the existing portfolio through next step proposals (NSPs), and conducts customer discussions related to NSPs and other opportunities.
* Engages in the pursuit cycle to ensure deals are structured appropriately.
* Supports and contributes to rhythm of business (ROB) and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) forecasting.
* Recognizes opportunities, creates a shared vision and direction, and moves people and processes in a new direction for a sector(s) or geoarea(s).
* Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Consulting personnel or the broader organization if required, to shape new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts for large or strategic opportunities.
* When appropriate, innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the account portfolio.
* As needed, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes, sometimes challenging deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately.
* Ensures delivery team alignment and holds the delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
* Looks for or creates opportunities to maximize timely cloud consumption through current deliveries.
* Coaches the team and Consulting Project Managers (CPMs) to identify new opportunities with customers and to accelerate delivery or prevent delivery delays.
* Proactively reshapes the portfolio to maximize consumption and drive transformation deliveries.
* Reviews new deals to confirm the expected outcomes are deliverable, the risk process is managed, and costs/resources and number of hours are correctly identified.

Delivery Management
  
  

* Ensures the right mix of internal/external resources are assigned in engagements to drive Microsoft's strategic use of onshore, offshore, nearshore, and partner delivery resource pools.
* Optimizes the use of resources according to deal shaping and financial efficiency to maximize customer value.
* Drives delivery excellence, maturity, and quality, leveraging Quality Assurance partners and organizations and ensuring appropriate use of Microsoft and industry methodologies.
* Oversees the successful delivery of projects, ensuring proper project initiation is followed and documented both internally and externally using the Service Delivery Methodology (SDM).
* Oversees the delivery team (Consulting Project Managers) as the primary escalation point for any delivery issues.
* Monitors the health and risk profile of individual projects through Project Health Reviews.
* Ensures that customers are surveyed for delivery satisfaction.
* Proactively anticipates when projects may go poorly and steps in to pivot priorities for mitigation.
* Influences others to secure resources for deliveries, and holds teams accountable for maintaining obligations to customer contracts and ensuring delivery services across the services lifecycle.
* Attends steering committee meetings, as needed, with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.

AI Knowledge and Leadership
  
  
AI is now part of most MCAPS-Core engagements. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but the delivery manager needs enough AI knowledge to shape deals, manage risk, coach Consulting Project Managers, and speak credibly with customer executives.
  
  
Microsoft AI Platform and Solution Fluency
  
  

* Understanding of Microsoft Cloud and AI portfolio, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric, and GitHub Copilot.
* Understands common AI solution types, such as copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Recognizes that AI depends on good data and flags data-readiness gaps early.

Delivering AI Engagements
  
  

* Knowledge of delivering AI projects and the risks associated with executing AI projects. Clear understanding of AI SDLC with a focus on delivery quality solutions to customers.
* Helps Consulting Project Managers deliver AI work in stages (proof of value, pilot, production), with clear success criteria at each step and an early plan for monitoring, cost control, and customer handover.
* Tracks AI-specific risks, such as inaccurate outputs, data leakage, and high consumption costs, in Project Health Reviews and Go-to-Green Plans.

Responsible AI, Security and Compliance
  
  

* Applies Microsoft's Responsible AI principles to every AI engagement.
* Ensures required Responsible AI reviews and approvals are completed before deployment, and escalates concerns when needed.
* Understands key AI security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, such as the EU AI Act where relevant.

AI Deal Shaping, Contracting and Commercials
  
  

* Challenges AI deal assumptions early in pre-sales, including data readiness, effort estimates, and customer dependencies.
* Checks that AI contracts include clear outcomes, measurable acceptance criteria, IP ownership, and enough Risk Reserve.
* Encourages reuse of Microsoft and partner AI accelerators and IP.

AI-Powered Delivery Operations
  
  

* Uses Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents to manage the portfolio, for example to summarize status, spot risks, and prepare executive briefings.
* Encourages the team to use AI tools in their daily work while protecting customer data.

Building AI-Ready Teams
  
  

* Builds AI skills across the team through training and certifications.
* Works with Global Capacity Management and partners to staff engagements with the right AI talent.
* Shares lessons learned from AI deliveries with the wider practice.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values.

**Qualifications**
Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field AND 6+ years' experience in consulting/professional services delivery, project management, practice management, or a related field, OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of people management experience.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field AND 12+ years' experience in consulting/professional services delivery, project management, or practice management, or leading portfolio management, complex programs, or revenue-driven (e.g., $10 million+) programs, OR equivalent experience.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* 2+ years of consulting, professional services, or related financial management experience (e.g., cost management, revenue forecasting).
* Agile certification, Scrum Master, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or Professional Scrum Master One (PSM1) certification.
* Certification in a relevant industry.
* Demonstrated experience leading or governing AI, data or Copilot engagements, and a current Microsoft AI certification (for example, Azure AI Fundamentals or Azure AI Engineer Associate, or their current equivalents).
