title: Global Delivery Manager (IT-SaaS)
description:
**What is Equisoft?**
Equisoft is a global provider of digital solutions for insurance and investments, recognized by more than 300 of the world’s leading financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive ecosystem of scalable solutions that help our customers navigate the challenges of digital transformation – powered by a business needs-driven approach, deep industry knowledge, cutting-edge technologies, and multicultural team of experts based in North America, the Caribbean, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.
  
  
  
  
Why Choose Equisoft? With 950+ Employees, We Are a Stable Organization That Offers Career Advancement And Fosters a Stimulant Environment. If That’s Not Enough, Then Check Out These Other Perks Below
  
  

* Hiring Location: Hyderabad, India
* If you are in Hyderabad, you will be working in a hybrid collaborative workspace.
* Internal job title: Global Delivery Manager (IT-SaaS)
* Full-time Permanent Role
* Benefits available day 1: medical, dental, term life/personal accident coverage, wellness sessions, telemedicine program, etc.
* Flexible Working Hours: Must be available for team meetings based on the client-based location.
* Number of hours per week: 40
* Educational Support: Equisoft University and LinkedIn learning

**Role:**
The Global Delivery Manager (IT- SaaS), reporting to the Senior Global Delivery Manager and works closely with Project Manager and Product Owner. The incumbent manages end-to-end execution of concurrent carrier engagements, ensuring efficient resource allocation, standardized delivery frameworks, and seamless deployments. The role drives operational efficiency and consistency across the product suite, enabling scalable growth and a strong customer experience.
  
  
Leading a core delivery pod specialized across these four products: Apply (eApp/AppCapture), Sync (Portal), Illustrate, and Amplify — for a portfolio of insurance carrier clients.
  
  
**Your Day with Equisoft:**

* Maintain a portfolio of Apply, Sync, Illustrate, and Amplify projects and provide regular status through Jira and other communication channels.
* Oversee simultaneous delivery of multiple fast-paced carrier implementations and product upgrades.
* Develop a project implementation blueprint per product, in collaboration with global and regional PMOs, standardizing future deployments across the product suite.
* Support sales from a pricing and scheduling standpoint on new carrier engagements.
* Organize project initiation from sales handoff through team assignment, kickoff, and delivery.
* Coordinate deliveries with other Equisoft services teams and carrier stakeholders, navigating the integrations, middleware, and technical complexity these projects typically involve.
* Own capacity planning and resource-allocation processes for the pod, balancing team capacity against carrier commitments.
* Maintain RAID logs and keep stakeholders informed on delivery status, risks, mitigations, and dependencies.
* Ensure proper process is followed for product service, change requests, and UAT restructuring across all four product lines.
* Identify, raise, and mitigate delivery risks across the pod and escalate to Global Delivery leadership.
* Participate in key initiatives spanning the product suite — data mapping, API integrations, middleware upgrades, compliance investigations, and data migrations.

**Requirements:**
  
  
**Technical**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering or Information Technology or College Diploma combined to 3 years of relevant experience
* 3+ years of project/delivery management experience and an additional 5 years of experience in a software IT field.
* Experience managing or implementing B2B SaaS software & full life cycle management projects
* Working experience with Jira for project and delivery tracking.
* Experience with allocation, resource-planning, or capacity-management software in some capacity (any platform).
* Experience defining or tracking KPIs for billability, performance, and resource allocation.
* Comfortable working with SharePoint for documentation and collaboration.
* Strong general IT/systems literacy — comfortable with data mapping, APIs, and middleware on projects with significant integrations and internal technical complexity.
* Successfully delivered several different projects and initiatives of varying sizes, complexities, and budgets.
* Customer focus mindset.
* Experience working with Agile methodology.
* Excellent knowledge English (spoken and written)

**Soft Skills**

* Negotiation & Problem Resolution Skills
* Ability to build a strong network and relationships across technology, operations, and services.
* Strong sense of organization and prioritizing
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate, write and synthesize information
* Ability to multi-task in a rapid-paced environment
* Team spirit, tact, diplomacy, autonomy, rigor, and discipline

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in the field of insurance or wealth management.
* Experience with any type of AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, etc.

Equisoft is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: GNOC Supervisor
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
The Global Operations Center Supervisor provides first-line people leadership and operational ownership for a 24x7 enterprise infrastructure monitoring and incident response function. The Supervisor is accountable for shift execution, staffing and workload allocation, major incident coordination, escalation management, service-level performance, and development of GNOC engineers and analysts. The role combines strong technical leadership across network, server, and infrastructure monitoring with operational management. title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
  
  
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of a NOC Manager I**
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.
  
  
In this role, the manager will work with stakeholders from multiple partner teams to manage Integrated Centralised Monitoring and Response System Auditing function & improve program performance along with lead a team of people managers overseeing operations for a team size of 30+ associates. Manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance - 6PM IST OR 8PM IST onwards) depending on business requirements.
  
  
The Manager would be responsible to evolve the processes and mechanisms with the growing complexities in the network by working across multiple stakeholders like configuration and design teams. The individual will drive improvements and automations to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.
  
  
This position also manages the planning and execution of the team’s goals, including segmentation of business goals, measurement of goal attainment, evolving and driving various improvements in Business to increase its effectiveness in driving results. They would drive quality and productivity in the team via continuous coaching and feedback mechanisms, scope out team's career development plans through performance assessment, drive associate engagement through 1-1s and team building activities, dive deep and drive action on insights from connection scores, manage exceptions and prepare dive deeps on escalations from Ops, represent the team in Business reviews (WBRs/MBRs), strategize and implement the associate shift planning and rostering to effectively meet the program requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL would be an added advantage. They should be be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will need have excellent communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for performing operational audits across miles in FCs, SCs, Lastmile and GSF.
* Prepare audit reports enclosed with findings, visual interpretations captured during audits.
* Working with operational stakeholders to aligning audit related binaries, key operational processes to be covered in audits
* Preparing SOPS, weekly business reviews, newsletters, help-texts, simulations to assist associates in performing audits
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Track the deliverables of the NOC-ICMRS team, work closely with the operations leadership and drive audit closures.
* Must be willing to share on-call rotations in support of alarms, security incidents, and critical service outages.
* Enhance, track, and report on metrics which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements so that the desired outcomes are achieved to plan and in a timely manner.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, training and documentation
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all key goals and metrics

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or 3+ equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of experience in control room management, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Good critical thinking skills and attention to detail
* Experience with security equipment such as CCTV cameras and video review system

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Be solutions-focused, customer-focused, and always deliver excellent follow-up.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Assistant manager - Property management
description:
**Assistant Manager, Property Management**
**Work Dynamics**
**What this job involves: Roles and Responsibilities.**
**Being the bearer of engineering best practices**
This role requires someone who can efficiently and effectively coordinate and support delivery of facilities management services from the landlord.
  
  
With such a lot at stake, you must have the ability to carry out and follow through on procedures that are vital in critical environments and general building services engineering services & maintenance, Janitorial services, pest control, waste management, efficiency and compliance etc. When you do site reviews, you'll keep a lookout for opportunities to develop, innovate, and share within the team's programs that not only reduce costs, but also increase productivity. Spotting developments in international best practices and figuring out how to apply them locally is a constant, yet rewarding, challenge. This role also puts you in a unique position to promote our sustainability service strategies for achieving measurable improvements in energy use.
  
  
**Bridging gaps in processes and controls**
As a Subject Matter Expert, you'll contribute to the optimization of processes, tools and documentation. At the front of your mind at all times is the completion and compliance audit process. Keeping planned preventive maintenance programmers and service contracts in place and the work practices of contractors in check are also your mandate. 'Safety first' is your strapline and you'll do this by maintaining safety procedures, including crisis management or business continuity and emergency procedures at all times. Getting our site teams on board our risk management and mitigation initiatives will also fall on your shoulders.
  
  
**Bringing new technologies**
Technology is our prime focus to deliver best in class services to our client in real estate which focuses around the ESG goals, employee experience and Artificial Intelligence and machine learning. The role is supposed to provide the leadership to explore and bring new technologies for our clients.
  
  
**Building Management**
Responsible for and lead contact for the operational management of all site based FM services and for service quality and development. Ensures that statutory and corporate H&S standards are applied and adhered to in delivery of the FM service. Takes a strategic overview of the portfolio and prepares formal commissions and technical briefs to manage complex programs of work and projects, taking into account the impact on building occupants, staff and visitors and to minimize disruption to key areas of service delivery. Manage vendor contracts and maximize diverse vendor spending. Ensure all statutory requirements are met for building operations.
  
  
**Property Inspections and Enhancements:**

* Inspect properties and equipment to assess the extent of service and equipment required.
* Recommend, justify, develop, and coordinate projects aimed at enhancing the value of the buildings.
* Work with the Engineering and maintenance team to facilitate maintenance, repairs, or renovations. Obtain bids from outside contractors following client and JLL guidelines.
* Track projects, such as tenant improvements and major repair and maintenance projects. Review construction specifications or plans, seeking advice from relevant stakeholders.

**Lease Administration and Tenant Relations:**

* Support the Brokerage Team in the review of lease proposals and lease language.
* Manage the lease administration process, from reviewing lease proposals to coordinating tenant construction and preparing lease abstracts.
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of lease agreements, ensuring compliance from an accounting and operations standpoint.
* Act as the primary or secondary contact for tenants regarding tenant service requests and FM teams. Proactively meet with tenant representatives on a scheduled basis.

**Performance Management**
Initiates, reviews, and maintains a system of performance indicators for facilities, services and monitors and compares performance with other relevant public and private sector organisations. Responsible for planning and implementing measurable performance standards for all work undertaken by the facilities project managers. Manages and monitors current and future workload of the team to ensure that individuals are able to meet required timescales for individual projects and assignments.
  
  
**Financial Management and Contracting:**

* Prepare adjustments to the tenant billing process, demonstrating a strong understanding of CPI increases, CAM reconciliations, escalations, recoveries, special charges, etc.
* Tracking of utilities consumption , cost and efficiency of landlord equipment and support FM team.

**Landlord and Developer Management**

* Service Monitoring : You'll monitor and maintain comprehensive service monitoring frameworks to ensure all property management deliverables meet agreed standards and client expectations. This includes implementing real-time monitoring systems, conducting regular service quality assessments, and maintaining performance dashboards that provide visibility into service delivery across all touchpoints. Your role involves continuous evaluation of service levels against established landlord KPIs and taking corrective action when performance gaps are identified.
* Governance and Compliance Framework: You'll oversee the implementation and maintenance of robust governance structures that ensure accountability, transparency, and effective decision-making across all property management activities. This includes tracking committees meeting, following escalation procedures, tracking compliance registers, and ensuring all activities are tracked, reported and escalated as required.
* Tracking the landlord deliverables: Tracking the landlord deliverables, identifying the gaps in the contract and recommending actions to get the best outcome.
* Asset Management Governance: Your role involves ensuring assets are managed in accordance with best practices, regulatory requirements by the landlord and outcomes are tracked and reported to client objectives while maximizing operational efficiency and minimizing client risks.
* Building Compliance: You'll oversee comprehensive building compliance management ensuring all facilities meet regulatory, statutory, and corporate requirements. This includes maintaining compliance calendars, conducting regular compliance audits, tracking certification renewals, and ensuring all building systems operate within prescribed parameters. Your role ensures buildings operate safely and legally while minimizing compliance-related risks.
* Risk Management: You’ll develop and implement comprehensive risk management frameworks that identify, assess, and mitigate operational, financial, and strategic risks across the facilities portfolio. This includes conducting regular risk assessments, maintaining risk registers, implementing mitigation strategies, and ensuring business continuity planning.
* Data relevancy and documentation management: You'll oversee comprehensive data and documentation management systems that ensure accurate, accessible, and secure information management across all facilities operations. This includes implementing document control procedures, maintaining digital asset libraries, ensuring data integrity and security, and establishing version control protocols. You'll also manage reporting systems, maintain historical records, and ensure all documentation complies with regulatory requirements and client specifications while supporting operational decision-making through effective data analytics.
* Leadership Connect: You'll establish and maintain strong leadership connections across all organizational levels, ensuring effective communication and alignment between senior leadership, operational teams, and landlords. This involves conducting regular leadership briefings, facilitating strategic planning sessions, managing escalations, and serving as a key liaison between different organizational levels.
* Landlord connect : You'll serve as the primary liaison between tenants, property management teams, and landlords, ensuring seamless communication and coordination across all stakeholder groups. This involves managing landlord relationships, coordinating property-related decisions, facilitating discussions around building improvements and capital expenditures, and ensuring landlord requirements are effectively communicated and implemented. You'll also support coordinate property inspections with landlords, handle escalations, and ensure that landlord expectations align with operational delivery while maintaining strong collaborative relationships that benefit all parties.

**Knowledge, Experience, Skills**

* Substantial post-qualification experience of managing a corporate property portfolio
* Excellent excel skills and dash bord and program management to track the various activities and support FM teams.
* A good understanding of program management including ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and prepare reports.
* Analytical skills, tracking and sound judgement
* A demonstrable commitment to achieving customer service excellence
* Ability to build and maintain excellent working relationships across a broad spectrum of internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience of managing and coordinating multi-disciplinary teams
* Ability to think, plan and act under pressure to meet deadlines and service priorities
* Persuasive communication and negotiation skills
* Excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills
* Experience of undertaking and reviewing elemental building condition surveys within large, occupied buildings
* Knowledge of statutory standards and requirements for the safe management of public buildings in respect to building repair, maintenance, and operation
* Knowledge of current contract standing orders, relevant legislation, and best practice, and of how these are applied in managing and operating buildings

**Qualification & Experience**
Graduation with 5 years or Diploma with 7 years’ experience in managing engineering functions in property and facility management. Person from engineering background with thorough knowledge in compliance, safety and engineering operations in managing commercial buildings.
  
  
Excellent excel skills, dash board and good written and verbal communication.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
**Apply today!**

title: Fund Servicing Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Associate II and be at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth and skill development, as you collaborate with a dynamic team and contribute to impactful solutions. Experience the benefits of being part of a leading financial institution that values innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Fund Servicing Associate ll within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our fund servicing operations. Leveraging your broad knowledge of fund accounting and administration, you will provide advice and support to ensure progress within established procedures and policies. Your work will have a significant impact on our department, requiring you to apply your advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions for varied and complex issues. Your advanced emotional intelligence will be key in building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for our team and clients. Your role will also involve planning and organizing your own work, and potentially that of a team, while continuously seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation in our operating platform.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead daily exception monitoring and triage at cutoffs; set prioritization and escalation standards; ensure timely escalation of material issues.
* Oversee and perform alert investigations using instrument data, rule logic, and prospectus terms to confirm validity; handle/review high-severity or complex cases.
* Drive false alert remediation with Data Management and Rule/Technology teams; validate fixes in test and production; own false-positive reduction themes and outcomes.
* Own compliance run management end-to-end (schedules, dependencies, reruns) to meet SLAs; implement run health monitoring and contingency processes.
* Lead data feed/import issue resolution with providers and internal stakeholders; interpret flat files/feed logs; document outcomes and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Manage stakeholder engagement across Operations, Technology, Investment teams, and third-party vendors; run governance routines and escalate effectively to achieve timely resolution.
* Produce and present MI/reporting (alert volumes, false positive rates, turnaround times, run timeliness, SLA adherence) and translate insights into capacity, control, and process improvements.
* Maintain strong audit and documentation discipline (evidence, audit trails, decision logs, procedures); ensure processes remain current, effective, and audit-ready.
* Provide people management: coach and develop team members, manage performance, ensure coverage planning, cross-training, and a strong risk & controls culture.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 12+ years of direct people management experience, including coaching, performance management, and driving delivery under SLAs.
* Strong experience in Fund Servicing, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Investment Operations, Reference Data Operations, or Investment Compliance Operations.
* Hands-on experience with breaks/alerts, daily cutoffs, prioritization, escalation, and defensible decision-making.
* Ability to interrogate datasets to validate rule triggers and exception drivers; strong comfort with spreadsheets and data analysis tools.
* Strong RCA capability; experience partnering with Tech/Data teams to raise defects, validate fixes (UAT), and deliver durable remediation (not just short-term closure).
* Experience producing and presenting operational MI/KPIs (volumes, ageing/TAT, false positives, run timeliness, SLA adherence) to drive action and improvements.
* Strong documentation discipline—evidence capture, audit trails, procedure maintenance, and control effectiveness.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Understanding of investment instruments, portfolio structures, market data concepts, fund restrictions, and prospectus-driven controls.
* Familiarity with issue tracking tools and structured exception management workflows.
* Familiarity with rule-based compliance engines, rule logic interpretation, scheduling/runs, dependencies, and rerun management.
* Experience troubleshooting data imports/feeds, interpreting flat files and feed logs, working with data providers/vendors, and implementing preventive controls.

Through them, ensure Optometrists, Vision Technicians and Field Assistants have the right staffing, attendance and field readiness, and share learnings across locations.· Referral follow-up: Monitor referrals, consultations and teleconsultations, and spectacle delivery, and clear backlogs with the help of field teams, share regular feedback for learning and updating.· Data and reporting: Keep a consolidated regional tracker, review data for completeness and accuracy, resolve discrepancies with the data team, and send regular updates to the Program Manager.· Logistics: Coordinate with local coordinators and local optom leads for respective aspects of transport, equipment and field resources, and escalate constraints quickly.· Problem solving: Spot bottlenecks early, maintain an escalation tracker, and raise critical risks to targets, timelines or quality.Who we're looking for· Experience: At least 2 years (3–5 preferred) in public health, school health, healthcare, or rural or community development; multi-location coordination is a plus.· Education: Bachelor's or Master's in any field; MPH, Social Work, Social Sciences, Rural Development or Healthcare Management preferred.· Skills: Strong planning, communication, team management and report writing; comfortable with Excel, Word, PowerPoint and email.· Languages: English and Telugu; Hindi a plus.· Willingness: To travel often, work in schools and field settings, and keep flexible hours around school schedules.

Quality Control and Inspection

Design to cost
  
  

* Ability to use all tools, methods and rules for cost evaluation and optimization of designed items

* Understands calculation of COGS (Capex, MBC, ..) n Has estimation in mind about products, functions and component costs n Is able to estimate cost for products components and parts and the parameters than can help to reduce its costs

title: Director - SN & Ent. Tools Operations Excellence
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Service Operations Lead is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of core systems and platforms within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations.
  
  
Operating at a senior level, the role provides leadership across operational teams, acts as the primary escalation point for platform issues, and partners with Product/Platform Owners, architects, engineering teams, and IT service functions to maintain platform stability and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide operational leadership across core platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
* Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
* Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
* Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
* Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
* Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
* Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
* Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
* Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
* Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
* Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Systems Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., ITIL, Agile/Scrum, Service Management, DevOps Foundations)

**Job Experience**

* Typically 18+ years of experience in platform operations (e.g. ServiceNow), system administration, service management, or technical delivery roles within complex environments.
* Significant experience overseeing operational performance for multiple platforms or systems within a complex environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management.
* Proven ability to diagnose operational issues, lead root cause analysis, and drive sustainable improvements.
* Experience coordinating with engineering, architecture, and product teams to ensure operational readiness and safe deployment of changes.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational artefacts such as runbooks, support procedures, and readiness assessments.
* Familiarity with operational KPIs, risk indicators, monitoring dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Experience operating in Agile and/or DevOps environments supporting continuous delivery and operational stability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Operational oversight and ITSM governance for ServiceNow platforms – Provides senior oversight of day-to-day ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools operations run by third parties, ensuring processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely so platforms remain stable, compliant, reliable, and within agreed service levels and security expectations.
* Service readiness, runbook quality, and major incident management – Skilled at defining and enforcing standards for knowledge, runbooks, escalation paths, and support tasks, leading major incident response and ensuring safe deployments and service continuity.
* Performance monitoring, RCA, and continuous improvement – Strong capability in owning operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting, diagnosing recurring issues, leading root cause analysis, and driving sustainable remediation and trend reduction.
* Cross-functional coordination for operational readiness and change – Proven ability to work with Platform Owners, architects, engineering squads, service teams, and third-party providers to ensure integrations, upgrades, and releases meet operational readiness standards.
* Vendor and MSP relationship management for high-quality operations – Experienced in managing third-party vendors and managed service providers, ensuring contractual obligations, support quality, and operational performance expectations are met.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
* Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.

Capacity Planning, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, IT Service Management (ITSM), Network Configurations, Network Troubleshooting, Operations Analysis, Performance Tuning, Platform Operations, Service Level Agreement (SLA), Services Management, System Administration, System Monitors, Technical Delivery, Vulnerability Management

title: Senior Principal - Service Owner – Network
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Service Owner is a service delivery and operations leadership role accountable for defining, monitoring and governing the operational service standards, service management practices and quality expectations for GSK's network and connectivity services. The role sets what good looks like for availability, supportability, incident, problem, change, knowledge, service reporting, operational readiness and continuous improvement across the teams and partners delivering the service. The post holder governs service performance through clear standards, metrics, controls, guardrails and evidence-based assurance, with particular focus on reliability, resilience, security, compliance, automation and responsible AI-enabled operational productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Set and govern service delivery and operations standards**

* Define, maintain and govern service delivery and operations practices, including incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, service introduction, operational readiness and service reporting standards for the assigned platform or capability area.
* Ensure standards align to GSK’s Technology operating model, enterprise architecture, cyber security, data privacy, quality and compliance expectations, including GxP where relevant.
* Create practical governance artefacts, runbooks, service acceptance criteria, operational health measures and evidence requirements that can be adopted by internal teams and suppliers without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

**Assure operational performance across the service's delivery ecosystem**

* Monitor service levels, operational performance, incident trends, problem backlog, change quality, service risk, customer experience and supplier adherence to agreed standards using clear metrics, evidence and exception-based governance.
* Work across platform operations, service management, reliability engineering, architecture, security, delivery teams and supplier organisations to identify service gaps, resolve recurring operational issues and drive continuous improvement.
* Challenge poor quality, weak controls or inconsistent ways of working while avoiding duplication of commercial supplier management accountability.

**Drive service automation and operational productivity**

* Promote automation-first service operations, including reduction of manual toil, improved ticket handling, knowledge quality, self-service adoption, operational observability and measurable efficiency improvement.
* Partner with the Automation Acceleration team or equivalent capability to identify, prioritise and safely scale service operations automation and AI-enabled productivity opportunities within agreed governance guardrails.
* Ensure AI-enabled operational tooling and automation are used responsibly, with appropriate security, compliance, human review, auditability, service impact assessment and change control before operational use.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology Management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience in enterprise technology service leadership.
* Relevant professional certifications or equivalent knowledge in ITIL, agile delivery, service management, platform operations, cyber security, cloud, infrastructure, reliability engineering, quality or compliance are desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Knowledge of enterprise Technology platforms or capability areas such as cloud, networks, digital workplace, security, service management, automation, observability, voice, mobility or enterprise tooling.
* Understanding of platform operating models, ITIL-aligned service management, platform operations, operational governance, supplier assurance, automation and AI-enabled operational productivity in a regulated enterprise environment.

**Related Experience Required**

* 15 Years overall and significant experience in technology service ownership, service delivery management, platform operations, service governance or operational assurance within a complex global organisation.
* Experience governing partner and supplier delivery against standards, controls and measurable service outcomes.
* Experience defining or improving incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, service introduction, operational readiness, service reporting, service review or continuous improvement practices.
* Experience using service performance data, SLA and KPI reporting, incident and problem trends, service risk indicators, audit findings, customer feedback and supplier performance information to drive improvement actions.
* Experience supporting automation, self-service, AI-enabled productivity or modern engineering practices in a governed enterprise environment.
* Significant experience owning or governing enterprise network service delivery and operations.
* Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, service level and supplier performance management.
* Evidence of improving service availability, customer experience, operational resilience or recurring incident performance.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to define clear service standards, operational governance artefacts, runbooks, service acceptance criteria, service health measures and evidence expectations that can be consistently applied across internal and external delivery teams.
* Strong judgement in balancing control, compliance, resilience, pace and agility in a regulated global technology environment.
* Strong documentation, policy-writing, process-design and knowledge management capability.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret service performance data, SLA and KPI trends, incident and problem patterns, automation opportunities, risk indicators and governance measures.
* Practical AI fluency, including the ability to identify appropriate productivity and automation use cases, apply human review and ensure responsible adoption within security, compliance and change guardrails.

**Preferred Skills**

* Network service ownership and operational governance: standards for incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, service introduction and readiness
* Enterprise network service delivery: significant experience owning or governing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN/SASE, data-centre and cloud connectivity services
* Network technology literacy: routing/switching, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, segmentation/NAC and security, enough to challenge engineering and supplier RCAs
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional / SIAM and carrier and managed-service assurance against SLAs/KPIs using exception-based governance
* Service performance analytics: availability, customer experience, repeat-incident reduction and resilience trends from monitoring/telemetry evidence
* Automation-first operations and responsible AI: toil reduction, self-service and AI-enabled productivity within security, compliance and change guardrails
* Influence and major incident leadership in regulated, manufacturing and OT environments: holding teams and partners to standard without sole reliance on line authority

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Capacity Planning, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Disaster Recovery (DR), Enterprise Network, Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, Network Configurations, Network Services, Network Technologies, Network Troubleshooting, Operations Analysis, Performance Tuning, Service Integration and Management (SIAM), Service Level Agreement (SLA), Service Performance Management, System Monitors, Vulnerability Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV to

***About the Role***

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager – Electrical (Projects) to oversee electrical project planning, technical coordination, and execution monitoring for large-scale, utility-scale solar power plants from our Head Office in Hyderabad.

The role involves coordinating with project managers and site teams, reviewing technical requirements, monitoring project progress, resolving electrical and execution-related challenges, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

The ideal candidate should have strong electrical engineering knowledge, hands-on experience in utility-scale solar projects, and the ability to manage multiple projects through effective coordination, technical guidance, and performance monitoring.

***Key Responsibilities***

**1. Project Planning and Monitoring**

* Oversee electrical project activities across multiple utility-scale solar projects from the Head Office.
* Monitor project schedules, milestones, resource requirements, and overall execution progress.
* Review regular progress reports from site teams, identify delays and risks, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Ensure project activities are aligned with approved plans, specifications, and delivery timelines.

**2. Electrical Engineering and Technical Coordination**

* Review electrical drawings, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), technical specifications, and project engineering documents.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams on electrical design, equipment selection, installation, and execution-related issues.
* Coordinate with engineering teams, consultants, and vendors to resolve technical queries and ensure compliance with project requirements.

**3. Solar Project Execution Oversight**

* Monitor electrical works for utility-scale, ground-mounted solar power plants, including DC/AC cabling, HT/LT systems, transformers, switchgear, substations, and grid evacuation infrastructure.
* Coordinate with site teams to address technical challenges and ensure electrical works are progressing as planned.
* Review the status of installation, testing, commissioning, and project handover activities.
* Support project teams in resolving critical issues affecting execution and commissioning.

**4. Coordination with Site Teams and Internal Departments**

* Act as a key coordination point between the Head Office and project sites for electrical project activities.
* Work closely with project managers, site engineers, procurement, contracts, and commercial teams to ensure smooth execution.
* Follow up on material requirements, technical approvals, vendor deliverables, and other project dependencies.
* Guide site teams on technical matters, execution priorities, and resolution of project-related issues.

**5. Procurement and Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with procurement teams for timely sourcing and delivery of electrical equipment and materials.
* Review technical specifications and support the evaluation of electrical equipment, vendors, and contractors.
* Monitor material availability and delivery schedules to avoid delays in project execution.
* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and contractors to resolve technical and supply-related issues.

**6. Project Cost, Quality and Safety**

* Monitor project budgets, electrical package costs, contractor progress, and variations in scope.
* Review project performance and highlight cost overruns, delays, and other execution risks.
* Ensure electrical works comply with approved specifications, applicable standards, and company quality and safety requirements.
* Coordinate with site teams to address quality observations, inspection findings, and electrical safety concerns.

**7. Testing, Commissioning and Grid Connectivity**

* Monitor testing and commissioning progress for electrical equipment and systems across project sites.
* Coordinate with site teams, OEMs, consultants, and utilities for inspections, energization, and grid synchronization.
* Review commissioning reports, test records, and pending technical issues to support timely project completion.
* Ensure proper documentation and coordination for project handover.

**8. Reporting and Stakeholder Management**

* Review and consolidate project updates covering progress, material status, technical issues, costs, risks, and commissioning milestones.
* Conduct regular review meetings with project teams and follow up on pending action items.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders on project-related technical matters.

***Required Qualifications and Experience***

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering is mandatory.
* 13+ years of overall experience in electrical projects, with substantial experience in the solar power sector.
* Strong experience in utility-scale, ground-mounted solar power projects is mandatory.
* Experience overseeing electrical project execution, technical coordination, and project monitoring.
* Good understanding of HT/LT systems, transformers, substations, electrical protection systems, and grid evacuation infrastructure.
* Experience in electrical testing, commissioning, and grid synchronization of solar power plants.
* Experience handling projects of 50 MW or above is preferred.
* Prior experience managing multiple projects or coordinating with teams across different project sites is preferred.
* Strong project planning, problem-solving, communication, reporting, and team management skills.

***What We’re Looking For***

A technically strong Electrical professional with substantial experience in utility-scale solar projects, capable of overseeing project activities from the Head Office, providing technical direction to site teams, coordinating with multiple departments, and ensuring timely project delivery.

The candidate should be comfortable reviewing technical and project progress, identifying risks, resolving execution challenges, and taking ownership of project performance across multiple sites.

***Work Location*
:**
Head Office, Hyderabad, Telangana. Travel to project sites may be required as needed.

title: Deputy Director -Service Modernization Lead
description:

title: Associate Director – Legacy EDC

Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. title: Fincrime Quality Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a FinCrime Quality Team Lead to join our growing team.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The main purpose of the Quality Control (QC) Team Lead role is to manage the performance of the QC team on an individual and team level, provide leadership, guidance, and direction to the quality assurance team to ensure the delivery of the right amount of QC reviews at the right time.
  
  
The QC Team Lead is responsible for managing performance and overseeing the activities of the quality assurance team. This includes task assignment, workload management, and ensuring that team members are aligned with priorities and objectives, while also actively promoting a positive and motivating work environment.
  
  
The QC Team Lead guarantees collaboration and opportunities to improve their stakeholders' (their assigned Service Operations area) state and scalability.
  
  
Activities performed on the job
  
  
Manages the quality assurance team on an individual and team level
  
  

* Performance management

+ Ensure timely delivery of QC reviews and keeps central task assignment documents up-to-date.
+ Completes demand vs capacity calculation for the QC team and assigned area.
+ Monitor and track the performance of QC specialists to ensure they meet or exceed set KPIs; identify and address performance issues or areas needing improvement through performance evaluations, feedback from stakeholders, or quality metrics analysis. Responsible for performance evaluation and recognition, assessing team performance, providing feedback, and recognizing achievements. Conducting regular performance reviews, setting and documenting development goals, and acknowledging outstanding contributions
+ Use mentoring, coaching and delegation in their team to create best practices for managing performance and for development opportunities.
+ Deliver monthly reports on team performance and KPIs.
+ Provides training and development opportunities for team members. This could include designing and delivering training programs, mentoring junior staff, and facilitating knowledge sharing sessions to enhance team capabilities.

* People management

+ Implements a monitoring system (talent map check ins) to identify team talents and provide support and development opportunities to those in need.
+ Talent map check-ins are completed twice a year by QC Lead
+ Propose decisions for direct reports like salary raise, promotion, leave approval, etc.
+ Hire, lead, develop and manage their quality team, including amongst others administrative tasks such as scheduling, interviewing, hiring, organising team activities, conducting the GrowWises’ etc
+ QC Lead is responsible for holding coaching sessions and 1:1s with their direct reports generally once every two weeks.
+ QC Lead is responsible for holding team meeting on a biweekly / monthly basis.
+ QC Lead is responsible for facilitating the sharing of information, skills, and best practices among team members to enhance collective learning and improve overall performance. QC Lead promotes a culture of knowledge sharing where team members feel encouraged and motivated to share their knowledge and expertise with one another.
+ QC Lead is responsible for pairing experienced team members with junior or less experienced colleagues to facilitate knowledge exchange.
+ QC Lead is responsible for regular team building activities to drive engagement in the team.
+ QC Lead is responsible for action planning based on Wiser Pulse results.

* Executing on strategy

QC Lead is responsible for aligning team objectives with broader organisational goals, ensuring the team is clear on the strategy and understands how their work supports it.
  
  
QC Lead is responsible for developing strategies to achieve targets and creating accessible documentation for these strategies.
  
  

* Quality reporting

+ Generating regular and timely reports on quality results, performance metrics, and key findings. The QC Team Lead communicates quality-related information to management and operational counterparts to facilitate decision-making and improve transparency.
+ Presents and delivers actionable insights and makes sure improvements are owned and followed up based on the stakeholder management framework.
+ Engage stakeholders to take necessary actions based on report findings and influence results positively.

* Change management

+ Effectively manages and communicates changes within their team (and to external stakeholders if needed) to ensure successful outcomes.
+ Ensures understanding so their team understands the nature and implications of any changes introduced. This involves providing clear explanations, answering questions, and addressing concerns to facilitate comprehension.
+ Facilitates adaptation and guides your team through changes, provides support, training, and resources as needed to facilitate a smooth transition.
+ Monitors progress and impact on their team's workflows and objectives. This involves gathering feedback, identifying challenges, and making adjustments as necessary to ensure successful integration.

* Manages stakeholder relationships

+ QC Lead is responsible for clear communication with stakeholders.
+ QC Lead is responsible for engaging with the stakeholders on weekly or monthly meetings to share key findings and insights from QC Reporting.
+ Conduct meetings with stakeholders according to a clear cadence, ensuring agendas are set, and notes are taken.
+ QC Lead is responsible for actionable insights to be formed on the stakeholder meetings and to find owners for the agreed actions and follow up and monitor and report impact.
+ Serving as the primary point of contact for communication between the quality assurance team and other stakeholders, including project managers, developers, and customers.
+ QC Lead is responsible for collecting stakeholder feedback and acting on shared improvement areas and stakeholder needs.
+ QC Lead takes part in assigned area’s tribe or regional planning where needed to ensure that QC Lead understands the plans / goals / strategy of their stakeholders and make sure that their actions support these objectives.
+ Proactively informs stakeholders of any changes and responds to queries within a reasonable timeframe.

* Operational efficiency

+ QC Lead is responsible for implementing continuous improvement initiatives within their quality assurance team / sharing ideas with peers and management.
+ QC Lead is responsible for their team’s use of tools and technology. This could include providing training on existing tools, and leveraging technology to streamline processes and improve efficiency.

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You’re experienced — with at least 1 year in a FinCrime, Quality Control or Quality Assurance role.
* You’re knowledgeable — you understand procedures and processes, stay up-to-date, and understand Wise's products, tools, and policies.
* You proactively solve problems — identifying and addressing issues to implement improvements that benefit customers and the team.
* You’re customer-centric — always prioritising customer satisfaction and advocating for their needs within the organisation.
* You embrace adaptability — readily accepting change and quickly integrating new processes while maintaining quality.
* You’re a team player — sharing knowledge and resources to ensure team success and actively engaging in discussions.
* You’re a strong communicator — tailoring your communication to suit diverse audiences with clarity and respect.
* You make data-driven decisions — leveraging data to inform your actions and enhance your impact.
* You take ownership — fully committing to your tasks and consistently striving to meet or exceed KPIs.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: VMO Director
description:
**Role Overview**
Astreya, a Cognizant company, delivers world-class enterprise workplace technology and Audio-Visual (AV) integration services to premier global clients as a prime contractor. While Audio-Visual integration represents our primary active scope, including hardware sourcing, warehousing, 3PL logistics, systems integration, and field installation, our delivery model relies on specialized regional delivery partners and subcontractors across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Astreya remains fully accountable to our enterprise clients for end-to-end service levels and operational quality across all partner-executed field work.
  
  
As Director of the Vendor Management Office (VMO), you will build, scale, and lead our global subcontractor and vendor governance organization from the ground up. In this role, you will establish the strategic VMO charter, back-to-back Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), vendor scorecards, commercial controls, penalty flushback mechanisms, automated tooling, and regional team structures. You will hold external AV integration and workplace technology partners strictly accountable to client SLAs, ensure commercial and financial alignment, and represent partner performance to executive client leadership.
  
  
While your immediate focus will center on scaling governance across our live AV integration contracts, as our global business grows you will expand the VMO framework to cover a broader vendor ecosystem. This expanded scope will encompass service desk operators, freight forwarders, SaaS providers, security vendors, and labor agencies across enterprise client accounts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Leadership: Build the Global VMO & Set Partner Direction
* Design and execute the global VMO operating model, vendor tiering strategy, governance cadences, and decision-rights matrix in alignment with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Delivery, and PMO leadership.
* Serve as the executive face of the VMO, representing subcontractor delivery performance in client QBRs/MBRs and serving as the primary accountable leader for partner-delivered AV and workplace services.
* Define and optimize the AV partner ecosystem strategy across VARs, OEMs, 3PL logistics, and integration subcontractors, determining portfolio density, challenger routes, regional expansion, insourcing, or offboarding.
* Establish commercial governance standards, structure back-to-back partner OLAs mirroring client SLAs, enforce service-credit penalty flushback, and govern rate-card, change-order, and gainshare models.
* Implement a comprehensive third-party risk management (TPRM) framework covering financial stability, info security, EHS, business continuity, and site compliance aligned with client audit requirements.
* Build scalable VMO playbooks, standard operating procedures, and automated tooling to enable seamless expansion across new service lines and enterprise accounts.
* Recruit, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of vendor management professionals, driving capability development and organizational succession planning.
* Tactical Governance: Subcontractor Control & Commercial Accountability
* Chair executive governance forums with Tier-1 AV integrators and technology partners, managing C-suite escalations and resolving contractual or operational disputes with objective data.
* Approve formal Service Improvement Plans (SIPs) for vendor performance breaches, determining when to execute step-in rights, re-scope deliverables, or terminate underperforming partners.
* Authorize major root-cause attribution and chargeback decisions, enforcing financial penalty recovery and credit settlements with vendor executives.
* Govern the mobilization and ramp-up of new integration partners across global regions, enforcing strict readiness gate reviews prior to operational launch.
* Partner with Procurement and Legal to lead contract renewals, re-scoping, and vendor selection based on rigorous performance scorecards and financial analytics.
* Own the VMO operating budget, delivering quarterly executive ROI reporting that quantifies financial value, recovered service credits, cost avoidance, and partner efficiency gains.
* Operational Oversight: Build-Phase Execution & Systems Integration
* Directly establish initial VMO operational assets during the standing-up phase, including partner contract inventories, gap logs, OLA registers, tiering frameworks, and quality scorecards.
* Audit weekly partner performance dashboards and monthly pay-versus-charge financial reconciliations, addressing operational exceptions immediately.
* Personally resolve critical partner escalations, conducting executive site visits to partner headquarters and key enterprise client locations.
* Sponsor the architecture and deployment of VMO platforms (Vendor Risk & Performance, ERP integration, BI dashboards), driving AI-assisted automation for photo-based quality checks and invoice audits.
* Ensure rigorous quality control over technical evidence packages, ticket records, and operational handoffs across internal delivery queues and vendor teams.

FIRST 12 MONTHS ROADMAP
  
  
Strategic milestone roadmap for the first year in role. Each phase concludes with a formal executive leadership review gate.
  
  

* Assess & Design (Days 0–45): Establish partner spend baselines, map contract gaps against client SLAs, finalize VMO charter, RACI, and tiering models, and initiate hiring for core VMO team leadership. Target Gate: Signed VMO Charter and RACI.
* Stand Up (Days 46–90): Execute back-to-back OLAs with all Tier-1 AV partners, launch weekly scorecard reporting, and activate credit recovery, TPRM compliance, and onboarding protocols. Target Gate: Operational Tier-1 OLAs and Scorecards Live.
* Run & Enforce (Months 4–6): Conduct initial partner QBRs, execute penalty recovery on evidence, implement monthly pay-versus-charge financial reconciliations, complete global team hiring, and define VMO tooling requirements. Target Gate: Team Onboarded and First VMO Value Report Delivered.
* Optimize & Extend (Months 7–12): Execute annual partner ecosystem strategy including renewals and exits, benchmark rate cards, deploy automated tooling, and expand VMO playbooks across additional service lines such as service desk operators, SaaS, and freight forwarders. Target Gate: Annual Partner Strategy Approved.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
**Key Performance Metrics Associated With The Role**

* VMO Governance Charter: Charter, RACI, and decision-rights matrix approved by executive stakeholders within 45 days.
* OLA Back-to-Back Coverage: 100% of Tier-1 AV integration and field service partners executed on OLAs mapped to client SLAs within 90 days.
* Partner Scorecard Execution: 100% of active delivery partners evaluated via weekly and monthly scorecards starting from Day 90.
* Governance Discipline: 100% of operational reviews, MBRs, and QBRs conducted on schedule with published action logs.
* Client SLA Attainment: Partner-delivered AV and technology scopes perform at or above contract target thresholds monthly.
* Penalty Flushback Recovery: 100% of vendor-attributable SLA penalties evidenced and recovered via contractual OLA credit mechanisms.
* Commercial Accuracy (Pay vs. Charge): 100% of Tier-1 partner invoices reconciled monthly against rate cards, approved change orders, and client billings.
* Partner Risk Compliance: 100% of active partners fully compliant with insurance, H&S, security, and compliance requirements.
* Contract Renewal Readiness: Comprehensive performance and spend analytics packs completed 90 days prior to contract notice windows.
* Team & Organization: Full VMO team onboarded by Month 6, with documented cross-coverage for all Tier-1 partner accounts.
* VMO Value Realization: Quarterly value delivery reporting demonstrating net financial ROI, cost avoidance, and credit recovery starting from Month 6.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* Ticketing & Evidence: enterprise ticketing (ITSM) incident, request and change records, used as the evidence trail for SLA, OLA and attribution work
* Contract & Commercial: contract repository and rate-card registers, change-request log and service-credit schedules
* Governance: partner scorecards, risk register, action and remediation trackers, QBR and MBR pack templates
* Finance Data: ERP purchase-order, goods-receipt and invoice data for pay-versus-charge reconciliation
* VMO Platforms: ServiceNow vendor risk and performance modules or equivalent, and contract lifecycle or vendor management tools, selected as part of the build
* Reporting & Automation: BI dashboards, automated scorecards, and AI-assisted evidence and invoice checks

**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 12–15+ years of progressive leadership experience in vendor management, subcontractor governance, commercial management, or delivery governance within IT services, managed services, Audio-Visual (AV) integration, 3PL logistics, or technology infrastructure.
* Proven track record building a Vendor Management Office (VMO), supplier governance function, or subcontractor control organization from scratch or leading a complete organizational transformation.
* Extensive experience governing subcontracted partner delivery under prime contractor structures, including back-to-back OLAs, SLA alignment, penalty recovery, and root-cause attribution.
* Deep commercial acumen across rate cards, change control, open-book pricing, gainshare/earn-back models, and gross margin optimization on partner-delivered scope in close partnership with Finance.
* Commanding executive presence, with a history of presenting partner performance in C-level client QBRs and negotiating effectively with senior partner executives.
* Experience managing multi-regional partner ecosystems (AMER, EMEA, APAC) and directly leading global, multi-tier teams across international locations.
* Strong analytical capability: designing KPI scorecards, extracting actionable insights from ticket/ERP data, and sponsoring workflow automation.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Technology, or equivalent experience; full professional English fluency; willingness to travel globally up to 30%.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience or established networks across AV integration
* Workplace technology, 3PL logistics, or specialized field services.
* Industry certifications: SIAM Professional, ITIL 4, World Commerce & Contracting (CCMP/IACCM), CIPS, or CPSM.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as MS Dynamics, ServiceNow, SAP, Coupa, and BI dashboards.
* Third-party risk management, and supplier ESG and code-of-conduct programmes.
* Experience in a services company integrating into a larger parent after an acquisition.

SCOPE & SPAN OF CONTROL
  
  
Key parameters framing the scope and span of the role:
  
  

* Team Leadership: 5 FTE global team (1x Manager VMO, 1x Vendor Relationship Lead IV, 2x Vendor Management Analysts II, 1x VMO Intake & Compliance Analyst I).
* Partner Portfolio: Initial focus on ~8-10 strategic AV delivery partners, expanding over time to include service desk operators, freight forwarders, SaaS providers, security vendors, and labor agencies globally.
* Geographic Scope: Global oversight across Americas, EMEA, and APAC delivery regions.
* Decision Rights: Approves partner tiering, OLA frameworks, scorecard methodologies, and chargebacks above threshold; recommends renewals, re-scoping, or exits; owns VMO budget.
* Key Stakeholders: Program leadership, Delivery and PMO, Procurement, Legal, Finance and Information Security; client service owners; partner executives; Cognizant procurement and supply chain teams.
* Work Mix: Year 1: 40% strategic, 35% tactical, 25% operational. From Year 2: 60% strategic, 30% tactical, 10% operational.
* Governance Boundaries: Procurement and Legal own sourcing events, contract drafting and signature. Delivery owns day-to-day service. The VMO owns post-contract governance: performance, commercial compliance, credit recovery, partner risk, and the requirements that go into each agreement.

description:

Digital Marketing Associate (Website/Digital Experience)

We are is seeking a hands-on Digital Marketing Associate to accelerate ongoing work on our clients website. We’re looking for a detail-oriented, curious generalist who can get things done, spot opportunities, and keep learning.

**Core Responsibilities:**

*Website Publishing, Maintenance and Troubleshooting*

·       Publish and update pages, reports, blogs, event pages, and campaign landing pages in WordPress and Elementor

·       Check forms, links, downloads, and gated content so clients and visitors can access the right resources.

·       Improve page layouts, navigation, and mobile usability in line with brand guidelines.

·       Investigate routine website issues and test changes on staging before they go live.

·       Document fixes and work with developers or IT on complex technical issues.

*Reporting and Analytics*

·       Use GA4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager to monitor traffic, downloads, and form submissions.

·       Help with campaign updates, tracking checks, and practical ideas to improve website engagement and conversions.

*SEO and AI Search*
