title: Head of Product - Fintech Domain
description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap:
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end: turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators:
* Spend time every week with credit, risk, legal and operations teams at banks, NBFCs and HFCs. Know their workflows better than they do.
* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on:
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage: document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales:
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.
* Run a tight loop on win/loss reasons, usage data and customer feedback, and use it to grow usage and revenue within existing accounts.
* Own pricing and monetization:
* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team:
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.
* Experience selling into or building for regulated enterprises, ideally banks, NBFCs or insurers, with long sales cycles and compliance reviews.
* First-principles thinking: you can break an ambiguous problem into bets, and show the data behind your calls.
* High agency and low ego. You do whatever part of the PM job the week demands.
* AI-native in how you work and what you build. You have shipped products where ML or LLM output quality was the product.
* Experience with data products where coverage, freshness and accuracy are the core metrics.
* Comfort with pricing and packaging for enterprise and usage-based API models.
* A track record of hiring and growing strong Experience taking a B2B data asset into a consumer or partner-led product.
* Background in lending, mortgage, credit risk, collateral or fintech infrastructure.
* You have been a founder or an early leader at a company through Series A to C.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Impact: property is India's largest asset class and its least liquid. Your work decides how fast credit reaches homeowners, small businesses and farmers.
* A real moat to build on: a property dataset and identity layer that took years to assemble, with live banking customers already using it.
* Ownership: a leadership seat, direct access to founders, board and customers, and meaningful equity.
* Compensation and benefits: Competitive salary, ESOPs, health cover, leave policy and other benefits.

title: Co-founder with investment

Operating in India’s highly fragmented fitness economy, Fytrack sits at the intersection of local supply, employee demand, corporate wellness budgets, and data intelligence. title: AVP – FLDG & Strategic Lending Partnerships
description:
**We're Hiring: AVP – FLDG & Strategic Lending Partnerships**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**

10–15 years

₹18–24 LPA + performance-linked incentives

Founder & CEO

**About the Role**

KGIL Fintech Solutions is looking for an experienced lending professional to establish and lead our First Loss Default Guarantee (FLDG/DLG) business vertical.

The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding lending partners, structuring commercially viable FLDG arrangements, managing portfolio performance, building operational processes and scaling the business independently.

We are looking for someone with strong relationships across banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and lending institutions, combined with practical experience in credit risk, lending operations and portfolio management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. FLDG Business Development**

* Establish and independently scale the FLDG business vertical.
* Identify banks and NBFCs interested in eligible DLG-supported lending arrangements.
* Develop new lending products and commercial opportunities.
* Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial structures.
* Build a sustainable and profitable lending portfolio.

**2. Strategic Lending Partnerships**

* Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across banks and NBFCs.
* Maintain relationships with existing lending institutions.
* Identify additional opportunities in digital lending, loan distribution and co-lending arrangements where applicable.

* Coordinate partner onboarding, underwriting criteria and credit policies.

* Work with regulated lending partners on approved DLG structures.
* Monitor portfolio performance, delinquency, defaults and guarantee utilisation.
* Coordinate reconciliation, claims, collections reporting and settlements with relevant teams.
* Develop operational SOPs and reporting dashboards.

**4. Risk & Portfolio Management**

* Analyse portfolio-level credit risk and profitability.
* Track delinquency buckets, vintage performance and loss trends.
* Recommend appropriate risk controls and portfolio eligibility criteria.
* Coordinate with lending partners' credit and risk teams.
* Ensure the business operates within approved risk limits.

* Recruit and lead a dedicated FLDG business team.
* Build capabilities in alliances, lending operations and portfolio MIS.
* Establish department-level targets and reporting systems.
* Work with internal Technology, Product, Finance and Compliance teams.

* Ensure FLDG arrangements comply with applicable RBI digital lending requirements.
* Coordinate agreement execution with Legal and Compliance.
* Maintain complete portfolio records, lender reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure clear accountability for guarantees, commercial obligations and portfolio performance.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10–15 years of experience in NBFCs, banks, fintech or digital lending.
* Direct experience managing FLDG/DLG arrangements or credit-risk-sharing programmes.
* Strong existing relationships with banks and NBFCs.
* Knowledge of unsecured personal loans, business loans and digital lending.
* Understanding of credit underwriting, portfolio risk, collections and lending operations.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial lending partnerships.
* Ability to independently establish and manage a business vertical.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates currently working as AVP, VP, Business Head, Lending Partnerships Head, FLDG Head or Credit Partnerships Head in an NBFC, bank, fintech or lending platform.

**Our expectation:**
An entrepreneurial business leader who can establish a new lending vertical, generate sustainable revenue, manage risk and build a strong team from the ground up.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI-first world. Today, we are known in the industry for our deep education expertise in domains such as eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product, Analytics, and AI.

As a Talent Acquisition, you will play a critical role in building the teams that power our growth and learner success. This is a high-impact, execution-focused role that goes beyond traditional recruitment. You will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent across business functions while helping create scalable hiring processes and a strong employer brand.

You will work closely with Hiring Managers, Business Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand talent requirements, drive hiring outcomes, and ensure a seamless candidate experience from sourcing through onboarding. The ideal candidate is highly organized, data driven, target-oriented, and passionate about building high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition & Recruitment

• Own and drive the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle across multiple functions and levels.

• Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structures, hiring priorities, and workforce plans.

• Source high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, networking, campus partnerships, and other talent channels.

• Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

• Conduct initial candidate screening and assessment to evaluate skills, experience, motivation, and cultural alignment.

• Ensure timely movement of candidates through the recruitment funnel while maintaining a positive candidate experience.

• Drive closure of open positions within defined timelines and hiring targets.

Stakeholder Management & Candidate Experience

• Act as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers and business leaders.

• Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding hiring progress, challenges, and market insights.

• Coordinate interviews and assessments while ensuring a smooth and professional experience for candidates.

• Build strong relationships with prospective candidates and effectively communicate Digiaccel and Altera’s vision, culture, and opportunities.

• Serve as a brand ambassador throughout the hiring journey.

Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence

• Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, hiring dashboards, candidate records, and reporting systems.

• Ensure high levels of accuracy and efficiency in recruitment documentation and process management.

• Support offer management, documentation, onboarding coordination, and pre-joining engagement activities.

• Leverage data and hiring metrics to improve recruitment effectiveness and decision-making.

• Identify bottlenecks in the hiring process and proactively recommend improvements.

Employer Branding & Talent Pipeline Development

• Contribute to employer branding initiatives aimed at attracting high-quality talent.

• Build relationships with colleges, institutes, professional communities, and talent networks.

• Support campus hiring, internship programs, and strategic talent acquisition initiatives.

• Stay updated on talent market trends, hiring best practices, and competitor hiring activity.

Collaboration & Organizational Support

• Work closely with HR, Business, Operations, Marketing, and Leadership teams to support organizational growth.

• Assist in HR operations related to onboarding, employee documentation, and people processes whenever required.

• Support special projects focused on workforce planning, talent mapping, and organizational development.

• Contribute towards building scalable recruitment systems and best practices.

Performance & Outcome Ownership

• Take ownership of individual hiring targets and recruitment KPIs.

• Demonstrate a strong bias for action, urgency, and execution excellence.

• Continuously improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.

• Maintain a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail in all recruitment activities.

What We're Looking For

• 0-1+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or HR.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment processes and candidate lifecycle management.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and networking channels.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and recruitment tracking/reporting.

• Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze hiring metrics and generate insights.

• Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving abilities.

• Passion for people, hiring, and building high-performing teams.

Good to Have

• Experience hiring for education, EdTech, consulting, marketing, sales, product, or technology roles.

• Exposure to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment automation tools.

• Experience with campus hiring, internship hiring, or employer branding initiatives.

• Understanding of end-to-end recruitment process and familiarity with sourcing tools.

Why Join Us?

• Make a Meaningful Impact - Play a critical role in building the teams that are redefining business education and helping professionals build future-ready careers in the digital economy.

• High-Growth Learning Environment - Work with a fast-scaling education company where ownership, innovation, and excellence are valued and rewarded.

• Learner-Centric Culture - Join a team that places learner outcomes at the center of every decision and takes pride in delivering world-class educational experiences.

• Accelerated Career Growth - Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, structured development, and the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as the organization grows.

• Build the Future of Education - Contribute to a mission-driven organization that is transforming how business education is delivered and creating measurable impact for thousands of learners across the country.

About the Company

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment. We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

title: Performance Marketing
description:
**The Mission**
At TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest), we aren't just automating scripts — we're deprecating the era of manual-heavy testing. We're building the world's first AI-native platform where Agentic Intelligence autonomously plans, authors, and self-heals the entire Quality Engineering lifecycle. The name "TestMu" comes from our community conference — our users and team aren't an audience, they're the heartbeat of what we build. We believe AI augments human potential, not replaces it.
  
  
*As our Performance Marketer, you'll own the Google Ads engine that puts our agentic platform in front of engineering leaders, QA heads, and CTOs defining the next decade of testing. Google Ads as your primary lever. 70+ live campaigns as your canvas. Pipeline as your scoreboard.*
**The Pillars of Impact**
🚀
**Google Ads Execution & Scale**
**50%**

* Own Google Ads end-to-end across 70+ live campaigns — Brand, Competitor, Generic/Non-brand, Performance Max, AI Max, Search, Display, Video.
* Manage $25K+ in monthly spend with disciplined CPC strategy — competitor campaigns the highest, generic second, brand lowest, calibrated to funnel stage.
* Default to Phrase and Exact match types for new keyword builds; use Broad with intent, never by default, and keep auction waste out of the system.
* Diagnose spend volatility in real-time — know when CPM is lifting, when creative is fatigued, when the form itself is losing conversions.

⚙️
**Attribution, Analytics & Reporting**
**30%**

* Work fluently across attribution models — first touch, last touch, time decay, multi-touch — and know which model answers which question.
* Build and own daily, weekly, and monthly reports that connect spend to pipeline, not just clicks to leads.
* Use UTM parameters with discipline — campaign, source, medium, term, content — so every click is traceable to the campaign that earned it.
* Partner with GA4, Looker Studio, and Salesforce (or any CRM) to close the loop from ad spend to revenue influenced.

🧠
**Landing Pages, Creative & Optimisation**
**20%**

* Define landing page content and iterate on CTAs, copy, and layout — Hotjar, VWO, or similar — based on heatmaps and session data, not opinion.
* Brief and shape ad creative with intent; AI handles the first draft, you handle the judgement on what actually converts.
* Run continuous A/B tests across copy, creative, and landing flows — document what wins and what doesn't for the team's playbook.

**The Bar**
*Non-negotiables. Every signal must be a yes.*
**Google Ads — in-and-out knowledge.**
*Fluent across Brand, Competitor, Generic, P-Max, AI Max. Not basic Search vs Display. You've shipped campaigns, not just reported on them.*
**$25K+ monthly budget managed.**
*Firm baseline. $20K considered only when every other signal is strong. Below $20K, this isn't the seat.*
**Attribution and diagnostic fluency.**
*First touch, last touch, time decay, multi-touch — you know them, and know when to use which. UTM depth is second nature.*
**Extreme Ownership.**
*Execution-first now, full channel strategy ownership as it evolves. You don't wait for the playbook. You write it.*
**The Interview Loop**
*Three rounds. Sharp, honest, and respectful of your time.*
Round I
  
  

* Talent Screen

*30 min with the recruiting team — Google Ads fundamentals, campaign depth, baseline criteria check.*
Round II
  
  

* Hiring Manager

*45 min with Himanshu Gulati (Director, Demand Generation) — your campaigns, your numbers, your diagnostic thinking.*
Final
  
  

* Leadership Conversation

*30 min with our CMO — scope fit, long-term trajectory, mutual conviction.*

We launched in the United States in 2026 and now sell to independent retailers through Faire, and to consumers through Amazon and Wayfair, shipping from our own US warehouse.

We are looking for a US Growth Manager to own the growth of our US business. You will build our base of independent US stores, run our marketplaces, and take responsibility for the US revenue and profitability numbers. You will work directly with the founder, with a product, ecommerce and operations team behind you.

* Own US revenue and channel profitability, and report on both every week.

* Plan seasonal launches and promotions for the US calendar, including festive and holiday ranges.
* Prepare target lists and meetings for management's US store visits and trade shows, and follow up every lead.

**What you bring**

**Why join us**

* Full ownership of a young US business, with the founder as your direct partner.

* Room to grow as the US business grows.

title: Assurance-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager - CQV
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets.
  
  
The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  

* Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments.
* Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors.
* Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams.
* Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client.
* Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle.
* Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation.
* Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff.
* Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies.
* Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 15+ year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: ADN-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. We value curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement, and are committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

  

**About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. From there, you'll grow into progressively larger scope, working toward owning the full arc of discovery, delivery, and outcomes for your own product area.

To find out more visit www.lenovo.com and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Role summary**
----------------

The LDR turns APAC marketing-generated leads (MQLs) into BANT-qualified, sales-ready opportunities that Sales accepts and progresses. This is an inside Sales Rep.( ISR)-calibre role: the LDR holds credible business conversations with SME, mid-market and enterprise prospects, tests genuine intent, and does not push weak leads through to Sales.

The LDR owns each lead from first contact to a documented handover, then follows Sales' accept, reject or recycle decision and reports progress to the LDR Manager on a regular cadence.

Key responsibilities

**Qualify marketing leads**

* Research and prioritise assigned MQLs by company profile, contact role, product relevance and engagement signals.
* Contact prospects by phone, email and approved digital channels within the agreed speed-to-lead standard.
* Run consultative discovery on Budget, Authority, Need and Timeline, and discuss the prospect's business priorities, current environment and buying process in enough depth to judge real intent.
* Apply BANT with integrity: do not force-fit weak leads into sales-accepted status. Recycle or nurture them with a clear reason and next action.
* Handle common objections ("send me information", "no budget", incumbent vendor) and agree a concrete next step.

**Assign qualified leads to Sales**

* Hand over each qualified lead, meeting or demo to the right Sales owner with full evidence: BANT findings, stakeholder map, pain points, call notes and agreed next step.
* Confirm Sales acceptance, and chase leads that are not accepted within the agreed SLA.
* Follow Sales accept, reject and recycle feedback, and use it to improve qualification quality.

**Track and report progress**

* Keep CRM records current and accurate: disposition, notes, qualification evidence and next action on every lead.
* Monitor own pipeline daily: lead ageing, stalled leads, follow-up cadence and handover status.
* Report progress to the LDR Manager weekly (daily when asked): MQLs worked, contact and qualification rates, leads assigned, Sales outcomes, and blockers.
* Flag patterns to the LDR Manager and Marketing: lead-quality issues by campaign, market or source, and recurring rejection reasons.

**Nurture and collaborate**

* Nurture interested but not-yet-ready prospects and reactivate aged leads.
* Share market and customer feedback with APAC Marketing and Sales.
* Take part in team calibration, call reviews and coaching sessions.

**Qualifications and experience**
---------------------------------

**Required**

* 7 to 8 years in inside sales, telesales, lead development or lead qualification, with a record of holding discovery conversations with business decision makers.
* B2B experience selling to SME, mid-market or enterprise customers; technology, devices, SaaS, IT solutions or other consultative products preferred.
* Working knowledge of BANT or an equivalent qualification framework, and a track record of handing leads to a sales team.
* Fluent, professional English, spoken and written, with a clear and confident phone manner for English-speaking APAC markets.
* Hands-on CRM use and disciplined documentation.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Adobe Marketo, DOMO or similar CRM, marketing-automation and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical and reporting capability.

**Preferred**

* Experience working across multiple APAC markets and cultures.
* Understanding of marketing funnels (MQL, SQL, SQO) and lead-scoring concepts.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Skills, tools and success measures**
--------------------------------------

**Core skills and behaviours**

* Consultative questioning, active listening and concise summarisation.
* Business acumen: understands customer priorities well enough to test need, authority and timeline credibly with managers and executives.
* Qualification integrity and sound commercial judgement.
* Polite, confident objection handling and persistence in follow-up.
* Clear written communication and accurate CRM records.
* Ownership, coachability, collaboration and cultural awareness across APAC.

**Tools**

CRM (for example Microsoft Dynamics 365), marketing automation (Adobe Marketo), reporting (DOMO), email and Microsoft Office.

**Success measures**

Targets are set by the LDR Manager with APAC Marketing and Sales.

* Speed to first contact: how quickly MQLs are worked after they arrive.
* MQL-to-SQL conversion: leads that Sales accepts, not just activity.
* Sales acceptance rate: whether handovers are sales-ready.
* Qualification quality and CRM evidence: complete notes, dispositions and next actions, reported accurately and on time.

**Additional Locations**:

* India

* India

**Success Scenarios & Executive Recommendations**

* Present leadership with clear recommendations, assumptions, costs, benefits, risks, and trade-offs.

**Skills, Deployment & Global Team Design**

* Diagnose whether delivery gaps stem from insufficient headcount, missing capabilities, low productivity, or structural constraints.

* Recommend talent deployment across priorities based on required skills, experience, capacity, timing, and delivery risk.

* Evaluate time zones, collaboration patterns, location mix, and team size to strengthen global delivery.

* Promote fungible skills and talent mobility to respond quickly to changing priorities.

**Cross-Functional Alignment & Follow-Through**

* Facilitate objective planning and decision-making across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and People functions.

* Resolve competing assumptions and drive alignment on the actions required for priority work to succeed.

* Track resource and capability decisions to closure and confirm that they address the underlying delivery need.

* Provide the SLT with clear updates on capacity, capability, productivity, and execution risk.

**Core Capabilities**

**Planning & Analytics**

* Portfolio-to-capacity planning, workforce forecasting, utilization and financial analysis, scenario modeling, business cases, and cost-benefit trade-offs.

Delivery constraints and root causes are identified early, with an agreed mitigation plan, accountable owners, and escalation before critical milestones are missed.

**Resource Effectiveness**

Talent is redeployed, developed, or augmented in time to address high-priority gaps, persistent underutilization, and capability shortfalls while protecting critical delivery commitments.

**Decision Quality & Speed**

The SLT receives timely, decision-ready options with clear assumptions, costs, benefits, risks, trade-offs, and a recommended course of action.

Approved resource and capability decisions are executed, tracked to closure, and evaluated against the intended delivery, cost, and capability outcomes.

description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

  Full Time Permanent co-worker
* Department

  Interior Design & Visual Merchandising

  2026-11-29

  Domestic

  

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are pleased to announce the launch of our physical Customer Meeting Point (CMP) in Bangalore — a Small Store L located in East Bangalore, one of the high-potential clusters of the city.
  
  
This new store marks an important milestone in our journey to strengthen market presence, while continuing to provide an omnichannel, customer-centric experience aligned with our long-term vision for the region.
  
  
Small stores are designed to offer a complete IKEA experience in a more compact format to make us even more accessible to our customers in our markets.
  
  
We are looking to hire a Communication & Interior Design Manager who will lead and inspire the store Com&In team to use knowledge of IKEA home furnishing and people's life at home to grow the business.
  
  
As a person you are passionate about people, business, IKEA’s purpose and continuously driving better performance.
  
You are energized by increasing customer value, driving business growth and contributing to overall success and results through people as well as motivated by leading and developing people.
  
  
You can lead, motivate and inspire a team in reaching goals, generating growth and long-term profitability. You have experience in setting and implementing action plans and budgets. You have a design-based education and experience in working in a design-oriented role.
  
  
You should have knowledge in home furnishing the IKEA way (living situations, style groups, store communication, furnish with light). Range presentation the IKEA way (layout as a commercial tool, store media, display techniques).
  
  
You should understand life at home in the local market and the outcome of market research, e.g. IKEA Customer Satisfaction Survey, IKEA Brand Capital. You should have the understand trends that influence home furnishing. Understand the IKEA Concept and IKEA Brand objectives. You should be aware of IKEA mechanical sales system, IKEA strategic landscape, global tools and solutions, understand how to lead creative processes and understand how to build business competence through recruitment, competence development, retention and succession.
  
  
You also can combine and identify commercial, aesthetic and practical skills and to create a trustful and creative environment. Good analytical and strategic skills, including the ability to steer the store business over the short-, mid- and long term will be preffered.

Key responsibilities (title) Your responsibilities

Key responsibilities (text) •To lead, develop and inspire the Com&In team and other functions in the store in increasing the home furnishing interest of the many people and creating demand for home furnishing solutions and know how in the local market.
  
  

* Accountable for the store layout, range presentation and store communication thereby contributing to positioning the IKEA Brand as the leader in life at home.

  

* Contributing to positioning the IKEA store as the first choice for home furnishing in your local market by using the IKEA product range to show many relevant, functional, beautiful, sustainable and affordable solutions in different distinct styles.

  

* Securing the use of the interior design layout as a commercial tool to plan and implement commercial strategies throughout the store.

  

* Lead and inspire the store Com&In team to use knowledge of IKEA home furnishing and people's life at home to grow the business.

  

* Partner with the store manager to stimulate and increase interest in home furnishing for all co-workers in the store.

  

* Be the creative leader by initiating and facilitating workshops to generate creative directions.

  

* Secure vitality and seasonality in the store by creating and implementing a store commercial calendar together with the store management team.

  

* Lead the store Com&In team in securing relevant and inspiring range presentation solutions, an optimal store layout and effective and efficient store communication that builds the IKEA Brand and distances IKEA retailers from the competition.

  

* Secure that the store commercial team has the right understanding of store layout, range presentation and store communication thereby contributing to the work method for range presentation.

  

* Contribute with knowledge of people's life at home and consumer shopping behaviour in the creation and implementation of the store business plan.

  

* Based on the national competence development plan, identify current and future business needs in order to recruit, develop and retain a high performing and passionate store Com&In team.

  

* Lead and challenge the Com&In team to constantly take actions that exploit commercial opportunities both in the short- and long term

  

* Recruit and develop a high-performing Com&In team through competence development, retention, and succession planning.

With a great deal of passion, imagination and brainstorming we turn colours, textiles and furniture into inspiring environments that excite, engage and convince IKEA visitors that they can do it too!

title: Data Management Specialist II
description:
As a Data Management Specialist II here at Honeywell, you will play a vital role in managing and optimizing data processes as part of the Global Data Admin team within our HR Services function. You will be responsible for ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and security while supporting HR operations and analytics. Your expertise will help drive data-driven decision-making and enhance the efficiency of HR services.

You will report directly to our Senior Manager - Data Management and you’ll work out of our Bangalore, India location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the organization by enabling seamless data management practices that support HR initiatives, improve workforce insights, and contribute to strategic business outcomes.

  

**Benefits of Working for Honeywell**

* Benefits – Medical, Mental Health, Paid Leaves (as per regional/statutory policy)
* Health & Insurance/Retirement Benefits (as per regional statutory policy)
* Career Growth
* Learning and Professional Development

**You Must Have**

* 5+ years of experience in data management, preferably within HR or related functions.
* Communicate clearly in speech and writing, build strong working relationships, collaborate and lead effectively, solve problems through critical thinking, and manage competing priorities with ease.
* Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, and data security principles.
* Proficiency in HRIS systems (PeopleSoft, Oracle HCM, Workday or equivalent), data analytics tools and database management.
* Experience with data integration and reporting tools relevant to HR data management.

**We Value**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Management, or related field.
* Experience working in HR services or supporting HR data operations.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of compliance requirements and best practices in HR data handling.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Day-to-Day job**

* Manage and maintain HR data systems ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies.
* Collaborate with HR, Data Managers and IT teams to streamline data collection, storage, and reporting processes.
* Your role will also include overseeing, supervising, and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end‑to‑end processes and projects for both internal and external stakeholders with responsibility for timely and accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on tasks to be performed; and mentoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skill development, professional growth, and overall success.

**Process Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain up-to-date standard operating procedures (SOPs). Track process changes and improvements and regularly update the related documentation (process maps, checklists, FMEA etc.).
* Share best practices with peers across the region to ensure consistent process maturity and adoption of a single best-known approach.
Support supervisors in assessing the team’s skill need and learning requirements. Provide refresher training as needed and track team members’ skill maturity.  

**Audit, Governance, and Quality Controls**

* **Audit Support:** Support internal and external audit requirements as needed.
* **Peer Audits:** Ensure regular peer audits meet data audit requirements in line with SOX and other controls.
* **Built-in Quality:** Track First Pass Yield (FPY) across processes, and review and refine controls as needed to strengthen built-in quality.

**Workload Review and Allocation**

* Review work inventory and support task allocation based on team structure and skills to ensure timely resolution of tickets, incidents, and other requests.

**Process Controls and Continuous Improvement**

* Review and evaluate existing process controls and identify continuous improvement opportunities to strengthen and enhance processes.

**Project and Initiative Support**

* Support projects and initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M&A), spin-offs, system integrations, and organizational redesign.

**Leadership and Customer Excellence**

* Lead by example for peers by taking on complex work, simplifying tasks, and delivering excellent customer service.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Manager, Reliability Engineering (PL)
description:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

  

**Role Profile**

LSEG Post Trade Solutions division – Acadia is seeking a skilled, hands-on Technical DevOps Manager with a Linux system administration (SA) background

Responsibilities include:

* Lead and inspire the local four-person team to become subject matter experts in service availability issues escalated from our Level 1 and 2 support desk. The team will operate across 2 shifts:

* 1st Shift (SF1) 05 :30 AM IST – 02:00 PM IST

* 2nd Shift (SF2) 02:00 PM IST – 10:00 PM IST

* Develop and set procedures for escalation and resolution of Level 3 technical issues.

* Work with cross functional teams to assist with root cause analysis and uptime optimization.

* Level 3 remediation and escalation of operational issues.

* Need to be subject matter experts in the underlying technologies.

* They may be required to provide detailed technical support for developers producing bug fixes & new releases of these applications.

* Must be self-motivating with the ability to prioritize workload.

* Remain hands-on: actively contribute to infrastructure code, automation, troubleshooting and releases alongside the team, rather than only managing it.

* Act as the technical lead and go-to resource for the team, providing mentoring, code and design reviews, and guidance on complex incidents.

* Define, promote and enforce engineering best practices across the team, including infrastructure as code, version control, peer review, CI/CD, automated testing, documentation and change management.

* Design, build and maintain automation using Ansible and Terraform, and support workloads on AWS cloud alongside the existing on-premises VMware and Windows/Linux estate.

Partner with development teams on bug fixes and new releases, including reviewing deployment and configuration changes for Java and other bespoke applications.  



**Key Responsibilities**

The role may include automated provisioning, installation/configuration, operation, and maintenance of software defined infrastructure.

This individual participates in technical research and development to enable continuing improvements in process and supporting the maximum available uptime. The best candidates are pro-active, self-led and are perceived as passionate about improving service for our clients.

The Acadia environment consists of VMware vSphere, AWS cloud (with Ansible and Terraform for automation). Windows desktop, Windows Server, and Ubuntu Server. We use both relational and document data stores (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB).

Use of Prometheus, Datadog, Opensearch and CloudWatch..  

Develop and maintain installation and configuration procedures as code (e.g. Ansible playbooks and Terraform modules) under version control.  



* Contribute to and maintain system standards, and embed them in automation and documentation.

Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all server resources, systems, and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs such as backups.  

Perform daily backup operations, ensuring all required file systems and system data are successfully backed up to the appropriate media, recovery tapes or disks are created, and media is recycled and sent off site as necessary.  

Systems Administration and Maintenance of a variety of bespoke systems.  

Apply OS patches and upgrades on a regular basis, and upgrade administrative tools and utilities. Configure / add new services as necessary.  



* Staff oversight, including performance management, coaching and career development.

Staff oversight of the entire PostTrade Solutions support team based in Bangalore in future once settled in the role  



* No budget responsibility.
  

**Experience and Qualifications Required**

Bachelor (4-year) degree, with a technical major, such as engineering or computer science.  



* Hands-on technical experience as a DevOps (Development Operations) engineer and in a technical lead role.

* Previous software development experience, ideally in Java, including writing, debugging and supporting application code.

* Working knowledge of Ansible and Terraform for configuration management and infrastructure provisioning.

* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (e.g. EC2, IAM, VPC, S3).

* Strong grounding in engineering best practices: Git, code review, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and documentation.

* Experience with Linux and Windows Server administration, VMware vSphere, and enterprise monitoring tools (e.g. Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk).

Ability to coach and develop engineers and to act as a technical resource for the team.  

Good communication skills  

Willing to adopt Hybrid working mode and work in Bangalore Office.  

Experience in Financial or an investment banking environment.  

Familiarity with financial products and financial terms.  

Excellent analytical skills, Attention to Detail and problem-solving abilities.  

Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to IT and business teams and to senior management.  

Strong negotiation / influencing skills able to overcome resistance and reach consensus and compromise in order to attain the required objective.  



**Career Stage:**

Manager  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: DevSecOps Services Technical Lead
description:
This role leads the Evergreen DevSecOps Toolkit development & releases. This is a critical, high visibility, customer-facing role to ensure regular deployments to Customer Reference Environments, Dev, QA and Production using CI/CD automation. The role includes contribution towards definition of standards around deployment automation, security, artifact transfer, test automation and other tools that form part of the toolkit ecosystem. The Evergreen offering has a high growth potential for GE Vernova and a core capability identified for scaling globally.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:
  

* Be responsible for providing technical leadership and defining, developing, and evolving the Evergreen Toolkit software in a fast paced and agile development environment using the latest software development and infrastructure
* Provide guidance to developers with either planning and execution and/or design architecture using agile methodologies such as SCRUM
* Develop and manage **infrastructure automation** and configuration management using **Ansible** to ensure consistency, speed, and reliability across environments.

* Build, manage, and optimize **CI/CD pipelines** using **Jenkins** and **GitHub** to enable efficient software integration, testing, and deployment.

* Manage artifact storage, versioning, and release promotion processes using **Artifactory** to support controlled and traceable software delivery.

* Build deep knowledge of GE Vernova Products across performance and GridOS.

* Working knowledge of Kubernetes on RKE2 (Rancher) is a plus.

* Partner with software engineering, product, support, and services teams to industrialize environment setup, upgrades, patching, and ongoing maintenance activities.

* Monitor environment health, troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues, and drive root cause resolution to improve stability and operational excellence.

* Implement and enforce DevOps best practices for source control, automation, release management, and system reliability.

* Contribute to the creation of standards, templates, runbooks, and reusable automation assets that accelerate Evergreen adoption across customers.

* Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance environment provisioning, operational efficiency, resiliency, and customer experience.
* Participate in readiness planning for new customer deployments and ensure environments are aligned to security, compliance, and supportability expectations

  

**Qualification**

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with significant experience.

  
  

For roles in USA:Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math)

  
  

* **12+ years of experience in DevOps CI/CD**

* **Hands on experience with Ansible, ArgoCD, Helm**

* **Hands on experience with AI Based Development**

  

Business Acumen:
  

* Evaluates technology to drive features and roadmaps. Maps technology trends to internal vision. Differentiates buzzwords from value proposition. Embraces technology trends that drive excellence beyond traditional practices (e.g., Test automation in lieu of traditional QA practices).

Conveys the value proposition for the company by assessing financial risks and gains of decisions and return on investment (ROI). Manages the process of building and maintaining a successful alliance. Understands and successfully applies common analytical techniques, including ROI, SWOT, and Gap analyses. Communicates and demonstrates a shared sense of purpose. Learns from failure.

title: Strategy Manager
description:
## About the Role

We are looking for a high-calibre, analytical and business-oriented professional to join the Group Strategy & Investor Relations function.

The role will work closely with senior leadership to drive strategic initiatives across the Group, evaluate growth and diversification opportunities, monitor business and financial performance, and support the development of high-quality investor and management communication.

The incumbent will have significant exposure to Group leadership, Business Heads, investors, analysts and external advisors, and will be expected to translate complex business and financial information into clear insights, recommendations and executive-level narratives.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking, financial acumen, strong business understanding and excellent communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, multi-business environment.

## Key Responsibilities

- Support the formulation and execution of the Group's long-term strategic roadmap and strategic priorities.

- Conduct market, industry, competitor and macroeconomic analysis across sectors relevant to the Group.

- Evaluate strategic opportunities across existing businesses, new markets, adjacencies and potential diversification areas.

- Develop strategic frameworks, business cases and recommendations for senior management.

- Analyse industry and regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on Group businesses.

- Support annual strategic planning, business reviews and periodic strategy reviews.

- Track implementation of strategic initiatives and ensure alignment with agreed priorities and milestones.

* Support — not lead — enhancement initiatives across OTR, P2P, and RTP that are owned by senior Business Systems Analysts and Architects
* Translate business requirements into Jira user stories and acceptance criteria under the direction of the project lead
* Participate in configuration, QA/UAT testing, and data validation for system enhancements and integrations
* Contribute to technical and process documentation for new configurations, features, and workflows

* Experience operating in a SOX-controlled, public-company environment - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, global team (Pune-based, supporting primarily US stakeholders)

**intersection of technology, business, and finance**

You will partner closely with Technology Strategy & Governance, Cloud Engineering, Finance, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, and business stakeholders to support FinOps governance, cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization tracking, and executive reporting.

* Self-starter who works well independently and collaborates effectively within a cross-functional team.
