title: Finance Manager
description:
**The Finance Manager**
will be responsible for overseeing the company's financial operations (customer invoicing & supplier payments), accounting and financial reporting. The role will partner closely with the company leadership team to ensure financial discipline, improve profitability and support strategic business decisions.

**Responsibilities:**

**Revenue and Billing Management:**

* Oversee revenue tracking, invoicing, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable.
* Ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with applicable accounting standards and contractual terms.
* Coordinate with sales, delivery, and project management teams to ensure timely and accurate client billing.
* Monitor contract milestones, purchase orders, timesheet approvals, and billing schedules.
* Identify revenue leakage and resolve billing disputes in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**Supplier Payment Processing and Vendor Management:**

* Oversee end-to-end supplier payment processing, ensuring payments are accurate, timely, and in accordance with agreed payment terms and company policies.
* Review and verify supplier invoices, purchase orders, goods or service confirmations, and supporting documentation before payment approval.
* Prepare and review payment runs, maintain payment schedules, and ensure appropriate authorization in accordance with the company's approval matrix.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all supplier payments and ensure compliance with internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate accounts payable processes, reduce payment errors, and improve processing efficiency.

Project and Client Profitability

* Monitor project-wise, client-wise, and service-line profitability.
* Track project budgets, resource utilization, billable hours, realization rates, and delivery costs.
* Analyze the financial impact of fixed-price, time-and-materials, managed services, and other client contracts.
* Monitor subcontractor costs, offshore and onsite delivery costs, and employee bench costs.

Accounting and Financial Reporting

* Review general ledger accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, payroll accounting, and month-end closing undertaken by accounting firm.
* Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and documentation.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Typically 7–10 years of relevant finance and accounting experience.
* Strong financial analysis, accounting, and management reporting skills.
* Experience in the IT services industry and understanding of IT services business models, project economics, resource utilization, and client profitability.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition principles and contract-based billing.
* Experience with ERP/accounting systems and financial reporting tools.
* Advanced Excel skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and commercial judgment.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment.
* High standards of integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and professional ethics.

* Leverage 2–3 years of hands-on SAP HANA Modelling experience or Datasphere and SAP BW experience in implementation.
* Design and develop SAP HANA Calculation Views to support SAC Planning and Reporting use cases.

* Collaborate with SAC planning teams to ensure optimal data structures and model performance.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas in both technical and business‑friendly language
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Highly process‑oriented with a structured approach to solution design
* Ability to work independently and lead complex engagements
* Strong documentation and knowledge‑sharing mindset

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in BW
* Good understanding on SAP BDC, Datasphere Seamless planning and SAP Joule and AI.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working on large‑scale finance transformation or planning initiatives
* Exposure to competitor EPM tools is a plus
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building
* Expertise in delivering the process definition document post workshops. Preparing the system design document by mapping client requirements. Capable to work with the team on sprint planning for the delivery.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

-------------------

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek -so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.

**Role Overview**

This role is critical to ensure site search is actively governed, continuously optimized, and aligned with evolving business and customer needs—bridging technology, content, and digital experience.

The Coveo Search & Merchandising Specialist will work very closely with Search product manager, and Analysts, and is responsible for the administration, configuration, optimization, and governance of Agilent’s site search experience using the Coveo platform. This role serves as the subject-matter expert for Coveo Search and Merchandising, ensuring search relevance, discoverability, and performance align with business priorities and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience across Agilent’s global digital channels.

* Own day-to-day administration of the Coveo platform, including environment configuration, access, pipelines, and governance.

* Monitor, analyze, and optimize search performance using Coveo analytics (e.g., zero-result queries, engagement, click-through rate, and conversion impact).
* Partner with Content, UX/UI, SEO, and Digital Product teams to align search behavior with content strategy and experience design.
* Collaborate with IT and Architecture teams to support search integrations, indexing accuracy, ingestion stability, and platform health.
* Participate in UAT, regression testing, and release readiness activities for search-related enhancements and platform updates.
* Work with external partners, including Coveo Customer Success and implementation teams, to resolve issues and drive continuous optimization.
* Maintain search documentation, configuration standards, data dictionaries, and operational guidelines.
* Support Service Desk workflows by triaging and coordinating search-related incidents and enhancement requests.
* Support the collection and documentation of search‑related requirements and assist in translating them into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and configuration guidance.
* Support backlog refinement and prioritization for search relevance, merchandising, analytics, and platform enhancements in collaboration with product and delivery teams.
* Coordinate and support testing activities, including functional validation, UAT planning and execution, defect triage, and release sign‑off for search changes.
* Review search analytics and performance data to identify trends, issues, and optimization opportunities, and support reporting and insight requests.
* Provide continuity of search operations by supporting post‑release validation, incident analysis, documentation updates, and analyst coverage as needed.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Digital Product and Platform Managers
* Content Strategy, UX/UI, and SEO teams
* IT Operations, Architecture, and Development teams
* External technology partners and vendors (including Coveo)

------------------

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Digital, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Total experience of 5-7 yrs and 2-3 years of experience administering or optimizing enterprise search, discovery, or personalization platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Coveo Search, including merchandising and analytics capabilities, strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of search relevance, information architecture, taxonomy, and digital merchandising concepts.
* Experience supporting search in complex B2B or highly technical product environments.
* Familiarity with analytics-driven optimization and experimentation.
* Comfort working with metadata, structured content, and platform configuration concepts.

title: Associate - Project Manager
description:
Job Description: We are seeking a skilled Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer with strong expertise in Power BI and Tableau to build scalable reporting and analytics solutions for a high-volume sports, media, and digital engagement ecosystem .

The role involves designing and delivering **enterprise-grade dashboards, data models, and KPI frameworks** that enable stakeholders across product, content, marketing, and operations to make data-driven decisions.

You will work closely with data engineering and analytics teams to transform complex datasets into **actionable, high-performance BI solutions** optimized for large-scale usage and executive reporting.

This is an **offshore role supporting a globally distributed analytics organization** .

  

**Responsibilities: 1. BI Dashboard Development (Power BI / Tableau)**

* Design, develop, and maintain **interactive dashboards and reports** using:
  + **Power BI**
  + **Tableau**
* Build dashboards for key domains such as:
  + User engagement and fan behavior analytics
  + Content consumption and streaming performance
  + Marketing campaign effectiveness
  + Operational and business KPI tracking
* Ensure dashboards are **visually intuitive, business-friendly, and performance-optimized** .
Implement advanced dashboard features such as drill-downs, filters, parameters, and dynamic visuals.  

**2. Data Modeling for BI**

* Develop and maintain **efficient data models (star schema / dimensional models)** for reporting.
* Build **semantic layers and reusable datasets** to ensure consistency across Power BI and Tableau reports.
* Optimize data models for **query performance and scalability** .
Collaborate with data engineering teams to structure BI-ready datasets.  

**3. SQL & Data Preparation**

* Write complex and optimized **SQL queries** for data extraction and transformation.
* Work with large datasets in **cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks)** .
* Validate and reconcile data to ensure accuracy across BI dashboards.
Support data preparation for reporting and analytics use cases.  

**4. KPI & Metrics Definition**

* Define and maintain **business KPIs and metric frameworks** in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Ensure **single source of truth** for all reporting layers.
* Align reporting logic across Power BI and Tableau environments.
Standardize definitions for key business and product metrics.  

**5. Performance Optimization**

* Optimize dashboards for **fast load times and high user concurrency** .
* Improve query performance through aggregation strategies and efficient data modeling.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues in BI reports.  

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with:
  + Data Engineering teams (data pipelines & transformations)
  + Product teams (reporting requirements & KPIs)
  + Analytics teams (insights & experimentation)
* Translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions.
Support ad-hoc reporting and deep-dive analysis requests.  

**7. Data Quality & Governance**

* Ensure **data accuracy, consistency, and validation** across BI outputs.
* Maintain documentation for dashboards, datasets, and KPI definitions.
* Follow best practices for **BI governance, version control, and reporting standards** .

  

* Qualifications: 3–7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data Analytics / BI Engineering roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with:
  + **Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling)**
  + **Tableau (LOD expressions, dashboard design, calculations)**
* Advanced **SQL skills** (joins, window functions, performance tuning).
* Strong experience in **data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling)** .
* Experience working with cloud data platforms:
  + Snowflake / BigQuery / Redshift / Databricks
* Strong understanding of **dashboard design principles and data visualization best practices** .
Experience working with large datasets and enterprise reporting systems.  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in **sports analytics, media, streaming, or digital consumer platforms** .
* Familiarity with **dbt or modern data transformation workflows** .
* Exposure to **A/B testing, cohort analysis, or experimentation frameworks** .
* Basic understanding of Python for data analysis (optional).
* Experience working in **real-time or near-real-time reporting environments** .
Knowledge of data governance tools and practices.  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills for working with **global offshore/onshore teams** .
* Ability to independently manage deliverables in a remote setup.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle multiple reporting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and requirement gathering skills.

description:

Valocity is trusted digital infrastructure for property decisions. Across India, Australia, New Zealand and the United Arab Emirates, we help leading financial institutions transform property decisioning through AI-enabled technology, trusted data and connected digital workflows.

In India, our platform supports digital mortgage valuation, project finance and legal workflows across a connected ecosystem of lenders, valuers, legal professionals and property data. * Exceptional verbal communication skills with a proven ability to build and maintain strong internal and external relationships
* Results driven mindset, with ability to take on personal challenge of driving and delivering business results and outcomes

  
  

**Experience**  

* 3-5 years plus experience in a Valuer Management/ Valuation process
* Success in deepening relationships with Valuer/ Lenders resulting in increased revenue and services bought by the customers
* Experience in leading customer onboarding / support teams with demonstrable understanding of best practice
* Experienced in developing and implementing new systems and processes in a fast-moving environment
* Proficiency in regional language will be a big plus

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in related field

**Technical Skills**  

* Has done Valuations or managed Valuers in a large Bank or Lending institution
* Working knowledge of MS office- Excel, PowerPoint, Word etc
* CRM (ideally Hubspot) or such tools to manage support desk

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Principal Product Manager, Loyalty**
**Team Description**
The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on HCOM loyalty. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia & Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML-driven personalization, promotions & incentives etc.
  
  
The team partners closely with brand GMs, marketing, engineering, design, finance, legal and other product stakeholders to improve the loyalty experience, drive clearer value for travelers, and increase outcomes such as active members, first transactions, repeat bookings, and direct return behavior for Expedia Group.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and champion the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Hotels.com loyalty.
* Establish the strategic direction for how loyalty creates value across the customer journey.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities that increase member engagement, repeat booking, retention, and direct customer relationships.
* Create simple, compelling experiences that help members understand, build, and use travel value over time.
* Use customer insight, experimentation, behavioral data, and market trends to shape strategy and measure impact.
* Lead complex, multi-quarter initiatives spanning discovery, booking, post-booking, and future-trip planning.
* Align senior stakeholders around priorities, investment decisions, success measures, and tradeoffs.
* Partner with cross-functional leaders to ensure cohesive execution across product areas and disciplines.
* Balance customer value, commercial outcomes, technical feasibility, operational readiness, and long-term platform health.
* Establish scalable product practices, operating mechanisms, and decision frameworks for complex loyalty initiatives.
* Represent Hotels.com loyalty in broader Expedia Group strategy discussions and identify opportunities for ecosystem alignment.
* Raise the quality of product thinking through coaching, mentorship, and thought leadership across the product organization.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Hotels.com has a clear, differentiated loyalty strategy that strengthens customer relationships and supports long-term growth.
* Members clearly understand the value of loyalty and are motivated to engage across the travel journey.
* Loyalty experiences increase meaningful engagement, repeat booking, retention, and direct customer relationships.
* The product portfolio is focused on the highest-value customer and business opportunities.
* Complex initiatives move forward with strong cross-functional alignment, clear accountability, and effective decision-making.
* Experiences are intuitive, scalable, measurable, and consistent across the customer journey.
* Loyalty strategy and execution are connected to broader Hotels.com and Expedia Group priorities.
* The product organization benefits from stronger strategic thinking, operating discipline, and product leadership.

**Who You Are**

* A distinguished product leader who combines customer empathy with commercial, analytical, and strategic judgment.
* Experienced in defining product strategy and delivering consumer-facing experiences at scale.
* Skilled at setting direction across multiple product areas and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating across functions, brands, geographies, and business models.
* Able to simplify complex concepts, create clarity in ambiguity, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
* A collaborative, inclusive leader who builds trust and raises the performance of teams around them.
* Curious, data-informed, and motivated by improving how people experience travel.
* Equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and driving detailed execution when needed.
* A strong communicator who can connect product decisions to customer outcomes and business impact.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience leading complex product portfolios and initiatives.
* Proven ability to define and execute product strategy across multiple teams, products, or customer journeys.
* Track record of delivering measurable customer and commercial outcomes through consumer, marketplace, platform, or loyalty products.
* Experience influencing senior leaders and aligning stakeholders in a highly matrixed organization.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and other business stakeholders.
* Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with loyalty, travel, e-commerce, marketplaces, subscriptions, rewards, or customer engagement products.
* Experience designing products that drive repeat behavior, retention, customer lifetime value, or direct relationships.
* Experience with experimentation, personalization, segmentation, or behavioral analytics.
* Experience leading multi-quarter, cross-functional product strategies in a global organization.
* Experience coaching product managers and contributing to product craft and organizational excellence.
* Ability to connect member needs and product strategy to broader business priorities and measurable commercial impact.

**Why this role matters**
Loyalty is a powerful way to make Hotels.com more relevant across the traveler’s journey and create lasting customer relationships. In this role, you will shape the strategy and experiences that turn customer value into sustained behavior—encouraging members to return, book more often, and build an enduring relationship with Hotels.com.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

**An AI platform for underwriting, claims, and insurance decision automation. is Looking for:******
**The Role**
This is not a standard recruiter role.
  
  
We’re looking for a
**“people leader”**
to own hiring and people operations. You’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team to shape client’s talent DNA as we scale, and be their key point of contact for everything people-related in India.
  
  
The role is split equally:
**50% Talent Acquisition and 50% People Operations**
, with Talent Acquisition as the primary focus. On the people side, you’ll run HR operations hands-on and support HR partnering, with room to take on more strategic work as the team grows.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Talent Acquisition (50%)
* Own hiring end to end across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success and business roles, from intake to offer.
* Lead direct sourcing. Find niche tech and non-tech talent through outreach, communities, referrals and Boolean/X-ray search, and keep warm pipelines for hard-to-fill roles.
* Recruit with AI. Use AI tools in sourcing, screening, outreach and pipeline tracking to hire faster without lowering quality.
* Partner with hiring managers. Define roles, calibrate profiles and make fast, well-judged hiring calls, pushing back with data when needed.
* Manage vendors and job listings. Run recruitment partners on clear SLAs for quality, speed and cost, and keep listings current across platforms.
* Close offers across levels, including negotiation and pre-joining engagement to reduce drop-offs.
* Track hiring metrics such as time-to-hire, funnel conversion and quality of hire, and report them to the founders.
* Deliver on hiring targets while giving candidates an experience that reflects client’s brand.
* People Operations & HR Partnering (50%)

**People Operations**

* Onboarding. Own offer acceptance to a fully ready Day 1: laptop and access setup, onboarding sessions and first-week introductions.
* Payroll and offboarding. Jointly own joining formalities, payroll inputs (role changes, revisions, exits), exit documentation and full-and-final settlements.
* Policies and compliance. Build the employee handbook and HR policies, and ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH) with external partners.
* People data and team events. Maintain employee records, KPIs and attendance tracking, and plan off-sites and team events within budget.

**HR Partnering**

* Performance cycles. Run the goal-setting and review calendar, track completion, and make sure managers share feedback regularly.
* Employee queries. Be the first point of contact for day-to-day concerns resolve what you can and escalate sensitive matters to the founders with proper documentation.
* Engagement and exits. Run pulse surveys and exit interviews, and share attrition trends with simple recommendations.
* Headcount planning support. Maintain the headcount plan and org chart, and flag people gaps early as the company scales.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of experience, with Talent Acquisition as your core strength and hands-on exposure to HR operations, preferably in fast-growing startups.
* A proven record of hiring for niche tech and non-tech roles, with tech being the primary area.
* Hands-on experience with direct sourcing and managing recruitment vendors.
* Working exposure to HR operations and partnering: onboarding, payroll coordination, performance cycles and employee queries.
* Familiarity with Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, or the ability to pick them up quickly with external partners.
* You already use AI to recruit and run people operations smarter and faster.
* A strong bias for speed, quality and ownership.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You Are**

* Organised and process-driven. You enjoy building systems, not just running them.
* Resourceful and proactive. You find a way and don’t wait to be told.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You can build structure from scratch in a high-energy startup.
* A strong communicator. You can earn the trust of senior leaders and candidates alike, and represent our client well in every hiring conversation.

**How to apply for this opportunity?**

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

**About Uplers:**
Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**HR & Administration Executive (HRGA)**

**About Semifive**

Founded in Seoul in 2019, SEMIFIVE is basing its foundation on Korea’s semiconductor design competency that was amassed for more than 20 years. With expertise spanning front-end to back-end design, SEMIFIVE has become the fastest growing silicon design company that offers the most comprehensive design solutions. SEMIFIVE’s core business is its innovative SoC Platform that enables low-cost and high-efficiency SoC design and also provides full turnkey silicon design services for global customers.

As the cost of developing an SoC and the demand for customized silicon continue to grow rapidly, SEMIFIVE’s SoC Platform plays a critical role in turning innovative ideas into silicon. SEMIFIVE works closely with global technology leaders and is rapidly emerging as The New Global Hub of Custom Silicon.

Semifive India Design Centre, headquartered in Bangalore, is a rapidly growing capability centre responsible for delivering complex, multi-node SoC programs for global customers across the US, Europe, and Asia. The India team owns front-end through back-end execution, including RTL, STA, synthesis, physical design, and signoff for turnkey silicon programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition (Semiconductor - VLSI Technical Hiring)**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment from requirement gathering to onboarding.
* Partner with Hiring Managers to understand hiring needs and role requirements.
* Prepare and publish job postings on LinkedIn.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, and employee referrals.
* Conduct candidate outreach, resume screening, and HR screening interviews.
* Coordinate interview scheduling, feedback collection, and candidate communication.
* Manage offer rollouts, negotiations, and joining follow-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring reports, and dashboards.

**2. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Coordinate employee onboarding, induction, and joining formalities.
* Maintain employee records, databases, and personnel files.
* Coordinate with internal teams for system access, email IDs, and assets.
* Conduct new hire orientation sessions.
* Manage employee exit processes, including documentation, clearance, and exit interviews.
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns by coordinating with management to ensure timely and effective resolution.
* Ensure employee information is accurate and updated.

**3. Employee Engagement & Event Management**

* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives and internal events.
* Organize celebrations, team-building activities, recognition programs, and culture-building initiatives.
* Coordinate vendors, logistics, budgets, and employee participation.
* Gather employee feedback and support workplace engagement efforts.

**4. Facility & Administration Vendor Management**

* Act as the SPOC for Recruitment, Facility and administration-related vendors.
* Coordinate with facility maintenance teams, travel agencies, forex service providers, hotels, accommodation partners, and other external service providers to support day-to-day business and employee requirements.
* Manage service requests, quotations, purchase requirements, and invoice coordination.
* Monitor vendor performance and maintain related records and agreements.

**5. HR Coordination, Policies & Documentation**

* Support the implementation of HR related policies, processes, workplace guidelines, and management initiatives.
* Coordinate communication of organizational updates and management decisions.
* Assist in drafting and updating policies, SOPs, employee communications, letters, and templates.
* Maintain HR, employee, vendor, and administrative documentation in an organized manner.
* Prepare HR reports, trackers, presentations, and management updates.

**6. Office & Facility Management**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day office operations and facility upkeep.
* Monitor office supplies, pantry requirements, and administrative resources.
* Coordinate facility maintenance and resolve office-related concerns.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and productive workplace environment.
* Identify and address operational gaps proactively.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Administration.
* Experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably Semiconductor or VLSI technical hiring.
* Strong experience in LinkedIn sourcing and candidate engagement.
* Good understanding of onboarding, employee lifecycle management, and HR operations.
* Experience in vendor management, event coordination, and office administration.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Self-driven and proactive with a hands-on approach to HR and Administration.
* Capable of independently managing recruitment and HRGA activities.
* Strong interpersonal and coordination skills with employees, management, hiring teams, and vendors.
* Adaptable to a dynamic, fast-paced semiconductor and technology environment.

**Why Join Us?**

At Semifive, you will play a critical technical leadership role in delivering first-time-right silicon for global customers. Unlike traditional large semiconductor organizations, Semifive offers broad ownership and real impact, where timing and synthesis leaders directly influence architecture, implementation strategy, and final silicon quality.

As part of Semifive India, you will work on multiple complex SoCs, partner with world-class engineering teams across geographies, and help build scalable STA and synthesis methodologies for a rapidly growing organization.

This role offers the opportunity to shape not just individual chips — but how silicon is built at Semifive.

title: Senior HR Business Partner - Tech
description:
**About Us**
Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.
  
  
Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.
  
  
For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.
  
  
**About Mercari India**
Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.
  
  
**Our Culture**
To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.
  
  
Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:
  
  

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations:
  
  

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation.
  
  
We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture
  
  
**About Role**
We are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner - Technology to partner with leaders, managers, and employees across assigned technology teams at Mercari India.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role combining business partnership with end-to-end ownership of people initiatives. You will translate business and People & Culture priorities into focused people plans, lead projects requiring strong HR expertise, and bring stakeholders together to solve organisational challenges.
  
  
Beyond delivering established HR programmes, you will identify underlying people issues, develop solutions, and drive implementation through to measurable outcomes. Your work will strengthen manager effectiveness, team performance, talent development, and employee experience while contributing to broader organisational priorities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is commercially aware, analytical, empathetic, and comfortable exercising judgement in an ambiguous, fast-changing, multicultural technology environment.
  
  
**Requirements**
****Business Partnership and People Planning****

* Build trusted relationships with technology leaders and managers, developing a strong understanding of their business priorities, operating context, and people challenges
* Own people plans for assigned teams, translating business and People & Culture priorities into clear objectives, interventions, timelines, and success measures
* Diagnose organisational issues using business context, people data, and employee insights; recommend practical solutions and secure stakeholder commitment
* Bring an informed People & Culture perspective to business discussions, constructively challenging assumptions and balancing organisational needs, employee experience, and risk

****Performance and Talent Management****

* Own the delivery and effectiveness of performance-management practices for assigned teams, including goal setting, check-ins, evaluations, calibration, and development planning
* Facilitate evidence-based talent discussions, helping leaders assess performance, potential, readiness, and capability gaps consistently and fairly
* Partner with leaders to develop and follow through on plans for critical talent, succession priorities, retention, career development, and internal mobility
* Work with Learning & Development and other People partners to design targeted interventions and assess their impact on team capability and performance

****Engagement and Culture****

* Integrate engagement results, attrition trends, listening-session findings, and employee feedback to identify underlying issues and prioritise action
* Lead targeted engagement initiatives with clear ownership, stakeholder involvement, and measures of effectiveness
* Help leaders build inclusive, high-performing teams that reflect Mercari's values and leverage diverse perspectives and working styles
* Evaluate interventions, share lessons from successes and setbacks, and adapt approaches based on evidence

****Manager Coaching and Effectiveness****

* Coach managers on leadership effectiveness, team dynamics, performance conversations, feedback, career development, and sensitive people matters
* Help managers identify underlying issues, weigh options, and take timely, fair, and well-supported action
* Design and deliver focused tools, workshops, or coaching interventions to address recurring managerial capability gaps
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority, offering clear recommendations while remaining open to constructive challenge

****Organisational Change and Headcount Planning****

* Lead the people workstreams of organisational changes affecting assigned teams, including leadership transitions, team movements, role changes, and restructuring
* Partner with leaders and relevant People teams on workforce and capability planning, role clarity, and team-effectiveness needs
* Develop and execute change plans covering stakeholder alignment, communications, employee impact, dependencies, and implementation risks
* Track adoption and outcomes, resolve issues within your remit, and escalate decisions requiring broader authority or specialist input

****Employee Relations and Risk Management****

* Manage employee-relations matters within your remit, applying sound judgement, appropriate confidentiality, and consistent documentation
* Conduct or coordinate fair, objective workplace reviews and investigations in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and relevant HR stakeholders
* Coach managers through performance improvement, workplace concerns, and disciplinary processes, ensuring appropriate procedural safeguards
* Recognise high-risk or sensitive issues early and seek specialist guidance or escalate appropriately

****People Analytics and Project Delivery (AI)****

* Translate people data into clear diagnoses, recommendations, and decision-ready insights rather than reporting metrics alone
* Lead cross-functional People & Culture projects requiring strong HR expertise, from problem definition and planning through implementation and evaluation
* Align stakeholders on outcomes, responsibilities, dependencies, and decisions; maintain momentum and follow through despite obstacles
* Apply relevant best practices, test new approaches, and document learning to improve HR delivery
* Partner closely with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Learning & Development, Finance, and global stakeholders

****Required Qualifications and Experience****

* Typically 6-9 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 4 years in HR business partnering or a comparable role
* Experience partnering with technology, engineering, or product teams in a dynamic business environment
* Demonstrated ownership of people initiatives from diagnosis through implementation, with evidence of measurable outcomes
* Strong applied expertise in performance management, talent development, employee engagement, organisational change, and employee relations
* Proven ability to coach managers, influence senior stakeholders, and coordinate cross-functional contributors without direct authority
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying issues and translate insights into action
* Sound understanding of Indian employment practices and workplace-compliance requirements, including when to seek legal or specialist advice
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Ability to prioritise competing needs, make timely decisions within your remit, and manage sensitive matters with discretion and sound judgement
* Evidence of learning from experience, adapting approaches, and delivering through ambiguity and obstacles

**Benefits**

* Location: Bengaluru, India - Hybrid
* Team: People & Culture
* Employment type: Full-time
* Role type: Individual contributor
* Indicative experience: 6-9 years

title: Senior HR Business Partner, India
description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:**
Senior HR Business Partner, India

**Primary Job Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:**
Hybrid, Bengaluru based

**Employment Type(Permanent/Contract/Part-time/Intern):**
Permanent, Full-Time

Immediate

Head of People

Open until filled

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview:**

Our India team of around 50 people works across consulting delivery, technology and shared services, and they need one senior People partner they can trust. As Senior HR Business Partner, India, you will own employee relations, performance management, engagement and compliance for the India team, and you will run our Bengaluru office. You will work directly with business leaders in India and North America, and with our Finance and Corporate Technology teams. This is a hands-on role in a small People team: you set the approach and you do the work.

**Mandate:**

* Be the first point of contact for every People matter in India, for employees and leaders alike
* Handle employee relations cases fairly, quickly and with clean documentation, escalating to the Head of People where needed
* Run India's performance and engagement cycles on time and to standard
* Keep FIQ fully compliant with Indian labour law and statutory obligations, with nothing missed and nothing late
* Make India HR processes run the same way, whoever runs them

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 6 to 10 years in HR, including at least 3 years as an HR Business Partner or HR generalist owning a site or business unit in India
* Hands-on employee relations experience: investigations, performance improvement plans, disciplinary processes and exits, documented to a standard that holds up
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance, including the Labour Codes, POSH, the Maternity Benefit Act and the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act
* Experience running performance review cycles and coaching managers through difficult conversations
* Comfort with HR data: you pull and analyse your own reports from an HRIS (BambooHR, greytHR or similar) and use AI tools to work faster
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to advise senior leaders across India and North America

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Employee Relations**

* Advise employees and managers across India on People matters, and be the person they come to first
* Investigate and resolve grievances and conduct issues, and run performance improvement plans and disciplinary processes with clear documentation
* Manage exits end to end, including exit interviews and the themes that come out of them
* Support our POSH Internal Committee and external member on process and record keeping

**Performance Management**

* Run the India side of FIQ's semi-annual performance cycle: timelines, manager training, calibration support and follow-through
* Coach managers to write fair, evidence-based assessments and to have direct conversations
* Track probation outcomes and make sure confirmations happen on time

**Engagement and Culture**

* Turn engagement survey results for India into action plans with leaders, and follow up until they are done
* Run the Bengaluru office engagement calendar and our hybrid attendance standards
* Roll out FIQ's recognition program in India

**Compliance and Policy**

* Own India's People compliance calendar, including POSH annual reporting, Maternity Benefit Act obligations and policy updates under the Labour Codes
* Flag legal risk early and escalate to the Head of People and outside counsel where needed

**HR Operations and Office**

* In the first half of 2027, oversee our outsourced HR operations partner across onboarding, offboarding, payroll inputs to Finance, full and final settlements and HR vendors
* Hold that partner to a ready first day for every joiner (induction, benefits enrolment, payroll setup and system access with Corporate Technology) and a clean, compliant exit for every leaver (access removal, asset return, clearances and full and final inputs to Finance)
* Over the same period, work with Finance and our external chartered accountants on statutory matters such as PF, ESI, PT and gratuity
* Over the same period, keep employee data in BambooHR accurate and reconcile it with Finance every month
* Build and run regular HR reports from BambooHR, such as headcount, attrition, leave and onboarding status, for India leaders and the Head of People
* Manage the Bengaluru office with our building and facilities partners
* Document and maintain the India People SOPs

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Meet every India leader and the People team, and understand the open employee relations cases, the compliance calendar and our HR operations partner's scope
* Take ownership of all open employee relations cases
* Agree a day-one readiness checklist with Finance, Corporate Technology and our HR operations partner

**60 Days In**

* Lead India's preparation for the next performance and increment cycle
* Close or move forward every open employee relations case, with documented outcomes
* Confirm the India compliance calendar is current, with no gaps
* Identify gaps in India HR policies and agree a plan with the Head of People to close them

**90 Days In**

* Deliver India's performance cycle on time
* Agree engagement action plans with India leaders
* Publish updated India People SOPs and a first monthly India People report

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Zero missed statutory or compliance deadlines in India
* Employee relations cases resolved within agreed timelines, with complete documentation
* 100% of India performance reviews and probation confirmations completed on time
* Improvement in India engagement scores and survey participation
* Regretted attrition in India held at or below target

**Why You Will Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we do not just build supply chain solutions, we build long-term careers. We give our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you are leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have visible impact. We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Compensation is a competitive annual CTC based on experience. We discuss compensation openly at the first screening call.

**India**

**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice

* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays

* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

**Retirement and Financial Security**

* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)

* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

**Professional Growth**

* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

**Flexible Work**

* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Accommodations:**

FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com and we will work with you to meet your needs.

**Candidate Privacy:**

Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Equal Opportunity:**

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**

FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.

**Honesty:**

title: P&C Operations Coordinator
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**
  
We are pleased to announce the launch of our physical Customer Meeting Point (CMP) in Bangalore — a Small Store L located in East Bangalore, one of the high-potential clusters of the city.
  
  
Create a Great Coworker Experience Every Day
  
  
At IKEA, we believe our people are our greatest strength. As a People & Culture Operations Coordinator, you'll play a key role in creating seamless employee experiences throughout the coworker journey, from onboarding and development to engagement and offboarding.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining operational excellence with a passion for people. You'll work closely with managers, coworkers, and People & Culture colleagues to ensure our people processes are efficient, compliant, and designed to help individuals and teams thrive.
  
  
Why Join IKEA?
  
  
At IKEA, you'll have the opportunity to:
  
  
•Make a meaningful impact on the everyday experience of coworkers.
  
•Be part of a purpose-driven, values-led organization.
  
•Gain exposure to multiple People & Culture disciplines including onboarding, learning, employee engagement, payroll support, talent acquisition, and employee relations.
  
•Collaborate with diverse teams across the country and contribute to a consistent, high-quality people experience.
  
•Grow your career in a global organization that invests in learning, development, and internal mobility.
  
  
Who We're Looking For
  
  
We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented People professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and creating great experiences for others.
  
  
You Will Bring
  
  
•Experience in HR Operations, People Services, HR Coordination, Employee Experience, or a related People & Culture role.

•Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  
•Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
•A collaborative mindset and passion for supporting people and business success.
  
•Confidence working with HR systems, digital tools, and people processes.
  
  
Preferred Skills & Knowledge
  
  
•HR Operations & Administration
  
•Payroll and Timekeeping Processes
  
•Employment Documentation & Compliance
  
•Learning Coordination
  
•Employee Lifecycle Management
  
•Business & Legal Acumen
  
•Digital Literacy and HR Systems Knowledge
  
  
**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  
Drive Exceptional Employee Experiences
  
  
•Own and coordinate key moments in the coworker lifecycle, including onboarding, transitions, and offboarding.
  
•Serve as a trusted point of contact for coworkers and managers, ensuring a smooth and positive employee experience.
  
•Coordinate welcome journeys, workplace access, equipment setup, and onboarding activities to help new coworkers feel connected from day one.
  
Support People Operations Excellence
  
•Execute core People & Culture processes efficiently and accurately while ensuring compliance with company policies and local regulations.
  
•Support operational services including contracts, uniforms, timekeeping, payroll-related activities, and employee documentation.
  
  
Workforce Planning
  
  
•Ensure adherence to IKEA employment standards, local legislation, and union requirements that relate to People Planning.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Human Capital HRT Oracle HCM Senior Manager
  
  
**Human Capital Overall**
The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Centered on five core issues, this Portfolio signifies to the market that we see Human Capital as a topic critical to the C-Suite. As we go to market, we show our clients that we serve more than HR organizations - from the CEO to CFO, Risk Manager to Business Unit leader - and that we deliver on our issues and help create value for our clients.
  
  
**Human Resources Transformation**
The HR Transformation team is a core component of our Human Capital practice. We collaborate with our clients to develop leading global HR strategies and support organizations in achieving excellence through implementing solutions that transform how they organize, develop capabilities, deploy technology and deliver a leading employee experience.
  
  
Keeping the employee in mind, our services help improve an organization's productivity through its people. The client issues we work with range from developing a comprehensive HR strategy and determining the need for enabling technologies to streamlining HR operations and transforming the way HR is delivered.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities**
Responsible for the successful end-to-end delivery and management of large-scale global Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM projects. The role requires an in-depth understanding of HR processes, the ability to define delivery strategies and experience leading teams. The Senior Manager will work closely with sales, functional, technical, PMO and testing teams.
  
  

* Understand the business case and functional and technical requirements. Lead process design workshops to identify gaps, assess options and recommend practical solutions.
* Lead Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations across the project lifecycle, including design, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
* Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks and issues. Establish change control, clear escalation paths and timely decisions.
* Manage staffing plans and forecast resource availability in line with project budgets, skills and delivery milestones.
* Work with client, functional and technical teams to deliver the agreed scope on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.
* Maintain open and timely communication with clients, stakeholders and project teams; ensure client satisfaction targets are achieved.
* Develop realistic work estimates, project budgets and timelines, drawing on experience with comparable engagements.
* Lead and motivate delivery teams, set clear expectations and create the conditions for team members to perform successfully.
* Align functional, integration, data and testing teams to deliver consistent solutions and reliable HR, payroll and third-party interfaces.

**Key Job Responsibilities Continued**

* Apply quality plans, risk management plans, issue and action logs, and change controls throughout delivery. Follow the agreed project management methodology and improve delivery practices.
* Manage change request plans where applicable, with clear ownership of deliverables and resolution of issues.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement that reduce manual work and improve the employee experience.
* Act as an Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM subject matter expert, providing guidance on process design, configuration, enterprise structures, security and cross-module dependencies.
* Mentor team members, provide hands-on guidance on complex issues and build a learning environment through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Define the delivery approach, standards and governance for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM services in line with client business priorities.
* Guide solution design and requirements gathering through client interviews, workshops and review of existing processes and documentation.
* Oversee configuration, test strategy and execution, training, knowledge transfer, cutover planning, go-live support and transition to ongoing support.
* Review solution configuration, integration designs and data readiness; ensure security and access requirements are addressed with the relevant specialists.
* Support practice growth through sales pursuits, proposals, solution presentations, estimates, pricing and reusable delivery assets.
* Build practice capability through recruitment, mentoring and coaching, and remain accountable for the agreed client outcomes.

**Key Skills And Qualifications**

* 12+ years of relevant experience, including at least 7+ years of experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM and experience leading large-scale global implementations.
* Solution design or architecture experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, with depth in one or more functional areas and an understanding of the wider HCM suite.
* Ability to lead delivery across relevant modules, including Global Human Resources, Payroll, Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent Management and Learning. Deep expertise in every module is not required; the ability to lead specialist teams and manage dependencies is essential.
* Experience overseeing Oracle HCM integrations and data migration, with an understanding of Oracle Integration, HCM Data Loader, HCM Extracts and APIs; familiarity with OTBI and BI Publisher reporting.
* Experience assessing quarterly updates, regression testing and impacts on configurations, integrations and reporting. Relevant Oracle HCM certifications are desirable.
* Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams in a global delivery model and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Ability to understand business and client challenges, articulate a clear point of view and work collaboratively to develop solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, interpersonal skills, and written and verbal communication. Ability to work across levels and manage ambiguity and delivery pressure.
* A master's degree in Human Resource Management is desirable. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, PowerPoint and Visio.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Operations Lead, APAC - India
description:
**About the Role**

The Raise operating model in APAC shifts by market. In Singapore, India, and the Philippines, we have our own established entities, and operations run much like they do in the Americas: Raise owns the back-office stack directly, from Sourcing & Curation through Contractor Success, Payroll Operations, AP, and AR. Across the rest of the region, we operate more like EMEA: a mix of anchor partners and single-country specialists delivering through EOR, AOR, and PEO models. Beeline is the VMS of record in most countries.

This role holds that complexity together rather than doing every piece of it directly. In our established markets, you’re the connective tissue between strong local teams and subject matter experts. In our partner-led markets, you hold partners accountable for delivery. Either way, you know where every piece stands, close the gaps between them, and make the region feel like one coherent Raise experience.

You’ll work alongside an experienced Account Director with an established footprint in the region on other clients. The ExxonMobil relationship here is newer and still evolving, so part of this role is building credibility quickly, with the Account Director and with the partners and teams you’ll coordinate across.

The region also has strong local HR expertise. You won’t replace that. You’ll partner closely with local HR, defer to their depth, and make sure nothing falls in the gap between HR and operations.

This is a senior, high-scope role. We’re a self-managed organization, so it isn’t about managing people, and it isn’t about being the expert in every market on day one. It’s about being capable and aware enough of the range of scenarios in play to hold the region together while it’s still taking shape.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Client relationship and confidence.**
  The Account Director leads client-facing reporting and owns the relationship, growth, and commercial delivery, across both ExxonMobil and other client work in the region. You’re the powerful engine behind the scenes, in every market, making sure operations are solid enough for the Account Director to lead with confidence.
* **Delivery team protection.**
  In Singapore, India, and the Philippines, you protect our own strong recruiting, sourcing, and back-office teams by absorbing coordination, questions, and escalations. Elsewhere, that same protection extends to our partner-delivered teams.
* **Direct operations ownership in established markets.**
  In Singapore, India, and the Philippines, you own the full operational stack the way our Americas operation does: Sourcing & Curation, Contractor Success, Payroll Operations, AP, and AR. You’re the single point of accountability for how these run day to day.
* **Partner and vendor oversight elsewhere.**
  Across the rest of APAC, you manage a mix of anchor partners and single-country specialists across EOR, AOR, and PEO arrangements, holding each accountable even when you don’t run the work directly.
* **VMS oversight.**
  Beeline is the system of record in most countries. Where it isn’t, you know what’s used instead and make sure the right processes hold regardless of system.
* **Entity change management.**
  When Raise stands up a new entity anywhere in the region, you own the operational transition, from how it lands with the client to how it’s absorbed internally.
* **Local HR partnership.**
  You work closely with strong local HR teams who carry the deep regulatory and cultural expertise, deferring to their judgment while closing any gap between HR and operations.
* **Regional compliance awareness.**
  You stay alert to legal and regulatory shifts across the region. You’re not the legal expert in any one market, but you know what’s changing, flag it early, and route it to the right person.
* **Financial and reporting infrastructure.**
  Much of the finance reporting and compliance tracking for this region is still being built. You won’t own this alone, but you’ll play an active advisory role alongside the Account Director and our internal reporting teams.
* **PMO collaboration on new country go-lives.**
  You’re a genuine contributor to go-live readiness, working with the PMO throughout and absorbing the operational load once a country is live.
* **The Raise experience, everywhere.**
  Whether someone is working with an established Raise entity or a regional partner, you make sure it feels distinctly, consistently Raise.

**How You’ll Grow Into It**

Growth here means becoming fluent across two operating models at once: hands-on knowledge of how our back office runs in Singapore, India, and the Philippines, and a working expert’s understanding of each partner’s model elsewhere. You’ll build regulatory awareness across the region and develop the instinct for which market needs a light touch and which needs you fully in the weeds.

What You Bring

* Significant experience running contingent workforce, MSP, or staffing operations, ideally across more than one operating model (direct delivery and partner-led delivery)
* Beeline experience strongly preferred
* A track record of managing multiple vendor or partner relationships across large strategic partners and smaller, single-country specialists
* Familiarity with EOR, AOR, and PEO delivery models
* Comfort operating with inconsistent visibility and maturity across countries and partners
* A keen eye for detail on financial and compliance reporting, including comfort helping shape infrastructure that doesn’t fully exist yet
* Familiarity with local customs, currencies, and staffing best practices across APAC
* Experience navigating multi-country compliance, and knowing when to escalate versus defer to local expertise
* A track record of building credibility quickly with senior stakeholders and established client relationships
* Comfort partnering closely with strong local HR functions without needing to own that expertise directly
* Comfort operating across a wide range of time zones and cultures, and supporting leadership based outside the region

**Who Succeeds Here**

This person doesn’t need to run every function to keep it under control, or be the expert in every market on day one. They build trust fast, with an experienced Account Director, with partners, and with local HR teams who expect a real collaborator, not someone doing their job for them.

They notice what’s off before it becomes a problem, whether in a spreadsheet, a partner’s delivery, or a shifting regulation, and know when to solve it themselves versus route it to the right expert. They’re comfortable holding a region together while it’s still finding its shape.

If you can walk into a region this varied, this early in its build-out, and make it feel steady, coherent, and unmistakably Raise, this is your role.

title: Delivery Manager - US Staffing
description:
**Overview**
TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.
  
  
**Job Title: Delivery Manager – US Staffing
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Job Type: Full Time
  
  
Work Type: Onsite
  
  
Shift Timing : US Shift
  
  
Experience: 15+ years**
**Job Description**

* We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Delivery Manager to lead and manage our US Staffing recruitment operations.
* The ideal candidate should have strong experience in US IT and Non-IT staffing, team leadership, client relationship management, MSP/VMS programs and end-to-end recruitment delivery.
* The candidate will be responsible for managing multiple recruitment teams, driving business performance, achieving placement targets, improving delivery efficiency and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
* This role requires a combination of strategic leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management and strong business acumen.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Recruitment Delivery:**

* Lead and manage end-to-end US Staffing recruitment delivery across IT and Non-IT verticals.
* Ensure timely fulfilment of client requirements and achieve monthly, quarterly and annual placement targets.
* Drive recruitment performance through effective sourcing, screening, submission, interview coordination and placement strategies.
* Monitor critical and ageing requirements and ensure timely closures.

**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage multiple recruitment teams consisting of Team Leads, Assistant Managers, Deputy Managers and Recruiters.
* Establish clear performance objectives, productivity benchmarks and accountability across teams.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, identify capability gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Develop leadership capabilities and build a high-performance recruitment culture.
* Drive employee engagement, retention and team development initiatives.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with direct clients, MSPs, implementation partners and hiring managers.
* Participate in client review meetings, business discussions and delivery performance reviews.
* Manage client escalations and ensure effective resolution of delivery challenges.
* Understand client hiring requirements, recruitment processes, SLAs and quality expectations.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and expand account engagement.

**MSP / VMS Program Management**

* Manage recruitment delivery across MSP and VMS-based staffing programs.
* Ensure compliance with client-specific recruitment guidelines and submission processes.
* Demonstrate hands-on knowledge of platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Beeline and other VMS tools.
* Monitor requisition ageing, submission ratios, interview conversion and fulfilment rates.
* Drive process improvements to enhance MSP program performance.

**Business & Financial Management**

* Take ownership of delivery performance, account productivity and business targets.
* Monitor revenue, gross profit, margins and overall account profitability, where applicable.
* Work closely with business leadership to develop delivery strategies and growth plans.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, new business development and additional client requirements.
* Support RFP responses, client presentations and strategic business initiatives.

**MIS, Reporting & Performance Management**

* Analyse daily, weekly and monthly recruitment performance reports.
* Track key performance indicators such as:
* Number of submissions.
* Interview-to-submission ratio.
* Offer-to-joining ratio.
* Number of placements.
* Requirement fulfilment rate.
* Recruiter productivity.
* Time-to-fill and ageing requisitions.
* Revenue and gross profit performance.
* Present delivery updates and performance dashboards to senior management.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective action plans.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience managing Fortune 500 client accounts.
* Exposure to multiple staffing domains such as IT, Engineering, Healthcare, Finance, Manufacturing and Life Sciences.
* Experience managing large recruitment teams across multiple locations.
* Experience in account management, P&L, revenue and margin management.
* Experience in scaling recruitment operations and improving delivery performance.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

title: Diversity & Inclusion Operations Manager for APAC
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

Diversity & Inclusion Operations Manager for APAC is an advisor and regional connector who partners with leaders, HR and key stakeholders to integrate inclusion into workforce, culture, talent and employee-experience priorities. You will develop and execute the APAC D&I roadmap, enables Employee Resource Groups and site-based engagement, and establishes practical governance, capabilities and measures of impact.
