* Promote site-based engagement across priority APAC locations by establishing a approach, supporting locally relevant plans and scaling practices across the region.
* Advise APAC leaders, HR and Talent partners on workforce, culture, talent and employee-experience decisions, using regional insight and data to identify priorities, risks and opportunities.
* Build shared accountability across business and HR team members by establishing clear operating rhythms, decision rights, tools and capabilities that embed inclusion into leadership and people practices.

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Development, Psychology, Social Sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* D&I experience is not a prerequisite for this role. We welcome professionals with experience in business, HR, organisational development, employee engagement, ERGs, site engagement, change management, or programme leadership who want to improve their careers in Diversity & Inclusion. Relevant D&I training and support will be provided.
* Translate enterprise strategy into regional plans and delivering complex programmes across multiple countries, cultures and partner groups.
* Advise leaders and influence decisions in a matrixed organisation.
* Establish governance, annual plans, success measures and reporting for regional or enterprise projects.
* Professional fluency in English and the ability to work across APAC time zones.
* Ability to travel regionally up to 20% of the time.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* 7+ years of work experience
* Support ERGs, inclusion councils, site engagement teams or employee-led communities, including governance, annual planning and influence measurement.
* Use data insights to identify trends, develop recommendations and communicate impact.
* Design or facilitating inclusive leadership learning, leader forums, listening sessions or organisational change projects.
* Working knowledge of cultural, workforce and regulatory considerations across multiple APAC markets.
* Manage budgets, external partners, vendors or programs.
* Additional APAC language capability.

**Leadership Competencies Required**

* Business Insight: Connects D&I priorities to business, workforce, culture and talent outcomes.
* Collaborate: Builds trusted partnerships and shared accountability across a complex matrix organisation.
* Provide clear, audience-relevant advice, facilitation and recommendations.
* Improve Results: Converts strategy into focused plans, governance, measures and sustainable operating rhythms.
* Balances Stakeholders: Integrates enterprise direction, regional needs and local context into sound decisions.
* Cultivate Innovation: Use data, external insight and employee perspectives to improve and scale practices.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalised wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development ... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Senior Manager, Pharmacovigilance Operations
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
  
  
Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
  
  
**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
  
  
***Objective / Purpose :***
The Senior Manager, Pharmacovigilance Operations, serves as a key liaison and point of contact for vendor operations and oversight, including vendors supporting case management, case intake and call-center activities, scientific literature review, and related services. The role provides subject-matter expertise during audits and inspections involving case processing, case management, literature monitoring, legal case processing, and vendor oversight. In collaboration with stakeholders across the broader PSPV organization, the Senior Manager supports harmonized operations and integrated processes that promote regulatory compliance. The role also leads initiatives to improve quality, compliance, productivity, innovation, and efficiency across case processing and related activities.
  
  
***Accountabilities :***

* Oversee day-to-day PSPV and PV Operations activities, including the intake, processing, evaluation, reconciliation, follow-up, and regulatory reporting of ICSRs and other safety information for marketed and investigational products. Monitor work against established timelines, quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements, and address operational issues as they arise.
* Implement and maintain PV Operations procedures, SOPs, case-handling conventions, work instructions, metrics, and monitoring activities. Provide practical guidance to local operating companies, affiliates, and delivery teams on ICSR processing, follow-up with reporters and healthcare professionals, targeted safety questionnaires, and applicable privacy and risk-management requirements.
* Manage and develop PV Operations team members through line management, performance management, mentoring, training, delegation, development planning, and day-to-day workload coordination. Promote effective collaboration and consistent execution across the team.
* Coordinate the day-to-day activities and deliverables of BPO/CRO and other PV vendors supporting case intake and processing, expedited reporting, post-marketing activities, literature review and surveillance, and related services. Monitor performance against Quality Management Plans, SLAs, KPIs, MSAs, budgets, timelines, and quality requirements; review deliverables; track issues and escalations; and coordinate corrective actions.
* Work with Business Partners, Vendor Alliance, Quality, Compliance, Commercial Quality, alliance partners, affiliates, and CROs to support safety data exchange and quality agreements, PVA compliance, partner reconciliation, case exchange, and the evaluation, processing, follow-up, and reporting of ICSRs.
* Coordinate the preparation of submission-ready reports from the Global Safety Database and monitor the timely transmission of adverse-event reports to health authorities, alliance partners, and other applicable recipients in accordance with regulatory timelines, agreements, and privacy requirements.
* Coordinate the review, exchange, reconciliation, and follow-up of product complaints and medical-information requests that may represent potential adverse events, working with Quality Assurance and Commercial Quality as needed.
* Monitor global literature-search and review activities and associated vendor deliverables for investigational and post-marketing products. Help ensure that safety information from market research, patient-support programs, IISR studies, post-marketing observational programs, and other sources is appropriately routed into PV Operations.
* Support audit and inspection readiness and execution by coordinating preparation activities, document requests, responses, interviews, root-cause investigations, corrective and preventive actions, implementation, and effectiveness checks for internal and external PV, GMP, and GCP audits and inspections.
* Coordinate and execute process-improvement and change-management activities, including PV system projects affecting the Global Safety Database, UAT, metric reviews, vendor-task quality checks, training, and the development and maintenance of SOPs, job aids, SharePoint materials, and other operational documentation.
* Coordinate with Clinical, Project Management, and other stakeholders to forecast case volumes, support vendor capacity and staffing plans, and execute ad hoc case-processing activities, including legal cases and cases generated through market research, patient-support programs, and post-marketing surveys.
* Organize and facilitate vendor and stakeholder operating meetings to review KPIs, SLAs, quality, demand forecasts, escalations, service delivery, action items, process changes, and improvement activities. Communicate operational requirements, track decisions and follow-up actions, and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
* Support budget planning with Finance and Project Management; monitor vendor spend, review and approve invoices, confirm billing accuracy, and track delivery against contractual and MSA requirements.
* Perform other duties and contribute to additional initiatives as assigned by PV Operations leadership.

***Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral) :***

* Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in a scientific or medical field is preferred.
* At least 6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, including a minimum of 5 years of pharmacovigilance experience and at least 3 years of experience managing CROs, vendors, and external partnerships. Global experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, including team building, mentoring, motivating, developing, and managing performance.
* Strong knowledge of global pre- and post-market pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and ICH GVP requirements, as well as medical and scientific terminology.
* Advanced understanding of safety databases, including data entry, navigation, case processing, and the use of coding dictionaries such as MedDRA and WHO Drug.
* Proven ability to manage external partner relationships, negotiate effectively, make sound decisions, and represent the department and company professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong strategic, critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions in complex, cross-functional, and global environments and contribute to process improvement aligned with Takeda’s business needs and strategy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present effectively at internal and cross-functional meetings and develop, review, and author SOPs, job aids, and other operational documents.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and flexibly in a fast-paced environment; identify and implement efficiencies; manage multiple competing priorities; and resolve critical issues under pressure.
* Exceptional organizational skills, accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize individual and departmental activities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.

**Travel Requirements:**
Local and international travel across Takeda sites may be required based on business needs.
  
  
**BENEFITS:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career.
  
  
Amongst our benefits are
  
  

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working

* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs

**About Thermo Fisher**
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD. For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
**About Customer Support Center**
At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are committed to being a Product Leadership company that creates innovative solutions across the spectrum of our customers’ needs. Our customer service and support are critical to enabling an exceptional customer experience. Our Customer Support organization is instrumental in these efforts and their seamless alignment across geographies and commercial functions is essential to our success.
  
  
The Bangalore Customer Support Center capability is a well-established team, which supports the North America, EMEA & APJ Order Management and other critical back-office jobs with four shifts working over a 22-hour window/day, together processing over 102,000 requests each month. These three teams are truly pivotal to delivering on our promises of quality, innovation and contribute to the success of our business in India and across the world.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Manager, ANZ Customer Service – Bangalore is the senior offshore leader responsible for establishing, leading and continuously evolving the ANZ Customer Service operation based in Bangalore. The role provides end-to-end accountability for the performance, customer experience, people, service delivery and operational effectiveness of the offshore Customer Service organisation, working in close partnership with the Head of Customer Experience ANZ and ANZ functional leaders.
  
  
The role owns the effective delivery of a broad portfolio of customer service activities spanning order processing, order and supply resolution, commercial and financial resolution, customer support and administration, and voice and phone support. The Manager, ANZ Customer Service - Bangalore will establish and lead an operating model that provides clear accountability, strong governance and seamless integration between onshore and offshore teams.
  
  
As a senior leader within the ANZ Customer Experience organisation, the role will proactively identify customer, operational and organisational opportunities; establish the appropriate structures, capabilities and performance disciplines; and lead transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, productivity, quality, cost and scalability.
  
  
The role will lead through Team Leaders and/or people managers and will be accountable for building a high-performing leadership team, developing organisational capability and establishing a culture of customer focus, ownership, continuous improvement and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Operational & Customer Service Leadership
  
  

* Provide end-to-end accountability for the Bangalore ANZ Customer Service operation, delivering customer, operational and business outcomes.
* Establish and lead the offshore operating model across Order Processing, Order & Supply Resolution, Commercial & Financial Resolution, Customer Support & Administration, and Voice & Phone Support.
* Own service delivery, operational governance and critical escalations, ensuring clear accountability and effective resolution across onshore and offshore teams.
* Proactively identify operational risks, service gaps and emerging business needs, ensuring appropriate action and sustainable resolution.

Customer Experience & Business Outcomes
  
  

* Own offshore customer experience outcomes, embedding a culture of proactive service, accountability and end-to-end resolution.
* Use CAS, Voice of Customer and operational insights to identify and lead systemic improvements to customer experience and service delivery.
* Partner across Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance and Logistics to resolve complex customer issues, supply constraints and revenue-critical priorities.

Performance & Workforce Management
  
  

* Establish and own the performance framework, KPIs and governance required to drive service, productivity, quality and customer outcomes.
* Lead workforce and capacity planning, ensuring capability and resources are aligned to demand and future business requirements.
* Establish a resilient and scalable operation through effective cross-training, contingency planning and performance management.

Continuous Improvement & Transformation
  
  

* Establish and lead the continuous improvement and transformation agenda, improving customer experience, productivity, quality, cost and scalability.
* Proactively identify and lead process simplification, standardization, automation, AI and digital improvement opportunities.
* Lead operational change and ensure improvements are effectively implemented, embedded and sustained.

Stakeholder Leadership
  
  

* Act as the senior Bangalore Customer Service partner for ANZ, building strong relationships with Customer Experience leadership and key business stakeholders.
* Establish effective onshore/offshore governance, ensuring alignment on priorities, performance, risks, escalations and accountabilities.
* Influence across the matrix to resolve complex issues and deliver cross-functional customer and business outcomes.

People & Organisational Leadership
  
  

* Establish and lead a high-performing leadership team, setting clear expectations and accountability for customer, people and operational outcomes.
* Lead organizational capability, talent development and succession planning to support current and future requirements.
* Build a culture of ownership, customer focus, high performance and continuous improvement, developing leaders who proactively identify and resolve issues.

**Frequent Contacts:**
Internal
  
  

* Head of Customer Experience ANZ
* ANZ Customer Service and Customer Experience leadership
* Bangalore Customer Support Center leadership
* Commercial and Sales leadership
* Supply Chain, Planning and Procurement
* Finance and Accounts Receivable
* Logistics, Warehousing and Distribution
* Manufacturing and Operations
* IT, Digital, Automation and Systems teams
* PPI / Continuous Improvement teams
* Other regional and global Customer Service leaders

External
  
  

* Customers, where senior leadership engagement or escalation is required
* Logistics and freight providers
* External service providers and business partners
* Relevant permit/export authorities where required

**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Supply Chain, Operations or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10–15 years’ progressive experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Supply Chain or Operations, including senior people leadership responsibilities.
* Demonstrated experience leading through managers and/or Team Leaders within complex, high-volume operations.
* Proven experience operating within global, matrixed, multi-site and onshore/offshore environments, with strong stakeholder management and influencing capability.
* Demonstrated success leading operational improvement, transformation and organisational change, including building scalable processes and operating models.
* Strong commercial acumen, customer focus and experience using performance data to drive decisions and outcomes.
* Experience with ERP, CRM and customer service technologies; knowledge of PPI, Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement methodologies desirable.

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strong senior leadership capability with the ability to lead through leaders, establish direction and drive accountability.
* Strong customer focus and commercial acumen, with an end-to-end ownership mindset.
* Proven ability to proactively identify risks, opportunities and systemic issues and drive sustainable outcomes.
* Strong operational, analytical and decision-making capability within complex, fast-paced environments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across global, matrixed organisations.
* Strong change leadership and continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to simplify, standardise and leverage digital solutions.
* Strong coaching and talent-development capability, with a track record of building high-performing teams and future leadership capability.

**Other Job Requirements:**

* Adhere to OHS policies and procedures and ensure a safe and healthy workplace environment.

title: Hotel Manager – 25-room business hotel, Hebbal, Bengaluru
description:
Zenith Suites is a 25-room business hotel in North Bengaluru, near Manyata Tech Park and Mall of Asia, serving corporate and business travellers through online travel sites and direct corporate accounts. We are hiring a Hotel Manager to run the hotel end to end, so that it runs well without the owner on the floor.

What you will own

* The whole operation: front office, housekeeping, kitchen and room service, maintenance, purchases.
* The numbers: occupancy, room rate, online ratings and reviews, costs within budget, daily and monthly reports.
* The team: hire, train and roster six to eight staff. We expect you to bring good people with you or know where to find them.
* Guests and corporate clients: complaints settled the same day, corporate accounts kept and grown.
* Systems: hotel PMS, OTA extranets, Google Business Profile, WhatsApp-based workflows and AI assistants. You must be comfortable using them.

What we need

* Graduate from a recognised university (hotel management, business or commerce). Not negotiable.
* 5+ years in hotel operations, at least 2 as manager or assistant manager of a 20 to 80 room hotel.
* Has built a hotel team before and has a network of housekeeping, front office and kitchen staff and vendors in Bengaluru.
* Hands-on, gets work done without being chased, honest, steady, available on call.
* Reads a P&L, controls costs, understands OTA pricing.
* English and Hindi or Kannada.

Pay, kept simple

* Fixed ₹30,000 a month.
* Incentive on the hotel's monthly net revenue (after OTA commissions and taxes) above ₹7 lakh: 3% on the first lakh above ₹7 lakh, 4% on the next lakh, 5% on everything after that. No cap.
* ₹5,000 bonus in every month the hotel crosses ₹8 lakh, and ₹10,000 extra when that happens three months in a row.
* ₹2,000 for every staff member you bring who completes 60 days.
* Example: a ₹10 lakh month pays ₹47,000 in all; a full hotel pays ₹60,000 to ₹85,000.
* Incentives are paid with the next month's salary, on money received.
* Accommodation at the hotel available. Six-day week. Three-month probation on the same terms. Joining within 30 days.

How to apply

Apply here, or email your CV with your current salary and notice period to zenithsuites@gmail.com with the subject "Hotel Manager". Shortlisted candidates meet the owner at the hotel.

title: Manager – Global Learning Services
description:
The
**Manager – Global Learning Services**
is responsible for managing regional and global learning services, providing expertise in learning management systems and learning operations, and supporting the planning and delivery of global and regional learning projects and initiatives.
  
  
The role drives operational excellence through effective service delivery, stakeholder collaboration, project management, governance, risk management, and continuous improvement. The Manager acts as a key point of contact for learning operations, working across functions and geographies to ensure consistent, scalable, and high-quality learning services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Operations & Service Delivery**

* Manage the execution of regional and global learning services, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Monitor operational performance across learning service activities and proactively address delivery gaps, risks, and dependencies.
* Act as a subject matter expert for learning operations, LMS processes, and system functionality.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and learning stakeholders to enable smooth execution of learning initiatives.
* Establish effective operating rhythms and communication channels to maintain visibility of priorities, progress, dependencies, and risks.
* Support the resolution of complex operational issues and facilitate timely decision-making.
* Manage multiple priorities and learning requirements across regions and stakeholder groups.

**Governance & Learning Standards**

* Ensure learning services are delivered in accordance with established policies, learning standards, governance frameworks, and service expectations.
* Work within defined SLAs, KPIs, processes, and learning governance requirements.
* Provide subject matter expertise on learning standards, LMS/CSOD functionality, and operational processes.
* Support the implementation and adoption of new or updated learning governance requirements.
* Identify process and governance gaps and work with relevant stakeholders to improve operational consistency.
* Provide guidance to stakeholders on learning processes, governance requirements, and appropriate operational solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Project Delivery**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with regional and global learning stakeholders.
* Lead stakeholder discussions on priorities, requirements, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and upcoming initiatives.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand business and learning requirements and translate them into practical learning solutions.
* Manage learning initiatives and projects from requirements and planning through deployment and stabilization.
* Coordinate across stakeholders, internal teams, vendors, and partners to ensure alignment and timely execution.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively address potential delivery concerns.
* Use operational insights and data to support decisions and communicate service performance and impact.

**Project Management**

* Support the planning and delivery of global and regional learning projects and initiatives.
* Coordinate project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies to support timely execution.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, internal teams, and partners to address risks and ensure alignment throughout delivery.
* Track progress and provide clear project updates through implementation and transition to operations.

**Escalation & Risk Management**

* Identify operational risks, issues, and dependencies early and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Manage operational escalations with clear context, impact assessment, recommended actions, ownership, and resolution timelines.
* Identify recurring service or delivery issues and work with relevant stakeholders to address root causes.
* Assess operational, delivery, technology, security, and business continuity risks relevant to learning services.
* Identify critical process dependencies and support appropriate continuity and risk-mitigation measures.
* Escalate issues appropriately when they have the potential to impact service delivery, learners, stakeholders, or business outcomes.

**Process Improvement & Innovation**

* Evaluate learning operations and workflows to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead initiatives focused on process simplification, standardization, efficiency, and scalability.
* Conduct gap and root-cause analysis and translate findings into practical improvement actions.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved use of learning technologies.
* Define appropriate measures and KPIs to evaluate the impact and sustainability of improvements.
* Drive adoption of improved processes and ways of working across relevant stakeholder groups.
* Stay informed on learning technology capabilities and identify opportunities to improve learner and stakeholder experience.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Collaborate effectively across global and regional teams, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Share learning operations expertise, best practices, and knowledge with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Support stakeholders in understanding learning processes, LMS capabilities, and governance requirements.
* Contribute to an environment of trust, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Promote consistent ways of working and effective knowledge sharing across learning services.

**Self-Leadership & Development**

* Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned learning services, projects, and initiatives.
* Independently manage priorities, deliverables, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen service delivery, processes, and tools.
* Seek and act on feedback to continuously improve effectiveness.
* Maintain and develop expertise in learning operations, LMS capabilities, project delivery, and emerging learning technologies.
* Effectively manage competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, regions, and initiatives.

**What's in it for me?**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* 4 – 7 years experience in learning operations, learning services, HR operations, shared services, or a related environment.
* Strong knowledge of learning operations and Learning Management Systems, preferably Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) or equivalent platforms.
* Experience managing complex learning projects or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Good understanding of service delivery principles, SLAs, KPIs, operational risk, and learning governance.
* Ability to analyze complex operational issues and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Exposure to continuous improvement and Agile methodologies is desirable.

title: Associate Manager - Food and Beverage
description:
**Job description**

To oversee and manage the hospital's food and beverage operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, hygiene, nutrition, patient and staff satisfaction, cost control, and operational efficiency. The role is responsible for managing patient meals, staff cafeterias, visitor food services, and other catering operations in compliance with hospital policies and applicable food safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities

A. Food & Beverage Operations

- Oversee daily food production, service, distribution, and catering operations across the hospital.

- Ensure timely delivery of meals to patients, staff, visitors, and consultants.

- Coordinate with the Dietary Department, Nursing, Purchase, Housekeeping, and other departments for smooth operations.

- Monitor food quality, portion sizes, presentation, and consistency of service.

- Ensure adequate food availability and effective management of kitchen and cafeteria operations.

B. Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and hospital food safety policies.

- Maintain high standards of kitchen hygiene, sanitation, food storage, and personal hygiene.

- Conduct regular inspections and internal audits of kitchen, cafeteria, and food service areas.

- Monitor food temperature, expiry dates, pest control, and prevention of cross-contamination.

- Maintain records related to food safety, cleaning schedules, and quality checks.

C. Patient Food Services

- Ensure timely and accurate delivery of patient meals as per prescribed dietary requirements.

- Coordinate with clinical dietitians and nursing teams regarding therapeutic diets, allergies, and special meal requests.

- Establish systems to minimise meal errors, food wastage, and patient complaints.

- Monitor patient feedback and implement corrective actions to improve satisfaction.

D. Financial & Inventory Management

- Prepare and monitor departmental budgets and operating expenses.

- Control food costs, wastage, and consumption through effective planning and monitoring.

- Manage inventory, stock rotation, procurement, and vendor coordination.

- Ensure appropriate storage and utilisation of raw materials and finished food products.

- Review operational costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising quality.

E. Team Management & Development

- Supervise chefs, kitchen staff, food service associates, cafeteria staff, and supervisors.

- Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate staffing across shifts.

- Train team members on food safety, hygiene, service standards, and customer handling.

- Conduct performance reviews and support employee development.

- Maintain discipline, teamwork, and adherence to hospital policies.

F. Customer Service & Stakeholder Management

- Address complaints and feedback from patients, attendants, employees, and visitors.

- Coordinate with hospital leadership to improve food service standards.

- Monitor service quality and ensure professional, courteous interactions.

- Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer experience and service efficiency.

G. Reporting & Quality Improvement

- Prepare periodic reports on food costs, consumption, wastage, complaints, and departmental performance.

- Track key performance indicators and implement corrective and preventive actions.

- Participate in quality audits, hospital accreditation activities, and departmental reviews.

- Identify process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Patient and customer satisfaction scores.

- Timely delivery of patient meals.

- Food safety and hygiene audit scores.

- Food cost and budget adherence.

- Reduction in food wastage.

- Inventory accuracy and stock control.

- Number of food quality complaints and corrective actions.

- Employee productivity, training, and retention.

- Compliance with applicable statutory and hospital standards.

4. Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Management, or a related field.

- Additional certification in food safety, catering operations, or hospitality management is preferred.

5. Experience

- 5 - 8 years of relevant experience in food and beverage, catering, or hospitality operations.

- Prior experience in a hospital, healthcare institution, large institutional kitchen, or high-volume catering setup is preferred.

- Experience in managing large teams, budgets, vendors, and food service operations is essential.

6. Key Skills & Competencies

- Strong operational and people management skills.

- Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.

- Budgeting, cost control, and inventory management.

- Vendor management and procurement coordination.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency in MS Office and food service or inventory management systems.

7. Working Conditions

- Ability to work in a 24/7 hospital environment, including weekends and holidays as required.

- Willingness to conduct regular kitchen, cafeteria, and food service inspections.

- Ability to manage operational issues and coordinate with multiple departments.

title: Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding- Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and delivery-focused Team Lead to manage end-to-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business-as-usual operations.
  
  
The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
  
  
Why this role is important to us
  
  
The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day-to-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
  
  
The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
  
  
What you will be responsible for
  
  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead-account, match-rule, workflow, and static-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Lead root-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit-ready.
* Oversee post-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker-checker controls, information-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.

What we value
  
  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead root-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project-tracking, workflow, data-visualization, and process-documentation tools.

**Education And Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience managing relationships with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, technology teams, and global operations stakeholders.
* Experience managing implementation risks, testing governance, production readiness, stabilization, and operational handover.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or related workflow and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Demonstrated involvement in automation, system enhancements, process transformation, or operating-model improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing management information, capacity views, performance metrics, and executive-level project updates.

**Shift Timings:**
EMEA/NA
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bangalore
  
  
**About State Street**
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors. From technology and product innovation to investment servicing, data and analytics, research, trading, and investment management, we help clients safeguard and steward investments around the world.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We aim to create an environment where employees can perform at their best and continue to develop. Our benefits and development programmed vary by location and may include medical coverage, insurance, savings plans, flexible-work arrangements, learning opportunities, and educational support.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where employees can contribute and grow. We also support active engagement with communities through volunteering, charitable programmers, and employee networks.
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
Assistant Manager – CX & Ops (Travel Category)
  
  
**About CREW**
CREW is Swiggy's premium travel concierge, built to take the stress out of planning and traveling for busy professionals. Instead of leaving customers to stitch together flights, hotels, visas and on-ground logistics across five different apps, CREW brings it all into one place - backed by real people, powered by AI.
  
  
**What Sets CREW Apart**
Member-only hotel rates: Negotiated prices on domestic and international stays
  
  
24×7 on-trip assistance: A concierge that stays live from planning to landing
  
  
Deep destination expertise: From the best activities to currency exchange to making the most of every day at the destination
  
  
One stop shop: Hotels, flights, visas, trip planning, forex, cabs and insurance - all in one place, so there's no juggling five platforms for one trip
  
  
By combining human expertise with seamless service delivery, CREW lets customers focus on the reason they're traveling - work, family or leisure - while we handle the details before, during and after the trip.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-focused Assistant Manager - Cx & Ops (Travel Category) to run day-to-day delivery on the Travel Desk. You will lead a team of Crew Captains who plan, book and coordinate trips for premium users, and you will own the outcome on your team: that the trip we promised is the trip the customer actually gets.
  
  
This is a hands-on, delivery-side ops role. On any given day you are on the floor - unblocking a Captain mid-mission, chasing a hotel or DMC for a confirmation that hasn't landed, rebalancing load across the shift, and stepping in yourself on the trips that need a sharper hand. You'll report to the Senior Manager - Travel & Ops, work to the desk's SOPs and escalation ladder, and be the person who spots where they break in practice and pushes the fix.
  
  
CREW is early, and much of how the Travel Desk works is still being written. You won't be handed a finished playbook - you'll be one of the people whose day-to-day makes it real. We're looking for someone from a genuine travel background - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge - who has planned trips themselves and knows what actually breaks on the ground. The ideal candidate has a strong ops mindset, a bias for action and high ownership, and gets things done without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead and coach a team of Crew Captains - daily huddles, quality feedback on live missions, and building depth so service doesn't depend on who happened to pick up the mission
  
  
Own trip delivery on your team end to end - coordination with hotels, DMCs, transport partners and on-ground vendors so bookings, changes and cancellations land correctly and on time.
  
  
Deliver against conversion, TAT, fulfillment and NPS/CSAT targets for your pod, and contribute to desk-level GMV goals.
  
  
Run the shift - task distribution, load balancing and live coverage, so the desk is genuinely staffed when customers are traveling: nights, weekends and peak season included.
  
  
Be the first line of escalation for your Captains. Resolve on-ground issues in the moment, escalate the ones that need it, and close the loop so the same failure doesn't recur next week.
  
  
Run the SOPs and flag where they don't hold up in the real world so they can be sharpened.
  
  
Automation and AI-assisted ops: Spot the manual work worth removing, and work with the desk lead, product and engineering to get it fixed. Comfort working alongside AI tooling is not optional in this role.
  
  
Travel craft: Hold the creative bar on itineraries and recommendations - the destination knowledge and taste that make a CREW trip feel different from a booking confirmation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  
  
Must be based in Bangalore.
  
  
Open to rotational shifts (5-day work week including weekends).
  
  
3-5 years in travel - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge/travel services - with hands-on trip planning experience of your own.
  
  
1+ year leading or mentoring a team in a service or operations setup.
  
  
Hands-on vendor coordination: you've held a third party to a service standard when the customer was already waiting.
  
  
Strong ops mindset with a demonstrated bias for action and high ownership.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication and leadership skills.
  
  
Strong creativity and attention to detail in travel planning.
  
  
Ability to perform under pressure while ensuring a seamless customer experience.
  
  
Passion for delivering outstanding, personalized experiences for premium users.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes

**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
Assistant Manager – CX & Ops (Travel Category)
  
  
**About CREW**
CREW is Swiggy's premium travel concierge, built to take the stress out of planning and traveling for busy professionals. Instead of leaving customers to stitch together flights, hotels, visas and on-ground logistics across five different apps, CREW brings it all into one place - backed by real people, powered by AI.
  
  
**What Sets CREW Apart**
Member-only hotel rates: Negotiated prices on domestic and international stays
  
  
24×7 on-trip assistance: A concierge that stays live from planning to landing
  
  
Deep destination expertise: From the best activities to currency exchange to making the most of every day at the destination
  
  
One stop shop: Hotels, flights, visas, trip planning, forex, cabs and insurance - all in one place, so there's no juggling five platforms for one trip
  
  
By combining human expertise with seamless service delivery, CREW lets customers focus on the reason they're traveling - work, family or leisure - while we handle the details before, during and after the trip.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-focused Assistant Manager - Cx & Ops (Travel Category) to run day-to-day delivery on the Travel Desk. You will lead a team of Crew Captains who plan, book and coordinate trips for premium users, and you will own the outcome on your team: that the trip we promised is the trip the customer actually gets.
  
  
This is a hands-on, delivery-side ops role. On any given day you are on the floor - unblocking a Captain mid-mission, chasing a hotel or DMC for a confirmation that hasn't landed, rebalancing load across the shift, and stepping in yourself on the trips that need a sharper hand. You'll report to the Senior Manager - Travel & Ops, work to the desk's SOPs and escalation ladder, and be the person who spots where they break in practice and pushes the fix.
  
  
CREW is early, and much of how the Travel Desk works is still being written. You won't be handed a finished playbook - you'll be one of the people whose day-to-day makes it real. We're looking for someone from a genuine travel background - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge - who has planned trips themselves and knows what actually breaks on the ground. The ideal candidate has a strong ops mindset, a bias for action and high ownership, and gets things done without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead and coach a team of Crew Captains - daily huddles, quality feedback on live missions, and building depth so service doesn't depend on who happened to pick up the mission
  
  
Own trip delivery on your team end to end - coordination with hotels, DMCs, transport partners and on-ground vendors so bookings, changes and cancellations land correctly and on time.
  
  
Deliver against conversion, TAT, fulfillment and NPS/CSAT targets for your pod, and contribute to desk-level GMV goals.
  
  
Run the shift - task distribution, load balancing and live coverage, so the desk is genuinely staffed when customers are traveling: nights, weekends and peak season included.
  
  
Be the first line of escalation for your Captains. Resolve on-ground issues in the moment, escalate the ones that need it, and close the loop so the same failure doesn't recur next week.
  
  
Run the SOPs and flag where they don't hold up in the real world so they can be sharpened.
  
  
Automation and AI-assisted ops: Spot the manual work worth removing, and work with the desk lead, product and engineering to get it fixed. Comfort working alongside AI tooling is not optional in this role.
  
  
Travel craft: Hold the creative bar on itineraries and recommendations - the destination knowledge and taste that make a CREW trip feel different from a booking confirmation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  
  
Must be based in Bangalore.
  
  
Open to rotational shifts (5-day work week including weekends).
  
  
3-5 years in travel - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge/travel services - with hands-on trip planning experience of your own.
  
  
1+ year leading or mentoring a team in a service or operations setup.
  
  
Hands-on vendor coordination: you've held a third party to a service standard when the customer was already waiting.
  
  
Strong ops mindset with a demonstrated bias for action and high ownership.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal, communication and leadership skills.
  
  
Strong creativity and attention to detail in travel planning.
  
  
Ability to perform under pressure while ensuring a seamless customer experience.
  
  
Passion for delivering outstanding, personalized experiences for premium users.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

title: HR & Admin Executive
description:
**Job Purpose**

Under the guidance of BU HRBP and in coordination with the Plant Head and EHS Lead/External EHS Consultant, responsible for executing and coordinating daily HR and administration activities at the India plant, covering recruitment and onboarding, attendance and payroll calculation support, employee records and statutory compliance documentation, daily employee relations support, training and performance process coordination, administrative logistics, HR data maintenance, and EHS daily coordination and record-keeping support. Serves as the daily execution bridge between BU HRBP and the India plant, ensuring HR, admin and EHS support activities are accurate, timely and compliant, and submitted to BU HRBP and authorized approvers for review and approval per process.

在BU HRBP指导下，与印度工厂厂长及EHS负责人/外部EHS顾问保持协调，负责印度工厂日常人事与行政工作的执行和协调，涵盖招聘与入职、考勤与薪资核算支持、员工档案与法定合规文件准备、员工关系日常支持、培训与绩效流程协调、行政后勤对接、HR数据维护，以及EHS日常协调与文件记录支持。作为BU HRBP与印度工厂之间的日常执行桥梁，确保人事行政及EHS支持工作准确、及时、合规，并按流程提交BU HRBP及相关授权人复核与审批。

**Responsibilities**

**(1) 招聘与入职执行 / Recruitment & Onboarding Execution**

* 根据工厂投产及扩产计划，在BU HRBP指导下执行本地招聘活动，包括职位发布、简历筛选、面试协调、招聘渠道日常维护及招聘数据记录。
* 办理录用通知、合同签订、法定登记、系统录入及新员工档案建立，确保入职资料完整。
* 跟踪招聘周期和成本数据，定期向BU HRBP汇报招聘进展。
* Execute local recruitment activities under BU HRBP guidance aligned with plant ramp-up and expansion plans, including job posting, CV screening, interview coordination, daily maintenance of recruitment channels, and recruitment data recording.
* Handle offer issuance, contract signing, statutory registration, system entry and new employee file creation, ensuring complete onboarding documentation.
* Track time-to-fill and recruitment cost data, and report recruitment progress to BU HRBP regularly.

**(2) 考勤、工时与薪资核算支持 / Attendance, Working Hours & Payroll Calculation Support**

* 维护生物识别考勤系统，处理排班、请假、加班授权记录及工时统计，确保考勤数据准确。
* 按月准备薪资核算输入，包括工资构成、考勤/加班数据、扣款及PF/ESIC/PT等法定缴纳数据。
* 编制工资单及法定申报所需资料，按流程提交BU HRBP/财务/厂长复核审批。
* 维护薪资、考勤及法定缴纳相关记录，配合审计和检查。
* Maintain biometric attendance system, process shift schedules, leave, overtime authorization records and working-hour statistics, ensuring attendance data accuracy.
* Prepare monthly payroll inputs, including salary components, attendance/overtime data, deductions and statutory contribution data such as PF/ESIC/PT.
* Prepare payroll sheets and documents required for statutory filings, and submit to BU HRBP/Finance/Plant Head for review and approval per process.
* Maintain payroll, attendance and statutory contribution records, and support audits and inspections.

**(3) 员工档案与合规文件管理 / Employee Records & Compliance Documentation**

* 维护员工个人档案、劳动合同、法定登记册、培训记录及离职文件，确保完整、可追溯。
* 协助PF/ESIC/PT、CLRA、Factories Act及《劳资关系法典》相关申报、更新和日常合规操作。
* 跟踪中央及邦级劳动法规变化，及时提醒BU HRBP，并协助更新内部表单和流程。
* 准备客户CSR验厂及劳动监察所需HR与劳工合规文件，协调现场安排并陪同检查；不独立代表公司作法律陈述或争议调解。
* Maintain employee personal files, employment contracts, statutory registers, training records and exit documents, ensuring completeness and traceability.
* Support PF/ESIC/PT, CLRA, Factories Act and Industrial Relations Code related filings, updates and daily compliance operations.
* Track central and state labour regulation changes, promptly remind BU HRBP, and support updating internal forms and processes.
* Prepare HR and labour compliance documents required for customer CSR audits and labour inspections, coordinate site arrangements and accompany inspections; do not independently represent the company in legal statements or dispute conciliation.

**(4) 员工关系日常支持 / Daily Employee Relations Support**

* 受理日常员工咨询和申诉，按流程记录、跟进并向BU HRBP升级。
* 协助纪律程序的文件准备、会议安排和记录归档。
* 组织员工沟通会、满意度调查、离职面谈、交接手续及最终结算资料准备。
* 协助组织员工关怀与凝聚力活动，推动集团文化与本地文化融合。
* 支持与本地劳动部门、法定机构的日常联络和资料提交。
* Handle daily employee inquiries and grievances, record and follow up per process, and escalate to BU HRBP.
* Support documentation preparation, meeting arrangement and record filing for disciplinary procedures.
* Organize employee communication meetings, satisfaction surveys, exit interviews, handover procedures and final settlement document preparation.
* Support employee care and engagement activities, and promote integration of Group culture with local culture.
* Support daily liaison and document submission with local labour authorities and statutory bodies.

**(5) 培训与绩效流程协调 / Training & Performance Process Coordination**

* 按BU HRBP部署，协调入职培训、合规复训及安全培训的安排、签到和记录维护。
* 维护完整培训档案，确保满足客户审核和劳动监察的可追溯要求。
* 协调绩效目标设定、中期回顾和年度评估的流程通知、数据收集与汇总。
* 协助PIP相关文件跟踪和会议安排，确保流程记录完整。
* As deployed by BU HRBP, coordinate induction training, compliance refresher training and safety training arrangements, attendance and record maintenance.
* Maintain complete training records to meet traceability requirements for customer audits and labour inspections.
* Coordinate performance goal setting, mid-year review and annual appraisal process notifications, data collection and consolidation.
* Support PIP-related document tracking and meeting arrangements, ensuring complete process records.

**(6) EHS日常协调与文件支持 / EHS Daily Coordination & Documentation Support**

* 协助EHS负责人/外部EHS顾问开展工厂EHS日常事务，包括安全培训组织、签到记录、培训档案维护及员工EHS入职教育协调。
* 维护EHS相关台账和记录，包括PPE发放记录、职业健康检查记录、事故/未遂事件登记、应急演练记录、消防检查跟踪及整改闭环资料。
* 协助收集和归档EHS法定许可、检测报告、供应商EHS文件及客户CSR/劳动监察所需的EHS资料。
* 协调EHS检查、安全委员会会议、应急演练及消防/安全标识检查的行政安排，跟踪整改事项并提醒责任部门。
* 配合客户审核、劳动监察及总部EHS专项检查，准备EHS文件清单、协调现场陪同并跟踪整改证据提交。
* 在EHS专业判断、事故调查结论、法定安全官职责及高风险作业审批事项上，及时升级至EHS负责人/厂长，不独立作出EHS技术决定。
* Support EHS Lead/External EHS Consultant in daily plant EHS affairs, including organizing safety training, attendance records, training file maintenance and coordination of employee EHS induction education.
* Maintain EHS-related ledgers and records, including PPE issuance records, occupational health examination records, accident/near-miss registers, emergency drill records, fire inspection tracking and corrective action closure documents.
* Support collection and filing of EHS statutory permits, test reports, supplier EHS documents and EHS materials required for customer CSR audits and labour inspections.
* Coordinate administrative arrangements for EHS inspections, safety committee meetings, emergency drills and fire/safety signage checks, track corrective actions and remind responsible departments.
* Support customer audits, labour inspections and HQ EHS special inspections, prepare EHS document lists, coordinate site accompaniment and track submission of corrective action evidence.
* Escalate EHS professional judgment, accident investigation conclusions, statutory safety officer responsibilities and high-risk work approvals to EHS Lead/Plant Head/External EHS Consultant in a timely manner; do not independently make EHS technical decisions.

**(7) 行政后勤执行与对接 / Administration & Logistics Execution**

* 协调印度工厂食堂、宿舍、通勤班车、安保及办公环境的日常管理，跟踪服务质量和成本。
* 评估并推荐本地行政供应商（餐饮、交通、劳务外包等），跟踪合同执行、账实一致及服务问题整改；合同审批按公司授权执行。
* 负责总部出差人员及来访客户的本地接待安排，协调签证、住宿和交通。
* 协助PPE、办公用品及行政物资的库存与发放管理。
* Coordinate daily management of canteen, dormitory, commuting shuttle, security and office environment at the India plant, tracking service quality and cost.
* Evaluate and recommend local admin vendors (catering, transportation, labour outsourcing, etc.), track contract execution, asset-reality consistency and service issue rectification; contract approval shall follow company authorization.
* Arrange local reception for HQ business travelers and visiting clients, coordinating visa, accommodation and transportation.
* Support inventory and issuance management of PPE, office supplies and administrative materials.

**(8) 数据与报表 / Data & Reporting**

* 维护HR系统及Excel台账，确保人员结构、考勤、加班、离职率等基础数据准确。
* 定期编制HR、行政及EHS支持相关基础报表，为BU HRBP及管理层决策提供数据支持。
* 配合BU HRBP完成人力资源数据收集、审计资料准备及其他专项工作。
* Maintain HR systems and Excel ledgers, ensuring accuracy of basic data such as workforce structure, attendance, overtime and attrition rate.
* Prepare regular basic reports related to HR, administration and EHS support, providing data support for BU HRBP and management decision-making.
* Support BU HRBP in HR data collection, audit material preparation and other special assignments.

**Requirements**

**(1) Education & Experience 学历与经验**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in HRM, Business Administration, Law or related fields preferred; 6+ years of HR/Admin experience, including at least 3 years as HR & Admin Manager or equivalent in Indian manufacturing. Experience supporting Chinese-invested plant setup or operations is a strong plus.
* 本科及以上学历，人力资源管理、工商管理、法学等相关专业优先；6年以上人事行政经验，其中至少3年印度当地制造业同等管理岗位经验；有中资企业印度工厂筹建或运营支持经验者优先。

**(2) Language 语言能力**

* Chinese speaking is mandatory; Chinese is a required working language; English is required as a working language.
* 会说中文，中文为必备工作语言；英文可作为工作语言。

**(3) Labour Law & Compliance 法律法规与合规实操**

* Hands-on experience with local labour laws and regulations, including practical implementation of wage structure compliance, FTE gratuity eligibility, and overtime compliance. Familiar with PF/ESI contribution mechanics, wage ceilings, monthly filing procedures, local minimum wage structures (Basic + VDA), and CSR audit processes.
* 具备当地劳动法律法规的实操经验（含工资结构合规、FTE服务金资格及加班合规）；熟悉PF/ESI缴纳机制、工资上限、月度申报流程、当地最低工资结构及CSR验厂流程。

**(4) Data & Systems 数据与系统**

* Proficient in MS Office with strong data analysis capability.
* 熟练使用MS Office，具备数据分析能力。

**(5) Competencies 综合素质**

* Cross-cultural management capability; familiar with manufacturing plant management modes.
* 具备跨文化管理能力；熟悉制造业工厂管理模式。

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Citi, you will design, build, and evolve mission-critical application systems that support global technology and business operations. You will own full stack development across the software lifecycle, applying Core Java, Spring, ReactJS, and modern CI/CD practices to deliver secure, high-performing solutions. This role offers the opportunity to shape system design, mentor junior engineers, and work directly with business stakeholders to solve complex technical challenges.

* Design and build full stack application solutions, guiding new and enhanced systems from feasibility studies through complete lifecycle delivery.
* Lead each phase of the development process, including analysis, design, coding, testing, and implementation, while providing ongoing operational support to business users.
* Analyze complex technical and business problems to evaluate system performance against industry standards and recommend practical solutions.
* Develop and implement security measures based on post-implementation reviews to strengthen system design and functionality.
* Partner with clients and technology teams to resolve issues and deliver advanced programming solutions for customer-facing systems.

* Mentor junior developers and analysts, sharing technical expertise to strengthen team capability.

Citi gives you the opportunity to grow your technical expertise while working on systems that support global markets and business operations.

* Collaborate with technology teams across global offices on large-scale application development projects.
* Access ongoing learning and development programs to build deep expertise in modern engineering practices and emerging tools.
* Gain exposure to complex, high-impact systems that sharpen your technical and problem-solving skills.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?**

The quality of school education available to students from low-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.

We run free and high-impact schools and an exceptional college-to-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world-class professional development, our result-oriented team culture, and our student-centric school design. Read more about us at www.iTeachSchools.org.

**Responsibilities**

iTeach is scaling — from a 500-person organisation today to 1,000+ over the next five years. That's not just a headcount number. It means new schools, new cities, new layers of leadership, and thousands more students getting a real shot at a different life. It also means the systems, culture, and people practices that got us here need to be rebuilt for where we're going.

This is where you come in.

iTeach's founding belief is "first who, then what" — we bet everything on our people. Get their experience right, every day, every year, and everything else follows. The HR Lead sits at the centre of that bet: you'll be the person leadership turns to for a real-time pulse on the health of the organisation, the architect of the systems that let us scale without losing what makes iTeach
*iTeach*
, and a builder of people-management muscle across every team.

You'll work as part of the Network Team's People Ops function, partnering closely with People Ops leadership on three fronts: designing a genuinely great staff experience, owning the policies, processes, and systems that keep the organisation running smoothly, and building people-management capacity across the org — from first-time managers to school leaders.

**Be the pulse of the organisation**

* Own how leadership sees organisational health — through regular staff check-ins, early-warning signals on brewing issues, and a sharp eye for helping leaders spot emerging talent as fast as emerging problems.
* Track and report on the metrics that matter — attrition, engagement, and other leading indicators — so leadership always has a real, current read on how the org is actually doing
* Turn what you see into action, not just dashboards.

**Build the systems for 500 → 1,000**

* Revamp the HR systems, tools, and processes that need to hold up at double our current size — leave tracking, punctuality, payroll, and beyond — designed for great user experience, easy review, and powerful analytics.
* Study trends across teams and locations and get ahead of the policy and system shifts we'll need before we need them.
* Design, refine, and future-proof our HR, Promotion, and related policies so they stay sharp, relevant, and fully compliant as we grow.
* Partner with managers across the org to work through underperformance, code-of-conduct issues, extended leaves, and similar situations with clarity and care.

**Champion engagement and well-being**

* Design and run programs that make iTeach a genuinely great place to work.
* Own staff engagement measurement using structured frameworks.
* Review and benchmark staff benefits so we stay competitive as we scale.

**Lead the team**

* Lead and grow a team of 5-6 HR Associates, setting the direction, standards, and support they need to deliver on everything below.
* Build long-term plans for the team — a clear vision, concrete goals, and a growth path for each Associate — so the team scales in capability, not just headcount.

**Prerequisites**

* Required: 5+ years of work experience overall, with 2 + years leading a team
* Required: Experience in People/ HR verticals
* Preferred: Experience in a school system/education organisation

**Compensation and Benefits:**
We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 9.0 - 10.5 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

**Role Objective**
Drive the organization's talent acquisition strategy by attracting, assessing, and hiring high-quality talent across IT and Non-IT functions. * Excellent stakeholder management and business partnering skills.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI, with familiarity in Copilot, EYQ, and other AI-enabled tools considered desirable.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier professional training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, India, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. The academy is recognized as one of India’s leading providers of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, with a strong focus on international exam success and global employability. MIA offers specialized preparatory programs for major language tests and healthcare professional assessments, supported by experienced trainers certified by global bodies. The institution combines evidence-based teaching methods, digital tools, and personalized coaching to serve both online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for learners across healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at the Kochi center. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. The manager will implement HR policies and procedures, ensure compliance with relevant labor laws, and support workforce planning in line with the academy’s growth objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include resolving employee relations issues, coordinating training and development initiatives, managing HR documentation and HRIS systems, and collaborating with leadership on organizational culture and change management. The role also involves partnering with department heads to identify talent needs, support retention strategies, and promote a positive, inclusive work environment.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in recruitment, talent acquisition, and workforce planning.
* Candidates should possess skills in performance management, employee engagement, and organizational development.
* Candidates should possess skills in HR policy implementation, compliance with labor laws, and HR documentation.
* Candidates should possess skills in conflict resolution, employee relations, and grievance handling.
* Candidates should possess skills in training coordination, learning and development, and coaching.
* Candidates should possess skills in HRIS usage, data management, and basic HR analytics.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills are required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar senior HR role, ideally in education or training services, is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi, handle multiple priorities, and uphold non-discriminatory, inclusive HR practices is essential.

description:

[Mention Location]

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented
**MIS Manager**
to manage the organisation's end-to-end reporting, data management, business analytics, and management dashboards. The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining MIS reports, generating business insights, tracking operational performance, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting to internal management and clients.

The ideal candidate should have advanced expertise in
**MS Excel, PowerPoint, data analysis, dashboard creation, and client management**

**4. Management Reporting & Presentations**

* Prepare management review presentations, business performance reports, and PowerPoint decks.
* Present data-driven insights and operational updates to senior leadership.

  **MS PowerPoint**
  for management and client presentations.

* Experience in handling multiple stakeholders and client-facing reporting.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and presentation skills.

Preferred Experience

Key Competencies
