title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A
description:
**The Opportunity**
Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst - GPG / Hub FP&A to join the Finance Center of Excellence (COE) in Bengaluru, India. In this role, you will partner with Global Product Groups (GPGs), Business Units, Hubs, and Factory stakeholders to provide strategic financial planning, profitability analysis, and decision support.
  
  
As a trusted finance partner to the GPG/Hub Controller and business leadership, you will drive insights on product profitability, pricing, commercial performance, forecasting, and product economics. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence business decisions through advanced analytics, financial modeling, and collaboration with global stakeholders across commercial, operations, supply chain, and product management functions.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Analyze product line, customer, project, and factory financial performance, providing actionable insights on orders, revenue, margins, and profitability.
* Perform detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast, and actual results, identifying impacts from price, volume, mix, material costs, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate sales pipelines, order intake, backlog quality, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy to identify risks and opportunities.
* Support pricing strategies, deal reviews, and bid evaluations through margin analysis, scenario modeling, and price realization tracking.
* Lead forecasting activities for orders, revenue, gross margin, and EBIT, ensuring alignment between commercial, operational, and financial drivers.
* Partner with Product Managers, Commercial teams, and business leaders to provide financial insights that support strategic decision-making.
* Manage gross spend reporting, including Cost of Sales (COS), SG&A, sales and marketing expenses, engineering support costs, and operating expenditures.
* Support capital expenditure planning, investment evaluations, rolling forecasts, and depreciation impact assessments.
* Analyze inventory performance, material cost variances, labor and overhead absorption, and drive root-cause analysis with factory controllers.
* Support month-end close activities by validating key performance indicators, consolidating financial estimates, and ensuring data accuracy.
* Develop executive-level reporting, management presentations, and interactive dashboards utilizing Power BI and advanced Excel analytics.
* Support long-cycle project accounting and contract profitability assessments in compliance with IFRS 15 requirements.
* Ensure adherence to IFRS standards, Hitachi Energy financial policies, internal controls, and audit requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, automation opportunities, and best practices across FP&A activities.
* Coach and support junior analysts, fostering a high-performance finance organization.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, CPA, ACCA, CFA, or MBA Finance are preferred.
* 4-8 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Business Finance, Commercial Finance, or related finance functions, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong expertise in financial accounting, management accounting, cost accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and profitability analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15 and IAS 2.
* Proven experience in product profitability, pricing analysis, commercial finance, and business partnering.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, AI-enabled analytical tools, and data visualization techniques.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA FICO, CO-PA, and integration with SD, PP, and MM modules.
* Excellent business acumen, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate financial insights to non-finance stakeholders.
* Experience working in a global, multicultural environment with cross-functional teams and senior business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, influence decision-making, and deliver high-quality results under tight timelines.
* Strong commitment to accuracy, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement.

* 2–6 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or business finance.

:

title: Lead Financial Analyst II [T500-30610]
description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.**

**ABOUT KROGER:**

The Kroger Co., founded in 1883 by Barney Kroger and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, is one of the largest retailers in the United States, serving millions of customers every day through a family of supermarket, multi-department, and marketplace store formats. With more than 2,700 stores across 35 states, supported by 32 manufacturing locations, 38 distribution centers, and over 400,000 associates, Kroger operates on a significant scale. Guided by its purpose to Feed the Human Spirit™, Kroger focuses on providing fresh, affordable food and an outstanding customer experience while investing in communities through initiatives like Zero Hunger | Zero Waste. Combining a strong store footprint with a growing digital presence, Kroger is transforming how Americans shop.

**ABOUT KROGER CAPABILITY CENTER (KCC):**

At Kroger Capability Center (KCC), we help modernize how work gets done at Kroger. KCC brings together expertise, technology, and global delivery to simplify work and strengthen cross-functional execution, so teams across Kroger can improve focus, speed, and impact. Our goal is to help associates, stores, and customers by making work faster, smoother, and easier to use – so more time can be spent on the highest-value outcomes. We see ourselves as an extension of the Kroger Store Support Center in Cincinnati, where everything we do is designed to support stores, associates, and the customers they serve. Through KCC, we tap into strong talent and capabilities in India to bring Kroger’s purpose – To Feed the Human Spirit – to life in new and impactful ways.

**FUNCTIONAL EVP:**

Turning financial expertise into better decisions

At Kroger Capability Center India, Finance and Accounting supports financial transactions, analysis, accounting operations, and reporting to enable better decision-making and strong financial control

**OUR VALUES:**

**In fulfilling Our Purpose, we live by our Kroger Values:**

**Honesty:**

We insist on truthfulness with each other, with our customers, with our vendors and in our business records. We expect and value openness.

**Integrity:**

We act in accordance with our values, even when it’s difficult.

**Respect:**

We treat all with dignity and value the opinions and perspectives of others.

**Diversity:**

We seek and embrace differences in the backgrounds, cultures and ethnicities of all associates, customers and vendors.

**Safety:**

We protect our customers and each other from injury with a safe and secure workplace and shopping environment.

**Inclusion:**

We encourage and expect collaboration, teamwork and the active involvement of all associates.

**Job Title- Lead Financial Analyst:**

**Position Summary:**

Serves as one of the initial senior finance resources in the Kroger Capability Center for Operational Finance. Provides financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and complex analysis while helping establish new ways of working, standard processes, documentation, and reporting routines for the KCC operating model. This role will partner closely with Finance, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Store Operations, and Corporate Leadership teams to deliver actionable insights that drive profitability, operational efficiency, and strategic growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead recurring financial reporting, KPI scorecards, variance analysis, dashboards, and management reporting packages for assigned Operational Finance areas.
* Support monthly forecasting, annual budgeting, long-range planning, and business performance reviews in partnership with retained Finance leaders.
* Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support decision-making and identify risks, opportunities, and business drivers.
* Prepare concise analysis, commentary, and presentation materials for Finance Managers, Directors, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in knowledge-transfer activities, process walkthroughs, parallel runs, and stabilization activities as work transitions into the KCC.
* Document standard work, reporting logic, data sources, key assumptions, dependencies, and control points to support repeatable execution.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, automate, or improve reporting, planning, forecasting, and analytical processes.
* Partner with retained teams, Shared Services, Accounting, and KCC colleagues to resolve data questions, timing issues, and process exceptions.
* Support onboarding and knowledge sharing for future KCC resources as additional work transitions into the center.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Business, or related field.
* MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CPA, or equivalent qualification preferred.

**Experience:**

* 6-8 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Commercial Finance, Corporate Finance, Retail Finance, or related areas.
* Experience supporting retail, consumer goods, e-commerce, or merchandising organizations preferred.
* Experience working in a Global Capability Center (GCC) environment is advantageous.

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
* 4+ years of finance, FP&A, accounting, operational finance, or quantitative analytical experience.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, variance analysis, and data-driven problem-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to communicate clearly with retained Finance partners and translate analysis into practical business insights.
* Ability to operate in a new-build environment with evolving processes, priorities, and ways of working.

**Preferred Retail Finance Experience:**

* MBA, CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, OneStream, SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, Essbase, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting process documentation, reporting automation, transition, or shared-services stabilization.
* Retail, consumer products, supply chain, manufacturing, health and wellness, or large enterprise finance experience.

**Kroger Leadership Model:**

* **Puts the Customer First**
  - Anticipates customer needs, champions for the customer, acts with customers in mind, exceeds customers’ expectations, gains customers’ trust and respect.

  - Communicates clearly and directly, approachable, relates well to others, engages people and helps them understand change, provides and seeks feedback, articulates clearly, actively listens.

  Is open to diverse ideas, works inclusively and collaboratively, holds self and others accountable, involves others to accomplish individual and team goals.

  Demonstrates strong character; builds partnerships; models a conscious balance between work and personal life; takes personal responsibility for own development; role models leadership qualities such as motivation, inspiration, passion and trust.
* **Coaches and develops others**
  - Develops and cares about associates, builds effective teams, helps people be their best, values and manages diversity, provides candid and constructive feedback.
* **Leads change and innovation -**
  Challenges the status quo, embraces technology, puts forward creative ideas, champions and implements process improvements, gathers the ideas of others, demonstrates good judgment about which ideas will work.
* **Executes with excellence -**
  Is action oriented, drives for results, sets clear expectations and milestones, reviews progress, acts decisively, solves problems, can be counted on to consistently meet or exceed goals.
* **Provides clear and strategic direction**
  - Plans and organizes well, sets a clear and simple course of action, stays focused on the most important priorities, has the ability to visualize and plan for the future, understands the industry and marketplace.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Financial Analyst II (Finance Business Partner) to join our team in
**Bengaluru**
in a
**hybrid**
capacity. * For less complex projects, facilitate the monthly revenue cycle, including review of units, forecasts, unit prices, and revenue recognition, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and forecasts align with operational plans
* Complete variance analyses with insight, identifying forecast risks and opportunities to improve the project revenue outlook
* Provide financial status updates and respond to client financial reporting needs for assigned projects
* For less complex projects, monitor balance sheet positions, working with project teams to keep balances current and improve DSO and cash flow
* Put steps in place with project teams to manage pass-through costs within project budgets, including triggering changes in scope as needed
* Maintain, produce, and communicate meaningful project financial metrics, and lead monthly project performance reviews with project leads and teams covering forecast, labor, margin, billing, and outlook
* Initiate, build, and review change in scope activity, and maintain simpler project budgets in relevant tools from post-award onward

**Candidate Profile**

* Strengths in financial analysis, forecasting, variance analysis, and business partnering
* Experience thriving in a complex, fast-paced, matrix environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams, build rapport with project leadership, and communicate clearly
* A partnering mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with Excel, PowerPoint, and financial performance systems such as Hyperion

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant and progressive finance roles with a strong analytical and partnering track record
* 2+ years in finance, with exposure to project or contract financial management
* Understanding of current financial and accounting standards, policies, and controls
* Strong experience with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with financial performance systems (e.g., Hyperion)
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CA, MBA, or other equivalent qualification
* Familiarity with the life sciences or clinical research industry, its lines of business, and industry trends
* Experience in a regulated environment with audit or SOX-related controls

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: Business Operations & FP&A Analyst
description:
**Business Operations & FP&A Analyst (India)**
**Job Description**
**Team**
Finance / FP&A
  
  
**Location**
India (hybrid), with overlap with EST Hours
  
  
**Reports to**
Sr. Director Strategic Finance
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a sharp, adaptable analyst to be a force multiplier for the finance team. You'll take recurring monthly work and make it repeatable, documented, and faster each cycle. You'll also help turn data into clear narratives for leadership. This is not a "run the report and send it" role. We want someone who asks why we do something this way and proposes a better more efficient and repeatable solution.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build sustainable processes and SOPs (core focus)
* Document how monthly and weekly deliverables are produced, step by step, so anyone could run them.
* Turn manual, tribal-knowledge workflows into standardized, repeatable processes with clear inputs, owners, checks, and timelines.
* Identify bottlenecks, error-prone steps, and automation opportunities, then recommend and implement improvements.
* Maintain a living SOP library and keep it current as processes change.
* Monthly FP&A reporting support
* Support the monthly P&E financial dashboard update and the review materials that go with it.
* Assist with spend allocation work, such as mapping AI and token spend to managers and departments, with gross vs. capitalized views.
* Run reasonableness checks, flag variances, and reconcile to prior periods before anything goes out.
* Market intelligence
* Compile the weekly earnings and market intelligence report from public company earnings materials and transcripts.
* Summarize key themes, pull relevant takeaways, and organize them into a clean, leadership-ready format.
* Track competitors and industry developments, and flag what matters to our business.
* Deck and presentation creation
* Build and polish on-brand PowerPoint decks from raw data and rough outlines.
* Turn analysis into clear visuals, tables, and storylines that fit brand standards.
* Prepare recurring leadership and board-style materials on schedule.
* Challenge and improve
* Pressure-test assumptions, definitions, and methods. Respectfully push back when something doesn't make sense.
* Bring a point of view, not just output.

**What We're Looking For**
**Must-haves**

* 3 to 5 years in FP&A, finance operations, business operations, strategy, or analytics (flexible for the right candidate).
* Affinity towards AI and integrating into daily workflows
* Advanced Excel: lookups, pivots, multi-tab models, and structured formatting. Comfortable with large, messy datasets.
* Strong written communication. You can write an SOP a stranger could follow.
* Strong PowerPoint skills and an eye for clean, consistent design.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined ask and structure it yourself.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with HRIS or payroll data (Paycom, Workday) and ERP or accounting systems (Sage).
* Familiarity with software capitalization concepts.
* Experience with AI tools (Claude or similar) to speed up analysis, documentation, and drafting.
* Basic SQL, Python, or automation experience.
* Background in healthcare, payments, or SaaS.

**Who Thrives Here**

* Nimble: You're comfortable switching between a headcount reconciliation, a deck, and a research summary in the same week.
* Adaptable: Priorities shift and you adjust without losing quality.
* A free thinker: You question the process, offer alternatives, and aren't afraid to disagree.
* Ownership-minded: You see a task through, flag risks early, and improve what you touch.
* Collaborative: You work well across time zones and with finance, HR, and product and engineering partners.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Monthly deliverables are accurate, on time, and need minimal rework.
* Every recurring process has an up-to-date SOP, and turnaround times keep dropping.
* Decks and reports are leadership-ready with light review.
* You regularly surface process improvements and ideas you've initiated yourself.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Assistant Vice President - Cost Management Analyst.**

* Develop new datasets linking suppliers to operational costs and revenue to support customer-centric decisions on cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support the development of Total Cost of Ownership models, enabling management to make fact-based decisions with full visibility of the impact on customers and revenue.

* Lead initiatives that promote strong data management and quality practices, ensure regulatory compliance across locations, and maintain appropriate data tools, standards, frameworks and templates.
* Monitor adherence to policies, frameworks and tools relating to Data Governance and Data Quality, while managing relationships between data elements across different systems.

title: Senior Principal - Tech Finance Manager
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Accountable for the financial management of [domain/platform team], applying the standards set by central Technology Business Operations. The role owns the budget, forecast, actuals and cost transparency, runs the day-to-day financial operations, and provides accurate, consistent financial inputs into the central DPTF reporting cycles. It gives leadership a clear view of spend, forecast and financial risk, and operates under a dotted line to the Director, Business Operations for financial governance and standards.
  
  
**ROLE SCALE, COMPLEXITY AND IMPACT**
This is a senior technology finance leadership role with end-to-end accountability for the financial position of the assigned technology domain or platform portfolio. The role integrates complex run, change, supplier, workforce, tooling, licence and investment cost drivers into a single decision-quality view for senior leadership.
  
  
The post holder manages and assures a complex annual cost base of approximately GBP 25 million, subject to confirmation through the Rewards and Finance calibration process. The role is accountable for forecast integrity, cost control, financial risk, investment insight and the quality of submissions feeding consolidated DPTF reporting and leadership decisions.
  
  
**MARKET AND GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE**
Global scope across the regions, countries and markets supported by the relevant technology services. The role consolidates financial inputs across geographically distributed teams and suppliers, while addressing differences in currency, local cost structures, market commitments, contractual arrangements and regulatory or control requirements.
  
  
Experience is required to operate as an independent financial authority for a material global portfolio, withstand senior challenge, identify second-order financial consequences and influence decisions where cost, service resilience, technology risk and strategic priorities compete.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Budgeting, Forecasting and Performance**
Own the budget, forecast and actuals, planning and tracking the cost base to the enterprise finance timetable.
  
  
Analyse variance, risk and opportunity against plan and provide clear commentary and recommendations to leadership.
  
  
Support business cases, funding requests and investment tracking, with spend decisions owned by the [domain/platform team].
  
  
**Financial Operations**
Run financial operations, including accruals, reclasses, cross-charges, purchase orders, invoices and payment follow-up.
  
  
Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close for the enterprise finance timetable.
  
  
Ensure financial transactions and records are accurate, complete and processed within control requirements.
  
  
**Cost Transparency and Reporting**
Provide cost transparency, including vendor, contractor and unit-cost views at the level leadership needs.
  
  
Maintain a financial view of headcount, covering budgeted positions and vacancies.
  
  
Provide accurate, standardised financial inputs into the central DPTF reporting cycles run by Technology Business Operations.
  
  
**Contract and Vendor Financial Management**
Govern contract spend, renewals, extension pipelines and financial commitments.
  
  
Monitor service continuity and vendor financial risk, coordinating with Procurement and contract owners.
  
  
**Governance and Standards**
Apply the central Technology Business Operations financial standards, definitions and controls so data is consistent and comparable.
  
  
Ensure [domain/team] operates within GSK financial policy, including approval routes, purchase governance and audit readiness.
  
  
Escalate material financial risks, variances and control issues to [domain/team] leadership and to Technology Business Operations.
  
  
Identify and support automation and simplification of recurring financial processes.
  
  
Lead the annual plan, rolling forecast and multi-year financial outlook for an approximately GBP 25 million technology cost base, integrating demand, workforce, supplier, licence, consumption and transformation assumptions.
  
  
Act as the financial co-pilot to the domain leadership team, converting operational and technology strategy into affordability scenarios, investment choices, risk exposures and measurable value outcomes.
  
  
Challenge Directors and Senior Directors on forecast assumptions, commitments, resource choices, supplier economics and business cases; escalate material exposures and decision requirements to VP-level governance where appropriate.
  
  
Provide scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis for complex decisions, including service transformation, sourcing, contract renewal, platform investment, resilience and cost optimisation.
  
  
Govern the financial implications of cross-market and cross-region services, including currency, consumption, allocation and chargeback complexity, ensuring a transparent and defensible cost position.
  
  
Set improved financial management practices, controls and reporting standards for the domain, using automation and data-led insight to improve forecast accuracy, cycle efficiency and decision quality.
  
  
**Professional Qualifications**

* BS or MS degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Technology Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Professionally qualified accountant (or qualified by experience) with a recognised accounting or cost-management credential e.g., [CA/CMA (India), CIMA/ACCA/ACA (UK), or CPA/CMA (US)] (desirable)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Technology financial management, budgeting, forecasting and cost transparency.
* Financial operations, period-end close and management reporting for a technology domain.
* Supplier, managed service and contract commercials and cost management.
* Hardware, software and license investment planning.
* Business cases, cost optimization and unit-cost reporting.

**Experience Required**

* Overall15 years and typically, 10+ years in finance, including substantial experience as a senior finance partner to a large, complex and globally distributed technology or infrastructure organisation.
* Owning budgets, forecasts, actuals and cost transparency for a technology function, domain or business unit.
* Running day-to-day financial operations - accruals, purchase orders, invoices and period-end close - against a fixed finance calendar.
* Turning vendor, contractor and unit-cost data into insight that explains and challenges spend.
* Handling supplier, managed service and contract spend, renewals and financial commitments.
* Building investment cases and delivering measurable cost reductions across supplier, licence and infrastructure spend.
* A demonstrable effect on forecast accuracy, unit costs, investment decisions or delivered savings.
* Working within financial standards and controls set by a central function.
* Demonstrated ownership or financial leadership of a material cost base, ideally around GBP 25 million or greater, covering multiple cost categories, suppliers, planning horizons and delivery locations.
* Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders through concise financial narratives, scenario analysis, constructive challenge and clear recommendations.
* Experience shaping strategic investment, sourcing, transformation and cost-optimisation decisions, not solely administering budgets and reporting cycles.
* Strong record of improving forecast accuracy, financial controls, cost transparency, unit economics and realised savings across complex technology services.

**Skills/Background**

* Able to own a technology cost base end-to-end and translate complex financial detail into clear decisions for non-finance leaders.
* Commercially astute across supplier, managed service and license spend, with the judgement to test whether an investment case genuinely stacks up.
* Rigorous on data quality and accuracy, recognizing that flawed inputs undermine the consolidated financial picture.
* Confident challenging forecasts, assumptions and spend decisions constructively
* Highly organised and self-directed, delivering multiple concurrent financial cycles reliably against fixed deadlines.
* A clear, credible communicator who can hold their position with Finance and Tech stakeholders

**Preferred Skills**

* End-to-end technology financial management: budget, forecast, actuals and cost transparency for a :GBP 25M global technology cost base (10+ years in finance)
* Planning and forecasting: annual plan, rolling forecast and multi-year outlook with driver-based assumptions and a record of improving forecast accuracy
* Variance analysis and executive financial narrative: constructively challenging Directors, Senior Directors and VPs with clear recommendations
* Financial operations and close: accruals, reclasses, cross-charges, POs and invoices through month, quarter and year-end close within control requirements
* Cost transparency and unit economics: vendor, contractor and unit-cost views, headcount and vacancy tracking, allocation and FX across regions
* Contract, supplier and investment management: renewals and commitments with Procurement, business-case testing and delivered savings
* Financial governance and standards: applying central Technology Business Operations controls and audit readiness, on a formal finance/cost-accounting foundation

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Business Case Development, Business Forecasting, Cost Transparency, Data Storytelling, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Financial Governance, Financial Modeling, Financial Operations, Financial Performance Improvement, Influencing Without Authority, Insight Generation, Intrapreneurship, IT Financial Management, Planning Budgeting And Forecasting (PBF), Supplier Contract Management, Variance Analysis
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**
The Senior Analyst is responsible for managing IT service performance reporting, ITSM governance metrics, budget tracking, financial reporting for change requests and projects, and ensuring accurate cross-charging of efforts across projects and cost centers. The role partners with service delivery teams, project managers, finance teams, and business stakeholders provide transparency on service performance, operational efficiency, costs, and resource utilization.
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and publish IT service performance reports and dashboards.
* Analyze service delivery metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and operational trends.
* Track incidents, service requests, change management, problem management, and backlog performance.
* Identify service improvement opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual service review meetings with stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy across reporting platforms.

**IT Service Management (ITSM) Reporting**

* Manage and enhance ITSM reporting across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management processes.
* Prepare executive reports and management dashboards for leadership teams.
* Monitor compliance with agreed service metrics and governance requirements.
* Coordinate with service providers and internal teams to validate reported performance data.
* Support audit and governance activities by providing required operational reporting.

**Budget & Financial Management**

* Manage budgets related to Change Requests (CRs), enhancement initiatives, and projects.
* Track actuals spend against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Monitor project costs, resource utilization, and financial variances.
* Prepare budget forecasts, accruals, and cost reports for management review.

**Cross-Charging & Cost Allocation**

* Manage effort tracking and cost allocation across projects, applications, services, and cost centers.
* Coordinate with project managers and finance teams to ensure accurate cross-charging and invoicing.
* Validate resource effort submissions and allocation models.
* Support monthly financial closing activities related to project charging and operational expenses.

**Primary Function**
Responsible for maintaining the integrity of balance sheet accounts through timely reconciliations, financial analysis, and month-end close activities. The role is accountable for ensuring accurate financial reporting, identifying and resolving reconciliation differences, strengthening internal controls, and driving process improvements to enhance the overall control environment. The Senior Analyst serves as a subject matter expert (SME) and partners with Headquarters and cross-functional business teams to support accounting governance, process standardization, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
**Maintain Financial Integrity**

* Perform timely and accurate preparation, review, and certification of Balance Sheet reconciliations for the assigned accounts.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including preparation and review of journal entries, accruals, reclasses, and supporting documentation.
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve reconciliation variances by partnering with upstream and downstream business partners to ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure compliance with US GAAP, Target accounting policies, and corporate financial reporting requirements.
* Prepare supporting schedules and account analyses for internal management reporting and external financial reporting requirements.

**Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Analyze balance sheet accounts to identify financial risks, unusual trends, and control gaps while recommending corrective actions.
* Maintain a strong SOX-compliant control environment by executing key financial controls and documenting evidence in accordance with corporate policies.
* Identify process control deficiencies and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure reconciliation standards, certification timelines, and documentation requirements are consistently met.

**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare reconciliation metrics, aging analysis, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for leadership reporting.
* Identify automation opportunities and process improvements to reduce manual effort, improve reconciliation quality, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Leverage system capabilities and analytical tools to improve reporting accuracy and reconciliation effectiveness.
* Standardize reconciliation templates, documentation, and best practices across the accounting team.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge repositories.
* Train, mentor, and support team members to strengthen technical accounting knowledge and reconciliation expertise.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal, external, and SOX audit requests related to assigned balance sheet accounts.
* Ensure timely preparation of audit schedules, reconciliation support, and documentation while addressing audit inquiries effectively.
* Support remediation of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions where required.

**Problem Solving & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned reconciliation processes and provide guidance to accounting team members.
* Lead discussions with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex accounting and reconciliation issues.
* Drive root cause analysis of recurring reconciliation differences and recommend long-term process improvements.
* Support leadership with financial insights, issue resolution, and decision-making through data-driven analysis.

**Projects & Transitions**

* Lead or participate in cross-functional projects involving process transitions, system implementations, reconciliation optimization, and accounting transformations.
* Support transition of new accounting activities into the team while ensuring strong governance, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on strengthening financial controls, automation, and operational excellence.

**REPORTING / WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports to the Sr Manager. Maintains strong working relationships with Headquarters Finance, Financial Reporting, Technology and Internal Audit.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Minimum Requirements**

* B.Com with CA / ACCA / CPA / CMA / CIMA qualification.
* Minimum 8 years of accounting experience with at least 5 years of General Ledger and Balance Sheet Reconciliation experience.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP (preferred) and financial reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP, SOX controls, and financial reporting requirements.
* Proven experience in reconciliation governance, financial analysis, risk identification, and issue resolution.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with attention to detail.
* Experience leading process improvements, automation initiatives, and cross-functional projects.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently meeting critical deadlines.

title: Project Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is a leading provider of transaction tax management solutions for companies of all sizes. Our flagship offering, the Thomson Reuters Application Suite, delivers consolidated transaction tax management software and services that help global enterprises manage sales, use, value-added, excise, and specialty taxes with consistency, accuracy, control, and efficiency.
  
  
The Project Analyst works with minimal supervision to support the Project Management Office (PMO) in analyzing project performance, establishing governance and compliance, and providing clear visibility into the health of the project portfolio. This role combines financial insight with project reporting to help project and program managers deliver on schedule, on budget, and in compliance with revenue and billing requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze project performance across the portfolio and identify trends, risks, and areas for improvement.
* Support the establishment and maintenance of project governance and compliance standards.
* Maintain a holistic, up-to-date view of the status and health of the portfolio and project office.
* Produce independent, objective, accurate, clear, and concise project reports for leadership and stakeholders.
* Advise project and program managers on report creation and the effective use of reporting tools.
* Collate and analyze project management data to assess the overall effectiveness of project management across the portfolio.
* Monitor revenue recognition based on project completion status.
* Track customer billing against planned customer milestones.
* Drive continuous process improvement in project management, reporting, and financial tracking practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in finance, managing revenue recognition and customer billing.
* Hands-on knowledge of revenue recognition based on project completion status.
* Experience with customer billing based on planned milestones.
* Exposure to systematic timekeeping mechanisms.
* Experience managing project-related data.
* Data analysis experience.
* Reporting experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of project management tools.
* Experience supporting a PMO or project governance function.
* Experience building dashboards or status reports for portfolio-level visibility.
* Familiarity with transaction tax, tax technology, or other enterprise software environments.
* Strong process improvement mindset, with examples of streamlining reporting or financial workflows.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. title: Anaplan Architect
description:
**We Are:**
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

You are a visionary change leader passionate about ushering in a new era of digital finance. You possess a robust problem-solving ability, allowing you to diagnose functional needs and navigate ambiguity effectively. You have a knack for identifying current states and desired outcomes, developing blueprints and roadmaps to bridge the gap, and executing strategic plans. With a background in Finance, Business, or Technology Information Systems, you are well-versed in leveraging Anaplan for transformative planning and forecasting processes. You are flexible and collaborative, comfortable working with global teams across different time zones, and eager to contribute to high-impact projects. Your advanced financial modelling skills, strong understanding of business processes, and excellent communication abilities make you an ideal candidate for this role.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Serving as the Model Builder SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.
* Gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements.
* Translating business requirements into functional requirements and use cases.
* Converting existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models.
* Modifying existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality.
* Developing model documentation.
* Participating in data integration and migration solutions.
* Leading UAT testing and deployment efforts.
* Operating cross-functionally with some ambiguity, providing expertise to Strategy and FP&A teams on best practices for modelling and reporting.
* Building and developing Anaplan modules and lists based on model blueprints.
* Configuring and maintaining Anaplan lists, modules, dashboards, actions, and other model settings to meet business needs.
* Monitoring data flows to and from source systems to ensure all data is up-to-date and accurate.
* Performing root cause analyses and proposing solutions.
* Providing hands-on training to new end users on Anaplan models and documenting processes.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Driving transformative change in Synopsys' collaborative planning and forecasting processes.
* Enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of financial planning and reporting.
* Contributing to the global finance function's strategy, process, system, structural, and behavioural changes.
* Enabling better decision-making through sophisticated Anaplan models.
* Improving data integration and migration solutions to ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
* Providing expertise and training to teams, fostering a culture of connected planning.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology Information Systems, or equivalent.
* 5+ years of experience in operations or FP&A leveraging Anaplan, or completion of 5+ Anaplan implementation projects as a Model Builder.
* Certified Anaplan Model Builder, level 3 or higher.
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Snowflake and other integration tools is a plus.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Experience with multi-dimensional or cube-based planning and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of business processes.

**Who You Are:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion.
* Proven record of career progression with increasing levels of responsibility.
* Experience in a fast-changing, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent teamwork skills, including the ability to interact with all organization levels.

**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
This opportunity sits within the Centre of Excellence’s Transformation Team, focused on reshaping the future of Finance at Synopsys. The team drives strategy, process, system, structural, and behavioural change across the finance function, partnering with Synopsys leadership globally to drive transformative change in collaborative planning and forecasting processes.
  
  
**Rewards and Benefits:**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Assistant Vice President Equity - Front Office**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Risk & Delta Management – Daily monitoring, Greeks, stress testing. Dividends & Corporate Actions – Forecasting and market impact analysis
* Index Events – Research and positioning for rebalances and events. Profit & Loss & Scenario Analytics – Attribution, shocks, and “what-if” tools
* Inventory Visualization & Optimization – Tools for portfolio construction and risk allocation. Automation & Tool-Building – Python-based solutions for workflows, dashboards, and reporting
* Innovation in Tech & Aritficial Intellegence – Applying Aritficial Intellegence/Machine Learning for forecasting and anomaly detection
* Partner with traders on risk, delta, and portfolio exposures. Help traders with trade bookings, reconciliations and exception handling to ensure smooth daily operations
* Build Python tools for PnL attribution, stress testing, and scenario analysis. Develop and maintain dividend forecasting and corporate actions models
* Analyse index rebalances, corporate events, and flows to support trading strategies
* Design inventory visualization & optimization tools for portfolio efficiency. Automate daily processes (risk reports, trade booking checks, reconciliations)

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Strong academic background in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields with experience working with a trading desk
* Knowledge of derivatives, swaps, risk management, and equity markets
* Advanced Python skills (Pandas, NumPy, visualization, automation)
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to handle time-sensitive tasks
* Excellent communication skills for direct interaction with traders. Exposure to front-office trading strategies

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Job Description**
Job Title: A2R Senior Analyst (PG25)
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for some great opportunities for its newly launched Global Services (GS) hub in Bangalore, India. GS Bangalore will be an industry player among the business services in Bangalore IT Hub, which is well equipped with the latest technology and modern infrastructure. This is your chance to work with the best talent in a workforce that reflects the diverse markets Johnson & Johnson serves around the world, and an inclusive culture that values different perspectives and life experiences.
  
  
“Reimagine the possibilities” at Johnson and Johnson Global Finance! We live this motto every day by creating game-changing business solutions for the world’s largest and most broadly-based healthcare company.
  
  
As a member of our Global Finance team, you will have exclusive access to a network of financial professionals located in over 60 countries. This new network will help you build on your current skills and explore opportunities to grow your career in J&J. At J&J Global Finance, we value ideas for innovation and improvement and are committed to diversity and inclusion. Together we will reimagine business processes to become more effective, more efficient, and improve customer experience. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
The Global Services Finance organization provides best-in-class, cost-effective financial services, and compliance—in a J&J way—to our Operating Companies around the world. The Account to Report (A2R) process area is a team of credo based, talented, finance experts structured in a Global Process based organization, executing processes in a compliant and efficient way through standardization and automation. The A2R goal is to deliver results through close connection to our corporate and business finance partners while demonstrating a deep understanding of the J&J business. * If assigned a role of Operational Key Contact (OKC) then candidates will be the key liaison point within their Process for a defined Region & Sector with BUF and CFMs, answering queries, coordinating with SMEs/analysts on process and operational matters, resolving issues and updating partners on close status.
* If assigned a role of Subject Matter Expert (SME) then candidates will be responsible to ensure cross sector, cross region, and cross process alignment, ensuring good documentation is maintained and consistency of a global approach.
* Create Game-Changing Innovation
* Generate ideas, fosters, and implements continuous improvement mindset, identifying and pursuing process efficiency opportunities.
* Influence and Execute process improvements, generating ideas and implementing in line with global standards. Qualifications: Education

* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with employees at all levels.
* Ability to frame clear & concise communication across all relevant stakeholders.
* Be open to new ideas, rapid change and embracing new technologies. Preferred
* Experience in a Shared Service Centre of a multinational corporation or BPO.
* Experience in a Global Account to Report function of a large multi-state company.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and fluid situations, demonstrating a pragmatic approach.
* Successfully manage multiple priorities, be very organized and work efficiently to tight deadlines.
* Solid US GAAP accounting knowledge.
* Digital/ intelligent automation capabilities. Other

* Proficient in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and MS Office in particular Excel.
* Candidates may be asked to work shifts to align with global assignments in Americas / EMEA / Asia.
* Lead/Participate in other Regional/Global/Cross functional duties as assigned.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Fluent English, other language skills desirable.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Manager - Economic Services
description:
**Job Description**
KPMG's Economic Services (ES) practice supports public and
  
  
private sector clients with complex business and regulatory matters
  
  
through rigorous economic, statistical, and quantitative analysis.
  
  
The team provides data-driven insights to assess risks, measure
  
  
economic impacts, evaluate alternatives, and support strategic
  
  
decision-making.
  
  
The practice's capabilities span economic impact analysis, public
  
  
policy evaluation, survey design and sampling, and predictive
  
  
modeling. Using advanced analytical and econometric techniques,
  
  
ES professionals help clients forecast outcomes, derive actionable
  
  
insights from large datasets, and deliver defensible conclusions that
  
  
support strategy, compliance, and operational improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage workflow, delivery, team utilization; act as KGS point of contact for the onshore stakeholders
* Perform statistical, economic, and financial analysis on economic, regulatory and policy issues of significance to a range of clients in the public and private sectors, both domestically and internationally
* Develop and apply complex computer algorithms to process and manage data, build tools, and automate manual tasks
* Advance mathematical and computational models to simulate impact of policy changes or business decisions
* Manipulate large data sets to support statistical, economic, financial analyses and apply creative, innovative, lateral thinking to problem solving
* Craft rigorous, insightful narratives on the issues under analysis and translate these into informative professional reports and presentations as needed that are accessible to non-specialists but add value for clients
* Write technical and non-technical memoranda and reports based on research and findings from analyses

**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science, coursework or minor in Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Data and Analytics is preferred; Master’s or higher degree is preferred
  
  
**Work Experience**
The candidate must have 6+ years of experience with advisory related projects
  
  
**Mandatory Technical & Functional Skills**

* Experience with management and analysis of large volumes of data, financial analysis and valuation, statistical analysis, building and working with economic or mathematical models, and econometric analyses
* Experience with data science, machine learning methods, and LLM-based solutions and products
* Significant experience with data analyses in Python, SQL, and R and visualizations in Tableau or Power BI

title: VP, Financial Control and Reporting- Bank
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
  
  
With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
  
  
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
  
  
We are seeking a motivated individual to join the financial reporting team to support and contribute to the management and reporting of the Bank’s balance sheet and Profit and Loss accounts, including Treasury Finance reporting. This includes completion of financial statements ensuring to be at its most accurate, complete and timely. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial reporting and governance frameworks.
  
  
**The Job Responsibilities Include**

* Preparation of Technology suspense accounts. This includes liaising with account owners to ensure validity and accuracy of individual account transactions and timely capitalization of assets, monitoring cost spend against budget, accruing, calculating withholding tax and markups, invoicing and following up on cash remittance for projects carried out in London on behalf of EMEA offices.
* Production and review of daily reconciliation between Front and Back Office systems.
* Production and review of Daily Profit and Loss reports for Global Market Division.
* Investigation of reconciliation differences with respective areas of the bank and advising on root cause and corrective actions.
* Maintain Bank’s fixed assets and leased assets register and prepare all related Head Office reports. This includes review of applications for system development, advising on investment vs expense treatment and monitoring the fixed assets coding in Oracle.
* Preparation of Bank’s pension accounting journals and reporting.
* Monthly balance sheet controls regarding nostro accounts
* Preparation of monthly closing journals, ledger adjustments, analysis and reconciliations. Review business reports to ensure accuracy in General Ledger including accruals processing to ensure reporting within the correct accounting period.
* Half yearly Variable Interest Entity reporting
* Preparation of Financial Accounting Reports in order to support the Bank in meeting its deadlines to its various stakeholders
* Quarterly and semi-annual Japanese GAAP and US GAAP reporting preparation and review ensuring complete, accurate and timely preparation and submission of reports and following up with auditor queries.
* Adhoc projects

**Job Requirements**
**Skills and Experience:**

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Proficient with Excel/VBA, Word and Access)
* Good exposure to accounting software packages.
* Good written and verbal skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Results driven, with a strong sense of accountability
* A proactive, motivated approach.
* The ability to operate with urgency and prioritize work accordingly
* Strong decision making skills, the ability to demonstrate sound judgement
* A structured and logical approach to work
* Strong problem solving skills
* A creative and innovative approach to work
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* A calm approach, with the ability to perform well in a pressurized environment

**Qualifications**

* Experience of working in financial closing and reporting teams or a big 4 accounting firm practice, preferably with a controls and governance focus.
* Bachelors / Masters degree and relevant accounting qualifications.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

title: Talent Development Specialist
description:

Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* 3+ years of experience in Talent Development, Learning and Development, or HR, with demonstrated success in designing and delivering scalable learning programs with measurable outcomes
* Strong expertise in learning program design and instructional design methodologies, including blended learning, experiential learning, coaching, and digital learning approaches
* Proven ability to partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, and HR partners to assess enterprise skill gaps and align learning initiatives with business priorities
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse global audiences and manage program logistics end to end
* Skilled in data-driven decision-making and program evaluation, including NPS, ROI, and impact reporting; proven ability to manage program budgets, timelines, and stakeholder relationships
* Experience with Gen AI and digital learning platforms is preferred; experience delivering learning programs in global organizations is a plus
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools — including generative AI platforms — to design engaging and future-ready learning experiences.
* Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to improve learning efficiency and personalization. Demonstrates a growing awareness of risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Education, or a related field
* Master's degree or professional certifications in Learning and Development, Coaching, or Project Management are preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, delivery, and evaluation of enterprise skills programs at Moody's, partnering with business leaders to identify skill gaps, build scalable learning solutions, and drive measurable impact through innovation and data-driven approaches.
* Partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, and HR partners to assess enterprise skill gaps and align programs with business strategy; conduct learning needs assessments and translate requirements into clear learning objectives and measurable program outcomes
* Design scalable program frameworks applicable across multiple skills, functions, and regions; curate and develop content using modern instructional approaches including blended learning, experiential activities, coaching, and digital learning
* Own end-to-end program management including planning, scheduling, facilitator preparation, participant communication, vendor coordination, logistics, and delivery; facilitate select sessions directly to ensure interactive, inclusive, and high-quality learning experiences
* Manage program budgets and timelines; report regularly on progress and risks; partner with other Talent Development teams to ensure smooth execution and consistency

* Integrate innovative approaches including Gen AI and adaptive learning to enhance learner engagement and personalization; build evaluation frameworks such as NPS, feedback surveys, and business impact measures into program design.Explore and pilot new learning technologies and methods including AI-driven learning, micro-learning, and digital simulations; champion innovation by scaling solutions that prove effective and staying ahead of L&D trends

Moody's University is the enterprise learning hub within Moody's Shared Services, responsible for building the skills and capabilities that enable employees and the organization to grow and succeed. Our Talent Development team partners closely with business leaders and HR teams to design impactful learning experiences, cultivate future-ready talent, and drive measurable business outcomes across the globe. By joining our team, you will contribute to innovative enterprise-wide learning initiatives, help shape the future of workforce development at Moody's, and support the adoption of modern technologies — including generative AI — to create engaging and scalable learning solutions.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

---------------

As **SAP HCM, Payroll & SuccessFactors Lead** should support and manage the organization's HR technology landscape, with primary responsibility for **SAP HCM/Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors**.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on functional knowledge of **SAP HCM, particularly SAP Payroll, and SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central, Time off, Onboarding / Offboarding, Recruitment)**, with the ability to understand complex HR and payroll processes, identify root causes, define requirements, coordinate with implementation/support partners, and ensure solutions are thoroughly tested, documented and successfully deployed.

Lead functional support for SAP HCM and Payroll, covering employee data, organizational management, personnel administration, time and payroll.

Analyze system issues, identify root causes and define functional solutions.

Support enhancements, statutory changes and process improvements.

Coordinate with HR, Payroll, Finance and IT to resolve issues.

Assess impacts of payroll changes on SuccessFactors and connected systems.

Manage and support SuccessFactors modules and related HR processes.

Assess issues and identify required configuration, process or integration changes.

Translate business needs into functional specifications.

Review solutions against business requirements and HR technology standards.

Drive system optimization and continuous improvement.

Gather, analyze and document business requirements.

Prepare functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.

Challenge solutions to ensure they address business needs.

Ensure delivery against agreed requirements and timelines.

Review specifications, system changes and deliverables.

Monitor issues, escalations and project progress.

Ensure root-cause analysis and drive partner accountability.

Prepare test scenarios, scripts and expected results.

Coordinate SIT, UAT, regression and production testing.

Ensure business sign-off before deployment.

Validate system changes and support post-production stabilization.

Ensure compliance with change-management procedures.

Identify data inconsistencies and coordinate resolution.

Maintain data validation and reconciliation controls.

Support data cleansing and ensure data integrity.

* **Integration & Replication Management**

Coordinate issue resolution with technical teams and vendors.

Validate successful replication and data consistency.

Assess the impact of system changes on integrations.

Ensure documentation is updated following enhancements and system changes.

Develop and deliver training for HR, Payroll and business users.

* Effective stakeholder and vendor management.

Technology & Systems
  
Work with automation platforms, booking and room/event management systems, and hospitality management software to support onboarding and ongoing operations.
  
Partner with IT and digital teams to configure, test, and roll out technology tools (e.g., café ordering apps, meeting room booking systems, feedback platforms) at new sites.
  
Use data and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI, or similar) to track performance metrics and present insights to stakeholders.
  
Required QualificationsExperience & Education
  
Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field; MBA preferred.
  
8–12 years of experience in hospitality operations, with at least 3–5 years in a program/project management or onboarding role.
  
Prior experience in corporate hospitality, IFM (Integrated Facilities Management), or managed services environment strongly preferred.
  
Experience working with or managing BFSI or other regulated-industry clients is a plus.
  
Functional Skills
  
**Deep understanding of hospitality service lines:** café/F&B, meeting & events, concierge, and guest experience management.
  
Strong grasp of operational frameworks, SLA/KPI design, and service delivery models.
  
Demonstrated experience in change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR or similar) is an advantage.
  
Proven ability to manage multiple global projects simultaneously, often across different time zones and cultural contexts.
  
Technology Skills
  
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for reporting, planning, and presentations.
  
Familiarity with project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar).
  
Strong Data AI acumen and knowledge
  
Basic data analysis skills to interpret operational and client satisfaction metrics.
  
Soft Skills
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear, concise MOMs and executive-level reports.
  
Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership.
  
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to manage ambiguity in fast-paced environments.
  
Cultural sensitivity and adaptability when working with global, cross-functional teams.
  
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.
  
Other Requirements
  
Willingness to travel as required for project onboarding and site visits.
  
Flexibility to work across time zones to support global client calls and go-lives.
  
Ability to work under pressure during peak onboarding/transition periods and manage competing priorities.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate.
