description:
**About Us:**

  
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  
  

**Job Description:**

**Job Description: People Operations Leader**

  

**Position Title:** People Operations Leader
  
**Reports To:** Director – People (BW India)
  
**Location:** Chennai, India

  

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the *St. Louis Business Journal* list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

**Our culture is built on:**

· **Ownership –** Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

· **Flexibility –** A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.

· **Empowerment –** Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.

· **Learning and Growth –** Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**  
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

**Role Overview**

The People Operations Leader will be responsible for designing and leading operational excellence across all core People processes at Barry-Wehmiller India. This includes executing managing payroll with accuracy and compliance, ensuring full adherence to local labour laws, and effective usage of HRMS (Workday). The role will also lead policy administration across BWI, ensuring consistent interpretation and implementation of People policies. In addition, this role will own People data, reporting, and analytics — delivering insights to guide leadership decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Compensation and Payroll**

* Execute the compensation strategy for BWI in alignment with global frameworks and local market practices.
* Lead compensation benchmarking, pay structure design, and annual merit review cycles.
Ensure timely and compliant payroll administration, resolving exceptions and ensuring accuracy.  

**Compliance and Policy Administration**

* Ensure full compliance with Indian employment laws, statutory benefits (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, etc.), and tax regulations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements and lead necessary policy or process updates.
Administer policies consistently ensuring clarity, fairness, and alignment with enterprise standards.  

**Workday and Systems**

* Lead Workday implementation, adoption, and ongoing governance for the GCC.
* Partner with global HRIS teams to enable new functionalities and process improvements.
* Ensure data integrity, access, and compliance in all People systems.
Build dashboards and analytics for leaders, enabling effective workforce planning and decision-making.  

**People Metrics and Reporting**

* Build and deliver dashboards and reports on key People metrics (attrition, hiring, compensation, training, performance cycle, etc.).
* Provide insights and recommendations to leadership based on data trends.
Partner with the People leadership team to identify opportunities for process optimization and improved team member experience.  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Master’s degree in HR, Business, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in HR operations, with strong expertise in compensation, payroll, compliance, and HRIS (preferably Workday).
* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate data into insights and action.
* Deep knowledge of Indian employment law, payroll compliance, and statutory benefits.
Experience working with global stakeholders across time zones.  

**Key Skills**

* Payroll administration
* HR compliance
* Workday/HRIS expertise and data integrity management.
* Analytical and problem-solving capability with strong attention to detail.
* Process optimization and project management.
* Stakeholder management, influencing, and collaboration skills.
High integrity and commitment to compliance.

title: HR Manager
description:
**Role Summary-**

Lead end-to-end human resources, industrial relations, statutory compliance, and plant administration for a solar manufacturing facility in Hyderabad. Partner with production and plant leadership to support workforce planning, shop-floor engagement, safety alignment, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Manpower Planning & Recruitment:** Drive hiring for technical, production, engineering, and support roles, as well as contract/temporary workforce mobilization aligned with shift and production targets.
* **Statutory & Labour Compliance:** Ensure strict adherence to central and Telangana state labour laws, including the Factories Act, Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Minimum Wages, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, and statutory registers/returns.

* **Plant Administration & MIS:** Manage plant-level facilities (transport, canteen, security, housekeeping) and prepare regular HR MIS reports on headcount, attrition, overtime, and compliance status.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (MBA/PGDM) in HR, Industrial Relations, or Business Administration; a diploma/degree in Labour Laws is a plus.
* **Experience:** 6–12 years of HR experience, with strong exposure to manufacturing/factory environments. Experience in solar, renewable energy, electronics, or heavy engineering manufacturing is preferred.
* **Skills:** Strong working knowledge of Telangana/Indian labour laws, contract labour management, HRMS/payroll tools, MS Excel, and stakeholder communication.

title: Associate HR Analyst - APAC
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**

At **Aleph**, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

We are looking for an Associate HR Analyst, to join the Human Resources team in Mumbai or Delhi, supporting our APAC markets. This is an early-career position that plays a key operational role supporting our Regional HR Business Partners (HRBPs), ensuring our people processes run smoothly across multiple markets.

You will work closely with the Regional HRBP, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition (TA), People Service Delivery (PSD), and business leaders across the region, contributing to a seamless employee experience and helping turn people priorities into action. You will support key HR processes, provide insights and follow-up, and help ensure that our people practices are consistently and effectively delivered across the region in line with global guidelines.

This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is energized by problem-solving. It is a permanent, hybrid position based in Mumbai or Delhi, with three days per week in the office.

### **What You Will Do**

**Hiring and Selection**

* Support the Regional HRBP in submitting hiring requests to TA through Workday
* Share regular updates with the Regional HRBP on hiring status and flag any potential hiring risks or challenges

**Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Coordinate and facilitate welcome meetings and inductions for new hires
* Ensure hiring managers take an active role in a standardized onboarding and induction template, and contribute to the onboarding process where necessary
* Conduct the scheduled check-in meetings with new employees and their managers; document key findings and flag risks to the Regional HRBP
* Track onboarding and offboarding processes: documentation, system updates, coordination with legal providers, and final payment follow-up
* Conduct the exit interview for voluntary resignations and analyze exit surveys to flag risks or challenges to the Regional HRBP
* Ensure all people movement events are processed accurately and on time in Workday

**HR Employee Support**

* Act as a point of contact for complex HR queries related to employee relations, policies and procedures, performance, and compensation from employees and managers across APAC
* Collaborate with PSD on complex employee queries related to other HR topics such as time-off requests and balances, Workday challenges, and more
* Liaise with PSD on open Jira tickets and ensure timely resolution and follow-up
* Actively contribute to the FAQ and knowledge base for recurring questions to reduce query volume over time, in partnership with the broader HR team

**Engagement Plan Execution Support**

* Support the execution of the APAC Engagement Plan (Career Path Program, Recognition Program, AI and Automation initiatives)
* Coordinate logistics for engagement activities: communications, scheduling, materials, and tracking
* Assist in collecting and organizing data for engagement surveys and post-program follow-ups

**HR Systems and Data Integrity (HRIS)**

* Own the accuracy of Workday organizational structures: positions, attributes, reporting lines, and job profiles
* Perform regular audits to ensure all people movements (new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations) are correctly reflected in the system
* Cross-check open positions in Workday against workforce planning data and flag discrepancies to the Regional HRBP
* Coordinate with HR teams globally to resolve data inconsistencies
* Prepare HR reports on demand: headcount, open positions, engagement metrics, and data sanity checks
* Support the Regional HRBP with data preparation for leadership presentations and business reviews
* Maintain data hygiene across HR tracking tools (spreadsheets, Workday exports, dashboards)

### **What We Are Looking For**

**Background**

* A degree in Human Resources (Human Resource Management), Labor Relations, Organizational Psychology, or a related field

**Experience**

* 1 to 3 years of HR experience in dynamic, fast-moving environments (for example HR operations, HR generalist, or HRIS support)
* Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday experience is a strong plus, not a requirement)
* Exposure to multi-country HR operations is valued but not mandatory

**Skills**

* Advanced English, written and spoken; most team communication is in English
* Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides): advanced level required
* AI tools literacy (familiarity with Claude or similar tools is a plus)
* Analytical mindset: comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and building clean reports

### **What Will Set You Apart**

* High tolerance for ambiguity: you don’t need everything to be defined to take action
* Dynamism: you shift context quickly and don’t lose quality when the pace picks up
* Comfort with uncertainty: you see change as the norm, not the exception
* Proactive communication: you flag issues before they become problems
* Discretion: you handle sensitive information with care and sound judgment

### **Why Join Aleph**

* **Real impact across APAC:** Your accuracy in Workday and your follow-through keep hiring, onboarding, and people movements running smoothly across multiple markets, and your insights help the Regional HRBP and business leaders decide what to do next.
* **A clear path into HR business partnering:** Learn the HRBP craft from the inside (employee relations, workforce planning data, leadership business reviews) with day-to-day exposure to the Director, HR Business Partners.
* **Collaborative, supportive team culture:** Work alongside Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, and People Service Delivery colleagues in an English-speaking team that values proactive communication, discretion, and flagging issues early.
* **Modern tools and AI-forward work:** Build hands-on experience with Workday, Google Workspace, Jira, and AI tools, and help deliver AI and Automation initiatives as part of the APAC Engagement Plan.

**Why Join Us?**

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: IT Operational Readiness Manager
description:
**Overview**

The IT Operational Readiness Manager is responsible for leading and governing operational readiness across technology change portfolios, ensuring that new services, systems, infrastructure, and significant changes are transitioned into production in a controlled, supportable, secure, and sustainable manner.

This position is accountable for influencing delivery outcomes, identifying and challenging readiness gaps, driving remediation activities, and providing independent readiness assessments to support go-live decision-making. title: Associate Director Quality

title: Manager PMS, Organisation Development & HR Governance
description:
A. Performance Management System (PMS)

· Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to strengthen the linkage between performance outcomes, increments, variable pay, promotions, development plans and succession decisions.

· Monitor completion and quality of PMS activities; publish dashboards and management reports on goal completion, review status, rating distribution and key trends.

B. Organisation Development (OD) & Organisation Effectiveness

· Conduct organisation diagnostics to identify gaps in structure, roles, spans and layers, decision-making and organisational effectiveness.

· Support organisation design and restructuring initiatives, including role clarity, reporting relationships, job architecture and manpower alignment.

· Facilitate organisation-wide interventions relating to culture, values, employee engagement, leadership effectiveness and change management.

· Partner with business leaders to identify capability and effectiveness gaps and recommend suitable OD interventions.

· Support talent reviews, succession planning, leadership competency frameworks and critical-role assessment in coordination with HRBPs and the Learning & Development team.

· Drive cross-functional effectiveness initiatives and track the impact of OD interventions through defined measures.

C. HR Policy Formulation & Review

· Develop, review and update HR policies in line with business requirements, organisational philosophy, market practices and applicable labour laws.

· Own policy areas such as performance management, compensation and benefits, promotion, recruitment, learning and development, attendance and leave, employee engagement, travel and expenses, code of conduct, grievance handling and separation, as assigned.

· Conduct stakeholder consultations and coordinate with Legal, Finance, HR Operations and business leaders for policy validation.

· Prepare policy documents with clear purpose, scope, eligibility, roles and responsibilities, approval authority, process steps and exception provisions.

· Obtain approvals from the designated authority, communicate approved policies and establish periodic review cycles.

· Maintain a central repository of current policies and ensure version control, accessibility and withdrawal of obsolete documents.

D. HR Process Formulation & Governance

· Map existing HR processes, identify gaps and develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), process flows, checklists and process manuals.

· Define process ownership, service standards, timelines, approval matrices, authority levels and escalation mechanisms.

· Establish governance controls to ensure HR policies and processes are implemented consistently across departments and locations.

· Conduct periodic process reviews or audits, identify non-compliance and process deviations, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.

· Monitor policy exceptions and deviations; maintain an exception log with rationale, approvals and closure status.

· Drive process simplification, standardisation and automation in collaboration with HR Operations and HR Technology.

· Ensure process documentation remains current and aligned with changes in organisation structure, systems and statutory requirements.

E. HR Analytics & Management Reporting

· Develop periodic dashboards and management reports covering PMS, organisation effectiveness, policy compliance and process governance.

· Analyse trends and provide actionable insights to support management decisions.

· Track agreed KPIs, highlight risks and recommend corrective actions to improve effectiveness and employee 5. Educational Qualification & Experience

· MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related discipline.

· Typically 8–12 years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful exposure to PMS, OD, HR policy design and process governance.

· Experience in a manufacturing, automotive or multi-location organisation would be an advantage.

· Strong experience in stakeholder management, HR project execution, documentation and HR analytics.

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Associate Manager - Instock
description:
**Job Description**
****ASSOCIATE MANAGER, IN-STOCK OPERATIONS****
****Role Summary****
**The Associate Manager, In-Stock Operations leads a team of In-Stock Specialists, translating individual execution into consistent team-wide performance. You own the team's output quality, capacity, and development - setting priorities, unblocking your team, and driving the projects that move inventory health metrics forward. You are accountable for your team's results, not just your own.**
****What You'll Do****

* Manage a team of In-Stock Specialists (I, II, and Senior) - setting goals, assigning work, and monitoring performance against SLAs and inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate).
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, coaching, and career development for direct reports.
* Run team rituals (1:1s, stand-ups, retros) and maintain a clear view of team capacity, workload distribution, and coverage.
* Lead cross-functional projects end-to-end (e.g., WBR, new brand onboarding, expiration-date programme) - defining scope, timelines, and success metrics, and coordinating across brand management, the US team, and leadership.
* Identify and prioritize automation and process-improvement opportunities across the team, and hold owners accountable for shipping them.
* Own and present WBR-level reporting and inventory health metrics to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative and action plan.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex vendor, catalogue, or marketplace issues that require cross-team coordination or leadership visibility.
* Partner with brand management and marketplace leads to align on inventory strategy and proactively manage risk.
* Build and maintain team documentation, training materials, and onboarding processes so the team scales without you as a bottleneck.

****What Success Looks Like****

* Team consistently meets or exceeds SLAs
* Your team's capacity and skills grow over time - specialists are promoted, and the team absorbs more scope without proportional headcount growth.
* Cross-functional projects you own land on time and deliver measurable results.
* You spend meaningfully more time on planning, coaching, and problem-solving than on individual task execution.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in inventory operations, supply chain, or e-commerce operations, including direct ownership of core inventory processes.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team - formally or informally - including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Strong project management skills - able to scope, sequence, and drive cross-functional projects to completion.
* Deep fluency in inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate) and the forecasting/ordering mechanics that drive them.
* Comfortable pulling and synthesizing data from multiple systems (e.g., Snowflake, brand selling accounts) to build a narrative for leadership.
* Track record of identifying and shipping process or automation improvements using AI tools, scripts, or workflow automation.
* Experience with e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Chewy, Australia marketplace, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build trust with stakeholders across functions and time zones.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: NPI Team Leader
description:
N

PI Team Leader

 

1. Job

Overview

To lead and coordinate the day-to-day activities of the

N

PI team, ensuring the efficient and timely management of part setups, purchase order placement, supplier management, order tracking and internal approval processes.

The

N

PI Team Leader will take ownership of the team's workload, ensuring all activities are completed accurately, efficiently and within agreed timescales.

The role will be responsible for driving team performance, maintaining high standards of data accuracy, identifying process improvements and ensuring effective communication between

N

PI, Commercial, Engineering, Operations and external suppliers

, and Customer

2. Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Management

* Lead, manage and support the day-to-day activities of the

  N

  PI team.
* Allocate workloads and ensure tasks are distributed effectively across the team.
* Monitor individual and team performance against agreed objectives and deadlines.
* Provide guidance, coaching and support to team members, encouraging ownership and accountability.
* Identify training and development requirements within the team.
* Manage attendance, performance and conduct in line with company policies.
* Promote a proactive, collaborative and solutions-focused working environment.

Purchase Order Management

* Oversee the accurate and timely creation and placement of purchase orders.
* Ensure purchase orders are raised in line with approved requirements, pricing and company procedures.
* Monitor outstanding purchase orders and ensure suppliers are regularly contacted for delivery updates.
* Identify potential delays, shortages or supply issues and ensure these are escalated appropriately.
* Ensure order acknowledgements and supplier confirmations are received and discrepancies resolved.
* Maintain visibility of outstanding orders and ensure priorities are managed effectively.

Part Setup & System Management

* Oversee the setup of new parts within the

  Netsuite

  .
* Ensure all part information is received, checked and entered accurately.
* Coordinate the completion of required documentation and information packs.
* Ensure supplier details, pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities and other relevant data are correctly maintained.
* Monitor outstanding part setups and ensure any missing information is chased through the relevant departments.
* Maintain high standards of system accuracy and data integrity.

Approvals & Process Management

* Monitor all outstanding internal and external approvals to ensure they progress within agreed timescales.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to obtain missing information, documentation and authorisations.
* Identify bottlenecks within the approval process and take ownership of driving these to resolution.
* Ensure all purchasing and setup activities follow the correct approval procedures.
* Escalate delays or issues that could impact production, customer delivery or business requirements.

Supplier

, Customer

& Internal Stakeholder Management

* Maintain effective working relationships with suppliers to support timely delivery of parts and materials.
* Proactively chase suppliers where delivery dates, acknowledgements or information are outstanding.
* Work closely with Commercial, Engineering, Operations and other relevant departments to ensure requirements are understood and prioritised.
* Communicate potential supply issues and delivery risks at the earliest opportunity.
* Act as the first point of escalation for day-to-day

  N

  PI queries and issues.
* Communicate with customers, providing acknowledgement of orders and estimated due dates, also updating on any potential delays at the earliest opportunity.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Establish and maintain visibility of the team's workload, outstanding activities and priorities.
* Monitor key performance indicators to measure team effectiveness and delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce administrative delays and increase efficiency.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accuracy and accountability.
* Ensure processes and working instructions are documented, understood and consistently followed.
* Provide regular updates to the

  NPI

  Manager on team performance, challenges and areas requiring support.

3. Key Skills & Experience

* Previous experience within purchasing, procurement, supply chain or materials management.
* Previous experience in a team leader or supervisory position, or demonstrable experience supporting and guiding others.
* Strong organisational and workload management skills.
* Good understanding of purchase order processes and supplier management.
* Experience working with ERP or MRP systems.
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify issues and drive them through to resolution.

4. Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* A proactive rather than reactive approach to workload management.
* Good leadership and people management skills.
* A high level of organisation and attention to detail.
* Confidence in managing priorities and challenging outstanding actions.
* A solutions-focused mindset.
* The ability to work independently while maintaining effective communication with the wider business.
* A commitment to developing the team and improving departmental performance.

5. Key Performance Measures (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against agreed departmental objectives, including:

* Timely and accurate purchase order placement.
* Completion of part setups within agreed timescales.
* Reduction in outstanding and overdue purchase orders.
* Supplier delivery performance and effective order expediting.
* Timely progression and completion of approval processes.
* Accuracy of system data and purchasing information.
* Team productivity and workload management.
* Reduction in outstanding actions and process bottlenecks.
* Team development, engagement and individual performance.

6. Overall Accountability

The

N

PI Team Leader is accountable for ensuring the

N

PI team operates effectively, with clear priorities, defined responsibilities and consistent delivery.

They will be expected to take ownership of day-to-day operational challenges, ensure issues are identified and addressed proactively, and provide the leadership necessary to develop a capable, organised and accountable team.

title: Cloud Financial Operations Manager
description:
Cloud Financial Operations Engineer
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 3–10 Years
* Location:\*\* Pune
* Working Hours:\*\* 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST

### Job Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Cloud Cost & Financial Analyst with hands-on experience in cloud financial management, cost optimization, and data analytics. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of public cloud pricing models and the ability to analyze cloud expenditure, identify cost-saving opportunities(197), and prepare meaningful financial reports.
  
  
The role involves working with cloud cost management platforms, consolidating financial data, and presenting actionable insights to business and technical stakeholders.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities & Technical Requirements
  
  

* \*\*Cloud Financial Management:\*\* Understand public cloud pricing structures, billing models, resource utilization, and cloud expenditure management across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* \*\*Cloud Cost Management Tools:\*\* Work with cloud-native and third-party cost monitoring and optimization tools such as AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Trusted Advisor, GCP Billing, GCP Recommender, BigQuery, and Ternary.
* \*\*Cost Optimization:\*\* Analyze cloud spending patterns, identify cost inefficiencies, and provide recommendations to optimize cloud infrastructure expenditure.
* \*\*Data Analytics & Reporting:\*\* Collect, consolidate, and analyze financial and cloud usage data to generate comprehensive reports and dashboards.
* \*\*Data Visualization:\*\* Utilize tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Google Data Studio to create dashboards and present financial insights.
* \*\*Database & Programming:\*\* Apply SQL and Python for data extraction, processing, analysis, and reporting.
* \*\*Reporting & Documentation:\*\* Prepare detailed reports, presentations, and cost analysis summaries using MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* \*\*Stakeholder Management:\*\* Communicate findings, cost optimization opportunities, and financial insights effectively to internal and external stakeholders.

### Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  

* 3–10 years of experience in Cloud Financial Operations, FinOps, Cloud Cost Management, or a relevant IT domain.
* Strong understanding of public cloud pricing models and billing structures.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience with cloud cost monitoring, billing analysis, and optimization tools.
* Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar visualization tools.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Practical experience with SQL and Python for data analysis.
* Ability to consolidate data from multiple sources and generate meaningful reports.

title: Data Privacy Operations Manager
description:
Join us as a "Data Privacy Operations Manager" at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as a "Data Privacy Operations Manager" you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Good understanding of the data protection laws, such as GDPR, CCPA and other emerging regulation.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with the IT departments to assess the risks, manage data breaches and ensure that technical safeguards in place to protect sensitive information against unauthorized access or data leaks.
* Have an experience in conducting the DPIAs(Data Protection Impact Assessment).
* Ability to interpret the privacy policies, conduct training session, and raise awareness about the data protection practices.
* Incident response and breach management.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Advocacy for privacy design.
* Data management standard concepts related to metadata, lineage, authoritative source.
* Risk and Control Assessment.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the design and implementation of the Bank’s Data Privacy Framework, monitor and report on the Bank’s adherence to its obligations and commitments in relation to the responsible handling of personal data, and act as a point of contact with Data Protection Authorities (DPAs).
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and maintenance of the Bank’s Data Privacy Framework, including the content of Data Privacy policies, processes and procedures and other artefacts, and supporting the Bank’s Data Protection Officers in monitoring and reporting on adherence to these.
* Provision of specialist support to Business Oversight Compliance teams in their oversight of the, identification, assessment and management of potential Data Privacy risks arising from the processing of personal data and implementation of the Bank’s Data Privacy Framework.
* Co-ordination of the response to personal data breaches, including appropriate containment and remediating actions, and, where personal data breaches are assessed as triggering a requirement to report to regulators, reviewing and then co-ordinating with 1LoD, Legal and BOC to ensure any such incidents are notified to regulators and impacted individuals in accordance with relevant statutory timeframes.
* Management of Barclays relationship with DPAs by acting as a point of contact for them and ensuring timely responses to regulatory complaints and investigations, queries, and formal consultations.
* Collaboration with 1LOD Data Privacy SMEs, Legal, and other relevant Compliance teams and risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to the management of Compliance Risk and other related risks.
* Barclays representation in key Data Privacy industry groups and associations, and use intelligence gained from these to identify areas for improvement and implementation of enhancements to the Data Privacy Framework.
* Education and awareness support to employees in relation to Data Privacy, including maintenance of Group-wide mandatory training courses on Data Privacy to ensure employees are clear on their data privacy obligations, how to manage personal data securely, and how to identify and report personal data breaches.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager - HR, Talent Management & Organization Development
description:
Overview:

WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.

As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.

Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.

WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri – Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.

We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.

Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.

WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.

**Position Summary**

The Manager – HR, Talent Management & Organization Development will partner with program and functional leaders to drive effective people management, talent development, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement across WJCF. The role will oversee key HR processes, ensure operational efficiency and compliance, and support the implementation of HR strategies and initiatives in close coordination with the Director – HR.

Responsibilities:

* **Strategic HR Business Partnership**

* Partner with program and functional leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, team effectiveness, and people-related priorities.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance management, and change management.
* Support managers in addressing people challenges and strengthening leadership and team capabilities.

* **Talent Management & Organization Development**

* Support the Director HR in the implementation of performance management, learning and development, and talent development initiatives.
* Drive employee engagement, organizational culture, and team effectiveness initiatives.
* Identify capability gaps and facilitate learning interventions and manager development.
* Support compensation benchmarking and HR analytics to inform people decisions.

* **HR Operations, Compliance & Workforce Management**

* Oversee HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and employee documentation.
* Manage payroll coordination and ensure timely, accurate processing.
* Oversee third-party staffing and contract management, including vendor coordination.
* Monitor labour law developments, statutory compliance, and policy implementation, working with the Director HR and external legal advisors as required.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance HR efficiency, systems, and service delivery.

* **Employee Engagement & Experience**

* Drive employee engagement, wellbeing, and employee experience initiatives.
* Support POSH compliance, Internal Committee functioning, and employee awareness initiatives.
* Lead India-wide HR communication forums, including HR All-Calls, Annual Retreats.
* Strengthen employee feedback mechanisms, conduct exit interviews and support timely resolution of concerns.

* **HR Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Guide and support HR team members in delivering effective HR services.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure consistent and responsive HR delivery.

Qualifications:

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 8 years proven HR generalist experience
* Experience in implementing talent management strategies and organizational development initiatives
* Expertise in employee engagement, performance management, and learning & development
* Proven experience in managing HR operations and compliance requirements
* Experience in compensation benchmarking and total rewards strategy implementation
* Informed of Indian labor laws and statutory HR compliances
* Experience in developing and implementing HR systems and processes
* Prior experience in managing employee relation issues within the India country context
* Experience working with HRIS/HRMS implementation and optimization
* Experience in working with matrix organizations and managing multiple stakeholders

**Skills and Traits**
=====================

* Strong analytical mindset with ability to leverage data for strategic decision-making
* Excellence in written and verbal communication, with ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels
* Demonstrated ability to design and facilitate training programs and employee engagement initiatives
* Strong project management capabilities with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated, with proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with teams
* Adept interpersonal skills; demonstrated strength in stakeholder management and relationship building
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational excellence
* Change management capabilities with experience in driving organizational initiatives
* Strong problem-solving abilities with a solution-oriented mindset
* Operating style suited to working in a large organization with a multigenerational and diverse workforce

**Additional Requirements**
===========================

* Experience working in matrix organizations and managing multiple stakeholders
* Strong understanding of development sector HR practices
* Demonstrated experience in leading organizational change initiatives
* Proven track record of successful business partnership with senior stakeholders

***Last Date to Apply: 18 December 2026***

title: Global People Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, you’ll support evidenced\-based decision making. You’ll provide analytical input to support the Global People team and work with stakeholders across BCG. You’ll add a quantitative perspective to discussions on new and existing HR processes and procedures
   

  

 You will apply an analytics mindset and empower internal clients with dashboards, data, and reports to help improve processes, and solve people related challenges, to provide thought leadership on the complete cycle of talent analytics, from sourcing the candidates to managing attrition
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop, design, and manage advanced Tableau and Power BI dashboards that integrate data from diverse sources
* Use SQL to query databases and retrieve relevant data for analysis and reporting Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to create efficient and scalable data models
* Thought partner with internal stakeholders on various people related challenges, by developing domain expertise
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency through rigorous testing and quality checks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and understand data sources


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in an engineering or other technology\-related fields, with high academic achievement required; advanced degree preferred
* MUST HAVES: 5\-7 years of full time Tableau and Power BI dashboard development, data modeling, and SQL language expertise
* Advanced Tableau experience, including Tableau server management, level of detail calculations, built custom charts, hyper data source, Javascript APIs
* Advanced Power BI skills, with a focus on dashboard development including DAX calculations, custom visualizations, and Power Query
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles for creating intuitive and visually impactful Tableau dashboards
* Knowledge in SQL for querying databases, optimizing data retrieval, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with skills in data manipulation, including sorting, filtering, and using formulas to analyze and organize complex data sets
* Background in HR data analysis and HR domain knowledge is preferred, however not mandatory
* Deep interest and aptitude in data, metrics, and analysis


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* As part of the Global People analytics team, you will modernize HR platforms, capabilities \& engagement, automate/digitize core HR processes and operations and enable greater efficiency. You will collaborate with the global people teams and colleagues across BCG to manage the life cycle of all BCG employees.
* The People Management Team (PMT) is comprised of several centers of expertise including HR Operations, People Analytics, Career Development, Learning \& Development, Talent Acquisition \& Branding, Compensation, and Mobility. Our centers of expertise work together to build out new teams and capabilities by sourcing, acquiring and retaining the best, diverse talent for BCG.
* We develop talent and capabilities, while enhancing managers’ effectiveness, and building affiliation and engagement in our global offices. The PMT also harmonizes process efficiencies, automation, and global standardization. Through analytics and digitalization, we are always looking to expand our PMT capabilities and coverage.


 Additional info
   

  

**You are good at**
* Providing analytical support in metrics, reporting, and dashboard development
* Leading technical aspects of a large project with minimal supervision
* Generating insights from large and complex datasets, and understanding the nuances and inconsistencies in data
* Ability to multi\-task and operate effectively in a fast\-paced and customer\-oriented environment; ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix organization
* Communicating and presenting technical details to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal skills, who showcases credibility and excels in a collaborative setting


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: People and Culture Business Partner

Join our collaborative People and Culture (P&C) team and partner with people leaders across several front office business groups to translate business priorities into practical people outcomes.

You will work closely with people leaders across several front office business groups, Regional Business Partners and specialist teams to deliver people priorities. You will also manage complex people matters, build leadership capability and deliver strategic HR programs that attract, develop, retain and engage high-performing talent.

### **What you offer**

* Excellent business partnering skills with 9+ years of experience in a business partnering role, with the ability to align people strategies to business objectives and influence senior stakeholders.

### **What we offer**

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year

WHO CAN APPLY

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Purpose**

The HRBP Assistant provides operational and administrative support to the Human Resources Business Partner in implementing the company's HR policies, processes and initiatives.

The role is responsible for personnel administration, supporting payroll preparation and coordination, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring the effective execution and follow-up of day-to-day HR activities.

The HRBP Assistant also supports the HRBP in coordinating HR processes, monitoring key HR indicators, managing HR campaigns and implementing cross-functional projects, while ensuring compliance with internal procedures, applicable labor legislation and established deadlines.

**Main Responsibilities**

* **HR Administration and Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the administrative aspects of the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, internal mobility, promotions, suspensions and offboarding.
* Prepare employment contracts, amendments, certificates, employment attestations and other HR-related documents.
* Follow up on document signatures and ensure proper filing and archiving of contractual documents.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee files, both physical and electronic.
* Update employee information and HR data in the relevant HR systems.
* Manage the administrative follow-up of leave, absences, permissions and overtime.
* Monitor probation periods and alert the HRBP of upcoming deadlines.
* Respond to employees' routine requests related to personnel administration.
* Ensure compliance with internal HR procedures and administrative deadlines.

**2. Payroll Preparation and Coordination Support**

* Collect and consolidate payroll inputs, including absences, leave, overtime, bonuses, allowances and benefits.
* Prepare and update payroll input files.
* Check the consistency and accuracy of collected payroll data before submission to the HRBP.
* Ensure timely transmission of payroll inputs to the external payroll provider.
* Assist in reviewing payroll reports and identifying potential discrepancies.
* Follow up on payroll corrections and adjustments.
* Prepare supporting documents and justifications required for payroll processing.
* Provide administrative support for social security declarations and CNSS-related documentation, in coordination with the HRBP.

**3. Recruitment and Onboarding**

* Provide administrative and operational support throughout the recruitment process.
* Prepare the administrative documentation required for new hires.
* Coordinate recruitment-related administrative formalities.
* Follow up on onboarding activities and ensure completion of required formalities.
* Contribute to the preparation and coordination of induction programs and onboarding materials.

**4. Performance Management and Talent Development**

* Support the organization and follow-up of performance evaluation campaigns (Cubes).
* Monitor deadlines and send reminders to managers and employees.
* Consolidate performance evaluation results.
* Provide administrative support for performance improvement plans (Optimiz).
* Maintain and update training records and employee development plans.
* Coordinate training logistics and administrative arrangements.
* Follow up on training registrations, attendance and evaluation forms.
* Maintain accurate employee training and development records.

**5. Employee Engagement and HR Communication**

* Support the organization of internal events.
* Prepare and distribute HR communications following HRBP approval.
* Contribute to improving the overall employee experience.
* Follow up on employee requests and feedback and escalate relevant matters to the HRBP.

**6. HR Reporting and KPI Monitoring**

* Collect and update data required for HR reporting.
* Maintain and update HR dashboards and tracking files.
* Prepare and consolidate data required for HRBP analysis and decision-making.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency and reliability of HR information.

**7. HR Projects and Continuous Improvement Support**

* Provide operational support to the HRBP in implementing HR projects and initiatives.
* Participate in the execution and monitoring of HR action plans.
* Track project deadlines and ensure follow-up on assigned actions.
* Contribute to the preparation and updating of HR procedures and documentation.
* Participate in HR digitalization and process improvement initiatives.
* Identify operational issues and suggest improvement opportunities.
* Provide administrative support for organizational development and transformation projects.

**8. HR Compliance and Legal Administrative Support**

* Ensure that HR administrative documents comply with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain proper filing and archiving of HR documentation in accordance with confidentiality requirements.
* Prepare supporting documentation for HR audits and administrative inspections.
* Assist in preparing disciplinary case files under the supervision of the HRBP.
* Monitor administrative deadlines and social obligations.
* Prepare documents required for interactions with social security organizations and government authorities.
* Report any identified discrepancies or potential compliance risks to the HRBP.
* Ensure strict confidentiality of employee information and personal data.

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. Job Description:

**Analyst – Technical Support JD**

Provide pre- and post-sales technical support for Heatcraft commercial refrigeration products. You will assist customers, end-users and field sales with basic product questions, troubleshooting, installation, operation and maintenance support. This position will develop product and refrigeration knowledge through training, hands-on experience and working with more experienced technical team members.

* Provide customer technical support for Heatcraft products through phone and email communication.
* Assist customers with basic product setup, operation and troubleshooting.

* Develop knowledge of Heatcraft products, refrigeration systems, controls and troubleshooting practices through training and experience.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of international voice/customer support experience, preferably supporting US customers in an inbound environment.

title: Scale Customer Success Manager
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
  
  
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Our vision:**
A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
  
  
**About the Role:**
You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. As a Scaled Customer Success Manager on our Wrike Self Service team, you will drive platform adoption, retention, and account expansion across a high-volume customer portfolio. By combining scalable digital initiatives with targeted 1:1 touchpoints, you will ensure our customers maximize the value of Wrike while embedding a digital-first approach across our Customer Success organization.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Execute Scaled Strategies: Design and deliver digital engagement campaigns —including webinars, automated email flows, and in-app messaging—balanced with strategic 1:1 customer interactions.
* Drive Adoption & Retention: Boost product utilization and customer satisfaction across a high-volume account tier, directly impacting Gross Retention Rate (GRR) and Net Retention Rate (NRR).
* Uncover Growth Opportunities: Leverage digital health metrics and interaction data to identify, nurture, and transition expansion opportunities to growth teams.
* Monitor Customer Health at Scale: Analyze telemetry and customer usage trends to proactively identify risks and implement retention tactics.
* Advocate a Digital-First Approach: Help establish best practices and scale standard operating procedures across the broader Customer Success team.

**Your Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in Scaled Customer Success, Account Management, or customer-facing roles, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Proven track record of planning and executing digital-first customer engagement strategies.
* Strong business acumen with a data-driven approach to evaluating health metrics and growth potential.
* Fluent oral and written English communication skills.

**Standout Qualities:**

* Exceptional organizational discipline to balance high-volume automated campaigns with priority 1:1 client needs.
* High curiosity and continuous learning agility to quickly adapt to evolving platform features and customer workflows.
* Strong foundation in enterprise business processes, account management, and value-based negotiations.

**Team Dynamics:**
You will join the
**Wrike Self Service team**
, a forward-thinking group dedicated to innovating how we engage with customers at scale. You will work closely with digital strategy leads, customer marketing, and expansion teams. Reporting to the Scaled CS Lead/Manager, you’ll operate in a highly collaborative environment that values experimentation, data insights, and customer advocacy.
  
  
**Our Work Style:**
We embrace a modern, digital-first engagement model leveraging customer success platforms, product analytics, automated messaging engines, and Wrike’s own work management ecosystem. Unlike traditional CS roles focused solely on dedicated account lists, this position places you at the intersection of marketing, operations, and customer success—giving you the leverage to impact thousands of users simultaneously while honing hybrid digital/human strategy skills.
  
  
Benefits & Perks:
  
  
  

* 18 calendar days of paid vacation
* 12 days of National & Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
* Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
* Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.
* Parental Leave: 26 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
* 2 Volunteer Days
* Group Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
* Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Monthly Broadband / Internet Reimbursement (INR 1500)
* Hybrid Working Model + Complimentary Lunch & Snacks

Your recruitment buddy will be Nandini Singh, Senior Recruiter
  
  
**Who Is Wrike And Our Culture**
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Hybrid work mode**
Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
  
  
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.
  
  
**Our persona**
**💡 Smart:**
We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  
  
**💚 Dedicated:**
We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  
  
**🤗 Approachable:**
We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.
  
  
**Our culture and Values**
**🤩 Customer-Focused**
**We care about our customers.**
We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.
  
  
**🤝 Collaborative**
**We work as one and win together,**
each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
  
  
**🎨 Creative**
**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.**
It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
  
  
**💪 Committed**
**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,**
by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.
  
  
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Senior Data Partnerships Manager I
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on technical customer success leader to be the go-to expert for Nielsen’s newest data products: Audience Builder, Data Driven Linear (DDL), data clean rooms, API-based offerings such as N1 advanced audiences, and the Media Data Engine (MDE).
  
  
Working from Bengaluru with clients and colleagues in the US, you will design how clients connect to our data, build the APIs, clean rooms and scripts that make it work, and help them get measurable value from it. You will also co-lead Quality 2.0, a program with Engineering that tracks data quality by its impact on customers, not just delivery metrics.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical solutions and client integrations
  
  

* Lead technical discussions with client data, engineering and analytics teams, and design integrations that fit each client's systems.
* Set up and troubleshoot REST and GraphQL API integrations, including authentication, paging, rate limits and error handling.
* Configure and query data clean rooms (for example Snowflake, Databricks), and support audience matching and overlap analysis.
* Write production-quality SQL and Python scripts and reusable code samples that speed up client onboarding.
* Run in-depth technical training for internal teams and client technical staff.

Product expertise and adoption
  
  

* Become the expert on a portfolio of audience and measurement data products, including their data models, APIs and main client use cases.
* Support audience workflows that combine first-party, third-party and Nielsen data, and help clients activate audiences in downstream platforms through the UI, APIs and AI-agent connections.
* Help media sellers, agencies and ad tech platforms use measurement data through APIs for planning, pacing, forecasting and deal reconciliation.
* Lead onboarding and adoption for new API-based data products. Deliver tailored training, define best practices, track usage, and turn client feedback into product improvements.

Data quality and customer impact (co-lead with Engineering)
  
  

* Build and maintain a quality scorecard that combines delivery metrics, customer impact and customer feedback.
* Analyse escalation trends and customer feedback to find recurring issues and their root causes.
* Push for preventive controls, such as automated data-freshness monitoring, more reliable reprocessing, and contract tests before each release, to reduce quality issues reported by customers.

Customer success and advocacy
  
  

* Lead onboarding for new clients, with demos, training and learning materials tailored to their needs.
* Track customer health and adoption metrics, and run plans to grow usage and retention.
* Represent the client inside Nielsen, sharing their needs and market trends with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales.
* Resolve complex client issues quickly by working with internal teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**
What you will bring
  
  
Must have
  
  

* 5+ years of experience, including at least 4 years in a client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Implementation or Data Consultant, or Technical Customer Success.
* Advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning) on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.
* At least 2 years of hands-on Python for data work and automation (pandas, requests, scripting).
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs (Postman, OAuth/API keys, JSON, troubleshooting) and GraphQL APIs.
* Experience working directly with US or other global clients, including presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Data clean rooms: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp Habu, AWS Clean Rooms or Google Ads Data Hub.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS & Data pipelines and quality tools: Airflow, dbt, redshift, monitoring and alerting.

Good to have
  
  

* Media, ad tech or measurement: TV/CTV, GRPs/impressions, audience-based buying, programmatic (DSP/SSP), post-buy reconciliation.
* AI and agent tools: LLM APIs, MCP or similar agent integrations.
* BI tools (Tableau,powerbi) and work-tracking tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce).

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain.
