title: AI Success Manager (US East Customer Hours)
description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Applied AI Team**
The Applied AI team works with Glean’s strategic customers to turn AI capabilities into meaningful business results. We help customers understand where AI can have the greatest impact, imagine new ways of working, identify and launch high-value use cases, help employees adopt them, and measure the results.
  
  
We work closely with customer executives and practitioners, Product, Engineering and Sales. What we learn from customers helps shape Glean’s products, adoption programs, and broader AI strategy.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Success Manager, you will be a trusted advisor and strategic partner to a portfolio of Glean’s strategic and enterprise customers. You will work directly with executives, business leaders, technical teams, and practitioners to understand their goals, workflows, personas, and challenges.
  
  
You will help customers imagine what is possible with Glean and rethink how work can be done across their organizations. This includes uncovering opportunities they have not yet identified, shaping new AI-powered ways of working, and turning those ideas into practical use cases and adoption plans.
  
  
You will own the full customer journey - from understanding the business and defining the opportunity, through use-case design, deployment readiness, end-to-end deployment, change management, adoption, measurement, and expansion. You will be accountable for helping customers move from ideas to production and from production to measurable business results.
  
  
You will own the overall customer plan and outcomes, while partnering with AI Outcomes Managers on function-level enablement, prompting, agent building, and user adoption.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Build trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, technical teams, and practitioners; understand their goals, workflows, personas, and challenges.
* Help customers imagine what is possible with Glean and identify new ways AI can improve how people and teams work.
* Discover and prioritize high-impact use cases, then turn them into clear roadmaps with owners, milestones, and success measures.
* Own deployment readiness and lead end-to-end deployment, from technical planning and configuration through rollout, go-live, and production support.
* Drive adoption and organizational change with AI Outcomes Managers, including training, champions, prompting, agent building, and enablement.
* Define value hypotheses, baselines, KPIs, and ROI measures; lead post-deployment reviews to assess results and determine next steps.
* Maintain a clear view of customer readiness, technical health, adoption, value, risks, and opportunities; lead Executive Business Reviews around these areas.
* Monitor usage and adoption to improve how customers use Glean and expand successful use cases across teams and workflows.
* Share customer patterns and unmet needs with Product, R&D, and company leadership while prioritizing the work most likely to drive customer results.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 6+ years in enterprise AI or technology transformation roles, including Customer Success, Technical Account Management, AI consulting or deployment, Solutions Consulting, Solutions Architecture, Strategy Consulting or Value Consulting.
* Experience advising executives and business leaders at large or complex companies.
* The ability to understand how businesses and teams work, identify where AI can help, and turn those opportunities into practical plans.
* A track record of helping customers move from an undefined opportunity to a use case, deployment, adoption, and measurable results.
* Experience leading change-management programs and measuring the value of technology investments.
* Strong technical ability, including familiarity with APIs, SDKs, integrations, permissions, data flows, security, and enterprise deployment issues.
* Strong consulting and communication skills, including discovery, workflow mapping, problem framing, use-case prioritization, and executive communication.
* The ability to work credibly with executives, technical teams, and end users while managing multiple priorities.
* Genuine curiosity about how businesses operate and how AI can help people work better.

**Note**
: This role with require you to work in US East hours.
  
  
**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
  
  
**AI-First Mindset At Glean**
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**
Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.
  
  
**Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants**
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our

**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Data Implementation Manager at Kyndryl, you will lead the successful rollout and adoption of enterprise data solutions across global markets. Acting as the bridge between strategy and execution, you will coordinate regional Data Leads, Data Stewards, business stakeholders, and technology teams to ensure data capabilities are implemented consistently, efficiently, and in alignment with organizational objectives.

You will drive the implementation of Master Data Management (MDM) and other strategic Data & Measure services, transforming complex requirements into actionable plans that deliver measurable business value. Through strong leadership, governance, and stakeholder engagement, you will help create a trusted data foundation that enables better decision-making, operational excellence, and business growth.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and teamwork to help define what comes next.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead, coach, and coordinate regional Data Leads across EMEA, APAC, and North America & LATAM, as well as the global Data Stewardship team.
* Own the implementation strategy for Master Data Management (MDM) and related Data & Measure services, translating strategic objectives into phased delivery plans.
* Develop and manage implementation roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, ownership models, and success criteria for global and regional rollouts.
* Partner with Enablement, Product, Platform, Governance, and Business teams to prepare markets for successful onboarding and adoption.
* Drive market implementation activities from readiness assessment through deployment, stabilization, and transition to business-as-usual operations.
* Ensure alignment between regional requirements and global standards, governance frameworks, operating models, and product strategies.
* Coordinate stewardship activities, workload prioritization, quality expectations, issue resolution, and escalation management across regions.
* Establish robust implementation governance, reporting mechanisms, risk management processes, and executive communications.
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and resource constraints while driving timely mitigation and resolution strategies.
* Serve as the central point of escalation for complex implementation and adoption challenges.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

title: Vice President - Global Indian Premier RM
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Description**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Personal Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
To grow and nurture HSBC NR Premier relationships (the HNI segment of the PLB customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan. Manage clients with a portfolio between USD 0.5M to USD 1M. To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and RBWM performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch RBWM Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider RBWM businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant MI to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
**Typical Targets And Measures**

* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales
* Through disciplined portfolio management, develop strategies to increase wallet share of existing clients and actively manage a prospect pipeline
* Specific metrics include, but not limited to: Revenue , AUM, TRB, number of products sold to client, number of referrals, total balance of relationship portfolio
* Client experience and/or client satisfaction metric
* Measured by client retention
* Measured by increase in portfolio penetration with diversified product and service mix
* Measured by adoption of global target operating model
* Measured by evidence of the development of a network of internal relationships
* Measured by Feedback from Colleagues
* Measured by Feedback from Clients
* Measured by compliance to KYC requirements, credit, service standards and reducing operational losses.
* Measured by internal audit standards
* Measured by number of information security breaches (none)
* Measured by client complaints
* Measured by no adverse feedback received from Local Credit Team, Global Wealth credit, or from a Credit Risk Review

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum of five years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Accreditations**

* Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market AMFI & IRDA

**Additional Information**

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Portfolio Manager
description:

title: Customer Experience Lead - D2C
description: Function: Customer Experience / Operations | Employment Type: Full-timeLocation: Guindy, Chennai | Experience: 5–8 years______________________________________________________________________________About Wenova BrandsWenova Brands is a Chennai-based consumer company building science-backed, purpose-driven food brands across D2C, digital, retail and international markets.Our portfolio includes:Kiddikind – Doctor-developed, clean-label pediatric nutrition.Chewboo – Better-for-you snacking that brings together health, taste and convenience, without making healthy eating boring.We're building brands that people don't just buy, but trust, choose and grow with.The OpportunityWe're looking for a Customer Experience Lead who will own how every customer experiences Wenova after they click “buy”, and turn that experience into repeat purchases, better reviews and better products.This is not a role where you simply clear tickets and report response times. You'll be expected to build the support function, find out why customers contact us, and fix the cause so they don't need to. In a food business, and especially in pediatric nutrition, trust is built or lost in how we respond when something goes wrong.You'll work closely with Supply Chain, QA/QC, brand, marketing, D2C and finance teams to make the customer's voice a daily input into how we run the business.The five questions you'll answer, every weekWhy are customers contacting us, and what can we fix so they don't have to?Which products, batches, couriers or channels are producing the most complaints, returns and poor reviews?Are we resolving issues fast and well enough that customers buy from us again?Which complaints are potential quality or safety signals that need to go to QA immediately?What are customers telling us that brand, product and marketing should act on next week?What you'll own1. Support operations and service levelsOwn customer support across our D2C website, marketplaces and other channels, through email, phone, WhatsApp, chat and social media.Set and maintain clear service standards: first response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution and escalation rules.Build and maintain the support toolkit: helpdesk and ticketing system, macros and templates, FAQs and a knowledge base that is always up to date.Make sure every customer, across every channel, gets one consistent, warm and accurate Wenova experience.2. Complaints, quality and safety escalationCreate a clear process to log, categorise and escalate product complaints, and work with QA/QC to trace them to the batch, supplier or process.Make sure any complaint involving health, allergies, foreign matter or a child's wellbeing is escalated immediately, and that the team never gives medical advice. Route health queries to the right expert or doctor-backed content.Close the loop with every customer on what we found and what we did, and make sure fixes actually reach the product.3. Orders, returns and delivery experienceWork with Supply Chain and logistics partners to resolve delivery delays, non-delivery, damaged and wrong-item orders quickly.Own the returns, refunds and replacement policy and its execution, balancing customer goodwill with commercial sense.Reduce avoidable contacts by tracking the top reasons customers reach out, including WISMO (“where is my order”), and fixing them at source with proactive updates.4. Voice of customer and insightsTrack reviews and ratings across our website, Amazon and other marketplaces, social media and Apollo Pharmacy, and respond to them thoughtfully.Run customer surveys, CSAT and NPS, and analyse complaints and feedback by product, channel, batch, courier and customer cohort.Present a weekly voice-of-customer summary to leadership: what customers love, what frustrates them, and exactly what we should change.5. Retention, loyalty and repeat purchaseDesign post-purchase journeys (onboarding, usage tips, replenishment reminders and win-back) with the CRM, brand and D2C teams.Turn support interactions into retention: recover unhappy customers, identify loyal ones, and invite reviews and referrals at the right moments.Track repeat purchase behaviour and the effect of service quality on repeat rate and lifetime value.6. Team, training and processHire, train, coach and lead the customer support team, whether in-house or with an outsourced partner. Set clear targets and review quality regularly.Build scripts, tone guidelines and training on our products, ingredients, claims and policies, so every agent communicates accurately and with empathy.Create SOPs, escalation matrices and dashboards that keep the function running smoothly as order volumes grow.7. Cost, tools and reportingOwn the CX budget, tools and vendors, and track cost per ticket and cost to serve while protecting service quality.Use automation, chatbots and self-service where they help the customer, and never where they get in the way.Maintain clear weekly and monthly dashboards of volumes, contact reasons, SLAs, CSAT, refunds, returns and reviews, and present recommendations to leadership.How you'll be measuredCustomer satisfaction – CSAT, NPS and review ratings across the website, marketplaces and other channelsResponsiveness – First response time, resolution time and first-contact resolution against agreed SLAsContact reduction – Contacts per 100 orders, and reduction in the top repeatable contact reasonsComplaint quality – Complaints per 1,000 orders, time to escalate quality and safety issues, closed-loop rateCommercial impact – Refund and replacement cost, return rate, and cost per ticketRetention signal – Repeat purchase rate and the repeat behaviour of customers who contacted supportInsight quality – Voice-of-customer recommendations raised, and whether the resulting changes workedTeam performance – Support team quality scores, productivity and attritionWhat we're looking for5–8 years of experience in customer experience, customer support or customer success, preferably in D2C, ecommerce, FMCG, food or consumer brands, with at least 2 years leading a team.Experience managing support across multiple channels and marketplaces, and working with helpdesk or CRM tools (such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or similar).Strong understanding of CX metrics: CSAT, NPS, SLA, first-contact resolution, contact rate, refund and return rate.Experience working with logistics, supply chain and quality teams to resolve delivery and product issues.Strong analytical skills, including comfort with Excel / Google Sheets and dashboards, and the ability to turn feedback into a clear business recommendation.Excellent written and spoken communication, high empathy and sound judgement, especially when handling sensitive complaints from parents.Proven ability to build processes, coach people and bring order to a fast-growing support function.Fluency in English and Tamil is an advantage; Hindi or other regional languages are a plus.Educational backgroundGraduate in any discipline; an MBA or a degree in business, operations or a related field is a plus.Someone who sees a complaint and immediately asks, “What is this telling us, and how do we make sure no other customer has to ask?”Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to build customer trust and loyalty, not just close tickets.Why Wenova?Ownership – You build and lead how customers experience our brands from day one.Speed – Less bureaucracy. More testing, learning and doing.Access – Work directly with leadership, brand, product, QA and supply chain teams, and see your insights change the product.Scale – Wenova has grown to ₹20 crore ARR in about a year, with 40,000+ monthly orders, 13 products and presence across D2C, major marketplaces and Apollo Pharmacy.We're building from momentum.One last thingThis is a startup. You'll get the freedom to build the function your way, but you'll also be expected to own the numbers and the customer's trust.If turning customer conversations into loyalty and better products excites you, let's talk.

title: Manager- Ad Operations
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Manager Ad Operations who will:
  
  

* Lead and manage daily trafficking operations across multiple client accounts
* Supervise and motivate the team to ensure timely and accurate task delivery
* Ensure adherence to Ad Ops best practices and evolving frameworks
* Oversee tag implementation (analytics, verification, targeting)
* Coordinate with regional stakeholders, creative teams, and internal partners
* Troubleshoot trafficking and tech issues with publishers and ad servers
* Collaborate with Analytics, Tech, and Data teams to ensure accurate measurement
* Drive team training, development, and performance management
* Promote efficiency through tech adoption and process optimization
* Communicate proactively across teams and escalate challenges as needed

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:
  
  

* Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline
* 4+ years of experience in Ad Operations or campaign trafficking
* Proven experience in team setup, people management, and process development
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem (agency, media, or ad tech)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication skills (verbal & written English)
* Ability to manage workload and mentor team members effectively
* Working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript preferred

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

description:

title: Export & Import Manager
description:
**Export and Import Manager – Job Description**

Job Title: Export and Import Manager
  
Department: Export & Import / Logistics
  
Experience: 5–8 years (preferred)
  
Qualification: Bachelor's degree in International Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

Job Description
  

We are looking for an experienced Export and Import Manager to manage and oversee the company's international trade operations. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating export and import shipments, ensuring compliance with customs regulations, managing documentation, coordinating with freight forwarders and customs brokers, and ensuring timely delivery of goods while controlling logistics costs.

Roles and Responsibilities
  

1. Export Operations

* Manage end-to-end export activities, including shipment planning, documentation, and dispatch.
* Coordinate with customers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and customs agents.
* Prepare and verify export documents such as commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and certificates of origin.
* Ensure timely shipment and delivery of export consignments.

2. Import Operations

* Handle import procedures, including purchase order coordination, shipment tracking, and customs clearance.
* Coordinate with overseas suppliers, customs brokers, and freight forwarders.
* Verify import documents such as bills of entry, invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading.
* Monitor shipment status and ensure timely clearance of imported goods.

3. Customs & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable customs laws, DGFT regulations, and foreign trade policies.
* Maintain accurate records of export and import transactions.
* Coordinate with customs authorities and other regulatory bodies.
* Monitor changes in international trade regulations and documentation requirements.

4. Logistics & Supply Chain Management

* Plan and coordinate transportation, shipping schedules, and cargo movement.
* Negotiate freight rates and logistics charges with service providers.
* Track shipments and resolve delays or transportation-related issues.
* Optimise logistics costs and improve operational efficiency.

5. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain export and import records and shipment documentation.
* Prepare periodic reports on shipment status, freight costs, and operational performance.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of statutory and commercial documents.

6. Team & Vendor Management

* Supervise the export/import team and allocate responsibilities.
* Manage relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, transporters, and other vendors.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Purchase, Sales, Finance, Warehouse, and Production.

Requirements
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of export and import procedures.
* Good understanding of customs clearance and international trade documentation.
* Knowledge of Incoterms and international shipping procedures.
* Experience in coordinating with freight forwarders and customs brokers.
* Good negotiation, communication, and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

**Preferred additional knowledge:**

DGFT procedures, IEC, ICEGATE, customs duty, GST implications on imports/exports, and Letter of Credit (LC) documentation.

* Supervise the operation of CCTV, access control, fire alarm, and other security systems.

You'll own end-to-end plant supply chain for our Chennai operations, keeping production running without interruption while driving cost, inventory and compliance performance. You’ll work closely with central procurement, plant leadership and the S&OP/IBP team, and lead a network of logistics partners, warehouses and local vendors.

**What you’ll do:**

***Supply chain planning***

* Execute the plant-level supply chain strategy to ensure continuous material availability for production.
* Participate in monthly and weekly S&OP/IBP cycles, aligning production, inventory and logistics with business demand.

***Warehousing & logistics***

* Manage RM, PM and FG warehousing for optimal space utilisation and full statutory, safety and quality compliance.
* Drive efficiency in inbound and outbound logistics and maintain service-level adherence.
* Manage internal and external logistics partners for timely, cost-effective material movement.

***Vendor & procurement***

* Manage procurement of direct and indirect materials in partnership with central procurement.
* Ensure timely renewal of AMC/CAMC, plant service contracts (canteen, security, employee transport), and logistics and warehousing agreements.
* Build strong relationships with local suppliers, transporters and contractors, and improve their performance through KPIs and scorecards.

***Inventory***

* Maintain inventory norms of 4 weeks for RM and 3 weeks for PM.
* Reduce slow-moving and obsolete inventory by 20%, and manage scrap and redundant stock disposal per policy.
* Conduct periodic inventory audits for accuracy and compliance.

***Budget & cost***

* Build the annual supply chain budget across procurement, logistics and warehousing, and ensure adherence across warehousing, freight, COGS, co-packing and related cost heads.
* Lead continuous improvement projects delivering ~2% budgeted savings without compromising service or compliance.

***Compliance & safety***

* Ensure 100% adherence to statutory requirements, company SOPs, audit standards and EHS frameworks, including Gemba and safety schedules.
* Maintain accurate records of material movement, vendor contracts and purchases.

**What you’ll bring:**

* MBA in Supply Chain Management / Operations
* 8–12 years in plant supply chain, ideally FMCG or food manufacturing
* Hands-on SAP (MM/PP/WM) and advanced Excel
* Strong grasp of statutory compliance, safety and audist requirements
* Vendor negotiation and relationship management
* Strategic planning, analytical rigour, and team leadership

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Job Description — Senior Accountant

**Amadora Artisan Ice Cream**
· Velachery, Chennai · Full-time, on-site

**Department**

Finance & Accounts

**Reports to**

Financial Controller (Managing Director until the Controller joins)

**Works with**

Senior Cost Accountant, Accounts Executives (Payables & Statutory; Receivables & Banking), external CA firm

**Experience**

5–8 years

About Amadora

Amadora has been a premium artisanal ice cream brand since 2011. We make everything from scratch in our own Velachery kitchen with no premixes. We run 17 franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad and Cochin, and plan to open 15–20 new franchise stores a year across South India.

Role Purpose

The Senior Accountant owns the accuracy and timeliness of Amadora's books. The role closes the month, reviews the work of the accounts team, keeps the company compliant and audit-ready, and produces the MIS that leadership runs the business on. As the finance function grows, this person is the hands-on anchor of day-to-day accounting.

Key Responsibilities

Books & month-end close

* Run the month-end close in Tally Prime to a fixed calendar: accruals, provisions, prepaids, closing entries and trial balance review
* Review and approve entries posted by the accounts team before close
* Maintain a clean chart of accounts and correct ledger classification

Review of the accounts team

* Review payables, vendor ledgers and statutory workings prepared by the Payables & Statutory executive
* Review receivables, franchisee billing, bank entries and collections prepared by the Receivables & Banking executive
* Set up and run a maker-checker sign-off on all payments, journals and reconciliations

Reconciliations

* Bank, credit card and payment gateway reconciliations
* Vendor and franchisee ledger reconciliations, with balance confirmations
* Swiggy / Zomato settlement reconciliations against POS sales
* GST input credit reconciliation (GSTR-2B vs books)

Compliance & tax

* Review GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) before filing and prepare annual returns (GSTR-9 / 9C)
* Coordinate with the external CA firm on TDS, income tax, ROC and other statutory matters
* Track statutory due dates and make sure nothing is filed late

Inventory & stock accounting

* Account for raw material, packaging and finished goods across the central kitchen, warehouse and company stores
* Record factory-to-store transfers and franchisee stock billing correctly
* Value month-end closing stock and reconcile it to physical counts

MIS & reporting

* Prepare the monthly company and store-wise P&L / MIS from Tally
* Tie reported revenue to POS (Petpooja) sales data each month
* Explain month-on-month variances to leadership

Fixed assets & audit

* Maintain the fixed asset register and depreciation schedule; support physical verification
* Prepare audit schedules and supporting documents, and close auditor queries for statutory and internal audits

Systems & improvement

* Support the move to a finance ERP (e.g. Odoo) and better integration with the POS
* Document accounting processes and controls
* Use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to generate all required reports (MIS, reconciliations, variance analysis, ageing, GST and audit schedules), and check every output against the source data before it is shared

Qualifications & Experience

* CA Inter / CMA Inter / M.Com (qualified CA or CMA welcome)
* 5–8 years of hands-on accounting, including at least 2 years running a month-end close
* Experience in F&B, QSR, retail, FMCG or a multi-location / franchise business strongly preferred
* Has handled a statutory audit from start to finish

Skills & Competencies

* Expert in Tally Prime; strong Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations)
* Solid working knowledge of GST, TDS and Indian accounting standards
* Inventory accounting in a manufacturing or multi-outlet setting
* Highly accurate and organised; works to deadlines
* Able to review others' work and coach a small team
* Will go to the kitchen or a store to get to the bottom of a number
* Clear communicator in English and Tamil
* Must be comfortable using AI tools to build and automate reports; hands-on experience is required

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* Books closed in Tally by the 7th working day of every month, consistently
* No unreconciled bank, vendor, franchisee or GST balance older than 30 days
* Monthly company and store-wise MIS delivered on time, with revenue tied to Petpooja
* Month-end closing stock valued correctly and reconciled to physical counts
* Statutory audit closed on schedule with no major findings
* Maker-checker review in place for all payments, journals and reconciliations, with zero late statutory filings
* All recurring reports generated with AI, cutting report preparation time and manual Excel work

Working Conditions

* Based at the Velachery head office and central kitchen, Chennai
* Six-day working week; extra hours at month-end and during audit
* Occasional visits to stores and the warehouse

title: Accounts Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations, including receivables, billing, GST compliance, payroll reconciliation, and financial documentation. The role requires strong accuracy and proficiency in Zoho Books and Excel/Google Sheets. Duruper is recruiting on behalf of a client for this position.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Generate and dispatch sales invoices and accurately record bank receipts.
* Maintain customer ledgers, receivables, outstanding dues, and support collection tracking.
* Prepare GSTR-2B reconciliation, GST Annual Return data, and GST refund documentation.
* Validate salary and overtime data and reconcile payroll records with Zoho Books.
* Ensure accurate payroll-related journal entries and accounting records.
* Maintain real-time financial tracking through Google Sheets/Excel.
* Keep financial records organized, accurate, and audit-ready.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve payment and payroll discrepancies.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Education: B.Com / M.Com.
* Experience: 3–5 years of core accounting experience, particularly in GST and Accounts Receivable.
* Advanced knowledge of Zoho Books or similar ERP.
* Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets.
* Good understanding of GST compliance, especially GSTR-2B reconciliation and GST refunds.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in reconciliation and financial data.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

title: Sub Lead - Direct Tax
description:
**Job Summary**
The Sub Lead - Direct Tax Reporting will be supporting the Direct tax reporting lead in managing the preparation, review and submission of corporate income tax returns and related direct tax reporting obligations across jurisdictions. This role involves ensuring compliance with all local and international tax regulations, optimizing tax reporting processes, and providing strategic tax planning advice. The role ensures accurate reporting, regulatory compliance and effective Tax management within the Bank’s Tax function. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in direct tax reporting and a deep understanding of global tax regulations
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Direct Tax Reporting:**

* Prepare and review corporate Income tax returns and related filings across various jurisdictions.
* Support the preparation of Tax provisions in accordance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS, Local GaaP).
* Ensure timely and accurate filing of all tax-related documents to comply with local and international regulations.
* Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and global Tax policies.
* Perform or consolidate the reconciliations between tax reports, general ledger and source systems (liaise across different Data/Application management functions within Tax).
* Develop and maintain Tax reporting procedures and controls.
* Assist in preparing quarterly and annual tax provisions, including current and deferred tax calculations.
* Support preparation of Tax disclosures in financial reports.

**Compliance And Risk Management**

* Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations and assess their impact on the organization.
* Conduct regular audits and reviews to ensure adherence to tax compliance standards.
* Monitor strong internal controls and governance over tax reporting processes.
* Support Tax auditors, regulatory reviews and inquiries related to Direct Tax Reporting.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for all tax filings.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Support the Tax lead in Coordinating with global tax leads across regions on the Direct Tax Reporting matters.
* Act as the liaison between Country Tax teams, external Vendors and the Internal Application support and Data streams.
* Collaborate with External auditors, Tax advisors and Finance teams.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of tax reporting.
* Leverage technology and automation to streamline tax processes.
* Support in Developing and delivering training programs to enhance the tax knowledge and skills of the team.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team responsible for Direct Tax reporting activities and a team of tax professionals.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture within the tax team.
* Provide guidance and support for professional development and career growth of team members.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Country Tax, External consultants, Group Tax, Respective Finance and other relevant departments

**Skills And Experience**

* MS Excel
* AI Tools
* SAP/PSGL
* Automation tools

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field (e.g., CPA, CTA) is preferred.
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in tax reporting, with a focus on Direct taxes, preferably within a multinational organization or financial institution.
* Extensive knowledge of international tax laws and regulations.
* Proven experience in managing tax compliance and reporting processes across multiple jurisdictions.
* Strong understanding of tax accounting principles and practices

* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.

* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

title: Sr. Analyst FP&A, SKYWAVE
description:
Join Us as Sr. FP&A Analyst, SKYWAVE!

  

Are you a hands-on finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Sr. FP&A Analyst to play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision support across a global organization for SKYWAVE, an ORBCOMM company.

  
  

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.

  
  

Why You'll Love Working Here

  

As a Sr. FP&A Analyst
**,**
you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.

  

Based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work environment, you will collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders located in the United States and Canada, gaining exposure to global operations and cross-functional business initiatives.

  
  

This role offers a highly visible opportunity to influence business performance through rigorous analysis, financial modeling, and insightful recommendations.

  
  

What You'll Do

  

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  

  
* Support the annual budgeting process, including development of assumptions, detailed financial models, and budget consolidations.
  
* Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions.
  
* Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models.
  
* Develop and track business unit capital expenditure (CapEx) and operating expenditure (OpEx) performance.
  

  

Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis

  

  
* Support monthly financial reporting processes, including Flash reporting and Growth Day materials.
  

  

  
* Maintain key financial and operational metrics used for performance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
  
* Perform variance analysis, including actual versus budget and forecast bridge analyses with clear driver-based commentary.
  
* Provide insights and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.
  

  

Business Partnering & Commercial Finance Support

  

  
* Prepare initial deal models and supporting CRB presentation materials.
  
* Partner with Sales teams to validate deal assumptions and assess financial impacts.
  
* Conduct account-level pricing, profitability, and revenue impact analyses.
  
* Support budget control activities, including purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), invoicing, and related processes.
  

  

Data Management, Modeling & Operational Support

  

  
* Perform ad hoc financial analyses, reporting, and scenario modeling as required.
  
* Support month-end close activities and planning/BI data integrity initiatives.
  
* Work with large datasets and reporting tools to ensure accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, financial models, and analytical capabilities.
  

  
  

Who You Are

  

You are a highly analytical finance professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, financial modeling, and collaboration. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and partnering with stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.

  

If you have:

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  
* CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  
* Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.
  

  

  
* Progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance.
  
* Experience supporting global organizations and collaborating with international stakeholders.
  
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis skills.
  
* Experience performing variance analysis and translating financial results into business insights.
  
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
  
* Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets.
  
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners.
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  
* Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred.
  

  

  
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
  

  

  
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.
  

  

Then we want to meet you!

  
  

The Benefits of Working Here 
  
  
  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

  
  

How We Hire

  

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

  
  

About Us

  

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

  
  

Ready to Join Us?

  

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

  
  

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

  
  

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:

description:

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

description:
**Description**
Are you a finance leader who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? Amazon is looking for a Finance Manager to lead a team of talented finance professionals, driving financial strategy, reporting, and analysis that directly influence how we operate and grow. In this role, you will own financial planning and reporting processes, build and refine financial models, and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to shape critical business decisions. You will work with large-scale datasets, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver recommendations that have meaningful impact across the organization. If you are a collaborative, analytical thinker who enjoys building scalable processes and developing high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a real difference at Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead financial reporting, forecasting, and budgeting cycles, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery of insights that inform strategic and operational decisions across the organization.
* Drive automation projects to improve productivity and data accuracy
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards that report teams performance, forecasting accuracy and quality of the deliverables.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify financial risks and opportunities, developing data-driven recommendations that improve cost efficiency and support long-term business goals.
* Establish and improve scalable finance processes, workflows, and audit mechanisms that enhance operational rigor and reduce complexity across teams.
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of finance professionals, setting clear expectations and creating growth opportunities that build the next generation of finance leaders.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning might start with reviewing financial close deliverables and preparing a narrative for leadership that explains key variances and their business implications. By midday, you could be collaborating with operations or technology partners to refine a cost model or evaluate a new investment proposal. In the afternoon, you may lead a team meeting to align on priorities for the upcoming planning cycle, followed by a one-on-one coaching session with a direct report focused on their career development.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our finance team plays a vital role in enabling Amazon to make informed, data-driven decisions at scale. We partner closely with business and technology teams to deliver financial insights, establish strong controls, and support strategic planning that shapes the direction of our operations. We are building an inclusive team culture grounded in collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. If you are excited about working in a fast-paced environment where your analytical expertise and leadership will directly influence business outcomes, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 3+ years of advanced proficiency in Excel (pivots, lookups, etc.) experience
* 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
* 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 5+ years of directly managing and leading a team of 5+ members experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 6+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* 3+ years of working with senior staff (e.g. c-suite) experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MSAccess, Essbase or Cognos) and providing recommendations based on results of ad hoc analyses to management for strategic decision-making

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Project Manager
description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Lead the end-to-end execution of large-scale and complex projects, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, business objectives, and contractual commitments.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, including schedules, milestones, resource allocation, procurement strategies, risk management plans, and financial targets.
* Deliver annual project performance objectives while maintaining a focus on quality, safety, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
* Coordinate activities across multiple manufacturing locations and global teams to optimize delivery, capability, and cost effectiveness.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful outcomes.
* Manage project scope, customer change requests, and contract modifications while balancing customer needs and business objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among internal stakeholders, customers, contractors, suppliers, and local business partners throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead project kick-off meetings, customer reviews, inspection activities, milestone assessments, and project status discussions.
* Ensure customer specifications, technical requirements, and documentation deliverables are fulfilled or appropriately addressed.
* Partner with project financial resources to establish, track, and achieve project financial targets and performance metrics.
* Drive margin improvement through disciplined project execution, effective change management, and proactive decision-making.
* Support project closeout activities, including documentation completion, customer handover, and transition to ongoing support teams.
* Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement in all aspects of project delivery.

**Who You Are:**

You create a compelling vision that inspires others and connects project objectives to broader business goals. You effectively plan, prioritize, and align resources to achieve successful outcomes while ensuring accountability across diverse teams. You make timely, well-informed decisions by balancing technical, commercial, and customer considerations. You build strong relationships, communicate clearly across different audiences, and influence stakeholders through collaboration, credibility, and sound business judgment. You leverage financial and commercial insight to manage project performance while maintaining a customer-focused approach in a global environment.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Demonstrated experience leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, locations, or countries.
* Ability to manage project schedules, budgets, risks, resources, and contractual commitments throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving alignment across diverse teams.
* Understanding of contract administration, commercial principles, and change management processes.
* Ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make effective decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand engineering concepts and project requirements.
* Commitment to delivering high-quality customer experiences while achieving business objectives.
* Willingness and ability to travel regionally or internationally based on project requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Experience managing large-scale, multinational, or highly engineered projects in industrial, manufacturing, automation, energy, or related industries.
* Professional project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, APM, or equivalent.
* Experience working with project financial management tools, reporting systems, and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of global project execution methodologies and best practices.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project outcomes and customer value.

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

By joining Emerson, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work that advances technology, improves operational performance, and supports customers around the world. We offer competitive compensation and benefits programs designed to support your well-being, professional growth, and long-term success. Emerson is committed to maintaining a safe, flexible, and inclusive workplace where individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. Through continuous learning, collaboration, and innovation, we empower our employees to achieve their full potential and make a lasting impact on our customers, communities, and business.

  

**WHY EMERSON**

**Our Commitment to Our People**

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

title: Senior Portfolio Risk Manager
description:
Location New Delhi, India

Job Category Finance / Controlling

Deadline December 02, 2026

As our new Senior Portfolio Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the success of a diverse and complex project portfolio within a large organization. Acting as a trusted advisor to project teams and leadership alike, you will bridge the gap between day-to-day project execution and enterprise-level strategy.

  

**The role and impact**
  
Your mission is to embed a proactive, risk-aware culture across both customer-facing and internal investment projects—ensuring that every project has clearly mapped, graduated risks with actionable mitigation plans, and that our most critical organizational risks are effectively reduced.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Project Teams: Collaborate closely with project managers and teams across the full project lifecycle to identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, and report risks, ensuring risk registers remain accurate and up to date for both customer and internal investment projects.
* Drive Organizational Risk Mgmt. for Operations: Work alongside the operational leadership team and the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function to ensure significant organizational risks are identified, evaluated, and addressed in alignment with company-wide standards.
* Deliver Strategic Insights: Prepare and present portfolio-level risk reports and dashboards, translating complex data into clear trends, insights, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
* Build Frameworks & Capability: Establish and maintain portfolio risk management structures, processes, and templates while coaching and training project teams on best practices, tools, and principles.
* Audit, Escalate & Evolve: Conduct regular reviews of risk management activities, escalate critical issues to the appropriate management level, and continuously improve our methodologies and tools based on industry developments.
  

**What you’ll bring**
  
You are a seasoned risk professional who works effectively in complex environments with shifting priorities and knows how to turn risk management from a "box-ticking exercise" into a genuine value driver. You have the strategic mindset to see the big picture across a large portfolio, paired with a practical, collaborative and pragmatic approach to support project managers in the trenches.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

* Proven Experience: Extensive experience in project or portfolio risk management within a large, complex organization, covering both external client deliveries and internal investments.
* Methodological Mastery: Deep knowledge of risk management frameworks, assessment methodologies, governance structures, and reporting tools.
* Effective Stakeholder Management: Clear communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence operational leaders, align with enterprise functions, and coach project teams effectively.
* Analytical Mindset: A sharp eye for patterns and trends, with the ability to synthesize complex project data into executive-ready dashboards and clear recommendations.
* Proactive & Structured Approach: Proactive and able to work independently with a continuous-improvement mindset that ensures frameworks stay modern, audits are constructive, and critical risks are mitigated before they escalate.

You hold a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, project management, business administration, or a related field and a certification or accreditation in risk management, such as PMI-RMP, IRM, or CRMA. You are proficient in using risk management software, tools, and systems, such as Primavera Risk Analysis, @Risk, Smartsheet, or RiskyProject.

  

**Why join us**

At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen. And with your contributions, we’re shaping a more sustainable future with solutions that truly matter.

We prioritize the safety and well-being of our employees and are committed to maintaining a safe work environment where everyone looks out for each other's health and safety.

  

**Your new team**

You will be part of a global Project Management Office (PMO), which serves all Topsoe’s project teams across customer and investment projects. The PMO supports project managers in effective project execution through strong governance, practical support, and project control, and drives portfolio and risk mgmt. for the full area in close collaboration with the operational leadership team.

The PMO team is a global team and collaborates closely to continuously improve and implement change initiatives. It holds diverse profiles with expertise covering EPCM, project mgmt., scheduling, portfolio mgmt., and risk mgmt., building on industry experiences from various industries including O&G, infrastructure, renewable energy, civil, chemicals, and engineering.

  

**How you apply**

If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

  

Application deadline: December 2, 2026.

  

You do not need to attach a cover letter. Instead, include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please do not include a photograph in your CV; these measures help us support a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

  

**About us**

Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced energy transition solutions for producing clean and conventional fuels and chemicals.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading catalysts and technologies for transforming resources into renewable, low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals, as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe.
