title: Global Service Desk Analyst I
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**About Machinify**
Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.
  
  
We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Global Service Desk Analyst serves as the first point of contact for employees seeking technical support. This role is responsible for delivering outstanding customer service, resolving technology issues, and ensuring timely ticket management using IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically proficient, and motivated to support a fast-paced, technology-driven environment while partnering with global IT teams.
  
  
Machinify's Global Service Desk is a strategic extension of the Global IT organization, providing follow-the-sun support to employees across North America and India. Analysts are expected to take ownership of incidents, leverage AI-enabled tools, and collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Identity, Endpoint Engineering, and Enterprise Applications teams to deliver exceptional service.
  
  
What You Will Own
  
  

* Serve as the first point of contact for IT incidents, service requests, and support inquiries.
* Log, categorize, prioritize, and route tickets according to established ITSM processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, account access, and application-related issues.
* Support Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers, and collaboration platforms.
* Perform password resets, account unlocks, MFA troubleshooting, and basic identity management tasks.
* Meet established SLA targets for response, communication, and resolution.
* Escalate incidents to specialized support teams when required.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation, knowledge articles, and support records.
* Promote self-service resources and knowledge management practices.
* Participate in continuous improvement, automation, and AI-driven support initiatives.
* Collaborate with global IT teams to ensure consistent service delivery and an exceptional employee experience.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**

* Windows 10/11 support and troubleshooting
* macOS support and troubleshooting
* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office Applications)
* Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID fundamentals
* Password management, MFA, and identity access support
* ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or equivalent
* Basic networking concepts including DNS, DHCP, VPN, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting
* Mobile device support (iOS and Android)
* Slack, Teams, and enterprise collaboration tools
* Knowledge base and documentation management

**Preferred**

* Microsoft Intune
* JAMF Pro
* Okta
* Google Workspace
* AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar productivity platforms

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 2-4 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, Technical Support, or related customer support role.
* Experience supporting users in a corporate environment.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
* Excellent customer service, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a global team.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to service quality.

**Preferred**

* Associate's degree or a Technical Diploma in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge.
* Experience working within a global support organization.
* Exposure to AI-powered support tools, automation, or virtual agent technologies.

Shift Coverage & Support Expectations
  
  

* Support a global workforce across multiple time zones, including India and the United States.
* Participate in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.
* Support multiple service channels including phone, chat, Slack, email, self-service portal, and virtual agent platforms.
* Participate in major incident and escalation activities when required.
* Maintain high standards for ticket quality, documentation accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure appropriate ticket ownership, communication, and handoff between shifts.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify
  
  
*Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiting team know.*

description:

is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. * Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
* Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.
* The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research and is responsible for driving the day-to-day operation of the Product & Technology organization, including project and portfolio management and tracking; organization-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team.

**Job Summary**
As a key member of the Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology team, the Technical Analyst I plays a critical role in supporting global media production and distribution systems. This role serves as the first line of technical engagement, responsible for intake, triage, and resolution of incidents, issues, and service requests, while ensuring seamless collaboration with engineering teams. The selected candidate will be able to leverage problem solving skills to execute the right runbooks to maintain service availability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Resolve standard issues and fulfill requests by following documented procedures
* Serve as the initial technical point of contact for customer-reported issues, leveraging strong problem-solving skills to triage and resolve concerns efficiently
* Work with and effectively communicate with Software, Infrastructure, and/or Network Engineers during incidents about necessary solutions to drive issues to resolution
* Closely monitor active incidents, and support engagement of engineering teams to ensure timely resolution of complex technical challenges
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, internal support teams, and product engineering to ensure alignment and transparency throughout the resolution process
* Monitor service‑health and communication channels (Datadog, BigPanda, Teams, email) and raise issues promptly to major incident management or to support teams as necessary
* Document incidents thoroughly in ServiceNow and Jira; maintain ticket hygiene and ensure all fields are correctly filled out
* Participate in training programs to build and enhance technical acumen

An ideal applicant should possess a solid technical background in IT, software, or production support, with problem solving skills to aid in resolving issues. This role demands swift incident detail gathering and analysis while providing troubleshooting support. Collaboration with engineering for specialized expertise is required. Active participation in incident management to ensure comprehensive documentation and lifecycle tracking for efficient issue resolution is vital. This role supports high service availability while minimizing disruptions across critical systems.

**Responsibilities And Duties Of The Role**
Incident Intake & Escalation
  
  

* Serve as the main point of contact for handling incidents reported by stakeholders by capturing incident details through phone calls, chat, or monitoring.

* Collaborate with technical support teams, engineering, and support teams to ensure incidents are resolved quickly.

Documentation, Incident Tracking and Reports, & Training
  
  

* Operate within the ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, and PagerDuty environments and ensure that procedures around tracking and reporting issues are being followed.
* Participate actively in incident management processes, documenting and tracking incidents throughout their lifecycle.
* Document solutions, best practices, and troubleshooting procedures to contribute to the knowledge base.

Monitoring
  
  

* Monitor various service-health platforms and stakeholder communication platforms like Teams, Datadog, BigPanda, email, etc.
* Proactively identify and address potential issues or performance bottlenecks.

* 1+ years of experience in a 24x7 IT call center or helpdesk role
* Knowledge of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, PagerDuty, and JIRA
* Hands-on experience fulfilling user service requests and leveraging problem solving skills to troubleshoot front-line technical issues
* Ability to work well under pressure and manage priorities with urgent deliverables
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder, peer interaction, and collaboration with other teams

description: DescriptionSikich is hiring an IT Support Engineer - NOC Analyst to join our Managed Services team. This is an infrastructure and server-side NOC role focused on monitoring, triaging, and supporting client server, network, cloud, and backup environments across multiple clients. The engineer will operate within defined NOC procedures, respond to infrastructure alerts, execute standard troubleshooting for common NOC events such as server, internet, and power outages, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers or US-based on-call consultants when required. Strong ownership, documentation discipline, and clean escalation are core expectations for this role.About The FirmSikich is a global company specializing in Accounting, Advisory, and Technical professional services. With employees across the globe, Sikich ranks as one of the largest professional services companies in the United States. Our comprehensive skillsets, obtained over decades of experience as entrepreneurs, business owners and industry innovators, allow us to provide insights and transformative strategies to help strengthen every dimension of our clients businesses.What will you do in this role?Monitor client infrastructure environments including servers, networks, backups, cloud resources, and endpoint management platforms across multiple clients. Investigate and triage infrastructure alerts related to servers, networking, internet connectivity, power, backups, and availability of business-critical systems. Support Windows Server environments through service and role health checks, event log review, resource utilization checks, disk space monitoring, and basic server-side troubleshooting. Perform Active Directory operations tasks including account status checks, group membership validation, account lockout investigation, and escalation of directory-related issues. Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity, and basic network incidents using standardized diagnostic steps. Troubleshoot basic switching, VLAN, wireless, and firewall connectivity issues using standardized diagnostic steps, and escalate complex network faults to senior engineers or the client's network provider. Perform basic health checks on virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V, including VM state, host health, and resource utilization. Monitor backup jobs, investigate backup failures, and escalate restore-related concerns based on documented backup procedures. Monitor patch compliance across servers and endpoints, deploy operating system and third-party updates through RMM tooling, triage patch failures, and coordinate reboots and maintenance windows per documented procedures. Execute NOC runbooks and SOPs for common infrastructure events and escalate cleanly when issues fall outside defined procedures. Coordinate with senior engineers and US-based on-call consultants for complex incidents by providing clear findings, evidence, and troubleshooting steps already performed. Maintain accurate ticket documentation including alert details, business impact, investigation steps, resolution notes, and escalation trail. Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams and clients during incident investigation and resolution. Contribute to knowledge sharing, SOP updates, and continuous improvement of NOC procedures and runbooks. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and SLAs while delivering infrastructure support. Participate in after-hours on-call rotation as required to support client NOC needs outside regular business hours. What do you need to succeed in this role?2-4 years of experience in Infrastructure Support, NOC Operations, Managed Services, Server Support, or a closely related IT operations role. Hands-on exposure to Windows Server environments and basic server-side troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy basics. Experience with monitoring platforms and infrastructure alert response. Exposure to patch management and operating system / third-party update deployment through RMM or patch management tooling. title: IT Support & Systems Administrator
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Eastern Time Business Hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$25,000 - $30,000 annually
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Langford Staffing is hiring an IT Support & Systems Administrator to support more than 100 remote users working across several technology-enabled and service-based companies.
  
  
You will be responsible for employee access, account administration, technical support, phone systems, software permissions, security controls, and IT documentation.
  
  
This is a hands-on position for someone who can work independently, solve technical problems, protect company systems, and provide reliable support across a distributed international workforce.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Create email accounts, system credentials, and permissions for new hires.
* Remove access immediately when employees or contractors leave.
* Administer Google Workspace, Outlook, Zoho, Zoho Vault, proprietary CRM systems, RingCentral, and other business applications.
* Configure RingCentral users, extensions, call queues, routing, and IVR systems.
* Troubleshoot employee access, email, software, phone, and connectivity problems.
* Assign CRM access and permission levels based on each user’s role.
* Enforce MFA, password, and access-control requirements.
* Review user access regularly and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
* Investigate suspicious activity, compromised accounts, and potential security incidents.
* Block user access immediately when there is credible evidence of a security risk.
* Maintain accurate records of accounts, permissions, licences, systems, and access changes.
* Manage software licences and coordinate with external technology providers.
* Create and maintain IT, onboarding, offboarding, access-control, and cybersecurity procedures.
* Train HR team members on the correct technical onboarding and offboarding process.
* Monitor critical systems and identify recurring technical or security problems.
* Recommend improvements to security, system reliability, and employee support.
* Provide emergency support outside regular hours for serious security incidents, urgent access removal, company-wide outages, or major phone-system failures.

**What You’ll Need**

* At least three years of experience in IT support, systems administration, help-desk operations, or a similar technical role.
* Experience supporting at least 50 users; experience supporting 100 or more remote users is preferred.
* Hands-on experience creating and removing user accounts, managing permissions, and supporting employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Experience administering Google Workspace and Microsoft Outlook.
* Experience with business phone or VoIP systems; RingCentral experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing CRM permissions and business applications.
* Working knowledge of MFA, password security, access control, account protection, and incident response.
* Experience with password-management systems; Zoho Vault experience is an asset.
* Ability to investigate suspicious account activity and respond quickly to security risks.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across email, user accounts, software, phones, VPNs, and remote connectivity.
* Experience maintaining technical documentation, access records, and software-licence information.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to explain technical procedures clearly to non-technical HR and operational employees.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize urgent issues, and communicate risks directly to the CEO.
* Availability during Eastern Time business hours and for serious technical emergencies when required.

A diploma, degree, or recognized certification in information technology, systems administration, networking, or cybersecurity is preferred. Strong equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this position means:
  
  

* New employees receive the correct accounts and permissions before they begin work.
* Departing users have their access removed immediately and completely.
* RingCentral call queues, routing, extensions, and IVR systems operate reliably.
* Technical problems are acknowledged promptly and resolved within reasonable timelines.
* MFA, password, and access-control requirements are consistently enforced.
* Access reviews are completed regularly, with unnecessary permissions removed.
* Security concerns are identified, contained, documented, and escalated quickly.
* Software licences and user-access records remain accurate.
* IT procedures are documented clearly enough for HR to follow during onboarding and offboarding.
* Recurring technical problems are investigated and permanently reduced.

**Who Will Succeed**
The right person is organized, security-conscious, responsive, and comfortable taking ownership of technical problems.
  
  
You must be able to distinguish an ordinary support request from a serious security or operational risk. You should act quickly during urgent incidents while remaining careful, methodical, and professional.
  
  
You will succeed if you document your work, protect sensitive information, communicate problems early, and prevent access or system issues from being overlooked.
  
  
Someone who waits for constant instructions, provides temporary fixes without investigating the cause, or treats access removal and cybersecurity as routine administrative work will struggle in this position.
  
  
**Remote Technology Requirements**
You must have:
  
  

* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Dual monitors
* Reliable internet with a speed of at least 100 Mbps
* Backup internet connectivity or a reliable power solution
* A webcam
* A noise-cancelling headset
* A private and professional workspace
* A secure, password-protected computer used only by authorized individuals

**How To Apply**
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
Selected candidates may also be asked to complete a technical interview, practical troubleshooting exercise, employment-reference check, equipment verification, and internet-speed test.

title: L2 Application Support Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**L2 Application Support Engineer**
with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, SQL, and Azure Logic Apps. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing technical and operational support for business-critical applications, troubleshooting incidents, resolving technical issues, and ensuring application availability and stability.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to manage incidents and service requests, and effective coordination with L1 support, development teams, and other stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of production issues.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide L2 production and application support for business-critical applications hosted on Microsoft Azure.
* Monitor application health, performance, and availability, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Troubleshoot application-related issues involving Azure services, Azure Logic Apps, integrations, and SQL databases.
* Analyze and resolve incidents, service requests, and recurring production issues within defined SLAs.
* Investigate application failures, workflow failures, integration errors, and database-related issues.
* Write and execute SQL queries for data validation, troubleshooting, and issue analysis.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Azure Logic Apps workflows, including failed runs, triggers, connectors, and execution errors.
* Work on incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
* Manage and update support tickets with proper investigation details, resolution steps, and closure notes.
* Coordinate with L1, L3, infrastructure, development, and business teams for issue resolution.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring and critical production incidents.
* Maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in shift handovers and ensure smooth transition of open incidents between support teams.
* Ensure adherence to support SLAs, operational processes, and service delivery standards.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Microsoft Azure: Good hands-on experience with Azure services, monitoring, troubleshooting, and application support.
* SQL: Strong knowledge of SQL queries, joins, data validation, and database troubleshooting.
* Azure Logic Apps: Experience monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting Logic Apps workflows and integrations.
* Application Support: Strong experience in L2 production/application support and incident resolution.
* Troubleshooting: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve application and integration issues.
* Ticketing Tools: Experience working with incident and service request management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.

**Required Experience & Competencies**

* 7+ years of overall IT experience, preferably in application/production support.
* Strong experience in L2 application support in an Azure-based environment.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting production issues and managing incidents.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, incident management, and problem management.
* Ability to work independently on technical investigations and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Flexibility to work in a 24x7 rotational shift environment.

Work Requirements
  
  

* Location: Bangalore
* Work Model: Hybrid – 3 Days Work from Office
* Shift: 24x7 rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays as per the support roster.
* Experience: 7+ Years

* You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

. The role will provide L3 operational support, infrastructure administration, troubleshooting, monitoring, security remediation, and participation in cloud and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Azure & AVD: Administer and support Azure infrastructure, Azure VMs, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup, Entra ID, RBAC, and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). Manage AVD host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, FSLogix, scaling, user access, and performance troubleshooting.
* Citrix Administration: Provide end-to-end administration of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD), including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, Citrix Studio, Director, VDAs, Citrix Gateway, Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, policies, applications, and user sessions. Troubleshoot VDA registration, session launch, authentication, application delivery, profile, performance, and connectivity issues.
* Citrix – VMware & Colo: Support Citrix workloads hosted on VMware vSphere/ESXi and physical/virtual infrastructure in Colocation environments. Perform VM provisioning, resource management, patching, migration, capacity planning, and troubleshooting across the physical server → VMware → Windows → Citrix stack.
* Networking: Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routing, switching, NAT, VPN, load balancing, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity. Troubleshoot connectivity between Azure, Citrix, VMware, on-premises, and Colo environments.
* Palo Alto: Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, VPN, routing, application connectivity, and firewall rules supporting cloud and Citrix environments.
* Cloudflare: Support Cloudflare DNS, CDN, WAF, SSL/TLS, proxy, and traffic management. Troubleshoot DNS, certificate, routing, and web connectivity issues.
* Colocation/Data Center: Support servers, VMware, network devices, storage, firewalls, and connectivity within Colocation/Data Center environments. Coordinate with Colo providers for hardware, remote hands, connectivity, power, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.
* Operations & Monitoring: Perform proactive monitoring, health checks, incident/problem management, P1/P2 troubleshooting, RCA, capacity management, and 24x7/on-call support as required. Experience with SolarWinds, Azure Monitor, Citrix Director, or similar monitoring platforms.
* Security & Lifecycle: Support vulnerability remediation, OS/Citrix/VMware patching, SSL certificate management, hardening, backup/DR, upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
* Automation & Documentation: Develop PowerShell/Python/Bash automation for operational tasks and maintain SOPs, runbooks, architecture documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
* Collaborate with Cloud, Network, Security, Application, VMware, Service Desk, and global infrastructure teams and provide technical mentoring to junior engineers.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and Azure AVD.
* Strong Citrix CVAD administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter experience.
* Strong Palo Alto firewall and enterprise networking experience.
* Hands-on Cloudflare administration experience.
* Experience supporting Colocation/Data Center infrastructure.
* Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, routing, and load-balancing knowledge.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, ITIL processes, change management, incident management, and RCA.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Relevant Azure, Citrix, VMware, Palo Alto, or networking certifications are an advantage.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  
  
**About Us**
From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

title: Executive/Analyst - SAP Ariba Support & Supplier Enablement  - On Contract
description:
**Role:**
**SAP Ariba Support & Supplier Enablement Executive/Analyst**
**Engagement type:**
Consultant Contract
  
  
**Location:**
[Bangalore]
  
  
**Experience:**
[3-8 years]
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To provide end-to-end support for SAP Ariba operations, drive user adoption, enable supplier onboarding, and act as the primary coordination point between business users, suppliers, SAP Ariba support teams, and implementation partners to ensure smooth functioning and continuous improvement of the procurement platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* SAP Ariba Support & Continuous Improvement
* Coordinate with implementation partners (PwC) and SAP Ariba support teams for issue resolution, system enhancements, and productivity improvements.
* Monitor and resolve day-to-day user issues, system bugs, workflow errors, and process-related challenges.
* Track open tickets, follow up on pending actions, and ensure timely closure of issues.
* Support stabilization and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance user experience and system effectiveness.
* Supplier Registration & Onboarding
* Drive supplier registration and onboarding activities within SAP Ariba.
* Coordinate with vendors for profile creation, documentation submission, qualification, and registration processes.
* Assist suppliers in completing onboarding requirements and resolving registration-related issues.
* Support new vendor creation and qualification workflows in line with company policies.
* Supplier Enablement & Training
* Act as the primary point of contact for suppliers using SAP Ariba.
* Conduct supplier training programs and awareness sessions on:

+ Supplier Lifecycle & Performance (SLP)
+ Supplier Profile Creation
+ Supplier Registration
+ RFQ/RFP Participation
+ Bid Submission
+ E-Auctions

* Develop user guides, FAQs, and training materials for suppliers.
* User Support & Adoption Management
* Provide first-level support to internal users for SAP Ariba-related queries.
* Manage user tickets and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.
* Conduct user training, refresher sessions, and awareness programs.
* Monitor system utilization across business units and identify opportunities to improve adoption and compliance.
* Workflow & Master Data Management
* Support workflow changes, approval matrix updates, and master data maintenance.
* Coordinate with relevant functions for updates related to suppliers, purchasing groups, commodity codes, and organizational structures.
* Ensure data accuracy and process compliance within the Ariba environment.
* Reporting & Governance
* Monitor SAP Ariba utilization, compliance, and performance KPIs.
* Track supplier onboarding progress, system adoption, and transaction volumes.
* Prepare monthly governance reports, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend corrective actions and process improvements.
* Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, IT, Business Users, Suppliers, PwC, and SAP Ariba support teams.
* Facilitate effective communication between internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* User Adoption Rate (%)
* Supplier Registration & Onboarding Completion Rate
* Ticket Resolution Turnaround Time (TAT)
* System Utilization Across Business Units
* Supplier Participation Rate in RFQs and E-Auctions
* Compliance to Procurement Processes
* User and Supplier Training Coverage
* Vendor Qualification Cycle Time

**Qualifications & Experience**
  
  

* Graduate in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, IT, or related field.
* 3-8 years of experience in Procurement Operations, SAP Ariba Support, Supplier Management, or Digital Procurement.
* Hands-on experience in SAP Ariba modules such as:

+ SLP (Supplier Lifecycle & Performance)
+ Sourcing
+ Guided Buying
+ Buying & Invoicing

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience in supplier onboarding and user support environments is preferred.

**Key Skills**

* SAP Ariba Administration & Support
* Supplier Onboarding & Enablement
* Procurement Process Knowledge
* Ticket & Issue Management
* User Training & Change Management
* Reporting & Data Analysis
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Problem Solving & Process Improvement

title: Software Support Engineer - 1
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: Software Support Engineer - SOLUTIONS**
**WHO WE ARE:**
**Esko**
is a part of Veralto’s Product Quality & Innovation companies. Esko is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our products empower teams to support and manage the packaging design and print processes for brand owners, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters.
  
  
**Veralto**
is a global leader in essential technology solutions with annual revenue of nearly $5 billion and a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. Our industry-leading companies and globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Mass. with 13 operating companies and 300+ locations worldwide. Our global team of 16,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on the world and is united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.
  
  
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto (VLTO) is creating today.
  
  
**Veralto’s Product Quality & Innovation companies**
—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—help package and protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials, tracing and authenticating billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day.
  
  
**Veralto’s Water Quality companies**
—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies and XOS—help manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and industrial wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**WITHIN YOUR TEAM**
As a
**Software Support Engineer – Solutions (Level‑1)**
, you will be part of a global, 24/7 support organization providing
**first‑line technical and functional support**
for Esko software solutions.
  
  
This role focuses on
**initial diagnosis, basic troubleshooting, and customer communication**
, ensuring customer issues are clearly understood, properly documented, and resolved where possible at Level‑1 or escalated effectively with thorough analysis.
  
  
You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and senior engineers while developing your technical and domain knowledge in a structured support environment.
  
  
**Job Description**
**WITHIN YOUR ROLE, YOU WILL:**
**Level‑1 Customer Support & Troubleshooting**

* Act as the first point of contact for customers reporting issues with Esko software solutions.
* Gather accurate information, understand reported problems, and perform initial troubleshooting.
* Resolve common and known issues using documentation, knowledge bases, and standard procedures.
* Identify when issues need escalation and ensure complete and clear handover to Level‑2 teams.

**Case Ownership & Communication**

* Take ownership of assigned support cases from initial contact until resolution or escalation.
* Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers.
* Provide timely updates and manage customer expectations effectively.
* Handle tense or challenging customer situations calmly and constructively.

**Documentation & Process Adherence**

* Document issues, troubleshooting steps, findings, and outcomes accurately in support tools.
* Follow defined support processes, quality standards, and escalation guidelines.
* Contribute to knowledge bases by sharing learnings and known solutions where applicable.

**Collaboration & Learning**

* Work closely with team members, Team Leaders, and other support teams across time zones.
* Participate in training, shadowing, and enablement sessions to build product and technical expertise.
* Show willingness to learn and grow towards handling more complex issues over time.

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PROFESSIONAL WHO IS:**

* A good communicator with the ability to defuse tense customer situations.
* Empathetic towards colleagues, customers, and suppliers.
* Proactive in addressing problems and curious about preventing similar issues in the future.
* An excellent listener, able to understand customer needs and manage expectations.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Knowledgeable about how web applications work, through experience or qualification.
* Comfortable working in a 24/7 support environment.
* Willing to work rotational shifts and weekends as part of scheduled workdays.
* Willing to work in hybrid mode (office and work‑from‑home) based on team planning.

**SHIFT DETAILS**

* First Shift: 03:30 AM – 12:00 PM IST
* Second Shift: 12:00 PM – 09:00 PM IST
* Night Shift: 06:30 PM – 03:30 AM IST (next day)

Weekend work (Saturday and/or Sunday) may be scheduled. These will count as regular workdays, with alternate days off provided based on schedule planning by the Team Leader.
  
  
**YOUR EDUCATION AND BACKGROUND EXPERIENCE WILL INCLUDE:**

* Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to learn quickly.
* An analytical mindset with a calm and methodical approach to troubleshooting.
* Experience handling technical issues with customers and/or internal stakeholders.
* Either:

+ 1–2 years of experience in IT support or software application / installation support.

* Experience in a software or SaaS support environment is an advantage.
* Familiarity with enterprise customer environments is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

**What We Value**
We believe that real breakthroughs come from teams that think big and respect each other’s differences – different ideas, different perspectives, and different experiences. We encourage all voices to be heard, both internally as we collaborate and externally as we listen to our customers’ most pressing needs. And we would love to have you on this journey with us! Apply today.
  
  
**Our Culture**
More important than what we do is how
**we operate together**
as a team across our global organization. Each of our businesses has a unique local culture which is inspired by variety of perspectives our diverse team members bring to the table. However, Veralto and all our businesses share the same foundation comprised of our values and passion for continuous improvement through the Veralto Enterprise System that enables our teams to bring our unifying purpose to life around the world.
  
  
**Our Values**

* We serve humanity with purpose and integrity.
* We unlock ingenuity for customer success.
* We deliver results as a team.
* We continually improve for enduring impact.

**Our offer**

* We grow talent; we give you the opportunity to develop your career based on your strengths. ESKO is a career destination for engaged passionate and talented people who are driven to seek innovation, growth, and opportunity.
* A career with ESKO will push you and challenge you, providing growth opportunities and the
* prospects to advance your career.
* If you are a driven high achiever, you will work with committed, like-minded people, giving you the
* support to reach your full potential.
* At Veralto, your potential is amplified. Our culture of continuous improvement defines who we are, drives our success, and translates to a career without limits for our team of curious associates.

**Equal Opportunity:**
**Veralto Corporation and**
all Veralto Companies are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law. We value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Problem-Solving and Resolution:**

* Coordinates with more experienced peers to report design, reliability, and maintenance problems or bugs, supporting resolution of routine issues through roll-up.

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Support Documentation:**

* Documents activities on service request and/or product documentation, learning to leverage troubleshooting guides and/or Knowledge Base articles, through resolution.
* Learns to prepare troubleshooting guides and/or create Knowledge Base articles for resolved issues.

**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement-Technical Support Collaboration:**

* Begins to develop a deeper understanding of assigned Oracle product ecosystem(s) and customer environment(s).
* Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues.

**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement-Technical Support Improvement:**

* Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues.
* Begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices, based on customer feedback and/or operational insights.

**Performance Monitoring and Management:**

* Monitors and executes own support service performance metrics, with some guidance.

**Issue Investigation & Troubleshooting**

* Analyze and investigate configuration-related issues reported by clients or stakeholders.
* Identify root causes and apply corrective changes without impacting other solutions or workflows.
* Document resolutions and improvements for future reference.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Provide clear status updates to clients, managers, and internal teams.
* Communicate risks, delays, scope changes, or dependencies proactively.
* Translate technical configurations into understandable explanations for non-technical stakeholders.

**Compliance, Standards & Documentation**
**-**
Ensure all changes adhere to organizational guidelines, quality standards, and SLAs.-
  
  

* Update configuration tracking tools, change logs, and documentation.
* Maintain audit readiness and follow ITIL-based change management processes.

**Additional Responsibilities (as Needed)**
**Services Translation:**

* Provides translation oral and verbal services for technical and non-technical inquiries for products and services, with guidance.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Change Configuration and Implementation:**

* Implement and configure changes in Cerner solutions based on client requirements and standardized build practices.
* Manage end-to-end change lifecycle: request intake, analysis, scoping, build, testing, validation, and deployment.

Ensure builds follow established configuration guidelines and maintain consistency across environments.
  
  
**Requirements Gathering And Analysis**

* Work with clients, solution architects, and internal teams to understand business requirements. Estimate work effort, clearly define scope, and document configuration details for each change request. Identify dependencies and integration points across interconnected modules or solutions. Testing & Quality Assurance
* Conduct unit, functional, and integration testing for all changes made.
* Validate system behavior, troubleshoot issues, and make adjustments as needed.

**Planning & Execution:**

* Completes assigned tasks and monitors timelines to ensure timely completion of work in accordance with project requirements, with supervision. Follows direction to prioritize work and adjust to shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates with team members to better understand expectations and contribute to shared objectives. Builds basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance.

**Problem Solving:**

* Follows standard procedures to identify and escalate issues to senior team members. Collects and reviews basic data and/or information to troubleshoot common errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Builds knowledge and learns new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices as directed. Incorporates feedback and participates in training to improve skills.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Begins to identify ways to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows with guidance.

**Qualifications**
Career Level - IC1
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:

Standard Office Hours (40/wk)

Office
  
  
**Summary**
We are seeking an experienced senior technical individual contributor to own and drive the Document Management Systems portfolio within the Oracle Center of Excellence Shared Services organization, supporting global business operations from Bangalore. This role requires hands-on technical depth across
**OpenText Captiva**
,
**e-Signature platforms (Adobe Sign and DocuSign)**
, and
**Lotus Notes**
, along with the ability to partner closely with business stakeholders, architecture teams, and vendors without direct people-management responsibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior technical resource and escalation point for OpenText Captiva, including capture workflow configuration, batch processing, troubleshooting, and production support.

+ Design and maintain batch classes, document classification, and extraction/validation rules across Captiva modules (Capture, InputAccel).
+ Support integration between Captiva and downstream repositories (e.g., Oracle WebCenter, Documentum).
+ Develop and maintain custom scripting for business rules within Captiva workflows.
+ Support version upgrades, patching, and environment troubleshooting.

* Own administration, configuration, and support of e-Signature platforms (Adobe Sign and DocuSign), including workflow/template management, integrations, and issue resolution.

+ Configure and support integrations with Malbek, Salesforce, and Workday, along with other enterprise systems requiring signature-triggered workflows.
+ Build and maintain custom API integrations using DocuSign and Adobe Sign SDKs/REST APIs for automated document routing and signature workflows.
+ Design workflow/template routing rules, bulk send configuration, and SSO/authentication integration.
+ Configure audit trail and reporting for compliance requirements.

* Provide technical support and administration for Lotus Notes applications, including maintenance, troubleshooting, and coordination of any migration/modernization efforts off the platform.

+ Support Domino server administration and Notes application/database maintenance (ACLs, replication, agents).
+ Contribute to migration planning and execution for moving legacy Notes applications to modern platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Power Platform).

* Own day-to-day operational support, enhancements, and administration of enterprise Document Management Systems supporting global business functions.
* Drive application lifecycle management, including roadmap input, risk mitigation, and compliance initiatives for owned platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architecture teams, and vendors to translate requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Support and help govern annual operating budget and CapEx project execution in collaboration with IT leadership.
* Monitor and report on KPIs, SLA compliance, and incident trends; lead root-cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts.
* Support global service delivery across multiple time zones, ensuring platform availability and uninterrupted operations.
* Design and deliver automation initiatives using RPA, Microsoft Power Automate, and Python to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
* Lead proactive support strategies to improve issue resolution timelines and reduce operational risk.
* Contribute technical and functional expertise to enterprise projects, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and quality delivery.
* Support modernization initiatives for legacy business applications while maintaining operational stability.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production incidents and enhancement requests.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master's preferred).
* 12+ years of progressive IT experience, including enterprise application support and delivery.
* Hands-on experience with OpenText Captiva, including batch class design, document classification/extraction rules, and integration with downstream ECM repositories (e.g., Oracle WebCenter, Documentum).
* Hands-on experience administering Adobe Sign and DocuSign, including workflow/template design, routing rules, and SSO/authentication integration.
* Experience building custom API integrations using DocuSign/Adobe Sign SDKs or REST APIs, including integrations with Malbek, Salesforce, and Workday.
* Working technical knowledge of Lotus Notes, including Domino server administration and Notes application/database maintenance (ACLs, replication, agents).
* Working knowledge of ITIL service management practices (incident, problem, release management).
* Experience with workflow automation tools (RPA, Microsoft Power Automate, Python) a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills across global, multi-region teams.
* Experience contributing to or managing project budgets and vendor relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience supporting global shared-services or Center of Excellence models.
* Experience with Lotus Notes-to-modern-platform migration efforts.
* Exposure to business continuity planning and regulatory compliance within enterprise application environments.

**Core Competencies**

* OpenText Captiva capture & workflow administration
* e-Signature platform administration (Adobe Sign, DocuSign)
* Lotus Notes support & administration
* Technology strategy & application modernization
* Service operations & SLA governance
* Risk management & business continuity planning
* Financial acumen (budget forecasting, cost optimization)
* Stakeholder engagement & executive communication
* Critical thinking & decision-making
* Documentation & policy development

description:

**Job Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Collaboration Platform & Service Reliability Engineer to join our globally distributed Enterprise IT team, supporting the stability, security, performance, and continuous improvement of Arm's collaboration platforms and business-critical applications.
  
  
The role combines specialist SharePoint Online and Microsoft Power Platform expertise with Service Reliability Centre (SRC) engineering, improving AIOps, observability, and automation to enhance application availability and operational resilience.
  
  
Working closely with application, infrastructure, and engineering teams, you will contribute to the evolution towards a proactive Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) operating model, focusing on incident prevention, intelligent monitoring, automation, and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The position is based in our Bengaluru office, working on a rotational shift pattern within a 24x7x365 operating model to support business-critical services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide specialist Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for SharePoint Online, Microsoft Power Platform, and associated collaboration services, ensuring service stability and timely issue resolution.
* Administer, secure, and optimize SharePoint Online environments, including site administration, access management, governance, and platform configuration.
* Support Microsoft Power Platform services, including Power Apps and Power Automate, covering administration, environment management, governance, and fix.
* Monitor, investigate, and resolve incidents affecting business-critical enterprise applications using Dynatrace and other AIOps and observability platforms.
* Collaborate with application owners, engineering teams, and third-party suppliers to expand monitoring coverage, establish alert thresholds, and onboard applications into SRC support.
* Drive proactive monitoring, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to improve application performance, availability, and service reliability.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts, operational runbooks, and monitoring processes to reduce manual intervention, enhance AIOps capabilities, and improve operational efficiency.
* Contribute to the adoption of SRE practices, including service health monitoring, reliability metrics, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in enterprise platform administration, application operations, or service reliability engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Dynatrace, including application monitoring, dashboard configuration, alert management, diagnostics, and performance analysis.
* Strong hands-on experience in SharePoint Online administration and fix, including site management, permissions, security, governance, and platform configuration.

* Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management processes and experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.

* Experience supporting enterprise business applications and SaaS platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Slack, or Zoom, including their onboarding into monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience with Python, JavaScript, Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, or other relevant scripting and integration technologies.

description:

**Job Description**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Reporting to the Deputy General Counsel, the
**Corporate Counsel – India**
will serve as a trusted, hands-on legal partner to Availity’s business and global Legal team. The role will independently manage a broad range of commercial, technology, corporate, and compliance matters; identify practical solutions to complex issues; and take ownership of matters from initial assessment through resolution. The successful candidate will exercise sound judgment, work effectively across time zones and functions, and be a key contributor to the Legal team while supporting Availity’s healthcare technology and revenue cycle management businesses.
  
  
**Candidates must be authorized to work in India without current or future employer sponsorship.**
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India or Remote
  
  
**Why You Want To Work On This Team**

* Work on a team that is collaborative and will offer continuous learning opportunities
* Enjoy solving complex issues from a legal perspective
* Be part of a fast-growing technology organization that is dedicated to innovation and transformation

**To Be Qualified For This Position You**

* At least 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in a law firm and/or an in-house legal department, with substantial responsibility for corporate, commercial, or technology transactions.
* Healthcare and/or information technology industry experience is strongly preferred. Healthcare clearinghouse or Revenue Cycle Management experience is a plus.
* LL.B. from a recognized Indian university and current enrollment with a State Bar Council in India; an LL.M. or other relevant advanced qualification is a plus.
* Working of commercial contracting and software licensing and offerings and security, and applicable Indian laws; familiarity with U.S. healthcare laws, emonstrated ability to draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial and technology agreements, including SaaS, software license, professional services, vendor, confidentiality, and data protection agreements.
* Ability to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, appropriately prioritize competing demands, and escalate material issues with clear analysis and recommended solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to move matters forward efficiently and deliver practical, business-oriented advice.
* Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and ownership, including the ability to anticipate legal and business needs, develop workable approaches, and contribute meaningfully to team priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain legal risk clearly to stakeholders in India and the United States.
* Sound, practical judgment and the confidence to make decisions within delegated authority while recognizing when consultation or escalation is appropriate.

**You Will Set Yourself Apart With**

* Healthcare Technology Experience
* Well versed in Clearinghouse and/or Revenue Cycle Management

**You Will Be**

* Independently drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a broad range of commercial and technology agreements, including SaaS, software licensing, professional services, vendor, confidentiality, and data protection agreements.
* Ensuring compliance with federal and state healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, HITECH, and other relevant privacy and security laws.
* Managing compliance with payer requirements and regulations affecting revenue cycle management.
* Proactively identifying legal and business risks, developing practical and proportionate solutions, and presenting clear recommendations that enable informed decision-making.
* Developing and implementing policies and procedures to manage and minimize legal risks.
* Managing and resolving legal disputes, including contract disputes, regulatory inquiries, and litigation related to healthcare technology and revenue cycle management.
* Serving as a responsive, trusted legal partner to internal stakeholders by translating legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance and taking ownership of follow-through.
* Collaborating effectively with Legal colleagues and business partners in India and the United States, including across time zones, while operating as an engaged and dependable member of the global team.
* Leading assigned matters from intake through completion, maintaining appropriate visibility for relevant stakeholders, and contributing to Legal team processes, knowledge resources, and strategic initiatives.

**Availity Culture And Benefits**

* Availity is a certified “Great Place to Work”! Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!
* We have several Diversity & Inclusion teams, a Young Professionals Group, a She Can Code IT group for women in tech, and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates.
* Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack and in our industry that can help get you there too!
* Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.
* We offer competitive compensation and benefits for India-based associates, including performance-based incentive opportunities and applicable health and retirement benefits.
* India-based associates receive paid time off and company holidays in accordance with applicable policy and local requirements.
* We support associate wellness through programs and resources available under our India benefits offering.
* Interested in furthering your education? We offer education reimbursement!
* Availity provides parental leave and other leave benefits in accordance with applicable policy and local requirements.
* Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with various organizations, both locally and nationally, to raise awareness, funds and morale as our staff members volunteer their time and funds to engage the organizations campaign.

**Next Steps**
After you apply, you will receive text/email messages thanking you for applying and then you will continue to receive more text/email messages alerting you as to where you are in the recruitment process.
  
  
**Interview Process**

* Video Interview with Hiring Manager
* Video Panel Interview with Legal Peers
* Video Interview with a SME from the Provider Sales Team
* Video Interview with Director, Legal Contracts
* Video Interview with HR Business Partner
* Final Video Interview with Chief Legal Officer

**Eligibility**

As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

This position will focus on assisting with responses to public tenders, RFPs, public and private solicitations, routine drafting of high-volume agreements as well as supporting the contracts lifecycle management process, and administration of other commercial contract matters. * Data entry and analytics to provide visibility on overall commercial activity at Arista.

* **Hands-on experience navigating GeM (Government of India e-Marketplace) and other electronic tendering portals and/or experience with Indian government tendering processes and bid related documentation.**
* Hands-on experience with drafting, negotiating and managing basic commercial contracts.
* Proficiency with legal and business technologies, such as DocuSign, Microsoft Office, G-Suite, Zoom, Salesforce.com, Egnyte, and Adobe.
* Demonstrates, commitment, positive, integrity and transparency.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A team player who is comfortable working closely with all Arista organizations and departments at any level upto executive management.
* Demonstrated experience as a motivated contributor who shows initiative and is willing to provide independent judgment and strategic thinking.
* Quick learner, with excellent time management and prioritization skills, who is familiar with setting appropriate expectations in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with enterprise software specifically, Salesforce, G-Suite, Microsoft Office, and Adobe.
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment and open to a flexible time schedule.

**Additional Information**

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: BI Manager, KYBP, Business Partner Integrity, and Strategic Transactions
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only authorities in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the operation and continuous improvement of Business Integrity’s Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) / Business Partner Integrity programme, helping ensure that integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored through a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach aligned to the Spirit of Integrity Framework.
  
  
The role will drive transformation and process improvement across the end-to-end KYBP lifecycle, working across Business Integrity and with Procurement, Commercial, D&T and other enterprise partners to simplify and strengthen processes, improve user experience, and make effective use of data, technology and automation. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, the role will also help find opportunities to align approaches, capabilities and ways of working across the function where relevant.
  
  
More broadly, the role will provide flexible project, analytical and operational capability across the Compliance Operations portfolio, supporting wider priorities and continuous improvement as the BI programme evolves.
  
  

* Lead the KYBP / Business Partner Integrity programme: Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the KYBP element of the Spirit of Integrity Framework, ensuring a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, approving and monitoring integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners.
* Drive KYBP transformation and end-to-end process excellence: Lead transformation and improvement across the end-to-end KYBP / KYC / TPRM lifecycle, working across Procurement, Commercial, OpCoP, the TPRM Control Tower, Legal, Finance, D&T and markets to simplify processes, strengthen handoffs and accountabilities, improve user experience and embed scalable and sustainable ways of working. Work with Legal Operations and other partners where there are opportunities to demonstrate common approaches to process improvement, service delivery or transformation.
* Maintain KYBP standards, methodology and risk-based decision-making: Develop and maintain the standards, procedures, playbooks and methodology supporting KYBP, including risk segmentation, due diligence requirements, screening, red flags, issue, mitigation and ongoing monitoring. Work with relevant risk-domain SMEs to ensure appropriate coverage of bribery and corruption, sanctions, money laundering, failure to prevent fraud, facilitation of tax evasion and other relevant integrity risks.
* Strengthen data, technology, monitoring and programme effectiveness: Use data, insight and monitoring to understand the effectiveness of the KYBP programme and find opportunities for continuous improvement. Define business requirements and work with D&T, Compliance Operations and other partners to improve systems, workflows, automation and AI-enabled capabilities supporting business partner integrity. Support complex or non-standard business relationships and strategic transactions, including relevant joint venture and M&A due diligence, risk assessment, mitigation and integration requirements.
* Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible analytical, project and operational support across the wider Compliance Operations agenda, responding to evolving priorities and opportunities to strengthen the BI programme. This may include projects and initiatives across Speak Up and breach management, BI controls, policy governance, training and engagement, risk assessment and monitoring, data and analytics, regulatory developments, external benchmarking and other elements of the Spirit of Integrity Framework. Provide appropriate resilience and cover for key Compliance Operations activities as required. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, give to cross-functional initiatives where relevant to the role's expertise and capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Business Partner Risk and Compliance Judgement: Strong understanding of third-party and business partner integrity risk, with the ability to apply risk-based and proportionate judgement across due diligence, screening, mitigation, issue and ongoing monitoring.
* Process Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement: Understands how processes, systems, data and controls connect, and identifies practical opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and continuously improve end-to-end ways of working.
* Problem Solving, Delivery and Partner Management: Brings structure to complex, cross-functional problems, handles projects and priorities effectively, and works collaboratively across stakeholders to translate requirements and ideas into practical, sustainable outcomes

**Experience / Skills Required**

* Relevant experience in ethics and compliance, third-party risk management, KYC/KYBP, consulting, transformation or a related field.
* Experience in third-party or business partner compliance risk, including areas such as due diligence, bribery and corruption, sanctions, AML, fraud or other relevant integrity risks.
* Strong transformation, process improvement and project management capability, with experience delivering change across complex, cross-functional processes.
* Strong analytical and digital capability, with experience using data, technology, automation or workflow tools to improve processes and programme effectiveness; consulting or professional services experience would be helpful.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  

* Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
* We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, give and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to improve, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to give an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you gain this information when you submit your application.*

* Must have a pragmatic and cost-effective approach to risk and compliance management while ensuring high bank requirements are fully met

Problem Solving, including the ability to use strong logic and linkage of related data points to solve problems and create effective new solutions
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree, ideally in relevant Business or Legal fields
* Commercial real estate / facilities management experience
* Audit, Internal Audit, and/or Quality Management qualification or experience preferred
* Six Sigma trained, and/or Process Management experience desirable but not required
* Second language a plus

Location in Bangalore preferred.

description: About Booking Holdings India COEAt Booking Holdings, we're more than just a leader in travel, we're shaping how people connect, explore, and experience the world. At Booking Holdings India COE, we combine data, technology, and creativity to build solutions that simplify global travel, enhance financial services, and create seamless customer experiences.Join us to innovate fearlessly, build connected experiences, and help shape the future of global travel and hospitality. Are you ready to be part of a journey that makes the world more accessible for everyone?About the team: The Data & AI Governance department enables extending the governance theme of policies, standards, processes and technology for governing data and AI to driving excellence in our approach to leveraging secure, trusted, accessible data for data driven decision making through:An overarching Data & AI Policy to include associated standardsData & AI Governance including meta and master data managementData & AI Delivery GovernanceData & AI Quality including both technical and business quality measuresThis enables the maturity of Data and AI capabilities across Booking.com, unlocking data and algorithms as assets for delivering innovative growth opportunities and cost saving operational efficiencies.Role Description: The Data & AI Governance Compliance Manager plays a critical role in balancing regulatory safety with high-velocity innovation. Sitting within the Data & AI Governance Department, you will be part of the team that translates complex regulations (DMA, EU AI Act, GDPR, etc.) into everyday agile practices. You will oversee the full lifecycle of governance, from maintaining the Data Catalogue and AI Registry, to conducting quality control reviews thus ensuring our ‘agile’ environment remains a ‘compliant’ environment.
