Ensure deficiencies identified by the team are strategically logged, tracked, and remediated, collaborating with second-line risk teams for appropriate executive reporting.Assist with Audits: Assist with the preparation and response strategy for critical internal and external audits from a Data & AI Governance perspective. Act as the definitive point of contact for auditors.Role Qualifications and Requirements:10+ years of experience around Governance and Compliance, preferably a few years with Data & AI risk managementExperience with building risk management processes that ensure risks are managed and reported effectively and create appropriate visibility for key stakeholders across the organizationExperience with establishing & operating continuous risk monitoring & reporting processes is a plusAbility to work on multiple competing priorities, delivering the right quality while managing delivery timelinesExceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions and instruct others, train personnel, write reports, correspondence and procedures, and speak clearly with stakeholders.Ability to deal with complex risk management problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations, requiring non-standard solutions.Ability to work independently with a wide variety and hierarchy of stakeholders.Ability to lead and develop a team of analysts and specialistsBookingHoldings India COE is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Regulatory Reporting Specialist
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
Working as part of the global Regulatory Governance and Reporting team, the role will manage Financial Regulatory Reporting obligations for PayPal Licensed entities
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate internally to influence the quality and efficiency of entity management processes and programs.
* Determine appropriate actions outside of defined processes while considering alternative solutions.
* Oversee team performance and prioritize work to ensure effective project execution.
* Provide insights on best practices in corporate governance and legal compliance.
* Assist in maintaining accurate records and documentation for all legal entities and subsidiaries.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
Job Description:
  
  

* Prepare accurate and timely regulatory reporting for PayPal licensed entities in compliance with financial regulation including financial, prudential, statistical and credit reports.
* Prepare actual and forecast internal regulatory metrics, primarily related to Safeguarding, Liquidity and Capital of licensed entities.
* Complete reconciliations of output against financial accounts ensuring any differences are remediated
* Collaborate effectively with key stakeholders including Regulatory Reporting Leadership, Finance Controllership, Finance Systems Leads, Data Technology, Treasury, Product, Compliance, Risk and Credit teams.
* Support integration of regulatory reporting changes originating from new regulation and new products.
* Manage the end-to-end data process to complete timely report production utilizing dedicated regulatory reporting applications and automation including AI.
* Ensure data integrity and controls with reconciliations to source systems and against financial accounts. Resolve any exceptions through process improvements and holding data providers accountable for data quality.
* Strive to create efficiencies in processes, in particular focusing on risk reduction through prioritizing automation and maximizing the use of AI technologies.
* Prepare and review detailed standard operating procedures and checklists focusing heavily on prescribed internal controls throughout.
* Prepare and present periodic updates to Finance Leadership.
* Challenge, resolve and communicate any issues to internal stakeholders, whilst adhering to the Enterprise Issue Management Policy
* Work with internal and external auditors ensuring all requests and any issues are addressed timely and accurately.
* Assist the Global Regulatory Reporting and Governance team when required.

**Requirements:**

* 5 years + experience in Financial Institution and regulated business including payments/fintech/banking.
* High level of expertise in sourcing, interrogating and manipulating data in various forms/code from multiple systems/platforms.
* Technical knowledge dealing with multiple data systems and regulatory reporting applications, including experience with SAP and Regnology RRH or equivalent
* Keen analytical and problem-solving experience with a strong focus on quality assurance of output.
* Experience in and ability to interpret EBA banking, payments and credit regulations relevant to UK, EU and globally is mandatory.
* Knowledge of local and international accounting standards.
* Strong interpersonal skills with excellent written and oral communication, with fluency in English mandatory.
* Attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast paced and dynamic environment with a high degree of personal accountability, integrity and trust.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively within cross functional and remote teams.
* Actively contributes to a balanced and positive work environment.
* Ability to share information, transfer knowledge and expertise to team members.
* Strong process improvement skills.
* Support regulatory reporting activities across regions as business needs evolve.
* Ability to escalate issues and seek guidance as required.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.
  
  
Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.
  
  
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
Looking for compliance professional who understand and can provide end-to-end support to investment company (Mutual Fund) clients & their Compliance teams by sharing, primarily, meaningful insights about the funds ability to comply with (i) SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) requirements and (ii) investment guidelines stated in the Prospectus/Statement of Additional Information (SAI).
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Onboarding of new clients for investment compliance by understanding the client requirements, interpreting the prospectus / investment mandate and extracting compliance restrictions to create a compliance rule matrix.
* Liaise with clients to obtain additional information that may be necessary from time to time to code compliance matrix into the compliance system.
* Perform annual review of compliance rules in the matrix by comparing them against updated prospectuses/SAIs.
* Research ad-hoc queries from compliance reporting team to determine if client portfolio is in line with the investment guidelines

description:

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll be the face and voice of Kyndryl, helping customers solve their problems every day. Being great in this job is less about your resume and more about your personality. A Customer Service Representative combines the know-how of tech support with problem solving and customer service, so bring your people skills and we’ll teach you the rest. It’s a fun and fast-paced role where you’ll start learning and contributing right away.

* Collaborate with back-office and senior team members to manage escalations, build technical expertise, and learn best practices from experienced professionals.
* Expand skills by working across diverse technologies, customer issues, and cross-functional teams, with access to mentorship and continuous professional development.
Develop expertise in Microsoft 365 and other enterprise platforms while pursuing industry-recognized certifications such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and related technologies in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
  
This is a true “start here, go anywhere” opportunity. As you get a close-up look at a wide variety of Kyndryl job roles, you can choose your career path. Many have moved up to the 2nd or 3rd level escalation team. Others go on to further education/certifications and more senior or technical roles.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong **help desk and technical support experience** , providing timely resolution to hardware, software, and system-related issues.
* Proven **troubleshooting and problem-solving skills** with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently.

* Proven **help desk and technical support experience** , delivering timely and effective user assistance.
* Demonstrated **customer service expertise** , ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and support quality.
* Ability to **adapt communication and support approaches** to meet diverse customer needs and expectations.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. title: Associate Manager - WMS DevOps Service
description:
**Overview**
The purpose of this role is to support our growing global AWMS capability. We are seeking a DevOps analyst with strong warehouse process and IT knowledge to drive change adoption, transition to sustain (T2S) and build enterprise capability across the user base to reduce incidents and problems, driving day to day service delivery.
  
  
The successful candidate will help deliver and sustain the Affordable WMS (AWMS) roadmap, supporting the deployments envisaged across multiple markets, and will be part of the end-to-end IT centre of excellence for all markets who use the LEA Reply AWMS template.
  
  
This role requires a mix of business and technical acumen, stakeholder engagement, and a process optimisation mindset. The expectation is you will be hands-on, driving the delivery of key outcomes and continuous improvement in the service.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Service Manager in triaging, assigning, resolving (and acting as escalation point for critical) incidents, both during office hours and occasionally out of hours, coordinating with the vendor and with key IT capability teams to assure the end to end service excellence.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Delivery Lead in partnering with local BU/OU key users to take ownership of the solution and build capability within their facility, with a ‘train-the-trainer’ culture to drive adoption and reduce dependence on the vendor as well as on the global Enterprise Solutions team.
  
  
A key element of the role will be in implementation, driving process adoption and supporting key users as they learn business and IT processes. Once live, you will support the ‘business as usual’ (BAU) service management, helping with prioritisation of change requests across OUs & new demand, and documenting best practices as Knowledge Base articles in ServiceNow.
  
  
The core application in scope, LEA Reply, is a business critical 24/7 operational application essential to enable the fulfilment of demanding customer service targets across PepsiCo, part of PepsiCo’s critical Make Move Sell (MMS) application portfolio. This criticality applies to the end to end process, including integrated systems – primarily SAP ECC, but in some cases local automation solutions driving warehouse productivity (eg. ASRS, autonomous VNAs, conveyoring). As such the role entails critical BIL 1 Application SME accountability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Incident resolution for WMS and integrations, including interfaces with ERP (e.g., SAP), automation systems, and warehouse IT hardware ie. handheld terminals (HHTs) & printers.
* Core IT functional ownership of LEA Reply Europe (and potentially LATAM, subject to global op model evolution) assignment group to ensure ServiceNow incidents and problems are resolved to meet service levels.
* Devises, owns and manages transition to sustain (T2S) approach and service plan and service management for BAU (“business as usual”) to assure PepsiCo standard service continuity for markets once live.
* Supporting the AWMS sites and markets in non-vendor defects and issues, especially business process errors, user application errors, or broader competency-based issues.
* Maintains ServiceNow knowledge base of key articles to ensure supporting materials meet the needs of the user base.
* Incident resolution for other platforms and applications in the scope of our team, including but not limited to Global Network Design (Lyric)

**Qualifications**

* Candidate should have 6-7 Years of experience
* Fluent English.
* Warehouse process knowledge.
* ITIL – industry standard IT service management knowledge & experience.
* SAP ECC process knowledge.
* Demonstrable capability of building trust across different cultures, ability to manage challenging stakeholders at all levels. Strong communication, interpersonal and mentoring skills. Proven ability to influence and collaborate cross-functionally and with vendors.
* Autonomous self-starter – not afraid to get stuck into the detail (technical or functional) to get things moving and drive delivery or problem-solving when required. Flexibility to adapt to the demands of the moment – self-reliance & ability to adapt to a changing environment, to achieve the desired outcome.
* Ideal: LEA Reply WMS experience, SAP ECC user experience, warehouse automation integration experience, and broad knowledge of PepsiCo’s Supply Planning processes & systems.
* Ideal: proficiency in Jira / Confluence / ServiceNow / ADO, with service management experience, reporting to leadership level.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

Job Summary :

Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day-to-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.

Role Definition :

Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.

Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** - Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting -** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** - Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** - For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** - They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.

Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** - Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem-Solving** - They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** - Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** - Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.

Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** - Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** - They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** - Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** - When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** - A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.

Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

  
**Qualifications**

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)

* 0-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
  + Ms. Excel (Intermediate)
  + Ms. PowerPoint (Basic)
* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding & Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Technical Support Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Technical Support Engineering
  
Work Dynamics
  
What this job involves
  
Bringing enhanced comfort and efficiency to the office
  
How can you help make employees and visitors alike love our office? You’ll do so by arranging for regular preventative maintenance and repairs for our facilities. Scheduling for regular cleaning services and ensuring all office equipment are in good working order are a few of the tasks you’ll do to spruce up the office.
  
You’ll keep an eye out for potential emergencies and carry out steps for managing such situations. You’ll also perform established escalation and incident reporting procedures should such an event take place. Being on the lookout for opportunities to reduce costs and improve our operational standards should also come instinctively to you.
  
Blending security and hospitality
  
How important is security to you? Security is a tall order and calls for an all-hands-on-deck approach. As such, we are always on the lookout for people for whom attention to security details comes naturally. In this role, you’ll help give an extra layer of protection by doing regular checks of our CCTV systems to review the need for maintenance and repairs. You’ll oversee visitor access—clients, contractors, vendors—and maintain logs and filing work of such information on a regular basis. You’ll not only be the “gatekeeper,” but also the “face of JLL,” acting as a back-up receptionist as needed.
  
As you perform a juggling act between helping safeguard our premises and giving a warm reception to our guests, you’ll be working closely with our security guards, receptionists and tea attendants, overseeing them and ensuring they carry out all work to a high standard.
  
Keeping stakeholders engaged
  
Every business aims for client satisfaction—but we take it up a notch! If you can take in the same passion for looking after our relationship with all our stakeholders—management, clients, vendors, landlords—we’ll be more than happy to work with you. Because in this role, you’ll be a vital element in keeping our communication lines with them open and strong. One way to do so is to ensure everyone follows the established key operating procedures to achieve standards. Another way is to schedule regular meetings to understand stakeholder’s needs.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  
Smart
  
Do you have more than two years’ experience in facilities management? Are you driven by service excellence? Are you knowledgeable in budgeting and facilities security? We’d love to speak with you!
  
Articulate
  
Excellent communication skills are vital—both spoken and written—as we’ll expect you to work independently in cascading high-level communications and boosting staff/client satisfaction. And if you know both the English and Chinese languages, that would be super! If you think you possess all these, then let’s work together and explore opportunities.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

Job Summary :

Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day-to-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.

Role Definition :

Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.

Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction**
  - Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally
* **Client Access Setup –**
  Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting -**
  They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible
* **Issue Resolution**
  - Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption
* **Escalation**
  - For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level
* **Documentation**
  - They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team

Skills :

**Broad Knowledge**
- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem-Solving**
- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication**
- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability**
- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.

Tasks :

**Responding to Cases**
- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics**
- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions**
- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues**
- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario**
- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

1. Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs
2. Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity
3. Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly
4. Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation

Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

**Qualifications**

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)

* 0-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
  + Ms. Excel (Intermediate)
  + Ms. PowerPoint (Basic)
* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding & Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Associate Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Associate Implementation Engineer works directly with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning both the product configuration and the underlying data migration that make each implementation successful. This role confirms requirements, configures and tests the platform, migrates and validates customer data, and trains users, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and strong data and database expertise, the Associate Implementation Engineer understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including database schema management, ETL configuration, and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach, and partners across teams to ensure a smooth, high-quality implementation that maximizes the value customers realize from OpenGov.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and test OpenGov cloud software to meet the documented implementation requirements of governments across the United States
* Own customer data migration end to end, including database schema management, ETL tool configuration, and scripting as required, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated customer data
* Confirm customer requirements across both configuration and data, and provide guidance, assistance, and support throughout the platform configuration and integration process
* Ensure receipt of appropriate data from customers, map it to OpenGov requirements, and upload, transform, and manipulate it to generate the desired application behaviors
* Build and execute test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Interact directly with government Finance staff, Budget Directors, IT personnel etc, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate existing processes that improve customer workflows
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues throughout the implementation and drive them to timely resolution
* Work closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to facilitate a consistent customer experience and ensure successful projects for customers

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 0 to 1 year of SQL scripting experience
* 0 to 1 year of Python, or similar, scripting experience
* Strong Microsoft Excel and Word skills, including using functions/formulas to format data such as v-lookup, pivot tables, error-checking, and developing properly formatted reports
* Experience with database technologies and with ETL or data-migration concepts and tools will be an advantage
* Excellent interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication skills, teamwork, and customer service mentality
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to customer needs
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to validate and reconcile data for accuracy

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

title: System Engineer - Telecom Services
description:

**We are looking for System Engineer - Telecom Services**
The System Engineer - Telecom Services is responsible for supporting local and global service bids, maintenance contracts, and project execution activities related to railway Telecom systems
  
  
The position demands strong system level technical expertise in various modern metro Telecom technologies and a thorough understanding of Railway technical requirements / system requirement specifications.
  
  
The role involves maintenance engineering, system analysis, bid preparation, lifecycle support, cost estimation, documentation, and coordination with cross-functional teams to deliver competitive and compliant Telecom service solutions.
  
  
The engineer will contribute to preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance strategies while ensuring adherence to customer requirements, railway standards, safety regulations, and company processes.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Conduct technical discussions with all stakeholders.
* Act as a problem solver while ensuring compliance with applicable railway standards and project requirements.
* Act as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Telecom service system engineering, ensuring clear communication and alignment with stakeholders.

**Bid & Tender Support**

* Analyze customer requirements, technical specifications, and tender documents.
* Support preparation of technical service proposals for Telecom maintenance and service contracts.
* Develop maintenance concepts, staffing models, maintenance plans, and service strategies.
* Estimate service workload, spare parts requirements, tools, and asset lifecycle costs.
* Support cost calculations, risk assessments, and bid reviews.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, finance, operations, and commercial teams during bid preparation.
* Support technical clarifications and customer queries during tender phases.

**Project Support**

* Support execution of Telecom service and maintenance projects.

* Prepare maintenance documentation, procedures, and work instructions.
* Monitor project deliverables, milestones, and technical compliance.
* Support system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and obsolescence management activities.

* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance plans.
* Analyze failures, incidents, and system performance data.
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Define spare parts strategies and lifecycle support plans.
* Contribute to RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety) calculations / demonstrations
* Support maintenance optimization and asset management initiatives.

**Technical Documentation**

* Prepare technical reports, maintenance plans, maintenance manuals, method statements, and service documentation.
* Maintain configuration and technical records.
* Ensure documentation compliance with customer and organizational standards.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in bid meetings, technical review meetings and project discussions.
* Support customer presentations and technical workshops.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with tender requirements, railway Telecom standards and safety requirements.
* Support quality audits and process improvement initiatives.

* Fiber Optic Communication Systems
* Network Management Systems (NMS)
* Redundant Telecom Architectures

* TETRA Communication Systems

* Passenger Information Systems (PIS)
* Public Address Systems (PA)
* Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS)
* Voice Recording Systems

**Security & Surveillance**

* CCTV Systems
* Video Management Systems (VMS)
* Access Control Systems
* Intrusion Detection Systems

* SCADA Communication Interfaces
* Telecom Monitoring Systems

title: Lead - CMDB, Discovery and Service Mapping
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
The Lead, CMDB Operations, Service Mapping & Discovery will serve as a senior
**Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
responsible for the operational health, accuracy, and continual improvement of the ServiceNow CMDB and associated Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
  
  
The role will focus primarily on
**BAU operations and process execution**
, ensuring that critical infrastructure and cloud environments are accurately discovered, mapped, reconciled, and maintained within the CMDB. The individual will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, application, ServiceNow platform, ITSM, and service management teams to improve CMDB data quality and ensure reliable service-to-infrastructure relationships.The emphasis is on operational ownership, technical troubleshooting, governance, data quality, and driving sustainable process improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
CMDB Operations & Data Quality
  
  

* Act as the SME for day-to-day CMDB operations, ensuring configuration data remains accurate, complete, current, and fit for operational use.
* Monitor and improve CMDB health across completeness, correctness, compliance, duplication, stale CIs, and relationship accuracy.
* Drive resolution of CI reconciliation, identification, data-quality, discovery, and integration issues.
* Partner with CI owners and infrastructure/application teams to establish accountability for remediation of data-quality exceptions.
* Support governance around CI lifecycle management, including onboarding, modification, reconciliation, retirement, and decommissioning.

Service Mapping
  
  

* Own and support the operational effectiveness of ServiceNow Service Mapping, ensuring critical business and technology services are appropriately mapped to their underlying infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot mapping failures, incomplete service relationships, incorrect dependencies, credential/access issues, and pattern-related exceptions.
* Partner with application and infrastructure teams to validate service topology and dependency relationships.
* Drive expansion and improvement of service mapping coverage for critical applications and services.

Discovery & Cloud Infrastructure
  
  

* Serve as the operational SME for ServiceNow Discovery, with particular focus on cloud and critical infrastructure.
* Support discovery across environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, virtual infrastructure, Windows/Linux servers, databases, network devices, middleware, and other critical technology components.
* Monitor discovery schedules, MID Server health, credentials, patterns, probes/sensors where applicable, and discovery error queues.
* Lead root cause analysis and remediation of recurring discovery failures and coverage gaps.
* Work with Cloud, Network, Compute, Database, Security, and Platform teams to ensure new infrastructure is incorporated into appropriate discovery and CMDB processes.

BAU Operational Management
  
  

* Establish and monitor operational KPIs for CMDB, Service Mapping, and Discovery.
* Manage operational backlogs, exceptions, recurring defects, failed discovery, stale CIs, orphan records, duplicate CIs, and mapping gaps.
* Perform trend analysis to identify systemic issues rather than relying solely on individual record remediation.
* Support production incidents and problems where inaccurate CMDB, Service Mapping, or Discovery data contributes to impact assessment, troubleshooting, or recovery.
* Ensure operational procedures, knowledge articles, runbooks, and support documentation remain current.

Process Improvement & Automation
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve CMDB accuracy, discovery coverage, service-mapping effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Drive process improvements that reduce manual intervention and prevent recurring data-quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to use automation and AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem to improve exception management, data-quality analysis, operational monitoring, and remediation.
* Define measurable improvement plans and track progress through appropriate operational metrics.
* Partner with ServiceNow engineering/development teams where configuration changes or development are required, while retaining ownership of the operational requirement and expected outcome.

Governance & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Act as a trusted SME for CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping across ITSM, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Service Management teams.
* Provide technical guidance on CI classes, relationships, discovery strategy, service modeling, reconciliation, and data ownership.
* Participate in CMDB governance forums and drive resolution of cross-functional data-quality issues.
* Support audit, risk, and control requirements associated with CMDB and configuration management.
* Promote adoption of CMDB as an authoritative operational source for Incident, Problem, Change, Availability, and other ITSM processes.

Key Success Measures
  
  
Success in this role would be demonstrated through measurable improvement in areas such as:
  
  

* CMDB Health Dashboard scores and overall data quality
* Discovery success and coverage rates
* Reduction in stale and duplicate CIs
* Reduction in recurring discovery errors
* Coverage of critical cloud and infrastructure components
* Accuracy and completeness of application/service relationships
* Service Mapping coverage for critical services
* Reduction in manual CMDB remediation
* Timely closure of operational exceptions and data-quality issues
* Improved usability of CMDB data across Incident, Problem, Change and Service Availability processes

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Strong hands-on operational experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
* Strong understanding of Configuration Management and CMDB operating models.
* Experience supporting discovery and CMDB operations for enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Working knowledge of technologies including Azure and/or AWS, Windows, Linux, virtualization, networking, databases, middleware, and enterprise infrastructure platforms.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB concepts including CI Class Manager, identification and reconciliation, relationships, data sources, CMDB Health, Discovery schedules, MID Servers, credentials, and Service Mapping.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex discovery, reconciliation, relationship, and data-quality issues.
* Strong analytical and root-cause-analysis skills, with the ability to identify systemic operational problems.
* Experience working across infrastructure, cloud, application, ServiceNow, and ITSM teams in a large enterprise environment.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Configuration Management and IT Service Management practices.
* Ability to operate independently as an SME and drive issues through to resolution without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications relevant to Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, or ITSM.
* Experience with enterprise-scale hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience with CMDB governance, health dashboards, operational controls, audit requirements, and continual service improvement.
* Exposure to infrastructure automation, APIs, integrations, orchestration, or AI-enabled IT operations would be beneficial.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Deputy Manager_Senior OSS Engineering Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**OSS Platform Operations Specialist**
to join the Group Technology TSSI Networks team in
**Pune**
, supporting the operation and evolution of critical OSS platforms used for UK network operations.
  
  
The role focuses on maintaining high service availability, resolving incidents within agreed service levels, proactively monitoring platform health and supporting the transition towards automated and zero-touch network operations.
  
  
You will work across
**NMS/EMS platforms, Linux/Unix environments, containers, databases, monitoring tools, cloud technologies and network protocols**
, while collaborating with network, infrastructure and vendor teams. The role operates in a multi-domain, multi-vendor environment and requires flexibility to work in
**24x7 rotating shifts**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Maintain high availability and operational stability of in-scope OSS applications in line with agreed service levels
* Take end-to-end accountability for investigating and resolving application incidents, faults, alerts and service requests
* Troubleshoot application behaviour and coordinate with technology vendors for production debugging and incident resolution
* Support planned and unplanned application, infrastructure and cloud changes, ensuring clear communication and appropriate business justification
* Collaborate with network teams to troubleshoot and improve integrations between NMS/EMS applications, alarming systems and ticketing platforms
* Support platform capacity planning, major application upgrades, bug fixes, licence management and introduction of new functionality
* Perform application health checks, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), application check-outs and production deployments
* Improve incident, problem and change management processes and maintain operating procedures and resolution documentation
* Manage user access requirements and support the development, deployment and maintenance of operational KPIs, dashboards, monitoring and alerting
* Identify opportunities for automation and proactive monitoring that improve platform reliability and support the journey towards zero-touch operations
* Collaborate effectively across multiple technical teams and share knowledge for supported OSS platforms

**Who You Are**
Who you are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in the telecom OSS domain, with proven experience working in IT and telecommunications environments
* You have operational experience with at least one NMS/EMS platform, such as Nokia MantaRay, Nokia NetAct or Nokia NSP
* You have hands-on knowledge of Unix/Linux, Docker or container technologies and MySQL, along with exposure to Python, Shell scripting, APIs or automation
* You have an understanding of cloud technologies such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or Wind River, alongside OSS monitoring technologies such as Netcool or Nagios
* You understand networking concepts and protocols including SNMP and ICMP, together with ITIL-based system support, incident, problem, change and service management practices
* You communicate effectively in spoken and written English and are comfortable collaborating across technical teams and vendors
* You are open to learning new technologies, handling multiple technical assignments and working in a 24x7 rotating-shift environment

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work with business-critical OSS, NMS and EMS platforms supporting large-scale telecom network operations
* Exposure to a multi-domain and multi-vendor technology environment, bringing together network, application, infrastructure and cloud capabilities
* Opportunities to contribute to automation, proactive monitoring and zero-touch operations initiatives
* Scope to develop expertise through new assignments, knowledge sharing, training and skill enhancement
* A work environment that encourages collaboration with managers on priorities, development opportunities and career growth
* Support for work-life balance through active prioritisation and management of project timelines

**What Skills You Will Learn**
This role provides opportunities to deepen and broaden expertise in:
  
  

* Advanced operation and troubleshooting of OSS and NMS/EMS platforms
* Linux/Unix, containers, MySQL, Python, Shell scripting and API-based automation
* Cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and Wind River
* Proactive service monitoring using technologies such as Netcool and Nagios
* Telecom network management protocols including SNMP and ICMP
* Automation and the evolution towards zero-touch network operations
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and service management

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

title: Analyst, Customer & Product Support
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Customer & Product Support (C&PS) team sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and technical support. Through close teamwork and collaboration, we drive positive customer outcomes and ensure seamless access and optimal utilization of AlphaSense’s market-leading platform and products. We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer & Product Support team is based globally across the US, UK, India and Singapore.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking to hire an
**Analyst, Customer & Product Support**
to join the growing C&PS team at AlphaSense. This role marries the technical knowledge of our solution with a deep understanding of our users, across all of the segments and business units that we work with, to realize maximum value from the platform. The team is heavily relied upon to contribute excellent customer service, which ultimately maximizes prospect and customer health. In order to learn our business and customer inside and out, this team acts as our first line of support. This role spearheads usage and engagement and partners with our product management and engineering teams in determining future product developments that will resonate with the market.
  
  
Customer and Product Support is an excellent launching off point to accelerate your personal growth and career at AlphaSense. The role offers cross-functional exposure across our business, consequently providing you with great exposure to the different areas you may want to develop your career in, as you grow with us.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* An intelligent, articulate, consultative and confident client-facing professional with 1-2 years of experience working in a client/product support role.
* You possess a customer-first mindset and enjoy working through complex problems to find solutions.
* You enjoy being part of an entrepreneurial team and work diligently to help others when needed.
* You are a strong communicator and have an innate ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.
* Possess strong analytical, critical thinking and problem solving abilities.
* A team player who enjoys building strong cross-group working relationships.
* You are curious, proactive and possess a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to learn quickly and adapt. Because of our diverse base of clients, much of the technical knowledge required to succeed will be learned on the job.
* You have strong attention to detail, effective time management skills and the ability to rigorously prioritize under pressure.
* You have an interest in AI, technology and software applications.

What You’ll Do
  
  

* Deliver a world-class customer experience.
* Act as the first line of defense and advocate for all of customers globally to ensure we deliver a consistently positive customer experience through timely responses and effective resolution of queries and issues.
* Guide customers through features and functionalities to maximize their experience and fully resolve their challenges or questions.
* Deliver on predefined team targets including delivering outcomes with high quality and excellence.
* Provide impeccable customer support.
* Investigate, diagnose, troubleshoot and find solutions for queries sent through emails and live chats, leading support calls directly with customers as needed.
* You will escalate tickets to appropriate teams when needed and will retain a position as the customer’s point person through regular updates and confirming resolution.
* Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical global stakeholders.
* Be an expert on our product and continuously build your knowledge.
* Be an expert on the AlphaSense product by proactively learning, staying up-to-date on new features and filling any gaps in your knowledge
* Identify areas to improve content and contribute to creating and updating knowledge base articles, tutorials, and other support documentation based on their expertise.
* Assist with special projects as assigned.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
  
  
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
  
  
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
  
  
We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
  
  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Associate - IAM Engineering (PAM) - Global Information Security
description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Security Technology**
Jefferies’ IT Security Technology / Global Information Security (GIS) team protects the firm’s critical systems, sensitive information, and global operations against evolving cyber threats. GIS partners with Technology, Operations, Corporate functions, and the Business to embed security into day-to-day operations while supporting productivity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience. GIS balances strong controls with efficiency and operates globally across the US, EMEA, and APAC to provide round-the-clock coverage.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Jefferies India is seeking a skilled and motivated Privileged Access Management Engineer to join our cybersecurity team in Pune. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of hands-on experience supporting and managing Privileged Access Management platforms, including CyberArk Password Vault, CyberArk EPM, BeyondTrust SRA/RA, and HashiCorp Vault.
  
  
This role will be responsible for supporting PAM infrastructure, ensuring platform stability, managing upgrades and integrations, and helping enhance privileged access and secrets management capabilities across the firm’s global technology environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, support, and maintain PAM infrastructure across CyberArk Password Vault, CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager, BeyondTrust SRA/RA, and HashiCorp Vault.
* Perform platform maintenance, health checks, monitoring, backup and recovery activities, capacity planning, and operational stability checks.
* Plan and execute platform upgrades, patches, enhancements, migrations, and configuration changes.
* Support proof of concepts, tool evaluations, new integrations, and capability enhancements for PAM and secrets management platforms.
* Integrate PAM and Vault solutions with enterprise applications, EKS/Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate account onboarding, password rotation, access workflows, reporting, and operational tasks using scripts and APIs.
* Support privileged account management, session monitoring, least privilege controls, break-glass access, and audit requirements.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and application teams to improve PAM maturity and operational effectiveness.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, coordinate with vendors when required, and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles related to PAM operations.
* Ensure PAM processes align with internal security standards, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management, privileged access management, or related technology roles.
* Hands-on experience with CyberArk Password Vault and CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager.
* Experience with BeyondTrust SRA/RA.
* Experience with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management.
* Knowledge of PAM infrastructure management, including upgrades, patching, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of privileged access, secrets management, credential rotation, least privilege principles, and access governance.
* Experience with EKS, Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD tools.
* Development or scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar languages.
* Experience working with APIs for automation and platform integration.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with global teams across security, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and application functions.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Experience in a financial services or large enterprise technology environment.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Understanding of IAM concepts, access controls, RBAC, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices such as Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Helm, or ArgoCD.
* Relevant certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault, cloud security, Kubernetes, or cybersecurity are desirable.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Service Desk Analyst (L1)
description:
**Role: Service Desk Analyst (L1)**

**Experience: 2–5 years in an IT service desk or end-user support role**

**Location: Chennai or Coimbatore, India**

**Responsibilities:**

* Answer phone, chat, email, Virtual Agent and portal contacts, and log, categorize and prioritize each one in ServiceNow.

* Resolve L1 incidents on first contact, such as Okta sign-in and MFA, password resets, Outlook, Teams, GlobalProtect VPN and laptop problems.

* Fulfil catalog and access requests within target times: 1 business day for access after approval, 2 business days by default for catalog items.

* Own each ticket from creation to closure, including tickets escalated to client L2/L3 groups or vendors.

* Escalate with complete notes and the correct assignment group (first-time-right target of 90% or higher).

* Spot possible major incidents and raise them straight away to the Shift Manager or Incident/Change Manager on duty.

* Write and update knowledge articles following KCS practice.

* Pod focus — Frontline: calls, chat and incidents. Access & Identity: account lifecycle (JML), SSO, licences, app access. Endpoint & Asset: laptop assignment and retrieval, wipes, asset records.

**Key relationships:**

* Shift Manager (manager).

* Incident/Change Manager on duty for possible major incidents.

* Client users, including VIPs, and client resolver groups.

* Desktop Engineering for device escalations.

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years in an IT service desk or end-user support role; 24x7 or multi-site desk experience preferred.

* Hands-on ServiceNow ITSM experience.

* Active Directory and Entra ID, Okta (password resets, MFA, app assignment) and SSO troubleshooting.

* Microsoft 365 support: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint permissions, licences.

* Windows 10/11 and macOS troubleshooting, with basic Intune or Jamf.

* Clear written and spoken English, and willingness to work rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.

**Preferred:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation.

* Microsoft MD-102 or MS-900, or an Okta certification.

* Experience with ServiceNow Virtual Agent or AI-assisted service desk tools.

**Tools and technologies:**

* ServiceNow ITSM and Virtual Agent.

* Okta, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID.

* Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint.

* Intune, Jamf, GlobalProtect VPN, Bomgar remote support.

**Skills and behaviours:**

* Friendly, clear communicator.

* Owns the ticket until it is closed.

* Accurate with high volumes.

* Curious and keen to learn.

**Your first 90 days:**

* 30 days: complete client onboarding (about 2 weeks) and internal certification; learn your pod's top request types.

* 60 days: handle live contacts at target handle times; cross-train in a second pod.

* 90 days: meet first-contact resolution and quality targets; contribute knowledge articles.

**How success is measured:**

* P1/P2 response within 30 minutes; access requests fulfilled within 1 business day.

* First-time-right routing of 90% or higher; reopen rate of 7% or lower.

* Ticket quality audit average of 90% or higher.

* Knowledge articles created or updated each month.

**Working arrangements:**

* India-based, rotational shifts in a follow-the-sun 24x7 model with 30-minute handovers; weekend and holiday cover on rota.

**Requirements for every role:**

* Pass a background check under local law before getting access to client systems.

* Complete client security and privacy training, including FERPA and COPPA, and an annual refresher.

* Work on secured, managed devices with client-provided accounts and MFA.

* Follow client policies on AI use and data governance.

* Get ITIL 4 Foundation within 6 months of joining if you don't already have it.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road
