**ROLE PROFILE – SHIP REPAIR MANAGER**
**SECTION I: BASIC INFORMATION**
**Job Function**
Ship Repair & Refit
  
  
**Role**
Ship Repair Manager
  
  
**Reporting to**
Head – Ship Repair & Refit
  
  
**Workplace Classification**
Office & Shipyard
  
  
**SECTION II: ROLE SUMMARY**
Responsible for planning, coordinating and executing ship repair and refit projects in coordination with various stakeholders, adhering to agreed schedules, allocated budgets, EHS and Quality regulations, and Classification Society requirements. Leads project teams, manages resources, interfaces with customers and drives operational excellence to achieve business objectives.
  
  
**SECTION III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / ACCOUNTABILITIES – PLANNING & EXECUTION**
**SECTION III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / ACCOUNTABILITIES – PLANNING & EXECUTION**

* Plan, organize and oversee ship repair, refit and dry-docking projects from commencement to completion.
* Review defect lists, repair specifications and customer requirements to define project scope and execution strategy.
* Develop project schedules, milestones and resource deployment plans; monitor progress against targets.
* Ensure timely availability of manpower, materials, equipment, subcontractors and support services.
* Coordinate and monitor production departments, subcontractors, OEMs and external agencies to achieve project objectives.
* Conduct periodic progress reviews and implement corrective actions to address delays, bottlenecks and resource constraints.
* Ensure repair activities comply with safety regulations, quality standards, statutory requirements and Classification Society rules.
* Monitor project costs, productivity and resource utilization to achieve budgetary and commercial targets.
* Manage customer interfaces and ensure timely resolution of technical, operational and contractual issues.
* Identify and capture Additional Work Orders (AWO) and ensure proper documentation and commercial closure.
* Ensure successful completion, testing, trials and vessel delivery in accordance with contractual commitments.
* Drive continuous improvement to enhance project performance, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

**Documentation**
**Documentation**

* Project Schedule / Master Repair Plan; Defect List and Scope of Work (SOW); Daily and Weekly Progress Reports.
* Purchase Requisitions and Procurement Tracking Reports; Additional Work Orders (AWO) / Growth of Work (GOW) records.
* Subcontractor Performance and Work Completion Reports; Budget Monitoring and Cost Control Reports; Work Done Certificates (WDC).
* Inspection and Test Reports; QA/QC records; Classification Society survey and approval documents; Permit-to-Work records; HIRA / Risk Assessment documents.
* RSC (Reportable Safety Concerns) and corrective action reports; meeting minutes; sea trial / harbour trial reports; invoice verification and commercial closure documents; lessons learned and continuous improvement records.

**Digitalization / Process Improvements**
**Digitalization / Process Improvements**

* Develop and maintain project dashboards for real-time tracking of progress, manpower, material status and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Promote ERP/SAP systems for resource planning, procurement tracking, cost control and project management.
* Analyse project performance data to improve productivity, quality and schedule adherence.
* Implement digital documentation and workflow systems to improve traceability and reduce approval-cycle time.
* Drive continuous improvement to reduce project cycle time, rework and operational costs; promote best practices and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor and improve business metrics related to project delivery, resource utilization and customer satisfaction.

title: Operations Manager
description:
ed Rhino Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and hospitality brand committed to delivering exceptional food, beverages, and guest experiences. With a focus on quality, innovation, and customer engagement, we aim to create memorable experiences through our taproom operations and hospitality offerings.

Role Overview

The Operations Manager – Taproom will be responsible for overseeing the overall functioning of the taproom, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, excellent guest experiences, revenue growth, cost optimisation, and adherence to operational standards.

The role requires a hands-on hospitality professional with strong leadership capabilities, commercial acumen, and the ability to manage multiple operational functions while maintaining high standards of service, food quality, and beverage delivery.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Taproom Operations**

* Oversee the complete day-to-day operations of the taproom, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning.
* Ensure operational readiness, including opening and closing procedures, service standards, hygiene, and maintenance.
* Monitor food and beverage service quality and ensure consistency in guest experience.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all operational areas.
* Coordinate with the kitchen, bar, service, and support teams for seamless operations.

**2. Revenue & Business Performance**

* Drive revenue growth through effective sales strategies, upselling, cross-selling, and promotional initiatives.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance against business targets.
* Analyse business performance, identify revenue opportunities, and implement corrective measures.
* Work towards improving average order value, table turnover, and overall profitability.
* Execute events, corporate bookings, and customer engagement initiatives to drive footfall.

**3. People & Team Management**

* Lead, manage, and motivate the taproom team, including restaurant, bar, kitchen, and support staff.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment and effective shift scheduling.
* Conduct regular team briefings, performance reviews, and on-the-job training.
* Identify training requirements and develop team capabilities.
* Maintain discipline, accountability, and a performance-driven work culture.

**4. Cost & Inventory Management**

* Monitor food and beverage costs, operational expenses, and overall profitability.
* Ensure effective inventory management, stock reconciliation, and timely procurement.
* Monitor wastage, pilferage, and inventory variances.
* Ensure proper utilisation of resources and adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with procurement and finance teams for cost control and financial reporting.

**5. Guest Experience & Customer Relations**

* Ensure consistently high standards of guest service and customer satisfaction.
* Handle guest feedback, complaints, and service recovery effectively.
* Develop initiatives to improve customer retention, repeat visits, and brand loyalty.
* Monitor online reviews and customer feedback across relevant platforms.
* Maintain the overall ambience, service standards, and brand experience of the taproom.

**6. Compliance, Safety & Maintenance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including FSSAI, excise, fire safety, and other operational licences.
* Maintain hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance of equipment, furniture, fixtures, and other facilities.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, safety protocols, and audit requirements.

**7. Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Track key business metrics, including revenue, food cost, beverage cost, manpower cost, and customer feedback.
* Coordinate with central teams, including HR, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, and Production.
* Provide regular updates to management on operational performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly revenue and profitability targets.
* Food and beverage cost management.
* Manpower cost optimisation.
* Customer satisfaction and online ratings.
* Inventory accuracy and reduction in wastage.
* Operational compliance and audit performance.
* Employee productivity, retention, and team performance.
* Improvement in repeat customer visits and overall business performance.

Educational Qualification & Experience

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in hospitality operations, preferably in restaurants, breweries, pubs, or premium casual dining establishments.
* At least 2–3 years of experience managing an outlet or handling a significant hospitality operation independently.
* Experience in managing large teams, revenue targets, inventory, and operational budgets.

title: Team Lead – Operations, Risk & Compliance
description:
**Location: Mumbai**

**Experience**: 6–8 years  
**Department**: Operations, Risk & Compliance

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a hands-on and experienced Team Lead – Operations, Risk & Compliance to manage day-to-day payment operations while leading the organisation’s operational risk and compliance activities. The role will oversee merchant and partner operations across digital payment channels, including online payment gateway, UPI, QR, POS and other payment solutions, as relevant to the business. The person will be responsible for ensuring smooth transaction operations, timely reconciliation and settlements, effective dispute and refund management, strong operational controls, fraud-risk monitoring, audit readiness and adherence to applicable regulatory and partner requirements. The role requires the ability to lead a team, work closely with banks, payment partners, merchants and internal stakeholders, and drive operational excellence in a fast-paced fintech environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Operations Management

· Lead and manage day-to-day payment operations across online and offline payment products, including PG, UPI, QR, POS and other digital payment channels.

· Oversee merchant onboarding and activation processes, including documentation, KYC coordination, due diligence, MID/VPA setup, QR/POS deployment, testing and go-live readiness.

· Monitor transaction processing, success rates, declines, pending transactions and operational exceptions; coordinate with technology teams, banks and payment partners for timely resolution.

· Manage daily reconciliation, settlement monitoring, refunds, reversals, chargebacks and transaction-related merchant queries.

· Ensure operational SLAs, turnaround times, process accuracy and service quality are consistently achieved.

· Establish maker-checker controls, daily trackers, dashboards, operating checklists and escalation mechanisms.

· Manage operational escalations from merchants, banks, payment aggregators, technology service providers and internal teams.

2. Team Leadership & Performance Management

· Lead, mentor and manage the Operations, Risk & Compliance team, ensuring clear ownership and accountability.

· Allocate work, define priorities, review team performance and ensure adequate coverage for critical operational activities.

· Set measurable KPIs and SLAs for onboarding, activation, reconciliation, settlement, refunds, disputes, risk reviews and compliance deliverables.

· Conduct regular team reviews, provide coaching and identify training needs to improve productivity and quality.

· Build a culture of process discipline, timely escalation, documentation and customer/merchant service.

3. Risk Management & Fraud Monitoring

· Identify, assess and monitor operational, transaction, merchant, fraud, technology and third-party risks across the payment ecosystem.

· Oversee merchant risk reviews, suspicious transaction escalations, transaction-pattern analysis and risk-related documentation.

· Coordinate with banks, acquirers, payment partners and internal teams on suspicious transactions, fund holds, merchant investigations and risk mitigation, in line with agreed contractual arrangements and applicable requirements.

· Ensure risk events are escalated promptly, investigated, documented and followed through to closure with root-cause analysis and preventive actions.

· Maintain risk registers, incident logs, control-gap trackers and mitigation plans.

· Work with Product and Technology teams to strengthen transaction monitoring, fraud controls, alerts, access controls and operational safeguards.

4. Regulatory Compliance & Policy Management

· Monitor and support compliance with applicable RBI, NPCI, card-network, data-protection and other regulatory or industry requirements relevant to the organisation’s business model and authorisations.

· Support implementation and periodic review of policies, SOPs and controls relating to KYC, AML, information security, data privacy, customer grievance redressal, refunds and disputes.

· Track regulatory and partner circulars, assess operational impact and coordinate implementation of required process or system changes.

· Maintain compliance calendars, obligation trackers, evidence repositories and periodic review records.

· Ensure that operational processes are aligned with the organisation’s role in the payment ecosystem and the scope of its applicable licences/authorisations; coordinate with regulated partners where responsibilities are allocated to them.

5. Disputes, Chargebacks & Grievance Management

· Oversee end-to-end handling of card and UPI disputes, chargebacks, retrieval requests, transaction complaints and related representment/documentation processes.

· Coordinate with banks, acquirers, payment aggregators, merchants and relevant internal teams to meet response timelines and reduce avoidable losses.

· Monitor dispute ratios, ageing, reason codes, repeat issues and merchant-level trends; recommend corrective actions.

· Ensure customer and merchant complaints are logged, acknowledged, investigated and resolved within applicable timelines.

· Maintain dispute and grievance MIS, escalation records and supporting evidence.

6. Reconciliation, Settlements & Financial Controls

· Supervise daily transaction reconciliation across internal systems, bank statements, acquirer/partner reports and merchant-level records.

· Monitor settlement cycles, delayed or failed settlements, refunds, reversals, short credits, excess credits and outstanding balances.

· Coordinate with Finance, banks and payment partners to resolve reconciliation breaks and settlement discrepancies within defined timelines.

· Ensure proper documentation and approvals for manual adjustments, refunds, reversals and other sensitive operational activities.

· Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational MIS covering transaction volumes, settlement status, reconciliation breaks, refunds and disputes.

7. Partner, Bank & Vendor Management

· Act as an operational point of contact for banks, payment aggregators, acquirers, issuers, technology service providers, POS/QR partners and other vendors.

· Coordinate partner onboarding, due diligence, operational readiness, integration dependencies, UAT, certification and production go-live activities.

· Review partner SLAs, operational processes, escalation matrices, reports and service performance.

· Conduct periodic vendor and partner risk reviews and track open issues, audit observations and remediation actions.

· Work with Business and Alliances teams on new partner/product launches, operational feasibility and process readiness.

8. Audit, Information Security & Internal Controls

· Coordinate internal, external, partner and regulatory audits by arranging evidence, process walkthroughs, responses and action plans.

· Support implementation and monitoring of relevant information-security controls and standards, including PCI-DSS and ISO-related requirements where applicable.

· Review access controls, data handling, record retention, operational approvals and maker-checker processes.

· Track audit observations and ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed within agreed timelines.

· Conduct periodic process reviews to identify control weaknesses, process gaps and opportunities for improvement.

9. Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

· Create, review and maintain SOPs, process notes, escalation matrices, checklists, operational trackers and business continuity procedures.

· Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and improve operational efficiency, accuracy and turnaround time.

· Partner with Product and Technology teams to define operational requirements, participate in UAT and validate production readiness.

· Drive root-cause analysis for recurring operational issues and ensure sustainable corrective actions.

· Prepare management dashboards and present key operational, risk and compliance updates to senior leadership.

Key Requirements

· **Experience:** 6–8 years of experience in operations, risk management or compliance within fintech, digital payments, banking, payment gateway, acquiring or financial services, with at least 1–2 years of team or workstream leadership experience preferred.

· **Payments Domain Knowledge:** Strong understanding of payment flows and operations across UPI, QR, POS, cards, payment gateways, acquiring, refunds, reversals, reconciliation, settlements and chargebacks.

· **Risk & Compliance Knowledge:** Working knowledge of merchant risk, transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, operational risk, KYC/AML, internal controls, audit processes and applicable RBI/NPCI or network requirements.

· **Partner Management:** Experience working with banks, payment aggregators, acquirers, issuers, technology service providers, vendors and merchants.

· **Operational Excellence:** Ability to manage high-volume operational processes, escalations, SLAs, MIS, root-cause analysis and process improvements.

· **Leadership:** Strong people-management, prioritisation, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

· **Tools & Reporting:** Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Familiarity with payment dashboards, reconciliation tools, ticketing systems and risk-monitoring platforms is an advantage.

· **Education:** Graduate or postgraduate degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Management, Law, Technology or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in a fintech company, payment gateway, merchant acquiring business, UPI ecosystem or banking operations.

· Exposure to PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, information-security reviews or payment-network audits.

· Certifications in AML/KYC, risk management, audit, information security or payments are an advantage but not mandatory.

· Experience in launching new payment products, partner integrations, UAT, certification and operational readiness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

· Merchant onboarding and activation turnaround time, with complete and accurate documentation.

· Transaction operations performance, issue-resolution TAT and adherence to partner/merchant SLAs.

· Reconciliation accuracy and timely closure of settlement breaks and outstanding items.

· Refund, reversal, dispute and chargeback turnaround time and ageing.

· Timely identification, escalation and closure of risk incidents and control gaps.

· Completion of compliance reviews, audit requirements and regulatory/partner action items within timelines.

· Team productivity, process adherence, quality of MIS and continuous improvement outcomes.

Key Stakeholders

Internal: Business Development, Banking Alliances, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Information Security, Customer Support and Senior Management.  
External: Banks, payment aggregators, acquirers, issuers, NPCI/card-network stakeholders where applicable, technology service providers, vendors and merchants.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Tax Litigation
description:

**Practice Area:** Direct Tax Litigation (Income Tax & Transfer Pricing) / Indirect Tax Litigation (GST & Customs)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time (On-site / Hybrid)

Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Tax Litigation professional to manage end-to-end tax dispute resolution, assessments, and appellate proceedings. Operating out of Mumbai, the role involves representing clients or the organization before revenue authorities and appellate tribunals, drafting high-stakes legal submissions, and briefing Senior Counsels for High Court matters.

Key Responsibilities

* **Assessments & Notice Management:** Handle scrutiny assessments, reassessments, audit objections, and show-cause notices (SCNs) under faceless (NFAC) and jurisdictional proceedings.

* **Counsel Briefing:** Prepare comprehensive case briefs, paper books, and chronology charts, and coordinate with Senior Advocates for writ petitions and appeals before the Bombay High Court.
* **Tax Risk & Litigation Strategy:** Analyze judicial precedents, CBDT/CBIC circulars, and statutory amendments to evaluate litigation exposure, provision requirements, and settlement/amnesty options.
* **Stakeholder & Client Coordination:** Manage case trackers, statutory limitation deadlines, and regular status updates with clients, internal finance teams, and tax authorities.

Qualifications & Experience

* **Education:** Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) and/or LL.B. / LL.M. (Semi-qualified CAs with strong articleship exposure in litigation are considered for junior roles).
* **Experience:**
* *Associate / Executive:* 0–3 years PQE (including relevant articleship/internship).
* *Senior Associate / Manager:* 4–8 years PQE with independent appearance experience.
* *Principal / Associate Director:* 9–12+ years PQE leading litigation verticals and client relationships.
* **Technical Skills:** Deep working knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (including International Tax/DTAA and Transfer Pricing) or CGST/IGST Acts and Customs Law, along with proficiency in tax research databases (Taxmann, SCC Online, Manupatra) and e-filing/faceless portals

title: Law Enforcement Response (LER) Specialist
description: DescriptionAMAZON | LEGALLaw Enforcement Response (LER) SpecialistLevel 5 Legal Operations & Compliance Amazon India Role LER Specialist (Paralegal II) Level L5 — Individual contributor with team leadership Team Law Enforcement Response (LER), India Location Delhi NCR, India Work model Full-time Work From Office People management Leads a team of 3 associates Experience 6–10 years of relevant experienceAbout The RoleAmazon is searching for a smart, motivated specialist to join its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team in India. The LER team is a dedicated group of specialists responsible for receiving, reviewing, and responding to law enforcement requests — such as notices, summons, and court orders — received from government agencies and police authorities across different Amazon India entities.As an LER Specialist, your principal duty is to ensure that these requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, while safeguarding the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures. The role sits at the intersection of law[ and demands sound judgment in challenging and ambiguous situations.This is a high-judgment, high-ownership role. You will lead a small team, serve as a trusted point of contact for law enforcement officers, and help Amazon meet its legal obligations in India’s rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently — at times with little supervision.Key Job Responsibilities Triage high request volumes. Receive, log, and process law enforcement information requests arriving through multiple channels, internal portal, the dedicated police-inquiries mailbox, the government portals. Respond lawfully and accurately. Evaluate and respond to each request in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, and in accordance with the law and with Amazon’s policies and procedures. Meet urgent SLAs. Triage and close requests in line with established SLAs and SOPs, recognizing that delayed responses can result in loss of customer trustin customers losing funds; periodically receive and process emergency requests on a set rotation, including outside normal business hours and sometimes overnight. Manage external stakeholders. Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement officers, Amazon employees, and others — including significant phone-based coordination with officers who follow up on submitted requests. Explain what information Amazon can and cannot legally share, and guide officers on legally compliant intake formats (e.g., Section 94 BNSS notice requirements). Lead a team. Manage and develop a team of 3 associates who actively process requests; help lead the training and development of other LER specialists. Coordinate internally. Work with internal Amazon partner teams — some of whom run data queries to retrieve relevant information — and apply familiarity with data-retrieval concepts to challenge or validate the outputs you receive. Use the right tools. Use a combination of web-based applications and data-extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular request. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, compliance playbooks, and process documentation Identify opportunities to improve workflows and partner with engineering/product teams to develop tools and automation for legal compliance processes Spot patterns. Assist in the identification of patterns and trends evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests, and handle the most complex and challenging requests and special projects. Authenticate evidence. Sign and issue certificates / letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests. Represent Amazon. Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices as required.A Day in the LifeYou will start your day reviewing incoming law enforcement requests from government agencies for validity, scope, and compliance requirements. You will exercise independent judgment to determine appropriate responses, balancing legal obligations with customer privacy and data security. Because a large share of information requests you will lean on your team to keep the queue healthy, partner with internal data teams to retrieve and validate information, and escalate the genuinely hard calls. It is fast-paced, operationally intense work where clear judgment and calm, credible communication make all the difference.Basic Qualifications 6–10 years of relevant experience (e.g., law enforcement / regulatory response, legal operations, compliance, trust & safety, or high-volume operations). Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work experience. Excellent English-language communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong judgment. Experience working in fast-paced environments and managing workload even during times of stress or escalated activity. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous situations. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities at once. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues and manage external stakeholders.Preferred Qualifications Experience responding to, or making, requests from law enforcement agencies. Demonstrated experience managing external law enforcement or regulatory communications. Familiarity with high-volume operational tools and data systems; comfort with data-retrieval concepts (SQL proficiency is not required). Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Written and/or verbal proficiency in Hindi and/or any other Indian language. Background in e-commerce, banking and financial services, or technology companies with trust & safety functions (e.g., Meta, Google).Note: An LLB qualification is not required for this role.What Sets a Strong Candidate ApartThe differentiating competency for this role is the ability to build trust with law enforcement officers while professionally pushing back. title: Manager – Excise Compliance (PSS08155)
description:
**About The Company**
A growing organization operating within the alcoholic beverages sector, focused on managing regulatory compliance and excise affairs across multiple states in India. The company emphasizes adherence to statutory requirements and efficient coordination with government bodies to support its portfolio.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
This role exists to oversee PAN-India excise compliance, licensing, product registrations, and regulatory requirements for the alcoholic beverage portfolio. The position is critical for ensuring adherence to state excise laws and facilitating smooth regulatory operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage state-wise excise licenses, registrations, renewals, and statutory compliances.
* Handle brand, label, and SKU/product registrations across states.
* Coordinate with State Excise Departments on approvals, queries, objections, and regulatory matters.
* Manage EDP, MRP/MSP, cost cards, and state-wise pricing submissions.
* Conduct market price benchmarking and track state-wise pricing changes.
* Manage excise documentation including permits, bonds, bank guarantees, and statutory submissions.
* Ensure label and packaging artwork compliance and validation.
* Monitor state excise policies and assess their impact on pricing and business operations.
* Support new state, SKU, and product launches from an excise and regulatory perspective.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Production, Legal, Marketing, and external consultants.
* Maintain comprehensive excise trackers, approvals, documentation, and regulatory records.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 5–8 years in Excise / Regulatory Affairs, preferably within the alcoholic beverages industry.
* Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of Indian State Excise regulations and processes; hands-on experience in brand/label registrations, pricing approvals, and excise licensing.
* Soft Skills: Strong stakeholder management, documentation, and follow-up skills; ability to manage multiple states, deadlines, and regulatory requirements simultaneously.

Why Consider this Opportunity?
  
  

* Lead excise compliance across a diverse and complex regulatory landscape spanning multiple Indian states.
* Drive critical regulatory processes that directly impact pricing, product launches, and market operations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to ensure seamless regulatory adherence.
* Operate in a dynamic sector with significant regulatory oversight and strategic importance.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
**About Loop**

Loop is a subscription management platform built for e-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.

We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved ~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025, followed by 2x growth again in 2026. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2027 as we accelerate toward our $100M goal.

**About the Role**

This is Loop's first dedicated legal hire, and you will be the company's sole in-house legal professional. You'll work independently, take ownership of day-to-day legal matters and build the templates, playbooks and processes needed to support Loop's growth. You'll partner directly with the Chief of Staff and work on de-risking and actively work with Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance team to remove legal roadblocks.

**Responsibilities**

* **Commercial contracts:**
  Draft, review and negotiate SaaS MSAs, Order Forms, DPAs, NDAs, vendor, partner and other business agreements across geographies.
* **Merchant negotiations:**
  Lead issue-based calls with merchants and their counsel, understand the commercial concern, explain Loop's position and agree workable fallbacks.
* **Contract standards:**
  Maintain templates and clause positions as legal or regulatory requirements change. Periodically improve the contract suite to remove inconsistencies, reflect negotiation history and improve clarity.
* **Privacy and data:**
  Support compliance with the EU GDPR, UK GDPR and applicable US state privacy laws. Align the MSA, DPA, privacy notices and incident obligations.
* **Product and consumer rules:**
  Assess cookie and tracking requirements, API and data access terms, and subscription, auto-renewal and cancellation rules across relevant markets; translate findings into product and contract actions.
* **Security and assurance:**
  Partner with Engineering, Security and Operations on PCI DSS responsibilities, SOC 2 readiness, customer security reviews and legal evidence for audits.
* **IP, employment and general advisory:**
  Support IP protection and licensing, HR policies, employment and consultant documents, and routine business contract reviews.
* **Intercompany agreements:**
  Draft, review and maintain agreements between group entities, ensuring they reflect the relevant commercial, operational and legal arrangements.
* **Litigation across geographies:**
  Coordinate litigation and dispute matters across jurisdictions with internal teams and external counsel, including tracking risks, deadlines and outcomes.
* **Legal operations and risk discovery:**
  Create intake, approval, escalation, repository and obligation-tracking SOPs. Proactively identify legal risks, rank them and drive practical mitigation with internal teams or external counsel.

**Ideal Profile**

* Law degree from a recognized institution and 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Hands-on commercial contract drafting and negotiation experience; SaaS, technology or in-house exposure is strongly preferred.
* Ability to research unfamiliar multi-jurisdictional questions, separate legal requirements from business preferences and give a clear recommendation.
* Comfortable working as a solo legal professional, setting priorities independently.
* Comfort speaking directly with merchants, business teams and technical stakeholders.
* Strong drafting discipline, attention to detail and judgment on when to accept, negotiate or escalate risk.
* Ownership mindset

**Perks**

* Annual Leaves
* Free lunch and snacks
* Annual company retreat
* Insurance

description:

* Exposure to working with highly regulated entities likes BFSI, NBFC etc.
* Some exposure to Indian employment and labor law matters is advantageous.
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to make complex legal issues clear, concise and commercially actionable.
* Excellent professional English, both written and spoken.

**Ways of working**

* This position requires involvement with Business Partners, Leadership team and day-in day-out negotiations with Client Counsel. The Job requires an individual who enjoys ACCOUNTABILITY, has a solution-oriented mindset.
* Pressure handling and expectation management is key, Individual needs to have a clear understanding of commercial implications from a legal and business standpoint.
* This is a role like no other, compelling and stimulating. Each case has new challenges and complexities but intellectually rewarding with an exposure to learn from a team of intelligent and sharp individuals locally and worldwide.

**Location**
Gurgaon, DLF Cyber ParkIndia

At Kantar we have an integrated way of rewarding our people based around a simple, clear and consistent set of principles. Our approach helps to ensure we are market competitive and also to support a pay for performance culture, where your reward and career progression opportunities are linked to what you deliver.
  
  
We go beyond the obvious, using intelligence, passion and creativity to inspire new thinking and shape the world we live in. Apply for a career that’s out of the ordinary and join us.
  
  
We want to create an equality of opportunity in a fair and supportive working environment where people feel included, accepted and are allowed to flourish in a space where their mental health and well being is taken into consideration.
  
  
We want to create a more diverse community to expand our talent pool, be locally representative, drive diversity of thinking and better commercial outcomes.
  
  
Kantar is the world’s leading data, insights and consulting company. We understand more about how people think, feel, shop, share, vote and view than anyone else. Combining our expertise in human understanding with advanced technologies, Kantar’s 30,000 people help the world’s leading organisations succeed and grow.

title: Chief Legal & Compliance Officer - Research, Investment Advisory, Stock Broking
description:
**About Univest**

Univest is a Series A-funded, profitable fintech startup based in Gurgaon. Across our group entities, we run multiple SEBI-registered business lines: research and investment advisory, stock broking, and algo trading. We are also expanding into new business lines.

**Key responsibilities: Compliance and Regulatory**

1. Regulator relations: Act as the designated compliance officer and main contact for SEBI, the exchanges and depositories across all group entities. Own every filing and submission, from daily and periodic exchange and depository reporting for broking to inspections, audits and responses to regulatory queries.
2. Research and advisory: Keep the research and investment advisory businesses compliant with SEBI's research analyst and investment adviser rules, including how recommendations, disclosures, client suitability and fees are handled and communicated.
3. Stock broking: Ensure broking operations meet SEBI and exchange requirements, including client onboarding and KYC, client fund and margin controls, trade surveillance and sales practices that prevent mis-selling.
4. Algo trading: Own compliance for the algo trading business, including exchange and SEBI approvals, controls on strategies and their performance claims, and the records regulators can inspect.
5. App-first products: Review app screens, onboarding flows, notifications and pricing changes before they go live. Work with product, tech and marketing from the start of every new product, feature or pricing change.
6. Marketing and performance communication: Make sure all customer-facing communication, including performance-marketing campaigns, meets SEBI's advertising and performance-communication rules.
7. New business lines: Lead compliance for every new business line the group launches, from registrations and approvals to day-to-day compliance once it is live. Ensure each entity also meets RBI or other regulator requirements where they apply.
8. Controls: Run internal audits, AML/CFT monitoring and insider-trading controls. Own data protection under the DPDP Act and cybersecurity compliance under SEBI's CSCRF.
9. Grievances: Handle investor and customer complaints through SCORES and ODR.
10. Governance: Track regulatory changes, brief leadership on their impact, and report quarterly to the Board and Audit Committee.

**Key responsibilities: Legal**

1. Client-facing legal documents: Own the legal terms for each business line, such as research and advisory client agreements, broking terms, algo product terms, privacy policies and disclaimers.
2. Legal risk on launches: Advise on legal risk for new products, features, pricing and campaigns alongside the compliance review.
3. Disputes and proceedings: Manage litigation, arbitration and regulatory proceedings, including SEBI, SAT and exchange arbitration matters, and coordinate external counsel.
4. Notices and enforcement: Handle legal notices, customer disputes and enforcement actions, and report exposure and outcomes to leadership.
5. Group structure: Oversee corporate and secretarial compliance across group entities, including for new entities set up for new business lines.

**What success looks like**

1. 100% compliance across research, advisory, broking, algo trading and every new product and business line.
2. Clear, documented compliance processes that every team follows, so compliance is embedded in how the company works.
3. All filings on time, with no penalties.
4. Clean SEBI and exchange inspections and audits.
5. App screens, features and marketing campaigns cleared within agreed timelines.
6. Complaints on SCORES and ODR resolved within SEBI timelines.
7. Contracts and legal requests handled within agreed timelines.
8. Litigation and disputes managed with no adverse outcomes from avoidable legal exposure.

**Who we are looking for**

1. 15+ years in compliance at SEBI-registered intermediaries, across both research/advisory and broking.
2. Has personally handled SEBI inspections and exchange relationships.
3. Hands-on legal experience in litigation or arbitration, and in managing external counsel.
4. Hands-on: comfortable reviewing app screens and campaigns, not just policies.
5. Has worked closely with performance marketing teams. This is a big plus.
6. Experience in a digital or app-first business is a plus.
7. Exposure to algo trading compliance is a plus, since we run an algo business.
8. Brownie points if you are AI-first and already use AI tools to work faster and smarter on compliance and legal work.

**Qualifications**

1. Required: LL.B/LL.M. CS or CA is acceptable only alongside demonstrated hands-on legal experience.
2. Required: NISM Series III-A.
3. Preferred: NISM Series XV (Research Analyst) and X-A/X-B (Investment Adviser).

description:
**We’re Hiring | Legal Associate Manager**

**Tuskh Law & Associates | Hauz Khas, New Delhi | Full-time | On-site**

Tuskh Law & Associates is looking for a driven and capable
**Legal Associate Manager**

to manage and oversee the delivery of litigation matters across the firm. This is a hands-on role for a legal professional with strong practical litigation experience, sound knowledge of court procedures and the ability to manage people, court-related activities and end-to-end execution of legal matters. The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing a legal team, coordinating with briefing and arguing counsel, handling court-related responsibilities and independently taking ownership of the firm's litigation assignments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Litigation Management & Court Coordination**

* Manage and oversee litigation matters before various courts, tribunals and judicial/quasi-judicial authorities.
* Coordinate and, where required, personally attend court proceedings, hearings, filings, mentioning and other procedural activities.
* Monitor case listings, hearing dates, filing deadlines, compliance requirements and matter progress.
* Coordinate with arguing counsel, briefing counsel, court clerks, clients and external stakeholders.
* Ensure that matters are properly briefed and all necessary documents, pleadings and supporting records are prepared ahead of hearings.

**2. End-to-End Case Delivery**

* Take ownership of the firm's litigation matters from initial assessment and strategy to drafting, filing, hearings and closure.
* Oversee the preparation and review of petitions, replies, written statements, rejoinders, applications, affidavits, legal notices and other pleadings.
* Ensure that every matter progresses in accordance with agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Identify procedural and substantive legal issues and work towards practical solutions.

**3. Team Management & Supervision**

* Supervise and coordinate with associates, junior advocates, legal executives and interns working on litigation matters.
* Allocate assignments, establish priorities and monitor individual and team performance.
* Review research, drafting and case preparation undertaken by team members.
* Ensure effective coordination between team members and minimise delays in execution.
* Guide and mentor junior team members while building an accountable and delivery-oriented legal team.

**4. Legal Operations & Process Management**

* Establish and maintain effective systems for case tracking, hearing management, documentation and internal reporting.
* Maintain updated matter records, litigation trackers, case summaries and status reports.
* Monitor workload, resource allocation and timelines across ongoing matters.
* Identify operational gaps and introduce processes to improve the efficiency of legal delivery.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on matter progress, team performance and pending deliverables.

**5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with clients to understand matter requirements and communicate progress.
* Ensure timely responses to client queries and appropriate follow-up on pending information and documentation.
* Participate in client meetings and discussions relating to litigation strategy and case progress.
* Maintain professional relationships with external counsel, court officials and other relevant stakeholders.

**Candidate Profile & Experience**

* LL.B. from a recognised university or institution.
* **3–5+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience**

  , with substantial exposure to litigation and court practice.
* Practical experience handling matters before District Courts, the Delhi High Court, tribunals and other judicial forums.
* Strong understanding of civil, criminal and commercial litigation procedures.
* Demonstrated experience in legal drafting, pleadings, case preparation and court-related activities.
* Prior experience coordinating or supervising junior associates, advocates or legal teams will be preferred.
* Ability to independently manage multiple matters and ensure timely delivery.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving and organisational skills.
* Proficiency in legal research platforms, e-filing systems and court-related digital platforms.
* Bar Council enrolment and applicable qualification, wherever applicable to the candidate's practice.

﻿

**What We Are Looking For**

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have genuine, hands-on litigation experience and a sound understanding of courtroom practice.
* Can take ownership of matters rather than merely coordinate assignments.
* Are capable of managing people, delegating responsibilities and ensuring accountability.
* Can balance legal quality with execution timelines.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced law firm environment.
* Be a team player and ready to grow with the law firm.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Any Packaging is a manufacturing company specializing in a wide range of industrial packaging products, including compostable bags, garbage bags, and various types of industrial poly bags. The company produces shrink films, stretch films, industrial printed packaging, blisters, packaging trays, and material handling trays for diverse sectors. Its portfolio also includes vacuum forming products, auto parts, ESD/anti-static trays, e-rickshaw roofs, insulation foam parts, suction pipes, PVC and drain pipes, and soundproof compressor jackets. Any Packaging further offers labels, stickers, and other customized packaging solutions to meet varied customer needs. Candidates can explore additional details about products and services on the company’s website.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida. The Production Manager will oversee daily manufacturing operations, plan and schedule production activities, and ensure that output meets quality standards, delivery timelines, and safety requirements. Responsibilities include managing shop-floor teams, coordinating with procurement and maintenance to minimize downtime, and optimizing resource utilization, workflows, and machine efficiency. The role involves monitoring production metrics, implementing process improvements, and supporting adherence to regulatory and environmental guidelines. The Production Manager will also collaborate with quality control and logistics teams to maintain consistent product quality and timely dispatch.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong production management skills, including planning, scheduling, and overseeing shop-floor operations in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with process optimization, lean manufacturing, or continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce waste.
* Knowledge of industrial packaging materials and processes, such as poly bags, films, trays, vacuum forming, and related plastic products.
* Ability to manage and motivate cross-functional teams, with skills in leadership, performance management, and conflict resolution.
* Competence in quality assurance, safety regulations, and compliance with environmental and industry standards.
* Proficiency in using production management tools or ERP systems, and comfort with data-driven decision making.
* Strong communication and coordination skills for working with procurement, maintenance, logistics, and senior management.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial management, or a related field; relevant experience in packaging or plastics manufacturing is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced production environment.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

**Position Overview:**

Assistant Manager– Fleet Operations is responsible for supporting the day-to-day management of regional fleet operations by ensuring vehicle availability, network connectivity and efficient execution of surface transportation across the assigned region. The role coordinates closely with hubs, service centres, transport vendors and linehaul teams to ensure reliable fleet deployment, schedule adherence and operational continuity.

Reporting to the Regional Fleet Manager, the incumbent monitors fleet utilisation, vehicle performance, route execution and operational compliance while supporting cost optimisation and service quality initiatives. The role plays a key part in ensuring timely movement of shipments across the surface network through effective fleet planning, vendor coordination and operational governance.

**Job Purpose:**

To support regional fleet operations by ensuring optimum vehicle availability, efficient fleet utilisation, timely execution of linehaul schedules and compliance with operational standards, while driving service reliability, productivity and cost-effective transportation across the assigned region.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Fleet Operations Management**

* Support the day-to-day execution of regional fleet operations across hubs, branches and service centres.
* Coordinate vehicle deployment to ensure uninterrupted movement of shipments across the surface network.
* Monitor fleet availability and utilisation to support daily operational requirements.
* Ensure adherence to planned transportation schedules and operational commitments.
* Support the Regional Fleet Manager in achieving fleet performance, productivity and service objectives.

**Fleet Planning & Network Coordination**

* Coordinate vehicle placement and movement in line with scheduled milk runs, feeder routes and linehaul operations.
* Monitor route adherence, dispatch schedules and turnaround times to ensure timely network connectivity.
* Coordinate with Hub Managers, Branch Operations and Network Operations teams to optimise fleet deployment.
* Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and operational emergencies.
* Monitor capacity utilisation and recommend improvements to optimise fleet efficiency.

**Transport Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with transport vendors to ensure timely availability of vehicles as per operational requirements.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels, schedules and operational commitments.
* Support onboarding, documentation and compliance of transport vendors in line with organisational requirements.
* Ensure timely communication with vendors regarding operational changes, route requirements and service expectations.
* Escalate vendor performance issues and support implementation of corrective actions.

**Fleet Performance & Operational Control**

* Monitor fleet utilisation, vehicle turnaround times and transportation performance across the assigned region.
* Track delays, vehicle breakdowns, route deviations and service disruptions, ensuring timely resolution.
* Coordinate with operational teams to minimise transportation delays and improve network reliability.
* Ensure timely updates of fleet movement and transportation status within operational systems.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving fleet productivity, route efficiency and transportation costs.

**Fleet Compliance & Operational Governance**

* Ensure fleet operations comply with organisational policies, transportation SOPs and statutory regulations.
* Monitor validity of vehicle documentation, permits, insurance, fitness certificates and statutory compliance in coordination with transport vendors.
* Support implementation of road safety initiatives and fleet governance standards across the assigned region.
* Ensure operational documentation and transportation records are maintained accurately and updated in a timely manner.
* Escalate operational risks, compliance deviations and service issues to the Regional Fleet Manager.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Monitor transportation service performance against defined operational KPIs and service level agreements.
* Analyse transportation delays, route deviations, transit exceptions and operational bottlenecks, recommending corrective actions.
* Support implementation of process improvements to enhance fleet productivity, vehicle utilisation and network efficiency.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to improve shipment movement, transit reliability and customer service performance.
* Drive adherence to operational best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the regional fleet network.

**MIS, Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly fleet performance reports for the assigned region.
* Monitor fleet utilisation, route productivity, vehicle turnaround time, transportation costs and service performance metrics.
* Analyse operational trends and provide insights to improve fleet planning and transportation efficiency.
* Maintain accurate operational dashboards and fleet-related MIS to support management decision-making.
* Support periodic reviews of fleet performance, vendor productivity and operational effectiveness.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Regional Operations, Hub Managers, Branch Operations, Network Operations and Procurement teams to ensure seamless fleet execution.
* Coordinate with Security and Safety teams to ensure adherence to transportation safety standards.
* Support implementation of new transportation initiatives, network changes and fleet optimisation projects.
* Participate in operational reviews and contribute towards improving regional transportation performance.
* Foster strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to ensure uninterrupted operational support.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education**:

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Certification or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transportation Management or Operations Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **3–5 years** of experience in fleet operations, transportation, linehaul, logistics or supply chain operations.
* Experience in coordinating regional fleet operations, transport vendors and vehicle deployment within a high-volume logistics environment.
* Exposure to transportation planning, route management, vehicle utilisation and operational performance monitoring.
* Experience in working with transport management systems, fleet tracking tools and operational MIS.
* Strong understanding of transportation compliance, fleet productivity and logistics operations across a regional network.

**Skills & Capabilities:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Fleet Operations & Transportation Management
* Linehaul & Route Coordination
* Fleet Planning & Vehicle Utilisation
* Transport Vendor Management
* Route Performance & Network Connectivity
* Fleet MIS & Operational Reporting
* Transportation Compliance & Documentation
* Fleet Productivity & Cost Optimisation
* Safety & Security Compliance
* Microsoft Office & Fleet/Transport Management Systems

**Key Competencies:**

* Planning & Organising
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
* Decision Making
* Customer Focus
* Stakeholder Management
* Negotiation & Coordination Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Accountability & Ownership
* Adaptability & Resilience

**Key Performance Indicators:**

Vehicle availability as per operational requirement; Fleet readiness; Vehicle placement adherence

Fleet utilisation percentage; Capacity utilisation; Reduction in idle fleet

description:
**Company Description**

7Med India Pvt. Ltd. is a patient-centric organization focused on meeting the needs of renal failure patients through its Kidney Care Centers. The company was founded by passionate professionals with a background in healthcare, particularly dialysis care. 7Med India aims to provide quality treatment and increase patient knowledge about dialysis procedures to improve outcomes and quality of life for patients.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time on-site role as a Center In-Charge at the Dialysis unit located in Bahadurgarh. The Center In-Charge will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the dialysis unit, managing patient care, leading the team, and providing training to staff.

**Qualifications**

* Patient Care and Team Leadership skills
* Medicine knowledge
* Training skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience in dialysis care is a must
* Bachelor's degree/Diploma in a relevant field
* Experience as a Dialysis Technician for more than 4 Years

**KRA**

* Ensure strict adherence to clinical SOPs, infection control protocols, and PPE guidelines.
* Supervise critical dialysis processes including dialyzer priming, termination, and machine disinfection across all shifts.
* Monitor accurate documentation of vitals and patient observations before, during, and after dialysis.
* Oversee timely and correct entry of all clinical records and consents.
* Ensure proper vascular access care including dressing changes, disinfection, and cannulation practices.
* Maintain high standards of hygiene through regular monitoring of hand hygiene and aseptic techniques.
* Manage equipment upkeep including daily disinfection logs, maintenance records, and breakdown history.
* Oversee crash cart readiness including availability and validity of all critical medicines and supplies.
* Ensure proper segregation and disposal of biomedical waste as per regulatory standards.
* Supervise RO plant operations – daily monitoring of TDS/hardness, backwash, regeneration, and filter replacements.
* Enforce discipline and professionalism among clinical staff, including attendance, dress code, and training participation.
* Generate and share daily/weekly/monthly clinical reports for performance and compliance tracking.
* Must be able to perform Dialysis process when needed.

title: RMS Manager - Retail
description:
**Job Title:**
RMS Manager (Retail)

**Location:**
GIFT City, Gandhinagar

**Experience:**
5 - 10 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time (On-site)

**Function:**
Risk Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a RMS Manager to lead the end-to-end Retail RMS function for our technology-led brokerage business.

The role will be responsible for overseeing day-to-day risk management, exposure and margin controls, client risk, trading limits, exchange compliance, risk monitoring and RMS operations across the business. The role will work closely with Trading, Technology, Operations, Compliance and senior management to ensure a robust and scalable risk environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end Retail RMS operations across Equity, F&O, Commodities and other applicable trading segments.
* Monitor and manage client exposure, margin utilisation, collateral, leverage, position limits, MTM and margin shortfalls.
* Oversee implementation and monitoring of pre-trade, intraday and post-trade risk controls, including client and scrip-level limits.
* Manage risk processes relating to square-off, liquidation, margin calls, shortfalls, client defaults and exceptional exposures.
* Ensure effective risk monitoring and controls across NSE, BSE, MCX, MSEI, NCL and other relevant exchanges/depositories and market infrastructure.
* Own the implementation and monitoring of SEBI and exchange-mandated RMS requirements, including changes arising from circulars and regulatory updates.
* Work closely with Technology to ensure real-time RMS systems, risk parameters, alerts, limits, integrations and automated controls operate reliably.
* Review and approve risk parameters, exposure limits, product-level controls and margin frameworks for existing and new products.
* Monitor unusual trading activity, concentrated positions and other emerging client or market risks, and ensure timely escalation and action.
* Lead RMS response during market volatility, system incidents, exchange disruptions and significant client-risk events.
* Maintain and review RMS policies, SOPs, escalation matrices and control frameworks and ensure consistent implementation.
* Drive daily, periodic and management-level risk reporting and MIS, providing clear visibility into exposures, breaches, shortfalls and key risk indicators.
* Coordinate with Compliance, Operations, Finance, Trading and Technology on risk-related issues, audits, reconciliations and regulatory requirements.
* Build, manage and develop a strong Retail RMS team, ensuring adequate coverage, clear accountability and operational discipline.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in RMS / Risk Management within stock broking, brokerage, trading platforms, exchanges or financial markets.
* Strong hands-on experience managing retail broking RMS operations across Equity, Derivatives, Commodities etc.
* Strong understanding of margining, exposure, leverage, collateral, position limits, MTM, square-off and client default management.
* Good understanding of exchanges, clearlings and the operational/risk processes associated with exchanges and depositories.
* Strong understanding of SEBI and exchange regulations relevant to retail broking and RMS.
* Experience working with real-time RMS platforms, OMS, trading systems and technology teams.
* Proven experience managing RMS teams and handling high-volume, time-sensitive risk situations.
* Strong analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, technology-driven brokerage environment.

**Leadership**

The ideal candidate will be a strong RMS Leader who is comfortable taking ownership of real-time risk decisions, managing teams and controls, working closely with technology, and ensuring that the business remains well protected while operating at scale.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
The Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFC) Investigator performs end-to-end investigations across one or more lines of business relevant to the Investigators specific area of responsibility. In the investigative role, the Investigator conducts routine to complex investigations, including money laundering, or terrorist financing.
  
  
**Job Description**
Responsibilities for this role include completing investigations while ensuring cases meet or exceed closure and quality metrics, reporting facts of the investigation to assist in identifying potential operational or compliance risks, and completing Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR) in a timely and accurate manner for submission to regulators and/or law enforcement. This role may partner with GFC Risk Management, front line units or other stakeholders to resolve investigations. This role may ultimately report to any number of investigations teams across consumer AML.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* The GFC Investigations Manager ensures significant issues and financial crimes trends related to fraud, money laundering, or terrorist financing are effectively communicated and acted upon.
* The GFC Investigations Manager may also work closely with law enforcement, regulatory agencies and industry counterparts to proactively share intelligence, best practices, etc. Additional responsibilities for this role include capacity planning, providing leadership direction, attracting, assessing, developing, motivating and retaining a successful team.
* The GFC Investigations Manager ensures consistent quality of activities, processes and outputs by reinforcing effective review practices across the team. Activities this role performs include, but are not limited to:

+ Oversees investigative efforts, reviewing and approving cases and ensuring the delivery of timely and accurate regulatory reporting
+ Provides oversight of a team of Investigators or activities performing end-to-end investigations of financial crimes activities across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities.
+ Ensures that the completion of Suspicious Activity Reports is conducted in a timely and accurate manner for submission to regulators and/or law enforcement, while providing review and oversight
+ Reviews facts of the investigation, and escalates risk to senior stakeholders and partners with Front Line Units to resolve
+ Leads quality control functions, training, communications, guidance, monitoring scenario development/enhancement input and testing, or law enforcement liaison responsibilities in an investigative support role
+ Evaluates internal controls to ensure they are working effectively by identifying weaknesses or gaps
+ Leads or contributes to the execution of the financial crimes program, including but not limited to regulatory change, financial crimes policies and procedures management, risk assessments, issue management as well as any global or regional driven initiatives and projects
+ Oversees or assists in the development of remediation plans to strengthen controls and providing oversight to ensure they are addressed appropriately.

This position also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.
  
  

* Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company D&I goals.
* Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
* Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
* Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
* People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
* Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.

**Job Title:**
Compliance Officer - Gift City

Gift City, Gujarat

**Position Overview:**

The Compliance Associate will ensure that the Fund Management Entity (FME) in Gift City operates in full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. In addition to overseeing general compliance, the Compliance Associate will actively support the investment team by ensuring that all transactions and investment activities are compliant with IFSCA, SEBI, and international regulatory standards. This role is crucial in safeguarding the organization’s reputation, mitigating risks, and ensuring that all investment-related operations are executed smoothly within the regulatory framework.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all regulatory compliance matters for the Fund Management Entity (FME) in Gift City, including specific oversight of investment-related compliance.
* Ensure adherence to IFSCA regulations and SEBI guidelines for both the feeder fund and angel fund.

* Monitor and evaluate changes in regulatory landscapes that may impact investment activities, providing guidance to the investment team to align with new regulations.

* File accurate reports and disclosures related to investment activities and fund performance to regulatory authorities.

title: Project Manager - Adani Museum Project
description:
**Responsibilities**

* BOQ Validation & Design-to-Execution Translation
* Review and validate Bills of Quantities submitted by the exhibition design consultant at each design milestone (from schematic design onward) for completeness, technical accuracy, cost reasonableness and alignment with the approved design intent.
* Identify discrepancies, scope gaps or ambiguities in BOQs and work with the design consultant to resolve these before procurement is initiated.
* Build and maintain cost and scope benchmarks for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media, lighting and specialty finishes to sense-check BOQ submissions against market rates.
* Procurement Coordination & Partner Onboarding
* Act as the primary interface between the exhibition design team and internal procurement to convert validated BOQs into clearly scoped procurement packages.
* Define technical requirements and vendor-qualification criteria for each package (artists, specialty fabricators, AV/technology vendors, content production houses, lighting specialists, etc.) in partnership with internal procurement.
* Drive identification, evaluation and onboarding of the right partners, leveraging existing relationships with exhibition fit-out, art and specialist production vendors, and proactively scouting new or niche partners where the project calls for novel, first-of-kind execution capability — working jointly with the exhibition design consultant on this search.
* Support commercial negotiations and contracting in coordination with procurement and legal/commercial teams.
* Timeline & TAT Management
* Establish and track turnaround times (TATs) for each vendor/partner package, aligning procurement and fabrication schedules with the overall project master timeline.
* Proactively flag schedule risks arising from design changes, vendor delays or supply constraints, and drive mitigation plans jointly with the design consultant and procurement.
* Maintain an integrated exhibition execution schedule, and report progress, risks and decisions required to project leadership.
* On-ground Execution Supervision
* Supervise on-site execution of exhibition fit-out, fabrication, installation and commissioning works, ensuring strict adherence to approved designs, specifications and quality standards.
* Coordinate closely with the exhibition design consultant, execution/fabrication partners and the building construction execution team to sequence exhibition works with ongoing civil and MEP construction.
* Conduct quality checks and inspections at key milestones, and manage snag/defect closure through to handover.
* Ensure compliance with safety, statutory and regulatory requirements on site.
* Stakeholder & Cross-functional Coordination
* Serve as a key coordination point among the exhibition design consultant, internal procurement, execution partners and the building construction team to ensure integrated, conflict-free delivery.
* Escalate risks, budget deviations and critical decisions to project leadership in a timely manner.

Prepare periodic status reports/dashboards covering BOQ validation status, procurement progress, partner onboarding, TAT adherence and on-ground execution
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Interior/Exhibition Design, Engineering, or a related field; a background in Project Management is an advantage.
* 10–15 years of experience managing exhibition design and fit-out execution for museums, experience centers, flagship retail, or other large-scale cultural/experiential projects, including at least one project of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing and validating BOQs for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media and specialty finishes.
* An established network of, and prior working experience with, exhibition fabricators, artists, AV/technology vendors and specialist content/production houses, with the ability to identify and onboard new partners for novel or first-of-kind requirements.
* Hands-on experience in vendor/procurement coordination, commercial negotiation and contract management.
* Proven track record of on-ground supervision of exhibition installation and commissioning, including coordination with civil/construction teams.
* Strong project management skills, including scheduling, budgeting and risk management.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Technical understanding of exhibition design, fabrication methods, materials, lighting and AV/technology integration.
* Strong commercial acumen — able to scrutinize BOQs and costs, and negotiate effectively with vendors and partners.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong documentation and reporting discipline.
* Problem-solving mindset, comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving project environment.
* Ability to manage multiple vendor streams simultaneously while maintaining an integrated project schedule.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work seamlessly across design, procurement and construction teams.
