title: Manager Plant Accounts & Costing
description:
**Role: Manager/Senior Manager – Plant Accounts & Costing**

**Industry:**
Manufacturing Business

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Location:**
Plant-based

**Reports to:**
Financial Controller (functional); Plant Head (administrative)

**Qualification:**
B.Com, M.Com or CMA Inter

**Experience:**
7–12 years in plant / manufacturing accounting
**CTC:**
As per market standard

**1. Position Summary**

The Plant Accounts Manager is the finance owner at the plant. The role ensures that costs, inventory, yield and dispatches are accurately recorded, reconciled and reported. The incumbent manages standard costing and conversion cost per tonne, reconciles billet-to-finished yield and scrap recovery, values WIP and finished goods, computes aluminium price-variation adjustments for customer contracts, and keeps the plant compliant on stores accounting, job-work challans, invoicing checks and e-way bills.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**2.1 Standard Costing, BOM and Conversion Cost**

* Develop, maintain and periodically revise standard costs for each product, section, alloy and finish.
* Maintain accurate Bills of Material (BOM) covering consumables & others, in coordination with Production and Engineering.
* Compute conversion cost per tonne by process (casting, extrusion/rolling, ageing, anodising/powder coating, fabrication, packing), covering power, fuel/gas, labour, die cost, maintenance and overheads.
* Compare actual vs. standard cost every month and report price, usage, efficiency and overhead variances with root causes.
* Support pricing and quotation decisions with product-wise and customer-wise costing and margin analysis.

**2.2 Yield, Scrap and By-product Accounting**

* Reconcile billet-to-finished yield for every production run, shift, press/line and product family; report yield loss against norms.
* Account for process scrap, end-cuts, returns, and track scrap recovery through remelting or sale.
* Investigate yield and scrap variances jointly with Production and Quality; escalate repeat or abnormal losses with recommended corrective action.
* Account for by-products and sale of scrap at correct values with proper documentation and GST treatment.
* Track metal loss (melt loss, oxidation) and maintain a metal balance across the plant.

**2.3 Order and Job Costing; WIP and Finished Goods Valuation**

* Open and close production orders/jobs and capture material, labour, die and overhead costs against each.
* Perform order-wise and job-wise costing, including special profiles and customer-specific jobs, and analyse profitability.
* Value WIP and finished goods at month-end and year-end on a consistent, audit-ready basis (cost or NRV, whichever is lower), including ageing and provisions for slow-moving, obsolete or non-conforming stock.
* Ensure the cost sheet reconciles with the general ledger and closing stock.

**2.4 Aluminium Price-Variation (LME-linked) Adjustments**

* Compute aluminium price-variation adjustments for customer contracts as per agreed formulaes.
* Prepare supporting workings, obtain approvals and coordinate with Sales and Commercial on debit/credit notes or invoice adjustments.
* Track open price-variation claims and recoveries; highlight metal price exposure to the CFO.

**2.5 Cost Records and Cost Audit**

* Maintain cost records and cost accounting statements in the prescribed format, where applicable under the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules.
* Support the statutory auditors, internal auditors and GST/other authorities with schedules, reconciliations and explanations.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations relating to the plant.

**2.6 Inventory Control and Physical Verification**

* Supervise periodic, cycle and year-end physical stock counts of raw material, WIP, finished goods, stores and spares.
* Reconcile physical stock with books, investigate differences, and obtain approvals for adjustments.
* Maintain inventory accuracy of 99% or better.
* Identify and report slow-moving, obsolete and excess stock.

**2.7 Stores and Goods Receipt Accounting**

* Ensure timely and correct goods-receipt (GRN) accounting for metal, chemicals, spares and consumables, including three-way match of PO, GRN and invoice.
* Verify weighment, quality acceptance and rate checks on inward material; track unbilled receipts and pending GRNs.
* Review stores issues against production orders and control consumption of consumables and spares.

**2.8 Job-work Challans and Dispatch Documentation**

* Manage job-work challans for material sent out and received; track ageing and ensure timely return and reconciliation.
* Check dispatch documents and invoices for correct quantity, rate, price-variation component, HSN, GST and terms before release.
* Reconcile dispatches with finished-goods stock and sales records; follow up on short or excess dispatch and customer rejections.
* Ensure e-way bill generation and compliance for all movements, including inter-plant transfers, job-work and sales, with no delays or penalties.

**2.9 Plant Expense Control**

* Monitor plant budgets for power, fuel, labour, repairs and maintenance, consumables and other overheads; report variances and trends.
* Verify plant-level expense bookings and bills in line with policy and delegation of authority.
* Track capital expenditure, capital work-in-progress and capitalisation at the plant.
* Recommend cost-reduction opportunities (energy, yield, die life, scrap recovery, productivity).

**2.10 Reporting and MIS**

* Submit the monthly cost-per-tonne report, yield variance report and plant P&L on schedule, within the finance close calendar.
* Provide a monthly inventory, scrap and variance analysis to the COO and CFO.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and annual planning for the plant.

**2.11 Compliance, Controls and Systems**

* Ensure internal financial controls and SOPs are followed at the plant; support internal audit.
* Assist with GST, TDS and other indirect and direct tax compliance related to plant transactions.
* Ensure data integrity in the ERP (costing, inventory, production and stores modules) and recommend process improvements.
* Lead and develop the plant accounts team.

**3. Skills and Competencies**

**Technical**

* Strong knowledge of cost accounting, standard costing, variance analysis, and inventory valuation (Ind AS 2).
* Understanding of aluminium process flow: or any other manufacturing Environment.
* Working knowledge of GST, e-way bill rules, job-work provisions.
* Proficient in ERP (SAP, ERP, Tally Prime or equivalent) and advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations).

**Behavioural**

* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and a strong reconciliation discipline.
* Ability to work with Production, Quality and Stores at shop-floor level and influence without direct authority.
* Integrity and independence in reporting, with the confidence to challenge variances.
* Leadership, team development and clear communication with plant and corporate management.
* Deadline orientation and ability to manage month-end pressure.

**4. Qualifications and Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.Com/M.Com & CMA Inter (completed CMA is an advantage).
* **Experience:**
  7–12 years in plant or manufacturing accounting, preferably in metals, aluminium, steel, or process / continuous-production industries.

**5. Working Conditions**

* Based at the plant; regular shop-floor presence for stock verification, yield review and process understanding.
* Extended hours during month-end, quarter-end, year-end close and audits.
* Occasional travel to corporate office or other plants.

For us, it is all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.

**Asset Management**

As the firm’s primary investment area, Goldman Sachs Asset & Wealth Management (GSAM) provides investment and advisory services for some of the world’s leading pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors, and individuals, for which we oversee more than $2 trillion in assets under supervision. Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, GSAM provides clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long-term performance. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success.

GSAM Private Credit is one of the world’s largest alternative credit investing platforms with approximately $125bn of AUM and investment professionals based in the US, Europe, Asia, and Australia. GSAM Private Credit is a dynamic platform with significant cross-pollination across strategies – Direct Lending, Hybrid Capital, Asset Finance and IG Corporate and Infrastructure Credit.

**Asset Finance**

Asset Finance (“AF”) is a growth area within Private Credit, focusing on financings backed by physical and/or financial collateral. AF provides flexible funding solutions across the capital structure, engaging in a broad range of asset-based strategies that include RE financings/ specialty mortgages, consumer and SME loans, fund financing, trade receivables, hard asset financings and more.

This is an opportunity to play an important role in the development and growth of our global asset finance platform and get exposure to a global team. The role we are looking for will encompass asset management and portfolio monitoring as we deploy client capital and grow the AF business.

**Role Description & Responsibilities**

AF is currently seeking Analysts to specialize in asset management across our portfolio and overall portfolio monitoring, a critical element of the overall investment process. This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position:

* Produce and present periodic portfolio company monitoring, including but not limited to asset performance, comparison vs. underwriting case, and key company developments, particularly those with implications for investment performance
* Maintain portfolio company models as part of the asset management process
* Track company compliance with financial covenants
* Prepare and maintain portfolio analytics for portfolio management purposes
* Participate in strategic projects regarding portfolio management, portfolio monitoring and performance tracking.
* Prepare and maintain investment and fund level statistics used for internal tracking, investor reporting as well as marketing materials

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital, and ideas to help our clients, shareholders, and the communities we serve to grow. **About Parexel**

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Financial Analyst II (Finance Business Partner) to join our team in **Bengaluru** in a **hybrid** capacity. As a Financial Analyst II, you will support the financial performance of clinical research projects, helping project leaders make sound, data-driven decisions that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in project financial analysis, revenue accuracy, forecasting, and financial controls. You will partner with cross-functional teams, apply current financial and accounting standards, and contribute to project financial management from post-award budgeting through ongoing performance review.

Your responsibilities will center on delivering accurate, timely insight into project economics, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence project financial outcomes.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through forecasting, revenue management, and disciplined budget control. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Financial Analyst II can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create accurate, transparent, and timely financial analysis to support project leadership in decision-making, including retrospective analysis and forward-looking recommendations on simpler projects and contract types
* For less complex projects, facilitate the monthly revenue cycle, including review of units, forecasts, unit prices, and revenue recognition, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and forecasts align with operational plans
* Complete variance analyses with insight, identifying forecast risks and opportunities to improve the project revenue outlook
* Provide financial status updates and respond to client financial reporting needs for assigned projects
* For less complex projects, monitor balance sheet positions, working with project teams to keep balances current and improve DSO and cash flow
* Put steps in place with project teams to manage pass-through costs within project budgets, including triggering changes in scope as needed
* Maintain, produce, and communicate meaningful project financial metrics, and lead monthly project performance reviews with project leads and teams covering forecast, labor, margin, billing, and outlook
* Initiate, build, and review change in scope activity, and maintain simpler project budgets in relevant tools from post-award onward
* Review labor assumptions for volume and mix, encourage accurate time charging, and monitor resource levels and their margin implications
* Complete revenue control testing, including SOX and audit-related testing, as required

**Candidate Profile**

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

* Strengths in financial analysis, forecasting, variance analysis, and business partnering
* Experience thriving in a complex, fast-paced, matrix environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams, build rapport with project leadership, and communicate clearly
* A partnering mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with Excel, PowerPoint, and financial performance systems such as Hyperion

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant and progressive finance roles with a strong analytical and partnering track record
* 2+ years in finance, with exposure to project or contract financial management
* Understanding of current financial and accounting standards, policies, and controls
* Strong experience with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with financial performance systems (e.g., Hyperion)
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CA, MBA, or other equivalent qualification
* Familiarity with the life sciences or clinical research industry, its lines of business, and industry trends

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - Healthcare Analytics and Model Validation - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – Healthcare Analytics & Model Validation, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class Actuarial and Analytics services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our Actuarial and Analytics team delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, model governance and help organizations make better business decisions through data driven insights. The role will focus on independent model validation, healthcare analytics, and model risk management activities across financial, operational, predictive, forecasting, and AI/ML models. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements.
  
  
Within our growing team, members work alongside healthcare, actuarial, data science, and business stakeholders to assess model methodologies, assumptions, data quality, performance, documentation, and governance frameworks. The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to advanced analytical techniques, healthcare economics, predictive modeling, and emerging AI/ML applications while contributing to critical business decisions.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals comes from diverse backgrounds and is committed to being trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager in Actuarial and Analytics team, your role involves developing, implementing and reviewing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
On engagements, you will:
  
  

* Be responsible for providing high-quality results and generating effective solutions, working along with Senior Consultants, Managers, Senior Managers and Engagement Partners in delivering the project.
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members.
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagements are delivered within the designated time.
* Deliver engagements in line with EY values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards.
* Set and oversee team priorities, drive communication of project progress and risks, and monitor margins to ensure efficient resource utilization and delivery performance.
* Collaborate effectively with client teams, data scientists, business users, and other EY professionals.

Within the actuarial and analytics practice you will:
  
  

* Validate and review healthcare cost forecasting and claims prediction models.
* Review claims cost and utilization forecasting methodologies.
* Assess budget planning and financial forecasting models.
* Evaluate reimbursement optimization and revenue cycle analytics models.
* Review Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) detection models and analytical frameworks.
* Support validation of AI/ML models used in healthcare decision-making.
* Review analysis performed on large healthcare datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and model performance issues.
* Perform ad hoc analytical projects and research activities.
* Stay informed of current developments in healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, AI/ML, and model governance.
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/geography.
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving abilities, the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, having a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS Actuarial and Analytics team.
  
  
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Excellent leadership skills to manage the engagement and ensure smooth delivery.
* Can independently investigate and challenge model assumptions.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Thrive in collaborative and client-facing environments.
* Are passionate about continuous learning and innovation.
* Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality standards.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 7+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, predictive modelling, model validation, actuarial analytics, risk analytics, data science, or related quantitative fields.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of statistical, forecasting, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, Power Query, advanced formulas, data modelling, data validation, and VBA/macros.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills.
* Ability to interpret complex quantitative results and communicate findings effectively.
* Experience of team management and project delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in US healthcare, health insurance, or managed care organizations.
* Exposure to healthcare claims analytics, medical cost forecasting, utilization management, or provider analytics.
* Experience reviewing AI/ML models and predictive analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks and model governance standards.
* Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial health insurance, and provider reimbursement processes.
* Experience in presenting analytical findings and validation conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* Exposure to cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience using Python and/or SAS for analytics, model development, or validation activities.
* Experience performing data quality reviews and quantitative testing.
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Strong knowledge of healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, data science, and model validation practices.
  
  
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent healthcare analytics experience in leading engagement with recognized health insurers and healthcare service providers.
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Cost Analyst
description:
**Role Overview:**

  

We are seeking a highly analytical, detailed oriented product cost analyst having good know-how of MAHLE products and related manufacturing processes (e.g. Injection molding, stamping, casting, machining etc.) to support conducting detailed cost benchmarking analysis, target costing activities and cost optimization initiatives across programs and products within BU2 (Thermal & Fluid Systems).

This role plays a key part in improving product cost efficiency through deep analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and effective use of Teamcenter Product Cost Management (TcPCM).

  

**Your Contribution:**

  

* Develop target cost models for NEW and existing MAHLE products using Siemens Team Center Product Cost Management (TcPCM) software.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and support design-to-cost activities with product engineering, manufacturing & purchasing teams.
* Conduct benchmarking and teardown analysis of competitor products and generate comparative cost insights.
* Create detailed “should-cost” / “zero-based cost” estimates for components/assemblies of various manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, casting, stamping, machining, etc.) including electronic components (e.g. PCBs, wire harness, etc.)
* Develop and standardize “Master” cost calculations in TcPCM by integrating technical inputs.
* Generate cost performance reports to monitor variances against targets (gap analysis) and recommend findings, potential actions to internal stakeholders.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and manufacturing innovations to ensure cost models remain current and competitive.
* Ensure compliance with MAHLE internal processes, standards, audits, documentation systems, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**Your Experience and Qualification:**

  

* Overall Experience: 6 to 13 years. (Note: Designation and Grade will be finalized based on the candidature)
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g. Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Electrical or similar)
* Proficiency in interpreting technical drawings, design specifications and BOM structures. Know-how of MAHLE thermal & fluid system products.
* Good engineering acumen and understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g. Injection molding plastics, Sheet metal, Casting, Machining etc.). Tooling know-how.
* Basic know-how of MTM Study (e.g. cycle time, TACT time, lead time etc.) & factors influencing it would be a plus.
* Experience in product design & development, and familiarity with SAP is a plus.
* Experience working with Teamcenter Product Cost Management (TcPCM) or similar would be an advantage.
  

**Minimum Requirements:**

  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Passion to learn new concepts, technologies, and processes.
* Proficiency with MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Good collaboration and communication skills. Fluent written and spoken English.
  

**Why Join Us?**

  

* Opportunity to work on all current and leading MAHLE products & develop techno-commercial capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
* Gain deep exposure to Teamcenter PCM (TcPCM) and learn advanced cost engineering practices.

title: Credit Portfolio Analytics - Existing Customer Management - Analyst I
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Credit Portfolio Analyst is an entry-level position responsible for participating in a variety of portfolio monitoring activities to identify credit migration in coordination with the Risk Management team. The overall objective of this role is to assist in managing Citi's portfolio exposure to clients and counterparties globally.

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Portfolio Monitoring & Risk Analysis**

* Track portfolio performance metrics including delinquency, roll rates, losses, and utilization.
* Perform trend, vintage, and cohort analysis to identify early risk signals.
* Support creation and maintenance of risk dashboards and MIS.
  

  

**Acquisition & New Account Risk**

* Analyze performance of new account vintages by channel, product, and segment.
* Monitor early delinquency and first-payment default trends.
* Support evaluation of acquisition strategies to balance growth and risk.
* Assist in evaluating approval rate vs loss trade-offs.
* Participate in champion–challenger analysis for policy and strategy updates.
* Help document policy rationale and analytical findings.
  

  

**Existing Customer Management (ECM) Responsibilities**

* Monitor existing customer credit risk performance across ECM levers, including CLI, CLD, authorization controls, and line management etc.
* Perform segmentation, trend, and vintage analysis to identify changes in customer behavior and emerging risk signals.
* Support analytics for risk-based ECM strategies to balance spend growth, customer experience, and credit losses.
* Track post-implementation performance of ECM actions and highlight variances versus expectations.
* Quantify risk–return impact of ECM strategies, including effects on utilization, delinquency, losses, and attrition.
* Assist in diagnosing portfolio performance changes and segment-level risk drivers.

**Stakeholder Communication & Governance**

* Prepare clear, structured presentations for senior analysts and managers.
* Support documentation for risk governance and audit requirements.
* Participate in regular risk review forums as an analytical contributor.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  
  

**Experience & Education**

* 1-2 years of experience in credit card risk analytics, consumer lending, or financial analytics.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative fields.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SQL/SAS; exposure to Python preferred.
* Experience working with large datasets.
* Experience with Tableau or PowerPoint for visualization and reporting.

**Analytical & Business Skills**

* Understanding of consumer credit risk fundamentals.
* Ability to interpret data and explain results clearly.
* Structured thinking and attention to detail.
* Problem-solving skills to identify, analyze, and challenge basic problems.
* Familiarity with data interpretation and ability to challenge decisions based on data analysis.
* Ability to interpret data, make sound decisions, and challenge the basis of the analysis.

**Soft Skills**

* Willingness to learn and take increasing ownership.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication.
  

  

**General Skills:**

* Basic understanding of various risk factors including stress testing, collateral risk and volatility, concentration risks, liquidity, and wrong way risk, with demonstrated experience in reviewing these factors and challenging any discrepancies.
* Adds value and contributes to the success of the team.
* Ability to work with little direction and in a team.
* Adaptability and flexibility to respond to ad-hoc requests and changes in the regulatory environment.

title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
  
  
For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:

* Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

What We're Looking For
  
  
Required Experience:

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:

* Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.

title: Freight & Logistics Finance Analyst
description:
**Freight & Logistics Finance Analyst**

**Location:**
GBS Cochin, India

**Function:**
Freight & Logistics Finance Analyst

**Reports to:**
Operations Reporting Specialist (Finance)

**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Freight & Logistics Finance Analyst provides an independent financial control over inbound and outbound freight and logistics expenditure for client . The role ensures that invoices are valid, accurate, properly supported, consistent with contractual terms and correctly accounted for before posting and payment. The position combines finance control, logistics knowledge, data analysis and supplier management and is expected to identify overcharges, duplicate costs and process weaknesses.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Perform a documented review of 100% of applicable freight and logistics invoices before posting, using a standard control checklist and retaining appropriate evidence for audit purposes.
* Confirm that the invoice belongs to the our client legal entity, relates to a genuine shipment/service, and contains the correct supplier, invoice number, date, currency, tax treatment and relevant shipment references.
* Validate shipment details including origin, destination, shipment date, transport mode, factory/customer reference, weight, volume and/or chargeable weight against available logistics documentation.
* Verify invoiced prices against approved contracts, quotations, rate cards and agreed commercial terms. Check base freight, minimum charges, fuel/security surcharges, handling, customs/documentation, storage, demurrage, detention and other accessorial charges.
* Perform systematic duplicate and completeness checks, including duplicate invoice numbers, repeated shipment references, multiple invoices for the same shipment and charges that were already invoiced or settled previously.
* Investigate unusual, unsupported or unexpected charges and obtain sufficient documentation/calculations from the freight provider before approval.
* Challenge freight forwarders and carriers professionally where invoices do not comply with agreed rates or supporting evidence. Request corrected invoices, credit notes or explanations and follow disputes through to resolution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (CONTINUED)**

* Post invoices that have successfully passed the required controls in QAD, using the correct GL account, cost center and other required accounting dimensions, and maintain a clear audit trail.
* Maintain accurate shipment/invoice records and support a centralized freight register linking shipment ID, supplier, carrier, lane, agreed rate, expected cost, invoice, approval status and dispute/credit-note status.
* Work closely with Houten Operations and Warehouse, Finance, Procurement, GBS colleagues and logistics providers while maintaining appropriate independence from the person who requested or arranged the shipment.
* Prepare regular analysis of freight spend, including inbound versus outbound costs, supplier and lane spend, price variances, unusual charges, disputes, duplicate/incorrect invoices and recoveries. Highlight trends and cost-saving opportunities.
* Support the development of stronger procure-to-pay controls, including shipment references, automated duplicate checks, contract/rate validation, invoice matching and QAD workflow improvements.
* Continuously challenge the existing process and propose practical improvements that increase control, reduce manual work and improve the quality and timeliness of logistics cost information.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related discipline. Professional accounting qualification is an advantage.
* Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in finance/AP controls, freight audit, logistics finance, procurement finance, supply-chain finance or a similar GBS/shared-services environment.
* Strong understanding of accounting, invoice verification, financial controls and segregation of duties, with a high level of attention to detail.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills; experience with QAD or another ERP system is preferred.
* Practical understanding of international logistics and freight processes, including air, ocean and road transport, Incoterms, chargeable weight, freight rate structures, surcharges, customs/documentation, storage, demurrage and detention.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with and challenge international suppliers professionally.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Analytical and investigative mindset — able to understand the transaction behind an invoice rather than simply checking whether an invoice appears reasonable.
* Strong ownership, integrity and independent judgement, with a clear commitment to financial control and compliance.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to negotiate and resolve invoice disputes constructively.
* Curiosity and continuous-improvement mindset; willing to question existing processes and identify opportunities for automation.
* Ability to work effectively across Finance, Operations, Logistics, Procurement and international sister companies.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* 100% of applicable freight invoices reviewed under the defined control procedure before posting.
* Timely processing of valid invoices and resolution of exceptions within agreed SLA.
* Number and value of incorrect, duplicate or unsupported invoices identified and prevented.
* Value of supplier credits, overcharges and disputed costs recovered.
* Compliance with contracted freight rates and quality/completeness of supporting documentation.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and stronger/automated invoice controls.

**ROLE ACCOUNTABILITY**

The position is accountable for the quality of the financial control performed on freight invoices. It is not simply an invoice-processing role: the Analyst is expected to independently verify the underlying shipment and commercial terms, challenge unsupported costs, ensure correct accounting in QAD and escalate material or unresolved issues to the Operations Reporting Specialist (Finance) and relevant Houten stakeholders.

**Overview**
This role reports into Technology GRC leadership and supports delivery across Advisory Services, the enterprise Risk Register, and Policy Governance. The Senior Technology GRC Advisor executes risk and compliance activities with a high degree of independence and contributes to maturing the team's processes and documentation.
  
  
The role partners with AI agents in a human-in-the-loop model, using AI-assisted workflows to accelerate evidence gathering, risk documentation, and control narratives while validating outputs for accuracy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technology Risk Assessments
  
  

* Lead or support technology risk assessments to identify, assess, and manage risks, including effective data-driven reporting and tracking of risk reduction activities.
* Execute risk assessments across SOX ITGCs, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS and NYDFS control expectations.
* Plan and conduct risk assessments to identify, quantify, and prioritize technology risks.
* Translate assessment outputs into actionable treatment plans, control improvements, and executive risk narratives.

Advisory Services
  
  

* Provide cross-functional risk and control guidance on process improvement, post-implementation reviews, and remediation activities.
* Support stakeholders in interpreting requirements and embedding controls into business processes.

Risk Register
  
  

* Maintain Risk Register entries across assigned technology domains, ensuring risks are documented, owned, risk-rated, and tracked through closure.

Policy Governance
  
  

* Support policy authoring, review cadence, and exception intake, keeping policies aligned to regulatory and industry frameworks.

AI-Augmented Delivery
  
  

* Use AI-assisted workflows (human-in-the-loop) to accelerate evidence collection, risk documentation, and control narratives, validating AI output for accuracy and confidentiality.

Control Testing & Evidence
  
  

* Perform control testing and evidence collection for SOC 2, PCI DSS, and SOX ITGC programs, mapping findings to applicable framework requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum 4+ years in GRC, technology risk, IT audit, or compliance.
* Solid working knowledge of risk registers, policy governance, and advisory support within a regulated or SaaS environment.
* Working proficiency with AI-assisted tools to draft and review risk and control content, with judgment on when to validate.
* Familiarity with NIST CSF 2.0, COBIT 2019, COSO ERM, and ISO 31000.
* Strong written communication and attention to detail.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CRISC, CISA, or progress toward them).
* Working experience with GRC tooling (e.g., ServiceNow IRM, AuditBoard, OneTrust, Vanta, Drata) and control testing/evidence collection.
* Familiarity with cloud/hybrid environments (AWS, Azure) and major frameworks (SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0).
* Preferred experience in the Property Management, Multifamily Housing, SaaS, FinTech, or PropTech industries.

title: Patent Associate - Chemistry / Agrochemical
description:
**Company Description-**

United & United is a full-service boutique intellectual property law firm focused on safeguarding innovation and creativity through strategic legal support. The firm provides end-to-end solutions across patents, trademarks, copyrights, IP litigation and enforcement, licensing, transactional support, and IP portfolio strategy. With roots in five sister concerns, including United Overseas Patent Firm and United Overseas Trade Mark Company, United & United combines a strong legacy with a modern, forward-looking approach to IP law. The firm serves a diverse clientele spanning private and public companies, entrepreneurs, and institutions, tailoring solutions to the specific needs of each client. United & United also emphasizes education and knowledge-sharing, fostering continuous growth and innovation within the IP community.

**Role Description-**

The Patent Associate – Chemistry / Agrochemical will be responsible for drafting, reviewing, and prosecuting patent applications related to chemical and agrochemical inventions. This full-time, on-site role in Noida includes conducting patentability and freedom-to-operate searches, analyzing scientific literature and prior art, and preparing detailed technical and legal documentation. The associate will collaborate closely with inventors, in-house R&D teams, and senior attorneys to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, defensible patent claims. Day-to-day tasks involve advising clients on patent strategy, responding to office actions, monitoring relevant IP landscapes, and supporting enforcement or licensing activities where needed. The role also entails staying current with developments in patent law and industry trends, contributing to internal knowledge-sharing and best practices.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Drafting of Provisional and Complete Patent Specifications.
2. Drafting and filing of FER Responses and replies to Office Actions.
3. Handling Pre-grant and Post-grant Opposition proceedings, particularly in the Agrochemical sector.
4. Patent prosecution, including claim amendments and written submissions.
5. Preparing and attending hearings before the Indian Patent Office.
6. Conducting Patentability, Novelty, Prior-Art and Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) Searches.
7. Coordinating with inventors, clients and foreign associates.

**Required Skills & Experience-**

1. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in patent drafting and prosecution.
2. Strong experience in Pre-grant and Post-grant Opposition filings.
3. Good understanding of Indian Patent Law and working knowledge of US and European patent laws.
4. Technical understanding of agrochemicals, pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, chemical formulations and compositions.
5. Excellent legal drafting, analytical and communication skills.
6. Ability to independently handle patent matters and meet statutory deadlines.

Preference: Candidates with substantial experience in agrochemical patent oppositions, hearings and FTO searches will be preferred.

3. Conducting Patentability, Prior Art, and Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) searches.

5. Handling patent prosecution, including attending Patent Office hearings.
6. Coordinating with inventors and clients for technical inputs and documentation.

* **Required Skills-**

1. Registered Patent Agent (desirable but not mandatory)
2. Good understanding of patent laws, Indian Patent Act and Rules.
3. Strong technical analysis, patent drafting, and written communication skills.
4. Experience in handling Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical patent matters.

title: Associate Director Legal, South Asia
description:
**Company Description**

Are you ready to run the show? Do you find joy in the challenge of executing masterplans, focusing strategically on guest experience, revenue generation, and commercial success.

Our people are at the core of our success. Your role guarantees variety and excitement every day. At RHG, we cherish your entrepreneurial spirit, collaborative nature. We foster an inclusive and supportive culture where, together, we ensure that every moment is truly meaningful. Embrace your uniqueness as an individual in our team and explore the exciting growth opportunities we have for you and the chance to create memorable moments.

**What We Offer:**

Our commitment to being a remarkable workplace mirrors our commitment to delivering Memorable Moments. Joining RHG comes with a range of perks:

* **Special rates** for team members, their friends, and family at our hotels.
* Tailored development opportunities for everyone at all levels and all roles
* A meaningful employment contributing **to shared value, a better future, and a sustainable planet.**

  
**Job Description**

Associate Director, Legal, South Asia , supports the regional growth of Radisson Hotel Group in South Asia and protect its legal interests by

(i) Overseeing and facilitating the development and administration of management, franchise, operating and other contracts and agreements and

(ii) Managing and resolving legal issues arising operationally, as appropriate and consistent with company policies.

**Key roles and responsibilities:**

* Draft, review, negotiate and advise other teams (when necessary) on employment contracts, sales and marketing contracts and various contracts with business partners and service providers
* Assist the team during negotiations and in review of hotel agreements.
* Ensure that contracts adhere to company’s policies and standards and report material deviations for approval by reporting Manager.
* Obtain and evaluate legal advice and counsel from local attorneys who are expert in hotel development and management contract issues
* Assist in implementing policies, procedures and business practices and ensure understanding and compliance by relevant departments
* Assist in handling corporate secretary and regulatory matters of subsidiaries and affiliates registered in India.
* Drafting and review of various of default notices, reply to legal notices, vendor agreements etc.
* Assist in ensuring legal and insurance compliance for the portfolio.
* Coordinate contract database process to ensure accurate and timely tracking of key contract terms, conditions, changes, timelines, and owner information
* Assist in coordinating response and settlement of legal disputes (e.g. debt recovery, breach of contract) including, when appropriate, the selection and supervision of external counsel.
* Coordinate legal action with external counsel under the supervision and guidance of supervisor including for handling various litigations and IP related matters.
* Applying legal leverage to assist in the collection of accounts receivables
* Other miscellaneous work as assigned by supervisor.
* Must, at all times, work in a safe and harassment free manner with respect to all other Radisson colleagues.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor of law from reputable Indian university
* Admitted to practice in India
* 7-8 years of experience in corporate and commercial law.
* Hotel industry related legal experience an advantage.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).
* Strong legal drafting skills.
* Corporate secretarial knowledge and experience is an added advantage

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?**

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career -** No matter your background or experience, we invest in your **growth, learning, and career development**—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit -** Join a workplace that’s **inclusive, fun, and meaningful**. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our **Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**.

**Lead with Your Ambition -** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Enjoy benefits such as** - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide  
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family  
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

title: Legal Counsel - India
description:
**We go beyond the obvious, using intelligence, passion and creativity to inspire new thinking and shape the world we live in.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**To start a career that is out of the ordinary, please apply...**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Details**
---------------

**About Kantar**

Kantar is a leading data, insights and consulting company. We combine deep expertise in human understanding with advanced technology to help organizations understand how people think and act, and to support better decisions and sustainable growth.

**The opportunity**

We are seeking a Pragmatic Legal Counsel to support Kantar's business in India, with support to Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The role combines commercial contracting for our market research, insights and related services with advisory work on data privacy, intellectual property and employment matters. The successful candidate will be pragmatic and comfortable balancing legal risk, local market realities and business priorities.

**Key responsibilities**

**Commercial contracting and business partnering**

* Act as a proactive and trusted legal adviser to business leaders and colleagues across Client Service, Finance, HR, Marketing, Procurement, Operations and Technology.
* Draft, review and negotiate client, supplier, subcontractor, partnership, data, technology and other commercial agreements.
* Identify material legal, commercial and operational risks, recommend proportionate mitigations, and clearly distinguish legal requirements from matters requiring business risk acceptance.
* Provide practical deal support that protects Kantar while facilitating timely contracting, revenue recognition and delivery.
* Advise on contract lifecycle issues, including change control, performance concerns, disputes, termination, renewals and the use of external counsel.

**Risk, compliance and specialist advice**

* Advise on privacy and data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and applicable Rules - including role alignment for processing activity - together with cross-border data transfers, information security, confidentiality, intellectual property, use of research deliverables and other compliance matters.
* Support employment-related matters across APAC, working closely with HR and local counsel on sensitive employee issues, investigations, workplace processes and regulatory engagement.
* Protect Kantar’s intellectual property and ensure appropriate ownership and license provisions for deliverables.
* Assess when matters require escalation to Senior leadership and prepare clear risk summaries and approval papers.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments relevant to supported markets and translate them into practical guidance, templates and controls.

**Regional collaboration and legal operations**

* Support matters across APAC and, where needed, collaborate with Global Legal and specialist teams on cross-border projects.
* Develop and maintain templates, playbooks, FAQs, checklists and self-service guidance to improve consistency, reduce avoidable legal work and help business teams use approved contracting routes.
* Coordinate external counsel efficiently, including scoping instructions, monitoring spend and ensuring advice is practical and aligned with Kantar’s position.
* Contribute to legal training, knowledge sharing, process improvement, reporting and regional or global legal transformation initiatives.

**Exposure to Legal Tools & Repositories**

* Use Kantar-approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of legal work, applying independent legal judgement to all AI-assisted output.
* Use only authorized tools and approved use cases in line with Kantar's Responsible AI, data classification, privacy, information security and intellectual property requirements; never upload Kantar, client, personal, confidential or restricted information to unapproved AI tools.
* Exposure to using legal tools and repositories such as Harvey, Wordsmith, SAP and similar platforms.

**Skills and experience**

* Qualified lawyer admitted to practise in India with 3-5 years' post-qualification experience, gained in a reputable law firm and/or in-house legal team, with strong commercial contracting experience.
* Experience supporting the India business is essential; multi-jurisdictional exposure is an advantage.
* Demonstrable exposure to intellectual property rights (IPR) and Data Privacy under Indian law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and applicable Rules, ideally in a data, insights, research, consulting or technology-enabled services environment.
* Exposure to working with highly regulated entities likes BFSI, NBFC etc.
* Some exposure to Indian employment and labor law matters is advantageous.
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to make complex legal issues clear, concise and commercially actionable.
* Excellent professional English, both written and spoken.

**Ways of working**

* This position requires involvement with Business Partners, Leadership team and day-in day-out negotiations with Client Counsel. The Job requires an individual who enjoys ACCOUNTABILITY, has a solution-oriented mindset.
* Pressure handling and expectation management is key, Individual needs to have a clear understanding of commercial implications from a legal and business standpoint.
* This is a role like no other, compelling and stimulating. Each case has new challenges and complexities but intellectually rewarding with an exposure to learn from a team of intelligent and sharp individuals locally and worldwide.

**Location**

Gurgaon, DLF Cyber ParkIndia

**Kantar Rewards Statement**

At Kantar we have an integrated way of rewarding our people based around a simple, clear and consistent set of principles. Our approach helps to ensure we are market competitive and also to support a pay for performance culture, where your reward and career progression opportunities are linked to what you deliver.

We go beyond the obvious, using intelligence, passion and creativity to inspire new thinking and shape the world we live in. Apply for a career that’s out of the ordinary and join us.

We want to create an equality of opportunity in a fair and supportive working environment where people feel included, accepted and are allowed to flourish in a space where their mental health and well being is taken into consideration.

We want to create a more diverse community to expand our talent pool, be locally representative, drive diversity of thinking and better commercial outcomes.

Kantar is the world’s leading data, insights and consulting company. We understand more about how people think, feel, shop, share, vote and view than anyone else. Combining our expertise in human understanding with advanced technologies, Kantar’s 30,000 people help the world’s leading organisations succeed and grow.
